ayahs.text_uthmani: بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: bis-mil la-hhir rah-man-nir raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: الحمد لله رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, Lord of the worlds -
ayahs.transliteration: a-lham-du lil-laa-hi rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: الرحمن الرحيم
ayahs.translation: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
ayahs.transliteration: ar-rah-maa-nir raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَٰلِكِ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ملك يوم الدين
ayahs.translation: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.
ayahs.transliteration: maa-li-ki yaw-mid deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِيَّاكَ نَعۡبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسۡتَعِينُ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: اياك نعبد واياك نستعين
ayahs.translation: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
ayahs.transliteration: iyyaa-ka na-bu-du waiyyaa-ka nas-taeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱهۡدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمَ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: اهدنا الصرط المستقيم
ayahs.translation: Guide us to the straight path -
ayahs.transliteration: ih-di-nas si-raa-tal mus-taqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غَيۡرِ ٱلۡمَغۡضُوبِ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: صرط الذين انعمت عليهم غير المغضوب عليهم ولا الضالين
ayahs.translation: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have earned [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
ayahs.transliteration: si-raa-tal lazee-na a-nam-ta a-lai-him ghay-ril mag-hdoo-bi a-lai-him wa-lad daaal-leen

ayahs.text_uthmani: الٓمٓ ١
ayahs.text_simple: الم
ayahs.translation: Alif, Lām, Meem.
ayahs.transliteration: a-lif-laaam-meeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيۡبَۛ فِيهِۛ هُدٗى لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: ذلك الكتب لا ريب فيه هدي للمتقين
ayahs.translation: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allāh -
ayahs.transliteration: zaa-li-kal ki-taa-bu laa rai-ba feeh hu-dal lil-mut-taqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: الذين يؤمنون بالغيب ويقيمون الصلوة ومما رزقنهم ينفقون
ayahs.translation: Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them,
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na yu-mi-noo-na bil-ghai-bi wayuqee-moo-nas sa-laa-ta wa-mim-maa ra-zaq-naa-hum yun-fi-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبۡلِكَ وَبِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوقِنُونَ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: والذين يؤمنون بما انزل اليك وما انزل من قبلك وبالاخرة هم يوقنون
ayahs.translation: And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na yu-mi-noo-na bi-maa un-zi-la i-lai-ka wa-maaa un-zi-la min qab-li-ka wa-bi-laa-khi-ra-ti hum yoo-qi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدٗى مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك علي هدي من ربهم واولئك هم المفلحون
ayahs.translation: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-ka a-laa hu-dam mir rab-bi-him wau-laaai-ka hu-mul muf-li-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَأَنذَرۡتَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تُنذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين كفروا سواء عليهم ءانذرتهم ام لم تنذرهم لا يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who disbelieve - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na ka-fa-roo sa-waaaun a-lai-him aan-zar-ta-hum am lam tun-zi-rhum laa yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: خَتَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ وَعَلَىٰ سَمۡعِهِمۡۖ وَعَلَىٰٓ أَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ غِشَٰوَةٞۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٞ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ختم الله علي قلوبهم وعلي سمعهم وعلي ابصرهم غشوة ولهم عذاب عظيم
ayahs.translation: Allāh has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil. And for them is a great punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: kha-ta-mal laa-hu a-laa qu-loo-bi-him waa-laa sa-mi-him waa-laaa ab-saa-ri-him ghi-shaa-wa-tunw wa-la-hum a-zaa-bun azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِ وَمَا هُم بِمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: ومن الناس من يقول ءامنا بالله وباليوم الاخر وما هم بمؤمنين
ayahs.translation: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allāh and the Last Day," but they are not believers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mi-nan naa-si mai-ny ya-qoo-lu aa-man-naa bil-laa-hi wa-bi-lyaw-mil aa-khi-ri wa-maa hum bi-mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُخَٰدِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَمَا يَخۡدَعُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: يخدعون الله والذين ءامنوا وما يخدعون الا انفسهم وما يشعرون
ayahs.translation: They [think to] deceive Allāh and those who believe, but they deceive not except themselves and perceive [it] not.
ayahs.transliteration: yu-khaa-dioo-nal laa-ha wal-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo wa-maa yak-hdaoo-na il-laaa an-fu-sa-hum wa-maa ya-shu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ فَزَادَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَرَضٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمُۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡذِبُونَ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: في قلوبهم مرض فزادهم الله مرضا ولهم عذاب اليم بما كانوا يكذبون
ayahs.translation: In their hearts is disease, so Allāh has increased their disease; and for them is a painful punishment because they [habitually] used to lie.
ayahs.transliteration: fee qu-loo-bi-him ma-ra-dun fa-zaa-da-hu-mul laa-hu ma-ra-dah wa-la-hum a-zaa-bun alee-mum bi-maa kaa-noo yak-zi-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَا تُفۡسِدُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَا نَحۡنُ مُصۡلِحُونَ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: واذا قيل لهم لا تفسدوا في الارض قالوا انما نحن مصلحون
ayahs.translation: And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa qee-la la-hum laa tuf-si-doo fil ar-di qaa-looo in-na-maa nah-nu mus-li-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدُونَ وَلَٰكِن لَّا يَشۡعُرُونَ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: الا انهم هم المفسدون ولكن لا يشعرون
ayahs.translation: Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive [it] not.
ayahs.transliteration: a-laaa in-na-hum hu-mul muf-si-doo-na wa-laa-kil laa ya-shu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ ءَامِنُواْ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلنَّاسُ قَالُوٓاْ أَنُؤۡمِنُ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُۗ أَلَآ إِنَّهُمۡ هُمُ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ وَلَٰكِن لَّا يَعۡلَمُونَ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: واذا قيل لهم ءامنوا كما ءامن الناس قالوا انؤمن كما ءامن السفهاء الا انهم هم السفهاء ولكن لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: And when it is said to them, "Believe as the people have believed," they say, "Should we believe as the foolish have believed?" Unquestionably, it is they who are the foolish, but they know [it] not.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa qee-la la-hum aa-mi-noo ka-maaa aa-ma-nan naa-su qaa-looo a-nu-mi-nu ka-maaa aa-ma-nas su-fa-haaa a-laaa in-na-hum hu-mus su-fa-haaau wa-laa-kil laa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا لَقُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ شَيَٰطِينِهِمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا مَعَكُمۡ إِنَّمَا نَحۡنُ مُسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: واذا لقوا الذين ءامنوا قالوا ءامنا واذا خلوا الي شيطينهم قالوا انا معكم انما نحن مستهزءون
ayahs.translation: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We believe"; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, "Indeed, we are with you; we were only mockers."
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa la-qul lazee-na aa-ma-noo qaa-looo aa-man-naa wai-zaa kha-law i-laa shayaatee-ni-him qaa-looo in-naa maa-kum in-na-maa nah-nu mus-tah-zioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَهۡزِئُ بِهِمۡ وَيَمُدُّهُمۡ فِي طُغۡيَٰنِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: الله يستهزئ بهم ويمدهم في طغينهم يعمهون
ayahs.translation: [But] Allāh mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression [while] they wander blindly.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-hu yas-tah-ziu bi-him waya-mud-du-hum fee tu-ghyaa-ni-him ya-ma-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشۡتَرَوُاْ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلۡهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُهۡتَدِينَ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك الذين اشتروا الضللة بالهدي فما ربحت تجرتهم وما كانوا مهتدين
ayahs.translation: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-kal lazee-nash ta-ra-wud da-laa-la-ta bi-lhu-daa fa-maa ra-bi-hat ti-jaa-ra-tu-hum wa-maa kaa-noo muh-tadeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَثَلُهُمۡ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِي ٱسۡتَوۡقَدَ نَارٗا فَلَمَّآ أَضَآءَتۡ مَا حَوۡلَهُۥ ذَهَبَ ٱللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمۡ وَتَرَكَهُمۡ فِي ظُلُمَٰتٖ لَّا يُبۡصِرُونَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: مثلهم كمثل الذي استوقد نارا فلما اضاءت ما حوله ذهب الله بنورهم وتركهم في ظلمت لا يبصرون
ayahs.translation: Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allāh took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see.
ayahs.transliteration: ma-sa-lu-hum ka-ma-sa-lil la-zis taw-qa-da naa-ran fa-lam-maaa a-daaaat maa haw-la-hoo za-ha-bal laa-hu bi-noo-ri-him wa-ta-ra-ka-hum fee zu-lu-maa-til laa yub-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: صُمُّۢ بُكۡمٌ عُمۡيٞ فَهُمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: صم بكم عمي فهم لا يرجعون
ayahs.translation: Deaf, dumb and blind - so they will not return [to the right path].
ayahs.transliteration: sum-mum buk-mun u-myun fa-hum laa yar-jioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوۡ كَصَيِّبٖ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فِيهِ ظُلُمَٰتٞ وَرَعۡدٞ وَبَرۡقٞ يَجۡعَلُونَ أَصَٰبِعَهُمۡ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِم مِّنَ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقِ حَذَرَ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۚ وَٱللَّهُ مُحِيطُۢ بِٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: او كصيب من السماء فيه ظلمت ورعد وبرق يجعلون اصبعهم في ءاذانهم من الصوعق حذر الموت والله محيط بالكفرين
ayahs.translation: Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. But Allāh is encompassing of the disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: aw ka-saiyi-bim mi-nas sa-maaai fee-hi zu-lu-maa-tunw wa-ra-dunw wa-barq ya-ja-loo-na a-saa-bi-a-hum feee aa-zaa-ni-him mi-nas sa-waai-qi ha-za-ral mawt wal-laa-hu muhee-tum bil-kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَكَادُ ٱلۡبَرۡقُ يَخۡطَفُ أَبۡصَٰرَهُمۡۖ كُلَّمَآ أَضَآءَ لَهُم مَّشَوۡاْ فِيهِ وَإِذَآ أَظۡلَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ قَامُواْۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَذَهَبَ بِسَمۡعِهِمۡ وَأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: يكاد البرق يخطف ابصرهم كلما اضاء لهم مشوا فيه واذا اظلم عليهم قاموا ولو شاء الله لذهب بسمعهم وابصرهم ان الله علي كل شيء قدير
ayahs.translation: The lightning almost snatches away their sight. Every time it lights [the way] for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand [still]. And if Allāh had willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
ayahs.transliteration: ya-kaa-dul bar-qu yak-hta-fu ab-saa-ra-hum kul-la-maaa a-daaaa la-hum ma-shaw fee-hi wai-zaaa az-la-ma a-lai-him qaa-moo wa-law shaaaal laa-hu la-za-ha-ba bi-sa-mi-him waab-saa-ri-him in-nal laa-ha a-laa kul-li shaiin qadeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱعۡبُدُواْ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُونَ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: يايها الناس اعبدوا ربكم الذي خلقكم والذين من قبلكم لعلكم تتقون
ayahs.translation: O mankind, worship your Lord, who created you and those before you, that you may become righteous -
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaaiyu-han naa-su bu-doo rab-ba-ku-mul lazee kha-la-qa-kum wal-la-zee-na min qab-li-kum laal-la-kum tat-ta-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِرَٰشٗا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءٗ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزۡقٗا لَّكُمۡۖ فَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ أَندَادٗا وَأَنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: الذي جعل لكم الارض فرشا والسماء بناء وانزل من السماء ماء فاخرج به من الثمرت رزقا لكم فلا تجعلوا لله اندادا وانتم تعلمون
ayahs.translation: [He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allāh equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him].
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee jaa-la la-ku-mul ar-da fi-raa-shanw was-sa-maaaa bi-naaa anw waan-za-la mi-nas-sa-maaai maaaan faak-hra-ja bihee mi-nas sa-ma-raa-ti riz-qal la-kum fa-laa ta-ja-loo lil-laa-hi an-daa-danw waan-tum ta-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِن كُنتُمۡ فِي رَيۡبٖ مِّمَّا نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِنَا فَأۡتُواْ بِسُورَةٖ مِّن مِّثۡلِهِۦ وَٱدۡعُواْ شُهَدَآءَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: وان كنتم في ريب مما نزلنا علي عبدنا فاتوا بسورة من مثله وادعوا شهداءكم من دون الله ان كنتم صدقين
ayahs.translation: And if you are in doubt about what We have sent down [i.e., the Qur’ān] upon Our Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)], then produce a sūrah the like thereof and call upon your witnesses [i.e., supporters] other than Allāh, if you should be truthful.
ayahs.transliteration: wain kun-tum fee rai-bim mim-maa naz-zal-naa a-laa ab-di-naa fa-too bi-soo-ra-tim mim mis-lihee wa-doo shu-ha-daaaa-kum min doo-nil laa-hi in kun-tum saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِن لَّمۡ تَفۡعَلُواْ وَلَن تَفۡعَلُواْ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِي وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلۡحِجَارَةُۖ أُعِدَّتۡ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: فان لم تفعلوا ولن تفعلوا فاتقوا النار التي وقودها الناس والحجارة اعدت للكفرين
ayahs.translation: But if you do not - and you will never be able to - then fear the Fire, whose fuel is people and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: fail lam taf a-loo wa-lan taf a-loo fat-ta-qun naa-ral latee wa-qoo-du-han naa-su wa-lhi-jaa-ra-tu u-i-ddat lil-kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ كُلَّمَا رُزِقُواْ مِنۡهَا مِن ثَمَرَةٖ رِّزۡقٗا قَالُواْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي رُزِقۡنَا مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَأُتُواْ بِهِۦ مُتَشَٰبِهٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَآ أَزۡوَٰجٞ مُّطَهَّرَةٞۖ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: وبشر الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت ان لهم جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر كلما رزقوا منها من ثمرة رزقا قالوا هذا الذي رزقنا من قبل واتوا به متشبها ولهم فيها ازوج مطهرة وهم فيها خلدون
ayahs.translation: And give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow. Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before." And it is given to them in likeness. And they will have therein purified spouses, and they will abide therein eternally.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-bas-hshi-ril lazee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti an-na la-hum jan-naa-tin taj-ree min tah-ti-hal a-nhaa-ru kul-la-maa ru-zi-qoo mi-nhaa min sa-ma-ra-tir riz-qan qaa-loo haa-zal lazee ru-ziq-naa min qab-lu wau-too bihee mu-ta-shaa-bi-haa wa-la-hum fee-haaa az-waa-jum mu-ta-hha-ra-tunw wa-hum fee-haa khaa-li-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَسۡتَحۡيِۦٓ أَن يَضۡرِبَ مَثَلٗا مَّا بَعُوضَةٗ فَمَا فَوۡقَهَاۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ فَيَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَيَقُولُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلٗاۘ يُضِلُّ بِهِۦ كَثِيرٗا وَيَهۡدِي بِهِۦ كَثِيرٗاۚ وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡفَٰسِقِينَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: ان الله لا يستحي ان يضرب مثلا ما بعوضة فما فوقها فاما الذين ءامنوا فيعلمون انه الحق من ربهم واما الذين كفروا فيقولون ماذا اراد الله بهذا مثلا يضل به كثيرا ويهدي به كثيرا وما يضل به الا الفسقين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Allāh is not timid to present an example - that of a mosquito or what is smaller than it. And those who have believed know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, they say, "What did Allāh intend by this as an example?" He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby. And He misleads not except the defiantly disobedient,
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal laa-ha laa yas-ta-hyeee ai yad-ri-ba ma-sa-lam maa baoo-da-tan fa-maa faw-qa-haa faam-mal lazee-na aa-ma-noo faya-la-moo-na an-na-hul haq-qu mir rab-bi-him waam-mal lazee-na ka-fa-roo faya-qoo-loo-na maa-zaaa a-raa-dal laa-hu bi-haa-zaa ma-sa-laa yu-dil-lu bihee kasee-ranw wayah-dee bihee kasee-raa wa-maa yu-dil-lu biheee il-lal faa-siqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهۡدَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مِيثَٰقِهِۦ وَيَقۡطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: الذين ينقضون عهد الله من بعد ميثقه ويقطعون ما امر الله به ان يوصل ويفسدون في الارض اولئك هم الخسرون
ayahs.translation: Who break the covenant of Allāh after contracting it and sever that which Allāh has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth. It is those who are the losers.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na yan-qu-doo-na ah-dal laa-hi mim ba-di mee-saa-qihee wayaq-taoo-na maaa a-ma-ral laa-hu biheee ai yoo-sa-la wayuf-si-doo-na fil ard u-laaai-ka hu-mul khaa-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَيۡفَ تَكۡفُرُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَكُنتُمۡ أَمۡوَٰتٗا فَأَحۡيَٰكُمۡۖ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُحۡيِيكُمۡ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: كيف تكفرون بالله وكنتم اموتا فاحيكم ثم يميتكم ثم يحييكم ثم اليه ترجعون
ayahs.translation: How can you disbelieve in Allāh when you were lifeless and He brought you to life; then He will cause you to die, then He will bring you [back] to life, and then to Him you will be returned.
ayahs.transliteration: kai-fa tak-fu-roo-na bil-laa-hi wa-kun-tum am-waa-tan faa-hyaa-kum sum-ma yu-mee-tu-kum sum-ma yu-hyee-kum sum-maa i-lai-hi tur-jaoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَسَوَّىٰهُنَّ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖۚ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: هو الذي خلق لكم ما في الارض جميعا ثم استوي الي السماء فسويهن سبع سموت وهو بكل شيء عليم
ayahs.translation: It is He who created for you all of that which is on the earth. Then He directed Himself to the heaven, [His being above all creation], and made them seven heavens, and He is Knowing of all things.
ayahs.transliteration: hu-wal lazee kha-la-qa la-kum maa fil ar-di jameean sum-mas ta-waaa i-las sa-maaai fa-saw-waa-hun-na sa-ba sa-maa-waat wa-hu-wa bi-kul-li shaiin aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي جَاعِلٞ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ خَلِيفَةٗۖ قَالُوٓاْ أَتَجۡعَلُ فِيهَا مَن يُفۡسِدُ فِيهَا وَيَسۡفِكُ ٱلدِّمَآءَ وَنَحۡنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمۡدِكَ وَنُقَدِّسُ لَكَۖ قَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: واذ قال ربك للملئكة اني جاعل في الارض خليفة قالوا اتجعل فيها من يفسد فيها ويسفك الدماء ونحن نسبح بحمدك ونقدس لك قال اني اعلم ما لا تعلمون
ayahs.translation: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority." They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we exalt You with praise and declare Your perfection?" He [Allāh] said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know."
ayahs.transliteration: waiz qaa-la rab-bu-ka lil-ma-laaai-ka-ti in-nee jaai-lun fil ar-di khalee-fa-tan qaa-looo a-ta-ja-lu fee-haa mai yuf-si-du fee-haa wayas-fi-kud di-maaaa wa-nah-nu nu-sab-bi-hu bi-ham-di-ka wa-nu-qad-di-su la-ka qaa-la in-neee a-la-mu maa laa ta-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَعَلَّمَ ءَادَمَ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءَ كُلَّهَا ثُمَّ عَرَضَهُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ فَقَالَ أَنۢبِـُٔونِي بِأَسۡمَآءِ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: وعلم ءادم الاسماء كلها ثم عرضهم علي الملئكة فقال انبوني باسماء هؤلاء ان كنتم صدقين
ayahs.translation: And He taught Adam the names - all of them. Then He showed them to the angels and said, "Inform Me of the names of these, if you are truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: waal-la-ma aa-da-mal as-maaaa kul-la-haa sum-ma a-ra-da-hum a-lal ma-laaai-ka-ti fa-qaa-la am-bioonee bi-a-smaaai haaau-laaai in kun-tum saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ لَا عِلۡمَ لَنَآ إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمۡتَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا سبحنك لا علم لنا الا ما علمتنا انك انت العليم الحكيم
ayahs.translation: They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing, the Wise."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo su-bhaa-na-ka laa il-ma la-naaa il-laa maa al-lam-ta-naaa in-na-ka an-tal alee-mul hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ أَنۢبِئۡهُم بِأَسۡمَآئِهِمۡۖ فَلَمَّآ أَنۢبَأَهُم بِأَسۡمَآئِهِمۡ قَالَ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ غَيۡبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَأَعۡلَمُ مَا تُبۡدُونَ وَمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡتُمُونَ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: قال يادم انبئهم باسمائهم فلما انباهم باسمائهم قال الم اقل لكم اني اعلم غيب السموت والارض واعلم ما تبدون وما كنتم تكتمون
ayahs.translation: He said, "O Adam, inform them of their names." And when he had informed them of their names, He said, "Did I not tell you that I know the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth? And I know what you reveal and what you have concealed."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la yaaaaa-da-mu am-bi-hum bi-a-smaaai-him fa-lam-maa am-baa-hum bi-a-smaaai-him qaa-la a-lam a-qul la-kum in-neee a-la-mu ghai-bas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di waa-la-mu maa tub-doo-na wa-maa kun-tum tak-tu-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسۡجُدُواْ لِأٓدَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: واذ قلنا للملئكة اسجدوا لادم فسجدوا الا ابليس ابي واستكبر وكان من الكفرين
ayahs.translation: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate before Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees. He refused and was arrogant and became of the disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: waiz qul-naa lil-ma-laaai-ka-tis ju-doo li-a-a-da-ma fa-sa-ja-dooo il-laaa ib-lee-sa a-baa was-tak-ba-ra wa-kaa-na mi-nal kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقُلۡنَا يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ ٱسۡكُنۡ أَنتَ وَزَوۡجُكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَكُلَا مِنۡهَا رَغَدًا حَيۡثُ شِئۡتُمَا وَلَا تَقۡرَبَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: وقلنا يادم اسكن انت وزوجك الجنة وكلا منها رغدا حيث شئتما ولا تقربا هذه الشجرة فتكونا من الظلمين
ayahs.translation: And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. But do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qul-naa yaaaaa-da-mus kun an-ta wa-zaw-ju-kal jan-na-ta wa-ku-laa mi-nhaa ra-gha-dan hai-su shi-tu-maa wa-laa taq-ra-baa haa-zi-hish sha-ja-ra-ta fa-ta-koo-naa mi-naz zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَزَلَّهُمَا ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ عَنۡهَا فَأَخۡرَجَهُمَا مِمَّا كَانَا فِيهِۖ وَقُلۡنَا ٱهۡبِطُواْ بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوّٞۖ وَلَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُسۡتَقَرّٞ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: فازلهما الشيطن عنها فاخرجهما مما كانا فيه وقلنا اهبطوا بعضكم لبعض عدو ولكم في الارض مستقر ومتع الي حين
ayahs.translation: But Satan caused them to slip out of it and removed them from that [condition] in which they had been. And We said, "Go down, [all of you], as enemies to one another, and you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time."
ayahs.transliteration: faa-zal-la-hu-mash shai-taa-nu a-nhaa faak-hra-ja-hu-maa mim-maa kaa-naa fee wa-qul-nah bi-too ba-du-kum li-ba-din a-duw-wunw wa-la-kum fil ar-di mus-ta-qar-runw wa-ma-taaun i-laa heen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَٰتٖ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡهِۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: فتلقي ءادم من ربه كلمت فتاب عليه انه هو التواب الرحيم
ayahs.translation: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ta-laq-qaaa aa-da-mu mir rab-bihee ka-li-maa-tin fa-taa-ba a-lai-hi in-na-hoo hu-wat taw-waa-bur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡنَا ٱهۡبِطُواْ مِنۡهَا جَمِيعٗاۖ فَإِمَّا يَأۡتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّي هُدٗى فَمَن تَبِعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: قلنا اهبطوا منها جميعا فاما ياتينكم مني هدي فمن تبع هداي فلا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
ayahs.translation: We said, "Go down from it, all of you. And when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
ayahs.transliteration: qul-nah bi-too mi-nhaa jameean faim-maa ya-tiyan-na-kum min-nee hu-dan fa-man ta-bi-a hu-daaya fa-laa khaw-fun a-lai-him wa-laa hum yah-za-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: والذين كفروا وكذبوا بايتنا اولئك اصحب النار هم فيها خلدون
ayahs.translation: And those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those will be companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally."
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na ka-fa-roo wa-kaz-za-booo bi-a-ayaa-ti-naa u-laaai-ka a-shaa-bun naa-ri hum fee-haa khaa-li-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَتِيَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَأَوۡفُواْ بِعَهۡدِيٓ أُوفِ بِعَهۡدِكُمۡ وَإِيَّٰيَ فَٱرۡهَبُونِ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: يبني اسرءيل اذكروا نعمتي التي انعمت عليكم واوفوا بعهدي اوف بعهدكم وايي فارهبون
ayahs.translation: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and fulfill My covenant [upon you] that I will fulfill your covenant [from Me], and be afraid of [only] Me.
ayahs.transliteration: yaa-baneee is-raaaee-laz ku-roo ni-ma-tiyal lateee a-nam-tu a-lai-kum waaw-foo bi-a-hdeee oo-fi bi-a-hdi-kum waiyyaaya fa-rha-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَءَامِنُواْ بِمَآ أَنزَلۡتُ مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا مَعَكُمۡ وَلَا تَكُونُوٓاْ أَوَّلَ كَافِرِۭ بِهِۦۖ وَلَا تَشۡتَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِي ثَمَنٗا قَلِيلٗا وَإِيَّٰيَ فَٱتَّقُونِ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: وءامنوا بما انزلت مصدقا لما معكم ولا تكونوا اول كافر به ولا تشتروا بايتي ثمنا قليلا وايي فاتقون
ayahs.translation: And believe in what I have sent down confirming that which is [already] with you, and be not the first to disbelieve in it. And do not exchange My signs for a small price, and fear [only] Me.
ayahs.transliteration: waaa-mi-noo bi-maaa an-zal-tu mu-sad-di-qal li-maa maa-kum wa-laa ta-koo-nooo aw-wa-la kaa-fi-rim bihee wa-laa tas-hta-roo bi-a-ayaa-tee sa-ma-nan qalee-lanw waiyyaaya fat-ta-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَلۡبِسُواْ ٱلۡحَقَّ بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ وَتَكۡتُمُواْ ٱلۡحَقَّ وَأَنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: ولا تلبسوا الحق بالبطل وتكتموا الحق وانتم تعلمون
ayahs.translation: And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa tal-bi-sul haq-qa bil-baa-ti-li wa-tak-tu-mul haq-qa waan-tum ta-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱرۡكَعُواْ مَعَ ٱلرَّٰكِعِينَ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: واقيموا الصلوة وءاتوا الزكوة واركعوا مع الركعين
ayahs.translation: And establish prayer and give zakāh and bow with those who bow [in worship and obedience].
ayahs.transliteration: waaqee-mus sa-laa-ta waaa-tuz za-kaa-ta war-kaoo maar raa-kieen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ أَتَأۡمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلۡبِرِّ وَتَنسَوۡنَ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ تَتۡلُونَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: اتامرون الناس بالبر وتنسون انفسكم وانتم تتلون الكتب افلا تعقلون
ayahs.translation: Do you order righteousness of the people and forget yourselves while you recite the Scripture? Then will you not reason?
ayahs.transliteration: a-taa-mu-roo-nan naa-sa bil-bir-ri wa-tan-saw-na an-fu-sa-kum waan-tum tat-loo-nal ki-taab a-fa-laa ta-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱسۡتَعِينُواْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِۚ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلۡخَٰشِعِينَ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: واستعينوا بالصبر والصلوة وانها لكبيرة الا علي الخشعين
ayahs.translation: And seek help through patience and prayer; and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allāh]
ayahs.transliteration: was-taee-noo bis-sab-ri was-sa-laah wain-na-haa la-ka-bee-ra-tun il-laa a-lal khaa-shieen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَٰقُواْ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِ رَٰجِعُونَ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: الذين يظنون انهم ملقوا ربهم وانهم اليه رجعون
ayahs.translation: Who are certain that they will meet their Lord and that they will return to Him.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na ya-zun-noo-na an-na-hum mu-laa-qoo rab-bi-him waan-na-hum i-lai-hi raa-jioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَتِيَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَأَنِّي فَضَّلۡتُكُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: يبني اسرءيل اذكروا نعمتي التي انعمت عليكم واني فضلتكم علي العلمين
ayahs.translation: O Children of Israel, remember My favor that I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds [i.e., peoples].
ayahs.transliteration: yaa-baneee is-raaaee-laz ku-roo ni-ma-tiyal lateee a-nam-tu a-lai-kum waan-nee fad-dal-tu-kum a-lal aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُواْ يَوۡمٗا لَّا تَجۡزِي نَفۡسٌ عَن نَّفۡسٖ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يُقۡبَلُ مِنۡهَا شَفَٰعَةٞ وَلَا يُؤۡخَذُ مِنۡهَا عَدۡلٞ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: واتقوا يوما لا تجزي نفس عن نفس شيا ولا يقبل منها شفعة ولا يؤخذ منها عدل ولا هم ينصرون
ayahs.translation: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul at all, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be taken from it, nor will they be aided.
ayahs.transliteration: wat-ta-qoo yaw-mal laa taj-zee naf-sun an naf-sin shai-anw wa-laa yuq-ba-lu mi-nhaa sha-faaa-tunw wa-laa yu-kha-zu mi-nhaa ad-lunw wa-laa hum yun-sa-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ نَجَّيۡنَٰكُم مِّنۡ ءَالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَسُومُونَكُمۡ سُوٓءَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ يُذَبِّحُونَ أَبۡنَآءَكُمۡ وَيَسۡتَحۡيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمۡۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ عَظِيمٞ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: واذ نجينكم من ءال فرعون يسومونكم سوء العذاب يذبحون ابناءكم ويستحيون نساءكم وفي ذلكم بلاء من ربكم عظيم
ayahs.translation: And [recall] when We saved you [i.e., your forefathers] from the people of Pharaoh, who afflicted you with the worst torment, slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.
ayahs.transliteration: waiz naj-jai-naa-kum min aa-li fi-raw-na ya-soo-moo-na-kum sooo-al a-zaa-bi yu-zab-bi-hoo-na ab-naaaa-kum wayas-ta-hyoo-na ni-saaaa-kum wafee zaa-li-kum ba-laaaum mir rab-bi-kum azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ فَرَقۡنَا بِكُمُ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ فَأَنجَيۡنَٰكُمۡ وَأَغۡرَقۡنَآ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَأَنتُمۡ تَنظُرُونَ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: واذ فرقنا بكم البحر فانجينكم واغرقنا ءال فرعون وانتم تنظرون
ayahs.translation: And [recall] when We parted the sea for you and saved you and drowned the people of Pharaoh while you were looking on.
ayahs.transliteration: waiz fa-raq-naa bi-ku-mul bah-ra faan-jai-naa-kum waag-hraq-naaa aa-la fi-raw-na waan-tum tan-zu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ وَٰعَدۡنَا مُوسَىٰٓ أَرۡبَعِينَ لَيۡلَةٗ ثُمَّ ٱتَّخَذۡتُمُ ٱلۡعِجۡلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ وَأَنتُمۡ ظَٰلِمُونَ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: واذ وعدنا موسي اربعين ليلة ثم اتخذتم العجل من بعده وانتم ظلمون
ayahs.translation: And [recall] when We made an appointment with Moses for forty nights. Then you took [for worship] the calf after him [i.e., his departure], while you were wrongdoers.
ayahs.transliteration: waiz waaad-naa moo-saaa ar-baee-na lai-la-tan sum-mat ta-khaz-tu-mul ij-la mim ba-dihee waan-tum zaa-li-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ عَفَوۡنَا عَنكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: ثم عفونا عنكم من بعد ذلك لعلكم تشكرون
ayahs.translation: Then We forgave you after that so perhaps you would be grateful.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma a-faw-naa an-kum mim ba-di zaa-li-ka laal-la-kum tas-hku-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡفُرۡقَانَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: واذ ءاتينا موسي الكتب والفرقان لعلكم تهتدون
ayahs.translation: And [recall] when We gave Moses the Scripture and criterion that perhaps you would be guided.
ayahs.transliteration: waiz aa-tai-naa moo-sal ki-taa-ba wal-fur-qaa-na laal-la-kum tah-ta-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوۡمِهِۦ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنَّكُمۡ ظَلَمۡتُمۡ أَنفُسَكُم بِٱتِّخَاذِكُمُ ٱلۡعِجۡلَ فَتُوبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ بَارِئِكُمۡ فَٱقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡ ذَٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ عِندَ بَارِئِكُمۡ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: واذ قال موسي لقومه يقوم انكم ظلمتم انفسكم باتخاذكم العجل فتوبوا الي بارئكم فاقتلوا انفسكم ذلكم خير لكم عند بارئكم فتاب عليكم انه هو التواب الرحيم
ayahs.translation: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "O my people, indeed you have wronged yourselves by your taking of the calf [for worship]. So repent to your Creator and kill yourselves [i.e., the guilty among you]. That is best for [all of] you in the sight of your Creator." Then He accepted your repentance; indeed, He is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: waiz qaa-la moo-saa li-qaw-mihee yaa-qaw-mi in-na-kum za-lam-tum an-fu-sa-kum bit-ti-khaa-zi-ku-mul ij-la fa-too-booo i-laa baa-rii-kum faq-tu-looo an-fu-sa-kum zaa-li-kum khai-rul la-kum in-da baa-rii-kum fa-taa-ba a-lai-kum in-na-hoo hu-wat taw-waa-bur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ قُلۡتُمۡ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نُّؤۡمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ نَرَى ٱللَّهَ جَهۡرَةٗ فَأَخَذَتۡكُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَأَنتُمۡ تَنظُرُونَ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: واذ قلتم يموسي لن نؤمن لك حتي نري الله جهرة فاخذتكم الصعقة وانتم تنظرون
ayahs.translation: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allāh outright"; so the thunderbolt took you while you were looking on.
ayahs.transliteration: waiz qul-tum yaa-moo-saa lan nu-mi-na la-ka hat-taa na-ral laa-ha jah-ra-tan faa-kha-zat-ku-mus saai-qa-tu waan-tum tan-zu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ بَعَثۡنَٰكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ مَوۡتِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: ثم بعثنكم من بعد موتكم لعلكم تشكرون
ayahs.translation: Then We revived you after your death that perhaps you would be grateful.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma baas-naa-kum mim ba-di maw-ti-kum laal-la-kum tas-hku-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَظَلَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡغَمَامَ وَأَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلۡوَىٰۖ كُلُواْ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنَٰكُمۡۚ وَمَا ظَلَمُونَا وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: وظللنا عليكم الغمام وانزلنا عليكم المن والسلوي كلوا من طيبت ما رزقنكم وما ظلمونا ولكن كانوا انفسهم يظلمون
ayahs.translation: And We shaded you with clouds and sent down to you manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not - but they were [only] wronging themselves.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-zal-lal-naa a-lai-ku-mul gha-maa-ma waan-zal-naa a-lai-ku-mul man-na was-sal-waa ku-loo min taiyi-baa-ti maa ra-zaq-naa-kum wa-maa za-la-moo-naa wa-laa-kin kaa-nooo an-fu-sa-hum yaz-li-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا ٱدۡخُلُواْ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةَ فَكُلُواْ مِنۡهَا حَيۡثُ شِئۡتُمۡ رَغَدٗا وَٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡبَابَ سُجَّدٗا وَقُولُواْ حِطَّةٞ نَّغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ خَطَٰيَٰكُمۡۚ وَسَنَزِيدُ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: واذ قلنا ادخلوا هذه القرية فكلوا منها حيث شئتم رغدا وادخلوا الباب سجدا وقولوا حطة نغفر لكم خطيكم وسنزيد المحسنين
ayahs.translation: And [recall] when We said, "Enter this city [i.e., Jerusalem] and eat from it wherever you will in [ease and] abundance, and enter the gate bowing humbly and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens [i.e., sins].' We will [then] forgive your sins for you, and We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]."
ayahs.transliteration: waiz qul-nad khu-loo haa-zi-hil qa-rya-ta fa-ku-loo mi-nhaa hai-su shi-tum ra-gha-danw wad-khu-lul baa-ba suj-ja-danw wa-qoo-loo hit-ta-tun nag-hfir la-kum kha-taayaa-kum wa-sa-na-zee-dul muh-sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبَدَّلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ قَوۡلًا غَيۡرَ ٱلَّذِي قِيلَ لَهُمۡ فَأَنزَلۡنَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ رِجۡزٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡسُقُونَ ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: فبدل الذين ظلموا قولا غير الذي قيل لهم فانزلنا علي الذين ظلموا رجزا من السماء بما كانوا يفسقون
ayahs.translation: But those who wronged changed [those words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them, so We sent down upon those who wronged a punishment [i.e., plague] from the sky because they were defiantly disobeying.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bad-da-lal lazee-na za-la-moo qaw-lan ghai-ral lazee qee-la la-hum faan-zal-naa a-lal lazee-na za-la-moo rij-zam mi-nas sa-maaai bi-maa kaa-noo yaf-su-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَإِذِ ٱسۡتَسۡقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوۡمِهِۦ فَقُلۡنَا ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡحَجَرَۖ فَٱنفَجَرَتۡ مِنۡهُ ٱثۡنَتَا عَشۡرَةَ عَيۡنٗاۖ قَدۡ عَلِمَ كُلُّ أُنَاسٖ مَّشۡرَبَهُمۡۖ كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ مِن رِّزۡقِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: واذ استسقي موسي لقومه فقلنا اضرب بعصاك الحجر فانفجرت منه اثنتا عشرة عينا قد علم كل اناس مشربهم كلوا واشربوا من رزق الله ولا تعثوا في الارض مفسدين
ayahs.translation: And [recall] when Moses prayed for water for his people, so We said, "Strike with your staff the stone." And there gushed forth from it twelve springs, and every people [i.e., tribe] knew its watering place. "Eat and drink from the provision of Allāh, and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zis tas-qaa moo-saa li-qaw-mihee fa-qul-nad rib bi-a-saa-kal ha-ja-ra fan-fa-ja-rat mi-nhus-na-taaa as-hra-ta ay-nan qad a-li-ma kul-lu u-naa-sim mash ra-ba-hum ku-loo was-hra-boo mir riz-qil laa-hi wa-laa ta-saw fil ar-di muf-sideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ قُلۡتُمۡ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نَّصۡبِرَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامٖ وَٰحِدٖ فَٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُخۡرِجۡ لَنَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مِنۢ بَقۡلِهَا وَقِثَّآئِهَا وَفُومِهَا وَعَدَسِهَا وَبَصَلِهَاۖ قَالَ أَتَسۡتَبۡدِلُونَ ٱلَّذِي هُوَ أَدۡنَىٰ بِٱلَّذِي هُوَ خَيۡرٌۚ ٱهۡبِطُواْ مِصۡرٗا فَإِنَّ لَكُم مَّا سَأَلۡتُمۡۗ وَضُرِبَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلذِّلَّةُ وَٱلۡمَسۡكَنَةُ وَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٖ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ يَكۡفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقۡتُلُونَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَواْ وَّكَانُواْ يَعۡتَدُونَ ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: واذ قلتم يموسي لن نصبر علي طعام وحد فادع لنا ربك يخرج لنا مما تنبت الارض من بقلها وقثائها وفومها وعدسها وبصلها قال اتستبدلون الذي هو ادني بالذي هو خير اهبطوا مصرا فان لكم ما سالتم وضربت عليهم الذلة والمسكنة وباءو بغضب من الله ذلك بانهم كانوا يكفرون بايت الله ويقتلون النبين بغير الحق ذلك بما عصوا وكانوا يعتدون
ayahs.translation: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we can never endure one [kind of] food. So call upon your Lord to bring forth for us from the earth its green herbs and its cucumbers and its garlic and its lentils and its onions." [Moses] said, "Would you exchange what is better for what is less? Go into [any] settlement and indeed, you will have what you have asked." And they were covered with humiliation and poverty and returned with anger from Allāh [upon them]. That was because they [repeatedly] disbelieved in the signs of Allāh and killed the prophets without right. That was because they disobeyed and were [habitually] transgressing.
ayahs.transliteration: waiz qul-tum yaa-moo-saa lan nas-bi-ra a-laa taaa-minw waa-hi-din fa-du la-naa rab-ba-ka yuk-hrij la-naa mim-maa tum-bi-tul ar-du mim baq-li-haa wa-qis-saaai-haa wa-foo-mi-haa waa-da-si-haa wa-ba-sa-li-haa qaa-la a-tas-tab-di-loo-nal lazee hu-wa ad-naa bil-lazee hu-wa khayr ih-bi-too mis-ran fain-na la-kum maa saal-tum wa-du-ri-bat a-lai-hi-muz zil-la-tu wal-mas-ka-na-tu wa-baaaoo bi-gha-da-bim mi-nal laah zaa-li-ka bi-a-nna-hum kaa-no yak-fu-roo-na bi-a-ayaa-til laa-hi wayaq-tu-loo-nan na-biyyee-na bi-ghai-ril haqq zaa-li-ka bi-maa a-saw wa-kaa-noo ya-ta-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُواْ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ وَٱلصَّٰبِـِٔينَ مَنۡ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين ءامنوا والذين هادوا والنصري والصبين من ءامن بالله واليوم الاخر وعمل صلحا فلهم اجرهم عند ربهم ولا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who believed and those who were Jews or Christians or Sabeans [before Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] - those [among them] who believed in Allāh and the Last Day and did righteousness - will have their reward with their Lord, and no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na aa-ma-noo wal-la-zee-na haa-doo wan-na-saa-raa was-saa-biee-na man aa-ma-na bil-laa-hi wa-lyaw-mil aa-khi-ri waa-mi-la saa-li-han fa-la-hum aj-ru-hum in-da rab-bi-him wa-laa khaw-fun a-lai-him wa-laa hum yah-za-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ أَخَذۡنَا مِيثَٰقَكُمۡ وَرَفَعۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمُ ٱلطُّورَ خُذُواْ مَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكُم بِقُوَّةٖ وَٱذۡكُرُواْ مَا فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُونَ ٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: واذ اخذنا ميثقكم ورفعنا فوقكم الطور خذوا ما ءاتينكم بقوة واذكروا ما فيه لعلكم تتقون
ayahs.translation: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [O Children of Israel, to abide by the Torah] and We raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and remember what is in it that perhaps you may become righteous."
ayahs.transliteration: waiz a-khaz-naa mee-saa-qa-kum wa-ra-fa-naa faw-qa-ku-mut too-ra khu-zoo maaa aa-tai-naa-kum bi-quw-wa-tinw waz-ku-roo maa fee-hi laal-la-kum tat-ta-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيۡتُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَۖ فَلَوۡلَا فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَرَحۡمَتُهُۥ لَكُنتُم مِّنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: ثم توليتم من بعد ذلك فلولا فضل الله عليكم ورحمته لكنتم من الخسرين
ayahs.translation: Then you turned away after that. And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy, you would have been among the losers.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma ta-wal-lai-tum mim ba-di zaa-li-ka fa-law-laa fad-lul laa-hi a-lai-kum wa-rah-ma-tu-hoo la-kun-tum mi-nal khaa-sireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعۡتَدَوۡاْ مِنكُمۡ فِي ٱلسَّبۡتِ فَقُلۡنَا لَهُمۡ كُونُواْ قِرَدَةً خَٰسِـِٔينَ ٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد علمتم الذين اعتدوا منكم في السبت فقلنا لهم كونوا قردة خسين
ayahs.translation: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad a-lim-tu-mul lazee-na ta-daw min-kum fis sab-ti fa-qul-naa la-hum koo-noo qi-ra-da-tan khaa-sieen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا نَكَٰلٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهَا وَمَا خَلۡفَهَا وَمَوۡعِظَةٗ لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ ٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: فجعلنها نكلا لما بين يديها وما خلفها وموعظة للمتقين
ayahs.translation: And We made it a deterrent punishment for those who were present and those who succeeded [them] and a lesson for those who fear Allāh.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-jaal-naa-haa na-kaa-lal li-maa bai-na ya-di-haa wa-maa khal-fa-haa wa-ma-wi-za-tal lil-mut-taqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأۡمُرُكُمۡ أَن تَذۡبَحُواْ بَقَرَةٗۖ قَالُوٓاْ أَتَتَّخِذُنَا هُزُوٗاۖ قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ أَنۡ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِينَ ٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: واذ قال موسي لقومه ان الله يامركم ان تذبحوا بقرة قالوا اتتخذنا هزوا قال اعوذ بالله ان اكون من الجهلين
ayahs.translation: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "Indeed, Allāh commands you to slaughter a cow." They said, "Do you take us in ridicule?" He said, "I seek refuge in Allāh from being among the ignorant."
ayahs.transliteration: waiz qaa-la moo-saa li-qaw-miheee in-nal laa-ha yaa-mu-ru-kum an taz-ba-hoo ba-qa-ra-tan qaa-looo a-tat-ta-khi-zun-na hu-zu-wan qaa-la aoo-zu bil-laa-hi an a-koo-na mi-nal jaa-hileen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِيَۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٞ لَّا فَارِضٞ وَلَا بِكۡرٌ عَوَانُۢ بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَۖ فَٱفۡعَلُواْ مَا تُؤۡمَرُونَ ٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا ادع لنا ربك يبين لنا ما هي قال انه يقول انها بقرة لا فارض ولا بكر عوان بين ذلك فافعلوا ما تؤمرون
ayahs.translation: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is." [Moses] said, "[Allāh] says, 'It is a cow which is neither old nor virgin, but median between that,' so do what you are commanded."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-lu u-du la-naa rab-ba-ka yu-baiyil la-naa maa hee qaa-la in-na-hoo ya-qoo-lu in-na-haa ba-qa-ra-tul laa faa-ri-dunw wa-laa bik-run a-waa-num bai-na zaa-li-ka fa-fa-loo maa tu-ma-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا لَوۡنُهَاۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٞ صَفۡرَآءُ فَاقِعٞ لَّوۡنُهَا تَسُرُّ ٱلنَّٰظِرِينَ ٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا ادع لنا ربك يبين لنا ما لونها قال انه يقول انها بقرة صفراء فاقع لونها تسر النظرين
ayahs.translation: They said, "Call upon your Lord to show us what is her color." He said, "He says, 'It is a yellow cow, bright in color - pleasing to the observers.'"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-lu u-du la-naa rab-ba-ka yu-baiyil la-naa maa law-nu-haa qaa-la in-na-hoo ya-qoo-lu in-na-haa ba-qa-ra-tun saf-raaau faa-qiul law-nu-haa ta-sur-run naa-zireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِيَ إِنَّ ٱلۡبَقَرَ تَشَٰبَهَ عَلَيۡنَا وَإِنَّآ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَمُهۡتَدُونَ ٧٠
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا ادع لنا ربك يبين لنا ما هي ان البقر تشبه علينا وانا ان شاء الله لمهتدون
ayahs.translation: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is. Indeed, [all] cows look alike to us. And indeed we, if Allāh wills, will be guided."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-lu u-du la-naa rab-ba-ka yu-baiyil la-naa maa hiya in-nal ba-qa-ra ta-shaa-ba-ha a-lai-naa wain-naaa in shaaaal laa-hu la-muh-ta-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٞ لَّا ذَلُولٞ تُثِيرُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَلَا تَسۡقِي ٱلۡحَرۡثَ مُسَلَّمَةٞ لَّا شِيَةَ فِيهَاۚ قَالُواْ ٱلۡـَٰٔنَ جِئۡتَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ فَذَبَحُوهَا وَمَا كَادُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ ٧١
ayahs.text_simple: قال انه يقول انها بقرة لا ذلول تثير الارض ولا تسقي الحرث مسلمة لا شية فيها قالوا الن جئت بالحق فذبحوها وما كادوا يفعلون
ayahs.translation: He said, "He says, 'It is a cow neither trained to plow the earth nor to irrigate the field, one free from fault with no spot upon her.'" They said, "Now you have come with the truth." So they slaughtered her, but they could hardly do it.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la in-na-hoo ya-qoo-lu in-na-haa ba-qa-ra-tul laa za-loo-lun tusee-rul ar-da wa-laa tas-qil har-sa mu-sal-la-ma-tul laa shiya-ta fee-haa qaa-lul aa-na ji-ta bi-lhaqq fa-za-ba-hoo-haa wa-maa kaa-do yaf a-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ قَتَلۡتُمۡ نَفۡسٗا فَٱدَّٰرَٰءۡتُمۡ فِيهَاۖ وَٱللَّهُ مُخۡرِجٞ مَّا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡتُمُونَ ٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: واذ قتلتم نفسا فادرءتم فيها والله مخرج ما كنتم تكتمون
ayahs.translation: And [recall] when you slew a man and disputed over it, but Allāh was to bring out that which you were concealing.
ayahs.transliteration: waiz qa-tal-tum naf-san fad-daa-ra-tum fee-haa wal-laa-hu muk-hri-jum maa kun-tum tak-tu-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقُلۡنَا ٱضۡرِبُوهُ بِبَعۡضِهَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُحۡيِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَيُرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ ٧٣
ayahs.text_simple: فقلنا اضربوه ببعضها كذلك يحي الله الموتي ويريكم ءايته لعلكم تعقلون
ayahs.translation: So We said, "Strike him [i.e., the slain man] with part of it." Thus does Allāh bring the dead to life, and He shows you His signs that you might reason.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qul-nad ri-boo-hu bi-ba-di-haa ka-zaa-li-ka yu-hyil laa-hul maw-taa wayuree-kum aayaa-tihee laal-la-kum ta-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ قَسَتۡ قُلُوبُكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَهِيَ كَٱلۡحِجَارَةِ أَوۡ أَشَدُّ قَسۡوَةٗۚ وَإِنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡحِجَارَةِ لَمَا يَتَفَجَّرُ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ وَإِنَّ مِنۡهَا لَمَا يَشَّقَّقُ فَيَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡمَآءُۚ وَإِنَّ مِنۡهَا لَمَا يَهۡبِطُ مِنۡ خَشۡيَةِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ ٧٤
ayahs.text_simple: ثم قست قلوبكم من بعد ذلك فهي كالحجارة او اشد قسوة وان من الحجارة لما يتفجر منه الانهر وان منها لما يشقق فيخرج منه الماء وان منها لما يهبط من خشية الله وما الله بغفل عما تعملون
ayahs.translation: Then your hearts became hardened after that, being like stones or even harder. For indeed, there are stones from which rivers burst forth, and there are some of them that split open and water comes out, and there are some of them that fall down for fear of Allāh. And Allāh is not unaware of what you do.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma qa-sat qu-loo-bu-kum mim ba-di zaa-li-ka fa-hiya ka-lhi-jaa-ra-ti aw a-shaa-du qas-wah wain-na mi-nal hi-jaa-ra-ti la-maa ya-ta-faj-ja-ru mi-nhul a-nhaar wain-na mi-nhaa la-maa yas-hshaq-qa-qu fayak-hru-ju mi-nhul maaa wain-na mi-nhaa la-maa yah-bi-tu min kha-shya-til laa wa-mal laa-hu bi-ghaa-fi-lin am-maa ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ أَفَتَطۡمَعُونَ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ لَكُمۡ وَقَدۡ كَانَ فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَسۡمَعُونَ كَلَٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُحَرِّفُونَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا عَقَلُوهُ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ ٧٥
ayahs.text_simple: افتطمعون ان يؤمنوا لكم وقد كان فريق منهم يسمعون كلم الله ثم يحرفونه من بعد ما عقلوه وهم يعلمون
ayahs.translation: Do you covet [the hope, O believers], that they would believe for you while a party of them used to hear the words of Allāh and then distort it [i.e., the Torah] after they had understood it while they were knowing?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-tat-maoo-na ai yu-mi-noo la-kum wa-qad kaa-na faree-qum mi-nhum yas-maoo-na ka-laa-mal laa-hi sum-ma yu-har-ri-foo-na-hoo mim ba-di maa a-qa-loo-hu wa-hum ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا لَقُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَا بَعۡضُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ قَالُوٓاْ أَتُحَدِّثُونَهُم بِمَا فَتَحَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لِيُحَآجُّوكُم بِهِۦ عِندَ رَبِّكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ ٧٦
ayahs.text_simple: واذا لقوا الذين ءامنوا قالوا ءامنا واذا خلا بعضهم الي بعض قالوا اتحدثونهم بما فتح الله عليكم ليحاجوكم به عند ربكم افلا تعقلون
ayahs.translation: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We have believed"; but when they are alone with one another, they say, "Do you talk to them about what Allāh has revealed to you so they can argue with you about it before your Lord?" Then will you not reason?
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa la-qul lazee-na aa-ma-noo qaa-looo aa-man-naa wai-zaa kha-laa ba-du-hum i-laa ba-din qaa-looo a-tu-had-di-soo-na-hum bi-maa fa-ta-hal laa-hu a-lai-kum liyu-haaj-joo-kum bihee in-da rab-bi-kum a-fa-laa ta-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَلَا يَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ ٧٧
ayahs.text_simple: اولا يعلمون ان الله يعلم ما يسرون وما يعلنون
ayahs.translation: But do they not know that Allāh knows what they conceal and what they declare?
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-laa ya-la-moo-na an-nal laa-ha ya-la-mu maa yu-sir-roo-na wa-maa yu-li-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِنۡهُمۡ أُمِّيُّونَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّآ أَمَانِيَّ وَإِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ ٧٨
ayahs.text_simple: ومنهم اميون لا يعلمون الكتب الا اماني وان هم الا يظنون
ayahs.translation: And among them are unlettered ones who do not know the Scripture except [indulgement in] wishful thinking, but they are only assuming.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mi-nhum um-miyyoo-na laa ya-la-moo-nal ki-taa-ba il-laaa a-maa-niyya wain hum il-laa ya-zun-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ يَكۡتُبُونَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِأَيۡدِيهِمۡ ثُمَّ يَقُولُونَ هَٰذَا مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ لِيَشۡتَرُواْ بِهِۦ ثَمَنٗا قَلِيلٗاۖ فَوَيۡلٞ لَّهُم مِّمَّا كَتَبَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَوَيۡلٞ لَّهُم مِّمَّا يَكۡسِبُونَ ٧٩
ayahs.text_simple: فويل للذين يكتبون الكتب بايديهم ثم يقولون هذا من عند الله ليشتروا به ثمنا قليلا فويل لهم مما كتبت ايديهم وويل لهم مما يكسبون
ayahs.translation: So woe to those who write the "scripture" with their own hands, then say, "This is from Allāh," in order to exchange it for a small price. Woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for what they earn.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-wai-lul lil-la-zee-na yak-tu-boo-nal ki-taa-ba bi-a-i-di-him sum-ma ya-qoo-loo-na haa-zaa min in-dil laa-hi liyas-hta-roo bihee sa-ma-nan qalee-lan fa-wai-lul la-hum mi-maa ka-ta-bat ay-dee-him wa-wai-lul la-hum mim-maa yak-si-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامٗا مَّعۡدُودَةٗۚ قُلۡ أَتَّخَذۡتُمۡ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَهۡدٗا فَلَن يُخۡلِفَ ٱللَّهُ عَهۡدَهُۥٓۖ أَمۡ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ ٨٠
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا لن تمسنا النار الا اياما معدودة قل اتخذتم عند الله عهدا فلن يخلف الله عهده ام تقولون علي الله ما لا تعلمون
ayahs.translation: And they say, "Never will the Fire touch us, except for [a few] numbered days." Say, "Have you taken a covenant with Allāh? For Allāh will never break His covenant. Or do you say about Allāh that which you do not know?"
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-loo lan ta-mas-sa-nan naa-ru il-laaa ayyaa-mam ma-doo-dah qul at-ta-khaz-tum in-dal laa-hi ah-dan fa-lai yuk-hli-fal laa-hu ah-da-hooo am ta-qoo-loo-na a-lal laa-hi maa laa ta-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلَىٰۚ مَن كَسَبَ سَيِّئَةٗ وَأَحَٰطَتۡ بِهِۦ خَطِيٓـَٔتُهُۥ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ ٨١
ayahs.text_simple: بلي من كسب سيئة واحطت به خطيته فاولئك اصحب النار هم فيها خلدون
ayahs.translation: Yes, [on the contrary], whoever earns evil and his sin has encompassed him - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.
ayahs.transliteration: ba-laa man ka-sa-ba sayyi-a-tanw waa-haa-tat bihee khateeea-tu-hoo fau-laaai-ka a-shaa-bun naa-ri hum fee-haa khaa-li-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ ٨٢
ayahs.text_simple: والذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت اولئك اصحب الجنة هم فيها خلدون
ayahs.translation: But they who believe and do righteous deeds - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti u-laaai-ka a-shaa-bul jan-na-ti hum fee-ha khaa-li-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ أَخَذۡنَا مِيثَٰقَ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ لَا تَعۡبُدُونَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَبِٱلۡوَٰلِدَيۡنِ إِحۡسَانٗا وَذِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَٱلۡيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلۡمَسَٰكِينِ وَقُولُواْ لِلنَّاسِ حُسۡنٗا وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا مِّنكُمۡ وَأَنتُم مُّعۡرِضُونَ ٨٣
ayahs.text_simple: واذ اخذنا ميثق بني اسرءيل لا تعبدون الا الله وبالولدين احسانا وذي القربي واليتمي والمسكين وقولوا للناس حسنا واقيموا الصلوة وءاتوا الزكوة ثم توليتم الا قليلا منكم وانتم معرضون
ayahs.translation: And [recall] when We took the covenant from the Children of Israel, [enjoining upon them], "Do not worship except Allāh; and to parents do good and to relatives, orphans, and the needy. And speak to people good [words] and establish prayer and give zakāh." Then you turned away, except a few of you, and you were refusing.
ayahs.transliteration: waiz a-khaz-naa mee-saa-qa baneee is-raaaee-la laa ta-bu-doo-na il-lal laa-ha wa-bil-waa-li-dai-ni ih-saa-nanw wa-zil qur-baa wa-lya-taa-maa wal-ma-saa-kee-ni wa-qoo-loo lin-naa-si hus-nanw waaqee-mus sa-laa-ta waaa-tuz za-kaa-ta sum-ma ta-wal-lai-tum il-laa qalee-lam min-kum waan-tum mu-ri-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ أَخَذۡنَا مِيثَٰقَكُمۡ لَا تَسۡفِكُونَ دِمَآءَكُمۡ وَلَا تُخۡرِجُونَ أَنفُسَكُم مِّن دِيَٰرِكُمۡ ثُمَّ أَقۡرَرۡتُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ تَشۡهَدُونَ ٨٤
ayahs.text_simple: واذ اخذنا ميثقكم لا تسفكون دماءكم ولا تخرجون انفسكم من ديركم ثم اقررتم وانتم تشهدون
ayahs.translation: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [saying], "Do not shed your [i.e., each other's] blood or evict one another from your homes." Then you acknowledged [this] while you were witnessing.
ayahs.transliteration: waiz a-khaz-naa mee-saa-qa-kum laa tas-fi-koo-na di-maaaa-kum wa-laa tuk-hri-joo-na an-fu-sa-kum min diyaa-ri-kum sum-ma aq-rar-tum waan-tum tas-hha-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَنتُمۡ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ تَقۡتُلُونَ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَتُخۡرِجُونَ فَرِيقٗا مِّنكُم مِّن دِيَٰرِهِمۡ تَظَٰهَرُونَ عَلَيۡهِم بِٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡعُدۡوَٰنِ وَإِن يَأۡتُوكُمۡ أُسَٰرَىٰ تُفَٰدُوهُمۡ وَهُوَ مُحَرَّمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِخۡرَاجُهُمۡۚ أَفَتُؤۡمِنُونَ بِبَعۡضِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَتَكۡفُرُونَ بِبَعۡضٖۚ فَمَا جَزَآءُ مَن يَفۡعَلُ ذَٰلِكَ مِنكُمۡ إِلَّا خِزۡيٞ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَشَدِّ ٱلۡعَذَابِۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ ٨٥
ayahs.text_simple: ثم انتم هؤلاء تقتلون انفسكم وتخرجون فريقا منكم من ديرهم تظهرون عليهم بالاثم والعدون وان ياتوكم اسري تفدوهم وهو محرم عليكم اخراجهم افتؤمنون ببعض الكتب وتكفرون ببعض فما جزاء من يفعل ذلك منكم الا خزي في الحيوة الدنيا ويوم القيمة يردون الي اشد العذاب وما الله بغفل عما تعملون
ayahs.translation: Then, you are those [same ones who are] killing one another and evicting a party of your people from their homes, cooperating against them in sin and aggression. And if they come to you as captives, you ransom them, although their eviction was forbidden to you. So do you believe in part of the Scripture and disbelieve in part? Then what is the recompense for those who do that among you except disgrace in worldly life; and on the Day of Resurrection they will be sent back to the severest of punishment. And Allāh is not unaware of what you do.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma an-tum haaau-laaai taq-tu-loo-na an-fu-sa-kum wa-tuk-hri-joo-na faree-qam min-kum min diyaa-ri-him ta-zaa-ha-roo-na a-lai-him bi-lis-mi wa-lud-waa-ni wai-ny yaa-too-kum u-saa-raa tu-faa-doo-hum wa-hu-wa mu-har-ra-mun a-lai-kum ik-hraa-ju-hum a-fa-tu-mi-noo-na bi-ba-dil ki-taa-bi wa-tak-fu-roo-na bi-bad fa-maa ja-zaaau mai yaf a-lu zaa-li-ka min-kum il-laa khi-zyun fil hayaa-tid du-nyaa wayaw-mal qiyaa-ma-ti yu-rad-doo-na i-laaa a-shad-dil a-zaab wa-mal laa-hu bi-ghaa-fi-lin am-maa ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشۡتَرَوُاْ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ ٨٦
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك الذين اشتروا الحيوة الدنيا بالاخرة فلا يخفف عنهم العذاب ولا هم ينصرون
ayahs.translation: Those are the ones who have bought the life of this world [in exchange] for the Hereafter, so the punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be aided.
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-kal lazee-nash ta-ra-wul hayaa-tad du-nyaa bi-laa-khi-ra-ti fa-laa yu-khaf-fa-fu a-nhu-mul a-zaa-bu wa-laa hum yun-sa-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَقَفَّيۡنَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ بِٱلرُّسُلِۖ وَءَاتَيۡنَا عِيسَى ٱبۡنَ مَرۡيَمَ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَأَيَّدۡنَٰهُ بِرُوحِ ٱلۡقُدُسِۗ أَفَكُلَّمَا جَآءَكُمۡ رَسُولُۢ بِمَا لَا تَهۡوَىٰٓ أَنفُسُكُمُ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتُمۡ فَفَرِيقٗا كَذَّبۡتُمۡ وَفَرِيقٗا تَقۡتُلُونَ ٨٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ءاتينا موسي الكتب وقفينا من بعده بالرسل وءاتينا عيسي ابن مريم البينت وايدنه بروح القدس افكلما جاءكم رسول بما لا تهوي انفسكم استكبرتم ففريقا كذبتم وفريقا تقتلون
ayahs.translation: And We did certainly give Moses the Scripture [i.e., the Torah] and followed up after him with messengers. And We gave Jesus, the son of Mary, clear proofs and supported him with the Pure Spirit [i.e., the angel Gabriel]. But is it [not] that every time a messenger came to you, [O Children of Israel], with what your souls did not desire, you were arrogant? And a party [of messengers] you denied and another party you killed.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad aa-tai-naa moo-sal ki-taa-ba wa-qaf-fai-naa mim ba-dihee bir-ru-su-li waaa-tai-naa ee-sab na ma-rya-mal baiyi-naa-ti waayyad-naa-hu bi-roo-hil qu-dus a-fa-kul-la-maa jaaaa-kum ra-soo-lum bi-maa laa tah-waaa an-fu-su-ku-mus tak-bar-tum fa-fa-ree-qan kaz-zab-tum wa-fa-ree-qan taq-tu-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ قُلُوبُنَا غُلۡفُۢۚ بَل لَّعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِكُفۡرِهِمۡ فَقَلِيلٗا مَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٨٨
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا قلوبنا غلف بل لعنهم الله بكفرهم فقليلا ما يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: And they said, "Our hearts are wrapped." But, [in fact], Allāh has cursed them for their disbelief, so little is it that they believe.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-loo qu-loo-bu-naa ghulf bal laa-na-hu-mul laa-hu bi-kuf-ri-him fa-qa-lee-lam maa yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ كِتَٰبٞ مِّنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٞ لِّمَا مَعَهُمۡ وَكَانُواْ مِن قَبۡلُ يَسۡتَفۡتِحُونَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم مَّا عَرَفُواْ كَفَرُواْ بِهِۦۚ فَلَعۡنَةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٨٩
ayahs.text_simple: ولما جاءهم كتب من عند الله مصدق لما معهم وكانوا من قبل يستفتحون علي الذين كفروا فلما جاءهم ما عرفوا كفروا به فلعنة الله علي الكفرين
ayahs.translation: And when there came to them a Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] from Allāh confirming that which was with them - although before they used to pray for victory against those who disbelieved - but [then] when there came to them that which they recognized, they disbelieved in it; so the curse of Allāh will be upon the disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lam-maa jaaaa-hum ki-taa-bum min in-dil laa-hi mu-sad-di-qul li-maa maa-hum wa-kaa-noo min qab-lu yas-taf-ti-hoo-na a-lal lazee-na ka-fa-roo fa-lam-maa jaaaa-hum maa a-ra-foo ka-fa-roo bih fa-la-na-tul laa-hi a-lal kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: بِئۡسَمَا ٱشۡتَرَوۡاْ بِهِۦٓ أَنفُسَهُمۡ أَن يَكۡفُرُواْ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بَغۡيًا أَن يُنَزِّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦۖ فَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٍ عَلَىٰ غَضَبٖۚ وَلِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ ٩٠
ayahs.text_simple: بئسما اشتروا به انفسهم ان يكفروا بما انزل الله بغيا ان ينزل الله من فضله علي من يشاء من عباده فباءو بغضب علي غضب وللكفرين عذاب مهين
ayahs.translation: How wretched is that for which they sold themselves - that they would disbelieve in what Allāh has revealed through [their] outrage that Allāh would send down His favor upon whom He wills from among His servants. So they returned having [earned] wrath upon wrath. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: bi-sa-mash ta-raw biheee an-fu-sa-hum ai yak-fu-roo bi-maaa an-za-lal laa-hu ba-ghyan ai yu-naz-zi-lal laa-hu min fad-lihee a-laa mai ya-shaaau min i-baa-dihee fa-baaaoo bi-gha-da-bin a-laa gha-dab wa-lil-kaa-fi-ree-na a-zaa-bum muheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ ءَامِنُواْ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُواْ نُؤۡمِنُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡنَا وَيَكۡفُرُونَ بِمَا وَرَآءَهُۥ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا مَعَهُمۡۗ قُلۡ فَلِمَ تَقۡتُلُونَ أَنۢبِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ مِن قَبۡلُ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ ٩١
ayahs.text_simple: واذا قيل لهم ءامنوا بما انزل الله قالوا نؤمن بما انزل علينا ويكفرون بما وراءه وهو الحق مصدقا لما معهم قل فلم تقتلون انبياء الله من قبل ان كنتم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation: And when it is said to them, "Believe in what Allāh has revealed," they say, "We believe [only] in what was revealed to us." And they disbelieve in what came after it, while it is the truth confirming that which is with them. Say, "Then why did you kill the prophets of Allāh before, if you are [indeed] believers?"
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa qee-la la-hum aa-mi-noo bi-maaa an-za-lal laa-hu qaa-loo nu-mi-nu bi-maaa un-zi-la a-lai-naa wayak-fu-roo-na bi-maa wa-raaaa-hoo wa-hu-wal haq-qu mu-sad-di-qal li-maa maa-hum qul fa-li-ma taq-tu-loo-na am-biyaaaal laa-hi min qab-lu in kun-tum mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَكُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ ثُمَّ ٱتَّخَذۡتُمُ ٱلۡعِجۡلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ وَأَنتُمۡ ظَٰلِمُونَ ٩٢
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد جاءكم موسي بالبينت ثم اتخذتم العجل من بعده وانتم ظلمون
ayahs.translation: And Moses had certainly brought you clear proofs. Then you took the calf [in worship] after that, while you were wrongdoers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad jaaaa-kum moo-sa bil-baiyi-naa-ti sum-mat ta-khaz-tu-mul ij-la mim ba-dihee waan-tum zaa-li-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ أَخَذۡنَا مِيثَٰقَكُمۡ وَرَفَعۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمُ ٱلطُّورَ خُذُواْ مَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكُم بِقُوَّةٖ وَٱسۡمَعُواْۖ قَالُواْ سَمِعۡنَا وَعَصَيۡنَا وَأُشۡرِبُواْ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلۡعِجۡلَ بِكُفۡرِهِمۡۚ قُلۡ بِئۡسَمَا يَأۡمُرُكُم بِهِۦٓ إِيمَٰنُكُمۡ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ ٩٣
ayahs.text_simple: واذ اخذنا ميثقكم ورفعنا فوقكم الطور خذوا ما ءاتينكم بقوة واسمعوا قالوا سمعنا وعصينا واشربوا في قلوبهم العجل بكفرهم قل بئسما يامركم به ايمنكم ان كنتم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation: And [recall] when We took your covenant and raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and listen." They said [instead], "We hear and disobey." And their hearts absorbed [the worship of] the calf because of their disbelief. Say, "How wretched is that which your faith enjoins upon you, if you should be believers."
ayahs.transliteration: waiz a-khaz-naa mee-saa-qa-kum wa-ra-fa-naa faw-qa-ku-mut too-ra khu-zoo maaa aa-tai-naa-kum bi-quw-wa-tinw was-maoo qaa-loo sa-mi-naa waa-sai-naa waus-hri-boo fee qu-loo-bi-hi-mul ij-la bi-kuf-ri-him qul bi-sa-maa yaa-mu-ru-kum biheee ee-maa-nu-kum in kun-tum mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ إِن كَانَتۡ لَكُمُ ٱلدَّارُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَالِصَةٗ مِّن دُونِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُاْ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ ٩٤
ayahs.text_simple: قل ان كانت لكم الدار الاخرة عند الله خالصة من دون الناس فتمنوا الموت ان كنتم صدقين
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "If the home of the Hereafter with Allāh is for you alone and not the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: qul in kaa-nat la-ku-mud daa-rul aa-khi-ra-tu in-dal laa-hi khaa-li-sa-tam min doo-nin naa-si fa-ta-man-na-wul maw-ta in kun-tum saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَن يَتَمَنَّوۡهُ أَبَدَۢا بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ٩٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولن يتمنوه ابدا بما قدمت ايديهم والله عليم بالظلمين
ayahs.translation: But never will they wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allāh is Knowing of the wrongdoers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lai ya-ta-man-na-whu a-ba-dam bi-maa qad-da-mat ay-dee-him wal-laa-hu alee-mum biz-zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَتَجِدَنَّهُمۡ أَحۡرَصَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ حَيَوٰةٖ وَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُواْۚ يَوَدُّ أَحَدُهُمۡ لَوۡ يُعَمَّرُ أَلۡفَ سَنَةٖ وَمَا هُوَ بِمُزَحۡزِحِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ أَن يُعَمَّرَۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرُۢ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُونَ ٩٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولتجدنهم احرص الناس علي حيوة ومن الذين اشركوا يود احدهم لو يعمر الف سنة وما هو بمزحزحه من العذاب ان يعمر والله بصير بما يعملون
ayahs.translation: And you will surely find them the most greedy of people for life - [even] more than those who associate others with Allāh. One of them wishes that he could be granted life a thousand years, but it would not remove him in the least from the [coming] punishment that he should be granted life. And Allāh is Seeing of what they do.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-ta-ji-dan-na-hum ah-ra-san naa-si a-laa hayaa-tinw wa-mi-nal lazee-na as-hra-koo ya-wad-du a-ha-du-hum law yu-a-mma-ru al-fa sa-na-tinw wa-maa hu-wa bi-mu-zah-zi-hi-hee mi-nal a-zaa-bi ai yu-a-mmar wal-laa-hu basee-rum bi-maa ya-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ مَن كَانَ عَدُوّٗا لِّـجِبۡرِيلَ فَإِنَّهُۥ نَزَّلَهُۥ عَلَىٰ قَلۡبِكَ بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ وَهُدٗى وَبُشۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٩٧
ayahs.text_simple: قل من كان عدوا لجبريل فانه نزله علي قلبك باذن الله مصدقا لما بين يديه وهدي وبشري للمؤمنين
ayahs.translation: Say, "Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - it is [none but] he who has brought it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down upon your heart, [O Muḥammad], by permission of Allāh, confirming that which was before it and as guidance and good tidings for the believers."
ayahs.transliteration: qul man kaa-na a-duw-wal li-jib-ree-la fain-na-hoo naz-za-la-hoo a-laa qal-bi-ka biiz-nil laa-hi mu-sad-di-qal li-maa bai-na ya-dai-hi wa-hu-danw wa-bus-hraa lil-mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَن كَانَ عَدُوّٗا لِّلَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَجِبۡرِيلَ وَمِيكَىٰلَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَدُوّٞ لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٩٨
ayahs.text_simple: من كان عدوا لله وملئكته ورسله وجبريل وميكيل فان الله عدو للكفرين
ayahs.translation: Whoever is an enemy to Allāh and His angels and His messengers and Gabriel and Michael - then indeed, Allāh is an enemy to the disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: man kaa-na a-duw-wal lil-laa-hi wa-ma-laaai-ka-tihee wa-ru-su-lihee wa-jib-ree-la wamee-kaa-la fain-nal laa-ha a-duw-wul lil-kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ءَايَٰتِۭ بَيِّنَٰتٖۖ وَمَا يَكۡفُرُ بِهَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ ٩٩
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد انزلنا اليك ءايت بينت وما يكفر بها الا الفسقون
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly revealed to you verses [which are] clear proofs, and no one would deny them except the defiantly disobedient.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad an-zal-naaa i-lai-ka aayaa-tim baiyi-naa-tinw wa-maa yak-fu-ru bi-haaa il-lal faa-si-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَكُلَّمَا عَٰهَدُواْ عَهۡدٗا نَّبَذَهُۥ فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُمۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ ١٠٠
ayahs.text_simple: اوكلما عهدوا عهدا نبذه فريق منهم بل اكثرهم لا يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: Is it not [true] that every time they took a covenant a party of them threw it away? But, [in fact], most of them do not believe.
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-kul-la-maa aa-ha-doo ah-dan na-ba-za-hoo faree-qum mi-nhum bal ak-sa-ru-hum laa yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ مِّنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٞ لِّمَا مَعَهُمۡ نَبَذَ فَرِيقٞ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ كِتَٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِهِمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ١٠١
ayahs.text_simple: ولما جاءهم رسول من عند الله مصدق لما معهم نبذ فريق من الذين اوتوا الكتب كتب الله وراء ظهورهم كانهم لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: And when a messenger from Allāh came to them confirming that which was with them, a party of those who had been given the Scripture threw the Scripture of Allāh [i.e., the Torah] behind their backs as if they did not know [what it contained].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lam-maa jaaaa-hum ra-soo-lum min in-dil laa-hi mu-sad-di-qul li-maa maa-hum na-ba-za faree-qum mi-nal lazee-na oo-tul ki-taa-ba ki-taa-bal laa-hi wa-raaaa zu-hoo-ri-him kaan-na-hum laa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَا تَتۡلُواْ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلۡكِ سُلَيۡمَٰنَۖ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ ٱلسِّحۡرَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلۡمَلَكَيۡنِ بِبَابِلَ هَٰرُوتَ وَمَٰرُوتَۚ وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنۡ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَآ إِنَّمَا نَحۡنُ فِتۡنَةٞ فَلَا تَكۡفُرۡۖ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنۡهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِۦ بَيۡنَ ٱلۡمَرۡءِ وَزَوۡجِهِۦۚ وَمَا هُم بِضَآرِّينَ بِهِۦ مِنۡ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمۡ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمۡۚ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمُواْ لَمَنِ ٱشۡتَرَىٰهُ مَا لَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ مِنۡ خَلَٰقٖۚ وَلَبِئۡسَ مَا شَرَوۡاْ بِهِۦٓ أَنفُسَهُمۡۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ ١٠٢
ayahs.text_simple: واتبعوا ما تتلوا الشيطين علي ملك سليمن وما كفر سليمن ولكن الشيطين كفروا يعلمون الناس السحر وما انزل علي الملكين ببابل هروت ومروت وما يعلمان من احد حتي يقولا انما نحن فتنة فلا تكفر فيتعلمون منهما ما يفرقون به بين المرء وزوجه وما هم بضارين به من احد الا باذن الله ويتعلمون ما يضرهم ولا ينفعهم ولقد علموا لمن اشتريه ما له في الاخرة من خلق ولبئس ما شروا به انفسهم لو كانوا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: And they followed [instead] what the devils had recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic and that which was revealed to the two angels at Babylon, Hārūt and Mārūt. But they [i.e., the two angels] do not teach anyone unless they say, "We are a trial, so do not disbelieve [by practicing magic]." And [yet] they learn from them that by which they cause separation between a man and his wife. But they do not harm anyone through it except by permission of Allāh. And they [i.e., people] learn what harms them and does not benefit them. But they [i.e., the Children of Israel] certainly knew that whoever purchased it [i.e., magic] would not have in the Hereafter any share. And wretched is that for which they sold themselves, if they only knew.
ayahs.transliteration: wat-ta-baoo maa tat-lush shayaatee-nu a-laa mul-ki su-lai-maa-na wa-maa ka-fa-ra su-lai-maa-nu wa-laa-kin-nash shayat-tee-na ka-fa-roo yu-a-lli-moo-nan naa-sas sih-ra wa-maaa un-zi-la a-lal ma-la-kai-ni bi-baa-bi-la haa-roo-ta wa-maa-root wa-maa yu-a-lli-maa-ni min a-ha-din hat-taa ya-qoo-laaa in-na-maa nah-nu fit-na-tun fa-laa tak-fur faya-taal-la-moo-na mi-nhu-maa maa yu-far-ri-qoo-na bihee bai-nal ma-ri wa-zaw-jih wa-maa hum bi-daaar-ree-na bihee min a-ha-din il-laa biiz-nil lah waya-taal-la-moo-na maa ya-dur-ru-hum wa-laa yan-fau-hum wa-la-qad a-li-moo la-ma-nish ta-raa-hu maa la-hoo fil aa-khi-ra-ti min kha-laaq wa-la-bi-sa maa sha-raw biheee an-fu-sa-hum law kaa-noo ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡ أَنَّهُمۡ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّقَوۡاْ لَمَثُوبَةٞ مِّنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞۚ لَّوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ ١٠٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولو انهم ءامنوا واتقوا لمثوبة من عند الله خير لو كانوا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: And if they had believed and feared Allāh, then the reward from Allāh would have been [far] better, if they only knew.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law an-na-hum aa-ma-noo wat-ta-qaw la-ma-soo-ba-tum min in-dil laa-hi khai-run law kaa-noo ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَقُولُواْ رَٰعِنَا وَقُولُواْ ٱنظُرۡنَا وَٱسۡمَعُواْۗ وَلِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ ١٠٤
ayahs.text_simple: يايها الذين ءامنوا لا تقولوا رعنا وقولوا انظرنا واسمعوا وللكفرين عذاب اليم
ayahs.translation: O you who have believed, say not [to Allāh's Messenger], "Rāʿinā" but say, "Unẓurnā" and listen. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayyu-hal lazee-na aa-ma-noo laa ta-qoo-loo raai-naa wa-qoo-lun zur-naa was-maoo wa-lil-kaa-fi-ree-na a-zaa-bun aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَّا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَلَا ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرٖ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَخۡتَصُّ بِرَحۡمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلۡفَضۡلِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ ١٠٥
ayahs.text_simple: ما يود الذين كفروا من اهل الكتب ولا المشركين ان ينزل عليكم من خير من ربكم والله يختص برحمته من يشاء والله ذو الفضل العظيم
ayahs.translation: Neither those who disbelieve from the People of the Scripture [i.e., the Jews and Christians] nor the polytheists wish that any good should be sent down to you from your Lord. But Allāh selects for His mercy whom He wills, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.
ayahs.transliteration: maa ya-wad-dul lazee-na ka-fa-roo min ah-lil ki-taa-bi wa-lal mus-hri-kee-na ai yu-naz-za-la a-lai-kum min khai-rim mir rab-bi-kum wal-laa-hu yak-htas-su bi-rah-ma-tihee mai ya-shaaa wal-laa-hu zul fad-lil azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ مَا نَنسَخۡ مِنۡ ءَايَةٍ أَوۡ نُنسِهَا نَأۡتِ بِخَيۡرٖ مِّنۡهَآ أَوۡ مِثۡلِهَآۗ أَلَمۡ تَعۡلَمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ ١٠٦
ayahs.text_simple: ما ننسخ من ءاية او ننسها نات بخير منها او مثلها الم تعلم ان الله علي كل شيء قدير
ayahs.translation: We do not abrogate a verse or cause it to be forgotten except that We bring forth [one] better than it or similar to it. Do you not know that Allāh is over all things competent?
ayahs.transliteration: maa nan-sakh min aaya-tin aw nun-si-haa na-ti bi-khai-rim mi-nhaaa aw mis-li-haaa a-lam ta-lam an-nal laa-ha a-laa kul-li shaiin qadeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَعۡلَمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ ١٠٧
ayahs.text_simple: الم تعلم ان الله له ملك السموت والارض وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير
ayahs.translation: Do you not know that to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and [that] you have not besides Allāh any protector or any helper?
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam ta-lam an-nal laa-ha la-hoo mul-kus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lard wa-maa la-kum min doo-nil laa-hi minw wa-liyyinw wa-laa naseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَسۡـَٔلُواْ رَسُولَكُمۡ كَمَا سُئِلَ مُوسَىٰ مِن قَبۡلُۗ وَمَن يَتَبَدَّلِ ٱلۡكُفۡرَ بِٱلۡإِيمَٰنِ فَقَدۡ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ١٠٨
ayahs.text_simple: ام تريدون ان تسلوا رسولكم كما سئل موسي من قبل ومن يتبدل الكفر بالايمن فقد ضل سواء السبيل
ayahs.translation: Or do you intend to ask your Messenger as Moses was asked before? And whoever exchanges faith for disbelief has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way.
ayahs.transliteration: am turee-doo-na an ta-sa-loo ra-soo-la-kum ka-maa su-i-la moo-sa min qabl wa-mai ya-ta-bad-da-lil kuf-ra bilee-maa-ni fa-qad dal-la sa-waaaas sabeel

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَدَّ كَثِيرٞ مِّنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَوۡ يَرُدُّونَكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ إِيمَٰنِكُمۡ كُفَّارًا حَسَدٗا مِّنۡ عِندِ أَنفُسِهِم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَٱعۡفُواْ وَٱصۡفَحُواْ حَتَّىٰ يَأۡتِيَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَمۡرِهِۦٓۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ ١٠٩
ayahs.text_simple: ود كثير من اهل الكتب لو يردونكم من بعد ايمنكم كفارا حسدا من عند انفسهم من بعد ما تبين لهم الحق فاعفوا واصفحوا حتي ياتي الله بامره ان الله علي كل شيء قدير
ayahs.translation: Many of the People of the Scripture wish they could turn you back to disbelief after you have believed, out of envy from themselves [even] after the truth has become clear to them. So pardon and overlook until Allāh delivers His command. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
ayahs.transliteration: wad-da kasee-rum min ah-lil ki-taa-bi law ya-rud-doo-na-kum mim ba-di ee-maa-ni-kum kuf-faa-ran ha-sa-dam min in-di an-fu-si-him mim ba-di maa ta-baiya-na la-hu-mul haq-qu fa-foo was-fa-hoo hat-taa yaa-tiyal laa-hu bi-a-mrih in-nal laa-ha a-laa kul-li shaiin qadeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرٖ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٞ ١١٠
ayahs.text_simple: واقيموا الصلوة وءاتوا الزكوة وما تقدموا لانفسكم من خير تجدوه عند الله ان الله بما تعملون بصير
ayahs.translation: And establish prayer and give zakāh, and whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. Indeed Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.
ayahs.transliteration: waaqee-mus sa-laa-ta waaa-tuz za-kaah wa-maa tu-qad-di-moo li-a-nfu-si-kum min khai-rin ta-ji-doo-hu in-dal laah in-nal laa-ha bi-maa ta-ma-loo-na baseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ لَن يَدۡخُلَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مَن كَانَ هُودًا أَوۡ نَصَٰرَىٰۗ تِلۡكَ أَمَانِيُّهُمۡۗ قُلۡ هَاتُواْ بُرۡهَٰنَكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ ١١١
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا لن يدخل الجنة الا من كان هودا او نصري تلك امانيهم قل هاتوا برهنكم ان كنتم صدقين
ayahs.translation: And they say, "None will enter Paradise except one who is a Jew or a Christian." That is [merely] their wishful thinking. Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-loo lai yad-khu-lal jan-na-ta il-laa man kaa-na hoo-dan aw na-saa-raa til-ka a-maa-niyyu-hum qul haa-too bu-rhaa-na-kum in kun-tum saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلَىٰۚ مَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ وَجۡهَهُۥ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحۡسِنٞ فَلَهُۥٓ أَجۡرُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ وَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ ١١٢
ayahs.text_simple: بلي من اسلم وجهه لله وهو محسن فله اجره عند ربه ولا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
ayahs.translation: Yes, [on the contrary], whoever submits his face [i.e., self] in Islām to Allāh while being a doer of good will have his reward with his Lord. And no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.
ayahs.transliteration: ba-laa man as-la-ma wa-jha-hoo lil-laa-hi wa-hu-wa muh-si-nun fa-la-hooo aj-ru-hoo in-da rab-bihee wa-laa khaw-fun a-lai-him wa-laa hum yah-za-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَتِ ٱلۡيَهُودُ لَيۡسَتِ ٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ وَقَالَتِ ٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ لَيۡسَتِ ٱلۡيَهُودُ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ وَهُمۡ يَتۡلُونَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَۗ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ مِثۡلَ قَوۡلِهِمۡۚ فَٱللَّهُ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ ١١٣
