ayahs.text_simple: ولقد استهزئ برسل من قبلك فحاق بالذين سخروا منهم ما كانوا به يستهزءون
ayahs.translation: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by that which they used to ridicule.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qa-dis tuh-zi-a bi-ru-su-lim min qab-li-ka fa-haa-qa bil-la-zee-na sa-khi-roo mi-nhum maa kaa-noo bihee yas-tah-zioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ سِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ثُمَّ ٱنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: قل سيروا في الارض ثم انظروا كيف كان عقبة المكذبين
ayahs.translation: Say, "Travel through the land; then observe how was the end of the deniers."
ayahs.transliteration: qul see-roo fil ar-di sum-man zu-roo kai-fa kaa-na aa-qi-ba-tul mu-kaz-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُل لِّمَن مَّا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ قُل لِّلَّهِۚ كَتَبَ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَةَۚ لَيَجۡمَعَنَّكُمۡ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِۚ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: قل لمن ما في السموت والارض قل لله كتب علي نفسه الرحمة ليجمعنكم الي يوم القيمة لا ريب فيه الذين خسروا انفسهم فهم لا يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: Say, "To whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth?" Say, "To Allāh." He has decreed upon Himself mercy. He will surely assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt. Those who will lose themselves [that Day] do not believe.
ayahs.transliteration: qul li-mam maa fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di qul lil-laah ka-ta-ba a-laa naf-si-hir rah-mah layaj-maan-na-kum i-laa yaw-mil qiyaa-ma-ti laa rai-ba feeh al-la-zee-na kha-si-rooo an-fu-sa-hum fa-hum laa yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَهُۥ مَا سَكَنَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: وله ما سكن في اليل والنهار وهو السميع العليم
ayahs.translation: And to Him belongs that which reposes by night and by day, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-hoo maa sa-ka-na fil lai-li wan-na-haar wa-hu-was samee-ul aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ أَتَّخِذُ وَلِيّٗا فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَهُوَ يُطۡعِمُ وَلَا يُطۡعَمُۗ قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنۡ أَسۡلَمَۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: قل اغير الله اتخذ وليا فاطر السموت والارض وهو يطعم ولا يطعم قل اني امرت ان اكون اول من اسلم ولا تكونن من المشركين
ayahs.translation: Say, "Is it other than Allāh I should take as a protector, Creator of the heavens and earth, while it is He who feeds and is not fed?" Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to be the first [among you] who submit [to Allāh] and [was commanded], 'Do not ever be of the polytheists.'"
ayahs.transliteration: qul a-ghai-ral laa-hi at-ta-khi-zu wa-liyyan faa-ti-ris sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di wa-hu-wa yu-ti-mu wa-laa yu-tam qul in-neee u-mir-tu an a-koo-na aw-wa-la man as-la-ma wa-laa ta-koo-nan-na mi-nal mus-hri-keen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ إِنۡ عَصَيۡتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: قل اني اخاف ان عصيت ربي عذاب يوم عظيم
ayahs.translation: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."
ayahs.transliteration: qul in-neee a-khaa-fu in a-sai-tu rab-bee a-zaa-ba yaw-min azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَّن يُصۡرَفۡ عَنۡهُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ فَقَدۡ رَحِمَهُۥۚ وَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: من يصرف عنه يومئذ فقد رحمه وذلك الفوز المبين
ayahs.translation: He from whom it is averted that Day - [Allāh] has granted him mercy. And that is the clear attainment.
ayahs.transliteration: mai yus-raf a-nhu yaw-mai-zin fa-qad ra-hi-mah wa-zaa-li-kal faw-zul mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِن يَمۡسَسۡكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرّٖ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَۖ وَإِن يَمۡسَسۡكَ بِخَيۡرٖ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: وان يمسسك الله بضر فلا كاشف له الا هو وان يمسسك بخير فهو علي كل شيء قدير
ayahs.translation: And if Allāh should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him. And if He touches you with good - then He is over all things competent.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-ny yam-sas-kal laa-hu bi-dur-rin fa-laaa kaa-shi-fa la-hoo il-laa hu-wa wai-ny yam-sas-ka bi-khai-rin fa-hu-wa a-laa kul-li shaiin qadeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلۡقَاهِرُ فَوۡقَ عِبَادِهِۦۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: وهو القاهر فوق عباده وهو الحكيم الخبير
ayahs.translation: And He is the subjugator over His servants. And He is the Wise, the Aware.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wal qaa-hi-ru faw-qa i-baa-dih wa-hu-wal hakee-mul khabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أَيُّ شَيۡءٍ أَكۡبَرُ شَهَٰدَةٗۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُۖ شَهِيدُۢ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكُمۡۚ وَأُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لِأُنذِرَكُم بِهِۦ وَمَنۢ بَلَغَۚ أَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَشۡهَدُونَ أَنَّ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً أُخۡرَىٰۚ قُل لَّآ أَشۡهَدُۚ قُلۡ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞ وَإِنَّنِي بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تُشۡرِكُونَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: قل اي شيء اكبر شهدة قل الله شهيد بيني وبينكم واوحي الي هذا القرءان لانذركم به ومن بلغ ائنكم لتشهدون ان مع الله ءالهة اخري قل لا اشهد قل انما هو اله وحد وانني بريء مما تشركون
ayahs.translation: Say, "What thing is greatest in testimony?" Say, "Allāh is witness between me and you. And this Qur’ān was revealed to me that I may warn you thereby and whomever it reaches. Do you [truly] testify that with Allāh there are other deities?" Say, "I will not testify [with you]." Say, "Indeed, He is but one God, and indeed, I am free of what you associate [with Him]."
ayahs.transliteration: qul ayyu shaiin ak-ba-ru sha-haa-da-tan qu-lil laa-hu shahee-dum bainee wa-bai-na-kum waoo-hiya i-laiya haa-zal qu-raa-nu liun-zi-ra-kum bihee wa-mam ba-lagh ain-na-kum la-tas-hha-doo-na an-na maal laa-hi aa-li-ha-tan uk-hraa qul laaa as-hhad qul in-na-maa hu-wa i-laa-hunw waa-hi-dunw wain-na-nee baree-um mim-maa tus-hri-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يَعۡرِفُونَهُۥ كَمَا يَعۡرِفُونَ أَبۡنَآءَهُمُۘ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: الذين ءاتينهم الكتب يعرفونه كما يعرفون ابناءهم الذين خسروا انفسهم فهم لا يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: Those to whom We have given the Scripture recognize it as they recognize their [own] sons. Those who will lose themselves [in the Hereafter] do not believe.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na aa-tai-naa-hu-mul ki-taa-ba ya-ri-foo-na-hoo ka-maa ya-ri-foo-na ab-naaaa-hum al-la-zee-na kha-si-rooo an-fu-sa-hum fa-hum laa yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوۡ كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: ومن اظلم ممن افتري علي الله كذبا او كذب بايته انه لا يفلح الظلمون
ayahs.translation: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allāh a lie or denies His verses? Indeed, the wrongdoers will not succeed.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-man az-la-mu mim-man if-ta-ra a-lal laa-hi ka-zi-ban aw kaz-za-ba bi-a-ayaa-tih in-na-hoo laa yuf-li-huz zaa-li-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُهُمۡ جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُوٓاْ أَيۡنَ شُرَكَآؤُكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمۡ تَزۡعُمُونَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: ويوم نحشرهم جميعا ثم نقول للذين اشركوا اين شركاؤكم الذين كنتم تزعمون
ayahs.translation: And [mention, O Muḥammad], the Day We will gather them all together; then We will say to those who associated others with Allāh, "Where are your 'partners' that you used to claim [with Him]?"
ayahs.transliteration: wayaw-ma nah-shu-ru-hum jameean sum-ma na-qoo-lu lil-la-zee-na as-hra-kooo ay-na shu-ra-kaaau-ku-mul lazee-na kun-tum ta-zu-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَمۡ تَكُن فِتۡنَتُهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ وَٱللَّهِ رَبِّنَا مَا كُنَّا مُشۡرِكِينَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: ثم لم تكن فتنتهم الا ان قالوا والله ربنا ما كنا مشركين
ayahs.translation: Then there will be no [excuse upon] examination except they will say, "By Allāh, our Lord, we were not those who associated."
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma lam ta-kun fit-na-tu-hum il-laaa an qaa-loo wal-laa-hi rab-bi-naa maa kun-naa mus-hri-keen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَذَبُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡۚ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: انظر كيف كذبوا علي انفسهم وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون
ayahs.translation: See how they will lie about themselves. And lost from them will be what they used to invent.
ayahs.transliteration: un-zur kai-fa ka-za-boo a-laaa an-fu-si-him wa-dal-la a-nhum maa kaa-noo yaf-ta-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَسۡتَمِعُ إِلَيۡكَۖ وَجَعَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفۡقَهُوهُ وَفِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرٗاۚ وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كُلَّ ءَايَةٖ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِهَاۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوكَ يُجَٰدِلُونَكَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: ومنهم من يستمع اليك وجعلنا علي قلوبهم اكنة ان يفقهوه وفي ءاذانهم وقرا وان يروا كل ءاية لا يؤمنوا بها حتي اذا جاءوك يجدلونك يقول الذين كفروا ان هذا الا اسطير الاولين
ayahs.translation: And among them are those who listen to you, but We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if they should see every sign, they will not believe in it. Even when they come to you arguing with you, those who disbelieve say, "This is not but legends of the former peoples."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mi-nhum mai yas-ta-miu i-lai-ka wa-jaal-naa a-laa qu-loo-bi-him a-kin-na-tan ai yaf-qa-hoo-hu wafeee aa-zaa-ni-him waq-raa waai ya-raw kul-la aaya-til laa yu-mi-noo bi-haa hat-taaa i-zaa jaaaoo-ka yu-jaa-di-loo-na-ka ya-qoo-lul lazee-na ka-fa-roo in haa-zaa il-laaa a-saa-tee-rul aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُمۡ يَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنۡهُ وَيَنۡـَٔوۡنَ عَنۡهُۖ وَإِن يُهۡلِكُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: وهم ينهون عنه وينون عنه وان يهلكون الا انفسهم وما يشعرون
ayahs.translation: And they prevent [others] from him and are [themselves] remote from him. And they do not destroy except themselves, but they perceive [it] not.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hum ya-nhaw-na a-nhu waya-naw-na a-nhu wai-ny yuh-li-koo-na il-laa an-fu-sa-hum wa-maa ya-shu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡ تَرَىٰٓ إِذۡ وُقِفُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَقَالُواْ يَٰلَيۡتَنَا نُرَدُّ وَلَا نُكَذِّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّنَا وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولو تري اذ وقفوا علي النار فقالوا يليتنا نرد ولا نكذب بايت ربنا ونكون من المؤمنين
ayahs.translation: If you could but see when they are made to stand before the Fire and will say, "Oh, would that we could be returned [to life on earth] and not deny the signs of our Lord and be among the believers."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law ta-raaa iz wu-qi-foo a-lan naa-ri fa-qaa-loo yaa-lai-ta-naa nu-rad-du wa-laa nu-kaz-zi-ba bi-a-ayaa-ti rab-bi-naa wa-na-koo-na mi-nal mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ بَدَا لَهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُخۡفُونَ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَلَوۡ رُدُّواْ لَعَادُواْ لِمَا نُهُواْ عَنۡهُ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: بل بدا لهم ما كانوا يخفون من قبل ولو ردوا لعادوا لما نهوا عنه وانهم لكذبون
ayahs.translation: But what they concealed before has [now] appeared to them. And even if they were returned, they would return to that which they were forbidden; and indeed, they are liars.
ayahs.transliteration: bal ba-daa la-hum maa kaa-noo yuk-hfoo-na min qab-lu wa-law rud-doo laaa-doo li-maa nu-hoo a-nhu wain-na-hum la-kaa-zi-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَبۡعُوثِينَ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا ان هي الا حياتنا الدنيا وما نحن بمبعوثين
ayahs.translation: And they say, "There is none but our worldly life, and we will not be resurrected."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-looo in hiya il-laa hayaa-tu-nad du-nyaa wa-maa nah-nu bi-ma-booseen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡ تَرَىٰٓ إِذۡ وُقِفُواْ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡۚ قَالَ أَلَيۡسَ هَٰذَا بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَاۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: ولو تري اذ وقفوا علي ربهم قال اليس هذا بالحق قالوا بلي وربنا قال فذوقوا العذاب بما كنتم تكفرون
ayahs.translation: If you could but see when they will be made to stand before their Lord. He will say, "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will [then] say, "So taste the punishment for what you used to deny."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law ta-raa iz wu-qi-foo a-laa rab-bi-him qaa-la a-lai-sa haa-zaa bi-lhaqq qaa-loo ba-laa wa-rab-bi-naa qaa-la fa-zoo-qul a-zaa-ba bi-maa kun-tum tak-fu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَدۡ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِلِقَآءِ ٱللَّهِۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغۡتَةٗ قَالُواْ يَٰحَسۡرَتَنَا عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطۡنَا فِيهَا وَهُمۡ يَحۡمِلُونَ أَوۡزَارَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِمۡۚ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: قد خسر الذين كذبوا بلقاء الله حتي اذا جاءتهم الساعة بغتة قالوا يحسرتنا علي ما فرطنا فيها وهم يحملون اوزارهم علي ظهورهم الا ساء ما يزرون
ayahs.translation: Those will have lost who deny the meeting with Allāh, until when the Hour [of resurrection] comes upon them unexpectedly, they will say, "Oh, [how great is] our regret over what we neglected concerning it [i.e., the Hour]," while they bear their burdens [i.e., sins] on their backs. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear.
ayahs.transliteration: qad kha-si-ral lazee-na kaz-za-boo bi-li-qaaail laa-hi hat-taaa i-zaa jaaaa-thu-mus saaa-tu bag-hta-tan qaa-loo yaa-has-ra-ta-naa a-laa maa far-rat-naa fee-haa wa-hum yah-mi-loo-na aw-zaa-ra-hum a-laa zu-hoo-ri-him a-laa saaaa ma ya-zi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَآ إِلَّا لَعِبٞ وَلَهۡوٞۖ وَلَلدَّارُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرٞ لِّلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: وما الحيوة الدنيا الا لعب ولهو وللدار الاخرة خير للذين يتقون افلا تعقلون
ayahs.translation: And the worldly life is not but amusement and diversion; but the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allāh, so will you not reason?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mal hayaa-tud du-nyaaa il-laa lai-bunw wa-lah-wunw wa-lad-daa-rul aa-khi-ra-tu khaiy-rul lil-la-zee-na yat-ta-qoon a-fa-laa ta-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيَحۡزُنُكَ ٱلَّذِي يَقُولُونَۖ فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَا يُكَذِّبُونَكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يَجۡحَدُونَ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: قد نعلم انه ليحزنك الذي يقولون فانهم لا يكذبونك ولكن الظلمين بايت الله يجحدون
ayahs.translation: We know that you, [O Muḥammad], are saddened by what they say. And indeed, they do not call you untruthful, but it is the verses of Allāh that the wrongdoers reject.
ayahs.transliteration: qad na-la-mu in-na-hoo layah-zu-nu-kal lazee ya-qoo-loo-na fain-na-hum laa yu-kaz-zi-boo-na-ka wa-laa-kin-naz zaa-li-mee-na bi-a-ayaa-til laa-hi ya-jha-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ كُذِّبَتۡ رُسُلٞ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَصَبَرُواْ عَلَىٰ مَا كُذِّبُواْ وَأُوذُواْ حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰهُمۡ نَصۡرُنَاۚ وَلَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَكَ مِن نَّبَإِيْ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد كذبت رسل من قبلك فصبروا علي ما كذبوا واوذوا حتي اتيهم نصرنا ولا مبدل لكلمت الله ولقد جاءك من نباي المرسلين
ayahs.translation: And certainly were messengers denied before you, but they were patient over the denial, and they were harmed until Our victory came to them. And none can alter the words [i.e., decrees] of Allāh. And there has certainly come to you some information about the [previous] messengers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad kuz-zi-bat ru-su-lum min qab-li-ka fa-sa-ba-roo a-laa maa kuz-zi-boo waoo-zoo hat-taaa a-taa-hum nas-ru-naa wa-laa mu-bad-di-la li-ka-li-maa-til laah wa-la-qad jaaaa-ka min na-bail mur-saleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِن كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيۡكَ إِعۡرَاضُهُمۡ فَإِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتَ أَن تَبۡتَغِيَ نَفَقٗا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَوۡ سُلَّمٗا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَأۡتِيَهُم بِـَٔايَةٖۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَمَعَهُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰۚ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِينَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: وان كان كبر عليك اعراضهم فان استطعت ان تبتغي نفقا في الارض او سلما في السماء فتاتيهم باية ولو شاء الله لجمعهم علي الهدي فلا تكونن من الجهلين
ayahs.translation: And if their evasion is difficult for you, then if you are able to seek a tunnel into the earth or a stairway into the sky to bring them a sign, [then do so]. But if Allāh had willed, He would have united them upon guidance. So never be of the ignorant.
ayahs.transliteration: wain kaa-na ka-bu-ra a-lai-ka i-raa-du-hum fai-nis ta-ta-ta an tab-ta-ghiya na-fa-qan fil ar-di aw sul-la-man fis sa-maaai fa-ta-tiya-hum bi-a-ayah wa-law shaaaal laa-hu la-ja-maa-hum a-lal hu-daa fa-laa ta-koo-nan-na mi-nal jaa-hileen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ إِنَّمَا يَسۡتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡمَعُونَۘ وَٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ يَبۡعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ يُرۡجَعُونَ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: انما يستجيب الذين يسمعون والموتي يبعثهم الله ثم اليه يرجعون
ayahs.translation: Only those who hear will respond. But the dead - Allāh will resurrect them; then to Him they will be returned.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-maa yas-ta-jee-bul lazee-na yas-maoon wal-maw-taa ya-ba-su-hu-mul laa-hu sum-ma i-lai-hi yur-jaoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُنَزِّلَ ءَايَةٗ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا لولا نزل عليه ءاية من ربه قل ان الله قادر علي ان ينزل ءاية ولكن اكثرهم لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: And they say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "Indeed, Allāh is Able to send down a sign, but most of them do not know."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-loo law-laa nuz-zi-la a-lai-hi aaya-tum mir rab-bih qul in-nal laa-ha qaa-di-run a-laaa ai yu-naz-zi-la aaya-tanw wa-laa-kin-na ak-sa-ra-hum laa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا طَٰٓئِرٖ يَطِيرُ بِجَنَاحَيۡهِ إِلَّآ أُمَمٌ أَمۡثَالُكُمۚ مَّا فَرَّطۡنَا فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِن شَيۡءٖۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يُحۡشَرُونَ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: وما من دابة في الارض ولا طئر يطير بجناحيه الا امم امثالكم ما فرطنا في الكتب من شيء ثم الي ربهم يحشرون
ayahs.translation: And there is no creature on [or within] the earth or bird that flies with its wings except [that they are] communities like you. We have not neglected in the Register a thing. Then unto their Lord they will be gathered.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa min daaab-ba-tin fil ar-di wa-laa taaai-ri-ny ya-tee-ru bi-ja-naa-hai-hi il-laaa u-ma-mun am-saa-lu-kum maa far-rat-naa fil ki-taa-bi min shaiyy sum-ma i-laa rab-bi-him yuh-sha-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا صُمّٞ وَبُكۡمٞ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِۗ مَن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يُضۡلِلۡهُ وَمَن يَشَأۡ يَجۡعَلۡهُ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: والذين كذبوا بايتنا صم وبكم في الظلمت من يشا الله يضلله ومن يشا يجعله علي صرط مستقيم
ayahs.translation: But those who deny Our verses are deaf and dumb within darknesses. Whomever Allāh wills - He sends astray; and whomever He wills - He puts him on a straight path.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na kaz-za-boo bi-a-ayaa-ti-naa sum-munw wa-buk-mun fiz zu-lu-maat mai ya-shail laa-hu yud-lil-lhu wa-mai ya-shaa ya-ja-lhu a-laa si-raa-tim mus-taqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتَكُمۡ إِنۡ أَتَىٰكُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡ أَتَتۡكُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ تَدۡعُونَ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: قل ارءيتكم ان اتيكم عذاب الله او اتتكم الساعة اغير الله تدعون ان كنتم صدقين
ayahs.translation: Say, "Have you considered: if there came to you the punishment of Allāh or there came to you the Hour - is it other than Allāh you would invoke, if you should be truthful?"
ayahs.transliteration: qul a-raay-ta-kum in a-taa-kum a-zaa-bul laa-hi aw a-tat-ku-mus saaa-tu a-ghai-ral laa-hi ta-doo-na in kun-tum saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ إِيَّاهُ تَدۡعُونَ فَيَكۡشِفُ مَا تَدۡعُونَ إِلَيۡهِ إِن شَآءَ وَتَنسَوۡنَ مَا تُشۡرِكُونَ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: بل اياه تدعون فيكشف ما تدعون اليه ان شاء وتنسون ما تشركون
ayahs.translation: No, it is Him [alone] you would invoke, and He would remove that for which you invoked Him if He willed, and you would forget what you associate [with Him].
ayahs.transliteration: bal iyyaa-hu ta-doo-na fayak-shi-fu maa ta-doo-na i-lai-hi in shaaaa wa-tan-saw-na maa tus-hri-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡبَأۡسَآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَضَرَّعُونَ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ارسلنا الي امم من قبلك فاخذنهم بالباساء والضراء لعلهم يتضرعون
ayahs.translation: And We have already sent [messengers] to nations before you, [O Muḥammad]; then We seized them with poverty and hardship that perhaps they might humble themselves [to Us].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad ar-sal-naaa i-laaa u-ma-mim min qab-li-ka faa-khaz-naa-hum bil-ba-saaai wad-dar-raaai laal-la-hum ya-ta-dar-raoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَوۡلَآ إِذۡ جَآءَهُم بَأۡسُنَا تَضَرَّعُواْ وَلَٰكِن قَسَتۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: فلولا اذ جاءهم باسنا تضرعوا ولكن قست قلوبهم وزين لهم الشيطن ما كانوا يعملون
ayahs.translation: Then why, when Our punishment came to them, did they not humble themselves? But their hearts became hardened, and Satan made attractive to them that which they were doing.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-law-laaa iz jaaaa-hum ba-su-naa ta-dar-raoo wa-laa-kin qa-sat qu-loo-bu-hum wa-zaiya-na la-hu-mush shai-taa-nu maa kaa-noo ya-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا نَسُواْ مَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِهِۦ فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَبۡوَٰبَ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَرِحُواْ بِمَآ أُوتُوٓاْ أَخَذۡنَٰهُم بَغۡتَةٗ فَإِذَا هُم مُّبۡلِسُونَ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به فتحنا عليهم ابوب كل شيء حتي اذا فرحوا بما اوتوا اخذنهم بغتة فاذا هم مبلسون
ayahs.translation: So when they forgot that by which they had been reminded, We opened to them the doors of every [good] thing until, when they rejoiced in that which they were given, We seized them suddenly, and they were [then] in despair.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa na-soo maa zuk-ki-roo bihee fa-tah-naa a-lai-him ab-waa-ba kul-li shaiin hat-taaa i-zaa fa-ri-hoo bi-maaa oo-tooo a-khaz-naa-hum bag-hta-tan fai-zaa hum mub-li-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْۚ وَٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: فقطع دابر القوم الذين ظلموا والحمد لله رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: So the people that committed wrong were eliminated. And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qu-ti-a daa-bi-rul qaw-mil lazee-na za-la-moo wa-lham-du lil-laa-hi rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ سَمۡعَكُمۡ وَأَبۡصَٰرَكُمۡ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُم مَّنۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأۡتِيكُم بِهِۗ ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ ثُمَّ هُمۡ يَصۡدِفُونَ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: قل ارءيتم ان اخذ الله سمعكم وابصركم وختم علي قلوبكم من اله غير الله ياتيكم به انظر كيف نصرف الايت ثم هم يصدفون
ayahs.translation: Say, "Have you considered: if Allāh should take away your hearing and your sight and set a seal upon your hearts, which deity other than Allāh could bring them [back] to you?" Look how We diversify the verses; then they [still] turn away.
ayahs.transliteration: qul a-raai-tum in a-kha-zal laa-hu sa-ma-kum waab-saa-ra-kum wa-kha-ta-ma a-laa qu-loo-bi-kum man i-laa-hun ghai-rul laa-hi ya-tee-kum bih un-zur kai-fa nu-sar-ri-ful aayaa-ti sum-ma hum yas-di-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتَكُمۡ إِنۡ أَتَىٰكُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱللَّهِ بَغۡتَةً أَوۡ جَهۡرَةً هَلۡ يُهۡلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلۡقَوۡمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: قل ارءيتكم ان اتيكم عذاب الله بغتة او جهرة هل يهلك الا القوم الظلمون
ayahs.translation: Say, "Have you considered: if the punishment of Allāh should come to you unexpectedly or manifestly, will any be destroyed but the wrongdoing people?"
ayahs.transliteration: qul a-raai-ta-kum in a-taa-kum a-zaa-bul laa-hi bag-hta-tan aw jah-ra-tan hal yuh-la-ku il-lal qaw-muz zaa-li-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا نُرۡسِلُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَۖ فَمَنۡ ءَامَنَ وَأَصۡلَحَ فَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: وما نرسل المرسلين الا مبشرين ومنذرين فمن ءامن واصلح فلا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
ayahs.translation: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. So whoever believes and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa nur-si-lul mur-sa-lee-na il-laa mu-bas-hshi-ree-na wa-mun-zi-ree-na fa-man aa-ma-na waas-la-ha fa-laa khaw-fun a-lai-him wa-laa hum yah-za-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡسُقُونَ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: والذين كذبوا بايتنا يمسهم العذاب بما كانوا يفسقون
ayahs.translation: But those who deny Our verses - the punishment will touch them for their defiant disobedience.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na kaz-za-boo bi-a-ayaa-ti-naa ya-mas-su-hu-mul a-zaa-bu bi-maa kaa-noo yaf-su-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُل لَّآ أَقُولُ لَكُمۡ عِندِي خَزَآئِنُ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ وَلَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمۡ إِنِّي مَلَكٌۖ إِنۡ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّۚ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ وَٱلۡبَصِيرُۚ أَفَلَا تَتَفَكَّرُونَ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: قل لا اقول لكم عندي خزائن الله ولا اعلم الغيب ولا اقول لكم اني ملك ان اتبع الا ما يوحي الي قل هل يستوي الاعمي والبصير افلا تتفكرون
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not tell you that I have the depositories [containing the provision] of Allāh or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel. I only follow what is revealed to me." Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Then will you not give thought?"
ayahs.transliteration: qul laaa a-qoo-lu la-kum in-dee kha-zaaai-nul laa-hi wa-laaa a-la-mul ghai-ba wa-laaa a-qoo-lu la-kum in-nee ma-la-kun in at-ta-biu il-laa maa yoo-haaa i-laiy qul hal yas-ta-wil a-maa wal-baseer a-fa-laa ta-ta-fak-ka-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنذِرۡ بِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَن يُحۡشَرُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ لَيۡسَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ وَلِيّٞ وَلَا شَفِيعٞ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: وانذر به الذين يخافون ان يحشروا الي ربهم ليس لهم من دونه ولي ولا شفيع لعلهم يتقون
ayahs.translation: And warn by it [i.e., the Qur’ān] those who fear that they will be gathered before their Lord - for them besides Him will be no protector and no intercessor - that they might become righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: waan-zir bi-hil lazee-na ya-khaa-foo-na ai yuh-sha-rooo i-laa rab-bi-him lai-sa la-hum min doo-nihee wa-liyyunw wa-laa shafee-ul laal-la-hum yat-ta-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَطۡرُدِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلۡعَشِيِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجۡهَهُۥۖ مَا عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَيۡءٖ وَمَا مِنۡ حِسَابِكَ عَلَيۡهِم مِّن شَيۡءٖ فَتَطۡرُدَهُمۡ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: ولا تطرد الذين يدعون ربهم بالغدوة والعشي يريدون وجهه ما عليك من حسابهم من شيء وما من حسابك عليهم من شيء فتطردهم فتكون من الظلمين
ayahs.translation: And do not send away those who call upon their Lord morning and afternoon, seeking His face [i.e., favor]. Not upon you is anything of their account and not upon them is anything of your account. So were you to send them away, you would [then] be of the wrongdoers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa tat-ru-dil lazee-na ya-doo-na rab-ba-hum bil-gha-daa-ti wa-la-shiyyi yu-ree-doo-na wa-jha-hoo ma a-lai-ka min hi-saa-bi-him min shaiinw wa-maa min hi-saa-bi-ka a-lai-him min shaiin fa-tat-ru-da-hum fa-ta-koo-na mi-naz zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعۡضَهُم بِبَعۡضٖ لِّيَقُولُوٓاْ أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنۢ بَيۡنِنَآۗ أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعۡلَمَ بِٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: وكذلك فتنا بعضهم ببعض ليقولوا اهؤلاء من الله عليهم من بيننا اليس الله باعلم بالشكرين
ayahs.translation: And thus We have tried some of them through others that they [i.e., the disbelievers] might say, "Is it these whom Allāh has favored among us?" Is not Allāh most knowing of those who are grateful?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ka-zaa-li-ka fa-tan-naa ba-da-hum bi-ba-dil liya-qoo-looo a-haaau-laaai man-nal laa-hu a-lai-him mim bai-ni-naa a-lai-sal laa-hu bi-a-la-ma bis-hshaa-kireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَقُلۡ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَةَ أَنَّهُۥ مَنۡ عَمِلَ مِنكُمۡ سُوٓءَۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٖ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ وَأَصۡلَحَ فَأَنَّهُۥ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: واذا جاءك الذين يؤمنون بايتنا فقل سلم عليكم كتب ربكم علي نفسه الرحمة انه من عمل منكم سوءا بجهلة ثم تاب من بعده واصلح فانه غفور رحيم
ayahs.translation: And when those come to you who believe in Our verses, say, "Peace be upon you. Your Lord has decreed upon Himself mercy: that any of you who does wrong out of ignorance and then repents after that and corrects himself - indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful."
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa jaaaa-kal lazee-na yu-mi-noo-na bi-a-ayaa-ti-naa fa-qul sa-laa-mun a-lai-kum ka-ta-ba rab-bu-kum a-laa naf-si-hir rah-ma-ta an-na-hoo man a-mi-la min-kum sooo-am bi-ja-haa-la-tin sum-ma taa-ba mim ba-dihee waas-la-ha faan-na-hoo gha-foo-rur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ وَلِتَسۡتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: وكذلك نفصل الايت ولتستبين سبيل المجرمين
ayahs.translation: And thus do We detail the verses, and [thus] the way of the criminals will become evident.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ka-zaa-li-ka nu-fas-si-lul aayaa-ti wa-li-tas-ta-bee-na sabee-lul muj-rimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنِّي نُهِيتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۚ قُل لَّآ أَتَّبِعُ أَهۡوَآءَكُمۡ قَدۡ ضَلَلۡتُ إِذٗا وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: قل اني نهيت ان اعبد الذين تدعون من دون الله قل لا اتبع اهواءكم قد ضللت اذا وما انا من المهتدين
ayahs.translation: Say, "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you invoke besides Allāh." Say, "I will not follow your desires, for I would then have gone astray, and I would not be of the [rightly] guided."
ayahs.transliteration: qul in-nee nuhee-tu an a-bu-dal lazee-na ta-doo-na min doo-nil laah qul laaa at-ta-biu ah-waaaa-kum qad da-lal-tu i-zanw wa-maaa a-na mi-nal muh-tadeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنِّي عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّي وَكَذَّبۡتُم بِهِۦۚ مَا عِندِي مَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ بِهِۦٓۚ إِنِ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِۖ يَقُصُّ ٱلۡحَقَّۖ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡفَٰصِلِينَ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: قل اني علي بينة من ربي وكذبتم به ما عندي ما تستعجلون به ان الحكم الا لله يقص الحق وهو خير الفصلين
ayahs.translation: Say, "Indeed, I am on clear evidence from my Lord, and you have denied it. I do not have that for which you are impatient. The decision is only for Allāh. He relates the truth, and He is the best of deciders."
ayahs.transliteration: qul in-nee a-laa baiyi-na-tim mir rab-bee wa-kaz-zab-tum bih maa in-dee maa tas-ta-ji-loo-na bih i-nil huk-mu il-laa lil-laa-hi ya-qus-sul haq-qa wa-hu-wa khai-rul faa-sileen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُل لَّوۡ أَنَّ عِندِي مَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ بِهِۦ لَقُضِيَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: قل لو ان عندي ما تستعجلون به لقضي الامر بيني وبينكم والله اعلم بالظلمين
ayahs.translation: Say, "If I had that for which you are impatient, the matter would have been decided between me and you, but Allāh is most knowing of the wrongdoers."
ayahs.transliteration: qul law an-na in-dee maa tas-ta-ji-loo-na bihee la-qu-diyal am-ru bainee wa-bai-na-kum wal-laa-hu a-la-mu biz-zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَعِندَهُۥ مَفَاتِحُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ لَا يَعۡلَمُهَآ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِۚ وَمَا تَسۡقُطُ مِن وَرَقَةٍ إِلَّا يَعۡلَمُهَا وَلَا حَبَّةٖ فِي ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا رَطۡبٖ وَلَا يَابِسٍ إِلَّا فِي كِتَٰبٖ مُّبِينٖ ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: وعنده مفاتح الغيب لا يعلمها الا هو ويعلم ما في البر والبحر وما تسقط من ورقة الا يعلمها ولا حبة في ظلمت الارض ولا رطب ولا يابس الا في كتب مبين
ayahs.translation: And with Him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them except Him. And He knows what is on the land and in the sea. Not a leaf falls but that He knows it. And no grain is there within the darknesses of the earth and no moist or dry [thing] but that it is [written] in a clear record.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-da-hoo ma-faa-ti-hul ghai-bi laa ya-la-mu-haaa il-laa hoo waya-la-mu maa fil bar-ri wal-bahr wa-maa tas-qu-tu minw wa-ra-qa-tin il-laa ya-la-mu-haa wa-laa hab-ba-tin fee zu-lu-maa-til ar-di wa-laa rat-binw wa-laa yaa-bi-sin il-laa fee ki-taa-bim mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا جَرَحۡتُم بِٱلنَّهَارِ ثُمَّ يَبۡعَثُكُمۡ فِيهِ لِيُقۡضَىٰٓ أَجَلٞ مُّسَمّٗىۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: وهو الذي يتوفيكم باليل ويعلم ما جرحتم بالنهار ثم يبعثكم فيه ليقضي اجل مسمي ثم اليه مرجعكم ثم ينبئكم بما كنتم تعملون
ayahs.translation: And it is He who takes your souls by night and knows what you have committed by day. Then He revives you therein [i.e., by day] that a specified term may be fulfilled. Then to Him will be your return; then He will inform you about what you used to do.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wal lazee ya-ta-waf-faa-kum bil-lai-li waya-la-mu maa ja-rah-tum bin-na-haa-ri sum-ma ya-ba-su-kum feehee liyuq-daaa a-ja-lum mu-sam-man sum-ma i-lai-hi mar-jiu-kum sum-ma yu-nab-biu-kum bi-maa kun-tum ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلۡقَاهِرُ فَوۡقَ عِبَادِهِۦۖ وَيُرۡسِلُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَفَظَةً حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ تَوَفَّتۡهُ رُسُلُنَا وَهُمۡ لَا يُفَرِّطُونَ ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: وهو القاهر فوق عباده ويرسل عليكم حفظة حتي اذا جاء احدكم الموت توفته رسلنا وهم لا يفرطون
ayahs.translation: And He is the subjugator over His servants, and He sends over you guardian-angels until, when death comes to one of you, Our messengers [i.e., angels of death] take him, and they do not fail [in their duties].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wal qaa-hi-ru faw-qa i-baa-dihee wayur-si-lu a-lai-kum ha-fa-za-tan hat-taaa i-zaa jaaaa a-ha-da-ku-mul maw-tu ta-waf-fa-thu ru-su-lu-naa wa-hum laa yu-far-ri-toon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ رُدُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَوۡلَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ وَهُوَ أَسۡرَعُ ٱلۡحَٰسِبِينَ ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: ثم ردوا الي الله موليهم الحق الا له الحكم وهو اسرع الحسبين
ayahs.translation: Then they [i.e., His servants] are returned to Allāh, their true Lord. Unquestionably, His is the judgement, and He is the swiftest of accountants.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma rud-dooo i-lal laa-hi maw-laa-hu-mul haqq a-laa la-hul huk-mu wa-hu-wa as-raul haa-sibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ مَن يُنَجِّيكُم مِّن ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ تَدۡعُونَهُۥ تَضَرُّعٗا وَخُفۡيَةٗ لَّئِنۡ أَنجَىٰنَا مِنۡ هَٰذِهِۦ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ ٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: قل من ينجيكم من ظلمت البر والبحر تدعونه تضرعا وخفية لئن انجينا من هذه لنكونن من الشكرين
ayahs.translation: Say, "Who rescues you from the darknesses of the land and sea [when] you call upon Him imploring [aloud] and privately, 'If He should save us from this [crisis], we will surely be among the thankful.'"
ayahs.transliteration: qul mai yu-naj-jee-kum min zu-lu-maa-til bar-ri wal-bah-ri ta-doo-na-hoo ta-dar-ru-anw wa-khu-fya-tal lain an-jaa-naa min haa-zihee la-na-koo-nan-na mi-nash shaa-kireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُنَجِّيكُم مِّنۡهَا وَمِن كُلِّ كَرۡبٖ ثُمَّ أَنتُمۡ تُشۡرِكُونَ ٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: قل الله ينجيكم منها ومن كل كرب ثم انتم تشركون
ayahs.translation: Say, "It is Allāh who saves you from it and from every distress; then you [still] associate others with Him."
ayahs.transliteration: qu-lil laa-hu yu-naj-jjee-kum mi-nhaa wa-min kul-li kar-bin sum-ma an-tum tus-hri-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلۡقَادِرُ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَبۡعَثَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابٗا مِّن فَوۡقِكُمۡ أَوۡ مِن تَحۡتِ أَرۡجُلِكُمۡ أَوۡ يَلۡبِسَكُمۡ شِيَعٗا وَيُذِيقَ بَعۡضَكُم بَأۡسَ بَعۡضٍۗ ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَفۡقَهُونَ ٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: قل هو القادر علي ان يبعث عليكم عذابا من فوقكم او من تحت ارجلكم او يلبسكم شيعا ويذيق بعضكم باس بعض انظر كيف نصرف الايت لعلهم يفقهون
ayahs.translation: Say, "He is the [one] Able to send upon you affliction from above you or from beneath your feet or to confuse you [so you become] sects and make you taste the violence of one another." Look how We diversify the signs that they might understand.
ayahs.transliteration: qul hu-wal qaa-di-ru a-laaa ai ya-ba-sa a-lai-kum a-zaa-bam min faw-qi-kum aw min tah-ti ar-ju-li-kum aw yal-bi-sa-kum shiyaanw wayuzee-qa ba-da-kum ba-sa bad un-zur kai-fa nu-sar-ri-ful aayaa-ti laal-la-hum yaf-qa-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبَ بِهِۦ قَوۡمُكَ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّۚ قُل لَّسۡتُ عَلَيۡكُم بِوَكِيلٖ ٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: وكذب به قومك وهو الحق قل لست عليكم بوكيل
ayahs.translation: But your people have denied it while it is the truth. Say, "I am not over you a manager [i.e., authority]."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kaz-za-ba bihee qaw-mu-ka wa-hu-wal haqq qul las-tu a-lai-kum bi-wakeel

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِّكُلِّ نَبَإٖ مُّسۡتَقَرّٞۚ وَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ ٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: لكل نبا مستقر وسوف تعلمون
ayahs.translation: For every news [i.e., happening] is a finality; and you are going to know.
ayahs.transliteration: li-kul-li na-baim mus-ta-qar-runw wa-saw-fa ta-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يَخُوضُواْ فِي حَدِيثٍ غَيۡرِهِۦۚ وَإِمَّا يُنسِيَنَّكَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ فَلَا تَقۡعُدۡ بَعۡدَ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ مَعَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: واذا رايت الذين يخوضون في ءايتنا فاعرض عنهم حتي يخوضوا في حديث غيره واما ينسينك الشيطن فلا تقعد بعد الذكري مع القوم الظلمين
ayahs.translation: And when you see those who engage in [offensive] discourse concerning Our verses, then turn away from them until they enter into another conversation. And if Satan should cause you to forget, then do not remain after the reminder with the wrongdoing people.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa raai-tal lazee-na ya-khoo-doo-na feee aayaa-ti-naa faa-rid a-nhum hat-taa yak-khoo-doo fee hadee-sin ghai-rih waim-maa yun-siyan-na-kash shai-taa-nu fa-laa ta-qud ba-daz zik-raa maal qaw-miz zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ مِنۡ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَيۡءٖ وَلَٰكِن ذِكۡرَىٰ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ ٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: وما علي الذين يتقون من حسابهم من شيء ولكن ذكري لعلهم يتقون
ayahs.translation: And those who fear Allāh are not held accountable for them [i.e., the disbelievers] at all, but [only for] a reminder - that perhaps they will fear Him.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa a-lal lazee-na yat-ta-qoo-na min hi-saa-bi-him min shaiinw wa-laa-kin zik-raa laal-la-hum yat-ta-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ دِينَهُمۡ لَعِبٗا وَلَهۡوٗا وَغَرَّتۡهُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَذَكِّرۡ بِهِۦٓ أَن تُبۡسَلَ نَفۡسُۢ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ لَيۡسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيّٞ وَلَا شَفِيعٞ وَإِن تَعۡدِلۡ كُلَّ عَدۡلٖ لَّا يُؤۡخَذۡ مِنۡهَآۗ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُبۡسِلُواْ بِمَا كَسَبُواْۖ لَهُمۡ شَرَابٞ مِّنۡ حَمِيمٖ وَعَذَابٌ أَلِيمُۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡفُرُونَ ٧٠
ayahs.text_simple: وذر الذين اتخذوا دينهم لعبا ولهوا وغرتهم الحيوة الدنيا وذكر به ان تبسل نفس بما كسبت ليس لها من دون الله ولي ولا شفيع وان تعدل كل عدل لا يؤخذ منها اولئك الذين ابسلوا بما كسبوا لهم شراب من حميم وعذاب اليم بما كانوا يكفرون
ayahs.translation: And leave those who take their religion as amusement and diversion and whom the worldly life has deluded. But remind with it [i.e., the Qur’ān], lest a soul be given up to destruction for what it earned; it will have other than Allāh no protector and no intercessor. And if it should offer every compensation, it would not be taken from it [i.e., that soul]. Those are the ones who are given to destruction for what they have earned. For them will be a drink of scalding water and a painful punishment because they used to disbelieve.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-za-ril lazee-nat ta-kha-zoo dee-na-hum lai-ban-wwa lah-wanw wa-ghar-ra-thu-mul hayaa-tud du-nyaa wa-zak-kir biheee an tub-sa-la naf-sum bi-maa ka-sa-bat lai-sa la-haa min doo-nil laa-hi wa-liyyunw wa-laa shafee-unw wain ta-dil kul-la ad-lil laa yu-khaz mi-nhaa u-laaai-kal lazee-na ub-si-loo bi-maa ka-sa-boo la-hum sha-raa-bum min hamee-minw waa-zaa-bun alee-mum bi-maa kaa-noo yak-kfu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أَنَدۡعُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُنَا وَلَا يَضُرُّنَا وَنُرَدُّ عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡقَابِنَا بَعۡدَ إِذۡ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ كَٱلَّذِي ٱسۡتَهۡوَتۡهُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ حَيۡرَانَ لَهُۥٓ أَصۡحَٰبٞ يَدۡعُونَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱلۡهُدَى ٱئۡتِنَاۗ قُلۡ إِنَّ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ هُوَ ٱلۡهُدَىٰۖ وَأُمِرۡنَا لِنُسۡلِمَ لِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٧١
ayahs.text_simple: قل اندعوا من دون الله ما لا ينفعنا ولا يضرنا ونرد علي اعقابنا بعد اذ هدينا الله كالذي استهوته الشيطين في الارض حيران له اصحب يدعونه الي الهدي ائتنا قل ان هدي الله هو الهدي وامرنا لنسلم لرب العلمين
ayahs.translation: Say, "Shall we invoke instead of Allāh that which neither benefits us nor harms us and be turned back on our heels after Allāh has guided us? [We would then be] like one whom the devils enticed [to wander] upon the earth confused, [while] he has companions inviting him to guidance, [calling], 'Come to us.'" Say, "Indeed, the guidance of Allāh is the [only] guidance; and we have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: qul a-na-doo min doo-nil laa-hi maa laa yan-fau-naa wa-laa ya-dur-ru-naa wa-nu-rad-du a-laaa a-qaa-bi-na ba-da iz ha-daa-nal laa-hu kal-la-zis tah-wa-thush shayaatee-nu fil ar-di hai-raa-na la-hooo a-shaa-bu-ny ya-doo-na-hooo i-lal hu-da ti-naa qul in-na hu-dal laa-hi hu-wal hu-daa wau-mir-naa li-nus-li-ma li-rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنۡ أَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّقُوهُۚ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ ٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: وان اقيموا الصلوة واتقوه وهو الذي اليه تحشرون
ayahs.translation: And to establish prayer and fear Him." And it is He to whom you will be gathered.
ayahs.transliteration: waan aqee-mus sa-laa-ta wat-ta-qooh wa-hu-wal lazeee i-lai-hi tuh-sha-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ وَيَوۡمَ يَقُولُ كُن فَيَكُونُۚ قَوۡلُهُ ٱلۡحَقُّۚ وَلَهُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِۚ عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ ٧٣
ayahs.text_simple: وهو الذي خلق السموت والارض بالحق ويوم يقول كن فيكون قوله الحق وله الملك يوم ينفخ في الصور علم الغيب والشهدة وهو الحكيم الخبير
ayahs.translation: And it is He who created the heavens and earth in truth. And the day [i.e., whenever] He says, "Be," and it is, His word is the truth. And His is the dominion [on] the Day the Horn is blown. [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed; and He is the Wise, the Aware.
ayahs.transliteration: waa-nhu-wal lazee kha-la-qas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da bi-lhaqq wayaw-ma ya-qoo-lu kun faya-koon qaw-lu-hul haqq wa-la-hul mul-ku yaw-ma yun-fa-khu fis soor aa-li-mul ghai-bi was-hsha-haa-dah wa-hu-wal hakee-mul khabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ ءَازَرَ أَتَتَّخِذُ أَصۡنَامًا ءَالِهَةً إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰكَ وَقَوۡمَكَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ ٧٤
ayahs.text_simple: واذ قال ابرهيم لابيه ءازر اتتخذ اصناما ءالهة اني اريك وقومك في ضلل مبين
ayahs.translation: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father Āzar, "Do you take idols as deities? Indeed, I see you and your people to be in manifest error."
ayahs.transliteration: waiz qaa-la ib-raa-hee-mu li-a-bee-hi aa-za-ra a-tat-ta-khi-zu as-naa-man aa-li-ha-tan in-neee a-raa-ka wa-qaw-ma-ka fee da-laa-lim mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِيٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُوقِنِينَ ٧٥
ayahs.text_simple: وكذلك نري ابرهيم ملكوت السموت والارض وليكون من الموقنين
ayahs.translation: And thus did We show Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be among the certain [in faith].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ka-zaa-li-ka nureee ib-raa-hee-ma ma-la-koo-tas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di wa-liya-koo-na mi-nal moo-qineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَنَّ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلَّيۡلُ رَءَا كَوۡكَبٗاۖ قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّيۖ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَآ أُحِبُّ ٱلۡأٓفِلِينَ ٧٦
ayahs.text_simple: فلما جن عليه اليل رءا كوكبا قال هذا ربي فلما افل قال لا احب الافلين
ayahs.translation: So when the night covered him [with darkness], he saw a star. He said, "This is my lord." But when it set, he said, "I like not those that set [i.e., disappear]."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa jan-na a-lai-hil lai-lu raaa kaw-ka-baan qaa-la haa-za rab-bee fa-lam-maaa a-fa-la qaa-la laaa u-hib-bul aa-fileen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلۡقَمَرَ بَازِغٗا قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّيۖ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَئِن لَّمۡ يَهۡدِنِي رَبِّي لَأَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ ٧٧
ayahs.text_simple: فلما رءا القمر بازغا قال هذا ربي فلما افل قال لئن لم يهدني ربي لاكونن من القوم الضالين
ayahs.translation: And when he saw the moon rising, he said, "This is my lord." But when it set, he said, "Unless my Lord guides me, I will surely be among the people gone astray."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-mmaa ra al-qa-ma-ra baa-zi-ghan qaa-la haa-zaa rab-bee fa-lam-maaa a-fa-la qaa-la lail lam yah-dinee rab-bee laa-koo-nan-na mi-nal qaw-mid daaal-leen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلشَّمۡسَ بَازِغَةٗ قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّي هَٰذَآ أَكۡبَرُۖ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَتۡ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تُشۡرِكُونَ ٧٨
ayahs.text_simple: فلما رءا الشمس بازغة قال هذا ربي هذا اكبر فلما افلت قال يقوم اني بريء مما تشركون
ayahs.translation: And when he saw the sun rising, he said, "This is my lord; this is greater." But when it set, he said, "O my people, indeed I am free from what you associate with Allāh.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa ra as-hsham-sa baa-zi-gha-tan qaa-la haa-zaa rab-bee haa-zaaa ak-ba-ru fa-lam-maaa a-fa-lat qaa-la yaa-qaw-mi in-nee bareee-um mim-maa tus-hri-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنِّي وَجَّهۡتُ وَجۡهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ حَنِيفٗاۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ ٧٩
ayahs.text_simple: اني وجهت وجهي للذي فطر السموت والارض حنيفا وما انا من المشركين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh."
ayahs.transliteration: in-nnee waj-jah-tu wa-jhiya lil-lazee fa-ta-ras sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da hanee-fanw wa-maaa a-na mi-nal mus-hri-keen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَحَآجَّهُۥ قَوۡمُهُۥۚ قَالَ أَتُحَٰٓجُّوٓنِّي فِي ٱللَّهِ وَقَدۡ هَدَىٰنِۚ وَلَآ أَخَافُ مَا تُشۡرِكُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ رَبِّي شَيۡـٔٗاۚ وَسِعَ رَبِّي كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمًاۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ ٨٠
ayahs.text_simple: وحاجه قومه قال اتحجوني في الله وقد هدين ولا اخاف ما تشركون به الا ان يشاء ربي شيا وسع ربي كل شيء علما افلا تتذكرون
ayahs.translation: And his people argued with him. He said, "Do you argue with me concerning Allāh while He has guided me? And I fear not what you associate with Him [and will not be harmed] unless my Lord should will something. My Lord encompasses all things in knowledge; then will you not remember?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-haaaj-ja-hoo qaw-muh qaa-la a-tu-hhaaaj-jooon-nee fil laa-hi wa-qad ha-daan wa-laaa a-khaa-fu maa tus-hri-koo-na bihee il-laaa ai ya-shaaaa rab-bee shai-anw wa-si-a rab-bee kul-la shaiin il-man a-fa-laa ta-ta-zak-ka-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَيۡفَ أَخَافُ مَآ أَشۡرَكۡتُمۡ وَلَا تَخَافُونَ أَنَّكُمۡ أَشۡرَكۡتُم بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمۡ يُنَزِّلۡ بِهِۦ عَلَيۡكُمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٗاۚ فَأَيُّ ٱلۡفَرِيقَيۡنِ أَحَقُّ بِٱلۡأَمۡنِۖ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ ٨١
ayahs.text_simple: وكيف اخاف ما اشركتم ولا تخافون انكم اشركتم بالله ما لم ينزل به عليكم سلطنا فاي الفريقين احق بالامن ان كنتم تعلمون
ayahs.translation: And how should I fear what you associate while you do not fear that you have associated with Allāh that for which He has not sent down to you any authority? So which of the two parties has more right to security, if you should know?"
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kai-fa a-khaa-fu maaa as-hrak-tum wa-laa ta-khaa-foo-na an-na-kum as-hrak-tum bil-laa-hi maa lam yu-naz-zil bihee a-lai-kum sul-taa-naa faaiyul faree-qai-ni a-haq-qu bi-lam-ni in kun-tum ta-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَمۡ يَلۡبِسُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنَهُم بِظُلۡمٍ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡأَمۡنُ وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ ٨٢
ayahs.text_simple: الذين ءامنوا ولم يلبسوا ايمنهم بظلم اولئك لهم الامن وهم مهتدون
ayahs.translation: They who believe and do not mix their belief with injustice - those will have security, and they are [rightly] guided.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo wa-lam yal-bi-sooo ee-maa-na-hum bi-zul-min u-laaai-ka la-hu-mul am-nu wa-hum muh-ta-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتِلۡكَ حُجَّتُنَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦۚ نَرۡفَعُ دَرَجَٰتٖ مَّن نَّشَآءُۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٞ ٨٣
ayahs.text_simple: وتلك حجتنا ءاتينها ابرهيم علي قومه نرفع درجت من نشاء ان ربك حكيم عليم
ayahs.translation: And that was Our [conclusive] argument which We gave Abraham against his people. We raise by degrees whom We will. Indeed, your Lord is Wise and Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-til-ka huj-ja-tu-naaa aa-tai-naa-haaa ib-raa-hee-ma a-laa qaw-mih nar-fau da-ra-jaa-tim man na-shaaa in-na rab-ba-ka hakee-mun aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَۚ كُلًّا هَدَيۡنَاۚ وَنُوحًا هَدَيۡنَا مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِۦ دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَأَيُّوبَ وَيُوسُفَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ٨٤
ayahs.text_simple: ووهبنا له اسحق ويعقوب كلا هدينا ونوحا هدينا من قبل ومن ذريته داود وسليمن وايوب ويوسف وموسي وهرون وكذلك نجزي المحسنين
ayahs.translation: And We gave to him [i.e., Abraham] Isaac and Jacob - all [of them] We guided. And Noah, We guided before; and among his descendants, David and Solomon and Job and Joseph and Moses and Aaron. Thus do We reward the doers of good.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-wa-hab-naa la-hoo i-shaa-qa waya-qoob kul-lan ha-dai-naa wa-noo-han ha-dai-naa min qab-lu wa-min zur-riyya-tihee daa-woo-da wa-su-lai-maa-na waayyoo-ba wayoo-su-fa wa-moo-saa wa-haa-roon wa-ka-zaa-li-ka naj-zil muh-sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَزَكَرِيَّا وَيَحۡيَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَإِلۡيَاسَۖ كُلّٞ مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ ٨٥
ayahs.text_simple: وزكريا ويحيي وعيسي والياس كل من الصلحين
ayahs.translation: And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elias - and all were of the righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-za-ka-riyyaa waya-hyaa waee-saa wail-lyaa-sa kul-lum mi-nas saa-liheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَيُونُسَ وَلُوطٗاۚ وَكُلّٗا فَضَّلۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٨٦
ayahs.text_simple: واسمعيل واليسع ويونس ولوطا وكلا فضلنا علي العلمين
ayahs.translation: And Ishmael and Elisha and Jonah and Lot - and all [of them] We preferred over the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: wais-maaee-la wa-lya-saa wayoo-nu-sa wa-loo-taa wa-kul-lan fad-dal-naa a-lal aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِنۡ ءَابَآئِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمۡ وَإِخۡوَٰنِهِمۡۖ وَٱجۡتَبَيۡنَٰهُمۡ وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ ٨٧
ayahs.text_simple: ومن ءابائهم وذريتهم واخونهم واجتبينهم وهدينهم الي صرط مستقيم
ayahs.translation: And [some] among their fathers and their descendants and their brothers - and We chose them and We guided them to a straight path.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-min aa-baaai-him wa-zur-riyyaa-ti-him waik-hwaa-ni-him waj-ta-bai-naa-hum wa-ha-dai-naa-hum i-laa si-raa-tim mus-taqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦۚ وَلَوۡ أَشۡرَكُواْ لَحَبِطَ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ ٨٨
ayahs.text_simple: ذلك هدي الله يهدي به من يشاء من عباده ولو اشركوا لحبط عنهم ما كانوا يعملون
ayahs.translation: That is the guidance of Allāh by which He guides whomever He wills of His servants. But if they had associated others with Allāh, then worthless for them would be whatever they were doing.
ayahs.transliteration: zaa-li-ka hu-dal laa-hi yah-dee bihee mai ya-shaaau min i-baa-dih wa-law as-hra-koo la-ha-bi-ta a-nhum maa kaa-noo ya-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحُكۡمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَۚ فَإِن يَكۡفُرۡ بِهَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ فَقَدۡ وَكَّلۡنَا بِهَا قَوۡمٗا لَّيۡسُواْ بِهَا بِكَٰفِرِينَ ٨٩
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك الذين ءاتينهم الكتب والحكم والنبوة فان يكفر بها هؤلاء فقد وكلنا بها قوما ليسوا بها بكفرين
ayahs.translation: Those are the ones to whom We gave the Scripture and authority and prophethood. But if they [i.e., the disbelievers] deny it, then We have entrusted it to a people who are not therein disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-kal lazee-na aa-tai-naa-hu-mul ki-taa-ba wa-lhuk-ma wan-nu-buw-wah fai-ny yak-fur bi-haa haaau-laaai fa-qad wak-kal-naa bi-haa qaw-mal lai-soo bi-haa bi-kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُۖ فَبِهُدَىٰهُمُ ٱقۡتَدِهۡۗ قُل لَّآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ أَجۡرًاۖ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٩٠
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك الذين هدي الله فبهديهم اقتده قل لا اسلكم عليه اجرا ان هو الا ذكري للعلمين
ayahs.translation: Those are the ones whom Allāh has guided, so from their guidance take an example. Say, "I ask of you for it [i.e., this message] no payment. It is not but a reminder for the worlds."
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-kal lazee-na ha-dal laa-hu fa-bi-hu-daa-hu-muq ta-dih qul laaa a-sa-lu-kum a-lai-hi aj-ran in hu-wa il-laa zik-raa li-laa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا قَدَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدۡرِهِۦٓ إِذۡ قَالُواْ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ بَشَرٖ مِّن شَيۡءٖۗ قُلۡ مَنۡ أَنزَلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ ٱلَّذِي جَآءَ بِهِۦ مُوسَىٰ نُورٗا وَهُدٗى لِّلنَّاسِۖ تَجۡعَلُونَهُۥ قَرَاطِيسَ تُبۡدُونَهَا وَتُخۡفُونَ كَثِيرٗاۖ وَعُلِّمۡتُم مَّا لَمۡ تَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنتُمۡ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُكُمۡۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُۖ ثُمَّ ذَرۡهُمۡ فِي خَوۡضِهِمۡ يَلۡعَبُونَ ٩١
ayahs.text_simple: وما قدروا الله حق قدره اذ قالوا ما انزل الله علي بشر من شيء قل من انزل الكتب الذي جاء به موسي نورا وهدي للناس تجعلونه قراطيس تبدونها وتخفون كثيرا وعلمتم ما لم تعلموا انتم ولا ءاباؤكم قل الله ثم ذرهم في خوضهم يلعبون
ayahs.translation: And they did not appraise Allāh with true appraisal when they said, "Allāh did not reveal to a human being anything." Say, "Who revealed the Scripture that Moses brought as light and guidance to the people? You [Jews] make it into pages, disclosing [some of] it and concealing much. And you were taught that which you knew not - neither you nor your fathers." Say, "Allāh [revealed it]." Then leave them in their [empty] discourse, amusing themselves.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa qa-da-rul laa-ha haq-qa qad-riheee iz qaa-loo maaa an-za-lal laa-hu a-laa ba-sha-rim min shai qul man an-za-lal ki-taa-bal lazee jaaaa bihee moo-saa noo-ranw wa-hu-dal lin-naa-si ta-ja-loo-na-hoo qa-raa-tee-sa tub-doo-na-haa wa-tuk-hfoo-na kasee-ranw waul-lim-tum maa lam ta-la-mooo an-tum wa-laaa aa-baaau-kum qu-lil laa-hu sum-ma za-rhum fee khaw-di-him ya-la-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهَٰذَا كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ مُبَارَكٞ مُّصَدِّقُ ٱلَّذِي بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ وَلِتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَاۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦۖ وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمۡ يُحَافِظُونَ ٩٢
ayahs.text_simple: وهذا كتب انزلنه مبارك مصدق الذي بين يديه ولتنذر ام القري ومن حولها والذين يؤمنون بالاخرة يؤمنون به وهم علي صلاتهم يحافظون
ayahs.translation: And this is a Book which We have sent down, blessed and confirming what was before it, that you may warn the Mother of Cities [i.e., Makkah] and those around it. Those who believe in the Hereafter believe in it, and they are maintaining their prayers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-haa-zaa ki-taa-bun an-zal-naa-hu mu-baa-ra-kum mu-sad-di-qul lazee bai-naa ya-dai-hi wa-li-tun-zi-ra um-mal qu-raa wa-man haw-la-haa wal-la-zee-na yu-mi-noo-na bi-laa-khi-ra-ti yu-mi-noo-na bihee wa-hum a-laa sa-laa-ti-him yu-haa-fi-zoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوۡ قَالَ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ وَلَمۡ يُوحَ إِلَيۡهِ شَيۡءٞ وَمَن قَالَ سَأُنزِلُ مِثۡلَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُۗ وَلَوۡ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ فِي غَمَرَٰتِ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ بَاسِطُوٓاْ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ أَخۡرِجُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمُۖ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ عَذَابَ ٱلۡهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ غَيۡرَ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَكُنتُمۡ عَنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ تَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ ٩٣
ayahs.text_simple: ومن اظلم ممن افتري علي الله كذبا او قال اوحي الي ولم يوح اليه شيء ومن قال سانزل مثل ما انزل الله ولو تري اذ الظلمون في غمرت الموت والملئكة باسطوا ايديهم اخرجوا انفسكم اليوم تجزون عذاب الهون بما كنتم تقولون علي الله غير الحق وكنتم عن ءايته تستكبرون
ayahs.translation: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allāh or says, "It has been inspired to me," while nothing has been inspired to him, and one who says, "I will reveal [something] like what Allāh revealed." And if you could but see when the wrongdoers are in the overwhelming pangs of death while the angels extend their hands, [saying], "Discharge your souls! Today you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation for what you used to say against Allāh other than the truth and [that] you were, toward His verses, being arrogant."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-man az-la-mu mim-ma-nif ta-raa a-lal laa-hi ka-zi-ban aw qaa-la oo-hiya i-laiya wa-lam yoo-ha i-lai-hi shaiun wa-man qaa-la saun-zi-lu mis-la maaa an-za-lal laah wa-law ta-raaa i-ziz zaa-li-moo-na fee gha-ma-raa-til maw-ti wal-ma-laaai-ka-tu baa-si-tooo ai-dee-him ak-hri-jooo an-fu-sa-kum a-lyaw-ma tuj-zaw-na a-zaa-bal hoo-ni bi-maa kun-tum ta-qoo-loo-na a-lal laa-hi ghai-ral haq-qi wa-kun-tum an aayaa-tihee tas-tak-bi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ جِئۡتُمُونَا فُرَٰدَىٰ كَمَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖ وَتَرَكۡتُم مَّا خَوَّلۡنَٰكُمۡ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِكُمۡۖ وَمَا نَرَىٰ مَعَكُمۡ شُفَعَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّهُمۡ فِيكُمۡ شُرَكَٰٓؤُاْۚ لَقَد تَّقَطَّعَ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَضَلَّ عَنكُم مَّا كُنتُمۡ تَزۡعُمُونَ ٩٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد جئتمونا فردي كما خلقنكم اول مرة وتركتم ما خولنكم وراء ظهوركم وما نري معكم شفعاءكم الذين زعمتم انهم فيكم شركؤا لقد تقطع بينكم وضل عنكم ما كنتم تزعمون
ayahs.translation: [It will be said to them], "And you have certainly come to Us alone [i.e., individually] as We created you the first time, and you have left whatever We bestowed upon you behind you. And We do not see with you your 'intercessors' which you claimed that they were among you associates [of Allāh]. It has [all] been severed between you, and lost from you is what you used to claim."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad ji-tu-moo-naa fu-raa-daa ka-maa kha-laq-naa-kum aw-wa-la mar-ra-tinw wa-ta-rak-tum maa khaw-wal-naa-kum wa-raaaa zu-hoo-ri-kum wa-maa na-raa maa-kum shu-faaaaa-ku-mul lazee-na zaam-tum an-na-hum fee-kum shu-ra-kaaa la-qat ta-qat-taa bai-na-kum wa-dal-la an-nkum maa kun-tum ta-zu-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ فَالِقُ ٱلۡحَبِّ وَٱلنَّوَىٰۖ يُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡحَيَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَيِّتِ وَمُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡمَيِّتِ مِنَ ٱلۡحَيِّۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤۡفَكُونَ ٩٥
ayahs.text_simple: ان الله فالق الحب والنوي يخرج الحي من الميت ومخرج الميت من الحي ذلكم الله فاني تؤفكون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Allāh is the cleaver of grain and date seeds. He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living. That is Allāh; so how are you deluded?
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal laa-ha faa-li-qul hab-bi wan-na-waa yuk-hri-jul haiya mi-nal maiyi-ti wa-muk-hri-jul maiyi-ti mi-nal haiy zaa-li-ku-mul laa-hu faan-naa tu-fa-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَالِقُ ٱلۡإِصۡبَاحِ وَجَعَلَ ٱلَّيۡلَ سَكَنٗا وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ حُسۡبَانٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ ٩٦
ayahs.text_simple: فالق الاصباح وجعل اليل سكنا والشمس والقمر حسبانا ذلك تقدير العزيز العليم
ayahs.translation: [He is] the cleaver of daybreak and has made the night for rest and the sun and moon for calculation. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-li-qul is-baa-hi wa-jaa-lal lai-la sa-ka-nanw was-hsham-sa wal-qa-ma-ra hus-baa-naa zaa-li-ka taq-dee-rul azee-zil aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلنُّجُومَ لِتَهۡتَدُواْ بِهَا فِي ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِۗ قَدۡ فَصَّلۡنَا ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لِقَوۡمٖ يَعۡلَمُونَ ٩٧
ayahs.text_simple: وهو الذي جعل لكم النجوم لتهتدوا بها في ظلمت البر والبحر قد فصلنا الايت لقوم يعلمون
ayahs.translation: And it is He who placed for you the stars that you may be guided by them through the darknesses of the land and sea. We have detailed the signs for a people who know.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wal lazee jaa-la la-ku-mun nu-joo-ma li-tah-ta-doo bi-haa fee zu-lu-maa-til bar-ri wal-bahr qad fas-sal-nal aayaa-ti li-qaw-mi-ny ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٖ فَمُسۡتَقَرّٞ وَمُسۡتَوۡدَعٞۗ قَدۡ فَصَّلۡنَا ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لِقَوۡمٖ يَفۡقَهُونَ ٩٨
ayahs.text_simple: وهو الذي انشاكم من نفس وحدة فمستقر ومستودع قد فصلنا الايت لقوم يفقهون
ayahs.translation: And it is He who produced you from one soul and [gave you] a place of dwelling and of storage. We have detailed the signs for a people who understand.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wal lazeee an-shaa-kum min naf-sinw waa-hi-da-tin fa-mus-ta-qar-runw wa-mus-taw-da qad fas-sal-nal aayaa-ti li-qaw mi-nyyaf-qa-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهِۦ نَبَاتَ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهُ خَضِرٗا نُّخۡرِجُ مِنۡهُ حَبّٗا مُّتَرَاكِبٗا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّخۡلِ مِن طَلۡعِهَا قِنۡوَانٞ دَانِيَةٞ وَجَنَّٰتٖ مِّنۡ أَعۡنَابٖ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونَ وَٱلرُّمَّانَ مُشۡتَبِهٗا وَغَيۡرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٍۗ ٱنظُرُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ ثَمَرِهِۦٓ إِذَآ أَثۡمَرَ وَيَنۡعِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكُمۡ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٩٩
ayahs.text_simple: وهو الذي انزل من السماء ماء فاخرجنا به نبات كل شيء فاخرجنا منه خضرا نخرج منه حبا متراكبا ومن النخل من طلعها قنوان دانية وجنت من اعناب والزيتون والرمان مشتبها وغير متشبه انظروا الي ثمره اذا اثمر وينعه ان في ذلكم لايت لقوم يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: And it is He who sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby the growth of all things. We produce from it greenery from which We produce grains arranged in layers. And from the palm trees - of its emerging fruit are clusters hanging low. And [We produce] gardens of grapevines and olives and pomegranates, similar yet varied. Look at [each of] its fruit when it yields and [at] its ripening. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wal lazeee an-za-la mi-nas sa-maaai maaaan faak-hraj-naa bihee na-baa-ta kul-li shaiin faak-hraj-naa mi-nhu kha-di-ran nuk-hri-ju mi-nhu hab-bam mu-ta-raa-ki-banw wa-mi-nan nak-hli min ta-li-haa qin-waa-nun daa-niya-tunw wa-jan-naa-tim min a-naa-binw waz-zai-too-na war-rum-maa-na mus-hta-bi-hanw wa-ghai-ra mu-ta-shaa-bih un-zu-rooo i-laa sa-ma-riheee i-zaaa as-ma-ra waya-nih in-na fee zaa-li-kum laaayaa-til li-qaw-mi-ny yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَخَلَقَهُمۡۖ وَخَرَقُواْ لَهُۥ بَنِينَ وَبَنَٰتِۭ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ ١٠٠
ayahs.text_simple: وجعلوا لله شركاء الجن وخلقهم وخرقوا له بنين وبنت بغير علم سبحنه وتعلي عما يصفون
ayahs.translation: But they have attributed to Allāh partners - the jinn, while He has created them - and have fabricated for Him sons and daughters without knowledge. Exalted is He and high above what they describe.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaa-loo lil-laa-hi shu-ra-kaaaal jin-na wa-kha-la-qa-hum wa-kha-ra-qoo la-hoo banee-na wa-ba-naa-tim bi-ghai-ri ilm su-bhaa-na-hoo wa-taaa-laa am-ma ya-si-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَدِيعُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لَهُۥ وَلَدٞ وَلَمۡ تَكُن لَّهُۥ صَٰحِبَةٞۖ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ ١٠١
ayahs.text_simple: بديع السموت والارض اني يكون له ولد ولم تكن له صحبة وخلق كل شيء وهو بكل شيء عليم
ayahs.translation: [He is] Originator of the heavens and the earth. How could He have a son when He does not have a companion [i.e., wife] and He created all things? And He is, of all things, Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: badee-us sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di an-nnaa ya-koo-nu la-hoo wa-la-dunw wa-lam ta-kul la-hoo saa-hi-ba-tunw wa-kha-la-qa kul-la shai-ninw wa-hu-wa bi-kul-li shaiin aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَكِيلٞ ١٠٢
ayahs.text_simple: ذلكم الله ربكم لا اله الا هو خلق كل شيء فاعبدوه وهو علي كل شيء وكيل
ayahs.translation: That is Allāh, your Lord; there is no deity except Him, the Creator of all things, so worship Him. And He is Disposer of all things.
ayahs.transliteration: zaa-li-ku-mul laa-hu rab-bu-kum laaa i-laa-ha il-laa hu-wa khaa-li-qu kul-li shaiin fa-bu-dooh wa-hu-wa a-laa kul-li shaiinw wakeel

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا تُدۡرِكُهُ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ وَهُوَ يُدۡرِكُ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَۖ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ ١٠٣
ayahs.text_simple: لا تدركه الابصر وهو يدرك الابصر وهو اللطيف الخبير
ayahs.translation: Vision perceives Him not, but He perceives [all] vision; and He is the Subtle, the Aware.
ayahs.transliteration: laa tud-ri-ku-hul ab-saa-ru wa-hu-wa yud-ri-kul ab-saa-ra wa-hu-wal latee-ful khabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَدۡ جَآءَكُم بَصَآئِرُ مِن رَّبِّكُمۡۖ فَمَنۡ أَبۡصَرَ فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ عَمِيَ فَعَلَيۡهَاۚ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيۡكُم بِحَفِيظٖ ١٠٤
ayahs.text_simple: قد جاءكم بصائر من ربكم فمن ابصر فلنفسه ومن عمي فعليها وما انا عليكم بحفيظ
ayahs.translation: There has come to you enlightenment from your Lord. So whoever will see does so for [the benefit of] his soul, and whoever is blind [does harm] against it. And [say], "I am not a guardian over you."
ayahs.transliteration: qad jaaaa-kum ba-saaai-ru mir rab-bi-kum fa-man ab-sa-ra fa-li-naf-sihee wa-man a-miya faa-lai-haa wa-maaa a-na a-lai-kum bi-hafeez

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ وَلِيَقُولُواْ دَرَسۡتَ وَلِنُبَيِّنَهُۥ لِقَوۡمٖ يَعۡلَمُونَ ١٠٥
ayahs.text_simple: وكذلك نصرف الايت وليقولوا درست ولنبينه لقوم يعلمون
ayahs.translation: And thus do We diversify the verses so they [i.e., the disbelievers] will say, "You have studied," and so We may make it [i.e., the Qur’ān] clear for a people who know.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ka-zaa-li-ka nu-sar-ri-ful aayaa-ti wa-liya-qoo-loo da-ras-ta wa-li-nu-baiyi-na-hoo li-qaw-mi-ny ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱتَّبِعۡ مَآ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ مِن رَّبِّكَۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ ١٠٦
ayahs.text_simple: اتبع ما اوحي اليك من ربك لا اله الا هو واعرض عن المشركين
ayahs.translation: Follow, [O Muḥammad], what has been revealed to you from your Lord - there is no deity except Him - and turn away from those who associate others with Allāh.
ayahs.transliteration: it-ta-bi maaa oo-hiya i-lai-ka mir rab-bi-ka laaa i-laa-ha il-laa hu-wa waa-rid a-nil mus-hri-keen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَآ أَشۡرَكُواْۗ وَمَا جَعَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَفِيظٗاۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِوَكِيلٖ ١٠٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولو شاء الله ما اشركوا وما جعلنك عليهم حفيظا وما انت عليهم بوكيل
ayahs.translation: But if Allāh had willed, they would not have associated. And We have not appointed you over them as a guardian, nor are you a manager over them.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law shaaaal laa-hu maaa as-hra-koo wa-maa jaal-naa-ka a-lai-him hafee-zanw wa-maaa an-ta a-lai-him bi-wakeel

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَسُبُّواْ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَسُبُّواْ ٱللَّهَ عَدۡوَۢا بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖۗ كَذَٰلِكَ زَيَّنَّا لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ عَمَلَهُمۡ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِم مَّرۡجِعُهُمۡ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ ١٠٨
ayahs.text_simple: ولا تسبوا الذين يدعون من دون الله فيسبوا الله عدوا بغير علم كذلك زينا لكل امة عملهم ثم الي ربهم مرجعهم فينبئهم بما كانوا يعملون
ayahs.translation: And do not insult those they invoke other than Allāh, lest they insult Allāh in enmity without knowledge. Thus We have made pleasing to every community their deeds. Then to their Lord is their return, and He will inform them about what they used to do.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa ta-sub-bul lazee-na ya-doo-na min doo-nil laa-hi faya-sub-bul laa-ha ad-wam bi-ghai-ri ilm ka-zaa-li-ka zaiyan-naa li-kul-li um-ma-tin a-ma-la-hum sum-ma i-laa rab-bi-him mar-jiu-hum fayu-nab-biu-hum bi-maa kaa-noo ya-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَقۡسَمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ جَهۡدَ أَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ لَئِن جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ءَايَةٞ لَّيُؤۡمِنُنَّ بِهَاۚ قُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡأٓيَٰتُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِۖ وَمَا يُشۡعِرُكُمۡ أَنَّهَآ إِذَا جَآءَتۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ ١٠٩
ayahs.text_simple: واقسموا بالله جهد ايمنهم لئن جاءتهم ءاية ليؤمنن بها قل انما الايت عند الله وما يشعركم انها اذا جاءت لا يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: And they swear by Allāh their strongest oaths that if a sign came to them, they would surely believe in it. Say, "The signs are only with [i.e., from] Allāh." And what will make you perceive that even if it [i.e., a sign] came, they would not believe.
ayahs.transliteration: waaq-sa-moo bil-laa-hi jah-da ai-maa-ni-him lain jaaaa-thum aaya-tul layu-mi-nun-na bi-haa qul in-na-mal aayaa-tu in-dal laa-hi wa-maa yu-shi-ru-kum an-na-haaa i-zaa jaaaat laa yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنُقَلِّبُ أَفۡـِٔدَتَهُمۡ وَأَبۡصَٰرَهُمۡ كَمَا لَمۡ يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِهِۦٓ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖ وَنَذَرُهُمۡ فِي طُغۡيَٰنِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ ١١٠
ayahs.text_simple: ونقلب افدتهم وابصرهم كما لم يؤمنوا به اول مرة ونذرهم في طغينهم يعمهون
ayahs.translation: And We will turn away their hearts and their eyes just as they refused to believe in it [i.e., the revelation] the first time. And We will leave them in their transgression, wandering blindly.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-nu-qal-li-bu a-fi-da-ta-hum waab-saa-ra-hum ka-maa lam yu-mi-noo biheee aw-wa-la mar-ra-tinw wa-na-za-ru-hum fee tu-ghyaa-ni-him ya-ma-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَوۡ أَنَّنَا نَزَّلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ وَكَلَّمَهُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَحَشَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖ قُبُلٗا مَّا كَانُواْ لِيُؤۡمِنُوٓاْ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ يَجۡهَلُونَ ١١١
ayahs.text_simple: ولو اننا نزلنا اليهم الملئكة وكلمهم الموتي وحشرنا عليهم كل شيء قبلا ما كانوا ليؤمنوا الا ان يشاء الله ولكن اكثرهم يجهلون
ayahs.translation: And even if We had sent down to them the angels [with the message] and the dead spoke to them [of it] and We gathered together every [created] thing in front of them, they would not believe unless Allāh should will. But most of them, [of that], are ignorant.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law an-na-naa naz-zal-naaa i-lai-hi-mul ma-laaai-ka-ta wa-kal-la-ma-hu-mul maw-taa wa-ha-shar-naa a-lai-him kul-la shaiin qu-bu-lam maa kaa-noo liyu-mi-nooo il-laaa ai ya-shaaaal laa-hu wa-laa-kin-na ak-sa-ra-hum ya-jha-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلۡنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوّٗا شَيَٰطِينَ ٱلۡإِنسِ وَٱلۡجِنِّ يُوحِي بَعۡضُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ زُخۡرُفَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ غُرُورٗاۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ مَا فَعَلُوهُۖ فَذَرۡهُمۡ وَمَا يَفۡتَرُونَ ١١٢
ayahs.text_simple: وكذلك جعلنا لكل نبي عدوا شيطين الانس والجن يوحي بعضهم الي بعض زخرف القول غرورا ولو شاء ربك ما فعلوه فذرهم وما يفترون
ayahs.translation: And thus We have made for every prophet an enemy - devils from mankind and jinn, inspiring to one another decorative speech in delusion. But if your Lord had willed, they would not have done it, so leave them and that which they invent.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ka-zaa-li-ka jaal-naa li-kul-li na-biyyin a-duw-wan shayaatee-nal in-si wal-jin-ni yoo-hee ba-du-hum i-laa ba-din zuk-hru-fal qaw-li ghu-roo-raa wa-law shaaaa rab-bu-ka maa faa-loo-hu fa-za-rhum wa-maa yaf-ta-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلِتَصۡغَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِ أَفۡـِٔدَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَلِيَرۡضَوۡهُ وَلِيَقۡتَرِفُواْ مَا هُم مُّقۡتَرِفُونَ ١١٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولتصغي اليه افدة الذين لا يؤمنون بالاخرة وليرضوه وليقترفوا ما هم مقترفون
ayahs.translation: And [it is] so the hearts of those who disbelieve in the Hereafter will incline toward it [i.e., deceptive speech] and that they will be satisfied with it and that they will commit that which they are committing.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-li-tas-ghaaa i-lai-hi a-fi-da-tul lazee-na laa yu-mi-noo-na bi-laa-khi-ra-ti wa-liyar-da-whu wa-liyaq-ta-ri-foo maa hum muq-ta-ri-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ أَبۡتَغِي حَكَمٗا وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مُفَصَّلٗاۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّهُۥ مُنَزَّلٞ مِّن رَّبِّكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُمۡتَرِينَ ١١٤
ayahs.text_simple: افغير الله ابتغي حكما وهو الذي انزل اليكم الكتب مفصلا والذين ءاتينهم الكتب يعلمون انه منزل من ربك بالحق فلا تكونن من الممترين
ayahs.translation: [Say], "Then is it other than Allāh I should seek as judge while it is He who has revealed to you the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] explained in detail?" And those to whom We [previously] gave the Scripture know that it is sent down from your Lord in truth, so never be among the doubters.
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-ghai-ral laa-hi ab-ta-ghee ha-ka-manw wa-hu-wal lazee an-za-la i-lai-ku-mul ki-taa-ba mu-fas-sa-laa wal-la-zee-na a-tai-naa-hu-mul ki-taa-ba ya-la-moo-na an-na-hoo mu-naz-za-lum mir rab-bi-ka bi-lhaq-qi fa-laa ta-koo-nan-na mi-nal mum-tareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَمَّتۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ صِدۡقٗا وَعَدۡلٗاۚ لَّا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ١١٥
ayahs.text_simple: وتمت كلمت ربك صدقا وعدلا لا مبدل لكلمته وهو السميع العليم
ayahs.translation: And the word of your Lord has been fulfilled in truth and in justice. None can alter His words, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-tam-mat ka-li-ma-tu rab-bi-ka sid-qanw waad-laa laa mu-bad-di-la li-ka-li-maa-tih wa-hu-was samee-ul aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِن تُطِعۡ أَكۡثَرَ مَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يُضِلُّوكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَخۡرُصُونَ ١١٦
ayahs.text_simple: وان تطع اكثر من في الارض يضلوك عن سبيل الله ان يتبعون الا الظن وان هم الا يخرصون
ayahs.translation: And if you obey most of those upon the earth, they will mislead you from the way of Allāh. They follow not except assumption, and they are not but misjudging.
ayahs.transliteration: wain tu-ti ak-sa-ra man fil ar-di yu-dil-loo-ka an sabee-lil laah i-ny yat-ta-bioo-na il-laz zan-na wain hum il-laa yak-hru-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ مَن يَضِلُّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۖ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ ١١٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان ربك هو اعلم من يضل عن سبيله وهو اعلم بالمهتدين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na rab-ba-ka hu-wa a-la-mu mai ya-dil-lu an sabee-lihee wa-hu-wa a-la-mu bil-muh-tadeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكُلُواْ مِمَّا ذُكِرَ ٱسۡمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡهِ إِن كُنتُم بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنِينَ ١١٨
ayahs.text_simple: فكلوا مما ذكر اسم الله عليه ان كنتم بايته مؤمنين
ayahs.translation: So eat of that [meat] upon which the name of Allāh has been mentioned, if you are believers in His verses [i.e., revealed law].
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ku-loo mim-mmaa zu-ki-ras mul laa-hi a-lai-hi in kun-tum bi-a-ayaa-tihee mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا لَكُمۡ أَلَّا تَأۡكُلُواْ مِمَّا ذُكِرَ ٱسۡمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡهِ وَقَدۡ فَصَّلَ لَكُم مَّا حَرَّمَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِلَّا مَا ٱضۡطُرِرۡتُمۡ إِلَيۡهِۗ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرٗا لَّيُضِلُّونَ بِأَهۡوَآئِهِم بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٍۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُعۡتَدِينَ ١١٩
ayahs.text_simple: وما لكم الا تاكلوا مما ذكر اسم الله عليه وقد فصل لكم ما حرم عليكم الا ما اضطررتم اليه وان كثيرا ليضلون باهوائهم بغير علم ان ربك هو اعلم بالمعتدين
ayahs.translation: And why should you not eat of that upon which the name of Allāh has been mentioned while He has explained in detail to you what He has forbidden you, excepting that to which you are compelled. And indeed do many lead [others] astray through their [own] inclinations without knowledge. Indeed, your Lord - He is most knowing of the transgressors.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa la-kum al-laa ta-ku-loo mim-maa zu-ki-ras mul laa-hi a-lai-hi wa-qad fas-sa-la la-kum maa har-ra-ma a-lai-kum il-laa mad tu-rir-tum i-laih wain-na kasee-ral layu-dil-loo-na bi-a-hwaaai-him bi-ghai-ri ilm in-na rab-ba-ka hu-wa a-la-mu bil-mu-tadeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَذَرُواْ ظَٰهِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَبَاطِنَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكۡسِبُونَ ٱلۡإِثۡمَ سَيُجۡزَوۡنَ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَقۡتَرِفُونَ ١٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: وذروا ظهر الاثم وباطنه ان الذين يكسبون الاثم سيجزون بما كانوا يقترفون
ayahs.translation: And leave [i.e., desist from] what is apparent of sin and what is concealed thereof. Indeed, those who earn [blame for] sin will be recompensed for that which they used to commit.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-za-roo zaa-hi-ral is-mi wa-baa-ti-nah in-nal lazee-na yak-si-boo-nal is-maa sayuj-zaw-na bi-maa kaa-noo yaq-ta-ri-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَأۡكُلُواْ مِمَّا لَمۡ يُذۡكَرِ ٱسۡمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡهِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِسۡقٞۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ لَيُوحُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَوۡلِيَآئِهِمۡ لِيُجَٰدِلُوكُمۡۖ وَإِنۡ أَطَعۡتُمُوهُمۡ إِنَّكُمۡ لَمُشۡرِكُونَ ١٢١
ayahs.text_simple: ولا تاكلوا مما لم يذكر اسم الله عليه وانه لفسق وان الشيطين ليوحون الي اوليائهم ليجدلوكم وان اطعتموهم انكم لمشركون
ayahs.translation: And do not eat of that upon which the name of Allāh has not been mentioned, for indeed, it is grave disobedience. And indeed do the devils inspire their allies [among men] to dispute with you. And if you were to obey them, indeed, you would be associators [of others with Him].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa ta-ku-loo mi-maa lam yuz-ka-ris mul laa-hi a-lai-hi wain-na-hoo la-fisq wain-nash shayaatee-na layoo-hoo-na i-laaa aw-liyaaai-him liyu-jaa-di-loo-kum wain a-ta-tu-moo-hum in-na-kum la-mus-hri-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَمَن كَانَ مَيۡتٗا فَأَحۡيَيۡنَٰهُ وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُۥ نُورٗا يَمۡشِي بِهِۦ فِي ٱلنَّاسِ كَمَن مَّثَلُهُۥ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ لَيۡسَ بِخَارِجٖ مِّنۡهَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ ١٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: اومن كان ميتا فاحيينه وجعلنا له نورا يمشي به في الناس كمن مثله في الظلمت ليس بخارج منها كذلك زين للكفرين ما كانوا يعملون
ayahs.translation: And is one who was dead and We gave him life and made for him light by which to walk among the people like one who is in darkness, never to emerge therefrom? Thus it has been made pleasing to the disbelievers that which they were doing.
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-man kaa-na mai-tan faa-hyai-naa-hu wa-jaal-naa la-hoo noo-ra-ny yam-shee bihee fin naa-si ka-mamm ma-sa-lu-hoo fiz zu-lu-maa-ti lai-sa bi-khaa-ri-jim mi-nhaa ka-zaa-li-ka zuyyi-na lil-kaa-fi-ree-na maa kaa-noo ya-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلۡنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرۡيَةٍ أَكَٰبِرَ مُجۡرِمِيهَا لِيَمۡكُرُواْ فِيهَاۖ وَمَا يَمۡكُرُونَ إِلَّا بِأَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ ١٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: وكذلك جعلنا في كل قرية اكبر مجرميها ليمكروا فيها وما يمكرون الا بانفسهم وما يشعرون
ayahs.translation: And thus We have placed within every city the greatest of its criminals to conspire therein. But they conspire not except against themselves, and they perceive [it] not.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ka-zaa-li-ka jaal-naa fee kul-li qa-rya-tin a-kaa-bi-ra muj-ri-mee-haa liyam-ku-roo fee-haa wa-maa yam-ku-roo-na il-laa bi-a-nfu-si-him wa-maa ya-shu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ءَايَةٞ قَالُواْ لَن نُّؤۡمِنَ حَتَّىٰ نُؤۡتَىٰ مِثۡلَ مَآ أُوتِيَ رُسُلُ ٱللَّهِۘ ٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ حَيۡثُ يَجۡعَلُ رِسَالَتَهُۥۗ سَيُصِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ صَغَارٌ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعَذَابٞ شَدِيدُۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَمۡكُرُونَ ١٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: واذا جاءتهم ءاية قالوا لن نؤمن حتي نؤتي مثل ما اوتي رسل الله الله اعلم حيث يجعل رسالته سيصيب الذين اجرموا صغار عند الله وعذاب شديد بما كانوا يمكرون
ayahs.translation: And when a sign comes to them, they say, "Never will we believe until we are given like that which was given to the messengers of Allāh." Allāh is most knowing of where [i.e., with whom] He places His message. There will afflict those who committed crimes debasement before Allāh and severe punishment for what they used to conspire.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa jaaaa-thum aaya-tun qaa-loo lan nu-mi-na hat-ta nu-taa mis-la maaa oo-tiya ru-su-lul laah al-la-hu aal-mu hai-su ya-ja-lu ri-saa-la-tah sayusee-bul lazee-na aj-ra-moo sa-ghaa-run in-dal laa-hi waa-zaa-bun shadee-dum bi-maa kaa-noo yam-ku-roon
