ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُۖ قُلۡ فَأۡتُواْ بِعَشۡرِ سُوَرٖ مِّثۡلِهِۦ مُفۡتَرَيَٰتٖ وَٱدۡعُواْ مَنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: ام يقولون افتريه قل فاتوا بعشر سور مثله مفتريت وادعوا من استطعتم من دون الله ان كنتم صدقين
ayahs.translation: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Say, "Then bring ten sūrahs like it that have been invented and call upon [for assistance] whomever you can besides Allāh, if you should be truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: am ya-qoo-loo-naf ta-raa-hu qul faa-too bi-a-shri su-wa-rim mis-lihee muf-ta-rayaa-tinw wa-doo ma-nis ta-ta-tum min doo-nil laa-hi in kun-tum saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِلَّمۡ يَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لَكُمۡ فَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ بِعِلۡمِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَهَلۡ أَنتُم مُّسۡلِمُونَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: فالم يستجيبوا لكم فاعلموا انما انزل بعلم الله وان لا اله الا هو فهل انتم مسلمون
ayahs.translation: And if they do not respond to you - then know that it [i.e., the Qur’ān] was revealed with the knowledge of Allāh and that there is no deity except Him. Then, would you [not] be Muslims?
ayahs.transliteration: fail-lam yas-ta-jee-boo la-kum fa-la-mooo an-na-maaa un-zil-la biil-mil laa-hi waal laaa i-laa-ha il-laa hu-wa fa-hal an-tum mus-li-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَزِينَتَهَا نُوَفِّ إِلَيۡهِمۡ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فِيهَا وَهُمۡ فِيهَا لَا يُبۡخَسُونَ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: من كان يريد الحيوة الدنيا وزينتها نوف اليهم اعملهم فيها وهم فيها لا يبخسون
ayahs.translation: Whoever desires the life of this world and its adornments - We fully repay them for their deeds therein, and they therein will not be deprived.
ayahs.transliteration: man kaa-na yu-ree-dul hayaa-tad du-nyaa wazee-na-ta-haa nu-waf-fi i-lai-him a-maa-la-hum fee-haa wa-hum fee-haa laa yub-kha-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَيۡسَ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِلَّا ٱلنَّارُۖ وَحَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُواْ فِيهَا وَبَٰطِلٞ مَّا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك الذين ليس لهم في الاخرة الا النار وحبط ما صنعوا فيها وبطل ما كانوا يعملون
ayahs.translation: Those are the ones for whom there is not in the Hereafter but the Fire. And lost is what they did therein, and worthless is what they used to do.
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-kal lazee-na lai-sa la-hum fil aa-khi-ra-ti il-lan naa-ru wa-ha-bi-ta maa sa-naoo fee-haa wa-baa-ti-lum maa kaa-noo ya-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ وَيَتۡلُوهُ شَاهِدٞ مِّنۡهُ وَمِن قَبۡلِهِۦ كِتَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامٗا وَرَحۡمَةًۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦۚ وَمَن يَكۡفُرۡ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ فَٱلنَّارُ مَوۡعِدُهُۥۚ فَلَا تَكُ فِي مِرۡيَةٖ مِّنۡهُۚ إِنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: افمن كان علي بينة من ربه ويتلوه شاهد منه ومن قبله كتب موسي اماما ورحمة اولئك يؤمنون به ومن يكفر به من الاحزاب فالنار موعده فلا تك في مرية منه انه الحق من ربك ولكن اكثر الناس لا يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: So is one who [stands] upon a clear evidence from his Lord [like the aforementioned]? And a witness from Him follows it, and before it was the Scripture of Moses to lead and as mercy. Those [believers in the former revelations] believe in it [i.e., the Qur’ān]. But whoever disbelieves in it from the [various] factions - the Fire is his promised destination. So be not in doubt about it. Indeed, it is the truth from your Lord, but most of the people do not believe.
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-man kaa-na a-la baiyi-na-tim mir rab-bihee wayat-loo-hu shaa-hi-dum mi-nhu wa-min qab-lihee ki-taa-bu moo-saaa i-maa-manw wa-rah-mah u-laaai-ka yu-mi-noo-na bih wa-mai yak-fur bihee mi-nal ah-zaa-bi fan-naa-ru ma-wi-duh fa-laa ta-ku fee mi-rya-tim minh in-na-hul haq-qu mir rab-bi-ka wa-laa-kin-na ak-sa-ran naa-si laa yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًاۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُعۡرَضُونَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡأَشۡهَٰدُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُواْ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡۚ أَلَا لَعۡنَةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: ومن اظلم ممن افتري علي الله كذبا اولئك يعرضون علي ربهم ويقول الاشهد هؤلاء الذين كذبوا علي ربهم الا لعنة الله علي الظلمين
ayahs.translation: And who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allāh? Those will be presented before their Lord, and the witnesses will say, "These are the ones who lied against their Lord." Unquestionably, the curse of Allāh is upon the wrongdoers
ayahs.transliteration: wa-man az-la-mu mim-ma-nif ta-raa a-lal laa-hi ka-zi-baa u-laaai-ka yu-ra-doo-na a-laa rab-bi-him waya-qoo-lul as-hhaa-du haaau-laaail lazee-na ka-za-boo a-laa rab-bi-him a-laa la-na-tul laa-hi a-laz zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَبۡغُونَهَا عِوَجٗا وَهُم بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ كَٰفِرُونَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: الذين يصدون عن سبيل الله ويبغونها عوجا وهم بالاخرة هم كفرون
ayahs.translation: Who averted [people] from the way of Allāh and sought to make it [seem] deviant while they, concerning the Hereafter, were disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na ya-sud-doo-na an sabee-lil laa-hi wayab-ghoo-na-haa i-wa-janw wa-hum bi-laa-khi-ra-ti hum kaa-fi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَمۡ يَكُونُواْ مُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِنۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَۘ يُضَٰعَفُ لَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُۚ مَا كَانُواْ يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَمَا كَانُواْ يُبۡصِرُونَ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك لم يكونوا معجزين في الارض وما كان لهم من دون الله من اولياء يضعف لهم العذاب ما كانوا يستطيعون السمع وما كانوا يبصرون
ayahs.translation: Those were not causing failure [to Allāh] on earth, nor did they have besides Allāh any protectors. For them the punishment will be multiplied. They were not able to hear, nor did they see.
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-ka lam ya-koo-noo mu-ji-zee-na fil ar-di wa-maa kaa-na la-hum min doo-nil laa-hi min aw-liyaaa yu-daaa-fu la-hu-mul a-zaab maa kaa-noo yas-ta-tee-o-o-nas sa-ma wa-maa kaa-noo yub-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك الذين خسروا انفسهم وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون
ayahs.translation: Those are the ones who will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent.
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-kal lazee-na kha-si-rooo an-fu-sa-hum wa-dal-la a-nhum maa kaa-noo yaf-ta-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلۡأَخۡسَرُونَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: لا جرم انهم في الاخرة هم الاخسرون
ayahs.translation: Assuredly, it is they in the Hereafter who will be the greatest losers.
ayahs.transliteration: laa ja-ra-ma an-na-hum fil aa-khi-ra-ti hu-mul ak-hsa-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَأَخۡبَتُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت واخبتوا الي ربهم اولئك اصحب الجنة هم فيها خلدون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds and humbled themselves to their Lord - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide eternally therein.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti waak-hba-tooo i-laa rab-bi-him u-laaai-ka a-shaa-bul jan-na-ti hum fee-haa khaa-li-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ مَثَلُ ٱلۡفَرِيقَيۡنِ كَٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ وَٱلۡأَصَمِّ وَٱلۡبَصِيرِ وَٱلسَّمِيعِۚ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًاۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: مثل الفريقين كالاعمي والاصم والبصير والسميع هل يستويان مثلا افلا تذكرون
ayahs.translation: The example of the two parties is like the blind and deaf, and the seeing and hearing. Are they equal in comparison? Then, will you not remember?
ayahs.transliteration: ma-sa-lul faree-qai-ni ka-la-maa wa-la-sam-mi wal-ba-see-ri was-samee hal yas-ta-wiyaa-ni ma-sa-laa a-fa-laa ta-zak-ka-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ارسلنا نوحا الي قومه اني لكم نذير مبين
ayahs.translation: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Indeed, I am to you a clear warner
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad ar-sal-naa noo-han i-laa qaw-mihee in-nee la-kum nazee-rum mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَن لَّا تَعۡبُدُوٓاْ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَۖ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ أَلِيمٖ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: ان لا تعبدوا الا الله اني اخاف عليكم عذاب يوم اليم
ayahs.translation: That you not worship except Allāh. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a painful day."
ayahs.transliteration: al laa ta-bu-dooo il-lal laa-ha in-neee a-khaa-fu a-lai-kum a-zaa-ba yaw-min aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقَالَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن قَوۡمِهِۦ مَا نَرَىٰكَ إِلَّا بَشَرٗا مِّثۡلَنَا وَمَا نَرَىٰكَ ٱتَّبَعَكَ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ أَرَاذِلُنَا بَادِيَ ٱلرَّأۡيِ وَمَا نَرَىٰ لَكُمۡ عَلَيۡنَا مِن فَضۡلِۭ بَلۡ نَظُنُّكُمۡ كَٰذِبِينَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: فقال الملا الذين كفروا من قومه ما نريك الا بشرا مثلنا وما نريك اتبعك الا الذين هم اراذلنا بادي الراي وما نري لكم علينا من فضل بل نظنكم كذبين
ayahs.translation: So the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "We do not see you but as a man like ourselves, and we do not see you followed except by those who are the lowest of us [and] at first suggestion. And we do not see in you over us any merit; rather, we think you are liars."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qaa-lal ma-laul lazee-na ka-fa-roo min qaw-mihee ma na-raa-ka il-laa ba-sha-ram mis-la-naa wa-maa na-raa-kat ta-baa-ka il-lal lazee-na hum a-raa-zi-lu-naa baa-diyar raayi wa-maa na-raa la-kum a-lai-naa min fad-lim bal na-zun-nu-kum kaa-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّي وَءَاتَىٰنِي رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِهِۦ فَعُمِّيَتۡ عَلَيۡكُمۡ أَنُلۡزِمُكُمُوهَا وَأَنتُمۡ لَهَا كَٰرِهُونَ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: قال يقوم ارءيتم ان كنت علي بينة من ربي وءاتيني رحمة من عنده فعميت عليكم انلزمكموها وانتم لها كرهون
ayahs.translation: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord while He has given me mercy from Himself but it has been made unapparent to you, should we force it upon you while you are averse to it?
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la yaa-qaw-mi a-raai-tum in kun-tu a-laa baiyi-na-tim mir rab-bee waaa-taanee rah-ma-tam min in-dihee faum-miyat a-lai-kum a-nul-zi-mu-ku-moo-haa waan-tum la-haa kaa-ri-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ لَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مَالًاۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْۚ إِنَّهُم مُّلَٰقُواْ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلَٰكِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰكُمۡ قَوۡمٗا تَجۡهَلُونَ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: ويقوم لا اسلكم عليه مالا ان اجري الا علي الله وما انا بطارد الذين ءامنوا انهم ملقوا ربهم ولكني اريكم قوما تجهلون
ayahs.translation: And O my people, I ask not of you for it any wealth. My reward is not but from Allāh. And I am not one to drive away those who have believed. Indeed, they will meet their Lord, but I see that you are a people behaving ignorantly.
ayahs.transliteration: wayaa-qaw-mi laaa a-sa-lu-kum a-lai-hi maa-lan in aj-riya il-laa a-lal laah wa-maaa a-na bi-taa-ri-dil lazee-na aa-ma-noo in-na-hum mu-laa-qoo rab-bi-him wa-laa-kin-neee a-raa-kum qaw-man ta-jha-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ مَن يَنصُرُنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِن طَرَدتُّهُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: ويقوم من ينصرني من الله ان طردتهم افلا تذكرون
ayahs.translation: And O my people, who would protect me from Allāh if I drove them away? Then will you not be reminded?
ayahs.transliteration: wayaa-qaw-mi mai yan-su-runee mi-nal laa-hi in ta-rat-tu-hum a-fa-laa ta-zak-ka-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمۡ عِندِي خَزَآئِنُ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ وَلَآ أَقُولُ إِنِّي مَلَكٞ وَلَآ أَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ تَزۡدَرِيٓ أَعۡيُنُكُمۡ لَن يُؤۡتِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ خَيۡرًاۖ ٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا فِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ إِنِّيٓ إِذٗا لَّمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: ولا اقول لكم عندي خزائن الله ولا اعلم الغيب ولا اقول اني ملك ولا اقول للذين تزدري اعينكم لن يؤتيهم الله خيرا الله اعلم بما في انفسهم اني اذا لمن الظلمين
ayahs.translation: And I do not tell you that I have the depositories [containing the provision] of Allāh or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel, nor do I say of those upon whom your eyes look down that Allāh will never grant them any good. Allāh is most knowing of what is within their souls. Indeed, I would then be among the wrongdoers [i.e., the unjust]."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa a-qoo-lu la-kum in-dee kha-zaai-nul laa-hi wa-laaa a-la-mul ghai-ba wa-laa a-qoo-lu inee ma-la-kunw wa-laaa a-qoo-lu lil-la-zee-na taz-dareee ayu-nu-kum lai yu-tiya-hu-mul laa-hu khai-ran al-laa-hu a-la-mu bi-maa feee an-fu-si-him in-nee i-zal la-mi-naz zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ يَٰنُوحُ قَدۡ جَٰدَلۡتَنَا فَأَكۡثَرۡتَ جِدَٰلَنَا فَأۡتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا ينوح قد جدلتنا فاكثرت جدلنا فاتنا بما تعدنا ان كنت من الصدقين
ayahs.translation: They said, "O Noah, you have disputed [i.e., opposed] us and been frequent in dispute of us. So bring us what you threaten us, if you should be of the truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo yaa-noo-hu qad jaa-dal-ta-naa faak-sar-ta ji-daa-la-naa faa-ti-naa bi-maa tai-du-naaa in kun-ta mi-nas saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَأۡتِيكُم بِهِ ٱللَّهُ إِن شَآءَ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: قال انما ياتيكم به الله ان شاء وما انتم بمعجزين
ayahs.translation: He said, "Allāh will only bring it to you if He wills, and you will not cause [Him] failure.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la in-na-maa yaa-tee-kum bi-hil laa-hu in shaaaa wa-maaa an-tum bi-mu-jizeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا يَنفَعُكُمۡ نُصۡحِيٓ إِنۡ أَرَدتُّ أَنۡ أَنصَحَ لَكُمۡ إِن كَانَ ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَن يُغۡوِيَكُمۡۚ هُوَ رَبُّكُمۡ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولا ينفعكم نصحي ان اردت ان انصح لكم ان كان الله يريد ان يغويكم هو ربكم واليه ترجعون
ayahs.translation: And my advice will not benefit you - although I wished to advise you - if Allāh should intend to put you in error. He is your Lord, and to Him you will be returned."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa yan-fau-kum nu-sheee in a-rat-tu an an-sa-ha la-kum in kaa-nal laa-hu yu-ree-du ai yug-hwiya-kum hu-wa rab-bu-kum wai-lai-hi tur-jaoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُۖ قُلۡ إِنِ ٱفۡتَرَيۡتُهُۥ فَعَلَيَّ إِجۡرَامِي وَأَنَا۠ بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تُجۡرِمُونَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: ام يقولون افتريه قل ان افتريته فعلي اجرامي وانا بريء مما تجرمون
ayahs.translation: Or do they say [about Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)], "He invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, then upon me is [the consequence of] my crime; but I am innocent of what [crimes] you commit."
ayahs.transliteration: am ya-qoo-loo-naf ta-raa-hu qul i-nif ta-rai-tu-hoo faa-laiya ij-raamee waa-na bareee-um mim-maa tuj-ri-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأُوحِيَ إِلَىٰ نُوحٍ أَنَّهُۥ لَن يُؤۡمِنَ مِن قَوۡمِكَ إِلَّا مَن قَدۡ ءَامَنَ فَلَا تَبۡتَئِسۡ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: واوحي الي نوح انه لن يؤمن من قومك الا من قد ءامن فلا تبتئس بما كانوا يفعلون
ayahs.translation: And it was revealed to Noah that, "No one will believe from your people except those who have already believed, so do not be distressed by what they have been doing.
ayahs.transliteration: waoo-hiya i-laa noo-hin an-na-hoo la-ny yu-mi-na min qaw-mi-ka il-laa man qad aa-ma-na fa-laa tab-tais bi-maa kaa-noo yaf a-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱصۡنَعِ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَا وَوَحۡيِنَا وَلَا تُخَٰطِبۡنِي فِي ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ إِنَّهُم مُّغۡرَقُونَ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: واصنع الفلك باعيننا ووحينا ولا تخطبني في الذين ظلموا انهم مغرقون
ayahs.translation: And construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration and do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are [to be] drowned."
ayahs.transliteration: was-nail ful-ka bi-a-yu-ni-naa wa-wa-hyi-naa wa-laa tu-khaa-tib-nee fil lazee-na za-la-moo in-na-hum mug-hra-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَصۡنَعُ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيۡهِ مَلَأٞ مِّن قَوۡمِهِۦ سَخِرُواْ مِنۡهُۚ قَالَ إِن تَسۡخَرُواْ مِنَّا فَإِنَّا نَسۡخَرُ مِنكُمۡ كَمَا تَسۡخَرُونَ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: ويصنع الفلك وكلما مر عليه ملا من قومه سخروا منه قال ان تسخروا منا فانا نسخر منكم كما تسخرون
ayahs.translation: And he constructed the ship, and whenever an assembly of the eminent of his people passed by him, they ridiculed him. He said, "If you ridicule us, then we will ridicule you just as you ridicule.
ayahs.transliteration: wayas-naul ful-ka wa-kul-la-maa mar-ra a-lai-hi ma-laum min qaw-mihee sa-khi-roo minh qaa-la in tas-kha-roo min-naa fain-naa nas-kha-ru min-kum ka-maa tas-kha-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ مَن يَأۡتِيهِ عَذَابٞ يُخۡزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيۡهِ عَذَابٞ مُّقِيمٌ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: فسوف تعلمون من ياتيه عذاب يخزيه ويحل عليه عذاب مقيم
ayahs.translation: And you are going to know who will get a punishment that will disgrace him [on earth] and upon whom will descend an enduring punishment [in the Hereafter]."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-saw-fa ta-la-moo-na mai ya-tee-hi a-zaa-bu-ny yuk-hzee-hi waya-hil-lu a-lai-hi a-zaa-bun muqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَمۡرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ قُلۡنَا ٱحۡمِلۡ فِيهَا مِن كُلّٖ زَوۡجَيۡنِ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ وَأَهۡلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ وَمَنۡ ءَامَنَۚ وَمَآ ءَامَنَ مَعَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلٞ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: حتي اذا جاء امرنا وفار التنور قلنا احمل فيها من كل زوجين اثنين واهلك الا من سبق عليه القول ومن ءامن وما ءامن معه الا قليل
ayahs.translation: [So it was], until when Our command came and the oven overflowed, We said, "Load upon it [i.e., the ship] of each [creature] two mates and your family, except those about whom the word [i.e., decree] has preceded, and [include] whoever has believed." But none had believed with him, except a few.
ayahs.transliteration: hat-taaa i-zaa jaaaa am-ru-naa wa-faa-rat tan-noo-ru qul-nah mil fee-haa min kul-lin zaw-jai-nis nai-ni waah-la-ka il-laa man sa-ba-qa a-lai-hil qaw-lu wa-man aa-man wa-maaa aa-ma-na maa-hooo il-laa qaleel

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱرۡكَبُواْ فِيهَا بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ مَجۡر۪ىٰهَا وَمُرۡسَىٰهَآۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: وقال اركبوا فيها بسم الله مجريها ومرسيها ان ربي لغفور رحيم
ayahs.translation: And [Noah] said, "Embark therein; in the name of Allāh [are] its course and its anchorage. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-lar ka-boo fee-haa bis-mil laa-hi maj-rai-haa wa-mur-saa-haa in-na rab-bee la-gha-foo-rur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهِيَ تَجۡرِي بِهِمۡ فِي مَوۡجٖ كَٱلۡجِبَالِ وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ ٱبۡنَهُۥ وَكَانَ فِي مَعۡزِلٖ يَٰبُنَيَّ ٱرۡكَب مَّعَنَا وَلَا تَكُن مَّعَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: وهي تجري بهم في موج كالجبال ونادي نوح ابنه وكان في معزل يبني اركب معنا ولا تكن مع الكفرين
ayahs.translation: And it sailed with them through waves like mountains, and Noah called to his son who was apart [from them], "O my son, come aboard with us and be not with the disbelievers."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hiya taj-ree bi-him fee maw-jin kal-ji-baa-li wa-naa-daa noo-hu-nib na-hoo wa-kaa-na fee ma-zi-li-ny yaa-bu-nai yar-kam maa-naa wa-laa ta-kum maal kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ سَـَٔاوِيٓ إِلَىٰ جَبَلٖ يَعۡصِمُنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِۚ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مِنۡ أَمۡرِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَۚ وَحَالَ بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلۡمَوۡجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُغۡرَقِينَ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: قال ساوي الي جبل يعصمني من الماء قال لا عاصم اليوم من امر الله الا من رحم وحال بينهما الموج فكان من المغرقين
ayahs.translation: [But] he said, "I will take refuge on a mountain to protect me from the water." [Noah] said, "There is no protector today from the decree of Allāh, except for whom He gives mercy." And the waves came between them, and he was among the drowned.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la saaaweee i-laa ja-ba-li-ny ya-si-munee mi-nal maaa qaa-la laa aa-si-mal yaw-ma min am-ril laa-hi il-laa mar ra-him wa-haa-la bai-na-hu-mal maw-ju fa-kaa-na mi-nal mug-hra-qeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ يَٰٓأَرۡضُ ٱبۡلَعِي مَآءَكِ وَيَٰسَمَآءُ أَقۡلِعِي وَغِيضَ ٱلۡمَآءُ وَقُضِيَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ وَٱسۡتَوَتۡ عَلَى ٱلۡجُودِيِّۖ وَقِيلَ بُعۡدٗا لِّلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: وقيل يارض ابلعي ماءك ويسماء اقلعي وغيض الماء وقضي الامر واستوت علي الجودي وقيل بعدا للقوم الظلمين
ayahs.translation: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people."
ayahs.transliteration: waqee-la yaaaar-dub-laee maaaa-ki wayaa sa-maaau aq-liee wa-ghee-dal maaau wa-qu-diyal am-ru was-ta-wat a-lal joo-diyyi waqee-la bu-dal lil-qaw-miz zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٞ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبۡنِي مِنۡ أَهۡلِي وَإِنَّ وَعۡدَكَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحۡكَمُ ٱلۡحَٰكِمِينَ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: ونادي نوح ربه فقال رب ان ابني من اهلي وان وعدك الحق وانت احكم الحكمين
ayahs.translation: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!"
ayahs.transliteration: wa-naa-daa noo-hur rab-ba-hoo fa-qaa-la rab-bi in-nab nee min ah-lee wain-na wa-da-kal haq-qu waan-ta ah-ka-mul haa-kimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰنُوحُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيۡسَ مِنۡ أَهۡلِكَۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَمَلٌ غَيۡرُ صَٰلِحٖۖ فَلَا تَسۡـَٔلۡنِ مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمٌۖ إِنِّيٓ أَعِظُكَ أَن تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِينَ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: قال ينوح انه ليس من اهلك انه عمل غير صلح فلا تسلن ما ليس لك به علم اني اعظك ان تكون من الجهلين
ayahs.translation: He said, "O Noah, indeed he is not of your family; indeed, he is [one whose] work was other than righteous, so ask Me not for that about which you have no knowledge. Indeed, I advise you, lest you be among the ignorant."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la yaa-noo-hu in-na-hoo lai-sa min ah-li-ka in-na-hoo a-ma-lun ghai-ru saa-li-hin fa-laa ta-sal-ni maa lai-sa la-ka bihee il-mun in-neee ai-zu-ka an ta-koo-na mi-nal jaa-hileen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّيٓ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنۡ أَسۡـَٔلَكَ مَا لَيۡسَ لِي بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞۖ وَإِلَّا تَغۡفِرۡ لِي وَتَرۡحَمۡنِيٓ أَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: قال رب اني اعوذ بك ان اسلك ما ليس لي به علم والا تغفر لي وترحمني اكن من الخسرين
ayahs.translation: [Noah] said, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-bi in-neee aoo-zu bi-ka an a-sa-la-ka maa lai-sa lee bihee il-munw wail-laa tag-hfir lee wa-ta-rham-neee a-kum mi-nal khaa-sireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قِيلَ يَٰنُوحُ ٱهۡبِطۡ بِسَلَٰمٖ مِّنَّا وَبَرَكَٰتٍ عَلَيۡكَ وَعَلَىٰٓ أُمَمٖ مِّمَّن مَّعَكَۚ وَأُمَمٞ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمۡ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: قيل ينوح اهبط بسلم منا وبركت عليك وعلي امم ممن معك وامم سنمتعهم ثم يمسهم منا عذاب اليم
ayahs.translation: It was said, "O Noah, disembark in security from Us and blessings upon you and upon nations [descending] from those with you. But other nations [of them] We will grant enjoyment; then there will touch them from Us a painful punishment."
ayahs.transliteration: qee-la yaa-noo-huh bit bi-sa-laa-mim min-naa wa-ba-ra-kaa-tin a-lai-ka waa-laaa u-ma-mim mim-mam maak wau-ma-mun sa-nu-mat-tiu-hum sum-ma ya-mas-su-hum min-na a-zaa-bun aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: تِلۡكَ مِنۡ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ نُوحِيهَآ إِلَيۡكَۖ مَا كُنتَ تَعۡلَمُهَآ أَنتَ وَلَا قَوۡمُكَ مِن قَبۡلِ هَٰذَاۖ فَٱصۡبِرۡۖ إِنَّ ٱلۡعَٰقِبَةَ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: تلك من انباء الغيب نوحيها اليك ما كنت تعلمها انت ولا قومك من قبل هذا فاصبر ان العقبة للمتقين
ayahs.translation: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muḥammad]. You knew it not, neither you nor your people, before this. So be patient; indeed, the [best] outcome is for the righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: til-ka min am-baaail ghai-bi noohee-haaa i-lai-ka maa kun-ta ta-la-mu-haaaa an-ta wa-laa qaw-mu-ka min qab-li haa-zaa fas-bir in-nal aa-qi-ba-ta lil-mut-taqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِلَىٰ عَادٍ أَخَاهُمۡ هُودٗاۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرُهُۥٓۖ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا مُفۡتَرُونَ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: والي عاد اخاهم هودا قال يقوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من اله غيره ان انتم الا مفترون
ayahs.translation: And to ʿAad [We sent] their brother Hūd. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. You are not but inventors [of falsehood].
ayahs.transliteration: wai-laa aa-din a-khaa-hum hoo-daa qaa-la yaa-qaw-mi bu-dul laa-ha maa la-kum min i-laa-hin ghai-ru-hooo in an-tum il-laa muf-ta-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰقَوۡمِ لَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ أَجۡرًاۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِيٓۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: يقوم لا اسلكم عليه اجرا ان اجري الا علي الذي فطرني افلا تعقلون
ayahs.translation: O my people, I do not ask you for it [i.e., my advice] any reward. My reward is only from the one who created me. Then will you not reason?
ayahs.transliteration: yaa-qaw-mi laaa a-sa-lu-kum a-lai-hi aj-ran in aj-riya il-laa a-lal lazee fa-ta-ranee a-fa-laa ta-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ يُرۡسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّدۡرَارٗا وَيَزِدۡكُمۡ قُوَّةً إِلَىٰ قُوَّتِكُمۡ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوۡاْ مُجۡرِمِينَ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: ويقوم استغفروا ربكم ثم توبوا اليه يرسل السماء عليكم مدرارا ويزدكم قوة الي قوتكم ولا تتولوا مجرمين
ayahs.translation: And O my people, ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in showers and increase you in strength [added] to your strength. And do not turn away, [being] criminals."
ayahs.transliteration: wayaa-qaw-mis tag-hfi-roo rab-ba-kum sum-ma too-booo i-lai-hi yur-si-lis sa-maaaa a-lai-kum mid-raa-ranw waya-zid-kum quw-wa-tan i-laa quw-wa-ti-kum wa-laa ta-ta-wal-law muj-rimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ يَٰهُودُ مَا جِئۡتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٖ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِتَارِكِيٓ ءَالِهَتِنَا عَن قَوۡلِكَ وَمَا نَحۡنُ لَكَ بِمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا يهود ما جئتنا ببينة وما نحن بتاركي ءالهتنا عن قولك وما نحن لك بمؤمنين
ayahs.translation: They said, "O Hūd, you have not brought us clear evidence, and we are not ones to leave our gods on your say-so. Nor are we believers in you.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo yaa-hoo-du maa ji-ta-naa bi-baiyi-na-tinw wa-maa nah-nu bi-taa-rikeee aa-li-ha-ti-naa an qaw-li-ka wa-maa nah-nu la-ka bi-mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِن نَّقُولُ إِلَّا ٱعۡتَرَىٰكَ بَعۡضُ ءَالِهَتِنَا بِسُوٓءٖۗ قَالَ إِنِّيٓ أُشۡهِدُ ٱللَّهَ وَٱشۡهَدُوٓاْ أَنِّي بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تُشۡرِكُونَ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان نقول الا اعتريك بعض ءالهتنا بسوء قال اني اشهد الله واشهدوا اني بريء مما تشركون
ayahs.translation: We only say that some of our gods have possessed you with evil [i.e., insanity]." He said, "Indeed, I call Allāh to witness, and witness [yourselves] that I am free from whatever you associate with Allāh
ayahs.transliteration: in na-qoo-lu il-la ta-raa-ka ba-du aa-li-ha-ti-naa bi-sooo qaa-la in-neee us-hhi-dul laa-ha was-hha-dooo an-nee bareee-um mim-maa tus-hri-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مِن دُونِهِۦۖ فَكِيدُونِي جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ لَا تُنظِرُونِ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: من دونه فكيدوني جميعا ثم لا تنظرون
ayahs.translation: Other than Him. So plot against me all together; then do not give me respite.
ayahs.transliteration: min doo-nihee fakee-doonee jameean sum-ma laa tun-zi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنِّي تَوَكَّلۡتُ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۚ مَّا مِن دَآبَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ ءَاخِذُۢ بِنَاصِيَتِهَآۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: اني توكلت علي الله ربي وربكم ما من دابة الا هو ءاخذ بناصيتها ان ربي علي صرط مستقيم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I have relied upon Allāh, my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but that He holds it by its forelock [i.e., controls it]. Indeed, my Lord is on a path [that is] straight.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nee ta-wak-kal-tu a-lal laa-hi rab-bee wa-rab-bi-kum maa min daaab-ba-tin il-laa hu-wa aa-khi-zum bi-naa-siya-ti-haa in-na rab-bee a-laa si-raa-tim mus-taqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَقَدۡ أَبۡلَغۡتُكُم مَّآ أُرۡسِلۡتُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَيۡكُمۡۚ وَيَسۡتَخۡلِفُ رَبِّي قَوۡمًا غَيۡرَكُمۡ وَلَا تَضُرُّونَهُۥ شَيۡـًٔاۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ حَفِيظٞ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: فان تولوا فقد ابلغتكم ما ارسلت به اليكم ويستخلف ربي قوما غيركم ولا تضرونه شيا ان ربي علي كل شيء حفيظ
ayahs.translation: But if you turn away, then I have already conveyed that with which I was sent to you. My Lord will give succession to a people other than you, and you will not harm Him at all. Indeed my Lord is, over all things, Guardian."
ayahs.transliteration: fain ta-wal-law fa-qad ab-lag-htu-kum maaa ur-sil-tu biheee i-lai-kum wayas-tak-hli-fu rab-bee qaw-man ghai-ra-kum wa-laa ta-dur-roo-na-hoo shai-a-a in-na rab-bee a-laa kul-li shaiin hafeez

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمۡرُنَا نَجَّيۡنَا هُودٗا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحۡمَةٖ مِّنَّا وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٖ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: ولما جاء امرنا نجينا هودا والذين ءامنوا معه برحمة منا ونجينهم من عذاب غليظ
ayahs.translation: And when Our command came, We saved Hūd and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us; and We saved them from a harsh punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lam-maa jaaaa am-ru-naa na-jai-naa hoo-danw wal-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo maa-hoo bi-rah-ma-tim min-naa wa-na-jai-naa-hum min a-zaa-bin ghaleez

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتِلۡكَ عَادٞۖ جَحَدُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَعَصَوۡاْ رُسُلَهُۥ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٖ ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: وتلك عاد جحدوا بايت ربهم وعصوا رسله واتبعوا امر كل جبار عنيد
ayahs.translation: And that was ʿAad, who rejected the signs of their Lord and disobeyed His messengers and followed the order of every obstinate tyrant.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-til-ka aad ja-ha-doo bi-a-ayaa-ti rab-bi-him waa-saw ru-su-la-hoo wat-ta-baooo am-ra kul-li jab-baa-rin aneed

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأُتۡبِعُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا لَعۡنَةٗ وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ عَادٗا كَفَرُواْ رَبَّهُمۡۗ أَلَا بُعۡدٗا لِّعَادٖ قَوۡمِ هُودٖ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: واتبعوا في هذه الدنيا لعنة ويوم القيمة الا ان عادا كفروا ربهم الا بعدا لعاد قوم هود
ayahs.translation: And they were [therefore] followed in this world with a curse and [as well] on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, ʿAad denied their Lord; then away with ʿAad, the people of Hūd.
ayahs.transliteration: waut-bioo fee haa-zi-hid du-nyaa la-na-tanw wayaw-mal qiyaa-mah a-laaa in-na aa-dan ka-fa-roo rab-ba-hum a-laa bu-dal li-a-a-din qaw-min hood

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمۡ صَٰلِحٗاۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرُهُۥۖ هُوَ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱسۡتَعۡمَرَكُمۡ فِيهَا فَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٞ مُّجِيبٞ ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: والي ثمود اخاهم صلحا قال يقوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من اله غيره هو انشاكم من الارض واستعمركم فيها فاستغفروه ثم توبوا اليه ان ربي قريب مجيب
ayahs.translation: And to Thamūd [We sent] their brother Ṣāliḥ. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. He has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive."
ayahs.transliteration: wai-laa sa-moo-da a-khaa-hum saa-li-haa qaa-la yaa-qaw-mi bu-dul laa-ha maa la-kum min i-laa-him ghai-ru-hoo hu-wa an-shaa-kum mi-nal ar-di was-ta-ma-ra-kum fee-haa fas-tag-hfi-roo-hu sum-ma too-booo i-laih in-na rab-bee qaree-bum mujeeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ يَٰصَٰلِحُ قَدۡ كُنتَ فِينَا مَرۡجُوّٗا قَبۡلَ هَٰذَآۖ أَتَنۡهَىٰنَآ أَن نَّعۡبُدَ مَا يَعۡبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَإِنَّنَا لَفِي شَكّٖ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُونَآ إِلَيۡهِ مُرِيبٖ ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا يصلح قد كنت فينا مرجوا قبل هذا اتنهينا ان نعبد ما يعبد ءاباؤنا واننا لفي شك مما تدعونا اليه مريب
ayahs.translation: They said, "O Ṣāliḥ, you were among us a man of promise before this. Do you forbid us to worship what our fathers worshipped? And indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo yaa-saa-li-hu qad kun-ta fee-naa mar-juw-wan qab-la haa-zaaa a-ta-nhaa-naaa an na-bu-da maa ya-bu-du aa-baaau-naa wain-na-naa lafee shak-kim mim-maa ta-doo-naaa i-lai-hi mureeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّي وَءَاتَىٰنِي مِنۡهُ رَحۡمَةٗ فَمَن يَنصُرُنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِنۡ عَصَيۡتُهُۥۖ فَمَا تَزِيدُونَنِي غَيۡرَ تَخۡسِيرٖ ٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: قال يقوم ارءيتم ان كنت علي بينة من ربي وءاتيني منه رحمة فمن ينصرني من الله ان عصيته فما تزيدونني غير تخسير
ayahs.translation: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has given me mercy from Himself, who would protect me from Allāh if I disobeyed Him? So you would not increase me except in loss.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la yaa-qaw-mi a-raay-tum in kun-tu a-laa baiyi-na-tim mir rab-bee waaa-taanee mi-nhu rah-ma-tan fa-mai yan-su-runee mi-nal laa-hi in a-sai-tu-hoo fa-maa tazee-doo-na-nee ghai-ra tak-hseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةُ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمۡ ءَايَةٗۖ فَذَرُوهَا تَأۡكُلۡ فِيٓ أَرۡضِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٖ فَيَأۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابٞ قَرِيبٞ ٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: ويقوم هذه ناقة الله لكم ءاية فذروها تاكل في ارض الله ولا تمسوها بسوء فياخذكم عذاب قريب
ayahs.translation: And O my people, this is the she-camel of Allāh - [she is] to you a sign. So let her feed upon Allāh's earth and do not touch her with harm, or you will be taken by an impending punishment."
ayahs.transliteration: wayaa-qaw-mi haa-zihee naa-qa-tul laa-hi la-kum aaya-tan fa-za-roo-haa taa-kul feee ar-dil laa-hi wa-laa ta-mas-soo-haa bi-soooin fayaa-khu-za-kum a-zaa-bun qareeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُواْ فِي دَارِكُمۡ ثَلَٰثَةَ أَيَّامٖۖ ذَٰلِكَ وَعۡدٌ غَيۡرُ مَكۡذُوبٖ ٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: فعقروها فقال تمتعوا في داركم ثلثة ايام ذلك وعد غير مكذوب
ayahs.translation: But they hamstrung her, so he said, "Enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days. That is a promise not to be denied [i.e., unfailing]."
ayahs.transliteration: faa-qa-roo-haa fa-qaa-la ta-mat-taoo fee daa-ri-kum sa-laa-sa-ta aiyaa-min zaa-li-ka wa-dun ghai-ru mak-zoob

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمۡرُنَا نَجَّيۡنَا صَٰلِحٗا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحۡمَةٖ مِّنَّا وَمِنۡ خِزۡيِ يَوۡمِئِذٍۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلۡقَوِيُّ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: فلما جاء امرنا نجينا صلحا والذين ءامنوا معه برحمة منا ومن خزي يومئذ ان ربك هو القوي العزيز
ayahs.translation: So when Our command came, We saved Ṣāliḥ and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us, and [saved them] from the disgrace of that day. Indeed, it is your Lord who is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa jaaaa am-ru-naa naj-jai-naa saa-li-hanw wal-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo maa-hoo bi-rah-ma-tim min-naa wa-min khi-zyi yaw-miiz in-na rab-ba-ka hu-wal qa-wiyyul azeez

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَخَذَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ فَأَصۡبَحُواْ فِي دِيَٰرِهِمۡ جَٰثِمِينَ ٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: واخذ الذين ظلموا الصيحة فاصبحوا في ديرهم جثمين
ayahs.translation: And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone
ayahs.transliteration: waa-kha-zal lazee-na za-la-mus sai-ha-tu faas-ba-hoo fee diyaa-ri-him jaa-si-mee-na

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَأَن لَّمۡ يَغۡنَوۡاْ فِيهَآۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ثَمُودَاْ كَفَرُواْ رَبَّهُمۡۗ أَلَا بُعۡدٗا لِّثَمُودَ ٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: كان لم يغنوا فيها الا ان ثمودا كفروا ربهم الا بعدا لثمود
ayahs.translation: As if they had never prospered therein. Unquestionably, Thamūd denied their Lord; then, away with Thamūd.
ayahs.transliteration: kaal lam yag-hnaw fee-haaa a-laaa in-na sa-moo-da ka-fa-roo rab-ba-hum a-laa bu-dal li-sa-mood

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰ قَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗاۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٞۖ فَمَا لَبِثَ أَن جَآءَ بِعِجۡلٍ حَنِيذٖ ٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد جاءت رسلنا ابرهيم بالبشري قالوا سلما قال سلم فما لبث ان جاء بعجل حنيذ
ayahs.translation: And certainly did Our messengers [i.e., angels] come to Abraham with good tidings; they said, "Peace." He said, "Peace," and did not delay in bringing [them] a roasted calf.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad jaaaat ru-su-lu-naaa ib-raa-hee-ma bil-bus-hraa qaa-loo sa-laa-man qaa-la sa-laa-mun fa-maa la-bi-sa an jaaaa biij-lin haneez

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَءَآ أَيۡدِيَهُمۡ لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيۡهِ نَكِرَهُمۡ وَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةٗۚ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِ لُوطٖ ٧٠
ayahs.text_simple: فلما رءا ايديهم لا تصل اليه نكرهم واوجس منهم خيفة قالوا لا تخف انا ارسلنا الي قوم لوط
ayahs.translation: But when he saw their hands not reaching for it, he distrusted them and felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not. We have been sent to the people of Lot."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa raaaa ai-diya-hum laa ta-si-lu i-lai-hi na-ki-ra-hum waaw-ja-sa mi-nhum khee-fah qaa-loo laa ta-khaf in-naaa ur-sil-naaa i-laa qaw-mi loot

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ قَآئِمَةٞ فَضَحِكَتۡ فَبَشَّرۡنَٰهَا بِإِسۡحَٰقَ وَمِن وَرَآءِ إِسۡحَٰقَ يَعۡقُوبَ ٧١
ayahs.text_simple: وامراته قائمة فضحكت فبشرنها باسحق ومن وراء اسحق يعقوب
ayahs.translation: And his wife was standing, and she smiled. Then We gave her good tidings of Isaac and after Isaac, Jacob.
ayahs.transliteration: wam-raa-tu-hoo qaaai-ma-tun fa-da-hi-kat fa-bas-hshar-naa-haa bii-shaa-qa wa-minw wa-raaai i-shaa-qa ya-qoob

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَتۡ يَٰوَيۡلَتَىٰٓ ءَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا۠ عَجُوزٞ وَهَٰذَا بَعۡلِي شَيۡخًاۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عَجِيبٞ ٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: قالت يويلتي ءالد وانا عجوز وهذا بعلي شيخا ان هذا لشيء عجيب
ayahs.translation: She said, "Woe to me! Shall I give birth while I am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? Indeed, this is an amazing thing!"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-lat yaa-wai-la-taaa aa-li-du waa-na a-joo-zunw wa-haa-za balee shai-khan in-na haa-zaa la-shaiun ajeeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓاْ أَتَعۡجَبِينَ مِنۡ أَمۡرِ ٱللَّهِۖ رَحۡمَتُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَٰتُهُۥ عَلَيۡكُمۡ أَهۡلَ ٱلۡبَيۡتِۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَمِيدٞ مَّجِيدٞ ٧٣
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا اتعجبين من امر الله رحمت الله وبركته عليكم اهل البيت انه حميد مجيد
ayahs.translation: They said, "Are you amazed at the decree of Allāh? May the mercy of Allāh and His blessings be upon you, people of the house. Indeed, He is Praiseworthy and Honorable."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-looo a-ta-ja-bee-na min am-ril laa-hi rah-ma-tul laa-hi wa-ba-ra-kaa-tu-hoo a-lai-kum ah-lal bayt in-na-hoo hamee-dun majeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنۡ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلرَّوۡعُ وَجَآءَتۡهُ ٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰ يُجَٰدِلُنَا فِي قَوۡمِ لُوطٍ ٧٤
ayahs.text_simple: فلما ذهب عن ابرهيم الروع وجاءته البشري يجدلنا في قوم لوط
ayahs.translation: And when the fright had left Abraham and the good tidings had reached him, he began to argue [i.e., plead] with Us concerning the people of Lot.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa za-ha-ba an ib-raa-hee-mar ra-wu wa-jaaaa-thul bus-hraaa yu-jaa-di-lu-naa fee qaw-mi loot

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ لَحَلِيمٌ أَوَّٰهٞ مُّنِيبٞ ٧٥
ayahs.text_simple: ان ابرهيم لحليم اوه منيب
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Abraham was forbearing, grieving and [frequently] returning [to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: in-na ib-raa-hee-ma la-ha-lee-mun aw-waa-hun muneeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُ أَعۡرِضۡ عَنۡ هَٰذَآۖ إِنَّهُۥ قَدۡ جَآءَ أَمۡرُ رَبِّكَۖ وَإِنَّهُمۡ ءَاتِيهِمۡ عَذَابٌ غَيۡرُ مَرۡدُودٖ ٧٦
ayahs.text_simple: يابرهيم اعرض عن هذا انه قد جاء امر ربك وانهم ءاتيهم عذاب غير مردود
ayahs.translation: [The angels said], "O Abraham, give up this [plea]. Indeed, the command of your Lord has come, and indeed, there will reach them a punishment that cannot be repelled."
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaib-raa-hee-mu a-rid an haa-zaaa in-na-hoo qad jaaaa am-ru rab-bi-ka wain-na-hum aa-tee-him a-zaa-bun ghai-run mar-dood

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَا لُوطٗا سِيٓءَ بِهِمۡ وَضَاقَ بِهِمۡ ذَرۡعٗا وَقَالَ هَٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَصِيبٞ ٧٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولما جاءت رسلنا لوطا سيء بهم وضاق بهم ذرعا وقال هذا يوم عصيب
ayahs.translation: And when Our messengers, [the angels], came to Lot, he was anguished for them and felt for them great discomfort and said, "This is a trying day."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lam-maa jaaaat ru-su-lu-naa loo-tan seeea bi-him wa-daa-qa bi-him za-ranw wa-qaa-la haa-zaa yaw-mun aseeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَآءَهُۥ قَوۡمُهُۥ يُهۡرَعُونَ إِلَيۡهِ وَمِن قَبۡلُ كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِي هُنَّ أَطۡهَرُ لَكُمۡۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخۡزُونِ فِي ضَيۡفِيٓۖ أَلَيۡسَ مِنكُمۡ رَجُلٞ رَّشِيدٞ ٧٨
ayahs.text_simple: وجاءه قومه يهرعون اليه ومن قبل كانوا يعملون السيات قال يقوم هؤلاء بناتي هن اطهر لكم فاتقوا الله ولا تخزون في ضيفي اليس منكم رجل رشيد
ayahs.translation: And his people came hastening to him, and before [this] they had been doing evil deeds. He said, "O my people, these are my daughters; they are purer for you. So fear Allāh and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not among you a man of reason?"
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaaaa-hoo qaw-mu-hoo yuh-raoo-na i-lai-hi wa-min qab-lu kaa-noo ya-ma-loo-nas saiyi-a-at qaa-la yaa-qaw-mi haaau-laaai ba-naatee hun-na a-tha-ru la-kum fat-ta-qul laa-ha wa-laa tuk-hzoo-ni fee daifee a-lai-sa min-kum ra-ju-lur ra-sheed

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ لَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتَ مَا لَنَا فِي بَنَاتِكَ مِنۡ حَقّٖ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَعۡلَمُ مَا نُرِيدُ ٧٩
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا لقد علمت ما لنا في بناتك من حق وانك لتعلم ما نريد
ayahs.translation: They said, "You have already known that we have not concerning your daughters [i.e., women] any claim [i.e., desire], and indeed, you know what we want."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo la-qad a-lim-ta maa la-naa fee ba-naa-ti-ka min haqq wain-na-ka la-ta-la-mu maa nureed

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَوۡ أَنَّ لِي بِكُمۡ قُوَّةً أَوۡ ءَاوِيٓ إِلَىٰ رُكۡنٖ شَدِيدٖ ٨٠
ayahs.text_simple: قال لو ان لي بكم قوة او ءاوي الي ركن شديد
ayahs.translation: He said, "If only I had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la law an-na lee bi-kum quw-wa-tan aw aa-weee i-laa ruk-nin shadeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ يَٰلُوطُ إِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَن يَصِلُوٓاْ إِلَيۡكَۖ فَأَسۡرِ بِأَهۡلِكَ بِقِطۡعٖ مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَلَا يَلۡتَفِتۡ مِنكُمۡ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَكَۖ إِنَّهُۥ مُصِيبُهَا مَآ أَصَابَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ مَوۡعِدَهُمُ ٱلصُّبۡحُۚ أَلَيۡسَ ٱلصُّبۡحُ بِقَرِيبٖ ٨١
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا يلوط انا رسل ربك لن يصلوا اليك فاسر باهلك بقطع من اليل ولا يلتفت منكم احد الا امراتك انه مصيبها ما اصابهم ان موعدهم الصبح اليس الصبح بقريب
ayahs.translation: They [the angels] said, "O Lot, indeed we are messengers of your Lord; [therefore], they will never reach you. So set out with your family during a portion of the night and let not any among you look back - except your wife; indeed, she will be struck by that which strikes them. Indeed, their appointment is [for] the morning. Is not the morning near?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo yaa-loo-tu in-naa ru-su-lu rab-bi-ka lai ya-si-loo i-lai-ka faas-ri bi-a-hli-ka bi-qi-tim mi-nal lai-li wa-laa yal-ta-fit min-kum a-ha-dun il-lam raa-ta-ka in-na-hoo musee-bu-haa maaa a-saa-ba-hum in-na ma-wi-da-hu-mus subh a-lai-sas su-bhu bi-qareeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمۡرُنَا جَعَلۡنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا حِجَارَةٗ مِّن سِجِّيلٖ مَّنضُودٖ ٨٢
ayahs.text_simple: فلما جاء امرنا جعلنا عليها سافلها وامطرنا عليها حجارة من سجيل منضود
ayahs.translation: So when Our command came, We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were]
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa jaaaa am-ru-naa jaal-naa aa-liya-haa saa-fi-la-haa waam-tar-naa a-lai-haa hi-jaa-ra-tam min sij-jee-lim man-dood

ayahs.text_uthmani: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَۖ وَمَا هِيَ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بِبَعِيدٖ ٨٣
ayahs.text_simple: مسومة عند ربك وما هي من الظلمين ببعيد
ayahs.translation: Marked from your Lord. And it [i.e., Allāh's punishment] is not from the wrongdoers [very] far.
ayahs.transliteration: mu-saw-wa-ma-tan in-da rab-bik wa-maa hiya mi-naz zaa-li-me-na bi-baeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَإِلَىٰ مَدۡيَنَ أَخَاهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٗاۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرُهُۥۖ وَلَا تَنقُصُواْ ٱلۡمِكۡيَالَ وَٱلۡمِيزَانَۖ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰكُم بِخَيۡرٖ وَإِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٖ مُّحِيطٖ ٨٤
ayahs.text_simple: والي مدين اخاهم شعيبا قال يقوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من اله غيره ولا تنقصوا المكيال والميزان اني اريكم بخير واني اخاف عليكم عذاب يوم محيط
ayahs.translation: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. And do not decrease from the measure and the scale. Indeed, I see you in prosperity, but indeed, I fear for you the punishment of an all-encompassing Day.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-laa ma-dya-na a-khaa-hum shu-a-i-baa qaa-la yaa-qaw-mi bu-dul laa-ha maa la-kum min i-laa-hin ghai-ru-hoo wa-laa tan-qu-sul mi-kyaa-la wal-mee-zaan in-neee a-raa-kum bi-khai-rinw wain-nee a-khaa-fu a-lai-kum a-zaa-ba yaw-mim muheet

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ أَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡمِكۡيَالَ وَٱلۡمِيزَانَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِۖ وَلَا تَبۡخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ ٨٥
ayahs.text_simple: ويقوم اوفوا المكيال والميزان بالقسط ولا تبخسوا الناس اشياءهم ولا تعثوا في الارض مفسدين
ayahs.translation: And O my people, give full measure and weight in justice and do not deprive the people of their due and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption.
ayahs.transliteration: wayaa-qaw-mi aw-ful mi-kyaa-la wal-mee-zaa-na bil-qis-ti wa-laa tab-kha-sun naa-sa a-shyaaaa-hum wa-laa ta-saw fil ar-di muf-sideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَقِيَّتُ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَۚ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيۡكُم بِحَفِيظٖ ٨٦
ayahs.text_simple: بقيت الله خير لكم ان كنتم مؤمنين وما انا عليكم بحفيظ
ayahs.translation: What remains [lawful] from Allāh is best for you, if you would be believers. But I am not a guardian over you."
ayahs.transliteration: ba-qiyya-tul laa-hi khai-rul la-kum in kun-tum mu-mineen wa-maa a-na a-lai-kum bi-hafeez

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ يَٰشُعَيۡبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأۡمُرُكَ أَن نَّتۡرُكَ مَا يَعۡبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوۡ أَن نَّفۡعَلَ فِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَٰٓؤُاْۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلۡحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ ٨٧
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا يشعيب اصلوتك تامرك ان نترك ما يعبد ءاباؤنا او ان نفعل في امولنا ما نشؤا انك لانت الحليم الرشيد
ayahs.translation: They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo yaa-shu-a-y-bu a-sa-laa-tu-ka ta-mu-ru-ka an nat-ru-ka maa ya-bu-du aa-baaau-naaa aw an naf a-la feee am-waa-li-naa maa na-shaaaoo in-na-ka laan-tal halee-mur ra-sheed

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّي وَرَزَقَنِي مِنۡهُ رِزۡقًا حَسَنٗاۚ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنۡ أُخَالِفَكُمۡ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنۡهَىٰكُمۡ عَنۡهُۚ إِنۡ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا ٱلۡإِصۡلَٰحَ مَا ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُۚ وَمَا تَوۡفِيقِيٓ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِۚ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ وَإِلَيۡهِ أُنِيبُ ٨٨
ayahs.text_simple: قال يقوم ارءيتم ان كنت علي بينة من ربي ورزقني منه رزقا حسنا وما اريد ان اخالفكم الي ما انهيكم عنه ان اريد الا الاصلح ما استطعت وما توفيقي الا بالله عليه توكلت واليه انيب
ayahs.translation: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I am upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has provided me with a good provision from Him...? And I do not intend to differ from you in that which I have forbidden you; I only intend reform as much as I am able. And my success is not but through Allāh. Upon Him I have relied, and to Him I return.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la yaa-qaw-mi a-raai-tum in kun-tu a-laa baiyi-na-tim mir rab-bee wa-ra-za-qanee mi-nhu riz-qan ha-sa-naa wa-maaa uree-du an u-khaa-li-fa-kum i-laa maaa a-nhaa-kum anh in uree-du il-lal is-laa-ha mas ta-tat wa-maa taw-feeqeee il-laa bil-laah a-lai-hi ta-wak-kal-tu wai-lai-hi uneeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ لَا يَجۡرِمَنَّكُمۡ شِقَاقِيٓ أَن يُصِيبَكُم مِّثۡلُ مَآ أَصَابَ قَوۡمَ نُوحٍ أَوۡ قَوۡمَ هُودٍ أَوۡ قَوۡمَ صَٰلِحٖۚ وَمَا قَوۡمُ لُوطٖ مِّنكُم بِبَعِيدٖ ٨٩
ayahs.text_simple: ويقوم لا يجرمنكم شقاقي ان يصيبكم مثل ما اصاب قوم نوح او قوم هود او قوم صلح وما قوم لوط منكم ببعيد
ayahs.translation: And O my people, let not [your] dissension from me cause you to be struck by that similar to what struck the people of Noah or the people of Hūd or the people of Ṣāliḥ. And the people of Lot are not from you far away.
ayahs.transliteration: wayaa-qaw-mi laa yaj-ri-man-na-kum shi-qaaqeee ai yu-see-ba-kum mis-lu maaa a-saa-ba qaw-ma noo-hin aw qaw-ma hoo-din aw qaw-ma saa-lih wa-maa qaw-mu loo-tim min-kum bi-baeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي رَحِيمٞ وَدُودٞ ٩٠
ayahs.text_simple: واستغفروا ربكم ثم توبوا اليه ان ربي رحيم ودود
ayahs.translation: And ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is Merciful and Affectionate."
ayahs.transliteration: was-tag-hfi-roo rab-ba-kum sum-ma too-booo i-laih in-na rab-bee rahee-munw wa-dood

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ يَٰشُعَيۡبُ مَا نَفۡقَهُ كَثِيرٗا مِّمَّا تَقُولُ وَإِنَّا لَنَرَىٰكَ فِينَا ضَعِيفٗاۖ وَلَوۡلَا رَهۡطُكَ لَرَجَمۡنَٰكَۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡنَا بِعَزِيزٖ ٩١
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا يشعيب ما نفقه كثيرا مما تقول وانا لنريك فينا ضعيفا ولولا رهطك لرجمنك وما انت علينا بعزيز
ayahs.translation: They said, "O Shuʿayb, we do not understand much of what you say, and indeed, we consider you among us as weak. And if not for your family, we would have stoned you [to death]; and you are not to us one respected."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo yaa-shu-a-i-bu maa naf-qa-hu kasee-ram mim-maa ta-qoo-lu wain-naa la-na-raa-ka fee-naa daee-fanw wa-law-laa rah-tu-ka la-ra-jam-naa-ka wa-maaa an-ta a-lai-naa bi-a-zeez

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَرَهۡطِيٓ أَعَزُّ عَلَيۡكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱتَّخَذۡتُمُوهُ وَرَآءَكُمۡ ظِهۡرِيًّاۖ إِنَّ رَبِّي بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ مُحِيطٞ ٩٢
ayahs.text_simple: قال يقوم ارهطي اعز عليكم من الله واتخذتموه وراءكم ظهريا ان ربي بما تعملون محيط
ayahs.translation: He said, "O my people, is my family more respected for power by you than Allāh? But you put Him behind your backs [in neglect]. Indeed, my Lord is encompassing of what you do.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la yaa-qaw-mi a-rah-teee aaz-zu a-lai-kum mi-nal laa-hi wat-ta-khaz-tu-moo-hu wa-raaaa-kum zih-riyyan in-na rab-bee bi-maa ta-ma-loo-na muheet

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡمَلُواْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمۡ إِنِّي عَٰمِلٞۖ سَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ مَن يَأۡتِيهِ عَذَابٞ يُخۡزِيهِ وَمَنۡ هُوَ كَٰذِبٞۖ وَٱرۡتَقِبُوٓاْ إِنِّي مَعَكُمۡ رَقِيبٞ ٩٣
ayahs.text_simple: ويقوم اعملوا علي مكانتكم اني عمل سوف تعلمون من ياتيه عذاب يخزيه ومن هو كذب وارتقبوا اني معكم رقيب
ayahs.translation: And O my people, work according to your position; indeed, I am working. You are going to know to whom will come a punishment that will disgrace him and who is a liar. So watch; indeed, I am with you a watcher, [awaiting the outcome]."
ayahs.transliteration: wayaa-qaw-mi ma-loo a-laa ma-kaa-na-ti-kum in-nee aa-mi-lun saw-fa ta-la-moo-na ma-ny ya-tee-hi a-zaa-bu-ny yuk-hzee-hi wa-man hu-wa kaa-zib war-ta-qi-booo in-nnee maa-kum raqeeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمۡرُنَا نَجَّيۡنَا شُعَيۡبٗا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحۡمَةٖ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ فَأَصۡبَحُواْ فِي دِيَٰرِهِمۡ جَٰثِمِينَ ٩٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولما جاء امرنا نجينا شعيبا والذين ءامنوا معه برحمة منا واخذت الذين ظلموا الصيحة فاصبحوا في ديرهم جثمين
ayahs.translation: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lam-maa jaaaa am-ru-naa naj-jai-naa shu-a-i-banw wal-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo maa-hoo bi-rah-ma-tim min-naa waa-kha-za-til lazee-na za-la-mus sai-ha-tu faas-ba-hoo fee diyaa-ri-him jaa-simeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَأَن لَّمۡ يَغۡنَوۡاْ فِيهَآۗ أَلَا بُعۡدٗا لِّمَدۡيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتۡ ثَمُودُ ٩٥
ayahs.text_simple: كان لم يغنوا فيها الا بعدا لمدين كما بعدت ثمود
ayahs.translation: As if they had never prospered therein. Then, away with Madyan as Thamūd was taken away.
ayahs.transliteration: kaal lam yag-hnaw fee-haaa a-laa bu-dal li-ma-dya-na ka-maa bai-dat sa-mood

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٍ ٩٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ارسلنا موسي بايتنا وسلطن مبين
ayahs.translation: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad ar-sal-naa moo-saa bi-a-ayaa-ti-naa wa-sul-taa-nim mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَ فِرۡعَوۡنَۖ وَمَآ أَمۡرُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِرَشِيدٖ ٩٧
ayahs.text_simple: الي فرعون وملايه فاتبعوا امر فرعون وما امر فرعون برشيد
ayahs.translation: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they followed the command of Pharaoh, and the command of Pharaoh was not [at all] discerning.
ayahs.transliteration: i-laa fi-raw-na wa-ma-laihee fat-ta-baooo am-ra fi-raw-na wa-maaa am-ru fi-raw-na bi-ra-sheed

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَقۡدُمُ قَوۡمَهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فَأَوۡرَدَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡوِرۡدُ ٱلۡمَوۡرُودُ ٩٨
ayahs.text_simple: يقدم قومه يوم القيمة فاوردهم النار وبئس الورد المورود
ayahs.translation: He will precede his people on the Day of Resurrection and lead them into the Fire; and wretched is the place to which they are led.
ayahs.transliteration: yaq-du-mu qaw-ma-hoo yaw-mal qiyaa-ma-ti faaw-ra-da-hu-mun naa-ra wa-bi-sal wir-dul maw-rood

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأُتۡبِعُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِۦ لَعۡنَةٗ وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ بِئۡسَ ٱلرِّفۡدُ ٱلۡمَرۡفُودُ ٩٩
ayahs.text_simple: واتبعوا في هذه لعنة ويوم القيمة بئس الرفد المرفود
ayahs.translation: And they were followed in this [world] with a curse and on the Day of Resurrection. And wretched is the gift which is given.
ayahs.transliteration: waut-bioo fee haa-zihee la-na-tanw wayaw-mal qiyaa-mah bi-sar rif-dul mar-food

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ نَقُصُّهُۥ عَلَيۡكَۖ مِنۡهَا قَآئِمٞ وَحَصِيدٞ ١٠٠
ayahs.text_simple: ذلك من انباء القري نقصه عليك منها قائم وحصيد
ayahs.translation: That is from the news of the cities, which We relate to you; of them, some are [still] standing and some are [as] a harvest [mowed down].
ayahs.transliteration: zaa-li-ka min am-baaail qu-raa na-qus-su-hoo a-lai-ka mi-nhaa qaaai-munw wa-haseed

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡۖ فَمَآ أَغۡنَتۡ عَنۡهُمۡ ءَالِهَتُهُمُ ٱلَّتِي يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَيۡءٖ لَّمَّا جَآءَ أَمۡرُ رَبِّكَۖ وَمَا زَادُوهُمۡ غَيۡرَ تَتۡبِيبٖ ١٠١
ayahs.text_simple: وما ظلمنهم ولكن ظلموا انفسهم فما اغنت عنهم ءالهتهم التي يدعون من دون الله من شيء لما جاء امر ربك وما زادوهم غير تتبيب
ayahs.translation: And We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. And they were not availed at all by their gods which they invoked other than Allāh when there came the command of your Lord. And they did not increase them in other than ruin.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa za-lam-naa-hum wa-laa-kin za-la-mooo an-fu-sa-hum fa-maaa ag-hnat a-nhum aa-li-ha-tu-hu-mul latee ya-doo-na min doo-nil laa-hi min shaiil lam-maa jaaaa am-ru rab-bi-ka wa-maa zaa-doo-hum ghai-ra tat-beeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَخۡذُ رَبِّكَ إِذَآ أَخَذَ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ وَهِيَ ظَٰلِمَةٌۚ إِنَّ أَخۡذَهُۥٓ أَلِيمٞ شَدِيدٌ ١٠٢
ayahs.text_simple: وكذلك اخذ ربك اذا اخذ القري وهي ظلمة ان اخذه اليم شديد
ayahs.translation: And thus is the seizure of your Lord when He seizes the cities while they are committing wrong. Indeed, His seizure is painful and severe.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ka-zaa-li-ka ak-hzu rab-bi-ka i-zaaa a-kha-zal qu-raa wa-hiya zaa-li-mah in-na ak-hza-hooo alee-mun shadeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّمَنۡ خَافَ عَذَابَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمٞ مَّجۡمُوعٞ لَّهُ ٱلنَّاسُ وَذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمٞ مَّشۡهُودٞ ١٠٣
ayahs.text_simple: ان في ذلك لاية لمن خاف عذاب الاخرة ذلك يوم مجموع له الناس وذلك يوم مشهود
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a sign for those who fear the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a Day for which the people will be collected, and that is a Day [which will be] witnessed.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaaya-tal li-man khaa-fa a-zaa-bal aa-khi-rah zaa-li-ka yaw-mum maj-mooul la-hun naa-su wa-zaa-li-ka yaw-mum mas-hhood

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا نُؤَخِّرُهُۥٓ إِلَّا لِأَجَلٖ مَّعۡدُودٖ ١٠٤
ayahs.text_simple: وما نؤخره الا لاجل معدود
ayahs.translation: And We do not delay it except for a limited term.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa nu-a-khkhi-ru-hooo il-laa li-a-ja-lim ma-dood

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يَأۡتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفۡسٌ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦۚ فَمِنۡهُمۡ شَقِيّٞ وَسَعِيدٞ ١٠٥
ayahs.text_simple: يوم يات لا تكلم نفس الا باذنه فمنهم شقي وسعيد
ayahs.translation: The Day it comes no soul will speak except by His permission. And among them will be the wretched and the prosperous.
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma yaa-ti laa ta-kal-la-mu naf-sun il-laa biiz-nih fa-mi-nhum sha-qiyyunw wa-saeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ شَقُواْ فَفِي ٱلنَّارِ لَهُمۡ فِيهَا زَفِيرٞ وَشَهِيقٌ ١٠٦
ayahs.text_simple: فاما الذين شقوا ففي النار لهم فيها زفير وشهيق
ayahs.translation: As for those who were [destined to be] wretched, they will be in the Fire. For them therein is [violent] exhaling and inhaling.
ayahs.transliteration: faam-mal lazee-na sha-qoo fa-fin naa-ri la-hum fee-haa zafee-runw wa-shaheeq

ayahs.text_uthmani: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٞ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ ١٠٧
ayahs.text_simple: خلدين فيها ما دامت السموت والارض الا ما شاء ربك ان ربك فعال لما يريد
ayahs.translation: [They will be] abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will. Indeed, your Lord is an effecter of what He intends.
ayahs.transliteration: khaa-li-dee-na fee-haa maa daa-ma-tis sa-maa-waa-tu wa-lar-du il-laa maa shaaaa rab-buk in-na rab-ba-ka faaa-lul li-maa yu-reed

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ سُعِدُواْ فَفِي ٱلۡجَنَّةِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَۖ عَطَآءً غَيۡرَ مَجۡذُوذٖ ١٠٨
ayahs.text_simple: واما الذين سعدوا ففي الجنة خلدين فيها ما دامت السموت والارض الا ما شاء ربك عطاء غير مجذوذ
ayahs.translation: And as for those who were [destined to be] prosperous, they will be in Paradise, abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will - a bestowal uninterrupted.
ayahs.transliteration: waam-mal lazee-na su-i-doo fa-fil jan-na-ti khaa-li-dee-na fee-haa maa daa-ma-tis sa-maa-waa-tu wa-lar-du il-laa maa shaaaa rab-buk a-taaaan ghai-ra maj-zooz

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَا تَكُ فِي مِرۡيَةٖ مِّمَّا يَعۡبُدُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِۚ مَا يَعۡبُدُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَعۡبُدُ ءَابَآؤُهُم مِّن قَبۡلُۚ وَإِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوهُمۡ نَصِيبَهُمۡ غَيۡرَ مَنقُوصٖ ١٠٩
ayahs.text_simple: فلا تك في مرية مما يعبد هؤلاء ما يعبدون الا كما يعبد ءاباؤهم من قبل وانا لموفوهم نصيبهم غير منقوص
ayahs.translation: So do not be in doubt, [O Muḥammad], as to what these [polytheists] are worshipping. They worship not except as their fathers worshipped before. And indeed, We will give them their share undiminished.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-laa ta-ku fee mi-rya-tim mim-mmaa ya-bu-du haaau-laaa maa ya-bu-doo-na il-laa ka-maa ya-bu-du aa-baaau-hum min qabl wain-naa la-mu-waf-foo-hum nasee-ba-hum ghai-ra man-qoos

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ فَٱخۡتُلِفَ فِيهِۚ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٞ سَبَقَتۡ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَفِي شَكّٖ مِّنۡهُ مُرِيبٖ ١١٠
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ءاتينا موسي الكتب فاختلف فيه ولولا كلمة سبقت من ربك لقضي بينهم وانهم لفي شك منه مريب
ayahs.translation: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them. And indeed they are, concerning it [i.e., the Qur’ān], in disquieting doubt.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad aa-tai-naa moo-sal ki-taa-ba fak-htu-li-fa feeh wa-law-laa ka-li-ma-tun sa-ba-qat mir rab-bi-ka la-qu-diya bai-na-hum wain-na-hum lafee shak-kim mi-nhu mureeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ كُلّٗا لَّمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمۡ رَبُّكَ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ ١١١
ayahs.text_simple: وان كلا لما ليوفينهم ربك اعملهم انه بما يعملون خبير
ayahs.translation: And indeed, each [of the believers and disbelievers] - your Lord will fully compensate them for their deeds. Indeed, He is Aware of what they do.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na kul-lal lam-maa layu-waf-fiyan-na-hum rab-bu-ka a-maa-la-hum in-na-hoo bi-maa ya-ma-loo-na khabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱسۡتَقِمۡ كَمَآ أُمِرۡتَ وَمَن تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطۡغَوۡاْۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٞ ١١٢
ayahs.text_simple: فاستقم كما امرت ومن تاب معك ولا تطغوا انه بما تعملون بصير
ayahs.translation: So remain on a right course as you have been commanded, [you] and those who have turned back with you [to Allāh], and do not transgress. Indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.
ayahs.transliteration: fas-ta-qim ka-maaa u-mir-ta wa-man taa-ba maa-ka wa-laa tat-ghaw in-na-hoo bi-maa ta-ma-loo-na baseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَرۡكَنُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ فَتَمَسَّكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِنۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ ١١٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولا تركنوا الي الذين ظلموا فتمسكم النار وما لكم من دون الله من اولياء ثم لا تنصرون
ayahs.translation: And do not incline toward those who do wrong, lest you be touched by the Fire, and you would not have other than Allāh any protectors; then you would not be helped.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa tar-ka-nooo i-lal lazee-na za-la-moo fa-ta-mas-sa-ku-mun naa-ru wa-maa la-kum min doo-nil laa-hi min aw-liyaaaa sum-ma laa tun-sa-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ طَرَفَيِ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَزُلَفٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِۚ إِنَّ ٱلۡحَسَنَٰتِ يُذۡهِبۡنَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِۚ ذَٰلِكَ ذِكۡرَىٰ لِلذَّٰكِرِينَ ١١٤
ayahs.text_simple: واقم الصلوة طرفي النهار وزلفا من اليل ان الحسنت يذهبن السيات ذلك ذكري للذكرين
ayahs.translation: And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember.
ayahs.transliteration: waa-qi-mis sa-laa-ta ta-ra-fayin na-haa-ri wa-zu-la-fam mi-nal layl in-nal ha-sa-naa-ti yu-zhib-nas saiyi-a-at zaa-li-ka zik-raa liz-zaa-kireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱصۡبِرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجۡرَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ١١٥
ayahs.text_simple: واصبر فان الله لا يضيع اجر المحسنين
ayahs.translation: And be patient, for indeed, Allāh does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.
ayahs.transliteration: was-bir fain-nal laa-ha laa yu-dee-u aj-ral muh-sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَوۡلَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ أُوْلُواْ بَقِيَّةٖ يَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ ٱلۡفَسَادِ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا مِّمَّنۡ أَنجَيۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡۗ وَٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مَآ أُتۡرِفُواْ فِيهِ وَكَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ ١١٦
ayahs.text_simple: فلولا كان من القرون من قبلكم اولوا بقية ينهون عن الفساد في الارض الا قليلا ممن انجينا منهم واتبع الذين ظلموا ما اترفوا فيه وكانوا مجرمين
ayahs.translation: So why were there not among the generations before you those of enduring discrimination forbidding corruption on earth - except a few of those We saved from among them? But those who wronged pursued what luxury they were given therein, and they were criminals.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-law-laa kaa-na mi-nal qu-roo-ni min qab-li-kum oo-loo ba-qiyya-ti-ny ya-nhaw-na a-nil fa-saa-di fil ar-di il-laa qalee-lam mim-man an-jai-naa mi-nhum wat-ta-baal lazee-na za-la-moo maaa ut-ri-foo fee-hi wa-kaa-noo muj-rimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهۡلِكَ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ بِظُلۡمٖ وَأَهۡلُهَا مُصۡلِحُونَ ١١٧
ayahs.text_simple: وما كان ربك ليهلك القري بظلم واهلها مصلحون
ayahs.translation: And your Lord would not have destroyed the cities unjustly while their people were reformers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa kaa-na rab-bu-ka liyuh-li-kal qu-raa bi-zul-minw waah-lu-haa mus-li-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّاسَ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗۖ وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخۡتَلِفِينَ ١١٨
ayahs.text_simple: ولو شاء ربك لجعل الناس امة وحدة ولا يزالون مختلفين
ayahs.translation: And if your Lord had willed, He could have made mankind one community; but they will not cease to differ,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law shaaaa rab-bu-ka la-jaa-lan-nnaa-sa um-ma-tanw waa hi-da-tanw wa-laa ya-zaa-loo-na muk-hta-lifeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَۚ وَلِذَٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمۡۗ وَتَمَّتۡ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجۡمَعِينَ ١١٩
ayahs.text_simple: الا من رحم ربك ولذلك خلقهم وتمت كلمة ربك لاملان جهنم من الجنة والناس اجمعين
ayahs.translation: Except whom your Lord has given mercy, and for that He created them. But the word of your Lord is to be fulfilled that, "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and men all together."
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa mar ra-hi-ma rab-buk wa-li-zaa-li-ka kha-la-qa-hum wa-tam-mat ka-li-ma-tu rab-bi-ka laam-laa-na ja-han-na-ma mi-nal jin-na-ti wan-nnaa-si aj-maeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكُلّٗا نَّقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَۚ وَجَآءَكَ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَمَوۡعِظَةٞ وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ١٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: وكلا نقص عليك من انباء الرسل ما نثبت به فؤادك وجاءك في هذه الحق وموعظة وذكري للمؤمنين
ayahs.translation: And each [story] We relate to you from the news of the messengers is that by which We make firm your heart. And there has come to you, in this, the truth and an instruction and a reminder for the believers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kul-lan na-qus-su a-lai-ka min am-baaair ru-su-li maa nu-sab-bi-tu bihee fu-a-a-dak wa-jaaaa-ka fee haa-zi-hil haq-qu wa-ma-wi-za-tunw wa-zik-raa lil-mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱعۡمَلُواْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمۡ إِنَّا عَٰمِلُونَ ١٢١
ayahs.text_simple: وقل للذين لا يؤمنون اعملوا علي مكانتكم انا عملون
ayahs.translation: And say to those who do not believe, "Work according to your position; indeed, we are working.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qul lil-la-zee-na laa yu-mi-noo na-ma-loo a-laa ma-kaa-na-ti-kum in-naa aa-mi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱنتَظِرُوٓاْ إِنَّا مُنتَظِرُونَ ١٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: وانتظروا انا منتظرون
ayahs.translation: And wait; indeed, we are waiting."
ayahs.transliteration: wan-ta-zi-roo in-naa mun-ta-zi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ غَيۡبُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِلَيۡهِ يُرۡجَعُ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ كُلُّهُۥ فَٱعۡبُدۡهُ وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَيۡهِۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ ١٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولله غيب السموت والارض واليه يرجع الامر كله فاعبده وتوكل عليه وما ربك بغفل عما تعملون
ayahs.translation: And to Allāh belong the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth and to Him will be returned the matter, all of it, so worship Him and rely upon Him. And your Lord is not unaware of that which you do.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lil-laa-hi ghai-bus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di wai-lai-hi yur-jaul am-ru kul-lu-hoo fa-bu-dhu wa-ta-wak-kal a-laih wa-maa rab-bu-ka bi-ghaa-fi-lin am-maa ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: الٓرۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: الر تلك ءايت الكتب المبين
ayahs.translation: Alif, Lām, Rā. These are the verses of the clear Book.
ayahs.transliteration: a-lif-laaam-raa til-ka aayaa-tul ki-taa-bil mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَٰنًا عَرَبِيّٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: انا انزلنه قرءنا عربيا لعلكم تعقلون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naaa an-zal-naa-hu qu-raa-nan a-ra-biyyal laal-la-kum ta-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: نَحۡنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡقَصَصِ بِمَآ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ وَإِن كُنتَ مِن قَبۡلِهِۦ لَمِنَ ٱلۡغَٰفِلِينَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: نحن نقص عليك احسن القصص بما اوحينا اليك هذا القرءان وان كنت من قبله لمن الغفلين
ayahs.translation: We relate to you, [O Muḥammad], the best of stories in what We have revealed to you of this Qur’ān although you were, before it, among the unaware.
ayahs.transliteration: nah-nu na-qus-su a-lai-ka ah-sa-nal qa-sa-si bi-maaa a-whai-naaa i-lai-ka haa-zal qu-raa-na wain kun-ta min qab-lihee la-mi-nal ghaa-fileen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّي رَأَيۡتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوۡكَبٗا وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ رَأَيۡتُهُمۡ لِي سَٰجِدِينَ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: اذ قال يوسف لابيه يابت اني رايت احد عشر كوكبا والشمس والقمر رايتهم لي سجدين
ayahs.translation: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me."
ayahs.transliteration: iz qaa-la yoo-su-fu li-a-bee-hi yaaaa-ba-ti in-nee raay-tu a-ha-da a-sha-ra kaw-ka-banw was-hsham-sa wal-qa-ma-ra raay-tu-hum lee saa-jideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ لَا تَقۡصُصۡ رُءۡيَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ إِخۡوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُواْ لَكَ كَيۡدًاۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: قال يبني لا تقصص رءياك علي اخوتك فيكيدوا لك كيدا ان الشيطن للانسن عدو مبين
ayahs.translation: He said, "O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers or they will contrive against you a plan. Indeed Satan, to man, is a manifest enemy.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la yaa-bu-naiya laa taq-sus ruyaa-ka a-laaa ik-hwa-ti-ka fayakee-doo la-ka kai-daa in-nash shai-taa-na li-lin-saa-ni a-duw-wum mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَجۡتَبِيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِن تَأۡوِيلِ ٱلۡأَحَادِيثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعۡمَتَهُۥ عَلَيۡكَ وَعَلَىٰٓ ءَالِ يَعۡقُوبَ كَمَآ أَتَمَّهَا عَلَىٰٓ أَبَوَيۡكَ مِن قَبۡلُ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: وكذلك يجتبيك ربك ويعلمك من تاويل الاحاديث ويتم نعمته عليك وعلي ءال يعقوب كما اتمها علي ابويك من قبل ابرهيم واسحق ان ربك عليم حكيم
ayahs.translation: And thus will your Lord choose you and teach you the interpretation of narratives [i.e., events or dreams] and complete His favor upon you and upon the family of Jacob, as He completed it upon your fathers before, Abraham and Isaac. Indeed, your Lord is Knowing and Wise."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ka-zaa-li-ka yaj-ta-bee-ka rab-bu-ka wayu-a-lli-mu-ka min tawee-lil a-haa-dee-si wayu-tim-mu ni-ma-ta-hoo a-lai-ka waa-laaa aa-li ya-qoo-ba ka-maaa a-tam-ma-haa a-laaa a-ba-wai-ka min qab-lu ib-raa-hee-ma wai-shaaq in-na rab-ba-ka alee-mun hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ لَّقَدۡ كَانَ فِي يُوسُفَ وَإِخۡوَتِهِۦٓ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: لقد كان في يوسف واخوته ءايت للسائلين
ayahs.translation: Certainly were there in Joseph and his brothers signs for those who ask, [such as]
ayahs.transliteration: la-qad kaa-na fee yoo-su-fa waik-hwa-tiheee aayaa-tul lis-saaaileen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالُواْ لَيُوسُفُ وَأَخُوهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَبِينَا مِنَّا وَنَحۡنُ عُصۡبَةٌ إِنَّ أَبَانَا لَفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: اذ قالوا ليوسف واخوه احب الي ابينا منا ونحن عصبة ان ابانا لفي ضلل مبين
ayahs.translation: When they said, "Joseph and his brother are more beloved to our father than we, while we are a clan. Indeed, our father is in clear error.
ayahs.transliteration: iz qaa-loo layoo-su-fu waa-khoo-hu a-hab-bu i-laaa abee-naa min-naa wa-nah-nu us-ba-tun in-na a-baa-naa lafee da-laa-lim mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱقۡتُلُواْ يُوسُفَ أَوِ ٱطۡرَحُوهُ أَرۡضٗا يَخۡلُ لَكُمۡ وَجۡهُ أَبِيكُمۡ وَتَكُونُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ قَوۡمٗا صَٰلِحِينَ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: اقتلوا يوسف او اطرحوه ارضا يخل لكم وجه ابيكم وتكونوا من بعده قوما صلحين
ayahs.translation: Kill Joseph or cast him out to [another] land; the countenance [i.e., attention] of your father will [then] be only for you, and you will be after that a righteous people."
ayahs.transliteration: uq-tu-loo yoo-su-fa a-wit-ra hoo-hu ar-da-ny yak-hlu la-kum wa-jhu abee-kum wa-ta-koo-noo mim ba-dihee qaw-man saa-liheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ قَآئِلٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ لَا تَقۡتُلُواْ يُوسُفَ وَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي غَيَٰبَتِ ٱلۡجُبِّ يَلۡتَقِطۡهُ بَعۡضُ ٱلسَّيَّارَةِ إِن كُنتُمۡ فَٰعِلِينَ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: قال قائل منهم لا تقتلوا يوسف والقوه في غيبت الجب يلتقطه بعض السيارة ان كنتم فعلين
ayahs.translation: Said a speaker among them, "Do not kill Joseph but throw him into the bottom of the well; some travelers will pick him up - if you would do [something]."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-laa qaaai-lum mi-nhum laa taq-tu-loo yoo-su-fa waal-qoo-hu fee ghayaa-ba-til jub-bi yal-ta-qi-thu ba-dus saiyaa-ra-ti in kun-tum faaileen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ يَٰٓأَبَانَا مَا لَكَ لَا تَأۡمَ۬نَّا عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَنَٰصِحُونَ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا يابانا ما لك لا تامنا علي يوسف وانا له لنصحون
ayahs.translation: They said, "O our father, why do you not entrust us with Joseph while indeed, we are to him sincere counselors?
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo yaaaa-baa-naa maa la-ka laa ta-man-naa a-laa yoo-su-fa wain-naa la-hoo la-naa-si-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَرۡسِلۡهُ مَعَنَا غَدٗا يَرۡتَعۡ وَيَلۡعَبۡ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: ارسله معنا غدا يرتع ويلعب وانا له لحفظون
ayahs.translation: Send him with us tomorrow that he may eat well and play. And indeed, we will be his guardians."
ayahs.transliteration: ar-sil-lhu maa-naa gha-da-ny yar-ta waya-lab wain-naa la-hoo la-haa-fi-zoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنِّي لَيَحۡزُنُنِيٓ أَن تَذۡهَبُواْ بِهِۦ وَأَخَافُ أَن يَأۡكُلَهُ ٱلذِّئۡبُ وَأَنتُمۡ عَنۡهُ غَٰفِلُونَ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: قال اني ليحزنني ان تذهبوا به واخاف ان ياكله الذئب وانتم عنه غفلون
ayahs.translation: [Jacob] said, "Indeed, it saddens me that you should take him, and I fear that a wolf would eat him while you are of him unaware."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la in-nee layah-zu-nu-neee an ta-zha-boo bihee waa-khaa-fu a-ny ya-ku-la-huz zi-bu waan-tum a-nhu ghaa-fi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ لَئِنۡ أَكَلَهُ ٱلذِّئۡبُ وَنَحۡنُ عُصۡبَةٌ إِنَّآ إِذٗا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا لئن اكله الذئب ونحن عصبة انا اذا لخسرون
ayahs.translation: They said, "If a wolf should eat him while we are a [strong] clan, indeed, we would then be losers."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo lain a-ka-la-hu zzi-bu wa-nah-nu us-ba-tun in-naaa i-zal la-khaa-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُواْ بِهِۦ وَأَجۡمَعُوٓاْ أَن يَجۡعَلُوهُ فِي غَيَٰبَتِ ٱلۡجُبِّۚ وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِ لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُم بِأَمۡرِهِمۡ هَٰذَا وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: فلما ذهبوا به واجمعوا ان يجعلوه في غيبت الجب واوحينا اليه لتنبئنهم بامرهم هذا وهم لا يشعرون
ayahs.translation: So when they took him [out] and agreed to put him into the bottom of the well... But We inspired to him, "You will surely inform them [someday] about this affair of theirs while they do not perceive [your identity]."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa za-ha-boo bihee waaj-maooo a-ny ya-ja-loo-hu fee ghayaa-ba-til jubb waa-whai-naaa i-lai-hi la-tu-nab-bi-a-nna-hum bi-a-mri-him haa-za wa-hum laa ya-shu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَآءُوٓ أَبَاهُمۡ عِشَآءٗ يَبۡكُونَ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: وجاءو اباهم عشاء يبكون
ayahs.translation: And they came to their father at night, weeping.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaaaooo a-baa-hum i-shaaaa-ny yab-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ يَٰٓأَبَانَآ إِنَّا ذَهَبۡنَا نَسۡتَبِقُ وَتَرَكۡنَا يُوسُفَ عِندَ مَتَٰعِنَا فَأَكَلَهُ ٱلذِّئۡبُۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِمُؤۡمِنٖ لَّنَا وَلَوۡ كُنَّا صَٰدِقِينَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا يابانا انا ذهبنا نستبق وتركنا يوسف عند متعنا فاكله الذئب وما انت بمؤمن لنا ولو كنا صدقين
ayahs.translation: They said, "O our father, indeed we went racing each other and left Joseph with our possessions, and a wolf ate him. But you would not believe us, even if we were truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo yaaaa-baa-naaa in-naa za-hab-naa nas-ta-bi-qu wa-ta-rak-naa yoo-su-fa in-da ma-taai-naa faa-ka-la-huz zib wa-maaa an-ta bi-mu-mi-nil la-naa wa-law kun-naa saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَآءُو عَلَىٰ قَمِيصِهِۦ بِدَمٖ كَذِبٖۚ قَالَ بَلۡ سَوَّلَتۡ لَكُمۡ أَنفُسُكُمۡ أَمۡرٗاۖ فَصَبۡرٞ جَمِيلٞۖ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُسۡتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: وجاءو علي قميصه بدم كذب قال بل سولت لكم انفسكم امرا فصبر جميل والله المستعان علي ما تصفون
ayahs.translation: And they brought upon his shirt false blood. [Jacob] said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. And Allāh is the one sought for help against that which you describe."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaaaoo a-laa qamee-sihee bi-da-min ka-zib qaa-la bal saw-wa-lat la-kum an-fu-su-kum am-raa fa-sab-run jameel wal-laa-hul mus-taaa-nu a-laa maa ta-si-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَآءَتۡ سَيَّارَةٞ فَأَرۡسَلُواْ وَارِدَهُمۡ فَأَدۡلَىٰ دَلۡوَهُۥۖ قَالَ يَٰبُشۡرَىٰ هَٰذَا غُلَٰمٞۚ وَأَسَرُّوهُ بِضَٰعَةٗۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُونَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: وجاءت سيارة فارسلوا واردهم فادلي دلوه قال يبشري هذا غلم واسروه بضعة والله عليم بما يعملون
ayahs.translation: And there came a company of travelers; then they sent their water drawer, and he let down his bucket. He said, "Good news! Here is a boy." And they concealed him, [taking him] as merchandise; and Allāh was Knowing of what they did.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaaaat saiyaa-ra-tun faar-sa-loo waa-ri-da-hum faad-laa dal-wah qaa-la yaa-bus-hraa haa-za ghu-laam waa-sar-roo-hu bi-daaah wal-laa-hu alee-mun bi-maa ya-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَشَرَوۡهُ بِثَمَنِۭ بَخۡسٖ دَرَٰهِمَ مَعۡدُودَةٖ وَكَانُواْ فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلزَّٰهِدِينَ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: وشروه بثمن بخس درهم معدودة وكانوا فيه من الزهدين
ayahs.translation: And they sold him for a reduced price - a few dirhams - and they were, concerning him, of those content with little.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-sha-ra-whu bi-sa-ma-nim bak-hsin da-raa-hi-ma ma-doo-da-tinw wa-kaa-noo fee-hi mi-naz zaa-hideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِي ٱشۡتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصۡرَ لِٱمۡرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكۡرِمِي مَثۡوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوۡ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدٗاۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأۡوِيلِ ٱلۡأَحَادِيثِۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرِهِۦ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: وقال الذي اشتريه من مصر لامراته اكرمي مثويه عسي ان ينفعنا او نتخذه ولدا وكذلك مكنا ليوسف في الارض ولنعلمه من تاويل الاحاديث والله غالب علي امره ولكن اكثر الناس لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-lal la-zish ta-raa-hu mim mis-ra lim-raa-tiheee ak-rimee mas-waa-hu a-saaa a-ny yan-faa-naaa aw nat-ta-khi-za-hoo wa-la-daa wa-ka-zaa-li-ka mak-kan-naa liyoo-su-fa fil ar-di wa-li-nu-a-lli-ma-hoo min tawee-lil a-haadees wal-laa-hu ghaa-li-bun a-laaa am-rihee wa-laa-kin-na ak-sa-ran naa-si laa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥٓ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ حُكۡمٗا وَعِلۡمٗاۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: ولما بلغ اشده ءاتينه حكما وعلما وكذلك نجزي المحسنين
ayahs.translation: And when he [i.e., Joseph] reached maturity, We gave him judgement and knowledge. And thus We reward the doers of good.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lam-maa ba-la-gha a-shud-da-hooo aa-tai-naa-hu huk-manw wail-maa wa-ka-zaa-li-ka naj-zil muh-sineen
