ayahs.text_simple: قال له صاحبه وهو يحاوره اكفرت بالذي خلقك من تراب ثم من نطفة ثم سويك رجلا
ayahs.translation: His companion said to him while he was conversing with him, "Have you disbelieved in He who created you from dust and then from a sperm-drop and then proportioned you [as] a man?
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la la-hoo saa-hi-bu-hoo wa-hu-wa yu-haa-wi-ru-hooo a-ka-far-ta bil-lazee kha-la-qa-ka min tu-raa-bin sum-ma min nut-fa-tin sum-ma saw-waa-ka ra-ju-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّٰكِنَّا۠ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّي وَلَآ أُشۡرِكُ بِرَبِّيٓ أَحَدٗا ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: لكنا هو الله ربي ولا اشرك بربي احدا
ayahs.translation: But as for me, He is Allāh, my Lord, and I do not associate with my Lord anyone.
ayahs.transliteration: laa-ki-naa hu-wal laa-hu rab-bee wa-laa us-hri-ku bi-rab-beee a-ha-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡلَآ إِذۡ دَخَلۡتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلۡتَ مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِۚ إِن تَرَنِ أَنَا۠ أَقَلَّ مِنكَ مَالٗا وَوَلَدٗا ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: ولولا اذ دخلت جنتك قلت ما شاء الله لا قوة الا بالله ان ترن انا اقل منك مالا وولدا
ayahs.translation: And why did you, when you entered your garden, not say, 'What Allāh willed [has occurred]; there is no power except in Allāh'? Although you see me less than you in wealth and children,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law-laaa iz da-khal-ta jan-na-ta-ka qul-ta maa shaaaal laa-hu laa quw-wa-ta il-laa bil-laah in ta-ra-ni a-na a-qal-la min-ka maa-lanw wa-wa-la-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَعَسَىٰ رَبِّيٓ أَن يُؤۡتِيَنِ خَيۡرٗا مِّن جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهَا حُسۡبَانٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتُصۡبِحَ صَعِيدٗا زَلَقًا ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: فعسي ربي ان يؤتين خيرا من جنتك ويرسل عليها حسبانا من السماء فتصبح صعيدا زلقا
ayahs.translation: It may be that my Lord will give me [something] better than your garden and will send upon it a [disastrous] penalty from the sky, and it will become a smooth, dusty ground,
ayahs.transliteration: faa-saa rabeee a-ny yu-tiya-ni khai-ram min jan-na-ti-ka wayur-si-la a-lai-haa hus-baa-nam mi-nas sa-maaai fa-tus-bi-ha saee-dan za-la-qaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوۡ يُصۡبِحَ مَآؤُهَا غَوۡرٗا فَلَن تَسۡتَطِيعَ لَهُۥ طَلَبٗا ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: او يصبح ماؤها غورا فلن تستطيع له طلبا
ayahs.translation: Or its water will become sunken [into the earth], so you would never be able to seek it."
ayahs.transliteration: aw yus-bi-ha maaau-haaa ghaw-ran fa-lan tas-ta-teea la-hoo ta-la-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأُحِيطَ بِثَمَرِهِۦ فَأَصۡبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيۡهِ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَنفَقَ فِيهَا وَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أُشۡرِكۡ بِرَبِّيٓ أَحَدٗا ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: واحيط بثمره فاصبح يقلب كفيه علي ما انفق فيها وهي خاوية علي عروشها ويقول يليتني لم اشرك بربي احدا
ayahs.translation: And his fruits were encompassed [by ruin], so he began to turn his hands about [in dismay] over what he had spent on it, while it had collapsed upon its trellises, and said, "Oh, I wish I had not associated with my Lord anyone."
ayahs.transliteration: wauhee-ta bi-sa-ma-rihee faas-ba-ha yu-qal-li-bu kaf-fai-hi a-laa maaa an-fa-qa fee-haa wa-hiya khaa-wiya-tun a-laa u-roo-shi-haa waya-qoo-lu yaa-lai-tanee lam us-hrik bi-rab-beee a-ha-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَمۡ تَكُن لَّهُۥ فِئَةٞ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنتَصِرًا ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولم تكن له فئة ينصرونه من دون الله وما كان منتصرا
ayahs.translation: And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor could he defend himself.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lam ta-kul la-hoo fi-a-tu-ny yan-su-roo-na-hoo min doo-nil laa-hi wa-maa kaa-na mun-ta-si-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: هُنَالِكَ ٱلۡوَلَٰيَةُ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ هُوَ خَيۡرٞ ثَوَابٗا وَخَيۡرٌ عُقۡبٗا ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: هنالك الولية لله الحق هو خير ثوابا وخير عقبا
ayahs.translation: There the authority is [completely] for Allāh, the Truth. He is best in reward and best in outcome.
ayahs.transliteration: hu-naa-li-kal wa-laaya-tu lil-laa-hil haqq hu-wa khai-run sa-waa-banw wa-khai-run uq-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُم مَّثَلَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا كَمَآءٍ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَٱخۡتَلَطَ بِهِۦ نَبَاتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَأَصۡبَحَ هَشِيمٗا تَذۡرُوهُ ٱلرِّيَٰحُۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ مُّقۡتَدِرًا ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: واضرب لهم مثل الحيوة الدنيا كماء انزلنه من السماء فاختلط به نبات الارض فاصبح هشيما تذروه الريح وكان الله علي كل شيء مقتدرا
ayahs.translation: And present to them the example of the life of this world, [its being] like rain which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it and [then] it becomes dry remnants, scattered by the winds. And Allāh is ever, over all things, Perfect in Ability.
ayahs.transliteration: wad-rib la-hum ma-sa-lal hayaa-tid du-nyaa ka-maaain an-zal-naa-hu mi-nas sa-maaai fak-hta-la-ta bihee na-baa-tul ar-di faas-ba-ha ha-shee-man taz-roo-hur riyaah wa-kaa-nal laa-hu a-laa kul-li shaiim muq-ta-di-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلۡمَالُ وَٱلۡبَنُونَ زِينَةُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَٱلۡبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيۡرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابٗا وَخَيۡرٌ أَمَلٗا ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: المال والبنون زينة الحيوة الدنيا والبقيت الصلحت خير عند ربك ثوابا وخير املا
ayahs.translation: Wealth and children are [but] adornment of the worldly life. But the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for [one's] hope.
ayahs.transliteration: al-maa-lu wal-ba-noo-na zee-na-tul hayaa-tid du-nya wal-baa-qiyaa-tus saa-li-haa-tu khai-run in-da rab-bi-ka sa-waa-banw wa-khai-run a-ma-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَوۡمَ نُسَيِّرُ ٱلۡجِبَالَ وَتَرَى ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَارِزَةٗ وَحَشَرۡنَٰهُمۡ فَلَمۡ نُغَادِرۡ مِنۡهُمۡ أَحَدٗا ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: ويوم نسير الجبال وتري الارض بارزة وحشرنهم فلم نغادر منهم احدا
ayahs.translation: And [warn of] the Day when We will remove the mountains and you will see the earth exposed, and We will gather them and not leave behind from them anyone.
ayahs.transliteration: wayaw-ma nu-saiyi-rul ji-baa-la wa-ta-ral ar-da baa-ri-za-tanw wa-ha-shar-naa-hum fa-lam nu-ghaa-dir mi-nhum a-ha-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَعُرِضُواْ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ صَفّٗا لَّقَدۡ جِئۡتُمُونَا كَمَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةِۭۚ بَلۡ زَعَمۡتُمۡ أَلَّن نَّجۡعَلَ لَكُم مَّوۡعِدٗا ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: وعرضوا علي ربك صفا لقد جئتمونا كما خلقنكم اول مرة بل زعمتم الن نجعل لكم موعدا
ayahs.translation: And they will be presented before your Lord in rows, [and He will say], "You have certainly come to Us just as We created you the first time. But you claimed that We would never make for you an appointment."
ayahs.transliteration: wau-ri-doo a-laa rab-bi-ka saf-faa la-qad ji-tu-moo-naa ka-maa kha-laq-naa-kum a-wa-la mar-rah bal zaam-tum al-lan na-ja-la la-kum ma-wi-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَوُضِعَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ فَتَرَى ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ مُشۡفِقِينَ مِمَّا فِيهِ وَيَقُولُونَ يَٰوَيۡلَتَنَا مَالِ هَٰذَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيرَةٗ وَلَا كَبِيرَةً إِلَّآ أَحۡصَىٰهَاۚ وَوَجَدُواْ مَا عَمِلُواْ حَاضِرٗاۗ وَلَا يَظۡلِمُ رَبُّكَ أَحَدٗا ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: ووضع الكتب فتري المجرمين مشفقين مما فيه ويقولون يويلتنا مال هذا الكتب لا يغادر صغيرة ولا كبيرة الا احصيها ووجدوا ما عملوا حاضرا ولا يظلم ربك احدا
ayahs.translation: And the record [of deeds] will be placed [open], and you will see the criminals fearful of that within it, and they will say, "Oh, woe to us! What is this book that leaves nothing small or great except that it has enumerated it?" And they will find what they did present [before them]. And your Lord does injustice to no one.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-wu-di-al ki-taa-bu fa-ta-ral muj-ri-mee-na mus-hfi-qee-na mim-maa fee-hi waya-qoo-loo-na yaa-wai-la-ta-naa maa li-haa-zal ki-taa-bi laa yu-ghaa-di-ru sa-ghee-ra-tanw wa-laa kabee-ra-tan il-laaa ah-saa-haa wa-wa-ja-doo maa a-mi-loo haa-di-raa wa-laa yaz-li-mu rab-bu-ka a-ha-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسۡجُدُواْ لِأٓدَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهِۦٓۗ أَفَتَتَّخِذُونَهُۥ وَذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِي وَهُمۡ لَكُمۡ عَدُوُّۢۚ بِئۡسَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَدَلٗا ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: واذ قلنا للملئكة اسجدوا لادم فسجدوا الا ابليس كان من الجن ففسق عن امر ربه افتتخذونه وذريته اولياء من دوني وهم لكم عدو بئس للظلمين بدلا
ayahs.translation: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He was of the jinn and departed from [i.e., disobeyed] the command of his Lord. Then will you take him and his descendants as allies other than Me while they are enemies to you? Wretched it is for the wrongdoers as an exchange.
ayahs.transliteration: waiz qul-naa lil-ma-laaai-ka-tis ju-doo li-a-a-da-ma fa-sa-ja-dooo il-laaa ib-lee-sa kaa-na mi-nal jin-ni fa-fa-sa-qa an am-ri rab-bih a-fa-tat-ta-khi-zoo-na-hoo wa-zur-riya-ta-hooo aw-liyaaaa min doonee wa-hum la-kum a-duww bi-sa liz-zaa-li-mee-na ba-da-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ مَّآ أَشۡهَدتُّهُمۡ خَلۡقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا خَلۡقَ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمَا كُنتُ مُتَّخِذَ ٱلۡمُضِلِّينَ عَضُدٗا ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: ما اشهدتهم خلق السموت والارض ولا خلق انفسهم وما كنت متخذ المضلين عضدا
ayahs.translation: I did not make them witness to the creation of the heavens and the earth or to the creation of themselves, and I would not have taken the misguiders as assistants.
ayahs.transliteration: maaa as-hhat-tu-hum khal-qas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di wa-laa khal-qa an-fu-si-him wa-maa kun-tu mut-ta-khi-zal mu-dil-lee-na a-du-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَوۡمَ يَقُولُ نَادُواْ شُرَكَآءِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمۡتُمۡ فَدَعَوۡهُمۡ فَلَمۡ يَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لَهُمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَهُم مَّوۡبِقٗا ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: ويوم يقول نادوا شركاءي الذين زعمتم فدعوهم فلم يستجيبوا لهم وجعلنا بينهم موبقا
ayahs.translation: And [warn of] the Day when He will say, "Call My 'partners' whom you claimed," and they will invoke them, but they will not respond to them. And We will put between them [a valley of] destruction.
ayahs.transliteration: wayaw-ma ya-qoo-lu naa-doo shu-ra-kaaaiyal lazee-na zaam-tum fa-daa-whum fa-lam yas-ta-jee-boo la-hum wa-jaal-naa bai-na-hum maw-bi-qaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَرَءَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ ٱلنَّارَ فَظَنُّوٓاْ أَنَّهُم مُّوَاقِعُوهَا وَلَمۡ يَجِدُواْ عَنۡهَا مَصۡرِفٗا ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: ورءا المجرمون النار فظنوا انهم مواقعوها ولم يجدوا عنها مصرفا
ayahs.translation: And the criminals will see the Fire and will be certain that they are to fall therein. And they will not find from it a way elsewhere.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ra al-muj-ri-moo-nan naa-ra fa-zan-nooo an-na-hum mu-waa-qioo-haa wa-lam ya-ji-doo a-nhaa mas-ri-faa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنَا فِي هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ لِلنَّاسِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٖۚ وَكَانَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَكۡثَرَ شَيۡءٖ جَدَلٗا ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد صرفنا في هذا القرءان للناس من كل مثل وكان الانسن اكثر شيء جدلا
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly diversified in this Qur’ān for the people from every [kind of] example; but man has ever been, most of anything, [prone to] dispute.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad sar-raf-naa fee haa-zal qu-raa-ni lin-naa-si min kul-li ma-sal wa-kaa-nal in-saa-nu ak-sa-ra shaiin ja-da-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا مَنَعَ ٱلنَّاسَ أَن يُؤۡمِنُوٓاْ إِذۡ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُمۡ سُنَّةُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ أَوۡ يَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ قُبُلٗا ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: وما منع الناس ان يؤمنوا اذ جاءهم الهدي ويستغفروا ربهم الا ان تاتيهم سنة الاولين او ياتيهم العذاب قبلا
ayahs.translation: And nothing has prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them and from asking forgiveness of their Lord except that there [must] befall them the [accustomed] precedent of the former peoples or that the punishment should come [directly] before them.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa ma-naan naa-sa a-ny yu-mi-nooo iz jaaaa-hu-mul hu-daa wayas-tag-hfi-roo rab-ba-hum il-laaa an taa-tiya-hum sun-na-tul aw-wa-lee-na aw yaa-tiya-hu-mul a-zaa-bu qu-bu-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا نُرۡسِلُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَۚ وَيُجَٰدِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ لِيُدۡحِضُواْ بِهِ ٱلۡحَقَّۖ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِي وَمَآ أُنذِرُواْ هُزُوٗا ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: وما نرسل المرسلين الا مبشرين ومنذرين ويجدل الذين كفروا بالبطل ليدحضوا به الحق واتخذوا ءايتي وما انذروا هزوا
ayahs.translation: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. And those who disbelieve dispute by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth and have taken My verses, and that of which they are warned, in ridicule.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa nur-si-lul mur-sa-lee-na il-laa mu-bas-hshi-ree-na wa-mun-zireen wayu-jaa-di-lul lazee-na ka-fa-roo bil-baa-ti-li liyu-dhi-doo bi-hil haq-qa wat-ta-kha-zooo aayaa-tee wa-maaa un-zi-roo hu-zu-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ فَأَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهَا وَنَسِيَ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُۚ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفۡقَهُوهُ وَفِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرٗاۖ وَإِن تَدۡعُهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰ فَلَن يَهۡتَدُوٓاْ إِذًا أَبَدٗا ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: ومن اظلم ممن ذكر بايت ربه فاعرض عنها ونسي ما قدمت يداه انا جعلنا علي قلوبهم اكنة ان يفقهوه وفي ءاذانهم وقرا وان تدعهم الي الهدي فلن يهتدوا اذا ابدا
ayahs.translation: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord but turns away from them and forgets what his hands have put forth? Indeed, We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if you invite them to guidance - they will never be guided, then - ever.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-man az-la-mu mim-man zuk-ki-ra bi-a-yaa-ti rab-bihee faa-ra-da a-nhaa wa-na-siya maa qad-da-mat ya-daah in-naa jaal-naa a-laa qu-loo-bi-him a-kin-na-tan a-ny yaf-qa-hoo-hu wafeee aa-zaa-ni-him waq-raa wain ta-du-hum i-lal hu-daa fa-la-ny yah-ta-dooo i-zan a-ba-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَرَبُّكَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ذُو ٱلرَّحۡمَةِۖ لَوۡ يُؤَاخِذُهُم بِمَا كَسَبُواْ لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابَۚ بَل لَّهُم مَّوۡعِدٞ لَّن يَجِدُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَوۡئِلٗا ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: وربك الغفور ذو الرحمة لو يؤاخذهم بما كسبوا لعجل لهم العذاب بل لهم موعد لن يجدوا من دونه موئلا
ayahs.translation: And your Lord is the Forgiving, the possessor of mercy. If He were to impose blame upon them for what they earned, He would have hastened for them the punishment. Rather, for them is an appointment from which they will never find an escape.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-rab-bu-kal gha-foo-ru zur rah-ma-ti law yu-a-a-khi-zu-hum bi-maa ka-sa-boo laa-ja-la la-hu-mul a-zaab bal la-hum ma-wi-dul la-ny ya-ji-doo min doo-nihee ma-wi-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡقُرَىٰٓ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡ لَمَّا ظَلَمُواْ وَجَعَلۡنَا لِمَهۡلِكِهِم مَّوۡعِدٗا ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: وتلك القري اهلكنهم لما ظلموا وجعلنا لمهلكهم موعدا
ayahs.translation: And those cities - We destroyed them when they wronged, and We made for their destruction an appointed time.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-til-kal qu-raaa ah-lak-na-hum lam-maa za-la-moo wa-jaal-naa li-mah-li-ki-him ma-wi-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَىٰهُ لَآ أَبۡرَحُ حَتَّىٰٓ أَبۡلُغَ مَجۡمَعَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ أَوۡ أَمۡضِيَ حُقُبٗا ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: واذ قال موسي لفتيه لا ابرح حتي ابلغ مجمع البحرين او امضي حقبا
ayahs.translation: And [mention] when Moses said to his boy [i.e., servant], "I will not cease [traveling] until I reach the junction of the two seas or continue for a long period."
ayahs.transliteration: waiz qaa-laa moo-saa li-fa-taa-hu laaa ab-ra-hu hat-taaa ab-lu-gha maj-maal bah-ray-ni aw am-diya hu-qu-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجۡمَعَ بَيۡنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا فَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ سَرَبٗا ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: فلما بلغا مجمع بينهما نسيا حوتهما فاتخذ سبيله في البحر سربا
ayahs.translation: But when they reached the junction between them, they forgot their fish, and it took its course into the sea, slipping away.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa ba-la-ghaa maj-maa bai-ni-hi-maa na-siyaa hoo-ta-hu-maa fat-ta-kha-za sabee-la-hoo fil bah-ri sa-ra-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتَىٰهُ ءَاتِنَا غَدَآءَنَا لَقَدۡ لَقِينَا مِن سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا نَصَبٗا ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: فلما جاوزا قال لفتيه ءاتنا غداءنا لقد لقينا من سفرنا هذا نصبا
ayahs.translation: So when they had passed beyond it, [Moses] said to his boy, "Bring us our morning meal. We have certainly suffered in this, our journey, [much] fatigue."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa jaa-wa-zaa qaa-la li-fa-taa-hu aa-ti-naa gha-daaaa-naa la-qad laqee-na min sa-fa-ri-naa haa-zaa na-sa-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَرَءَيۡتَ إِذۡ أَوَيۡنَآ إِلَى ٱلصَّخۡرَةِ فَإِنِّي نَسِيتُ ٱلۡحُوتَ وَمَآ أَنسَىٰنِيهُ إِلَّا ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَنۡ أَذۡكُرَهُۥۚ وَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ عَجَبٗا ٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: قال ارءيت اذ اوينا الي الصخرة فاني نسيت الحوت وما انسينيه الا الشيطن ان اذكره واتخذ سبيله في البحر عجبا
ayahs.translation: He said, "Did you see when we retired to the rock? Indeed, I forgot [there] the fish. And none made me forget it except Satan - that I should mention it. And it took its course into the sea amazingly."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la a-raay-ta iz a-wai-naaa i-las sak-hra-ti fain-nee nasee-tul hoo-ta wa-maaa an-saa-nee-hu il-lash shai-taa-nu an az-ku-rah wat-ta-kha-za sabee-la-hoo fil bah-ri a-ja-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبۡغِۚ فَٱرۡتَدَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَارِهِمَا قَصَصٗا ٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: قال ذلك ما كنا نبغ فارتدا علي ءاثارهما قصصا
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "That is what we were seeking." So they returned, following their footprints.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la zaa-li-ka maa kun-naa nab-ghi far-tad-daa a-laa aa-saa-ri-him-maa qa-sa-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَوَجَدَا عَبۡدٗا مِّنۡ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمۡنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلۡمٗا ٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: فوجدا عبدا من عبادنا ءاتينه رحمة من عندنا وعلمنه من لدنا علما
ayahs.translation: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-wa-ja-daa ab-dam min i-baa-di-naaa aa-tai-naa-hu rah-ma-tam min in-di-naa waal-lam-naa-hu mil la-dun-naa il-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَهُۥ مُوسَىٰ هَلۡ أَتَّبِعُكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمۡتَ رُشۡدٗا ٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: قال له موسي هل اتبعك علي ان تعلمن مما علمت رشدا
ayahs.translation: Moses said to him, "May I follow you on [the condition] that you teach me from what you have been taught of sound judgement?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la la-hoo moo-saa hal at-ta-biu-ka a-laaa an tu-a-lli-ma-ni mim-maa ul-lim-ta rus-hdaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسۡتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرٗا ٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: قال انك لن تستطيع معي صبرا
ayahs.translation: He said, "Indeed, with me you will never be able to have patience.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-laa in-na-ka lan tas-ta-teea maiya sab-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَيۡفَ تَصۡبِرُ عَلَىٰ مَا لَمۡ تُحِطۡ بِهِۦ خُبۡرٗا ٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: وكيف تصبر علي ما لم تحط به خبرا
ayahs.translation: And how can you have patience for what you do not encompass in knowledge?"
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kai-fa tas-bi-ru a-laa maa lam tu-hit bihee khub-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ صَابِرٗا وَلَآ أَعۡصِي لَكَ أَمۡرٗا ٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: قال ستجدني ان شاء الله صابرا ولا اعصي لك امرا
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "You will find me, if Allāh wills, patient, and I will not disobey you in [any] order."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la sa-ta-ji-duneee in shaa al-laa-hu saa-bi-ranw wa-laaa asee la-ka am-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَإِنِ ٱتَّبَعۡتَنِي فَلَا تَسۡـَٔلۡنِي عَن شَيۡءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ أُحۡدِثَ لَكَ مِنۡهُ ذِكۡرٗا ٧٠
ayahs.text_simple: قال فان اتبعتني فلا تسلني عن شيء حتي احدث لك منه ذكرا
ayahs.translation: He said, "Then if you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I make to you about it mention [i.e., explanation]."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la fai-nit ta-ba-tanee fa-laa ta-sal-nee an shaiin hat-taaa uh-di-sa la-ka mi-nhu zik-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَكِبَا فِي ٱلسَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَاۖ قَالَ أَخَرَقۡتَهَا لِتُغۡرِقَ أَهۡلَهَا لَقَدۡ جِئۡتَ شَيۡـًٔا إِمۡرٗا ٧١
ayahs.text_simple: فانطلقا حتي اذا ركبا في السفينة خرقها قال اخرقتها لتغرق اهلها لقد جئت شيا امرا
ayahs.translation: So they set out, until when they had embarked on the ship, he [i.e., al-Khiḍr] tore it open. [Moses] said, "Have you torn it open to drown its people? You have certainly done a grave thing."
ayahs.transliteration: fan-ta-la-qaa hat-taaa i-zaa ra-ki-baa fis safee-na-ti kha-ra-qa-haa qaa-la a-kha-raq-ta-haa li-tug-hri-qa ah-la-haa la-qad ji-ta shai-an im-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَلَمۡ أَقُلۡ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسۡتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرٗا ٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: قال الم اقل انك لن تستطيع معي صبرا
ayahs.translation: [Al-Khiḍr] said, "Did I not say that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la a-lam a-qul in-na-ka lan tas-ta-teea maiya sab-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنِي بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرۡهِقۡنِي مِنۡ أَمۡرِي عُسۡرٗا ٧٣
ayahs.text_simple: قال لا تؤاخذني بما نسيت ولا ترهقني من امري عسرا
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "Do not blame me for what I forgot and do not overwhelm me in my matter with difficulty."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la laa tu-a-a-khiz-nee bi-maa nasee-tu wa-laa tu-rhiq-nee min am-ree us-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَٰمٗا فَقَتَلَهُۥ قَالَ أَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسٗا زَكِيَّةَۢ بِغَيۡرِ نَفۡسٖ لَّقَدۡ جِئۡتَ شَيۡـٔٗا نُّكۡرٗا ٧٤
ayahs.text_simple: فانطلقا حتي اذا لقيا غلما فقتله قال اقتلت نفسا زكية بغير نفس لقد جئت شيا نكرا
ayahs.translation: So they set out, until when they met a boy, he [i.e., al-Khiḍr] killed him. [Moses] said, "Have you killed a pure soul for other than [having killed] a soul? You have certainly done a deplorable thing."
ayahs.transliteration: fan-ta-la-qaa hat-taa i-zaa la-qiyaa ghu-laa-man fa-qa-ta-la-hoo qaa-la a-qa-tal-ta naf-san za-kiyya-tam bi-ghai-ri nafs la-qad ji-ta shai-an nuk-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسۡتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرٗا ٧٥
ayahs.text_simple: قال الم اقل لك انك لن تستطيع معي صبرا
ayahs.translation: [Al-Khiḍr] said, "Did I not tell you that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la a-lam a-qul la-ka in-na-ka lan tas-ta-teea maiya sab-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِن سَأَلۡتُكَ عَن شَيۡءِۭ بَعۡدَهَا فَلَا تُصَٰحِبۡنِيۖ قَدۡ بَلَغۡتَ مِن لَّدُنِّي عُذۡرٗا ٧٦
ayahs.text_simple: قال ان سالتك عن شيء بعدها فلا تصحبني قد بلغت من لدني عذرا
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "If I should ask you about anything after this, then do not keep me as a companion. You have obtained from me an excuse."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la in saal-tu-ka an shaiim ba-da-haa fa-laa tu-saa-hib-nee qad ba-lag-hta mil la-dun-nee uz-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَيَآ أَهۡلَ قَرۡيَةٍ ٱسۡتَطۡعَمَآ أَهۡلَهَا فَأَبَوۡاْ أَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارٗا يُرِيدُ أَن يَنقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُۥۖ قَالَ لَوۡ شِئۡتَ لَتَّخَذۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ أَجۡرٗا ٧٧
ayahs.text_simple: فانطلقا حتي اذا اتيا اهل قرية استطعما اهلها فابوا ان يضيفوهما فوجدا فيها جدارا يريد ان ينقض فاقامه قال لو شئت لتخذت عليه اجرا
ayahs.translation: So they set out, until when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. And they found therein a wall about to collapse, so he [i.e., al-Khiḍr] restored it. [Moses] said, "If you wished, you could have taken for it a payment."
ayahs.transliteration: fan-ta-la-qaa hat-taaa i-zaaa a-tayaaa ah-la qa-rya-ti-nis ta-ta-maaa ah-la-haa faa-baw a-ny yu-daiyi-foo-hu-maa fa-wa-ja-daa fee-haa ji-daa-ra-ny yu-ree-du a-ny yan-qad-da faa-qaa-mah qaa-la law shi-ta lat-ta-khaz-ta a-lai-hi aj-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ هَٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنِكَۚ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأۡوِيلِ مَا لَمۡ تَسۡتَطِع عَّلَيۡهِ صَبۡرًا ٧٨
ayahs.text_simple: قال هذا فراق بيني وبينك سانبئك بتاويل ما لم تستطع عليه صبرا
ayahs.translation: [Al-Khiḍr] said, "This is parting between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la haa-zaa fi-raa-qu bainee wa-bai-nik sau-na-biu-ka bi-taa-wee-li maa lam tas-ta-ti a-lai-hi sab-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمَّا ٱلسَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتۡ لِمَسَٰكِينَ يَعۡمَلُونَ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنۡ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُم مَّلِكٞ يَأۡخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصۡبٗا ٧٩
ayahs.text_simple: اما السفينة فكانت لمسكين يعملون في البحر فاردت ان اعيبها وكان وراءهم ملك ياخذ كل سفينة غصبا
ayahs.translation: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force.
ayahs.transliteration: am-mas safee-na-tu fa-kaa-nat li-ma-saa-kee-na ya-ma-loo-na fil bah-ri faa-rat-tu an aee-ba-haa wa-kaa-na wa-raaaa-hum ma-li-ku-ny yaa-khu-zu kul-la safee-na-tin ghas-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡغُلَٰمُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤۡمِنَيۡنِ فَخَشِينَآ أَن يُرۡهِقَهُمَا طُغۡيَٰنٗا وَكُفۡرٗا ٨٠
ayahs.text_simple: واما الغلم فكان ابواه مؤمنين فخشينا ان يرهقهما طغينا وكفرا
ayahs.translation: And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.
ayahs.transliteration: waaam-mal ghu-laa-mu fa-kaa-na a-ba-waa-hu mu-mi-nai-ni fa-kha-shee-naaa a-ny yu-rhi-qa-hu-maa tu-ghyaa-nanw wa-kuf-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَرَدۡنَآ أَن يُبۡدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهُ زَكَوٰةٗ وَأَقۡرَبَ رُحۡمٗا ٨١
ayahs.text_simple: فاردنا ان يبدلهما ربهما خيرا منه زكوة واقرب رحما
ayahs.translation: So we intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and nearer to mercy.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-rad-naa a-ny yub-di-la-hu-maa rab-bu-hu-maa khai-ram mi-nhu za-kaa-tanw waaq-ra-ba ruh-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَٰمَيۡنِ يَتِيمَيۡنِ فِي ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحۡتَهُۥ كَنزٞ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَٰلِحٗا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَن يَبۡلُغَآ أَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسۡتَخۡرِجَا كَنزَهُمَا رَحۡمَةٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ وَمَا فَعَلۡتُهُۥ عَنۡ أَمۡرِيۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَأۡوِيلُ مَا لَمۡ تَسۡطِع عَّلَيۡهِ صَبۡرٗا ٨٢
ayahs.text_simple: واما الجدار فكان لغلمين يتيمين في المدينة وكان تحته كنز لهما وكان ابوهما صلحا فاراد ربك ان يبلغا اشدهما ويستخرجا كنزهما رحمة من ربك وما فعلته عن امري ذلك تاويل ما لم تسطع عليه صبرا
ayahs.translation: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience."
ayahs.transliteration: waam-mal ji-daa-ru fa-kaa-na li-ghu-laa-mai-ni ya-tee-mai-ni fil madee-na-ti wa-kaa-na tah-ta-hoo kan-zul la-hu-maa wa-kaa-na a-boo-hu-maa saa-li-han faa-raa-da rab-bu-ka a-ny yab-lu-ghaaa a-shud-da-hu-maa wayas-tak-hri-jaa kan-za-hu-maa rah-ma-tam mir rab-bik wa-maa faal-tu-hoo an am-ree zaa-li-ka taawee-lu maa lam tas-ti a-lai-hi sab-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَن ذِي ٱلۡقَرۡنَيۡنِۖ قُلۡ سَأَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡكُم مِّنۡهُ ذِكۡرًا ٨٣
ayahs.text_simple: ويسلونك عن ذي القرنين قل ساتلوا عليكم منه ذكرا
ayahs.translation: And they ask you, [O Muḥammad], about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say, "I will recite to you about him a report."
ayahs.transliteration: waya-sa-loo-na-ka an zil qar-nai-ni qul saat-loo a-lai-kum mi-nhu zik-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ سَبَبٗا ٨٤
ayahs.text_simple: انا مكنا له في الارض وءاتينه من كل شيء سببا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We established him upon the earth, and We gave him from everything a way [i.e., means].
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa mak-kan-naa la-hoo fil ar-di waaa-tai-naa-hu min kul-li shaiin sa-ba-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا ٨٥
ayahs.text_simple: فاتبع سببا
ayahs.translation: So he followed a way
ayahs.transliteration: faat-baa sa-ba-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغۡرِبَ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغۡرُبُ فِي عَيۡنٍ حَمِئَةٖ وَوَجَدَ عِندَهَا قَوۡمٗاۖ قُلۡنَا يَٰذَا ٱلۡقَرۡنَيۡنِ إِمَّآ أَن تُعَذِّبَ وَإِمَّآ أَن تَتَّخِذَ فِيهِمۡ حُسۡنٗا ٨٦
ayahs.text_simple: حتي اذا بلغ مغرب الشمس وجدها تغرب في عين حمئة ووجد عندها قوما قلنا يذا القرنين اما ان تعذب واما ان تتخذ فيهم حسنا
ayahs.translation: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun [i.e., the west], he found it [as if] setting in a body of dark water, and he found near it a people. We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, either you punish [them] or else adopt among them [a way of] goodness."
ayahs.transliteration: hat-taaa i-zaa ba-la-gha mag-hri-bash sham-si wa-ja-da-haaa tag-hru-bu fee ay-nin ha-mi-a-tinw wa-wa-ja-da in-da-haa qaw-maa qul-naa yaa-zal qar-nai-ni im-maaa an tu-a-zzi-ba waim-maaa an tat-ta-khi-za fee-him hus-naa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَمَّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوۡفَ نُعَذِّبُهُۥ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ فَيُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابٗا نُّكۡرٗا ٨٧
ayahs.text_simple: قال اما من ظلم فسوف نعذبه ثم يرد الي ربه فيعذبه عذابا نكرا
ayahs.translation: He said, "As for one who wrongs, we will punish him. Then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment [i.e., Hellfire].
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la am-ma man za-la-ma fa-saw-fa nu-a-zzi-bu-hoo sum-ma yu-rad-du i-laa rab-bihee fayu-a-zzi-bu-hoo a-zaa-ban nuk-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلَهُۥ جَزَآءً ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۖ وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُۥ مِنۡ أَمۡرِنَا يُسۡرٗا ٨٨
ayahs.text_simple: واما من ءامن وعمل صلحا فله جزاء الحسني وسنقول له من امرنا يسرا
ayahs.translation: But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of the best [i.e., Paradise], and we [i.e., Dhul-Qarnayn] will speak to him from our command with ease."
ayahs.transliteration: waam-maa man aa-ma-na waa-mi-la saa-li-han fa-la-hoo ja-zaaaa-nil hus-naa wa-sa-na-qoo-lu la-hoo min am-ri-naa yus-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا ٨٩
ayahs.text_simple: ثم اتبع سببا
ayahs.translation: Then he followed a way
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma at-baa sa-ba-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطۡلِعَ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطۡلُعُ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ لَّمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُم مِّن دُونِهَا سِتۡرٗا ٩٠
ayahs.text_simple: حتي اذا بلغ مطلع الشمس وجدها تطلع علي قوم لم نجعل لهم من دونها سترا
ayahs.translation: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun [i.e., the east], he found it rising on a people for whom We had not made against it any shield.
ayahs.transliteration: hat-taaa i-zaa ba-la-gha mat-li-ash sham-si waj-da-haa tat-luu a-laa qaw-mil lam na-jal la-hum min doo-ni-haa sit-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَقَدۡ أَحَطۡنَا بِمَا لَدَيۡهِ خُبۡرٗا ٩١
ayahs.text_simple: كذلك وقد احطنا بما لديه خبرا
ayahs.translation: Thus. And We had encompassed [all] that he had in knowledge.
ayahs.transliteration: ka-zaa-li-ka wa-qad a-hat-naa bi-maa la-dai-hi khub-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا ٩٢
ayahs.text_simple: ثم اتبع سببا
ayahs.translation: Then he followed a way
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma at-baa sa-ba-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ بَيۡنَ ٱلسَّدَّيۡنِ وَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمَا قَوۡمٗا لَّا يَكَادُونَ يَفۡقَهُونَ قَوۡلٗا ٩٣
ayahs.text_simple: حتي اذا بلغ بين السدين وجد من دونهما قوما لا يكادون يفقهون قولا
ayahs.translation: Until, when he reached [a pass] between two mountains, he found beside them a people who could hardly understand [his] speech.
ayahs.transliteration: hat-taaa i-zaa ba-la-gha bai-nas sad-dai-ni wa-ja-da min doo-ni-hi-maa qaw-mal laa ya-kaa-doo-na yaf-qa-hoo-na qaw-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ يَٰذَا ٱلۡقَرۡنَيۡنِ إِنَّ يَأۡجُوجَ وَمَأۡجُوجَ مُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَهَلۡ نَجۡعَلُ لَكَ خَرۡجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجۡعَلَ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ سَدّٗا ٩٤
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا يذا القرنين ان ياجوج وماجوج مفسدون في الارض فهل نجعل لك خرجا علي ان تجعل بيننا وبينهم سدا
ayahs.translation: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo yaa-zal qar-nai-ni in-na yaa-joo-ja wa-maa-joo-ja muf-si-doo-na fil ar-di fa-hal na-ja-lu la-ka khar-jan a-laaa an ta-ja-la bai-na-naa wa-bai-na-hum sad-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّي فِيهِ رَبِّي خَيۡرٞ فَأَعِينُونِي بِقُوَّةٍ أَجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ رَدۡمًا ٩٥
ayahs.text_simple: قال ما مكني فيه ربي خير فاعينوني بقوة اجعل بينكم وبينهم ردما
ayahs.translation: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la maa mak-kan-nee fee-hi rab-bee khai-run faaee-noonee bi-quw-wa-tin a-jal bai-na-kum wa-bai-na-hum rad-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ءَاتُونِي زُبَرَ ٱلۡحَدِيدِۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا سَاوَىٰ بَيۡنَ ٱلصَّدَفَيۡنِ قَالَ ٱنفُخُواْۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَعَلَهُۥ نَارٗا قَالَ ءَاتُونِيٓ أُفۡرِغۡ عَلَيۡهِ قِطۡرٗا ٩٦
ayahs.text_simple: ءاتوني زبر الحديد حتي اذا ساوي بين الصدفين قال انفخوا حتي اذا جعله نارا قال ءاتوني افرغ عليه قطرا
ayahs.translation: Bring me bars of iron" - until, when he had leveled [them] between the two mountain walls, he said, "Blow [with bellows]," until when he had made it [like] fire, he said, "Bring me, that I may pour over it molten copper."
ayahs.transliteration: aa-toonee zu-ba-ral hadeed hat-taaa i-zaa saa-waa bai-nas sa-da-fai-ni qaa-lan fu-khoo hat-taaa i-zaa jaa-la-hoo naa-ran qaa-la aa-tooneee uf-righ a-lai-hi qit-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَا ٱسۡطَٰعُوٓاْ أَن يَظۡهَرُوهُ وَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ لَهُۥ نَقۡبٗا ٩٧
ayahs.text_simple: فما اسطعوا ان يظهروه وما استطعوا له نقبا
ayahs.translation: So they [i.e., Gog and Magog] were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-mas taaooo a-ny ya-zha-roo-hu wa-mas ta-taaoo la-hoo naq-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ هَٰذَا رَحۡمَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّيۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّي جَعَلَهُۥ دَكَّآءَۖ وَكَانَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّي حَقّٗا ٩٨
ayahs.text_simple: قال هذا رحمة من ربي فاذا جاء وعد ربي جعله دكاء وكان وعد ربي حقا
ayahs.translation: [Dhul-Qarnayn] said, "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord comes [i.e., approaches], He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la haa-za rah-ma-tum mir rab-bee fai-zaa jaaaa wa-du rab-bee jaa-la-hoo dak-kaaaa wa-kaa-na wa-du rab-bee haq-qaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَتَرَكۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَمُوجُ فِي بَعۡضٖۖ وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَجَمَعۡنَٰهُمۡ جَمۡعٗا ٩٩
ayahs.text_simple: وتركنا بعضهم يومئذ يموج في بعض ونفخ في الصور فجمعنهم جمعا
ayahs.translation: And We will leave them that day surging over each other, and [then] the Horn will be blown, and We will assemble them in [one] assembly.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-rak-naa ba-da-hum yaw-mai-zi-ny ya-moo-ju fee ba-dinw wa-nu-fi-kha fis soo-ri fa-ja-ma-naa-hum ja-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَعَرَضۡنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَرۡضًا ١٠٠
ayahs.text_simple: وعرضنا جهنم يومئذ للكفرين عرضا
ayahs.translation: And We will present Hell that Day to the disbelievers, on display -
ayahs.transliteration: waa-rad-naa ja-han-na-ma yaw-mai-zil lil-kaa-fi-ree-na ar-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ كَانَتۡ أَعۡيُنُهُمۡ فِي غِطَآءٍ عَن ذِكۡرِي وَكَانُواْ لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ سَمۡعًا ١٠١
ayahs.text_simple: الذين كانت اعينهم في غطاء عن ذكري وكانوا لا يستطيعون سمعا
ayahs.translation: Those whose eyes had been within a cover [removed] from My remembrance, and they were not able to hear.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na kaa-nat ayu-nu-hum fee ghi-taaain an zik-ree wa-kaa-noo laa yas-ta-tee-o-o-na sa-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَحَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَن يَتَّخِذُواْ عِبَادِي مِن دُونِيٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَۚ إِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ نُزُلٗا ١٠٢
ayahs.text_simple: افحسب الذين كفروا ان يتخذوا عبادي من دوني اولياء انا اعتدنا جهنم للكفرين نزلا
ayahs.translation: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-ha-si-bal lazee-na ka-fa-rooo a-ny yat-ta-khi-zoo i-baadee min dooneee aw-liyaaa in-naaa a-tad-naa ja-han-na-ma lil-kaa-fi-ree-na nu-zu-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ هَلۡ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِٱلۡأَخۡسَرِينَ أَعۡمَٰلًا ١٠٣
ayahs.text_simple: قل هل ننبئكم بالاخسرين اعملا
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?
ayahs.transliteration: qul hal nu-nab-biu-kum bi-lak-hsa-ree-na a-maa-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعۡيُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَهُمۡ يَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمۡ يُحۡسِنُونَ صُنۡعًا ١٠٤
ayahs.text_simple: الذين ضل سعيهم في الحيوة الدنيا وهم يحسبون انهم يحسنون صنعا
ayahs.translation: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na dal-la sayu-hum fil hayaa-tid du-nyaa wa-hum yah-sa-boo-na an-na-hum yuh-si-noo-na su-naa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلِقَآئِهِۦ فَحَبِطَتۡ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَزۡنٗا ١٠٥
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك الذين كفروا بايت ربهم ولقائه فحبطت اعملهم فلا نقيم لهم يوم القيمة وزنا
ayahs.translation: Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any weight [i.e., importance].
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-kal lazee-na ka-fa-roo bi-a-ayaa-ti rab-bi-him wa-li-qaaaihee fa-ha-bi-tat a-maa-lu-hum fa-laa nuqee-mu la-hum yaw-mal qiyaa-ma-ti waz-naa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُواْ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِي وَرُسُلِي هُزُوًا ١٠٦
ayahs.text_simple: ذلك جزاؤهم جهنم بما كفروا واتخذوا ءايتي ورسلي هزوا
ayahs.translation: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.
ayahs.transliteration: zaa-li-ka ja-zaaau-hum ja-han-na-mu bi-maa ka-fa-roo wat-ta-kha-zooo aayaa-tee wa-ru-sulee hu-zu-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَانَتۡ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلۡفِرۡدَوۡسِ نُزُلًا ١٠٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت كانت لهم جنت الفردوس نزلا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging,
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti kaa-nat la-hum jan-naa-tul fir-daw-si nu-zu-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبۡغُونَ عَنۡهَا حِوَلٗا ١٠٨
ayahs.text_simple: خلدين فيها لا يبغون عنها حولا
ayahs.translation: Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.
ayahs.transliteration: khaa-li-dee-na fee-ha laa yab-ghoo-na a-nhaa hi-wa-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُل لَّوۡ كَانَ ٱلۡبَحۡرُ مِدَادٗا لِّكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّي لَنَفِدَ ٱلۡبَحۡرُ قَبۡلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَٰتُ رَبِّي وَلَوۡ جِئۡنَا بِمِثۡلِهِۦ مَدَدٗا ١٠٩
ayahs.text_simple: قل لو كان البحر مدادا لكلمت ربي لنفد البحر قبل ان تنفد كلمت ربي ولو جئنا بمثله مددا
ayahs.translation: Say, "If the sea were ink for [writing] the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it in [continual] supplement."
ayahs.transliteration: qul law kaa-nal bah-ru mi-daa-dal li-ka-li-maa-ti rab-bee la-na-fi-dal bah-ru qab-la an tan-fa-da ka-li-maa-tu rab-bee wa-law ji-naa bi-mis-lihee ma-da-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلۡيَعۡمَلۡ عَمَلٗا صَٰلِحٗا وَلَا يُشۡرِكۡ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدَۢا ١١٠
ayahs.text_simple: قل انما انا بشر مثلكم يوحي الي انما الهكم اله وحد فمن كان يرجوا لقاء ربه فليعمل عملا صلحا ولا يشرك بعبادة ربه احدا
ayahs.translation: Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."
ayahs.transliteration: qul in-na-maaa a-na ba-sha-rum mis-lu-kum yoo-haaa i-laiya an-na-maa i-laa-hu-kum i-laa-hunw waa-hid fa-man kaa-na yar-joo li-qaaaa rab-bihee fa-lya-mal a-ma-lan saa-li-hanw wa-laa yus-hrik bii-baa-da-ti rab-biheee a-ha-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: كٓهيعٓصٓ ١
ayahs.text_simple: كهيعص
ayahs.translation: Kāf, Hā, Yā, ʿAyn, Ṣād.
ayahs.transliteration: kaaa-fhaayaaayyyn-saaad

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذِكۡرُ رَحۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبۡدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: ذكر رحمت ربك عبده زكريا
ayahs.translation: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
ayahs.transliteration: zik-ru rah-ma-ti rab-bi-ka ab-da-hoo za-ka-riyya

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيّٗا ٣
ayahs.text_simple: اذ نادي ربه نداء خفيا
ayahs.translation: When he called to his Lord a private call [i.e., supplication].
ayahs.transliteration: iz naa-daa rab-ba-hoo ni-daaaan kha-fiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَهَنَ ٱلۡعَظۡمُ مِنِّي وَٱشۡتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأۡسُ شَيۡبٗا وَلَمۡ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيّٗا ٤
ayahs.text_simple: قال رب اني وهن العظم مني واشتعل الراس شيبا ولم اكن بدعائك رب شقيا
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy [i.e., disappointed].
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-bi in-nee wa-ha-nal az-mu min-nee was-htaa-lar ra-su shai-banw wa-lam a-kun bi-du-a-aai-ka rab-bi sha-qiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنِّي خِفۡتُ ٱلۡمَوَٰلِيَ مِن وَرَآءِي وَكَانَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتِي عَاقِرٗا فَهَبۡ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيّٗا ٥
ayahs.text_simple: واني خفت المولي من وراءي وكانت امراتي عاقرا فهب لي من لدنك وليا
ayahs.translation: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
ayahs.transliteration: wain-nee khif-tul ma-waa-liya minw wa-raaaee wa-kaa-nat im-raatee a-qi-ran fa-hab lee mil la-dun-ka wa-liyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَرِثُنِي وَيَرِثُ مِنۡ ءَالِ يَعۡقُوبَۖ وَٱجۡعَلۡهُ رَبِّ رَضِيّٗا ٦
ayahs.text_simple: يرثني ويرث من ءال يعقوب واجعله رب رضيا
ayahs.translation: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."
ayahs.transliteration: ya-ri-sunee waya-ri-su min aa-li ya-qoob wa-ja-lhu rab-bi ra-diyya

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ ٱسۡمُهُۥ يَحۡيَىٰ لَمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبۡلُ سَمِيّٗا ٧
ayahs.text_simple: يزكريا انا نبشرك بغلم اسمه يحيي لم نجعل له من قبل سميا
ayahs.translation: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."
ayahs.transliteration: yaa-za-ka-riyyaaa in-naa nu-bas-hshi-ru-ka bi-ghu-laa-min is-mu-hoo ya-hyaa lam na-jal la-hoo min qab-lu sa-miyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَٰمٞ وَكَانَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتِي عَاقِرٗا وَقَدۡ بَلَغۡتُ مِنَ ٱلۡكِبَرِ عِتِيّٗا ٨
ayahs.text_simple: قال رب اني يكون لي غلم وكانت امراتي عاقرا وقد بلغت من الكبر عتيا
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-bi an-naa ya-koo-nu lee ghu-laa-munw wa-kaa-nat im-raatee aa-qi-ranw wa-qad ba-lag-htu mi-nal ki-ba-ri i-tiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٞ وَقَدۡ خَلَقۡتُكَ مِن قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ تَكُ شَيۡـٔٗا ٩
ayahs.text_simple: قال كذلك قال ربك هو علي هين وقد خلقتك من قبل ولم تك شيا
ayahs.translation: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.'"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la ka-zaa-li-ka qaa-la rab-bu-ka hu-wa a-laiya haiyi-nunw wa-qad kha-laq-tu-ka min qab-lu wa-lam ta-ku shai-a-a

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَل لِّيٓ ءَايَةٗۖ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالٖ سَوِيّٗا ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: قال رب اجعل لي ءاية قال ءايتك الا تكلم الناس ثلث ليال سويا
ayahs.translation: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-bi jal leee aayah qaa-la aaya-tu-ka al-laa tu-kal-li-man naa-sa sa-laa-sa layaa-lin sa-wiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابِ فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ أَن سَبِّحُواْ بُكۡرَةٗ وَعَشِيّٗا ١١
ayahs.text_simple: فخرج علي قومه من المحراب فاوحي اليهم ان سبحوا بكرة وعشيا
ayahs.translation: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allāh] in the morning and afternoon.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kha-ra-ja a-laa qaw-mihee mi-nal mih-raa-bi faa-whaaa i-lai-him an sab-bi-hoo buk-ra-tanw waa-shiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰيَحۡيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٖۖ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحُكۡمَ صَبِيّٗا ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: ييحيي خذ الكتب بقوة وءاتينه الحكم صبيا
ayahs.translation: [Allāh said], "O John, take the Scripture [i.e., adhere to it] with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
ayahs.transliteration: yaaya-hyaa khu-zil ki-taa-ba bi-quw-wa-tinw waaa-tai-naa-hul huk-ma sa-biyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَحَنَانٗا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةٗۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيّٗا ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: وحنانا من لدنا وزكوة وكان تقيا
ayahs.translation: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allāh
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ha-naa-nam mil la-dun-naa wa-za-kaa-tanw wa-kaa-na ta-qiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَبَرَّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ وَلَمۡ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيّٗا ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: وبرا بولديه ولم يكن جبارا عصيا
ayahs.translation: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-bar-ram bi-waa-li-day-hi wa-lam ya-kum jab-baa-ran a-siyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡهِ يَوۡمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوۡمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوۡمَ يُبۡعَثُ حَيّٗا ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: وسلم عليه يوم ولد ويوم يموت ويوم يبعث حيا
ayahs.translation: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-sa-laa-mun a-lai-hi yaw-ma wu-li-da wayaw-ma ya-moo-tu wayaw-ma yu-ba-su haiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مَرۡيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتۡ مِنۡ أَهۡلِهَا مَكَانٗا شَرۡقِيّٗا ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: واذكر في الكتب مريم اذ انتبذت من اهلها مكانا شرقيا
ayahs.translation: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.
ayahs.transliteration: waz-kur fil ki-taa-bi ma-ry-ma i-zin ta-ba-zat min ah-li-haa ma-kaa-nan shar-qiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱتَّخَذَتۡ مِن دُونِهِمۡ حِجَابٗا فَأَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرٗا سَوِيّٗا ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: فاتخذت من دونهم حجابا فارسلنا اليها روحنا فتمثل لها بشرا سويا
ayahs.translation: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel [i.e., Gabriel], and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
ayahs.transliteration: fat-ta-kha-zat min doo-ni-him hi-jaa-ban faar-sal-naaa i-lai-haa roo-ha-naa fa-ta-mas-sa-la la-haa ba-sha-ran sa-wiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَتۡ إِنِّيٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيّٗا ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: قالت اني اعوذ بالرحمن منك ان كنت تقيا
ayahs.translation: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allāh."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-lat in-neee aoo-zu bir-rah-maa-ni min-ka in kun-ta ta-qiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمٗا زَكِيّٗا ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: قال انما انا رسول ربك لاهب لك غلما زكيا
ayahs.translation: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy [i.e., son]."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la in-na-maa a-na ra-soo-lu rab-bi-ki li-a-ha-ba la-ki ghu-laa-man za-kiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَتۡ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَٰمٞ وَلَمۡ يَمۡسَسۡنِي بَشَرٞ وَلَمۡ أَكُ بَغِيّٗا ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: قالت اني يكون لي غلم ولم يمسسني بشر ولم اك بغيا
ayahs.translation: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-lat an-na ya-koo-nu lee ghu-laa-munw wa-lam yam-sas-nee bas-hrunw wa-lam a-ku ba-ghiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٞۖ وَلِنَجۡعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةٗ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّاۚ وَكَانَ أَمۡرٗا مَّقۡضِيّٗا ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: قال كذلك قال ربك هو علي هين ولنجعله ءاية للناس ورحمة منا وكان امرا مقضيا
ayahs.translation: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.'"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la ka-zaa-li-ki qaa-la rab-bu-ki hu-wa a-laiya haiyi-munw wa-li-na-ja-la-hooo aaya-tal lin-naa-si wa-rah-ma-tam min-naa wa-kaa-na am-ram maq-diyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ فَحَمَلَتۡهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتۡ بِهِۦ مَكَانٗا قَصِيّٗا ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: فحملته فانتبذت به مكانا قصيا
ayahs.translation: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ha-ma-la-thu fan-ta-ba-zat bihee ma-kaa-nan qa-siyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلۡمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذۡعِ ٱلنَّخۡلَةِ قَالَتۡ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي مِتُّ قَبۡلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسۡيٗا مَّنسِيّٗا ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: فاجاءها المخاض الي جذع النخلة قالت يليتني مت قبل هذا وكنت نسيا منسيا
ayahs.translation: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."
ayahs.transliteration: faa-jaaaa-hal ma-khaa-du i-laa ji-zin nak-hla-ti qaa-lat yaa-lai-tanee mit-tu qab-la haa-zaa wa-kun-tu na-syam man-siyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحۡتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحۡزَنِي قَدۡ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحۡتَكِ سَرِيّٗا ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: فناديها من تحتها الا تحزني قد جعل ربك تحتك سريا
ayahs.translation: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-naa-daa-haa min tah-ti-haaa al-laa tah-zanee qad jaa-la rab-bu-ki tah-ta-ki sa-riyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُزِّيٓ إِلَيۡكِ بِجِذۡعِ ٱلنَّخۡلَةِ تُسَٰقِطۡ عَلَيۡكِ رُطَبٗا جَنِيّٗا ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: وهزي اليك بجذع النخلة تسقط عليك رطبا جنيا
ayahs.translation: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-huz-zeee i-lai-ki bi-ji-zin nak-hla-ti tu-saa-qit a-lai-ki ru-ta-ban ja-niyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكُلِي وَٱشۡرَبِي وَقَرِّي عَيۡنٗاۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡبَشَرِ أَحَدٗا فَقُولِيٓ إِنِّي نَذَرۡتُ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ صَوۡمٗا فَلَنۡ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ إِنسِيّٗا ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: فكلي واشربي وقري عينا فاما ترين من البشر احدا فقولي اني نذرت للرحمن صوما فلن اكلم اليوم انسيا
ayahs.translation: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.'"
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kulee was-hra-bee wa-qar-ree ai-naa faim-maa ta-rayin-nna mi-nal ba-sha-ri a-ha-dan fa-qooleee in-nee na-zar-tu lir-rah-maa-ni saw-man fa-lan u-kal-li-mal yaw-ma in-siyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَتَتۡ بِهِۦ قَوۡمَهَا تَحۡمِلُهُۥۖ قَالُواْ يَٰمَرۡيَمُ لَقَدۡ جِئۡتِ شَيۡـٔٗا فَرِيّٗا ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: فاتت به قومها تحمله قالوا يمريم لقد جئت شيا فريا
ayahs.translation: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-tat bihee qaw-ma-haa tah-mi-lu-hoo qaa-loo yaa-ma-rya-moo la-qad ji-ti shai-an fa-riyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأُخۡتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمۡرَأَ سَوۡءٖ وَمَا كَانَتۡ أُمُّكِ بَغِيّٗا ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: ياخت هرون ما كان ابوك امرا سوء وما كانت امك بغيا
ayahs.translation: O sister [i.e., descendant] of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."
ayahs.transliteration: yaaauk-hta haa-roo-na maa kaa-na a-book im-raa sa-winw wa-maa kaa-nat um-mu-ki ba-ghiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَشَارَتۡ إِلَيۡهِۖ قَالُواْ كَيۡفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِي ٱلۡمَهۡدِ صَبِيّٗا ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: فاشارت اليه قالوا كيف نكلم من كان في المهد صبيا
ayahs.translation: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"
ayahs.transliteration: faa-shaa-rat i-laih qaa-loo kai-fa nu-kal-li-mu man kaa-na fil mah-di sa-biyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنِّي عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِيَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِي نَبِيّٗا ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: قال اني عبد الله ءاتيني الكتب وجعلني نبيا
ayahs.translation: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allāh. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la in-nee ab-dul laa-hi aa-taa-niyal ki-taa-ba wa-jaa-lanee na-biyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلَنِي مُبَارَكًا أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوۡصَٰنِي بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمۡتُ حَيّٗا ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: وجعلني مباركا اين ما كنت واوصني بالصلوة والزكوة ما دمت حيا
ayahs.translation: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakāh as long as I remain alive
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaa-lanee mu-baa-ra-kan ai-na maa kun-tu waaw-saanee bis-sa-laa-ti waz-za-kaa-ti maa dum-tu haiyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَبَرَّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِي وَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡنِي جَبَّارٗا شَقِيّٗا ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: وبرا بولدتي ولم يجعلني جبارا شقيا
ayahs.translation: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-bar-ram bi-waa-li-datee wa-lam ya-jal-nee jab-baa-ran sha-qiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَيَّ يَوۡمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوۡمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوۡمَ أُبۡعَثُ حَيّٗا ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: والسلم علي يوم ولدت ويوم اموت ويوم ابعث حيا
ayahs.translation: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."
ayahs.transliteration: was-sa-laa-mu a-laiya yaw-ma wu-lid-tu wayaw-ma a-moo-tu wayaw-ma u-ba-su haiyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَۖ قَوۡلَ ٱلۡحَقِّ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يَمۡتَرُونَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: ذلك عيسي ابن مريم قول الحق الذي فيه يمترون
ayahs.translation: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.
ayahs.transliteration: zaa-li-ka ee-sab nu ma-rya-ma qaw-lal haq-qil lazee fee-hi yam-ta-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٖۖ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥٓۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: ما كان لله ان يتخذ من ولد سبحنه اذا قضي امرا فانما يقول له كن فيكون
ayahs.translation: It is not [befitting] for Allāh to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
ayahs.transliteration: maa kaa-na lil-laa-hi ai yat-ta-khi-za minw wa-la-din su-bhaa-nah i-zaa qa-daaa am-ran fain-na-maa ya-qoo-lu la-hoo kun faya-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: وان الله ربي وربكم فاعبدوه هذا صرط مستقيم
ayahs.translation: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."
ayahs.transliteration: wain-nal laa-ha rab-bee wa-rab-bu-kum fa-bu-dooh haa-zaa si-raa-tum mus-taqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱخۡتَلَفَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡۖ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن مَّشۡهَدِ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٍ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: فاختلف الاحزاب من بينهم فويل للذين كفروا من مشهد يوم عظيم
ayahs.translation: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
ayahs.transliteration: fak-hta-la-fal ah-zaa-bu min bai-ni-him fa-wai-lul lil-la-zee-na ka-fa-roo min mas-hha-di yaw-min azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَسۡمِعۡ بِهِمۡ وَأَبۡصِرۡ يَوۡمَ يَأۡتُونَنَا لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: اسمع بهم وابصر يوم ياتوننا لكن الظلمون اليوم في ضلل مبين
ayahs.translation: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.
ayahs.transliteration: as-mi bi-him waab-sir yaw-ma ya-too-na-naa laa-ki-niz zaa-li-moo-nal yaw-ma fee da-laa-lin mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحَسۡرَةِ إِذۡ قُضِيَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ وَهُمۡ فِي غَفۡلَةٖ وَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: وانذرهم يوم الحسرة اذ قضي الامر وهم في غفلة وهم لا يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: And warn them, [O Muḥammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.
ayahs.transliteration: waan-zi-rhum yaw-mal has-ra-ti iz qu-diyal amr wa-hum fee ghaf-la-tinw wa-hum laa yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَرِثُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا وَإِلَيۡنَا يُرۡجَعُونَ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: انا نحن نرث الارض ومن عليها والينا يرجعون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa nah-nu na-ri-sul ar-da wa-man a-lai-haa wai-lai-naa yur-jaoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقٗا نَّبِيًّا ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: واذكر في الكتب ابرهيم انه كان صديقا نبيا
ayahs.translation: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
ayahs.transliteration: waz-kur fil ki-taa-bi ib-raaheem in-na-hoo kaa-na sid-dee-qan na-biyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعۡبُدُ مَا لَا يَسۡمَعُ وَلَا يُبۡصِرُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي عَنكَ شَيۡـٔٗا ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: اذ قال لابيه يابت لم تعبد ما لا يسمع ولا يبصر ولا يغني عنك شيا
ayahs.translation: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?
ayahs.transliteration: iz qaa-la li-a-bee-hi yaaaa-ba-ti li-ma ta-bu-du maa laa yas-mau wa-laa yub-si-ru wa-laa yug-hnee an-ka shai-a-a

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّي قَدۡ جَآءَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ مَا لَمۡ يَأۡتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعۡنِيٓ أَهۡدِكَ صِرَٰطٗا سَوِيّٗا ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: يابت اني قد جاءني من العلم ما لم ياتك فاتبعني اهدك صرطا سويا
ayahs.translation: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaa-ba-ti in-nee qad jaaaanee mi-nal il-mi maa lam ya-ti-ka fat-ta-bineee ah-di-ka si-raa-tan sa-wiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعۡبُدِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَصِيّٗا ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: يابت لا تعبد الشيطن ان الشيطن كان للرحمن عصيا
ayahs.translation: O my father, do not worship [i.e., obey] Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaa-ba-ti laa ta-bu-dish shai-taan in-nash shai-taa-na kaa-na lir-rah-maa-ni a-siyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٞ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيۡطَٰنِ وَلِيّٗا ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: يابت اني اخاف ان يمسك عذاب من الرحمن فتكون للشيطن وليا
ayahs.translation: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaa-ba-ti in-nee a-khaa-fu ai ya-mas-sa-ka a-zaa-bum mi-nar rah-maa-ni fa-ta-koo-na lis-hshai-taa-ni wa-liyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنۡ ءَالِهَتِي يَٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ لَأَرۡجُمَنَّكَۖ وَٱهۡجُرۡنِي مَلِيّٗا ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: قال اراغب انت عن ءالهتي يابرهيم لئن لم تنته لارجمنك واهجرني مليا
ayahs.translation: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la a-raa-ghi-bun an-ta an aa-li-hatee yaaaib-raa-hee-mu lail lam tan-ta-hi laar-ju-man-na-ka wah-jur-nee ma-liyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكَۖ سَأَسۡتَغۡفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّيٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِي حَفِيّٗا ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: قال سلم عليك ساستغفر لك ربي انه كان بي حفيا
ayahs.translation: [Abraham] said, "Peace [i.e., safety] will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la sa-laa-mun a-lai-ka saas-tag-hfi-ru la-ka rab-beee in-na-hoo kaa-na bee ha-fiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَعۡتَزِلُكُمۡ وَمَا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّي شَقِيّٗا ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: واعتزلكم وما تدعون من دون الله وادعوا ربي عسي الا اكون بدعاء ربي شقيا
ayahs.translation: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allāh and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy [i.e., disappointed]."
ayahs.transliteration: waa-ta-zi-lu-kum wa-maa ta-doo-na min doo-nil laa-hi waa-doo rab-bee a-saaa al-laaa a-koo-na bi-du-a-aai rab-bee sha-qiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا ٱعۡتَزَلَهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَۖ وَكُلّٗا جَعَلۡنَا نَبِيّٗا ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: فلما اعتزلهم وما يعبدون من دون الله وهبنا له اسحق ويعقوب وكلا جعلنا نبيا
ayahs.translation: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allāh, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam ma-ta-za-la-hum wa-maa ya-bu-doo-na min doo-nil laa-hi wa-hab-naa la-hoo i-shaa-qa waya-qoob wa-kul-lan jaal-naa na-biyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحۡمَتِنَا وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ عَلِيّٗا ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: ووهبنا لهم من رحمتنا وجعلنا لهم لسان صدق عليا
ayahs.translation: And We gave them of Our mercy, and We made for them a mention [i.e., reputation] of high honor.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-wa-hab-naa la-hum mir rah-ma-ti-naa wa-jaal-naa la-hum li-saa-na sid-qin a-liyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخۡلَصٗا وَكَانَ رَسُولٗا نَّبِيّٗا ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: واذكر في الكتب موسي انه كان مخلصا وكان رسولا نبيا
ayahs.translation: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
ayahs.transliteration: waz-kur fil ki-taa-bi moo-saaa in-na-hoo kaa-na muk-hla-sanw wa-kaa-na ra-soo-lan na-biyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَٰدَيۡنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلۡأَيۡمَنِ وَقَرَّبۡنَٰهُ نَجِيّٗا ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: وندينه من جانب الطور الايمن وقربنه نجيا
ayahs.translation: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-naa-dai-naa-hu min jaa-ni-bit too-ril ai-ma-ni wa-qar-rab-naa-hu na-jiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحۡمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيّٗا ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: ووهبنا له من رحمتنا اخاه هرون نبيا
ayahs.translation: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-wa-hab-naa la-hoo mir rah-ma-ti-naaa a-khaa-hu haa-roo-na na-biyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلۡوَعۡدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولٗا نَّبِيّٗا ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: واذكر في الكتب اسمعيل انه كان صادق الوعد وكان رسولا نبيا
ayahs.translation: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
ayahs.transliteration: waz-kur fil ki-taa-bi is-maaeel in-na-hoo kaa-na saa-di-qal wa-di wa-kaa-na ra-soo-lan na-biyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَانَ يَأۡمُرُ أَهۡلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرۡضِيّٗا ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: وكان يامر اهله بالصلوة والزكوة وكان عند ربه مرضيا
ayahs.translation: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakāh and was to his Lord pleasing [i.e., accepted by Him].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kaa-na ya-mu-ru ah-la-hoo bis-sa-laa-ti waz-za-kaa-ti wa-kaa-na in-da rab-bihee mar-diyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِدۡرِيسَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقٗا نَّبِيّٗا ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: واذكر في الكتب ادريس انه كان صديقا نبيا
ayahs.translation: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
ayahs.transliteration: waz-kur fil ki-taa-bi id-rees in-na-hoo kaa-na sid-dee-qan na-biyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَرَفَعۡنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: ورفعنه مكانا عليا
ayahs.translation: And We raised him to a high station.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ra-fa-naa-hu ma-kaa-nan a-liyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنۡ حَمَلۡنَا مَعَ نُوحٖ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنۡ هَدَيۡنَا وَٱجۡتَبَيۡنَآۚ إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ خَرُّواْۤ سُجَّدٗاۤ وَبُكِيّٗا۩ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك الذين انعم الله عليهم من النبين من ذرية ءادم وممن حملنا مع نوح ومن ذرية ابرهيم واسرءيل وممن هدينا واجتبينا اذا تتلي عليهم ءايت الرحمن خروا سجدا وبكيا
ayahs.translation: Those were the ones upon whom Allāh bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-kal lazee-na a-na-mal laa-hu a-lai-him mi-nan na-biyyee-na min zur-riyya-ti aa-da-ma wa-mim-man ha-mal-naa maa noo-hinw wa-min zur-riyya-ti ib-raa-hee-ma wais-raaaee-la wa-mim-man ha-dai-naa waj-ta-bai-naaa i-zaa tut-laa a-lai-him aayaa-tur rah-maa-ni khar-roo suj-ja-danw wa-bu-kiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ خَلۡفٌ أَضَاعُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَلۡقَوۡنَ غَيًّا ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: فخلف من بعدهم خلف اضاعوا الصلوة واتبعوا الشهوت فسوف يلقون غيا
ayahs.translation: But there came after them successors [i.e., later generations] who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kha-la-fa min ba-di-him khal-fun a-daaus sa-laa-ta wat-ta-baush sha-ha-waa-ti fa-saw-fa yal-qaw-na ghaiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُونَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظۡلَمُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: الا من تاب وءامن وعمل صلحا فاولئك يدخلون الجنة ولا يظلمون شيا
ayahs.translation: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa man taa-ba waaa-ma-na waa-mi-la saa-li-han fau-laaai-ka yad-khu-loo-nal jan-na-ta wa-laa yuz-la-moo-na shai-a-a

ayahs.text_uthmani: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَأۡتِيّٗا ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: جنت عدن التي وعد الرحمن عباده بالغيب انه كان وعده ماتيا
ayahs.translation: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been eminent.
ayahs.transliteration: jan-naa-ti ad-ni-nil latee waa-dar rah-maa-nu i-baa-da-hoo bil-ghaib in-na-hoo kaa-na wa-du-hoo ma-tiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ رِزۡقُهُمۡ فِيهَا بُكۡرَةٗ وَعَشِيّٗا ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا الا سلما ولهم رزقهم فيها بكرة وعشيا
ayahs.translation: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.
ayahs.transliteration: laa yas-maoo-na fee-haa lag-hwan il-laa sa-laa-maa wa-la-hum riz-qu-hum fee-haa buk-ra-tanw waa-shiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: تِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِي نُورِثُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيّٗا ٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: تلك الجنة التي نورث من عبادنا من كان تقيا
ayahs.translation: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allāh.
ayahs.transliteration: til-kal jan-na-tul latee noo-ri-su min i-baa-di-naa man kaa-na ta-qiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمۡرِ رَبِّكَۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِينَا وَمَا خَلۡفَنَا وَمَا بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيّٗا ٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: وما نتنزل الا بامر ربك له ما بين ايدينا وما خلفنا وما بين ذلك وما كان ربك نسيا
ayahs.translation: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa na-ta-naz-za-lu il-laa bi-a-mri rab-bi-ka la-hoo maa bai-na ai-dee-naa wa-maa khal-fa-naa wa-maa bai-na zaa-lik wa-maa kaa-na rab-bu-ka na-siyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فَٱعۡبُدۡهُ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦۚ هَلۡ تَعۡلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيّٗا ٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: رب السموت والارض وما بينهما فاعبده واصطبر لعبدته هل تعلم له سميا
ayahs.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"
ayahs.transliteration: rab-bus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di wa-maa bai-na-hu-maa fa-bu-dhu was-ta-bir lii-baa-da-tih hal ta-la-mu la-hoo sa-miyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوۡفَ أُخۡرَجُ حَيًّا ٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: ويقول الانسن اءذا ما مت لسوف اخرج حيا
ayahs.translation: And man [i.e., the disbeliever] says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"
ayahs.transliteration: waya-qoo-lul in-saa-nu ai-zaa maa mit-tu la-saw-fa uk-hra-ju haiyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَلَا يَذۡكُرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ يَكُ شَيۡـٔٗا ٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: اولا يذكر الانسن انا خلقنه من قبل ولم يك شيا
ayahs.translation: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-laa yaz-ku-rul in-saa-nu an-naa kha-laq-naa-hu min qab-lu wa-lam ya-ku shai-a-a

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحۡشُرَنَّهُمۡ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحۡضِرَنَّهُمۡ حَوۡلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيّٗا ٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: فوربك لنحشرنهم والشيطين ثم لنحضرنهم حول جهنم جثيا
ayahs.translation: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-wa-rab-bi-ka la-nah-shu-ran-na-hum was-hshayaa-tee-na sum-ma la-nuh-di-ran-na-hum haw-la ja-han-na-ma ji-siyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمۡ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عِتِيّٗا ٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: ثم لننزعن من كل شيعة ايهم اشد علي الرحمن عتيا
ayahs.translation: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma la-nan-zi-a-nna min kul-li sheea-tin aiyu-hum a-shad-du a-lar rah-maa-ni i-tiyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَنَحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ أَوۡلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيّٗا ٧٠
ayahs.text_simple: ثم لنحن اعلم بالذين هم اولي بها صليا
ayahs.translation: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma la-nah-nu a-la-mu bil-la-zee-na hum aw-laa bi-haa si-liyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِن مِّنكُمۡ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَاۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتۡمٗا مَّقۡضِيّٗا ٧١
ayahs.text_simple: وان منكم الا واردها كان علي ربك حتما مقضيا
ayahs.translation: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.
ayahs.transliteration: wain min-kum il-laa waa-ri-du-haa kaa-na a-laa rab-bi-ka hat-mam maq-diyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَواْ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيّٗا ٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: ثم ننجي الذين اتقوا ونذر الظلمين فيها جثيا
ayahs.translation: Then We will save those who feared Allāh and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma nu-naj-jil lazee-nat ta-qaw wa-na-za-ruz zaa-li-mee-na fee-haa ji-siyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَيُّ ٱلۡفَرِيقَيۡنِ خَيۡرٞ مَّقَامٗا وَأَحۡسَنُ نَدِيّٗا ٧٣
ayahs.text_simple: واذا تتلي عليهم ءايتنا بينت قال الذين كفروا للذين ءامنوا اي الفريقين خير مقاما واحسن نديا
ayahs.translation: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa tut-laa a-lai-him aayaa-tu-naa baiyi-naa-tin qaa-lal lazee-na ka-fa-roo lil-la-zee-na aa-ma-nooo aiyul faree-qai-ni khai-rum ma-qaa-manw waah-sa-nu na-diyyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ أَثَٰثٗا وَرِءۡيٗا ٧٤
ayahs.text_simple: وكم اهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هم احسن اثثا ورءيا
ayahs.translation: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kam ah-lak-naa qab-la-hum min qar-nin hum ah-sa-nu a-saa-sanw wa-riyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ مَن كَانَ فِي ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلۡيَمۡدُدۡ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مَدًّاۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ شَرّٞ مَّكَانٗا وَأَضۡعَفُ جُندٗا ٧٥
ayahs.text_simple: قل من كان في الضللة فليمدد له الرحمن مدا حتي اذا راوا ما يوعدون اما العذاب واما الساعة فسيعلمون من هو شر مكانا واضعف جندا
ayahs.translation: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."
ayahs.transliteration: qul man kaa-na fid-da laa-la-ti fa-lyam-dud la-hur rah-maa-nu mad-daa hat-taaa i-zaa raaw maa yoo-a-doo-na im-mal a-zaa-ba waim-mas saaa-ta fa-saya-la-moo-na man hu-wa shar-rum ma-kaa-nanw waa-da-fu jun-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهۡتَدَوۡاْ هُدٗىۗ وَٱلۡبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيۡرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابٗا وَخَيۡرٞ مَّرَدًّا ٧٦
ayahs.text_simple: ويزيد الله الذين اهتدوا هدي والبقيت الصلحت خير عند ربك ثوابا وخير مردا
ayahs.translation: And Allāh increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.
ayahs.transliteration: wayazee-dul laa-hul lazee-nah ta-daw hu-daa wal-baa-qiyaa-tus saa-li-haa-tu khai-run in-da rab-bi-ka sa-waa-banw wa-khai-rum ma-rad-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالٗا وَوَلَدًا ٧٧
ayahs.text_simple: افرءيت الذي كفر بايتنا وقال لاوتين مالا وولدا
ayahs.translation: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]"?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-raay-tal lazee ka-fa-ra bi-a-ayaa-ti-naa wa-qaa-la laoo-tayan-na maa-lanw wa-wa-la-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَهۡدٗا ٧٨
ayahs.text_simple: اطلع الغيب ام اتخذ عند الرحمن عهدا
ayahs.translation: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?
ayahs.transliteration: at-ta-laal ghai-ba a-mit ta-kha-za in-dar rah-maa-ni ah-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّاۚ سَنَكۡتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ مَدّٗا ٧٩
ayahs.text_simple: كلا سنكتب ما يقول ونمد له من العذاب مدا
ayahs.translation: No! We will record what he says and extend [i.e., increase] for him from the punishment extensively.
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laa sa-nak-tu-bu maa ya-qoo-lu wa-na-mud-du la-hoo mi-nal a-zaa-bi mad-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأۡتِينَا فَرۡدٗا ٨٠
ayahs.text_simple: ونرثه ما يقول وياتينا فردا
ayahs.translation: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-na-ri-su-hoo maa ya-qoo-lu wayatee-naa far-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةٗ لِّيَكُونُواْ لَهُمۡ عِزّٗا ٨١
ayahs.text_simple: واتخذوا من دون الله ءالهة ليكونوا لهم عزا
ayahs.translation: And they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.
ayahs.transliteration: wat-ta-kha-zoo min doo-nil laa-hi aa-li-ha-tal liya-koo-noo la-hum iz-zaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّاۚ سَيَكۡفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمۡ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضِدًّا ٨٢
ayahs.text_simple: كلا سيكفرون بعبادتهم ويكونون عليهم ضدا
ayahs.translation: No! They [i.e., those "gods"] will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laa sayak-fu-roo-na bii-baa-da-ti-him waya-koo-noo-na a-lai-him did-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمۡ أَزّٗا ٨٣
ayahs.text_simple: الم تر انا ارسلنا الشيطين علي الكفرين تؤزهم ازا
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them [to evil] with [constant] incitement?
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam ta-ra an-naaa ar-sal-nash shayaatee-na a-lal kaa-fi-ree-na tauz-zu-hum az-zaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمۡ عَدّٗا ٨٤
ayahs.text_simple: فلا تعجل عليهم انما نعد لهم عدا
ayahs.translation: So be not impatient over them. We only count out [i.e., allow] to them a [limited] number.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-laa ta-jal a-lai-him in-na-maa naud-du la-hum ad-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَفۡدٗا ٨٥
ayahs.text_simple: يوم نحشر المتقين الي الرحمن وفدا
ayahs.translation: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma nah-shu-rul mut-ta-qee-na i-lar rah-maa-ni waf-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرۡدٗا ٨٦
ayahs.text_simple: ونسوق المجرمين الي جهنم وردا
ayahs.translation: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
ayahs.transliteration: wa-na-soo-qul muj-ri-mee-na i-laa ja-han-na-ma wir-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا يَمۡلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَهۡدٗا ٨٧
ayahs.text_simple: لا يملكون الشفعة الا من اتخذ عند الرحمن عهدا
ayahs.translation: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.
ayahs.transliteration: laa yam-li-koo-nash sha-faaa-ta il-laa ma-nit ta-kha-za in-dar rah-maa-ni ah-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَلَدٗا ٨٨
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا اتخذ الرحمن ولدا
ayahs.translation: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-lut ta-kha-zar rah-maa-nu wa-la-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّقَدۡ جِئۡتُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِدّٗا ٨٩
ayahs.text_simple: لقد جئتم شيا ادا
ayahs.translation: You have done an atrocious thing.
ayahs.transliteration: la-qad ji-tum shai-an id-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلۡجِبَالُ هَدًّا ٩٠
ayahs.text_simple: تكاد السموت يتفطرن منه وتنشق الارض وتخر الجبال هدا
ayahs.translation: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
ayahs.transliteration: ta-kaa-dus sa-maa-waa-tu ya-ta-fat-tar-na mi-nhu wa-tan-shaq-qul ar-du wa-ta-khir-rul ji-baa-lu had-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَن دَعَوۡاْ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدٗا ٩١
ayahs.text_simple: ان دعوا للرحمن ولدا
ayahs.translation: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.
ayahs.transliteration: an daaw lir-rah-maa-ni wa-la-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا ٩٢
ayahs.text_simple: وما ينبغي للرحمن ان يتخذ ولدا
ayahs.translation: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa yam-ba-ghee lir-rah-maa-ni ai yat-ta-khi-za wa-la-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِي ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَبۡدٗا ٩٣
ayahs.text_simple: ان كل من في السموت والارض الا ءاتي الرحمن عبدا
