ayahs.translation: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.
ayahs.transliteration: in kul-lu man fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di il-laaa aa-tir rah-maa-ni ab-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّقَدۡ أَحۡصَىٰهُمۡ وَعَدَّهُمۡ عَدّٗا ٩٤
ayahs.text_simple: لقد احصيهم وعدهم عدا
ayahs.translation: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
ayahs.transliteration: la-qad ah-saa-hum waad-da-hum ad-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكُلُّهُمۡ ءَاتِيهِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فَرۡدًا ٩٥
ayahs.text_simple: وكلهم ءاتيه يوم القيمة فردا
ayahs.translation: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kul-lu-hum aa-tee-hi yaw-mal qiyaa-ma-ti far-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجۡعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وُدّٗا ٩٦
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت سيجعل لهم الرحمن ودا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti saya-ja-lu la-hu-mur rah-maa-nu wud-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوۡمٗا لُّدّٗا ٩٧
ayahs.text_simple: فانما يسرنه بلسانك لتبشر به المتقين وتنذر به قوما لدا
ayahs.translation: So, [O Muḥammad], We have only made it [i.e., the Qur’ān] easy in your tongue [i.e., the Arabic language] that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.
ayahs.transliteration: fain-na-maa yas-sar-naa-hu bi-li-saa-ni-ka li-tu-bas-hshi-ra bi-hil mut-ta-qee-na wa-tun-zi-ra bihee qaw-mal lud-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هَلۡ تُحِسُّ مِنۡهُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ أَوۡ تَسۡمَعُ لَهُمۡ رِكۡزَۢا ٩٨
ayahs.text_simple: وكم اهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هل تحس منهم من احد او تسمع لهم ركزا
ayahs.translation: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kam ah-lak-naa qab-la-hum min qar-nin hal tu-his-su mi-nhum min a-ha-din aw tas-mau la-hum rik-zaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: طه ١
ayahs.text_simple: طه
ayahs.translation: Ṭā, Hā.
ayahs.transliteration: taa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِتَشۡقَىٰٓ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: ما انزلنا عليك القرءان لتشقي
ayahs.translation: We have not sent down to you the Qur’ān that you be distressed
ayahs.transliteration: maaa an-zal-naa a-lai-kal qu-raa-na li-tas-hqaaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا تَذۡكِرَةٗ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: الا تذكرة لمن يخشي
ayahs.translation: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allāh] -
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa taz-ki-ra-tal li-ma-ny yak-hshaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَنزِيلٗا مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلۡعُلَى ٤
ayahs.text_simple: تنزيلا ممن خلق الارض والسموت العلي
ayahs.translation: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,
ayahs.transliteration: tan-zee-lam mim-man kha-la-qal ar-da was-sa-maa-waa-til u-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: الرحمن علي العرش استوي
ayahs.translation: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.
ayahs.transliteration: ar-rah-maa-nu a-lal ar-shis ta-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحۡتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: له ما في السموت وما في الارض وما بينهما وما تحت الثري
ayahs.translation: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.
ayahs.transliteration: la-hoo maa fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-maa fil ar-di wa-maa bai-na-hu-maa wa-maa tah-tas sa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِن تَجۡهَرۡ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخۡفَى ٧
ayahs.text_simple: وان تجهر بالقول فانه يعلم السر واخفي
ayahs.translation: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.
ayahs.transliteration: wain ta-jhar bil-qaw-li fain-na-hoo ya-la-mus sir-ra waak-hfaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: الله لا اله الا هو له الاسماء الحسني
ayahs.translation: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.
ayahs.transliteration: al-laa-hu laaa i-laa-ha il-laa hu-wa la-hul as-maaul hus-naa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: وهل اتيك حديث موسي
ayahs.translation: And has the story of Moses reached you? -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hal a-taa-ka hadee-su moo-sa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ رَءَا نَارٗا فَقَالَ لِأَهۡلِهِ ٱمۡكُثُوٓاْ إِنِّيٓ ءَانَسۡتُ نَارٗا لَّعَلِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنۡهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوۡ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدٗى ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: اذ رءا نارا فقال لاهله امكثوا اني ءانست نارا لعلي ءاتيكم منها بقبس او اجد علي النار هدي
ayahs.translation: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."
ayahs.transliteration: iz raaa naa-ran fa-qaa-la li-a-hli-him ku-sooo in-neee aa-nas-tu naa-ral laal-leee aa-tee-kum mi-nhaa bi-qa-ba-sin aw a-ji-du a-lan naa-ri hu-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِيَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: فلما اتيها نودي يموسي
ayahs.translation: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maaa a-taa-haa noo-diya yaa-moo-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنِّيٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخۡلَعۡ نَعۡلَيۡكَ إِنَّكَ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوٗى ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: اني انا ربك فاخلع نعليك انك بالواد المقدس طوي
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the blessed valley of Ṭuwā.
ayahs.transliteration: in-neee a-na rab-bu-ka fak-hla na-lai-ka in-na-ka bil-waa-dil mu-qad-da-si tu-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَا ٱخۡتَرۡتُكَ فَٱسۡتَمِعۡ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: وانا اخترتك فاستمع لما يوحي
ayahs.translation: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].
ayahs.transliteration: waa-na khtar-tu-ka fas-ta-mi li-maa yoo-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّنِيٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعۡبُدۡنِي وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكۡرِيٓ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: انني انا الله لا اله الا انا فاعبدني واقم الصلوة لذكري
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I am Allāh. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-neee a-nal laa-hu laaa i-laa-ha il-laa a-na fa-bud-nee waa-qi-mis sa-laa-ta li-zik-ree

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخۡفِيهَا لِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا تَسۡعَىٰ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: ان الساعة ءاتية اكاد اخفيها لتجزي كل نفس بما تسعي
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nas saaa-ta aa-tiya-tun a-kaa-du uk-hfee-haa li-tuj-zaa kul-lu naf-sin bi-maa ta-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنۡهَا مَن لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرۡدَىٰ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: فلا يصدنك عنها من لا يؤمن بها واتبع هويه فتردي
ayahs.translation: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-laa ya-sud-dan-na-ka a-nhaa mal laa yu-mi-nu bi-haa wat-ta-baa ha-waa-hu fa-tar-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا تِلۡكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: وما تلك بيمينك يموسي
ayahs.translation: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa til-ka biyamee-ni-ka yaa-moo-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَ أَتَوَكَّؤُاْ عَلَيۡهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِي وَلِيَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخۡرَىٰ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: قال هي عصاي اتوكؤا عليها واهش بها علي غنمي ولي فيها مارب اخري
ayahs.translation: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la hiya a-saaya a-ta-wak-kau a-lai-haa waa-hus-hshu bi-haa a-laa gha-namee wa-liya fee-haa maaa-ri-bu uk-hraa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَلۡقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: قال القها يموسي
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la al-qi-haa yaa-moo-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَلۡقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةٞ تَسۡعَىٰ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: فالقيها فاذا هي حية تسعي
ayahs.translation: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.
ayahs.transliteration: faal-qaa-haa fai-zaa hiya haiya-tun ta-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ خُذۡهَا وَلَا تَخَفۡۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: قال خذها ولا تخف سنعيدها سيرتها الاولي
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la khu-zhaa wa-laa ta-haf sa-nuee-du-haa see-ra-ta-hal oo-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱضۡمُمۡ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخۡرَىٰ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: واضمم يدك الي جناحك تخرج بيضاء من غير سوء ءاية اخري
ayahs.translation: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,
ayahs.transliteration: wad-mum ya-da-ka i-laa ja-naa-hi-ka tak-hruj bai-daaaa min ghai-ri soooin aaya-tan uk-hraa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلۡكُبۡرَى ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: لنريك من ءايتنا الكبري
ayahs.translation: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.
ayahs.transliteration: li-nu-riya-ka min aayaa-ti-nal kub-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: اذهب الي فرعون انه طغي
ayahs.translation: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed [i.e., tyrannized]."
ayahs.transliteration: i-zhab i-laa fi-raw-na in-na-hoo ta-ghaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: قال رب اشرح لي صدري
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand [i.e., relax] for me my breast [with assurance]
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-bish rah lee sad-ree

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: ويسر لي امري
ayahs.translation: And ease for me my task
ayahs.transliteration: wayas-sir leee am-ree

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةٗ مِّن لِّسَانِي ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: واحلل عقدة من لساني
ayahs.translation: And untie the knot from my tongue
ayahs.transliteration: wah-lul uq-da-tan mil-li saanee

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِي ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: يفقهوا قولي
ayahs.translation: That they may understand my speech.
ayahs.transliteration: yaf-qa-hoo qaw-lee

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي وَزِيرٗا مِّنۡ أَهۡلِي ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: واجعل لي وزيرا من اهلي
ayahs.translation: And appoint for me a minister [i.e., assistant] from my family -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jal lee wazee-ran min ah-lee

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰرُونَ أَخِي ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: هرون اخي
ayahs.translation: Aaron, my brother.
ayahs.transliteration: haa-roo-na a-khee

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱشۡدُدۡ بِهِۦٓ أَزۡرِي ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: اشدد به ازري
ayahs.translation: Increase through him my strength
ayahs.transliteration: us-hdud biheee az-ree

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَشۡرِكۡهُ فِيٓ أَمۡرِي ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: واشركه في امري
ayahs.translation: And let him share my task
ayahs.transliteration: waas-hri-khu feee am-ree

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَيۡ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرٗا ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: كي نسبحك كثيرا
ayahs.translation: That we may exalt You much
ayahs.transliteration: kai nu-sab-bi-ha-ka kasee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَذۡكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: ونذكرك كثيرا
ayahs.translation: And remember You much.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-naz-ku-ra-ka kasee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرٗا ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: انك كنت بنا بصيرا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-ka kun-ta bi-naa basee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ قَدۡ أُوتِيتَ سُؤۡلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: قال قد اوتيت سؤلك يموسي
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la qad oo-tee-ta su-la-ka yaa-moo-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَيۡكَ مَرَّةً أُخۡرَىٰٓ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد مننا عليك مرة اخري
ayahs.translation: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad ma-nan-naa a-lai-ka mar-ra-tan uk-hraaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: اذ اوحينا الي امك ما يوحي
ayahs.translation: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,
ayahs.transliteration: iz a-whai-naaa i-laaa um-mi-ka maa yoo-haaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ فَلۡيُلۡقِهِ ٱلۡيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأۡخُذۡهُ عَدُوّٞ لِّي وَعَدُوّٞ لَّهُۥۚ وَأَلۡقَيۡتُ عَلَيۡكَ مَحَبَّةٗ مِّنِّي وَلِتُصۡنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيۡنِيٓ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: ان اقذفيه في التابوت فاقذفيه في اليم فليلقه اليم بالساحل ياخذه عدو لي وعدو له والقيت عليك محبة مني ولتصنع علي عيني
ayahs.translation: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye [i.e., observation and care].
ayahs.transliteration: a-ni iq-zi-fee-hi fit taa-boo-ti faq-zi-fee-hi fil yam-mi fa-lyul-qi-hil yam-mu bis-saa-hi-li ya-khu-zhu a-duw-wul lee waa-duw-wul lah waal-qai-tu a-lai-ka ma-hab-ba-tan min-nee wa-li-tus-naa a-laa ai-nee

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ تَمۡشِيٓ أُخۡتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكۡفُلُهُۥۖ فَرَجَعۡنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَۚ وَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسٗا فَنَجَّيۡنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونٗاۚ فَلَبِثۡتَ سِنِينَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئۡتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٖ يَٰمُوسَىٰ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: اذ تمشي اختك فتقول هل ادلكم علي من يكفله فرجعنك الي امك كي تقر عينها ولا تحزن وقتلت نفسا فنجينك من الغم وفتنك فتونا فلبثت سنين في اهل مدين ثم جئت علي قدر يموسي
ayahs.translation: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.
ayahs.transliteration: iz tam-sheee uk-htu-ka fa-ta-qoo-lu hal a-dul-lu-kum a-laa mai yak-fu-lu-hoo fa-ra-ja-naa-ka i-laaa um-mi-ka kai ta-qar-ra ai-nu-haa wa-laa tah-zan wa-qa-tal-ta naf-san fa-naj-jai-naa-ka mi-nal gham-mi wa-fa-tan-naa-ka fu-too-naa fa-la-bis-ta sinee-na feee ah-li ma-dya-na sum-ma ji-ta a-laa qa-da-ri-ny yaa-moo-sa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱصۡطَنَعۡتُكَ لِنَفۡسِي ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: واصطنعتك لنفسي
ayahs.translation: And I produced you for Myself.
ayahs.transliteration: was-ta-na-tu-ka li-naf-see

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱذۡهَبۡ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِي وَلَا تَنِيَا فِي ذِكۡرِي ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: اذهب انت واخوك بايتي ولا تنيا في ذكري
ayahs.translation: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.
ayahs.transliteration: i-zhab an-ta waa-khoo-ka bi-a-ayaa-tee wa-laa ta-niyaa fee zik-ree

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱذۡهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: اذهبا الي فرعون انه طغي
ayahs.translation: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
ayahs.transliteration: i-zha-baaa i-laa fi-raw-na in-na-hoo ta-ghaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوۡلٗا لَّيِّنٗا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوۡ يَخۡشَىٰ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: فقولا له قولا لينا لعله يتذكر او يخشي
ayahs.translation: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allāh]."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qoo-laa la-hoo qaw-lal laiyi-nal laal-la-hoo ya-ta-zak-kka-ru aw yak-hshaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفۡرُطَ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوۡ أَن يَطۡغَىٰ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: قالا ربنا اننا نخاف ان يفرط علينا او ان يطغي
ayahs.translation: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-laa rab-ba-naaa in-na-naa na-khaa-fu ai yaf-ru-ta a-lai-naaa aw ai yat-ghaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآۖ إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَآ أَسۡمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: قال لا تخافا انني معكما اسمع واري
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la laa ta-khaa-faaa in-na-nee maa-ku-maa as-mau waa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأۡتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبۡهُمۡۖ قَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّكَۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: فاتياه فقولا انا رسولا ربك فارسل معنا بني اسرءيل ولا تعذبهم قد جئنك باية من ربك والسلم علي من اتبع الهدي
ayahs.translation: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-tiyaa-hu fa-qoo-laaa in-naa ra-soo-laa rab-bi-ka faar-sil maa-naa banee is-raaaee-la wa-laa tu-a-zzi-bhum qad ji-naa-ka bi-a-aya-tim mir rab-bi-ka was-sa-laa-mu a-laa ma-nit ta-baal hu-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا قَدۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡنَآ أَنَّ ٱلۡعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: انا قد اوحي الينا ان العذاب علي من كذب وتولي
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.'"
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa qad oo-hiya i-lai-naaa an-nnal a-zaa-ba a-laa man kaz-za-ba wa-ta-wal-la

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: قال فمن ربكما يموسي
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la fa-mar rab-bu-ku-maa yaa-moo-sa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَعۡطَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلۡقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: قال ربنا الذي اعطي كل شيء خلقه ثم هدي
ayahs.translation: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-bu-nal lazeee a-taa kul-la shaiin khal-qa-hoo sum-ma ha-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلۡقُرُونِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: قال فما بال القرون الاولي
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la fa-maa baa-lul qu-roo-nil oo-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ عِلۡمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَٰبٖۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّي وَلَا يَنسَى ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: قال علمها عند ربي في كتب لا يضل ربي ولا ينسي
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la il-mu-haa in-da rabee fee ki-taab laa ya-dil-lu rab-bee wa-laa yan-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَهۡدٗا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا سُبُلٗا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٗا مِّن نَّبَاتٖ شَتَّىٰ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: الذي جعل لكم الارض مهدا وسلك لكم فيها سبلا وانزل من السماء ماء فاخرجنا به ازوجا من نبات شتي
ayahs.translation: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee jaa-la la-ku-mul ar-da mah-danw wa-sa-la-ka la-kum fee-haa su-bu-lanw waan-za-la mi-nas sa-maaai maaaan faak-hraj-naa biheee az-waa-jam min na-baa-tin shat-ta

ayahs.text_uthmani: كُلُواْ وَٱرۡعَوۡاْ أَنۡعَٰمَكُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلنُّهَىٰ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: كلوا وارعوا انعمكم ان في ذلك لايت لاولي النهي
ayahs.translation: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.
ayahs.transliteration: ku-loo wa-raw a-naa-ma-kum in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayaa-til liu-lin nu-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ مِنۡهَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا نُخۡرِجُكُمۡ تَارَةً أُخۡرَىٰ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: منها خلقنكم وفيها نعيدكم ومنها نخرجكم تارة اخري
ayahs.translation: From it [i.e., the earth] We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.
ayahs.transliteration: mi-nhaa kha-laq-naa-kum wafee-haa nuee-du-kum wa-mi-nhaa nuk-hri-ju-kum taa-ra-tan uk-hraa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَرَيۡنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ارينه ءايتنا كلها فكذب وابي
ayahs.translation: And We certainly showed him [i.e., Pharaoh] Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad a-rai-naa-hu aayaa-ti-naa kul-la-haa fa-kaz-za-ba waa-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَجِئۡتَنَا لِتُخۡرِجَنَا مِنۡ أَرۡضِنَا بِسِحۡرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: قال اجئتنا لتخرجنا من ارضنا بسحرك يموسي
ayahs.translation: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la a-ji-ta-naa li-tuk-hri-ja-naa min ar-di-naa bi-sih-ri-ka yaa-moo-sa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَنَأۡتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحۡرٖ مِّثۡلِهِۦ فَٱجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكَ مَوۡعِدٗا لَّا نُخۡلِفُهُۥ نَحۡنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانٗا سُوٗى ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: فلناتينك بسحر مثله فاجعل بيننا وبينك موعدا لا نخلفه نحن ولا انت مكانا سوي
ayahs.translation: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-la-naa-tiyan-na-ka bi-sih-rim mis-lihee fa-jal bai-na-naa wa-bai-na-ka ma-wi-dal laa nuk-hli-fu-hoo nah-nu wa-laaa an-ta ma-kaa-nan su-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ مَوۡعِدُكُمۡ يَوۡمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحۡشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحٗى ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: قال موعدكم يوم الزينة وان يحشر الناس ضحي
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la ma-wi-du-kum yaw-muz zee-na-ti waai yuh-sha-ran naa-su du-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيۡدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: فتولي فرعون فجمع كيده ثم اتي
ayahs.translation: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ta-wal-laa fi-raw-nu faj-ja-maa kai-da-hoo sum-ma a-taa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيۡلَكُمۡ لَا تَفۡتَرُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا فَيُسۡحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٖۖ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: قال لهم موسي ويلكم لا تفتروا علي الله كذبا فيسحتكم بعذاب وقد خاب من افتري
ayahs.translation: Moses said to them [i.e., the magicians summoned by Pharaoh], "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allāh or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la la-hum moo-saa wai-la-kum laa taf-ta-roo a-lal laa-hi ka-zi-ban fayu-shi-ta-kum bi-a-zaab wa-qad khaa-ba ma-nif ta-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّجۡوَىٰ ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: فتنزعوا امرهم بينهم واسروا النجوي
ayahs.translation: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ta-naa-zaooo am-ra-hum bai-na-hum waa-sar-run naj-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخۡرِجَاكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِمَا وَيَذۡهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلۡمُثۡلَىٰ ٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا ان هذن لسحرن يريدان ان يخرجاكم من ارضكم بسحرهما ويذهبا بطريقتكم المثلي
ayahs.translation: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way [i.e., religion or tradition].
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-looo in haaa-zaa-ni la-saa-hi-raa-ni yu-ree-daa-ni ai yuk-hri-jaa-kum min ar-di-kum bi-sih-ri-hi-maa waya-zha-baa bi-ta-ree-qa-ti-ku-mul mus-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَجۡمِعُواْ كَيۡدَكُمۡ ثُمَّ ٱئۡتُواْ صَفّٗاۚ وَقَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مَنِ ٱسۡتَعۡلَىٰ ٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: فاجمعوا كيدكم ثم ائتوا صفا وقد افلح اليوم من استعلي
ayahs.translation: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."
ayahs.transliteration: faaj-mioo kai-da-kum sum-mma too saf-faa wa-qad af-la-hal yaw-ma ma-nis ta-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلۡقِيَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنۡ أَلۡقَىٰ ٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا يموسي اما ان تلقي واما ان نكون اول من القي
ayahs.translation: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo yaa-moo-saaa im-maaa an tul-qiya waim-maaa an na-koo-na a-wa-la man al-qaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ بَلۡ أَلۡقُواْۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمۡ وَعِصِيُّهُمۡ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيۡهِ مِن سِحۡرِهِمۡ أَنَّهَا تَسۡعَىٰ ٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: قال بل القوا فاذا حبالهم وعصيهم يخيل اليه من سحرهم انها تسعي
ayahs.translation: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la bal al-qoo fai-zaa hi-baa-lu-hum wai-siyyu-hum yu-khaiya-lu i-lai-hi min sih-ri-him an-na-haa ta-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَوۡجَسَ فِي نَفۡسِهِۦ خِيفَةٗ مُّوسَىٰ ٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: فاوجس في نفسه خيفة موسي
ayahs.translation: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.
ayahs.transliteration: faaw-ja-sa fee naf-sihee khee-fa-tam moo-sa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡنَا لَا تَخَفۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ ٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: قلنا لا تخف انك انت الاعلي
ayahs.translation: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.
ayahs.transliteration: qul-naa laa ta-khaf in-na-ka an-tal a-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَلۡقِ مَا فِي يَمِينِكَ تَلۡقَفۡ مَا صَنَعُوٓاْۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُواْ كَيۡدُ سَٰحِرٖۖ وَلَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيۡثُ أَتَىٰ ٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: والق ما في يمينك تلقف ما صنعوا انما صنعوا كيد سحر ولا يفلح الساحر حيث اتي
ayahs.translation: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."
ayahs.transliteration: waal-qi maa fee ya-mee-ni-ka tal-qaf maa sa-naoo in-na-maa sa-naoo kai-du saa-hir wa-laa yuf-li-hus saa-hi-ru hai-su a-taa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأُلۡقِيَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدٗا قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ ٧٠
ayahs.text_simple: فالقي السحرة سجدا قالوا ءامنا برب هرون وموسي
ayahs.translation: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."
ayahs.transliteration: faul-qiyas sa-ha-ra-tu suj-ja-dan qaa-looo aa-man-naa bi-rab-bi haa-roo-na wa-moo-sa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفٖ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ فِي جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخۡلِ وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابٗا وَأَبۡقَىٰ ٧١
ayahs.text_simple: قال ءامنتم له قبل ان ءاذن لكم انه لكبيركم الذي علمكم السحر فلاقطعن ايديكم وارجلكم من خلف ولاصلبنكم في جذوع النخل ولتعلمن اينا اشد عذابا وابقي
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la aa-man-tum la-hoo qab-la an aa-za-na la-kum in-na-hoo la-ka-bee-ru-ku-mul lazee al-la-ma-ku-mus sih-ra fa-lau-qat-ti-a-nna ai-diya-kum waar-ju-la-kum min khi-laa-finw wa-lau-sal-li-ban-na-kum fee ju-zooin nak-hli wa-la-ta-la-mun-na aiyu-naaa a-shad-du a-zaa-banw waab-qaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ لَن نُّؤۡثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنَاۖ فَٱقۡضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍۖ إِنَّمَا تَقۡضِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَآ ٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا لن نؤثرك علي ما جاءنا من البينت والذي فطرنا فاقض ما انت قاض انما تقضي هذه الحيوة الدنيا
ayahs.translation: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us. So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo lan nu-si-ra-ka a-laa maa jaaaa-naa mi-nal baiyi-naa-ti wal-lazee fa-ta-ra-naa faq-di maaa an-ta qaad in-na-maa taq-dee haa-zi-hil hayaa-tad du-nyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغۡفِرَ لَنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَا وَمَآ أَكۡرَهۡتَنَا عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحۡرِۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ ٧٣
ayahs.text_simple: انا ءامنا بربنا ليغفر لنا خطينا وما اكرهتنا عليه من السحر والله خير وابقي
ayahs.translation: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allāh is better and more enduring."
ayahs.transliteration: in-naaa aa-man-naa bi-rab-bi-naa liyag-hfi-ra la-naa kha-taayaa-naa wa-maaa ak-rah-ta-naa a-lai-hi mi-nas sihr wal-laa-hu khai-runw waab-qaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَأۡتِ رَبَّهُۥ مُجۡرِمٗا فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ ٧٤
ayahs.text_simple: انه من يات ربه مجرما فان له جهنم لا يموت فيها ولا يحيي
ayahs.translation: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hoo mai ya-ti rab-ba-hoo muj-ri-man fain-na la-hoo ja-han-na-ma laa ya-moo-tu fee-haa wa-laa ya-hyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَن يَأۡتِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنٗا قَدۡ عَمِلَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتُ ٱلۡعُلَىٰ ٧٥
ayahs.text_simple: ومن ياته مؤمنا قد عمل الصلحت فاولئك لهم الدرجت العلي
ayahs.translation: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]:
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mai ya-tihee mu-mi-nan qad a-mi-las saa-li-haa-ti fau-laaai-ka la-hu-mud da-ra-jaa-tul u-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ ٧٦
ayahs.text_simple: جنت عدن تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها وذلك جزاء من تزكي
ayahs.translation: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.
ayahs.transliteration: jan-naa-tu ad-nin taj-ree min tah-ti-hal a-nhaa-ru khaa-li-dee-na fee-haa wa-zaa-li-ka ja-zaaau man ta-zak-ka

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي فَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ طَرِيقٗا فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ يَبَسٗا لَّا تَخَٰفُ دَرَكٗا وَلَا تَخۡشَىٰ ٧٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد اوحينا الي موسي ان اسر بعبادي فاضرب لهم طريقا في البحر يبسا لا تخف دركا ولا تخشي
ayahs.translation: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad a-whai-naaa i-laa moo-saaa an as-ri bii-baadee fad-rib la-hum taree-qan fil bah-ri ya-ba-sal laa ta-khaa-fu da-ra-kanw wa-laa tak-hshaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَتۡبَعَهُمۡ فِرۡعَوۡنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمۡ ٧٨
ayahs.text_simple: فاتبعهم فرعون بجنوده فغشيهم من اليم ما غشيهم
ayahs.translation: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,
ayahs.transliteration: faat-baa-hum fi-raw-nu bi-ju-noo-dihee fa-gha-shiya-hum mi-nal yam-mmi maa gha-shiya-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَضَلَّ فِرۡعَوۡنُ قَوۡمَهُۥ وَمَا هَدَىٰ ٧٩
ayahs.text_simple: واضل فرعون قومه وما هدي
ayahs.translation: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them].
ayahs.transliteration: waa-dal-la fi-raw-nu qaw-ma-hoo wa-maa ha-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدۡ أَنجَيۡنَٰكُم مِّنۡ عَدُوِّكُمۡ وَوَٰعَدۡنَٰكُمۡ جَانِبَ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلۡأَيۡمَنَ وَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلۡوَىٰ ٨٠
ayahs.text_simple: يبني اسرءيل قد انجينكم من عدوكم ووعدنكم جانب الطور الايمن ونزلنا عليكم المن والسلوي
ayahs.translation: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,
ayahs.transliteration: yaa-baneee is-raaaee-la qad an-jai-naa-kum min a-duw-wi-kum wa-waad-naa-kum jaa-ni-bat too-ril ai-ma-na wa-naz-zal-naa a-lai-ku-mul man-na was-sal-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: كُلُواْ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنَٰكُمۡ وَلَا تَطۡغَوۡاْ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبِيۖ وَمَن يَحۡلِلۡ عَلَيۡهِ غَضَبِي فَقَدۡ هَوَىٰ ٨١
ayahs.text_simple: كلوا من طيبت ما رزقنكم ولا تطغوا فيه فيحل عليكم غضبي ومن يحلل عليه غضبي فقد هوي
ayahs.translation: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen [i.e., perished]."
ayahs.transliteration: ku-loo min taiyi-baa-ti maa ra-zaq-naa-kum wa-laa tat-ghaw fee-hi faya-hil-la a-lai-kum gha-dabee wa-mai yah-lil a-lai-hi gha-dabee fa-qad ha-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنِّي لَغَفَّارٞ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا ثُمَّ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ ٨٢
ayahs.text_simple: واني لغفار لمن تاب وءامن وعمل صلحا ثم اهتدي
ayahs.translation: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-nee la-ghaf-faa-rul li-man taa-ba waaa-ma-na waa-mi-la saa-li-han sum-mah ta-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَمَآ أَعۡجَلَكَ عَن قَوۡمِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ ٨٣
ayahs.text_simple: وما اعجلك عن قومك يموسي
ayahs.translation: [Allāh said], "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?"
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa a-ja-la-ka an qaw-mi-ka yaa-moo-sa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ هُمۡ أُوْلَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِي وَعَجِلۡتُ إِلَيۡكَ رَبِّ لِتَرۡضَىٰ ٨٤
ayahs.text_simple: قال هم اولاء علي اثري وعجلت اليك رب لترضي
ayahs.translation: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la hum u-laaai a-laaa a-saree waa-jil-tu i-lai-ka rab-bi li-tar-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَوۡمَكَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِيُّ ٨٥
ayahs.text_simple: قال فانا قد فتنا قومك من بعدك واضلهم السامري
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la fain-naa qad fa-tan-naa qaw-ma-ka mim ba-di-ka waa-dal-la-hu-mus saa-mi-riyy

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ غَضۡبَٰنَ أَسِفٗاۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَلَمۡ يَعِدۡكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ وَعۡدًا حَسَنًاۚ أَفَطَالَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡعَهۡدُ أَمۡ أَرَدتُّمۡ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ فَأَخۡلَفۡتُم مَّوۡعِدِي ٨٦
ayahs.text_simple: فرجع موسي الي قومه غضبن اسفا قال يقوم الم يعدكم ربكم وعدا حسنا افطال عليكم العهد ام اردتم ان يحل عليكم غضب من ربكم فاخلفتم موعدي
ayahs.translation: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved. He said, "O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise? Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me?"
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ra-jaa moo-saaa i-laa qaw-mihee ghad-baa-na a-si-faa qaa-la yaa-qaw-mi a-lam yaid-kum rab-bu-kum wa-dan ha-sa-naa a-fa-taa-la a-lai-ku-mul ah-du am a-rat-tum ai ya-hil-la a-lai-kum gha-da-bum mir rab-bi-kum faak-hlaf-tum ma-widee

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ مَآ أَخۡلَفۡنَا مَوۡعِدَكَ بِمَلۡكِنَا وَلَٰكِنَّا حُمِّلۡنَآ أَوۡزَارٗا مِّن زِينَةِ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ فَقَذَفۡنَٰهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلۡقَى ٱلسَّامِرِيُّ ٨٧
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا ما اخلفنا موعدك بملكنا ولكنا حملنا اوزارا من زينة القوم فقذفنها فكذلك القي السامري
ayahs.translation: They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Sāmirī throw."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo maaa ak-hlaf-naa ma-wi-da-ka bi-mal-kin-na wa-laa-kin-na hum-mil-naaa aw-zaa-ram min zee-na-til qaw-mi fa-qa-zaf-naa-haa fa-ka-zaa-li-ka al-qas saa-mi-riyy

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَخۡرَجَ لَهُمۡ عِجۡلٗا جَسَدٗا لَّهُۥ خُوَارٞ فَقَالُواْ هَٰذَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ وَإِلَٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِيَ ٨٨
ayahs.text_simple: فاخرج لهم عجلا جسدا له خوار فقالوا هذا الهكم واله موسي فنسي
ayahs.translation: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, "This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot."
ayahs.transliteration: faak-hra-ja la-hum ij-lan ja-sa-dal la-hoo khu-waa-run fa-qaa-loo haa-zaaa i-laa-hu-kum wai-laa-hu moo-saa fa-nasee

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ أَلَّا يَرۡجِعُ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَوۡلٗا وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ لَهُمۡ ضَرّٗا وَلَا نَفۡعٗا ٨٩
ayahs.text_simple: افلا يرون الا يرجع اليهم قولا ولا يملك لهم ضرا ولا نفعا
ayahs.translation: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech [i.e., response] and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-laa ya-raw-na al-laa yar-jiu i-lai-him qaw-lanw wa-laa yam-li-ku la-hum dar-ranw wa-laa naf aa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ هَٰرُونُ مِن قَبۡلُ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ فَٱتَّبِعُونِي وَأَطِيعُوٓاْ أَمۡرِي ٩٠
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد قال لهم هرون من قبل يقوم انما فتنتم به وان ربكم الرحمن فاتبعوني واطيعوا امري
ayahs.translation: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad qaa-la la-hum haa-roo-nu min qab-lu yaa-qaw-mi in-na-maa fu-tin-tum bihee wain-na rab-ba-ku-mur rah-maa-nu fat-ta-bioonee waatee-o-oo am-ree

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ لَن نَّبۡرَحَ عَلَيۡهِ عَٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرۡجِعَ إِلَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ ٩١
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا لن نبرح عليه عكفين حتي يرجع الينا موسي
ayahs.translation: They said, "We will never cease being devoted to it [i.e., the calf] until Moses returns to us."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo lan nab-ra-ha a-lai-hi aa-ki-fee-na hat-taa yar-ji-a i-lai-naa moo-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰهَٰرُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذۡ رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ ضَلُّوٓاْ ٩٢
ayahs.text_simple: قال يهرون ما منعك اذ رايتهم ضلوا
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la yaa-haa-roo-nu maa ma-naa-ka iz raai-ta-hum dal-looo

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِۖ أَفَعَصَيۡتَ أَمۡرِي ٩٣
ayahs.text_simple: الا تتبعن افعصيت امري
ayahs.translation: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?"
ayahs.transliteration: al-laa tat-ta-bi-a-ni a-faa-sai-ta am-ree

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَبۡنَؤُمَّ لَا تَأۡخُذۡ بِلِحۡيَتِي وَلَا بِرَأۡسِيٓۖ إِنِّي خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقۡتَ بَيۡنَ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمۡ تَرۡقُبۡ قَوۡلِي ٩٤
ayahs.text_simple: قال يبنؤم لا تاخذ بلحيتي ولا براسي اني خشيت ان تقول فرقت بين بني اسرءيل ولم ترقب قولي
ayahs.translation: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word.'"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la yab-naum-ma laa ta-khuz bi-li-hyatee wa-laa bi-rasee in-nee kha-shee-tu an ta-qoo-la far-raq-ta bai-na baneee is-raaaee-la wa-lam tar-qub qaw-lee

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكَ يَٰسَٰمِرِيُّ ٩٥
ayahs.text_simple: قال فما خطبك يسمري
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Sāmirī?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la fa-maa khat-bu-ka yaa-saa-mi-riyy

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ بَصُرۡتُ بِمَا لَمۡ يَبۡصُرُواْ بِهِۦ فَقَبَضۡتُ قَبۡضَةٗ مِّنۡ أَثَرِ ٱلرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذۡتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتۡ لِي نَفۡسِي ٩٦
ayahs.text_simple: قال بصرت بما لم يبصروا به فقبضت قبضة من اثر الرسول فنبذتها وكذلك سولت لي نفسي
ayahs.translation: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la ba-sur-tu bi-maa lam yab-su-roo bihee fa-qa-bad-tu qab-da-tam min a-sa-rir ra-soo-li fa-na-baz-tu-haa wa-ka-zaa-li-ka saw-wa-lat lee naf-see

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَٱذۡهَبۡ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوۡعِدٗا لَّن تُخۡلَفَهُۥۖ وَٱنظُرۡ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِي ظَلۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ عَاكِفٗاۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ نَسۡفًا ٩٧
ayahs.text_simple: قال فاذهب فان لك في الحيوة ان تقول لا مساس وان لك موعدا لن تخلفه وانظر الي الهك الذي ظلت عليه عاكفا لنحرقنه ثم لننسفنه في اليم نسفا
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la fa-zhab fain-na la-ka fil hayaa-ti an ta-qoo-la laa mi-saa-sa wain-na la-ka ma-wi-dal lan tuk-hla-fa-hoo wan-zur i-laaa i-laa-hi-kal lazee zal-ta a-lai-hi aa-ki-faa la-nu-har-ri-qan-na-hoo thum-ma la-nan-si-fan-na-hoo fil yam-mi nas-faa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمٗا ٩٨
ayahs.text_simple: انما الهكم الله الذي لا اله الا هو وسع كل شيء علما
ayahs.translation: Your god is only Allāh, except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge."
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-maaa i-laa-hu-ku-mul laa-hul lazee laa i-laa-ha il-laa hoo wa-si-a kul-la shaiin il-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ أَنۢبَآءِ مَا قَدۡ سَبَقَۚ وَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكۡرٗا ٩٩
ayahs.text_simple: كذلك نقص عليك من انباء ما قد سبق وقد ءاتينك من لدنا ذكرا
ayahs.translation: Thus, [O Muḥammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us a message [i.e., the Qur’ān].
ayahs.transliteration: ka-zaa-li-ka na-qus-su a-lai-ka min an-baaai maa qad sa-baq wa-qad aa-tai-naa-ka mil la-dun-naa zik-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَّنۡ أَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَحۡمِلُ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وِزۡرًا ١٠٠
ayahs.text_simple: من اعرض عنه فانه يحمل يوم القيمة وزرا
ayahs.translation: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden [i.e., great sin],
ayahs.transliteration: man a-ra-da a-nhu fain-na-hoo yah-mi-lu yaw-mal qiyaa-ma-ti wiz-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهِۖ وَسَآءَ لَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ حِمۡلٗا ١٠١
ayahs.text_simple: خلدين فيه وساء لهم يوم القيمة حملا
ayahs.translation: [Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -
ayahs.transliteration: khaa-li-dee-na fee-hi wa-saaaa la-hum yaw-mal qiyaa-ma-ti him-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِۚ وَنَحۡشُرُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ زُرۡقٗا ١٠٢
ayahs.text_simple: يوم ينفخ في الصور ونحشر المجرمين يومئذ زرقا
ayahs.translation: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma yun-fa-khu fis soo-ri wa-nah-shu-rul muj-ri-mee-na yaw-mai-zin zur-qaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ إِن لَّبِثۡتُمۡ إِلَّا عَشۡرٗا ١٠٣
ayahs.text_simple: يتخفتون بينهم ان لبثتم الا عشرا
ayahs.translation: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."
ayahs.transliteration: ya-ta-khaa-fa-too-na bai-na-hum il la-bis-tum il-laa as-hraa

ayahs.text_uthmani: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذۡ يَقُولُ أَمۡثَلُهُمۡ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثۡتُمۡ إِلَّا يَوۡمٗا ١٠٤
ayahs.text_simple: نحن اعلم بما يقولون اذ يقول امثلهم طريقة ان لبثتم الا يوما
ayahs.translation: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner [i.e., wisdom or speech] will say, "You remained not but one day."
ayahs.transliteration: nah-nu a-la-mu bi-maa ya-qoo-loo-na iz ya-qoo-lu am-sa-lu-hum taree-qa-tan il la-bis-tum il-laa yaw-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلۡجِبَالِ فَقُلۡ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّي نَسۡفٗا ١٠٥
ayahs.text_simple: ويسلونك عن الجبال فقل ينسفها ربي نسفا
ayahs.translation: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast.
ayahs.transliteration: waya-sa-loo-na-ka a-nil ji-baa-li fa-qul yan-si-fu-haa rab-bee nas-faa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعٗا صَفۡصَفٗا ١٠٦
ayahs.text_simple: فيذرها قاعا صفصفا
ayahs.translation: And He will leave it [i.e., the earth] a level plain;
ayahs.transliteration: faya-za-ru-haa qaaan saf-sa-faa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجٗا وَلَآ أَمۡتٗا ١٠٧
ayahs.text_simple: لا تري فيها عوجا ولا امتا
ayahs.translation: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."
ayahs.transliteration: laa ta-raa fee-haa i-wa-janw wa-laaa am-taa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلدَّاعِيَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُۥۖ وَخَشَعَتِ ٱلۡأَصۡوَاتُ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ فَلَا تَسۡمَعُ إِلَّا هَمۡسٗا ١٠٨
ayahs.text_simple: يومئذ يتبعون الداعي لا عوج له وخشعت الاصوات للرحمن فلا تسمع الا همسا
ayahs.translation: That Day, they [i.e., everyone] will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-mai-zi-ny yat-ta-bioo-nad daaiya laa i-wa-ja la-hoo wa-kha-shaa-til as-waa-tu lir-rah-maa-ni fa-laa tas-mau il-laa ham-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَرَضِيَ لَهُۥ قَوۡلٗا ١٠٩
ayahs.text_simple: يومئذ لا تنفع الشفعة الا من اذن له الرحمن ورضي له قولا
ayahs.translation: That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word.
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-mai-zil laa tan-faush sha-faaa-tu il-laa man a-zi-na la-hur rah-maa-nu wa-ra-diya la-hoo qaw-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمٗا ١١٠
ayahs.text_simple: يعلم ما بين ايديهم وما خلفهم ولا يحيطون به علما
ayahs.translation: He [i.e., Allāh] knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it [i.e., what He knows] in knowledge.
ayahs.transliteration: ya-la-mu maa bai-naa ai-dee-him wa-maa khal-fa-hum wa-laa yu-hee-too-na bihee il-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَعَنَتِ ٱلۡوُجُوهُ لِلۡحَيِّ ٱلۡقَيُّومِۖ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنۡ حَمَلَ ظُلۡمٗا ١١١
ayahs.text_simple: وعنت الوجوه للحي القيوم وقد خاب من حمل ظلما
ayahs.translation: And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. And he will have failed who carries injustice.
ayahs.transliteration: waa-na-til wu-joo-hu li-lhaiiyil qaiyoo-mi wa-qad khaa-ba man ha-ma-la zul-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلۡمٗا وَلَا هَضۡمٗا ١١٢
ayahs.text_simple: ومن يعمل من الصلحت وهو مؤمن فلا يخاف ظلما ولا هضما
ayahs.translation: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mai ya-mal mi-nas saa-li-haa-ti wa-hu-wa mu-mi-nun fa-laa ya-khaa-fu zul-manw wa-laa had-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيّٗا وَصَرَّفۡنَا فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلۡوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ أَوۡ يُحۡدِثُ لَهُمۡ ذِكۡرٗا ١١٣
ayahs.text_simple: وكذلك انزلنه قرءانا عربيا وصرفنا فيه من الوعيد لعلهم يتقون او يحدث لهم ذكرا
ayahs.translation: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’ān and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ka-zaa-li-ka an-zal-naa-hu qu-raa-nan a-ra-biyyanw wa-sar-raf-naa fee-hi mi-nal waee-di laal-la-hum yat-ta-qoo-na aw yuh-di-su la-hum zik-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡحَقُّۗ وَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يُقۡضَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكَ وَحۡيُهُۥۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدۡنِي عِلۡمٗا ١١٤
ayahs.text_simple: فتعلي الله الملك الحق ولا تعجل بالقرءان من قبل ان يقضي اليك وحيه وقل رب زدني علما
ayahs.translation: So high [above all] is Allāh, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muḥammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur’ān before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-taaa-lal laa-hul ma-li-kul haqq wa-laa ta-jal bil-qu-raa-ni min qab-li ai yuq-daaa i-lai-ka wa-hyu-hoo wa-qur rab-bi zid-nee il-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ عَهِدۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ مِن قَبۡلُ فَنَسِيَ وَلَمۡ نَجِدۡ لَهُۥ عَزۡمٗا ١١٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد عهدنا الي ءادم من قبل فنسي ولم نجد له عزما
ayahs.translation: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad a-hid-naaa i-laaa aa-da-ma min qab-lu fa-na-siya wa-lam na-jid la-hoo az-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسۡجُدُواْ لِأٓدَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰ ١١٦
ayahs.text_simple: واذ قلنا للملئكة اسجدوا لادم فسجدوا الا ابليس ابي
ayahs.translation: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused.
ayahs.transliteration: waiz qul-naa lil-ma-laaai-ka-tis ju-doo li-a-a-da-ma fa-sa-ja-dooo il-laaa ib-lee-sa a-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقُلۡنَا يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ إِنَّ هَٰذَا عَدُوّٞ لَّكَ وَلِزَوۡجِكَ فَلَا يُخۡرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ فَتَشۡقَىٰٓ ١١٧
ayahs.text_simple: فقلنا يادم ان هذا عدو لك ولزوجك فلا يخرجنكما من الجنة فتشقي
ayahs.translation: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qul-naa yaaaaa-da-mu in-na haa-zaa a-duw-wul la-ka wa-li-zaw-ji-ka fa-laa yuk-hri-jan-na-ku-maa mi-nal jan-na-ti fa-tas-hqaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعۡرَىٰ ١١٨
ayahs.text_simple: ان لك الا تجوع فيها ولا تعري
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa la-ka al-laa ta-joo-a fee-ha wa-laa ta-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظۡمَؤُاْ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضۡحَىٰ ١١٩
ayahs.text_simple: وانك لا تظمؤا فيها ولا تضحي
ayahs.translation: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun."
ayahs.transliteration: waan-na-ka laa taz-mau fee-haa wa-laa ta-dhaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَوَسۡوَسَ إِلَيۡهِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ قَالَ يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ وَمُلۡكٖ لَّا يَبۡلَىٰ ١٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: فوسوس اليه الشيطن قال يادم هل ادلك علي شجرة الخلد وملك لا يبلي
ayahs.translation: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?"
ayahs.transliteration: fa-was-wa-sa i-lai-hish shai-taa-nu qaa-la yaaaaa-da-mu hal a-dul-lu-ka a-laa sha-ja-ra-til khul-di wa-mul-kil laa yab-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَكَلَا مِنۡهَا فَبَدَتۡ لَهُمَا سَوۡءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخۡصِفَانِ عَلَيۡهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلۡجَنَّةِۚ وَعَصَىٰٓ ءَادَمُ رَبَّهُۥ فَغَوَىٰ ١٢١
ayahs.text_simple: فاكلا منها فبدت لهما سوءتهما وطفقا يخصفان عليهما من ورق الجنة وعصي ءادم ربه فغوي
ayahs.translation: And they [i.e., Adam and his wife] ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-ka-laa mi-nhaa fa-ba-dat la-hu-maa sa-waa-tu-hu-maa wa-ta-fi-qaa yak-hsi-faa-ni a-lai-hi-maa minw wa-ra-qil jan-nah waa-saaa aa-da-mu rab-ba-hoo fa-gha-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ٱجۡتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡهِ وَهَدَىٰ ١٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: ثم اجتبه ربه فتاب عليه وهدي
ayahs.translation: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him].
ayahs.transliteration: sum-maj tab-ba-hu rab-bu-hoo fa-taa-ba a-lai-hi wa-ha-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ ٱهۡبِطَا مِنۡهَا جَمِيعَۢاۖ بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوّٞۖ فَإِمَّا يَأۡتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّي هُدٗى فَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشۡقَىٰ ١٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: قال اهبطا منها جميعا بعضكم لبعض عدو فاما ياتينكم مني هدي فمن اتبع هداي فلا يضل ولا يشقي
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "Descend from it [i.e., Paradise] - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-lah bi-ta mi-nhaa jameeam ba-du-kum li-ba-din a-duww faim-maa ya-tiyan-na-kum min-nee hu-dan fa-ma-nit ta-baa hu-daaya fa-laa ya-dil-lu wa-laa yas-hqaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَنۡ أَعۡرَضَ عَن ذِكۡرِي فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةٗ ضَنكٗا وَنَحۡشُرُهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ أَعۡمَىٰ ١٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: ومن اعرض عن ذكري فان له معيشة ضنكا ونحشره يوم القيمة اعمي
ayahs.translation: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed [i.e., difficult] life, and We will gather [i.e., raise] him on the Day of Resurrection blind."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-man a-ra-da an zik-ree fain-na la-hoo maee-sha-tan dan-kanw wa-nah-shu-ru-hoo yaw-mal qiyaa-ma-ti a-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرۡتَنِيٓ أَعۡمَىٰ وَقَدۡ كُنتُ بَصِيرٗا ١٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: قال رب لم حشرتني اعمي وقد كنت بصيرا
ayahs.translation: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-bi li-ma ha-shar-tanee a-maa wa-qad kun-tu basee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ أَتَتۡكَ ءَايَٰتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَاۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُنسَىٰ ١٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: قال كذلك اتتك ءايتنا فنسيتها وكذلك اليوم تنسي
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot [i.e., disregarded] them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la ka-zaa-li-ka a-tat-ka aayaa-tu-naa fa-na-see-ta-haa wa-ka-zaa-li-kal yaw-ma tun-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَنۡ أَسۡرَفَ وَلَمۡ يُؤۡمِنۢ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦۚ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ ١٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: وكذلك نجزي من اسرف ولم يؤمن بايت ربه ولعذاب الاخرة اشد وابقي
ayahs.translation: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ka-zaa-li-ka naj-zee man as-ra-fa wa-lam yu-min bi-a-ayaa-ti rab-bih wa-laa-zaa-bul aa-khi-ra-ti a-shad-du waab-qaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَلَمۡ يَهۡدِ لَهُمۡ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ يَمۡشُونَ فِي مَسَٰكِنِهِمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلنُّهَىٰ ١٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: افلم يهد لهم كم اهلكنا قبلهم من القرون يمشون في مسكنهم ان في ذلك لايت لاولي النهي
ayahs.translation: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-lam yah-di la-hum kam ah-lak-naa qab-la-hum mi-nal qu-roo-ni yam-shoo-na fee ma-saa-ki-ni-him in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayaa-til liu-lin nu-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٞ سَبَقَتۡ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامٗا وَأَجَلٞ مُّسَمّٗى ١٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: ولولا كلمة سبقت من ربك لكان لزاما واجل مسمي
ayahs.translation: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it [i.e., punishment] would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law-laa ka-li-ma-tun sa-ba-qat mir rab-bi-ka la-kaa-na li-zaa-manw waa-ja-lun mu-sam-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ غُرُوبِهَاۖ وَمِنۡ ءَانَآيِٕ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡ وَأَطۡرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرۡضَىٰ ١٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: فاصبر علي ما يقولون وسبح بحمد ربك قبل طلوع الشمس وقبل غروبها ومن ءاناي اليل فسبح واطراف النهار لعلك ترضي
ayahs.translation: So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied.
ayahs.transliteration: fas-bir a-laa maa ya-qoo-loo-na wa-sab-bih bi-ham-di rab-bi-ka qab-la tu-looish sham-si wa-qab-la ghu-roo-bi-haa wa-min aa-naaail lai-li fa-sab-bih waat-raa-fan na-haa-ri laal-la-ka tar-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ زَهۡرَةَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا لِنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَرِزۡقُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰ ١٣١
ayahs.text_simple: ولا تمدن عينيك الي ما متعنا به ازوجا منهم زهرة الحيوة الدنيا لنفتنهم فيه ورزق ربك خير وابقي
ayahs.translation: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa ta-mud-dan-na ai-nai-ka i-laa ma mat-ta-na biheee az-wa-jam mi-nhum zah-ra-tal hayaa-tid du-nya li-naf-ti-na-hum feeh wa-riz-qu rab-bi-ka khai-runw waab-qaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأۡمُرۡ أَهۡلَكَ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ عَلَيۡهَاۖ لَا نَسۡـَٔلُكَ رِزۡقٗاۖ نَّحۡنُ نَرۡزُقُكَۗ وَٱلۡعَٰقِبَةُ لِلتَّقۡوَىٰ ١٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: وامر اهلك بالصلوة واصطبر عليها لا نسلك رزقا نحن نرزقك والعقبة للتقوي
ayahs.translation: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mur ah-la-ka bis-sa-laa-ti was-ta-bir a-lai-haa laa na-sa-lu-ka riz-qaa nah-nu nar-zu-quk wa-laa-qi-ba-tu lit-taq-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا يَأۡتِينَا بِـَٔايَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓۚ أَوَلَمۡ تَأۡتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِي ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ ١٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا لولا ياتينا باية من ربه اولم تاتهم بينة ما في الصحف الاولي
ayahs.translation: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-loo law-laa ya-tee-naa bi-a-aya-tin mir rab-bih a-wa-lam ta-ti-him baiyi-na-tu maa fis su-hu-fil oo-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡ أَنَّآ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُم بِعَذَابٖ مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ لَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا لَوۡلَآ أَرۡسَلۡتَ إِلَيۡنَا رَسُولٗا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَٰتِكَ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخۡزَىٰ ١٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولو انا اهلكنهم بعذاب من قبله لقالوا ربنا لولا ارسلت الينا رسولا فنتبع ءايتك من قبل ان نذل ونخزي
ayahs.translation: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses [i.e., teachings] before we were humiliated and disgraced?"
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law an-naaa ah-lak-naa-hum bi-a-zaa-bin min qab-lihee la-qaa-loo rab-ba-naa law-laaa ar-sal-ta i-lai-naa ra-soo-lan fa-nat-ta-bi-a aayaa-ti-ka min qab-li an na-zil-la wa-nak-hzaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ كُلّٞ مُّتَرَبِّصٞ فَتَرَبَّصُواْۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٱلسَّوِيِّ وَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ ١٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: قل كل متربص فتربصوا فستعلمون من اصحب الصرط السوي ومن اهتدي
ayahs.translation: Say, "Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided."
ayahs.transliteration: qul kul-lum mu-ta-rab-bi-sun fa-ta-rab-ba-soo fa-sa-ta-la-moo-na man a-shaa-bus si-raa-tis sa-wiyyi wa-ma-nih ta-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱقۡتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِي غَفۡلَةٖ مُّعۡرِضُونَ ١
ayahs.text_simple: اقترب للناس حسابهم وهم في غفلة معرضون
ayahs.translation: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
ayahs.transliteration: iq-ta-ra-ba lin-naa-si hi-saa-bu-hum wa-hum fee ghaf-la-tim mu-ri-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن ذِكۡرٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحۡدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسۡتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمۡ يَلۡعَبُونَ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: ما ياتيهم من ذكر من ربهم محدث الا استمعوه وهم يلعبون
ayahs.translation: No mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play
ayahs.transliteration: maa ya-tee-him min zik-rim mir rab-bi-him muh-da-sin il-las ta-maoo-hu wa-hum ya-la-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَاهِيَةٗ قُلُوبُهُمۡۗ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّجۡوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ هَلۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡۖ أَفَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلسِّحۡرَ وَأَنتُمۡ تُبۡصِرُونَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: لاهية قلوبهم واسروا النجوي الذين ظلموا هل هذا الا بشر مثلكم افتاتون السحر وانتم تبصرون
ayahs.translation: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
ayahs.transliteration: laa-hiya-tan qu-loo-bu-hum waa-sar-run naj-wal lazee-na za-la-moo hal haa-zaaa il-laa ba-sha-rum mis-lu-kum a-fa-ta-too-nas sih-ra waan-tum tub-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّي يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: قال ربي يعلم القول في السماء والارض وهو السميع العليم
ayahs.translation: He [the Prophet (ﷺ)] said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-bee ya-la-mul qaw-la fis sa-maaai wa-lar-di wa-hu-was samee-ul aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ قَالُوٓاْ أَضۡغَٰثُ أَحۡلَٰمِۭ بَلِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُ بَلۡ هُوَ شَاعِرٞ فَلۡيَأۡتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٖ كَمَآ أُرۡسِلَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: بل قالوا اضغث احلم بل افتريه بل هو شاعر فلياتنا باية كما ارسل الاولون
ayahs.translation: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."
ayahs.transliteration: bal qaa-looo ad-ghaa-su ah-laa-min bal if-ta-raa-hu bal hu-wa shaai-run fa-lya-ti-naa bi-a-aya-tin ka-maa ur-si-lal aw-wa-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَآ ءَامَنَتۡ قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهَآۖ أَفَهُمۡ يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: ما ءامنت قبلهم من قرية اهلكنها افهم يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?
ayahs.transliteration: maaa aaa-ma-nat qab-la-hum min qa-rya-tin ah-lak-naa-haa a-fa-hum yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالٗا نُّوحِيٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡۖ فَسۡـَٔلُوٓاْ أَهۡلَ ٱلذِّكۡرِ إِن كُنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: وما ارسلنا قبلك الا رجالا نوحي اليهم فسلوا اهل الذكر ان كنتم لا تعلمون
ayahs.translation: And We sent not before you, [O Muḥammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message [i.e., former scriptures] if you do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa ar-sal-naa qab-la-ka il-laa ri-jaa-lan nooheee i-lai-him fa-sa-loo ah-laz zik-ri in kun-tum laa ta-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ جَسَدٗا لَّا يَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُواْ خَٰلِدِينَ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: وما جعلنهم جسدا لا ياكلون الطعام وما كانوا خلدين
ayahs.translation: And We did not make them [i.e., the prophets] forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa jaal-naa-hum ja-sa-dal laa ya-ku-loo-nat taaa-ma wa-maa kaa-noo khaa-lideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ صَدَقۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡوَعۡدَ فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُمۡ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهۡلَكۡنَا ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: ثم صدقنهم الوعد فانجينهم ومن نشاء واهلكنا المسرفين
ayahs.translation: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma sa-daq-naa-hu-mul wa-da faan-jai-naa-hum wa-man na-shaaau waah-lak-nal mus-rifeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَقَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ كِتَٰبٗا فِيهِ ذِكۡرُكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: لقد انزلنا اليكم كتبا فيه ذكركم افلا تعقلون
ayahs.translation: We have certainly sent down to you a Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?
ayahs.transliteration: la-qad an-zal-naaa i-lai-kum ki-taa-ban fee-hi zik-ru-kum a-fa-laa ta-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَمۡ قَصَمۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٖ كَانَتۡ ظَالِمَةٗ وَأَنشَأۡنَا بَعۡدَهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: وكم قصمنا من قرية كانت ظالمة وانشانا بعدها قوما ءاخرين
ayahs.translation: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kam qa-sam-naa min qa-rya-tin kaa-nat zaa-li-ma-tanw waan-sha-naa ba-da-haa qaw-man aa-khareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّواْ بَأۡسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنۡهَا يَرۡكُضُونَ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: فلما احسوا باسنا اذا هم منها يركضون
ayahs.translation: And when they [i.e., its inhabitants] perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maaa a-has-soo ba-sa-naaa i-zaa hum mi-nhaa yar-ku-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَا تَرۡكُضُواْ وَٱرۡجِعُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتۡرِفۡتُمۡ فِيهِ وَمَسَٰكِنِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُسۡـَٔلُونَ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: لا تركضوا وارجعوا الي ما اترفتم فيه ومسكنكم لعلكم تسلون
ayahs.translation: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."
ayahs.transliteration: laa tar-ku-doo war-jiooo i-laa maaa ut-rif-tum fee-hi wa-ma-saa-ki-ni-kum laal-la-kum tu-sa-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا يويلنا انا كنا ظلمين
ayahs.translation: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo yaa-wai-la-naaa in-naa kun-naa zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلۡكَ دَعۡوَىٰهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ حَصِيدًا خَٰمِدِينَ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: فما زالت تلك دعويهم حتي جعلنهم حصيدا خمدين
ayahs.translation: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
ayahs.transliteration: fa-maa zaa-lat til-ka da-waa-hum hat-taa jaal-naa-hum hasee-dan khaa-mideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: وما خلقنا السماء والارض وما بينهما لعبين
ayahs.translation: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa kha-laq-nas sa-maaaa wa-lar-da wa-maa bai-na-hu-maa laaibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَوۡ أَرَدۡنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهۡوٗا لَّٱتَّخَذۡنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: لو اردنا ان نتخذ لهوا لاتخذنه من لدنا ان كنا فعلين
ayahs.translation: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
ayahs.transliteration: law a-rad-naaa an nat-ta-khi-za lah-wal lat-ta-khaz-naa-hu mil la-dun-naaa in kun-naa faaileen

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ نَقۡذِفُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلۡبَٰطِلِ فَيَدۡمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٞۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡوَيۡلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: بل نقذف بالحق علي البطل فيدمغه فاذا هو زاهق ولكم الويل مما تصفون
ayahs.translation: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.
ayahs.transliteration: bal naq-zi-fu bi-lhaq-qi a-lal baa-ti-li fayad-ma-ghu-hoo fai-zaa hu-wa zaa-hiq wa-la-ku-mul wai-lu mim-maa ta-si-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَمَنۡ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسۡتَحۡسِرُونَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: وله من في السموت والارض ومن عنده لا يستكبرون عن عبادته ولا يستحسرون
ayahs.translation: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him [i.e., the angels] are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-hoo man fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lard wa-man in-da-hoo laa yas-tak-bi-roo-na an i-baa-da-tihee wa-laa yas-tah-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفۡتُرُونَ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: يسبحون اليل والنهار لا يفترون
ayahs.translation: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.
ayahs.transliteration: yu-sab-bi-hoo-na lai-la wan-na-haa-ra laa yaf-tu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ ءَالِهَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ هُمۡ يُنشِرُونَ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: ام اتخذوا ءالهة من الارض هم ينشرون
ayahs.translation: Or have they [i.e., men] taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
ayahs.transliteration: a-mit ta-kha-zooo aa-li-ha-tam mi-nal ar-di hum yun-shi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَوۡ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَاۚ فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: لو كان فيهما ءالهة الا الله لفسدتا فسبحن الله رب العرش عما يصفون
ayahs.translation: Had there been within them [i.e., the heavens and earth] gods besides Allāh, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allāh, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
ayahs.transliteration: law kaa-na fee-hi-maaa aa-li-ha-tun il-lal laa-hu la-fa-sa-da-taa fa-su-bhaa-nal laa-hi rab-bil ar-shi am-maa ya-si-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفۡعَلُ وَهُمۡ يُسۡـَٔلُونَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: لا يسل عما يفعل وهم يسلون
ayahs.translation: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
ayahs.transliteration: laa yu-sa-lu am-maa yaf a-lu wa-hum yu-sa-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةٗۖ قُلۡ هَاتُواْ بُرۡهَٰنَكُمۡۖ هَٰذَا ذِكۡرُ مَن مَّعِيَ وَذِكۡرُ مَن قَبۡلِيۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٱلۡحَقَّۖ فَهُم مُّعۡرِضُونَ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: ام اتخذوا من دونه ءالهة قل هاتوا برهنكم هذا ذكر من معي وذكر من قبلي بل اكثرهم لا يعلمون الحق فهم معرضون
ayahs.translation: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muḥammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur’ān] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
ayahs.transliteration: a-mit ta-kha-zoo min doo-nihee aa-li-ha-tan qul haa-too bu-rhaa-na-kum haa-za zik-ru mam maiya wa-zik-ru man qab-lee bal ak-sa-ru-hum laa ya-la-moo-nal haq-qa fa-hum mu-ri-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعۡبُدُونِ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: وما ارسلنا من قبلك من رسول الا نوحي اليه انه لا اله الا انا فاعبدون
ayahs.translation: And We sent not before you any messenger except We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa ar-sal-naa min qab-li-ka mir ra-soo-lin il-laa nooheee i-lai-hi an-na-hoo laaa i-laa-ha il-laaa a-na fa-bu-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَلَدٗاۗ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥۚ بَلۡ عِبَادٞ مُّكۡرَمُونَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا اتخذ الرحمن ولدا سبحنه بل عباد مكرمون
ayahs.translation: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-lut ta-kha-zar rah-maa-nu wa-la-daa su-bhaa-na-hu bal i-baa-dum muk-ra-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَا يَسۡبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَهُم بِأَمۡرِهِۦ يَعۡمَلُونَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: لا يسبقونه بالقول وهم بامره يعملون
ayahs.translation: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
ayahs.transliteration: laa yas-bi-qoo-na-hoo bil-qaw-li wa-hum bi-a-mri-hee ya-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَلَا يَشۡفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنۡ خَشۡيَتِهِۦ مُشۡفِقُونَ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: يعلم ما بين ايديهم وما خلفهم ولا يشفعون الا لمن ارتضي وهم من خشيته مشفقون
ayahs.translation: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
ayahs.transliteration: ya-la-mu maa bai-na ai-dee-him wa-maa khal-fa-hum wa-laa yas-hfaoo-na il-laa li-ma-nir ta-daa wa-hum min kha-shya-tihee mus-hfi-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلۡ مِنۡهُمۡ إِنِّيٓ إِلَٰهٞ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: ومن يقل منهم اني اله من دونه فذلك نجزيه جهنم كذلك نجزي الظلمين
ayahs.translation: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him" - that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mai ya-qul mi-nhum in-neee i-laa-hum min doo-nihee fa-zaa-li-ka naj-zee-hi ja-han-nam ka-zaa-li-ka naj-ziz zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ كَانَتَا رَتۡقٗا فَفَتَقۡنَٰهُمَاۖ وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ حَيٍّۚ أَفَلَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: اولم ير الذين كفروا ان السموت والارض كانتا رتقا ففتقنهما وجعلنا من الماء كل شيء حي افلا يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and then We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-lam ya-ral lazee-na ka-fa-rooo an-nas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da kaa-na-taa rat-qan fa-fa-taq-naa-hu-maa wa-jaal-naa mi-nal maaai kul-la shaiin haiyin a-fa-laa yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجٗا سُبُلٗا لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُونَ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: وجعلنا في الارض روسي ان تميد بهم وجعلنا فيها فجاجا سبلا لعلهم يهتدون
ayahs.translation: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaal-naa fil ar-di ra-waa-siya an tamee-da bi-him wa-jaal-naa fee-haa fi-jaa-jan su-bu-lal laal-la-hum yah-ta-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقۡفٗا مَّحۡفُوظٗاۖ وَهُمۡ عَنۡ ءَايَٰتِهَا مُعۡرِضُونَ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: وجعلنا السماء سقفا محفوظا وهم عن ءايتها معرضون
ayahs.translation: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaal-nas sa-maaaa saq-fam mah-foo-zanw wa-hum an aayaa-ti-haa mu-ri-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ فِي فَلَكٖ يَسۡبَحُونَ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: وهو الذي خلق اليل والنهار والشمس والقمر كل في فلك يسبحون
ayahs.translation: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wal lazee kha-la-qal lai-la wan-na-haa-ra was-hsham-sa wal-qa-ma-ra kul-lun fee fa-la-ki-ny yas-ba-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا لِبَشَرٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ ٱلۡخُلۡدَۖ أَفَإِيْن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِدُونَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: وما جعلنا لبشر من قبلك الخلد افاين مت فهم الخلدون
ayahs.translation: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa jaal-naa li-ba-sha-rim min qab-li-kal khuld a-fa im-mit-ta fa-hu-mul khaa-li-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۗ وَنَبۡلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلۡخَيۡرِ فِتۡنَةٗۖ وَإِلَيۡنَا تُرۡجَعُونَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: كل نفس ذائقة الموت ونبلوكم بالشر والخير فتنة والينا ترجعون
ayahs.translation: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
ayahs.transliteration: kul-lu naf-sin zaaai-qa-tul mawt wa-nab-loo-kum bi-shar-ri wal-khai-ri fit-na-tanw wai-lai-naa tur-jaoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي يَذۡكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ وَهُم بِذِكۡرِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ هُمۡ كَٰفِرُونَ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: واذا رءاك الذين كفروا ان يتخذونك الا هزوا اهذا الذي يذكر ءالهتكم وهم بذكر الرحمن هم كفرون
ayahs.translation: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who mentions [i.e., insults] your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa raaa-kal lazee-na ka-fa-rooo i-ny yat-ta-khi-zoo-na-ka il-la hu-zu-wan a-haa-zal lazee yaz-ku-ru aa-li-ha-ta-kum wa-hum bi-zik-rir rah-maa-ni hum kaa-fi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: خُلِقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مِنۡ عَجَلٖۚ سَأُوْرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِي فَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: خلق الانسن من عجل ساوريكم ءايتي فلا تستعجلون
ayahs.translation: Man was created of haste [i.e., impatience]. I will show you My signs [i.e., vengeance], so do not impatiently urge Me.
ayahs.transliteration: khu-li-qal in-saa-nu min a-jal sauree-kum aayaa-tee fa-laa tas-ta-ji-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: ويقولون متي هذا الوعد ان كنتم صدقين
ayahs.translation: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
ayahs.transliteration: waya-qoo-loo-na ma-taa haa-zal wa-du in kun-tum saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَوۡ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: لو يعلم الذين كفروا حين لا يكفون عن وجوههم النار ولا عن ظهورهم ولا هم ينصرون
ayahs.translation: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...
ayahs.transliteration: law ya-la-mul lazee-na ka-fa-roo hee-na laa ya-kuf-foo-na anw wu-joo-hi-hi-mun naa-ra wa-laa an zu-hoo-ri-him wa-laa hum yun-sa-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ تَأۡتِيهِم بَغۡتَةٗ فَتَبۡهَتُهُمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنظَرُونَ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: بل تاتيهم بغتة فتبهتهم فلا يستطيعون ردها ولا هم ينظرون
ayahs.translation: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.
ayahs.transliteration: bal ta-tee-him bag-hta-tan fa-ta-bha-tu-hum fa-laa yas-ta-tee-o-o-na rad-da-haa wa-laa hum yun-za-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱسۡتُهۡزِئَ بِرُسُلٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُواْ مِنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد استهزئ برسل من قبلك فحاق بالذين سخروا منهم ما كانوا به يستهزءون
ayahs.translation: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qa-dis tuh-zi-a bi-ru-su-lim min qab-li-ka fa-haa-qa bil-la-zee-na sa-khi-roo mi-nhum maa kaa-noo bihee yas-tah-zioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ مَن يَكۡلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعۡرِضُونَ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: قل من يكلؤكم باليل والنهار من الرحمن بل هم عن ذكر ربهم معرضون
ayahs.translation: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
ayahs.transliteration: qul mai yak-lau-kum bil-lai-li wan-na-haa-ri mi-nar rah-maan bal hum an zik-ri rab-bi-him mu-ri-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ ءَالِهَةٞ تَمۡنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَاۚ لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصۡحَبُونَ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: ام لهم ءالهة تمنعهم من دوننا لا يستطيعون نصر انفسهم ولا هم منا يصحبون
ayahs.translation: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
ayahs.transliteration: am la-hum aa-li-ha-tun tam-nau-hum min doo-ni-naa laa yas-ta-tee-o-o-na nas-ra an-fu-si-him wa-laa hum min-na yu-sha-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡعُمُرُۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ أَنَّا نَأۡتِي ٱلۡأَرۡضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنۡ أَطۡرَافِهَآۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ ٤٤
