ayahs.text_simple: الم تر ان الله يزجي سحابا ثم يؤلف بينه ثم يجعله ركاما فتري الودق يخرج من خلله وينزل من السماء من جبال فيها من برد فيصيب به من يشاء ويصرفه عن من يشاء يكاد سنا برقه يذهب بالابصر
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that Allāh drives clouds? Then He brings them together; then He makes them into a mass, and you see the rain emerge from within it. And He sends down from the sky, mountains [of clouds] within which is hail, and He strikes with it whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills. The flash of its lightning almost takes away the eyesight.
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam ta-ra an-nal laa-ha yuz-jee sa-haa-ban sum-ma yu-a-lli-fu bai-na-hoo sum-ma ya-ja-lu-hoo ru-kaa-man fa-ta-ral wad-qa yak-hru-ju min khi-laa-lihee wayu-naz-zi-lu mi-nas sa-maaai min ji-baa-lin fee-haa mim ba-ra-din fayusee-bu bihee mai ya-shaaau wayas-ri-fu-hoo am mai ya-shaaau yak-kaa-du sa-naa bar-qihee ya-zha-bu bi-lab-saar

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُقَلِّبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةٗ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: يقلب الله اليل والنهار ان في ذلك لعبرة لاولي الابصر
ayahs.translation: Allāh alternates the night and the day. Indeed in that is a lesson for those who have vision.
ayahs.transliteration: yu-qal-li-bul laa-hul lai-la wan-na-haar in-na fee zaa-li-ka laib-ra-tal liu-lil ab-saar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَآبَّةٖ مِّن مَّآءٖۖ فَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَمۡشِي عَلَىٰ بَطۡنِهِۦ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَمۡشِي عَلَىٰ رِجۡلَيۡنِ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَمۡشِي عَلَىٰٓ أَرۡبَعٖۚ يَخۡلُقُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: والله خلق كل دابة من ماء فمنهم من يمشي علي بطنه ومنهم من يمشي علي رجلين ومنهم من يمشي علي اربع يخلق الله ما يشاء ان الله علي كل شيء قدير
ayahs.translation: Allāh has created every [living] creature from water. And of them are those that move on their bellies, and of them are those that walk on two legs, and of them are those that walk on four. Allāh creates what He wills. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-laa-hu kha-la-qa kul-la daaab-ba-tim mim maaain fa-mi-nhum mai yam-shee a-laa bat-nihee wa-mi-nhum mai yam-shee a-laa rij-laine wa-mi-nhum mai yam-shee a-laaa ar-ba yak-hlu-qul laa-hu maa ya-shaaa in-nal laa-ha a-laa kul-li shaiin qadeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّقَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَآ ءَايَٰتٖ مُّبَيِّنَٰتٖۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: لقد انزلنا ءايت مبينت والله يهدي من يشاء الي صرط مستقيم
ayahs.translation: We have certainly sent down distinct verses. And Allāh guides whom He wills to a straight path.
ayahs.transliteration: la-qad an-zal-naaa aayaa-tim mu-baiyi-naat wal-laa-hu yah-dee mai ya-shaaau i-laa si-raa-tim mus-taqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلرَّسُولِ وَأَطَعۡنَا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَۚ وَمَآ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: ويقولون ءامنا بالله وبالرسول واطعنا ثم يتولي فريق منهم من بعد ذلك وما اولئك بالمؤمنين
ayahs.translation: But they [i.e., the hypocrites] say, "We have believed in Allāh and in the Messenger, and we obey"; then a party of them turns away after that. And those are not believers.
ayahs.transliteration: waya-qoo-loo-na aa-man-naa bil-laa-hi wa-bir-ra-soo-li waa-ta-naa sum-ma ya-ta-wal-laa faree-qum mi-nhum mim ba-di zaa-lik wa-maaa u-laaai-ka bil-mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا دُعُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ لِيَحۡكُمَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ إِذَا فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُم مُّعۡرِضُونَ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: واذا دعوا الي الله ورسوله ليحكم بينهم اذا فريق منهم معرضون
ayahs.translation: And when they are called to [the words of] Allāh and His Messenger to judge between them, at once a party of them turns aside [in refusal].
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa duooo i-lal laa-hi wa-ra-soo-lihee liyah-ku-ma bai-na-hum i-zaa faree-qum mi-nhum mu-ri-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ يَأۡتُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ مُذۡعِنِينَ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: وان يكن لهم الحق ياتوا اليه مذعنين
ayahs.translation: But if the right is theirs, they come to him in prompt obedience.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-ny ya-kul la-hu-mul haq-qu yaa-tooo i-lai-hi mu-zineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَمِ ٱرۡتَابُوٓاْ أَمۡ يَخَافُونَ أَن يَحِيفَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَرَسُولُهُۥۚ بَلۡ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: افي قلوبهم مرض ام ارتابوا ام يخافون ان يحيف الله عليهم ورسوله بل اولئك هم الظلمون
ayahs.translation: Is there disease in their hearts? Or have they doubted? Or do they fear that Allāh will be unjust to them, or His Messenger? Rather, it is they who are the wrongdoers [i.e., the unjust].
ayahs.transliteration: afee qu-loo-bi-him ma-ra-dun a-mi ir-taa-booo am ya-khaa-foo-na a-ny ya-hee-fal laa-hu a-lai-him wa-ra-soo-luh bal u-laaai-ka hu-muz zaa-li-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوۡلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ إِذَا دُعُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ لِيَحۡكُمَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ أَن يَقُولُواْ سَمِعۡنَا وَأَطَعۡنَاۚ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: انما كان قول المؤمنين اذا دعوا الي الله ورسوله ليحكم بينهم ان يقولوا سمعنا واطعنا واولئك هم المفلحون
ayahs.translation: The only statement of the [true] believers when they are called to Allāh and His Messenger to judge between them is that they say, "We hear and we obey." And those are the successful.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-maa kaa-na qaw-lal mu-mi-nee-na i-zaa duooo i-lal laa-hi wa-ra-soo-lihee liyah-ku-ma bai-na-hum ai ya-qoo-loo sa-mi-naa waa-ta-naa wau-laaai-ka hu-mul muf-li-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَيَخۡشَ ٱللَّهَ وَيَتَّقۡهِ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡفَآئِزُونَ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: ومن يطع الله ورسوله ويخش الله ويتقه فاولئك هم الفائزون
ayahs.translation: And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger and fears Allāh and is conscious of Him - it is those who are the attainers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mai yu-tiil laa-ha wa-ra-soo-la-hoo wayak-hshal laa-ha wayat-ta-qhi fau-laaai-ka hu-mul faaai-zoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَأَقۡسَمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ جَهۡدَ أَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ لَئِنۡ أَمَرۡتَهُمۡ لَيَخۡرُجُنَّۖ قُل لَّا تُقۡسِمُواْۖ طَاعَةٞ مَّعۡرُوفَةٌۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: واقسموا بالله جهد ايمنهم لئن امرتهم ليخرجن قل لا تقسموا طاعة معروفة ان الله خبير بما تعملون
ayahs.translation: And they swear by Allāh their strongest oaths that if you ordered them, they would go forth [in Allāh's cause]. Say, "Do not swear. [Such] obedience is known. Indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of that which you do."
ayahs.transliteration: waaq-sa-moo bil-laa-hi jah-da ai-maa-ni-him lain a-mar-ta-hum layak-hru-jun-na qul laa tuq-si-moo taaa-tum ma-roo-fah in-nal laa-ha khabee-rum bi-maa ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱلرَّسُولَۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيۡهِ مَا حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيۡكُم مَّا حُمِّلۡتُمۡۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوهُ تَهۡتَدُواْۚ وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: قل اطيعوا الله واطيعوا الرسول فان تولوا فانما عليه ما حمل وعليكم ما حملتم وان تطيعوه تهتدوا وما علي الرسول الا البلغ المبين
ayahs.translation: Say, "Obey Allāh and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon him is only that [duty] with which he has been charged, and upon you is that with which you have been charged. And if you obey him, you will be [rightly] guided. And there is not upon the Messenger except the [responsibility for] clear notification."
ayahs.transliteration: qul atee-ul laa-ha waatee-ur ra-soo-la fain ta-wal-law fain-na-maa a-lai-hi maa hum-mi-la waa-lai-kum maa hum-mil-tum wain tu-tee-o-o-hu tah-ta-doo wa-maa a-lar ra-soo-li il-lal ba-laa-ghul mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنكُمۡ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَيَسۡتَخۡلِفَنَّهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَمَا ٱسۡتَخۡلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمۡ دِينَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي ٱرۡتَضَىٰ لَهُمۡ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ خَوۡفِهِمۡ أَمۡنٗاۚ يَعۡبُدُونَنِي لَا يُشۡرِكُونَ بِي شَيۡـٔٗاۚ وَمَن كَفَرَ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: وعد الله الذين ءامنوا منكم وعملوا الصلحت ليستخلفنهم في الارض كما استخلف الذين من قبلهم وليمكنن لهم دينهم الذي ارتضي لهم وليبدلنهم من بعد خوفهم امنا يعبدونني لا يشركون بي شيا ومن كفر بعد ذلك فاولئك هم الفسقون
ayahs.translation: Allāh has promised those who have believed among you and done righteous deeds that He will surely grant them succession [to authority] upon the earth just as He granted it to those before them and that He will surely establish for them [therein] their religion which He has preferred for them and that He will surely substitute for them, after their fear, security, [for] they worship Me, not associating anything with Me. But whoever disbelieves after that - then those are the defiantly disobedient.
ayahs.transliteration: waa-dal laa-hul lazee-na aa-ma-noo min-kum waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti layas-tak-hli-fan-na-hum fil ar-di ka-mas tak-hla-fal lazee-na min qab-li-him wa-layu-mak-ki-nan-na la-hum dee-na-hu-mul la-zir ta-daa la-hum wa-layu-bad-di-lan-na-hum mim ba-di khaw-fi-him am-naa ya-bu-doo-na-nee laa yus-hri-koo-na bee shai-a-a wa-man ka-fa-ra ba-da zaa-li-ka fau-laaai-ka hu-mul faa-si-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱلرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: واقيموا الصلوة وءاتوا الزكوة واطيعوا الرسول لعلكم ترحمون
ayahs.translation: And establish prayer and give zakāh and obey the Messenger - that you may receive mercy.
ayahs.transliteration: waaqee-mus sa-laa-ta waaa-tuz za-kaa-ta waatee-ur ra-soo-la laal-la-kum tu-rha-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَمَأۡوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُۖ وَلَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: لا تحسبن الذين كفروا معجزين في الارض وماويهم النار ولبئس المصير
ayahs.translation: Never think that the disbelievers are causing failure [to Allāh] upon the earth. Their refuge will be the Fire - and how wretched the destination.
ayahs.transliteration: laa tah-sa-ban-nal lazee-na ka-fa-roo mu-ji-zee-na fil ard wa-maa-waa-hu-mun naa-ru wa-la-bi-sal maseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لِيَسۡتَـٔۡذِنكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُكُمۡ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَمۡ يَبۡلُغُواْ ٱلۡحُلُمَ مِنكُمۡ ثَلَٰثَ مَرَّٰتٖۚ مِّن قَبۡلِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلۡفَجۡرِ وَحِينَ تَضَعُونَ ثِيَابَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظَّهِيرَةِ وَمِنۢ بَعۡدِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلۡعِشَآءِۚ ثَلَٰثُ عَوۡرَٰتٖ لَّكُمۡۚ لَيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَلَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ جُنَاحُۢ بَعۡدَهُنَّۚ طَوَّٰفُونَ عَلَيۡكُم بَعۡضُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: يايها الذين ءامنوا ليستذنكم الذين ملكت ايمنكم والذين لم يبلغوا الحلم منكم ثلث مرت من قبل صلوة الفجر وحين تضعون ثيابكم من الظهيرة ومن بعد صلوة العشاء ثلث عورت لكم ليس عليكم ولا عليهم جناح بعدهن طوفون عليكم بعضكم علي بعض كذلك يبين الله لكم الايت والله عليم حكيم
ayahs.translation: O you who have believed, let those whom your right hands possess and those who have not [yet] reached puberty among you ask permission of you [before entering] at three times: before the dawn prayer and when you put aside your clothing [for rest] at noon and after the night prayer. [These are] three times of privacy for you. There is no blame upon you nor upon them beyond these [periods], for they continually circulate among you - some of you, among others. Thus does Allāh make clear to you the verses [i.e., His ordinances]; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaaiyu-hal lazee-na aa-ma-noo liyas-ta-zin-ku-mul lazee-na ma-la-kat ai-maa-nu-kum wal-la-zee-na lam yab-lu-ghul hu-lu-ma min-kum sa-laa-sa mar-raat min qab-li sa-laa-til faj-ri wahee-na ta-daoo-na siyaa-ba-kum mi-naz zahee-ra-ti wa-min ba-di sa-laa-til i-shaaa sa-laa-su aw-raa-til la-kum lai-sa a-lai-kum wa-laa a-lai-him ju-naa-hun ba-da-hunn taw-waa-foo-na a-lai-kum ba-du-kum a-laa bad ka-zaa-li-ka yu-baiyi-nul laa-hu la-ku-mul aayaat wal-la-hu alee-mun hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا بَلَغَ ٱلۡأَطۡفَٰلُ مِنكُمُ ٱلۡحُلُمَ فَلۡيَسۡتَـٔۡذِنُواْ كَمَا ٱسۡتَـٔۡذَنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: واذا بلغ الاطفل منكم الحلم فليستذنوا كما استذن الذين من قبلهم كذلك يبين الله لكم ءايته والله عليم حكيم
ayahs.translation: And when the children among you reach puberty, let them ask permission [at all times] as those before them have done. Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa ba-la-ghal at-faa-lu min-ku-mul hu-lu-ma fa-lyas-ta-zi-noo ka-mas ta-za-nal lazee-na min qab-li-him ka-zaa-li-ka yu-baiyi-nul laa-hu la-kum aayaa-tih wal-laa-hu alee-mun hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡقَوَٰعِدُ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ٱلَّٰتِي لَا يَرۡجُونَ نِكَاحٗا فَلَيۡسَ عَلَيۡهِنَّ جُنَاحٌ أَن يَضَعۡنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيۡرَ مُتَبَرِّجَٰتِۭ بِزِينَةٖۖ وَأَن يَسۡتَعۡفِفۡنَ خَيۡرٞ لَّهُنَّۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٞ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: والقوعد من النساء التي لا يرجون نكاحا فليس عليهن جناح ان يضعن ثيابهن غير متبرجت بزينة وان يستعففن خير لهن والله سميع عليم
ayahs.translation: And women of post-menstrual age who have no desire for marriage - there is no blame upon them for putting aside their outer garments [but] not displaying adornment. But to modestly refrain [from that] is better for them. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-qa-waai-du mi-nan ni-saaail laatee laa yar-joo-na ni-kaa-han fa-lai-sa a-lai-hin-na ju-naa-hun ai ya-da-na siyaa-ba-hun-na ghai-ra mu-ta-bar-ri-jaa-tin bizee-nah waai yas-ta-fif-na khai-rul la-hunn wal-laa-hu samee-un aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّيۡسَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ حَرَجٞ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡرَجِ حَرَجٞ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡمَرِيضِ حَرَجٞ وَلَا عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَن تَأۡكُلُواْ مِنۢ بُيُوتِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ ءَابَآئِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ إِخۡوَٰنِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ أَخَوَٰتِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ أَعۡمَٰمِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ عَمَّٰتِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ أَخۡوَٰلِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ خَٰلَٰتِكُمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكۡتُم مَّفَاتِحَهُۥٓ أَوۡ صَدِيقِكُمۡۚ لَيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَأۡكُلُواْ جَمِيعًا أَوۡ أَشۡتَاتٗاۚ فَإِذَا دَخَلۡتُم بُيُوتٗا فَسَلِّمُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ تَحِيَّةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَٰرَكَةٗ طَيِّبَةٗۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: ليس علي الاعمي حرج ولا علي الاعرج حرج ولا علي المريض حرج ولا علي انفسكم ان تاكلوا من بيوتكم او بيوت ءابائكم او بيوت امهتكم او بيوت اخونكم او بيوت اخوتكم او بيوت اعممكم او بيوت عمتكم او بيوت اخولكم او بيوت خلتكم او ما ملكتم مفاتحه او صديقكم ليس عليكم جناح ان تاكلوا جميعا او اشتاتا فاذا دخلتم بيوتا فسلموا علي انفسكم تحية من عند الله مبركة طيبة كذلك يبين الله لكم الايت لعلكم تعقلون
ayahs.translation: There is not upon the blind [any] constraint nor upon the lame constraint nor upon the ill constraint nor upon yourselves when you eat from your [own] houses or the houses of your fathers or the houses of your mothers or the houses of your brothers or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your father's brothers or the houses of your father's sisters or the houses of your mother's brothers or the houses of your mother's sisters or [from houses] whose keys you possess or [from the house] of your friend. There is no blame upon you whether you eat together or separately. But when you enter houses, give greetings of peace upon each other - a greeting from Allāh, blessed and good. Thus does Allāh make clear to you the verses [of ordinance] that you may understand.
ayahs.transliteration: lai-sa a-lal a-maa ha-ra-junw wa-laa a-lal a-ra-ji ha-ra-junw wa-laa a-lal maree-di ha-ra-jun wa-laa a-laa an-fu-si-kum an ta-ku-loo min buyoo-ti-kum aw buyoo-ti aa-baaai-kum aw buyoo-ti um-ma-haa-ti-kum aw buyoo-ti ik-hwaa-ni-kum aw buyoo-ti a-kha-waa-ti-kum aw buyoo-ti a-maa-mi-kum aw buyoo-ti am-maa-ti-kum aw buyoo-ti ak-hwaa-li-kum aw buyoo-ti khaa-laa-ti-kum aw maa ma-lak-tum ma-faa-ti-ha-hooo aw sadee-qi-kum lai-sa a-lai-kum ju-naa-hun an ta-ku-loo jameean aw as-htaa-ta fai-zaa da-khal-tum buyoo-tan fa-sal-li-moo a-laaa an-fu-si-kum ta-hiyya-tan min in-dil laa-hi mu-baa-ra-ka-tan taiyi-bah ka-zaa-li-ka yu-baiyi-nul laa-hu la-ku-mul aayaa-ti laal-la-kum ta-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَإِذَا كَانُواْ مَعَهُۥ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرٖ جَامِعٖ لَّمۡ يَذۡهَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يَسۡتَـٔۡذِنُوهُۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَـٔۡذِنُونَكَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦۚ فَإِذَا ٱسۡتَـٔۡذَنُوكَ لِبَعۡضِ شَأۡنِهِمۡ فَأۡذَن لِّمَن شِئۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَهُمُ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: انما المؤمنون الذين ءامنوا بالله ورسوله واذا كانوا معه علي امر جامع لم يذهبوا حتي يستذنوه ان الذين يستذنونك اولئك الذين يؤمنون بالله ورسوله فاذا استذنوك لبعض شانهم فاذن لمن شئت منهم واستغفر لهم الله ان الله غفور رحيم
ayahs.translation: The believers are only those who believe in Allāh and His Messenger and, when they are [meeting] with him for a matter of common interest, do not depart until they have asked his permission. Indeed, those who ask your permission, [O Muḥammad] - those are the ones who believe in Allāh and His Messenger. So when they ask your permission due to something of their affairs, then give permission to whom you will among them and ask forgiveness for them of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-mal mu-mi-noo-nal lazee-na aa-ma-noo bil-laa-hi wa-ra-soo-lihee wai-zaa kaa-noo maa-hoo a-laaa am-rin jaa-miil lam ya-zha-boo hat-taa yas-ta-zi-nooh in-nal lazee-na yas-ta-zi-noo-na-ka u-laaai-kal lazee-na yu-mi-noo-na bil-laa-hi wa-ra-soo-lih fai-zas ta-za-noo-ka li-ba-di sha-ni-him fa-zal li-man shi-ta mi-nhum was-tag-hfir la-hu-mul laah in-nal laa-ha gha-foo-rur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا تَجۡعَلُواْ دُعَآءَ ٱلرَّسُولِ بَيۡنَكُمۡ كَدُعَآءِ بَعۡضِكُم بَعۡضٗاۚ قَدۡ يَعۡلَمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَسَلَّلُونَ مِنكُمۡ لِوَاذٗاۚ فَلۡيَحۡذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَ عَنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦٓ أَن تُصِيبَهُمۡ فِتۡنَةٌ أَوۡ يُصِيبَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ ٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: لا تجعلوا دعاء الرسول بينكم كدعاء بعضكم بعضا قد يعلم الله الذين يتسللون منكم لواذا فليحذر الذين يخالفون عن امره ان تصيبهم فتنة او يصيبهم عذاب اليم
ayahs.translation: Do not make [your] calling of the Messenger among yourselves as the call of one of you to another. Already Allāh knows those of you who slip away, concealed by others. So let those beware who dissent from his [i.e., the Prophet's] order, lest fitnah strike them or a painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: laa ta-ja-loo du-a-aaar ra-soo-li bai-na-kum ka-du-a-aai ba-di-kum ba-daa qad ya-la-mul laa-hul lazee-na ya-ta-sal-la-loo-na min-kum li-waa-zaa fa-lyah-za-ril lazee-na yu-khaa-li-foo-na an am-riheee an tusee-ba-hum fit-na-tun aw yu-see-ba-hum a-zaa-bun aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ قَدۡ يَعۡلَمُ مَآ أَنتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَيَوۡمَ يُرۡجَعُونَ إِلَيۡهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُواْۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمُۢ ٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: الا ان لله ما في السموت والارض قد يعلم ما انتم عليه ويوم يرجعون اليه فينبئهم بما عملوا والله بكل شيء عليم
ayahs.translation: Unquestionably, to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Already He knows that upon which you [stand] and [knows] the Day when they will be returned to Him and He will inform them of what they have done. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.
ayahs.transliteration: a-laaa in-na lil-laa-hi maa fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di qad ya-la-mu maaa an-tum a-lai-hi wayaw-ma yur-jaoo-na i-lai-hi fayu-nab-biu-hum bi-maa a-mi-loo wal-laa-hu bi-kul-li shaiin aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي نَزَّلَ ٱلۡفُرۡقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِۦ لِيَكُونَ لِلۡعَٰلَمِينَ نَذِيرًا ١
ayahs.text_simple: تبارك الذي نزل الفرقان علي عبده ليكون للعلمين نذيرا
ayahs.translation: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant that he may be to the worlds a warner -
ayahs.transliteration: ta-baa-ra-kal lazee naz-za-lal fur-qaa-na a-laa ab-dihee liya-koo-na li-laa-la-mee-na nazee-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَمۡ يَتَّخِذۡ وَلَدٗا وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٞ فِي ٱلۡمُلۡكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ تَقۡدِيرٗا ٢
ayahs.text_simple: الذي له ملك السموت والارض ولم يتخذ ولدا ولم يكن له شريك في الملك وخلق كل شيء فقدره تقديرا
ayahs.translation: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and who has not taken a son and has not had a partner in dominion and has created each thing and determined it with [precise] determination.
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee la-hoo mul-kus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di wa-lam yat-ta-khiz wa-la-danw wa-lam ya-kul la-hoo sharee-kun fil mul-ki wa-kha-la-qa kul-la shaiin fa-qad-da-ra-hoo taq-dee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةٗ لَّا يَخۡلُقُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمۡلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمۡ ضَرّٗا وَلَا نَفۡعٗا وَلَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مَوۡتٗا وَلَا حَيَوٰةٗ وَلَا نُشُورٗا ٣
ayahs.text_simple: واتخذوا من دونه ءالهة لا يخلقون شيا وهم يخلقون ولا يملكون لانفسهم ضرا ولا نفعا ولا يملكون موتا ولا حيوة ولا نشورا
ayahs.translation: But they have taken besides Him gods which create nothing, while they are created, and possess not for themselves any harm or benefit and possess not [power to cause] death or life or resurrection.
ayahs.transliteration: wat-ta-kha-zoo min doo-niheee aa-li-ha-tal laa yak-hlu-qoo-na shai-anw wa-hum yuk-hla-qoo-na wa-laa yam-li-koo-na li-a-nfu-si-him dar-ranw wa-laa naf anw wa-laa yam-li-koo-na maw-tanw wa-laa hayaa-tanw wa-laa nu-shoo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفۡكٌ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُ وَأَعَانَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِ قَوۡمٌ ءَاخَرُونَۖ فَقَدۡ جَآءُو ظُلۡمٗا وَزُورٗا ٤
ayahs.text_simple: وقال الذين كفروا ان هذا الا افك افتريه واعانه عليه قوم ءاخرون فقد جاءو ظلما وزورا
ayahs.translation: And those who disbelieve say, "This [Qur’ān] is not except a falsehood he invented, and another people assisted him in it." But they have committed an injustice and a lie.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-lal lazee-na ka-fa-rooo in haa-zaaa il-laaa if-ku-nif ta-raa-hu waaaa-na-hoo a-lai-hi qaw-mun aa-kha-roo-na fa-qad jaaaoo zul-manw wa-zoo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓاْ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ٱكۡتَتَبَهَا فَهِيَ تُمۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ بُكۡرَةٗ وَأَصِيلٗا ٥
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا اسطير الاولين اكتتبها فهي تملي عليه بكرة واصيلا
ayahs.translation: And they say, "Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-looo a-saa-tee-rul aw-wa-lee-nak ta-ta-ba-haa fa-hiya tum-laa a-lai-hi buk-ra-tanw waasee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أَنزَلَهُ ٱلَّذِي يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا ٦
ayahs.text_simple: قل انزله الذي يعلم السر في السموت والارض انه كان غفورا رحيما
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed by He who knows [every] secret within the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving and Merciful."
ayahs.transliteration: qul an-za-lhul lazee ya-la-mus sir-ra fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lard in-na-hoo kaa-na gha-foo-rar rahee-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ مَالِ هَٰذَا ٱلرَّسُولِ يَأۡكُلُ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمۡشِي فِي ٱلۡأَسۡوَاقِ لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡهِ مَلَكٞ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُۥ نَذِيرًا ٧
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا مال هذا الرسول ياكل الطعام ويمشي في الاسواق لولا انزل اليه ملك فيكون معه نذيرا
ayahs.translation: And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets? Why was there not sent down to him an angel so he would be with him a warner?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-loo maa-li haa-zar ra-soo-li ya-ku-lut taaa-ma wayam-shee fil as-waaq law-laaa un-zi-la i-lai-hi ma-la-kun faya-koo-na maa-hoo nazee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوۡ يُلۡقَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِ كَنزٌ أَوۡ تَكُونُ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٞ يَأۡكُلُ مِنۡهَاۚ وَقَالَ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلٗا مَّسۡحُورًا ٨
ayahs.text_simple: او يلقي اليه كنز او تكون له جنة ياكل منها وقال الظلمون ان تتبعون الا رجلا مسحورا
ayahs.translation: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."
ayahs.transliteration: aw yul-qaaa i-lai-hi kan-zun aw ta-koo-nu la-hoo jan-na-tu-ny ya-ku-lu mi-nhaa wa-qaa-laz zaa-li-moo-na in tat-ta-bioo-na il-laa ra-ju-lan ma-shoo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبُواْ لَكَ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلَ فَضَلُّواْ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلٗا ٩
ayahs.text_simple: انظر كيف ضربوا لك الامثل فضلوا فلا يستطيعون سبيلا
ayahs.translation: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
ayahs.transliteration: un-zur kai-fa da-ra-boo la-kal am-saa-la fa-dal-loo fa-laa yas-ta-tee-o-o-na sabee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِيٓ إِن شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيۡرٗا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكَ قُصُورَۢا ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: تبارك الذي ان شاء جعل لك خيرا من ذلك جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر ويجعل لك قصورا
ayahs.translation: Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you [something] better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces.
ayahs.transliteration: ta-baa-ra-kal lazeee in shaaaa jaa-la la-ka khai-ran min zaa-li-ka jan-naa-tin taj-ree min tah-ti-hal a-nhaa-ru waya-jal la-ka qu-soo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلسَّاعَةِۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا ١١
ayahs.text_simple: بل كذبوا بالساعة واعتدنا لمن كذب بالساعة سعيرا
ayahs.translation: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.
ayahs.transliteration: bal kaz-za-boo bis-saaa-ti waa-tad-naa li-man kaz-za-ba bis-saaa-ti saee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذَا رَأَتۡهُم مِّن مَّكَانِۭ بَعِيدٖ سَمِعُواْ لَهَا تَغَيُّظٗا وَزَفِيرٗا ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: اذا راتهم من مكان بعيد سمعوا لها تغيظا وزفيرا
ayahs.translation: When it [i.e., the Hellfire] sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.
ayahs.transliteration: i-zaa raa-thum min ma-kaa-nin baee-din sa-mioo la-haa ta-ghaiyu-zanw wa-za-fee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَآ أُلۡقُواْ مِنۡهَا مَكَانٗا ضَيِّقٗا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوۡاْ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورٗا ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: واذا القوا منها مكانا ضيقا مقرنين دعوا هنالك ثبورا
ayahs.translation: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaaa ul-qoo mi-nhaa ma-kaa-nan daiyi-qam mu-qar-ra-nee-na daaw hu-naa-li-ka thu-boo-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا تَدۡعُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ ثُبُورٗا وَٰحِدٗا وَٱدۡعُواْ ثُبُورٗا كَثِيرٗا ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: لا تدعوا اليوم ثبورا وحدا وادعوا ثبورا كثيرا
ayahs.translation: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."
ayahs.transliteration: laa ta-dul yaw-ma thu-boo-ranw waa-hi-danw wa-doo thu-boo-ran kasee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ جَنَّةُ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ ٱلَّتِي وُعِدَ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَۚ كَانَتۡ لَهُمۡ جَزَآءٗ وَمَصِيرٗا ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: قل اذلك خير ام جنة الخلد التي وعد المتقون كانت لهم جزاء ومصيرا
ayahs.translation: Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination.
ayahs.transliteration: qul a-zaa-li-ka khai-run am jan-na-tul khul-dil latee wu-i-dal mut-ta-qoon kaa-nat la-hum ja-zaaaanw wa-ma-see-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّهُمۡ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَٰلِدِينَۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعۡدٗا مَّسۡـُٔولٗا ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: لهم فيها ما يشاءون خلدين كان علي ربك وعدا مسولا
ayahs.translation: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested.
ayahs.transliteration: la-hum fee-haa maa ya-shaaaoo-na khaa-lideen kaa-na a-laa rab-bi-ka wa-dan ma-soo-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَوۡمَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنتُمۡ أَضۡلَلۡتُمۡ عِبَادِي هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَمۡ هُمۡ ضَلُّواْ ٱلسَّبِيلَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: ويوم يحشرهم وما يعبدون من دون الله فيقول ءانتم اضللتم عبادي هؤلاء ام هم ضلوا السبيل
ayahs.translation: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allāh and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way?"
ayahs.transliteration: wayaw-ma yah-shu-ru-hum wa-maa ya-bu-doo-na min doo-nil laa-hi faya-qoo-lu aan-tum ad-lal-tum i-baadee haaau-laaai am hum dal-lus sabeel

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢبَغِي لَنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَ وَلَٰكِن مَّتَّعۡتَهُمۡ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ نَسُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَكَانُواْ قَوۡمَۢا بُورٗا ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا سبحنك ما كان ينبغي لنا ان نتخذ من دونك من اولياء ولكن متعتهم وءاباءهم حتي نسوا الذكر وكانوا قوما بورا
ayahs.translation: They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies [i.e., protectors]. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo su-bhaa-na-ka maa kaa-na yan-ba-ghee la-naaa an nat-ta-khi-za min doo-ni-ka min aw-liyaaaa wa-laa-kin mat-ta-ta-hum waaa-baaaa-hum hat-taa na-sooz zik-ra wa-kaa-noo qaw-man boo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسۡتَطِيعُونَ صَرۡفٗا وَلَا نَصۡرٗاۚ وَمَن يَظۡلِم مِّنكُمۡ نُذِقۡهُ عَذَابٗا كَبِيرٗا ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: فقد كذبوكم بما تقولون فما تستطيعون صرفا ولا نصرا ومن يظلم منكم نذقه عذابا كبيرا
ayahs.translation: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say, and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qad kaz-za-boo-kum bi-maa ta-qoo-loo-na fa-maa tas-ta-tee-o-o-na sar-fanw wa-laa nas-raa wa-ma-ny yaz-lim min-kum nu-zi-qhu a-zaa-ban kabee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ لَيَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمۡشُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡوَاقِۗ وَجَعَلۡنَا بَعۡضَكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٖ فِتۡنَةً أَتَصۡبِرُونَۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرٗا ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: وما ارسلنا قبلك من المرسلين الا انهم لياكلون الطعام ويمشون في الاسواق وجعلنا بعضكم لبعض فتنة اتصبرون وكان ربك بصيرا
ayahs.translation: And We did not send before you, [O Muḥammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa ar-sal-naa qab-la-ka mi-nal mur-sa-lee-na il-laaa in-na-hum laya-ku-loo-nat taaa-ma wayam-shoo-na fil as-waaq wa-jaal-naa ba-da-kum li-ba-din fit-na-tan a-tas-bi-roon wa-kaa-na rab-bu-ka basee-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡنَا ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوۡ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَاۗ لَقَدِ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ فِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَعَتَوۡ عُتُوّٗا كَبِيرٗا ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: وقال الذين لا يرجون لقاءنا لولا انزل علينا الملئكة او نري ربنا لقد استكبروا في انفسهم وعتو عتوا كبيرا
ayahs.translation: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves and [become] insolent with great insolence.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-lal lazee-na laa yar-joo-na li-qaaaa-naa law-laaa un-zi-la a-lai-nal ma-laaai-ka-tu aw na-raa rab-ba-naa la-qa-dis tak-ba-roo feee an-fu-si-him waa-taw u-tuw-wan kabee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشۡرَىٰ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجۡرٗا مَّحۡجُورٗا ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: يوم يرون الملئكة لا بشري يومئذ للمجرمين ويقولون حجرا محجورا
ayahs.translation: The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma ya-raw-nal ma-laaai-ka-ta laa bus-hraa yaw-mai-zin lil-muj-ri-mee-na waya-qoo-loo-na hij-ran mah-joo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَدِمۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُواْ مِنۡ عَمَلٖ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ هَبَآءٗ مَّنثُورًا ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: وقدمنا الي ما عملوا من عمل فجعلنه هباء منثورا
ayahs.translation: And We will approach [i.e., regard] what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qa-dim-naaa i-laa maa a-mi-loo min a-ma-lin fa-jaal-naa-hu ha-baaaan man-thoo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ يَوۡمَئِذٍ خَيۡرٞ مُّسۡتَقَرّٗا وَأَحۡسَنُ مَقِيلٗا ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: اصحب الجنة يومئذ خير مستقرا واحسن مقيلا
ayahs.translation: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.
ayahs.transliteration: a-shaa-bul jan-na-ti yaw-mai-zin khai-run mus-ta-qar-ranw waah-sa-nu maqee-la

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلۡغَمَٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: ويوم تشقق السماء بالغمم ونزل الملئكة تنزيلا
ayahs.translation: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.
ayahs.transliteration: wayaw-ma ta-shaq-qa-qus sa-maaau bil-gha-maa-mi wa-nuz-zi-lal ma-laaai-ka-tu tan-zee-la

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلۡمُلۡكُ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ٱلۡحَقُّ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ وَكَانَ يَوۡمًا عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرٗا ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: الملك يومئذ الحق للرحمن وكان يوما علي الكفرين عسيرا
ayahs.translation: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.
ayahs.transliteration: al-mul-ku yaw-mai-zi-nil haq-qu lir rah-maan wa-kaa-na yaw-ma-na-lal kaa-fi-ree-na asee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَوۡمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيۡهِ يَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي ٱتَّخَذۡتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلٗا ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: ويوم يعض الظالم علي يديه يقول يليتني اتخذت مع الرسول سبيلا
ayahs.translation: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.
ayahs.transliteration: wayaw-ma yaad-duz zaa-li-mu a-laa ya-dai-hi ya-qoo-lu yaa-lai-ta-nit ta-khaz-tu maar ra-soo-li sabee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰوَيۡلَتَىٰ لَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أَتَّخِذۡ فُلَانًا خَلِيلٗا ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: يويلتي ليتني لم اتخذ فلانا خليلا
ayahs.translation: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend.
ayahs.transliteration: yaa-wai-la-taa lai-tanee lam at-ta-khiz fu-laa-nan khalee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّقَدۡ أَضَلَّنِي عَنِ ٱلذِّكۡرِ بَعۡدَ إِذۡ جَآءَنِيۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ خَذُولٗا ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: لقد اضلني عن الذكر بعد اذ جاءني وكان الشيطن للانسن خذولا
ayahs.translation: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."
ayahs.transliteration: la-qad a-dal-lanee a-niz zik-ri ba-da iz jaaaanee wa-kaa-nash shai-taa-nu li-lin-saa-ni kha-zoo-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوۡمِي ٱتَّخَذُواْ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ مَهۡجُورٗا ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: وقال الرسول يرب ان قومي اتخذوا هذا القرءان مهجورا
ayahs.translation: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur’ān as [a thing] abandoned."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-lar ra-soo-lu yaa-rab-bi in-na qaw-mit ta-kha-zoo haa-zal qu-raa-na mah-joo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلۡنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوّٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيٗا وَنَصِيرٗا ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: وكذلك جعلنا لكل نبي عدوا من المجرمين وكفي بربك هاديا ونصيرا
ayahs.translation: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ka-zaa-li-ka jaal-naa li-kul-li na-biyyin a-duw-wan mi-nal muj-rimeen wa-ka-faa bi-rab-bi-ka haa-diyanw wa-na-see-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ جُمۡلَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَۖ وَرَتَّلۡنَٰهُ تَرۡتِيلٗا ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: وقال الذين كفروا لولا نزل عليه القرءان جملة وحدة كذلك لنثبت به فؤادك ورتلنه ترتيلا
ayahs.translation: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur’ān not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-lal lazee-na ka-fa-roo law-laa nuz-zi-la a-lai-hil qu-raa-nu jum-la-tanw waa-hi-dah ka-zaa-li-ka li-nu-sab-bi-ta bihee fu-a-a-da-ka wa-rat-tal-naa-hu tar-tee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا يَأۡتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَحۡسَنَ تَفۡسِيرًا ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولا ياتونك بمثل الا جئنك بالحق واحسن تفسيرا
ayahs.translation: And they do not come to you with an example [i.e., argument] except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa ya-too-na-ka bi-ma-sa-lin il-laa ji-naa-ka bi-lhaq-qi waah-sa-na taf-see-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحۡشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ شَرّٞ مَّكَانٗا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلٗا ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: الذين يحشرون علي وجوههم الي جهنم اولئك شر مكانا واضل سبيلا
ayahs.translation: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na yuh-sha-roo-na a-laa wu-joo-hi-him i-laa ja-han-na-ma u-laaai-ka shar-run ma-kaa-nanw waa-dal-lu sabee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلۡنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ وَزِيرٗا ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ءاتينا موسي الكتب وجعلنا معه اخاه هرون وزيرا
ayahs.translation: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad aa-tai-naa moo-sal ki-taa-ba wa-jaal-naa maa-hooo a-khaa-hu haa-roo-na wazee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقُلۡنَا ٱذۡهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرۡنَٰهُمۡ تَدۡمِيرٗا ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: فقلنا اذهبا الي القوم الذين كذبوا بايتنا فدمرنهم تدميرا
ayahs.translation: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qul-naz ha-baaa i-lal qaw-mil lazee-na kaz-za-boo bi-a-ayaa-ti-naa fa-dam-mar-naa-hum tad-mee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُواْ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةٗۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: وقوم نوح لما كذبوا الرسل اغرقنهم وجعلنهم للناس ءاية واعتدنا للظلمين عذابا اليما
ayahs.translation: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaw-ma noo-hin lam-maa kaz-za-bur ru-su-la ag-hraq-naa-hum wa-jaal-naa-hum lin-naa-si aaya-tanw waa-tad-naa liz-zaa-li-mee-na a-zaa-ban alee-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَعَادٗا وَثَمُودَاْ وَأَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونَۢا بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرٗا ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: وعادا وثمودا واصحب الرس وقرونا بين ذلك كثيرا
ayahs.translation: And [We destroyed] ʿAad and Thamūd and the companions of the well and many generations between them.
ayahs.transliteration: waaa-danw wa-sa-moo-da waa-shaa-bar ras-si wa-qu-roo-nan bai-na zaa-li-ka ka-thee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكُلّٗا ضَرَبۡنَا لَهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلَۖ وَكُلّٗا تَبَّرۡنَا تَتۡبِيرٗا ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: وكلا ضربنا له الامثل وكلا تبرنا تتبيرا
ayahs.translation: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kul-lan da-rab-naa la-hul am-saa-la wa-kul-lan tab-bar-naa tat-bee-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَتَوۡاْ عَلَى ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُمۡطِرَتۡ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوۡءِۚ أَفَلَمۡ يَكُونُواْ يَرَوۡنَهَاۚ بَلۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ نُشُورٗا ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد اتوا علي القرية التي امطرت مطر السوء افلم يكونوا يرونها بل كانوا لا يرجون نشورا
ayahs.translation: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil [i.e., stones]. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad a-taw a-lal qa-rya-til lateee um-ti-rat ma-ta-ras saw a-fa-lam ya-koo-noo ya-raw-na-haa bal kaa-noo laa yar-joo-na nu-shoo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: واذا راوك ان يتخذونك الا هزوا اهذا الذي بعث الله رسولا
ayahs.translation: And when they see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allāh has sent as a messenger?
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa raaw-ka i-ny yat-ta-khi-zoo-na-ka il-laa hu-zu-wan a-haa-zal lazee baa-sal laa-hu ra-soo-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنۡ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوۡلَآ أَن صَبَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهَاۚ وَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوۡنَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ مَنۡ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: ان كاد ليضلنا عن ءالهتنا لولا ان صبرنا عليها وسوف يعلمون حين يرون العذاب من اضل سبيلا
ayahs.translation: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.
ayahs.transliteration: in kaa-da layu-dil-lu-naa an aa-li-ha-ti-naa law-laaa an sa-bar-naa a-lai-haa wa-saw-fa ya-la-moo-na hee-na ya-raw-nal a-zaa-ba man a-dal-lu sabee-la

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَرَءَيۡتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيۡهِ وَكِيلًا ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: ارءيت من اتخذ الهه هويه افانت تكون عليه وكيلا
ayahs.translation: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?
ayahs.transliteration: a-raai-ta ma-nit ta-kha-za i-laa-ha-hoo ha-waa-hu a-faan-ta ta-koo-nu a-lai-hi wakee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ تَحۡسَبُ أَنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ يَسۡمَعُونَ أَوۡ يَعۡقِلُونَۚ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا كَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ بَلۡ هُمۡ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: ام تحسب ان اكثرهم يسمعون او يعقلون ان هم الا كالانعم بل هم اضل سبيلا
ayahs.translation: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.
ayahs.transliteration: am tah-sa-bu an-na ak-sa-ra-hum yas-maoo-na aw ya-qi-loon in hum il-laa ka-la-naa-mi bal hum a-dal-lu sabee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيۡفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنٗا ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَا ٱلشَّمۡسَ عَلَيۡهِ دَلِيلٗا ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: الم تر الي ربك كيف مد الظل ولو شاء لجعله ساكنا ثم جعلنا الشمس عليه دليلا
ayahs.translation: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam ta-ra i-laa rab-bi-ka kai-fa mad-daz zil-la wa-law shaaaa la-jaa-la-hoo saa-ki-nan thum-ma jaal-nash sham-sa a-lai-hi dalee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ قَبَضۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡنَا قَبۡضٗا يَسِيرٗا ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: ثم قبضنه الينا قبضا يسيرا
ayahs.translation: Then We [retract and] hold it with Us for a brief grasp.
ayahs.transliteration: thum-ma qa-bad-naa-hu i-lai-naa qab-da-ny ya-see-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ لِبَاسٗا وَٱلنَّوۡمَ سُبَاتٗا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورٗا ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: وهو الذي جعل لكم اليل لباسا والنوم سباتا وجعل النهار نشورا
ayahs.translation: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wal lazee jaa-la la-ku-mul lai-la li-baa-sanw wan-naw-ma su-baa-tanw wa-jaa-lan na-haa-ra nu-shoo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَرۡسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشۡرَۢا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ طَهُورٗا ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: وهو الذي ارسل الريح بشرا بين يدي رحمته وانزلنا من السماء ماء طهورا
ayahs.translation: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy [i.e., rainfall], and We send down from the sky pure water
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wal lazeee ar-sa-lar riyaa-ha bus-hran bai-na ya-dai rah-ma-tih waan-zal-naa mi-nas sa-maaai maaaan ta-hoo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِّنُحۡـِۧيَ بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةٗ مَّيۡتٗا وَنُسۡقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقۡنَآ أَنۡعَٰمٗا وَأَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيرٗا ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: لنحي به بلدة ميتا ونسقيه مما خلقنا انعما واناسي كثيرا
ayahs.translation: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.
ayahs.transliteration: li-nu-hyiya bihee bal-da-tan mai-tan-wwa nus-qiya-hoo mim-maa kha-laq-naaa a-naa-manw waa-naa-siyya ka-thee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنَٰهُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ لِيَذَّكَّرُواْ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورٗا ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد صرفنه بينهم ليذكروا فابي اكثر الناس الا كفورا
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad sar-raf-naa-hu bai-na-hum liyaz-zak-ka-roo faa-baaa ak-sa-run naa-si il-laa ku-foo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡ شِئۡنَا لَبَعَثۡنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرۡيَةٖ نَّذِيرٗا ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: ولو شئنا لبعثنا في كل قرية نذيرا
ayahs.translation: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law shi-naa la-baas-naa fee kul-li qa-rya-tin nazee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ وَجَٰهِدۡهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادٗا كَبِيرٗا ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: فلا تطع الكفرين وجهدهم به جهادا كبيرا
ayahs.translation: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a great striving.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-laa tu-tiil kaa-fi-ree-na wa-jaa-hi-dhum bihee ji-haa-dan kabee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي مَرَجَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ هَٰذَا عَذۡبٞ فُرَاتٞ وَهَٰذَا مِلۡحٌ أُجَاجٞ وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخٗا وَحِجۡرٗا مَّحۡجُورٗا ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: وهو الذي مرج البحرين هذا عذب فرات وهذا ملح اجاج وجعل بينهما برزخا وحجرا محجورا
ayahs.translation: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas [i.e., bodies of water], one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wal lazee ma-ra-jal bah-rai-ni haa-zaa az-bun fu-raa-tunw wa-haa-zaa mi-lhun u-jaaj wa-jaa-la bai-na-hu-maa bar-za-khanw wa-hij-ran mah-joo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِ بَشَرٗا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبٗا وَصِهۡرٗاۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرٗا ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: وهو الذي خلق من الماء بشرا فجعله نسبا وصهرا وكان ربك قديرا
ayahs.translation: And it is He who has created from water [i.e., semen] a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wal lazee kha-la-qa mi-nal maaai ba-sha-ran fa-jaa-la-hoo na-sa-ban wa-sih-raa wa-kaa-na rab-bu-ka qadee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمۡ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمۡۗ وَكَانَ ٱلۡكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرٗا ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: ويعبدون من دون الله ما لا ينفعهم ولا يضرهم وكان الكافر علي ربه ظهيرا
ayahs.translation: But they worship rather than Allāh that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].
ayahs.transliteration: waya-bu-doo-na min doo-nil laa-hi maa laa yan-fau-hum wa-laa ya-dur-ru-hum wa-kaa-nal kaa-fi-ru a-laa rab-bihee zahee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: وما ارسلنك الا مبشرا ونذيرا
ayahs.translation: And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa ar-sal-naa-ka il-laa mu-bas-hshi-ranw wa-na-zee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلٗا ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: قل ما اسلكم عليه من اجر الا من شاء ان يتخذ الي ربه سبيلا
ayahs.translation: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."
ayahs.transliteration: qul maaa a-sa-lu-kum a-lai-hi min aj-rin il-laa man shaaaa ai yat-ta-khi-za i-laa rab-bihee sabee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱلۡحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِهِۦۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: وتوكل علي الحي الذي لا يموت وسبح بحمده وكفي به بذنوب عباده خبيرا
ayahs.translation: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allāh] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, [fully] Aware -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-wak-kal a-lal haiyil lazee laa ya-moo-tu wa-sab-bih bi-ham-dih wa-ka-faa bihee bi-zu-noo-bi i-baa-dihee khabee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ فَسۡـَٔلۡ بِهِۦ خَبِيرٗا ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: الذي خلق السموت والارض وما بينهما في ستة ايام ثم استوي علي العرش الرحمن فسل به خبيرا
ayahs.translation: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)].
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee kha-la-qas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da wa-maa bai-na-hu-maa fee sit-ta-ti aiyaa-min thum-ma sta-waa a-lal arsh ar-rah-maa-nu fa-sal bihee khabee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ قَالُواْ وَمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ أَنَسۡجُدُ لِمَا تَأۡمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمۡ نُفُورٗا۩ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: واذا قيل لهم اسجدوا للرحمن قالوا وما الرحمن انسجد لما تامرنا وزادهم نفورا
ayahs.translation: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa qee-la la-hu-mus ju-doo lir-rah-maa-ni qaa-loo wa-mar rah-maa-nu a-nas-ju-du li-maa ta-mu-ru-naa wa-zaa-da-hum nu-foo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجٗا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجٗا وَقَمَرٗا مُّنِيرٗا ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: تبارك الذي جعل في السماء بروجا وجعل فيها سرجا وقمرا منيرا
ayahs.translation: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.
ayahs.transliteration: ta-baa-ra-kal lazee jaa-la fis sa-maaai bu-roo-janw wa-jaa-la fee-haa si-raa-janw wa-qa-ma-ran munee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلۡفَةٗ لِّمَنۡ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوۡ أَرَادَ شُكُورٗا ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: وهو الذي جعل اليل والنهار خلفة لمن اراد ان يذكر او اراد شكورا
ayahs.translation: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wal lazee jaa-lal lai-la wan-na-haa-ra khil-fa-tan li-man a-raa-da a-ny yaz-zak-ka-ra aw a-raa-daa shu-koo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمۡشُونَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ هَوۡنٗا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلۡجَٰهِلُونَ قَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗا ٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: وعباد الرحمن الذين يمشون علي الارض هونا واذا خاطبهم الجهلون قالوا سلما
ayahs.translation: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
ayahs.transliteration: wai-baa-dur rah-maa-nil lazee-na yam-shoo-na a-lal ar-di haw-nanw wai-zaa khaa-ta-ba-hu-mul jaa-hi-loo-na qaa-loo sa-laa-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمۡ سُجَّدٗا وَقِيَٰمٗا ٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: والذين يبيتون لربهم سجدا وقيما
ayahs.translation: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na ya-bee-too-na li-rab-bi-him suj-ja-danw wa-qiyaa-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصۡرِفۡ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا ٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: والذين يقولون ربنا اصرف عنا عذاب جهنم ان عذابها كان غراما
ayahs.translation: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na ya-qoo-loo-na rab-ba-nas rif an-naa a-zaa-ba ja-han-na-ma in-na a-zaa-ba-haa kaa-na gha-raa-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرّٗا وَمُقَامٗا ٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: انها ساءت مستقرا ومقاما
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-haa saaaat mus-ta-qar-ranw wa-mu-qaa-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُواْ لَمۡ يُسۡرِفُواْ وَلَمۡ يَقۡتُرُواْ وَكَانَ بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامٗا ٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: والذين اذا انفقوا لم يسرفوا ولم يقتروا وكان بين ذلك قواما
ayahs.translation: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na i-zaaa an-fa-qoo lam yus-ri-foo wa-lam yaq-tu-roo wa-kaa-na bai-na zaa-li-ka qa-waa-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدۡعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقۡتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفۡسَ ٱلَّتِي حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا يَزۡنُونَۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡ ذَٰلِكَ يَلۡقَ أَثَامٗا ٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: والذين لا يدعون مع الله الها ءاخر ولا يقتلون النفس التي حرم الله الا بالحق ولا يزنون ومن يفعل ذلك يلق اثاما
ayahs.translation: And those who do not invoke with Allāh another deity or kill the soul which Allāh has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na laa ya-doo-na maal laa-hi i-laa-han aa-kha-ra wa-laa yaq-tu-loo-nan naf-sal latee har-ra-mal laa-hu il-laa bi-lhaq-qi wa-laa yaz-noon wa-mai yaf al zaa-li-ka yal-qa a-thaa-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُضَٰعَفۡ لَهُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَيَخۡلُدۡ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا ٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: يضعف له العذاب يوم القيمة ويخلد فيه مهانا
ayahs.translation: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
ayahs.transliteration: yu-daaaf la-hul a-zaa-bu yaw-mal qiyaa-ma-ti wayak-hlud feehee mu-haa-naa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلٗا صَٰلِحٗا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ حَسَنَٰتٖۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا ٧٠
ayahs.text_simple: الا من تاب وءامن وعمل عملا صلحا فاولئك يبدل الله سياتهم حسنت وكان الله غفورا رحيما
ayahs.translation: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allāh will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa man taa-ba waaa-ma-na waa-mi-la a-ma-lan saa-li-han fau-laaai-ka yu-bad-di-lul laa-hu saiyi-a-a-ti-him ha-sa-naat wa-kaa-nal laa-hu gha-foo-rar rahee-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابٗا ٧١
ayahs.text_simple: ومن تاب وعمل صلحا فانه يتوب الي الله متابا
ayahs.translation: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allāh with [accepted] repentance.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-man taa-ba waa-mi-la saa-li-han fain-na-hoo ya-too-bu i-lal laa-hi ma-taa-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشۡهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِٱللَّغۡوِ مَرُّواْ كِرَامٗا ٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: والذين لا يشهدون الزور واذا مروا باللغو مروا كراما
ayahs.translation: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na laa yas-hha-doo-naz zoo-ra wai-zaa mar-roo bil-lag-hwi mar-roo ki-raa-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَمۡ يَخِرُّواْ عَلَيۡهَا صُمّٗا وَعُمۡيَانٗا ٧٣
ayahs.text_simple: والذين اذا ذكروا بايت ربهم لم يخروا عليها صما وعميانا
ayahs.translation: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na i-zaa zuk-ki-roo bi-a-ayaa-ti rab-bi-him lam ya-khir-roo a-lai-haa sum-manw wau-myaa-naa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعۡيُنٖ وَٱجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا ٧٤
ayahs.text_simple: والذين يقولون ربنا هب لنا من ازوجنا وذريتنا قرة اعين واجعلنا للمتقين اماما
ayahs.translation: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous."
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na ya-qoo-loo-na rab-ba-naa hab la-naa min az-waa-ji-naa wa-zur-riyaa-ti-naa qur-ra-ta ayu-ninw wa-jal-naa lil-mut-ta-qee-na i-maa-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُجۡزَوۡنَ ٱلۡغُرۡفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُواْ وَيُلَقَّوۡنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةٗ وَسَلَٰمًا ٧٥
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك يجزون الغرفة بما صبروا ويلقون فيها تحية وسلما
ayahs.translation: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace,
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-ka yuj-zaw-nal ghur-fa-ta bi-maa sa-ba-roo wayu-laq-qaw-na fee-haa ta-hiyya-tanw wa-sa-laa-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ حَسُنَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرّٗا وَمُقَامٗا ٧٦
ayahs.text_simple: خلدين فيها حسنت مستقرا ومقاما
ayahs.translation: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
ayahs.transliteration: khaa-li-dee-na fee-haa ha-su-nat mus-ta-qar-ranw wa-mu-qaa-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ مَا يَعۡبَؤُاْ بِكُمۡ رَبِّي لَوۡلَا دُعَآؤُكُمۡۖ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبۡتُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامَۢا ٧٧
ayahs.text_simple: قل ما يعبؤا بكم ربي لولا دعاؤكم فقد كذبتم فسوف يكون لزاما
ayahs.translation: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so it [i.e., your denial] is going to be adherent.
ayahs.transliteration: qul maa ya-bau bi-kum rab-bee law-laa du-a-aau-kum fa-qad kaz-zab-tum fa-saw-fa ya-koo-nu li-zaa-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: طسٓمٓ ١
ayahs.text_simple: طسم
ayahs.translation: Ṭā, Seen, Meem.
ayahs.transliteration: taaseeen-meeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: تلك ءايت الكتب المبين
ayahs.translation: These are the verses of the clear Book.
ayahs.transliteration: til-ka aayaa-tul ki-taa-bil mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٞ نَّفۡسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: لعلك بخع نفسك الا يكونوا مؤمنين
ayahs.translation: Perhaps, [O Muḥammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: laal-la-ka baa-khiun naf-sa-ka al-laa ya-koo-noo mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِن نَّشَأۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةٗ فَظَلَّتۡ أَعۡنَٰقُهُمۡ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان نشا ننزل عليهم من السماء ءاية فظلت اعنقهم لها خضعين
ayahs.translation: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
ayahs.transliteration: in na-shaa nu-naz-zil a-lai-him mi-nas sa-maaai aaya-tan fa-zal-lat a-naa-qu-hum la-haa khaa-dieen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن ذِكۡرٖ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مُحۡدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضِينَ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: وما ياتيهم من ذكر من الرحمن محدث الا كانوا عنه معرضين
ayahs.translation: And no mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa yaa-tee-him min zik-rim mi-nar rah-maa-ni muh-da-sin il-laa kaa-noo a-nhu mu-rideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُواْ فَسَيَأۡتِيهِمۡ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُاْ مَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: فقد كذبوا فسياتيهم انبؤا ما كانوا به يستهزءون
ayahs.translation: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qad kaz-za-boo fa-sayaa-tee-him am-baaau maa kaa-noo bihee yas-tah-zioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَمۡ أَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجٖ كَرِيمٍ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: اولم يروا الي الارض كم انبتنا فيها من كل زوج كريم
ayahs.translation: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-lam ya-raw i-lal ar-di kam am-bat-naa fee-haa min kul-li zaw-jin kareem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: ان في ذلك لاية وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayah wa-maa kaa-na ak-sa-ru-hum mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: وان ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم
ayahs.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na rab-ba-ka la-hu-wal azee-zur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئۡتِ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: واذ نادي ربك موسي ان ائت القوم الظلمين
ayahs.translation: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
ayahs.transliteration: waiz naa-daa rab-bu-ka moo-saaa a-ni til qaw-maz zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: قوم فرعون الا يتقون
ayahs.translation: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allāh?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaw-ma fi-rawn a-laa yat-ta-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: قال رب اني اخاف ان يكذبون
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-bi in-neee a-khaa-fu ai yu-kaz-zi-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَضِيقُ صَدۡرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرۡسِلۡ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: ويضيق صدري ولا ينطلق لساني فارسل الي هرون
ayahs.translation: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
ayahs.transliteration: wayadee-qu sad-ree wa-laa yan-ta-li-qu li-saanee faar-sil i-laa haa-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَهُمۡ عَلَيَّ ذَنۢبٞ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقۡتُلُونِ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولهم علي ذنب فاخاف ان يقتلون
ayahs.translation: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-hum a-laiya zam-bun faa-khaa-fu ai yaq-tu-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ كـَلَّاۖ فَٱذۡهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسۡتَمِعُونَ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: قال كلا فاذهبا بايتنا انا معكم مستمعون
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la kal-laa fa-zha-baa bi-a-ayaa-ti-naaa in-naa maa-kum mus-ta-mioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأۡتِيَا فِرۡعَوۡنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: فاتيا فرعون فقولا انا رسول رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
ayahs.transliteration: faa-tiyaa fi-raw-na fa-qoo-laaa in-naa ra-soo-lu rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَنۡ أَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان ارسل معنا بني اسرءيل
ayahs.translation: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
ayahs.transliteration: an ar-sil maa-naa baneee is-raaaeel

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَلَمۡ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدٗا وَلَبِثۡتَ فِينَا مِنۡ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: قال الم نربك فينا وليدا ولبثت فينا من عمرك سنين
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la a-lam nu-rab-bi-ka fee-naa walee-danw wa-la-bis-ta fee-naa min u-mu-ri-ka sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِي فَعَلۡتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: وفعلت فعلتك التي فعلت وانت من الكفرين
ayahs.translation: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-faal-ta fa-la-ta-kal latee faal-ta waan-ta mi-nal kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُهَآ إِذٗا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: قال فعلتها اذا وانا من الضالين
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray [i.e., ignorant].
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la faal-tu-haaa i-zanw waa-na mi-nad daaaleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَفَرَرۡتُ مِنكُمۡ لَمَّا خِفۡتُكُمۡ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكۡمٗا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: ففررت منكم لما خفتكم فوهب لي ربي حكما وجعلني من المرسلين
ayahs.translation: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me judgement [i.e., wisdom and prophethood] and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-fa-rar-tu min-kum lam-maa khif-tu-kum fa-wa-ha-ba lee rab-bee huk-manw wa-jaa-lanee mi-nal mur-saleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتِلۡكَ نِعۡمَةٞ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنۡ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: وتلك نعمة تمنها علي ان عبدت بني اسرءيل
ayahs.translation: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
ayahs.transliteration: wa-til-ka ni-ma-tun ta-mun-nu-haa a-laiya an ab-bat-ta baneee is-raaaeel

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: قال فرعون وما رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la fi-raw-nu wa-maa rab-bul aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: قال رب السموت والارض وما بينهما ان كنتم موقنين
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-bus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di wa-maa bai-na-hu-maa in kun-tum moo-qineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ لِمَنۡ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسۡتَمِعُونَ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: قال لمن حوله الا تستمعون
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la li-man haw-la-hooo a-laa tas-ta-mioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: قال ربكم ورب ءابائكم الاولين
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-bu-kum wa-rab-bu aa-baaai-ku-mul aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أُرۡسِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمَجۡنُونٞ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: قال ان رسولكم الذي ارسل اليكم لمجنون
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la in-na ra-soo-la-ku-mul lazee ur-si-la i-lai-kum la-maj-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: قال رب المشرق والمغرب وما بينهما ان كنتم تعقلون
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-bul mas-hri-qi wal-mag-hri-bi wa-maa bai-na-hu-maa in kun-tum ta-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذۡتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيۡرِي لَأَجۡعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَسۡجُونِينَ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: قال لئن اتخذت الها غيري لاجعلنك من المسجونين
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la lai-nit ta-khaz-ta i-laa-han ghairee laa-ja-lan-na-ka mi-nal mas-jooneen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكَ بِشَيۡءٖ مُّبِينٖ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: قال اولو جئتك بشيء مبين
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you something [i.e., proof] manifest?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la a-wa-law ji-tu-ka bi-shaiim mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَأۡتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: قال فات به ان كنت من الصدقين
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la faa-ti biheee in kun-ta mi-nas saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَلۡقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعۡبَانٞ مُّبِينٞ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: فالقي عصاه فاذا هي ثعبان مبين
ayahs.translation: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.
ayahs.transliteration: faal-qaa a-saa-hu fai-zaaa hiya su-baa-num mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيۡضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: ونزع يده فاذا هي بيضاء للنظرين
ayahs.translation: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-na-zaa ya-da-hoo fai-zaa hiya bai-daaau lin-naa-zireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ لِلۡمَلَإِ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٞ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: قال للملا حوله ان هذا لسحر عليم
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la lil-ma-lai haw-la-hooo in-na haa-zaa la-saa-hi-run aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخۡرِجَكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأۡمُرُونَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: يريد ان يخرجكم من ارضكم بسحره فماذا تامرون
ayahs.translation: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
ayahs.transliteration: yu-ree-du ai yuk-hri-ja-kum min ar-di-kum bi-sih-rihee fa-maa-zaa taa-mu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓاْ أَرۡجِهۡ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبۡعَثۡ فِي ٱلۡمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا ارجه واخاه وابعث في المدائن حشرين
ayahs.translation: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-looo ar-jih waa-khaa-hu wa-bas fil ma-daaai-ni haa-shireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَأۡتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٖ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: ياتوك بكل سحار عليم
ayahs.translation: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
ayahs.transliteration: yaa-too-ka bi-kul-li sa-hhaa-rin aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَٰتِ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: فجمع السحرة لميقت يوم معلوم
ayahs.translation: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ju-mi-as sa-ha-ra-tu limee-qaa-ti yaw-mim ma-loom

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلۡ أَنتُم مُّجۡتَمِعُونَ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: وقيل للناس هل انتم مجتمعون
ayahs.translation: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate
ayahs.transliteration: waqee-la lin-naa-si hal an-tum muj-ta-mioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: لعلنا نتبع السحرة ان كانوا هم الغلبين
ayahs.translation: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
ayahs.transliteration: laal-la-naa nat-ta-bius sa-ha-ra-ta in kaa-noo hu-mul ghaa-libeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُواْ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجۡرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: فلما جاء السحرة قالوا لفرعون ائن لنا لاجرا ان كنا نحن الغلبين
ayahs.translation: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa jaaaas sa-ha-ra-tu qaa-loo li-fi-raw-na ain-na la-naa laaj-jran in kun-naa nah-nul ghaa-libeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ نَعَمۡ وَإِنَّكُمۡ إِذٗا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: قال نعم وانكم اذا لمن المقربين
ayahs.translation: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la naam wain-na-kum i-zal la-mi-nal mu-qar-rabeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلۡقُواْ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلۡقُونَ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: قال لهم موسي القوا ما انتم ملقون
ayahs.translation: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la la-hum moo-saaa al-qoo maaa an-tum mul-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَلۡقَوۡاْ حِبَالَهُمۡ وَعِصِيَّهُمۡ وَقَالُواْ بِعِزَّةِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: فالقوا حبالهم وعصيهم وقالوا بعزة فرعون انا لنحن الغلبون
ayahs.translation: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
ayahs.transliteration: faal-qaw hi-baa-la-hum wai-siyya-hum wa-qaa-loo biiz-za-ti fi-raw-na in-naa la-nah-nul ghaa-li-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَلۡقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا يَأۡفِكُونَ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: فالقي موسي عصاه فاذا هي تلقف ما يافكون
ayahs.translation: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
ayahs.transliteration: faal-qaa moo-saa a-saa-hu fai-zaa hiya tal-qa-fu maa yaa-fi-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأُلۡقِيَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَٰجِدِينَ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: فالقي السحرة سجدين
ayahs.translation: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: faul-qiyas sa-ha-ra-tu saa-jideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا ءامنا برب العلمين
ayahs.translation: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-looo aa-man-naa bi-rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: رب موسي وهرون
ayahs.translation: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
ayahs.transliteration: rab-bi moo-saa wa-haa-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَ فَلَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفٖ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: قال ءامنتم له قبل ان ءاذن لكم انه لكبيركم الذي علمكم السحر فلسوف تعلمون لاقطعن ايديكم وارجلكم من خلف ولاصلبنكم اجمعين
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la aa-man-tum la-hoo qab-la an aa-za-na la-kum in-na-hoo la-ka-bee-ru-ku-mul lazee al-la-ma-ku-mus sih-ra fa-la-saw-fa ta-la-moon lau-qat-ti-a-nna ai-diya-kum waar-ju-la-kum min khi-laa-finw wa-lau-sal-li-ban-na-kum aj-maeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ لَا ضَيۡرَۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا لا ضير انا الي ربنا منقلبون
ayahs.translation: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo la dai-ra in-naaa i-laa rab-bi-naa mun-qal-li-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: انا نطمع ان يغفر لنا ربنا خطينا ان كنا اول المؤمنين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa nat-mau ai yag-hfi-ra la-naa rab-bu-naa kha-taayaa-naaa an kun-naaa aw-wa-lal mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: واوحينا الي موسي ان اسر بعبادي انكم متبعون
ayahs.translation: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
ayahs.transliteration: waa-whai-naaa i-laa moo-saaa an as-ri bii-baadeee in-na-kum mut-ta-baoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَرۡسَلَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِي ٱلۡمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: فارسل فرعون في المدائن حشرين
ayahs.translation: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
ayahs.transliteration: faar-sa-la fi-raw-nu fil ma-daaai-ni haa-shireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرۡذِمَةٞ قَلِيلُونَ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان هؤلاء لشرذمة قليلون
ayahs.translation: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
ayahs.transliteration: in-na haaau-laaai la-shir-zi-ma-tun qalee-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: وانهم لنا لغائظون
ayahs.translation: And indeed, they are enraging us,
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na-hum la-naa la-ghaaai-zoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَٰذِرُونَ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: وانا لجميع حذرون
ayahs.translation: And indeed, we are a cautious society..."
ayahs.transliteration: wain-naa la-ja-mee-un haa-zi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَٰهُم مِّن جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: فاخرجنهم من جنت وعيون
ayahs.translation: So We removed them from gardens and springs
ayahs.transliteration: faak-hraj-naa-hum min jan-naa-tinw wauyoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكُنُوزٖ وَمَقَامٖ كَرِيمٖ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: وكنوز ومقام كريم
ayahs.translation: And treasures and honorable station -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ku-noo-zinw wa-ma-qaa-min kareem

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: كذلك واورثنها بني اسرءيل
ayahs.translation: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
ayahs.transliteration: ka-zaa-li-ka waaw-ras-naa-haa baneee is-raaaeel

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَتۡبَعُوهُم مُّشۡرِقِينَ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: فاتبعوهم مشرقين
ayahs.translation: So they pursued them at sunrise.
ayahs.transliteration: faat-baoo-hum mus-hri-qeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلۡجَمۡعَانِ قَالَ أَصۡحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدۡرَكُونَ ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: فلما ترءا الجمعان قال اصحب موسي انا لمدركون
ayahs.translation: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa ta-raaaal ja-maa-ni qaa-la a-shaa-bu moo-saaa in-naa la-mud-ra-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ كـَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: قال كلا ان معي ربي سيهدين
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la kal-laaa in-na maiya rab-bee sayah-deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقٖ كَٱلطَّوۡدِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ ٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: فاوحينا الي موسي ان اضرب بعصاك البحر فانفلق فكان كل فرق كالطود العظيم
ayahs.translation: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-whai-naaa i-laa moo-saaa a-ni drib bi-a-saa-kal bah-ra fan-fa-la-qa fa-kaa-na kul-lu fir-qin kat-taw-dil azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَزۡلَفۡنَا ثَمَّ ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ ٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: وازلفنا ثم الاخرين
ayahs.translation: And We advanced thereto the others [i.e., the pursuers].
ayahs.transliteration: waaz-laf-naa sam-mal aa-khareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنجَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ ٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: وانجينا موسي ومن معه اجمعين
ayahs.translation: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
ayahs.transliteration: waan-jai-naa moo-saa wa-mam maa-hooo aj-maeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ ٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: ثم اغرقنا الاخرين
ayahs.translation: Then We drowned the others.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma ag-hraq-nal aa-khareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ ٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان في ذلك لاية وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayaah wa-maa kaa-na ak-sa-ru-hu mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: وان ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم
ayahs.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na rab-ba-ka la-hu-wal azee-zur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱتۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَبَأَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: واتل عليهم نبا ابرهيم
ayahs.translation: And recite to them the news of Abraham,
ayahs.transliteration: wat-lu a-lai-him na-baa ib-raaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ ٧٠
ayahs.text_simple: اذ قال لابيه وقومه ما تعبدون
ayahs.translation: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
ayahs.transliteration: iz qaa-la li-a-bee-hi wa-qaw-mihee maa ta-bu-doon
