ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ نَعۡبُدُ أَصۡنَامٗا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ ٧١
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا نعبد اصناما فنظل لها عكفين
ayahs.translation: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo na-bu-du as-naa-man fa-na-zal-lu la-haa aa-kifeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلۡ يَسۡمَعُونَكُمۡ إِذۡ تَدۡعُونَ ٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: قال هل يسمعونكم اذ تدعون
ayahs.translation: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la hal yas-maoo-na-kum iz ta-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوۡ يَنفَعُونَكُمۡ أَوۡ يَضُرُّونَ ٧٣
ayahs.text_simple: او ينفعونكم او يضرون
ayahs.translation: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
ayahs.transliteration: aw yan-faoo-na-kum aw ya-dur-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ بَلۡ وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُونَ ٧٤
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا بل وجدنا ءاباءنا كذلك يفعلون
ayahs.translation: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo bal wa-jad-naaa aa-baaaa-naa ka-zaa-li-ka yaf a-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُونَ ٧٥
ayahs.text_simple: قال افرءيتم ما كنتم تعبدون
ayahs.translation: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la a-fa-raai-tum maa kun-tum ta-bu-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلۡأَقۡدَمُونَ ٧٦
ayahs.text_simple: انتم وءاباؤكم الاقدمون
ayahs.translation: You and your ancient forefathers?
ayahs.transliteration: an-tum waaa-baaau-ku-mul aq-da-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمۡ عَدُوّٞ لِّيٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٧٧
ayahs.text_simple: فانهم عدو لي الا رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
ayahs.transliteration: fain-na-hum a-duw-wwul leee il-laa rab-bal aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهۡدِينِ ٧٨
ayahs.text_simple: الذي خلقني فهو يهدين
ayahs.translation: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee kha-la-qanee fa-hu-wa yah-deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِي هُوَ يُطۡعِمُنِي وَيَسۡقِينِ ٧٩
ayahs.text_simple: والذي هو يطعمني ويسقين
ayahs.translation: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-lazee hu-wa yu-ti-munee wayas-qeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرِضۡتُ فَهُوَ يَشۡفِينِ ٨٠
ayahs.text_simple: واذا مرضت فهو يشفين
ayahs.translation: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa ma-rid-tu fa-hu-wa yas-hfeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِي يُمِيتُنِي ثُمَّ يُحۡيِينِ ٨١
ayahs.text_simple: والذي يميتني ثم يحيين
ayahs.translation: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
ayahs.transliteration: wal-lazee yu-mee-tunee sum-ma yu-hyeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لِي خَطِيٓـَٔتِي يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ ٨٢
ayahs.text_simple: والذي اطمع ان يغفر لي خطيتي يوم الدين
ayahs.translation: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
ayahs.transliteration: wal-lazeee at-mau ai yag-hfi-ra lee khateeeatee yaw-mad deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي حُكۡمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ ٨٣
ayahs.text_simple: رب هب لي حكما والحقني بالصلحين
ayahs.translation: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: rab-bi hab lee huk-manw waa-lhiq-nee bis-saa-liheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدۡقٖ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ ٨٤
ayahs.text_simple: واجعل لي لسان صدق في الاخرين
ayahs.translation: And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honor among later generations.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jal lee li-saa-na sid-qin fil aa-khireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱجۡعَلۡنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ ٨٥
ayahs.text_simple: واجعلني من ورثة جنة النعيم
ayahs.translation: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jal-nee minw wa-ra-sa-ti jan-nna-tin naeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱغۡفِرۡ لِأَبِيٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ ٨٦
ayahs.text_simple: واغفر لابي انه كان من الضالين
ayahs.translation: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
ayahs.transliteration: wag-hfir li-a-beee in-na-hoo kaa-na mind daal-leen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا تُخۡزِنِي يَوۡمَ يُبۡعَثُونَ ٨٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولا تخزني يوم يبعثون
ayahs.translation: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa tuk-hzi-nee yaw-ma yu-ba-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٞ وَلَا بَنُونَ ٨٨
ayahs.text_simple: يوم لا ينفع مال ولا بنون
ayahs.translation: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma laa yan-fau maa-lunw wa-laa ba-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنۡ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلۡبٖ سَلِيمٖ ٨٩
ayahs.text_simple: الا من اتي الله بقلب سليم
ayahs.translation: But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart."
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa man a-tal laa-ha bi-qal-bin saleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ ٩٠
ayahs.text_simple: وازلفت الجنة للمتقين
ayahs.translation: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: wauz-li-fa-til jan-na-tu lil-mut-taqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلۡجَحِيمُ لِلۡغَاوِينَ ٩١
ayahs.text_simple: وبرزت الجحيم للغاوين
ayahs.translation: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-bur-ri-za-til jahee-mu lil-ghaaween

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُونَ ٩٢
ayahs.text_simple: وقيل لهم اين ما كنتم تعبدون
ayahs.translation: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
ayahs.transliteration: waqee-la la-hum ai-na maa kun-tum ta-bu-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلۡ يَنصُرُونَكُمۡ أَوۡ يَنتَصِرُونَ ٩٣
ayahs.text_simple: من دون الله هل ينصرونكم او ينتصرون
ayahs.translation: Other than Allāh? Can they help you or help themselves?"
ayahs.transliteration: min doo-nil laa-hi hal yan-su-roo-na-kum aw yan-ta-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكُبۡكِبُواْ فِيهَا هُمۡ وَٱلۡغَاوُۥنَ ٩٤
ayahs.text_simple: فكبكبوا فيها هم والغاون
ayahs.translation: So they will be overturned into it [i.e., Hellfire], they and the deviators
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kub-ki-boo fee-haa hum wal-ghaa-woon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجُنُودُ إِبۡلِيسَ أَجۡمَعُونَ ٩٥
ayahs.text_simple: وجنود ابليس اجمعون
ayahs.translation: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ju-noo-du ib-lee-sa aj-maoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا يَخۡتَصِمُونَ ٩٦
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا وهم فيها يختصمون
ayahs.translation: They will say while they dispute therein,
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo wa-hum fee-haa yak-khta-si-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ ٩٧
ayahs.text_simple: تالله ان كنا لفي ضلل مبين
ayahs.translation: "By Allāh, we were indeed in manifest error
ayahs.transliteration: tal-laa-hi in kun-naa lafee da-laa-lim mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٩٨
ayahs.text_simple: اذ نسويكم برب العلمين
ayahs.translation: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: iz nu-saw-wee-kum bi-rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ ٩٩
ayahs.text_simple: وما اضلنا الا المجرمون
ayahs.translation: And no one misguided us except the criminals.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa a-dal-la-naaa il-lal muj-ri-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَٰفِعِينَ ١٠٠
ayahs.text_simple: فما لنا من شفعين
ayahs.translation: So now we have no intercessors
ayahs.transliteration: fa-maa la-naa min shaa-fieen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٖ ١٠١
ayahs.text_simple: ولا صديق حميم
ayahs.translation: And not a devoted friend.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa sadee-qin hameem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَوۡ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةٗ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ١٠٢
ayahs.text_simple: فلو ان لنا كرة فنكون من المؤمنين
ayahs.translation: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers..."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-law an-na la-naa kar-ra-tan fa-na-koo-na mi-nal mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ ١٠٣
ayahs.text_simple: ان في ذلك لاية وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaaya-tanw wa-maa kaa-na ak-sa-ru-hum mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ١٠٤
ayahs.text_simple: وان ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم
ayahs.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na rab-ba-ka la-hu-wal azee-zur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٍ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ ١٠٥
ayahs.text_simple: كذبت قوم نوح المرسلين
ayahs.translation: The people of Noah denied the messengers
ayahs.transliteration: kaz-za-bat qaw-mu noo-hi-nil mur-saleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ ١٠٦
ayahs.text_simple: اذ قال لهم اخوهم نوح الا تتقون
ayahs.translation: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
ayahs.transliteration: iz qaa-la la-hum a-khoo-hum noo-hun a-laa tat-ta-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ ١٠٧
ayahs.text_simple: اني لكم رسول امين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nee la-kum ra-soo-lun ameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ١٠٨
ayahs.text_simple: فاتقوا الله واطيعون
ayahs.translation: So fear Allāh and obey me.
ayahs.transliteration: fat-ta-qul laa-ha waatee-o-on

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ١٠٩
ayahs.text_simple: وما اسلكم عليه من اجر ان اجري الا علي رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa a-sa-lu-kum a-lai-hi min aj-rin in aj-riya il-laa a-laa rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ١١٠
ayahs.text_simple: فاتقوا الله واطيعون
ayahs.translation: So fear Allāh and obey me."
ayahs.transliteration: fat-ta-qul laa-ha waatee-o-on

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ قَالُوٓاْ أَنُؤۡمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلۡأَرۡذَلُونَ ١١١
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا انؤمن لك واتبعك الارذلون
ayahs.translation: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-looo a-nu-mi-nu la-ka wat-ta-baa-kal ar-za-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ وَمَا عِلۡمِي بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ ١١٢
ayahs.text_simple: قال وما علمي بما كانوا يعملون
ayahs.translation: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la wa-maa il-mee bi-maa kaa-noo ya-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنۡ حِسَابُهُمۡ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّيۖ لَوۡ تَشۡعُرُونَ ١١٣
ayahs.text_simple: ان حسابهم الا علي ربي لو تشعرون
ayahs.translation: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
ayahs.transliteration: in hi-saa-bu-hum il-laa a-laa rab-bee law ta-shu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ١١٤
ayahs.text_simple: وما انا بطارد المؤمنين
ayahs.translation: And I am not one to drive away the believers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa a-na bi-taa-ri-dil mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنۡ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ ١١٥
ayahs.text_simple: ان انا الا نذير مبين
ayahs.translation: I am only a clear warner."
ayahs.transliteration: in a-na il-laa nazee-rum mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَرۡجُومِينَ ١١٦
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا لئن لم تنته ينوح لتكونن من المرجومين
ayahs.translation: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo lail lam tan-ta-hi yaa-noo-hu la-ta-koo-nan-na mi-nal mar-joomeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوۡمِي كَذَّبُونِ ١١٧
ayahs.text_simple: قال رب ان قومي كذبون
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-bi in-na qaw-mee kaz-za-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱفۡتَحۡ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ فَتۡحٗا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِيَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ١١٨
ayahs.text_simple: فافتح بيني وبينهم فتحا ونجني ومن معي من المؤمنين
ayahs.translation: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
ayahs.transliteration: faf-tab bainee wa-bai-na-hum fa-thanw wa-naj-jinee wa-mam maiya mi-nal mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ ١١٩
ayahs.text_simple: فانجينه ومن معه في الفلك المشحون
ayahs.translation: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
ayahs.transliteration: faan-jai-naa-hu wa-mam maa-hoo fil ful-kil mas-hhoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا بَعۡدُ ٱلۡبَاقِينَ ١٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: ثم اغرقنا بعد الباقين
ayahs.translation: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma ag-hraq-naa ba-dul baaqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ ١٢١
ayahs.text_simple: ان في ذلك لاية وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayaah wa-maa kaa-na ak-sa-ru-hum mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ١٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: وان ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم
ayahs.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na rab-ba-ka la-hu-wal azee-zur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٌ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ ١٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: كذبت عاد المرسلين
ayahs.translation: ʿAad denied the messengers
ayahs.transliteration: kaz-za-bat aa-du-nil mur-saleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ ١٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: اذ قال لهم اخوهم هود الا تتقون
ayahs.translation: When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
ayahs.transliteration: iz qaa-la la-hum a-khoo-hum hoo-dun a-laa tat-ta-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ ١٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: اني لكم رسول امين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nee la-kum ra-soo-lun ameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ١٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: فاتقوا الله واطيعون
ayahs.translation: So fear Allāh and obey me.
ayahs.transliteration: fat-ta-qul laa-ha waatee-o-on

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ١٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: وما اسلكم عليه من اجر ان اجري الا علي رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa a-sa-lu-kum a-lai-hi min aj-rin in aj-riya il-laa a-laa rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَتَبۡنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةٗ تَعۡبَثُونَ ١٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: اتبنون بكل ريع ءاية تعبثون
ayahs.translation: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,
ayahs.transliteration: a-tab-noo-na bi-kul-li reein aaya-tan ta-ba-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَخۡلُدُونَ ١٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: وتتخذون مصانع لعلكم تخلدون
ayahs.translation: And take for yourselves constructions [i.e., palaces and fortresses] that you might abide eternally?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-tat-ta-khi-zoo-na ma-saa-ni-a laal-la-kum tak-hlu-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا بَطَشۡتُم بَطَشۡتُمۡ جَبَّارِينَ ١٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: واذا بطشتم بطشتم جبارين
ayahs.translation: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa ba-tas-htum ba-tas-htum jab-baareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ١٣١
ayahs.text_simple: فاتقوا الله واطيعون
ayahs.translation: So fear Allāh and obey me.
ayahs.transliteration: fat-ta-qul laa-ha waatee-o-on

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعۡلَمُونَ ١٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: واتقوا الذي امدكم بما تعلمون
ayahs.translation: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
ayahs.transliteration: wat-ta-qul lazeee a-mad-da-kum bi-maa ta-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنۡعَٰمٖ وَبَنِينَ ١٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: امدكم بانعم وبنين
ayahs.translation: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
ayahs.transliteration: a-mad-da-kum bi-a-naa-minw wa-baneen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ ١٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: وجنت وعيون
ayahs.translation: And gardens and springs.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jan-naa-tinw wauyoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ ١٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: اني اخاف عليكم عذاب يوم عظيم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
ayahs.transliteration: in-nee a-khaa-fu a-lai-kum a-zaa-ba yaw-min azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوَعَظۡتَ أَمۡ لَمۡ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡوَٰعِظِينَ ١٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا سواء علينا اوعظت ام لم تكن من الوعظين
ayahs.translation: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo sa-waaaun a-lai-naaa a-waaz-ta am lam ta-kum mi-nal waaizeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ١٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان هذا الا خلق الاولين
ayahs.translation: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
ayahs.transliteration: in haa-zaaa il-laa khu-lu-qul aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ ١٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: وما نحن بمعذبين
ayahs.translation: And we are not to be punished."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa nah-nu bi-mu-a-zza-been

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ ١٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: فكذبوه فاهلكنهم ان في ذلك لاية وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kaz-za-boo-hu faah-lak-naa-hum in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayah wa-maa kaa-na ak-sa-ru-hum mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ١٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: وان ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم
ayahs.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na rab-ba-ka la-hu-wal azee-zur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ ١٤١
ayahs.text_simple: كذبت ثمود المرسلين
ayahs.translation: Thamūd denied the messengers
ayahs.transliteration: kaz-za-bat sa-moo-dul mur-saleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ ١٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: اذ قال لهم اخوهم صلح الا تتقون
ayahs.translation: When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
ayahs.transliteration: iz qaa-la la-hum a-khoo-hum saa-li-hun a-laa tat-ta-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ ١٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: اني لكم رسول امين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nee la-kum ra-soo-lun ameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ١٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: فاتقوا الله واطيعون
ayahs.translation: So fear Allāh and obey me.
ayahs.transliteration: fat-ta-qul laa-ha waatee-o-on

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ١٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: وما اسلكم عليه من اجر ان اجري الا علي رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa a-sa-lu-kum a-lai-hi min aj-rin in aj-riya il-laa a-laa rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَتُتۡرَكُونَ فِي مَا هَٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ ١٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: اتتركون في ما ههنا ءامنين
ayahs.translation: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
ayahs.transliteration: a-tut-ra-koo-na fee maa haa-hun-naaa aa-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ ١٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: في جنت وعيون
ayahs.translation: Within gardens and springs
ayahs.transliteration: fee jan-naa-tinw wauyoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٖ وَنَخۡلٖ طَلۡعُهَا هَضِيمٞ ١٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: وزروع ونخل طلعها هضيم
ayahs.translation: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-zu-rooinw wa-nak-hlin ta-lu-haa hadeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَنۡحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتٗا فَٰرِهِينَ ١٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: وتنحتون من الجبال بيوتا فرهين
ayahs.translation: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-nhi-too-na mi-nal ji-baa-li buyoo-tan faa-riheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ١٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: فاتقوا الله واطيعون
ayahs.translation: So fear Allāh and obey me.
ayahs.transliteration: fat-ta-qul laa-ha waatee-o-on

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ ١٥١
ayahs.text_simple: ولا تطيعوا امر المسرفين
ayahs.translation: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa tu-tee-o-oo am-ral mus-rifeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُونَ ١٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: الذين يفسدون في الارض ولا يصلحون
ayahs.translation: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na yuf-si-doo-na fil ar-di wa-laa yus-li-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسَحَّرِينَ ١٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا انما انت من المسحرين
ayahs.translation: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-looo in-na-maa an-ta mi-nal mu-sa-hhareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا فَأۡتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ ١٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: ما انت الا بشر مثلنا فات باية ان كنت من الصدقين
ayahs.translation: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: maaa an-ta il-laa ba-sha-rum mis-lu-naa faa-ti bi-a-aya-tin in kun-ta mi-nas saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٞ لَّهَا شِرۡبٞ وَلَكُمۡ شِرۡبُ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ ١٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: قال هذه ناقة لها شرب ولكم شرب يوم معلوم
ayahs.translation: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la haa-zihee naa-qa-tul la-haa shir-bunw wa-la-kum shir-bu yaw-mim ma-loom

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٖ فَيَأۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ ١٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولا تمسوها بسوء فياخذكم عذاب يوم عظيم
ayahs.translation: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa ta-mas-soo-haa bi-soooin fayaa-khu-za-kum a-zaa-bu yaw-min azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصۡبَحُواْ نَٰدِمِينَ ١٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: فعقروها فاصبحوا ندمين
ayahs.translation: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-qa-roo-haa faas-ba-hoo naa-dimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ ١٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: فاخذهم العذاب ان في ذلك لاية وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-kha-za-hu-mul a-zaab in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayah wa-maa kaa-na ak-sa-ru-hum mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ١٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: وان ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم
ayahs.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na rab-ba-ka la-hu-wal azee-zur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطٍ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ ١٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: كذبت قوم لوط المرسلين
ayahs.translation: The people of Lot denied the messengers
ayahs.transliteration: kaz-za-bat qaw-mu loo-ti-nil mur-saleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ ١٦١
ayahs.text_simple: اذ قال لهم اخوهم لوط الا تتقون
ayahs.translation: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
ayahs.transliteration: iz qaa-la la-hum a-khoo-hum loo-tun a-laa tat-ta-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ ١٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: اني لكم رسول امين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nee la-kum ra-soo-lun ameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ١٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: فاتقوا الله واطيعون
ayahs.translation: So fear Allāh and obey me.
ayahs.transliteration: fat-ta-qul laa-ha waatee-o-on

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ١٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: وما اسلكم عليه من اجر ان اجري الا علي رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa a-sa-lu-kum a-lai-hi min aj-rin in aj-riya il-laa a-laa rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلذُّكۡرَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ١٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: اتاتون الذكران من العلمين
ayahs.translation: Do you approach males among the worlds
ayahs.transliteration: a-taa-too-naz zuk-raa-na mi-nal aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ رَبُّكُم مِّنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ عَادُونَ ١٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: وتذرون ما خلق لكم ربكم من ازوجكم بل انتم قوم عادون
ayahs.translation: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-za-roo-na maa kha-la-qa la-kum rab-bu-kum min az-waa-ji-kum bal an-tum qaw-mun aa-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡرَجِينَ ١٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا لئن لم تنته يلوط لتكونن من المخرجين
ayahs.translation: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."
ayahs.transliteration: qa-loo lail lam tan-ta-hi yaa-loo-tu la-ta-koo-nan-na mi-nal muk-hra-jeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنِّي لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقَالِينَ ١٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: قال اني لعملكم من القالين
ayahs.translation: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la in-nee li-a-ma-li-kum mi-nal qaaleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهۡلِي مِمَّا يَعۡمَلُونَ ١٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: رب نجني واهلي مما يعملون
ayahs.translation: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."
ayahs.transliteration: rab-bi naj-jji-nee waah-lee mim-mmaa ya-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ ١٧٠
ayahs.text_simple: فنجينه واهله اجمعين
ayahs.translation: So We saved him and his family, all,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-naj-jai-naa-hu waah-la-hooo aj-maeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَجُوزٗا فِي ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ ١٧١
ayahs.text_simple: الا عجوزا في الغبرين
ayahs.translation: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa a-joo-zan fil ghaa-bireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَمَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ ١٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: ثم دمرنا الاخرين
ayahs.translation: Then We destroyed the others.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma dam-mar-nal aa-khareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم مَّطَرٗاۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ ١٧٣
ayahs.text_simple: وامطرنا عليهم مطرا فساء مطر المنذرين
ayahs.translation: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
ayahs.transliteration: waam-tar-naa a-lai-him ma-ta-ran fa-saaaa ma-ta-rul mun-zareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ ١٧٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان في ذلك لاية وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayah wa-maa kaa-na ak-sa-ru-hum mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ١٧٥
ayahs.text_simple: وان ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم
ayahs.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na rab-ba-ka la-hu-wal azee-zur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَ أَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ ١٧٦
ayahs.text_simple: كذب اصحب ليكة المرسلين
ayahs.translation: The companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] denied the messengers
ayahs.transliteration: kaz-za-ba a-shaa-bul ay-ka-til mur-saleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ ١٧٧
ayahs.text_simple: اذ قال لهم شعيب الا تتقون
ayahs.translation: When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
ayahs.transliteration: iz qaa-la la-hum shu-a-y-bun a-laa tat-ta-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ ١٧٨
ayahs.text_simple: اني لكم رسول امين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nee la-kum ra-soo-lun ameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ١٧٩
ayahs.text_simple: فاتقوا الله واطيعون
ayahs.translation: So fear Allāh and obey me.
ayahs.transliteration: fat-ta-qul laa-ha waatee-o-on

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ١٨٠
ayahs.text_simple: وما اسلكم عليه من اجر ان اجري الا علي رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa a-sa-lu-kum a-lai-hi min aj-rin in aj-riya il-laa a-laa rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ أَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡكَيۡلَ وَلَا تَكُونُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡسِرِينَ ١٨١
ayahs.text_simple: اوفوا الكيل ولا تكونوا من المخسرين
ayahs.translation: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
ayahs.transliteration: aw-ful kai-la wa-laa ta-koo-noo mi-nal muk-hsi-reen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَزِنُواْ بِٱلۡقِسۡطَاسِ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمِ ١٨٢
ayahs.text_simple: وزنوا بالقسطاس المستقيم
ayahs.translation: And weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-zi-noo bil-qis-taa-sil mus-taqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَبۡخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ ١٨٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولا تبخسوا الناس اشياءهم ولا تعثوا في الارض مفسدين
ayahs.translation: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa tab-kha-sun naa-sa a-shyaaaa-hum wa-laa ta-saw fil ar-di muf-sideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ وَٱلۡجِبِلَّةَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ١٨٤
ayahs.text_simple: واتقوا الذي خلقكم والجبلة الاولين
ayahs.translation: And fear He who created you and the former creation."
ayahs.transliteration: wat-ta-qul lazee kha-la-qa-kum wal-ji-bil-la-tal aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسَحَّرِينَ ١٨٥
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا انما انت من المسحرين
ayahs.translation: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-looo in-na-maa an-ta mi-nal mu-sa-hhareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ ١٨٦
ayahs.text_simple: وما انت الا بشر مثلنا وان نظنك لمن الكذبين
ayahs.translation: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa an-ta il-laa ba-sha-rum mis-lu-naa wain na-zun-nu-ka la-mi-nal kaa-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡنَا كِسَفٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ ١٨٧
ayahs.text_simple: فاسقط علينا كسفا من السماء ان كنت من الصدقين
ayahs.translation: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: faas-qit a-lai-naa ki-sa-fam mi-nas sa-maaai in kun-ta mi-nas saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ ١٨٨
ayahs.text_simple: قال ربي اعلم بما تعملون
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-beee a-la-mu bi-maa ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٍ ١٨٩
ayahs.text_simple: فكذبوه فاخذهم عذاب يوم الظلة انه كان عذاب يوم عظيم
ayahs.translation: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kaz-za-boo-hu faa-kha-za-hum a-zaa-bu yaw-miz zul-lah in-na-hoo kaa-na a-zaa-ba yaw-min azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ ١٩٠
ayahs.text_simple: ان في ذلك لاية وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayah wa-maa kaa-na ak-sa-ru-hum mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ١٩١
ayahs.text_simple: وان ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم
ayahs.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na rab-ba-ka la-hu-wal azee-zur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ١٩٢
ayahs.text_simple: وانه لتنزيل رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na-hoo la-tan-zee-lu rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلۡأَمِينُ ١٩٣
ayahs.text_simple: نزل به الروح الامين
ayahs.translation: The Trustworthy Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down
ayahs.transliteration: na-za-la bi-hir roo-hul ameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ قَلۡبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنذِرِينَ ١٩٤
ayahs.text_simple: علي قلبك لتكون من المنذرين
ayahs.translation: Upon your heart, [O Muḥammad] - that you may be of the warners
ayahs.transliteration: a-laa qal-bi-ka li-ta-koo-na mi-nal mun-zireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِيّٖ مُّبِينٖ ١٩٥
ayahs.text_simple: بلسان عربي مبين
ayahs.translation: In a clear Arabic language.
ayahs.transliteration: bi-li-saa-nin a-ra-biyyim mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِي زُبُرِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ١٩٦
ayahs.text_simple: وانه لفي زبر الاولين
ayahs.translation: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na-hoo lafee zu-bu-ril aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُمۡ ءَايَةً أَن يَعۡلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُاْ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ١٩٧
ayahs.text_simple: اولم يكن لهم ءاية ان يعلمه علمؤا بني اسرءيل
ayahs.translation: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-lam ya-kul la-hum aaya-tan ai ya-la-ma-hoo u-la-maaau baneee is-raaaeel

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡ نَزَّلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضِ ٱلۡأَعۡجَمِينَ ١٩٨
ayahs.text_simple: ولو نزلنه علي بعض الاعجمين
ayahs.translation: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law naz-zal-naa-hu a-laa ba-dil a-jameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنِينَ ١٩٩
ayahs.text_simple: فقراه عليهم ما كانوا به مؤمنين
ayahs.translation: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qa-raa-hoo a-lai-him maa kaa-noo bihee mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكۡنَٰهُ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ ٢٠٠
ayahs.text_simple: كذلك سلكنه في قلوب المجرمين
ayahs.translation: Thus have We inserted it [i.e., disbelief] into the hearts of the criminals.
ayahs.transliteration: ka-zaa-li-ka sa-lak-naa-hu fee qu-loo-bil muj-rimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ ٢٠١
ayahs.text_simple: لا يؤمنون به حتي يروا العذاب الاليم
ayahs.translation: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: laa yu-mi-noo-na bihee hat-taa ya-ra-wul a-zaa-bal aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَيَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ ٢٠٢
ayahs.text_simple: فياتيهم بغتة وهم لا يشعرون
ayahs.translation: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
ayahs.transliteration: fayaa-tiya-hum bag-hta-tanw wa-hum laa ya-shu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَيَقُولُواْ هَلۡ نَحۡنُ مُنظَرُونَ ٢٠٣
ayahs.text_simple: فيقولوا هل نحن منظرون
ayahs.translation: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
ayahs.transliteration: faya-qoo-loo hal nah-nu mun-za-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ ٢٠٤
ayahs.text_simple: افبعذابنا يستعجلون
ayahs.translation: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-bi-a-zaa-bi-naa yas-ta-ji-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ إِن مَّتَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ سِنِينَ ٢٠٥
ayahs.text_simple: افرءيت ان متعنهم سنين
ayahs.translation: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-raai-ta im mat-ta-naa-hum sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ ٢٠٦
ayahs.text_simple: ثم جاءهم ما كانوا يوعدون
ayahs.translation: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma jaaaa-hum maa kaa-noo yoo-a-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُمَتَّعُونَ ٢٠٧
ayahs.text_simple: ما اغني عنهم ما كانوا يمتعون
ayahs.translation: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
ayahs.transliteration: maaa ag-hnaaa a-nhum maa kaa-noo yu-mat-taoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ ٢٠٨
ayahs.text_simple: وما اهلكنا من قرية الا لها منذرون
ayahs.translation: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa ah-lak-naa min qa-rya-tin il-laa la-haa mun-zi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذِكۡرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ ٢٠٩
ayahs.text_simple: ذكري وما كنا ظلمين
ayahs.translation: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
ayahs.transliteration: zik-raa wa-maa kun-naa zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتۡ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ ٢١٠
ayahs.text_simple: وما تنزلت به الشيطين
ayahs.translation: And the devils have not brought it [i.e., the revelation] down.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa ta-naz-za-lat bi-hish shayaateen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لَهُمۡ وَمَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ ٢١١
ayahs.text_simple: وما ينبغي لهم وما يستطيعون
ayahs.translation: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa yam-ba-ghee la-hum wa-maa yas-ta-tee-o-on

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّمۡعِ لَمَعۡزُولُونَ ٢١٢
ayahs.text_simple: انهم عن السمع لمعزولون
ayahs.translation: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hum a-nis sa-mi la-ma-zoo-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُعَذَّبِينَ ٢١٣
ayahs.text_simple: فلا تدع مع الله الها ءاخر فتكون من المعذبين
ayahs.translation: So do not invoke with Allāh another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-laa ta-du maal laa-hi i-laa-han aa-kha-ra fa-ta-koo-na mi-nal mu-a-zza-been

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنذِرۡ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلۡأَقۡرَبِينَ ٢١٤
ayahs.text_simple: وانذر عشيرتك الاقربين
ayahs.translation: And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.
ayahs.transliteration: waan-zir a-shee-ra-ta-kal aq-rabeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٢١٥
ayahs.text_simple: واخفض جناحك لمن اتبعك من المؤمنين
ayahs.translation: And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to those who follow you of the believers.
ayahs.transliteration: wak-hfid ja-naa-ha-ka li-ma-nit ta-baa-ka mi-nal mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِنۡ عَصَوۡكَ فَقُلۡ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ ٢١٦
ayahs.text_simple: فان عصوك فقل اني بريء مما تعملون
ayahs.translation: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
ayahs.transliteration: fain a-saw-ka fa-qul in-nee bareee-um mim-mmaa ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٢١٧
ayahs.text_simple: وتوكل علي العزيز الرحيم
ayahs.translation: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-wak-kal a-lal azee-zir raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ ٢١٨
ayahs.text_simple: الذي يريك حين تقوم
ayahs.translation: Who sees you when you arise
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee ya-raa-ka hee-na ta-qoom

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ ٢١٩
ayahs.text_simple: وتقلبك في السجدين
ayahs.translation: And your movement among those who prostrate.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-qal-lu-ba-ka fis saa-jideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٢٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: انه هو السميع العليم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hoo hu-was samee-ul aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَلۡ أُنَبِّئُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ ٢٢١
ayahs.text_simple: هل انبئكم علي من تنزل الشيطين
ayahs.translation: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
ayahs.transliteration: hal u-nab-biu-kum a-laa man ta-naz-za-lush shayaateen

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٖ ٢٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: تنزل علي كل افاك اثيم
ayahs.translation: They descend upon every sinful liar.
ayahs.transliteration: ta-naz-za-lu a-laa kul-li af-faa-kin aseem

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُلۡقُونَ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَأَكۡثَرُهُمۡ كَٰذِبُونَ ٢٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: يلقون السمع واكثرهم كذبون
ayahs.translation: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
ayahs.transliteration: yul-qoo-nas sa-ma waak-sa-ru-hum kaa-zi-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلۡغَاوُۥنَ ٢٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: والشعراء يتبعهم الغاون
ayahs.translation: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them.
ayahs.transliteration: was-hshu-a-raaau yat-ta-biu-hu-mul ghaa-woon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّهُمۡ فِي كُلِّ وَادٖ يَهِيمُونَ ٢٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: الم تر انهم في كل واد يهيمون
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam ta-ra an-na-hum fee kul-li waa-di-ny ya-hee-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُمۡ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفۡعَلُونَ ٢٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: وانهم يقولون ما لا يفعلون
ayahs.translation: And that they say what they do not do? -
ayahs.transliteration: waan-na-hum ya-qoo-loo-na ma laa yaf a-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا وَٱنتَصَرُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْۗ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَيَّ مُنقَلَبٖ يَنقَلِبُونَ ٢٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: الا الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت وذكروا الله كثيرا وانتصروا من بعد ما ظلموا وسيعلم الذين ظلموا اي منقلب ينقلبون
ayahs.translation: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allāh often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
ayahs.transliteration: il-lal lazee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti wa-za-ka-rul laa-ha kasee-ranw wan-ta-sa-roo min ba-di maa zu-li-moo wa-saya-la-mul lazee-na za-la-mooo aiya mun-qa-la-bi-ny yan-qa-li-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: طسٓۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ وَكِتَابٖ مُّبِينٍ ١
ayahs.text_simple: طس تلك ءايت القرءان وكتاب مبين
ayahs.translation: Ṭā, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] and a clear Book
ayahs.transliteration: taaseeen til-ka aayaa-tul qu-raa-ni wa-ki-taa-bim mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: هُدٗى وَبُشۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: هدي وبشري للمؤمنين
ayahs.translation: As guidance and good tidings for the believers
ayahs.transliteration: hu-danw wa-bus-hraa lil-mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوقِنُونَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: الذين يقيمون الصلوة ويؤتون الزكوة وهم بالاخرة هم يوقنون
ayahs.translation: Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na yu-qee-moo-nas sa-laa-ta wayu-too-naz za-kaa-ta wa-hum bi-laa-khi-ra-ti hum yoo-qi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين لا يؤمنون بالاخرة زينا لهم اعملهم فهم يعمهون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na laa yu-mi-noo-na bi-laa-khi-ra-ti zaiyan-naa la-hum a-maa-la-hum fa-hum ya-ma-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمۡ سُوٓءُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ وَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلۡأَخۡسَرُونَ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك الذين لهم سوء العذاب وهم في الاخرة هم الاخسرون
ayahs.translation: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-kal lazee-na la-hum soooul a-zaa-bi wa-hum fil aa-khi-ra-ti hu-mul ak-hsa-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ مِن لَّدُنۡ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: وانك لتلقي القرءان من لدن حكيم عليم
ayahs.translation: And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you receive the Qur’ān from one Wise and Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na-ka la-tu-laq-qal qu-raa-na mil la-dun hakee-min aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهۡلِهِۦٓ إِنِّيٓ ءَانَسۡتُ نَارٗا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنۡهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوۡ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٖ قَبَسٖ لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَصۡطَلُونَ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: اذ قال موسي لاهله اني ءانست نارا ساتيكم منها بخبر او ءاتيكم بشهاب قبس لعلكم تصطلون
ayahs.translation: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."
ayahs.transliteration: iz qaa-la moo-saa li-a-hli-heee in-neee aa-nas-tu naa-ran saaatee-kum mi-nhaa bi-kha-ba-rin aw aa-tee-kum bi-shi-haa-bin qa-ba-sil laal-la-kum tas-ta-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِيَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَا وَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: فلما جاءها نودي ان بورك من في النار ومن حولها وسبحن الله رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa jaaaa-haa noo-diya am boo-ri-ka man fin nnnaa-ri wa-man haw-la-haa wa-su-bhaa-nal laa-hi rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: يموسي انه انا الله العزيز الحكيم
ayahs.translation: O Moses, indeed it is I - Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
ayahs.transliteration: yaa-moo-saaa in-na-hooo a-nal laa-hul azee-zul hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَلۡقِ عَصَاكَۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهۡتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنّٞ وَلَّىٰ مُدۡبِرٗا وَلَمۡ يُعَقِّبۡۚ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفۡ إِنِّي لَا يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: والق عصاك فلما رءاها تهتز كانها جان ولي مدبرا ولم يعقب يموسي لا تخف اني لا يخاف لدي المرسلون
ayahs.translation: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allāh said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.
ayahs.transliteration: waal-qi a-saak fa-lam-mmaa raaa-haa tah-taz-zu kaan-na-haa jaaan-nunw wal-laa mud-bi-ranw wa-lam yu-a-qqib yaa-moo-saa laa ta-khaf in-nee laa ya-khaa-fu la-daiyal mur-sa-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسۡنَۢا بَعۡدَ سُوٓءٖ فَإِنِّي غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: الا من ظلم ثم بدل حسنا بعد سوء فاني غفور رحيم
ayahs.translation: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa man za-la-ma sum-ma bad-da-la hus-nam ba-da soooin fain-nee gha-foo-rur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَدۡخِلۡ يَدَكَ فِي جَيۡبِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٖۖ فِي تِسۡعِ ءَايَٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَقَوۡمِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: وادخل يدك في جيبك تخرج بيضاء من غير سوء في تسع ءايت الي فرعون وقومه انهم كانوا قوما فسقين
ayahs.translation: And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."
ayahs.transliteration: waad-khil ya-da-ka fee jai-bi-ka tak-hruj bai-daaaa min ghai-ri soooin fee ti-si aayaa-tin i-laa fi-raw-na wa-qaw-mih in-na-hum kaa-noo qaw-man faa-siqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا مُبۡصِرَةٗ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٞ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: فلما جاءتهم ءايتنا مبصرة قالوا هذا سحر مبين
ayahs.translation: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa jaaaa-thum aayaa-tu-naa mub-si-ra-tan qaa-loo haa-zaa sih-rum mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَحَدُواْ بِهَا وَٱسۡتَيۡقَنَتۡهَآ أَنفُسُهُمۡ ظُلۡمٗا وَعُلُوّٗاۚ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: وجحدوا بها واستيقنتها انفسهم ظلما وعلوا فانظر كيف كان عقبة المفسدين
ayahs.translation: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ja-ha-doo bi-haa was-tai-qa-na-thaaa an-fu-su-hum zul-man-wwa u-luw-waa fan-zur kai-fa kaa-na aa-qi-ba-tul muf-sideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيۡمَٰنَ عِلۡمٗاۖ وَقَالَا ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٖ مِّنۡ عِبَادِهِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ءاتينا داود وسليمن علما وقالا الحمد لله الذي فضلنا علي كثير من عباده المؤمنين
ayahs.translation: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allāh, who has favored us over many of His believing servants."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad aa-tai-naa daa-woo-da wa-su-lai-maa-na il-maa wa-qaa-lal ham-du lil-laa-hil lazee fad-da-la-naa a-laa kasee-rim min i-baa-di-hil mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَۖ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمۡنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيۡرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡفَضۡلُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: وورث سليمن داود وقال يايها الناس علمنا منطق الطير واوتينا من كل شيء ان هذا لهو الفضل المبين
ayahs.translation: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-wa-ri-sa su-lai-maa-nu daa-woo-da wa-qaa-la yaaaaiyu-han naa-su ul-lim-naa man-ti-qat tai-ri waootee-naa min kul-li shaiin in-na haa-zaa la-hu-wal fad-lul mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيۡمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيۡرِ فَهُمۡ يُوزَعُونَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: وحشر لسليمن جنوده من الجن والانس والطير فهم يوزعون
ayahs.translation: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-shi-ra su-lai-maa-na ju-noo-du-hoo mi-nal jin-ni wa-lin-si wat-tai-ri fa-hum yoo-zaoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمۡلِ قَالَتۡ نَمۡلَةٞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمۡلُ ٱدۡخُلُواْ مَسَٰكِنَكُمۡ لَا يَحۡطِمَنَّكُمۡ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: حتي اذا اتوا علي واد النمل قالت نملة يايها النمل ادخلوا مسكنكم لا يحطمنكم سليمن وجنوده وهم لا يشعرون
ayahs.translation: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."
ayahs.transliteration: hat-taaa i-zaaa a-taw a-laa waa-din nam-li qaa-lat nam-la-tu-ny yaaaaiyu-han nam-lud khu-loo ma-saa-ki-na-kum laa yah-ti-man-na-kum su-lai-maa-nu wa-ju-noo-du-hoo wa-hum laa ya-shu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكٗا مِّن قَوۡلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحٗا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَدۡخِلۡنِي بِرَحۡمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: فتبسم ضاحكا من قولها وقال رب اوزعني ان اشكر نعمتك التي انعمت علي وعلي ولدي وان اعمل صلحا ترضيه وادخلني برحمتك في عبادك الصلحين
ayahs.translation: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ta-bas-sa-ma daa-hi-kam min qaw-li-haa wa-qaa-la rab-bi aw-zinee an as-hku-ra ni-ma-ta-kal lateee a-nam-ta a-laiya waa-laa waa-li-daiya waan a-ma-la saa-li-han tar-daa-hu waad-khil-nee bi-rah-ma-ti-ka fee i-baa-di-kas saa-liheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيۡرَ فَقَالَ مَالِيَ لَآ أَرَى ٱلۡهُدۡهُدَ أَمۡ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَآئِبِينَ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: وتفقد الطير فقال مالي لا اري الهدهد ام كان من الغائبين
ayahs.translation: And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-faq-qa-dat tai-ra fa-qaa-la maa liya laaa a-raa a-lhu-dhu-da am kaa-na mi-nal ghaaaibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَابٗا شَدِيدًا أَوۡ لَأَاْذۡبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوۡ لَيَأۡتِيَنِّي بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: لاعذبنه عذابا شديدا او لااذبحنه او لياتيني بسلطن مبين
ayahs.translation: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."
ayahs.transliteration: lau-a-zzi-ba-na-hoo a-zaa-ban shadee-dan aw laaz-ba-han-na-hoo aw layaa-tiyan-nee bi-sul-taa-nim mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَكَثَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيدٖ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمۡ تُحِطۡ بِهِۦ وَجِئۡتُكَ مِن سَبَإِۭ بِنَبَإٖ يَقِينٍ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: فمكث غير بعيد فقال احطت بما لم تحط به وجئتك من سبا بنبا يقين
ayahs.translation: But he [i.e., the hoopoe] stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ma-ka-sa ghai-ra baee-din fa-qaa-la a-hat-tu bi-maa lam tu-hit bihee wa-ji-tu-ka min sa-baim bi-na-ba i-nyyaqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنِّي وَجَدتُّ ٱمۡرَأَةٗ تَمۡلِكُهُمۡ وَأُوتِيَتۡ مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَلَهَا عَرۡشٌ عَظِيمٞ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: اني وجدت امراة تملكهم واوتيت من كل شيء ولها عرش عظيم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nee wa-jat-tum raa-tan tam-li-ku-hum waoo-tiyat min kul-li shaiinw wa-la-haa ar-shun azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوۡمَهَا يَسۡجُدُونَ لِلشَّمۡسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَصَدَّهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمۡ لَا يَهۡتَدُونَ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: وجدتها وقومها يسجدون للشمس من دون الله وزين لهم الشيطن اعملهم فصدهم عن السبيل فهم لا يهتدون
ayahs.translation: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allāh, and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from [His] way, so they are not guided,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jat-tu-haa wa-qaw-ma-haa yas-ju-doo-na lis-hsham-si min doo-nil laa-hi wa-zaiya-na la-hu-mush shai-taa-nu a-maa-la-hum fa-sad-da-hum a-nis sabee-li fa-hum laa yah-ta-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَّاۤ يَسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي يُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡخَبۡءَ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُخۡفُونَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُونَ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: الا يسجدوا لله الذي يخرج الخبء في السموت والارض ويعلم ما تخفون وما تعلنون
ayahs.translation: [And] so they do not prostrate to Allāh, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare -
ayahs.transliteration: al-laa yas-ju-doo lil-laa-hil lazee yuk-hri-jul kha-ba fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di waya-la-mu maa tuk-hfoo-na wa-maa tu-li-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ۩ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: الله لا اله الا هو رب العرش العظيم
ayahs.translation: Allāh - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne."
ayahs.transliteration: al-laa-hu laaa i-laa-ha il-laa hu-wa rab-bul ar-shil azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقۡتَ أَمۡ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: قال سننظر اصدقت ام كنت من الكذبين
ayahs.translation: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la sa-nan-zu-ru a-sa-daq-ta am kun-ta mi-nal kaa-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱذۡهَب بِّكِتَٰبِي هَٰذَا فَأَلۡقِهۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا يَرۡجِعُونَ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: اذهب بكتبي هذا فالقه اليهم ثم تول عنهم فانظر ماذا يرجعون
ayahs.translation: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."
ayahs.transliteration: i-zhab bi-ki-taabee haa-za faal-qih i-lai-him sum-mma ta-wal-la a-nhum fan-zur maa-zaa yar-jioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَتۡ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ إِنِّيٓ أُلۡقِيَ إِلَيَّ كِتَٰبٞ كَرِيمٌ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: قالت يايها الملؤا اني القي الي كتب كريم
ayahs.translation: She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-lat yaaaaiyu-hal ma-lau in-nee ul-qiya i-laiya ki-taa-bun kareem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: انه من سليمن وانه بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it is [i.e., reads]: 'In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hoo min su-lai-maa-na wain-na-hoo bis-mil laa-hir rah-maa-nir raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَيَّ وَأۡتُونِي مُسۡلِمِينَ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: الا تعلوا علي واتوني مسلمين
ayahs.translation: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].'"
ayahs.transliteration: al-laa ta-loo a-laiya waa-toonee mus-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَتۡ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ أَفۡتُونِي فِيٓ أَمۡرِي مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمۡرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشۡهَدُونِ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: قالت يايها الملؤا افتوني في امري ما كنت قاطعة امرا حتي تشهدون
ayahs.translation: She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-lat yaaaaiyu-hal ma-lau af-toonee fee am-ree maa kun-tu qaa-ti-a-tan am-ran hat-taa tas-hhha-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ نَحۡنُ أُوْلُواْ قُوَّةٖ وَأُوْلُواْ بَأۡسٖ شَدِيدٖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ إِلَيۡكِ فَٱنظُرِي مَاذَا تَأۡمُرِينَ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا نحن اولوا قوة واولوا باس شديد والامر اليك فانظري ماذا تامرين
ayahs.translation: They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo nah-nu u-loo quw-wa-tinw wau-loo baa-sin shadeed wa-lam-ru i-lai-ki fan-zuree maa-zaa taa-mureen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَتۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُواْ قَرۡيَةً أَفۡسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوٓاْ أَعِزَّةَ أَهۡلِهَآ أَذِلَّةٗۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُونَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: قالت ان الملوك اذا دخلوا قرية افسدوها وجعلوا اعزة اهلها اذلة وكذلك يفعلون
ayahs.translation: She said, "Indeed kings - when they enter a city, they ruin it and render the honored of its people humbled. And thus do they do.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-lat in-nal mu-loo-ka i-zaa da-kha-loo qa-rya-tan af-sa-doo-haa wa-jaa-looo aiz-za-ta ah-li-haaa a-zil-lah wa-ka-zaa-li-ka yaf a-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنِّي مُرۡسِلَةٌ إِلَيۡهِم بِهَدِيَّةٖ فَنَاظِرَةُۢ بِمَ يَرۡجِعُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: واني مرسلة اليهم بهدية فناظرة بم يرجع المرسلون
ayahs.translation: But indeed, I will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return."
ayahs.transliteration: wain-nee mur-si-la-tun i-lai-him bi-ha-diyya-tin fa-naa-zi-ra-tum bi-ma yar-jiul mur-sa-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٖ فَمَآ ءَاتَىٰنِۦَ ٱللَّهُ خَيۡرٞ مِّمَّآ ءَاتَىٰكُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُمۡ تَفۡرَحُونَ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: فلما جاء سليمن قال اتمدونن بمال فما ءاتين الله خير مما ءاتيكم بل انتم بهديتكم تفرحون
ayahs.translation: So when they came to Solomon, he said, "Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allāh has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa jaaaa su-lai-maa-na qaa-la a-tu-mid-doo-na-ni bi-maa-lin fa-maaa aa-taa-niyal laa-hu khai-rum mim-mmaaa aa-taa-kum bal an-tum bi-ha-diyya-ti-kum taf-ra-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱرۡجِعۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ فَلَنَأۡتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٖ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِهَا وَلَنُخۡرِجَنَّهُم مِّنۡهَآ أَذِلَّةٗ وَهُمۡ صَٰغِرُونَ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: ارجع اليهم فلناتينهم بجنود لا قبل لهم بها ولنخرجنهم منها اذلة وهم صغرون
ayahs.translation: Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased."
ayahs.transliteration: ir-ji i-lai-him fa-la-naa-tiyan-na-hum bi-ju-noo-dil laa qi-ba-la la-hum bi-haa wa-la-nuk-hri-jan-na-hum mi-nhaaa a-zil-la-tanw wa-hum saa-ghi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ أَيُّكُمۡ يَأۡتِينِي بِعَرۡشِهَا قَبۡلَ أَن يَأۡتُونِي مُسۡلِمِينَ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: قال يايها الملؤا ايكم ياتيني بعرشها قبل ان ياتوني مسلمين
ayahs.translation: [Solomon] said, "O assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la yaaaaiyu-hal ma-lau aiyu-kum yaa-teenee bi-a-rshi-haa qab-la ai yaa-toonee mus-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ عِفۡرِيتٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبۡلَ أَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَۖ وَإِنِّي عَلَيۡهِ لَقَوِيٌّ أَمِينٞ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: قال عفريت من الجن انا ءاتيك به قبل ان تقوم من مقامك واني عليه لقوي امين
ayahs.translation: A powerful one from among the jinn said, "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and indeed, I am for this [task] strong and trustworthy."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la if-ree-tum mi-nal jin-ni a-na aa-tee-ka bihee qab-la an ta-qoo-ma mim ma-qaa-mi-ka wain-nee a-lai-hi la-qa-wiyyun ameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ ٱلَّذِي عِندَهُۥ عِلۡمٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبۡلَ أَن يَرۡتَدَّ إِلَيۡكَ طَرۡفُكَۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسۡتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِن فَضۡلِ رَبِّي لِيَبۡلُوَنِيٓ ءَأَشۡكُرُ أَمۡ أَكۡفُرُۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشۡكُرُ لِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّي غَنِيّٞ كَرِيمٞ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: قال الذي عنده علم من الكتب انا ءاتيك به قبل ان يرتد اليك طرفك فلما رءاه مستقرا عنده قال هذا من فضل ربي ليبلوني ءاشكر ام اكفر ومن شكر فانما يشكر لنفسه ومن كفر فان ربي غني كريم
ayahs.translation: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-lal lazee in-da-hoo il-mum mi-nal ki-taa-bi a-na aa-tee-ka bihee qab-la ai yar-tad-da i-lai-ka tar-fuk fa-lam-maa raaa-hu mus-ta-qir-ran in-da-hoo qaa-la haa-zaa min fad-li rab-bee liyab-lu-waneee aas-hku-ru am ak-fu-ru wa-man sha-ka-ra fain-na-maa yas-hku-ru li-naf-sihee wa-man ka-fa-ra fain-na rab-bee gha-niyyun kareem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ نَكِّرُواْ لَهَا عَرۡشَهَا نَنظُرۡ أَتَهۡتَدِيٓ أَمۡ تَكُونُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَهۡتَدُونَ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: قال نكروا لها عرشها ننظر اتهتدي ام تكون من الذين لا يهتدون
ayahs.translation: He said, "Disguise for her her throne; we will see whether she will be guided [to truth] or will be of those who is not guided."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la nak-ki-roo la-haa ar-sha-haa nan-zur a-tah-tadeee am ta-koo-nu mi-nal lazee-na laa yah-ta-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ قِيلَ أَهَٰكَذَا عَرۡشُكِۖ قَالَتۡ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلۡعِلۡمَ مِن قَبۡلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسۡلِمِينَ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: فلما جاءت قيل اهكذا عرشك قالت كانه هو واوتينا العلم من قبلها وكنا مسلمين
ayahs.translation: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa jaaaat qee-la a-haa-ka-za ar-shu-ki qaa-lat kaan-na-hoo hoo waootee-nal il-ma min qab-li-haa wa-kun-naa mus-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَت تَّعۡبُدُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّهَا كَانَتۡ مِن قَوۡمٖ كَٰفِرِينَ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: وصدها ما كانت تعبد من دون الله انها كانت من قوم كفرين
ayahs.translation: And that which she was worshipping other than Allāh had averted her [from submission to Him]. Indeed, she was from a disbelieving people."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-sad-da-haa maa kaa-nat ta-bu-du min doo-nil laa-hi in-na-haa kaa-nat min qaw-min kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدۡخُلِي ٱلصَّرۡحَۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتۡهُ حَسِبَتۡهُ لُجَّةٗ وَكَشَفَتۡ عَن سَاقَيۡهَاۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرۡحٞ مُّمَرَّدٞ مِّن قَوَارِيرَۗ قَالَتۡ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِي وَأَسۡلَمۡتُ مَعَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: قيل لها ادخلي الصرح فلما راته حسبته لجة وكشفت عن ساقيها قال انه صرح ممرد من قوارير قالت رب اني ظلمت نفسي واسلمت مع سليمن لله رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds."
ayahs.transliteration: qee-la la-had khu-lis sa-rha fa-lam-maa raa-thu ha-si-ba-thu luj-ja-tanw wa-kha-sha-fat an saa-qai-haa qaa-la in-na-hoo sa-rhum mu-mar-ra-dum min qa-waareer qaa-lat rab-bi in-nee za-lam-tu naf-see waas-lam-tu maa su-lai-maa-na lil-laa-hi rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمۡ صَٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمۡ فَرِيقَانِ يَخۡتَصِمُونَ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ارسلنا الي ثمود اخاهم صلحا ان اعبدوا الله فاذا هم فريقان يختصمون
ayahs.translation: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad ar-sal-naaa i-laa sa-moo-da a-khaa-hum saa-li-han a-ni bu-dul laa-ha fai-zaa hum faree-qaa-ni yak-hta-si-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ لِمَ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبۡلَ ٱلۡحَسَنَةِۖ لَوۡلَا تَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: قال يقوم لم تستعجلون بالسيئة قبل الحسنة لولا تستغفرون الله لعلكم ترحمون
ayahs.translation: He said, "O my people, why are you impatient for evil before [i.e., instead of] good? Why do you not seek forgiveness of Allāh that you may receive mercy?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la yaa-qaw-mi li-ma tas-ta-ji-loo-na bis-saiyi-a-ti qab-lal ha-sa-na-ti law-laa tas-tag-hfi-roo-nal laa-ha laal-la-kum tu-rha-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ ٱطَّيَّرۡنَا بِكَ وَبِمَن مَّعَكَۚ قَالَ طَٰٓئِرُكُمۡ عِندَ ٱللَّهِۖ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٞ تُفۡتَنُونَ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا اطيرنا بك وبمن معك قال طئركم عند الله بل انتم قوم تفتنون
ayahs.translation: They said, "We consider you a bad omen, you and those with you." He said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with Allāh. Rather, you are a people being tested."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-lut taiyar-naa bi-ka wa-bi-mam maak qaa-la taaai-ru-kum in-dal laa-hi bal an-tum qaw-mun tuf-ta-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَانَ فِي ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ تِسۡعَةُ رَهۡطٖ يُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُونَ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: وكان في المدينة تسعة رهط يفسدون في الارض ولا يصلحون
ayahs.translation: And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kaa-na fil madee-na-ti ti-sa-tu rah-ti-ny yuf-si-doo-na fil ar-di wa-laa yus-li-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ تَقَاسَمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُۥ وَأَهۡلَهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِۦ مَا شَهِدۡنَا مَهۡلِكَ أَهۡلِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا تقاسموا بالله لنبيتنه واهله ثم لنقولن لوليه ما شهدنا مهلك اهله وانا لصدقون
ayahs.translation: They said, "Take a mutual oath by Allāh that we will kill him by night, he and his family. Then we will say to his executor, 'We did not witness the destruction of his family, and indeed, we are truthful.'"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo ta-qaa-sa-moo bil-laa-hi la-nu-baiyi-tan-na-hoo waah-la-hoo sum-maa la-na-qoo-la-na li-wa-liyyihee maa sha-hid-naa mah-li-ka ah-lihee wain-naa la-saa-di-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرٗا وَمَكَرۡنَا مَكۡرٗا وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: ومكروا مكرا ومكرنا مكرا وهم لا يشعرون
ayahs.translation: And they planned a plan, and We planned a plan, while they perceived not.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ma-ka-roo mak-ranw wa-ma-kar-naa mak-ranw wa-hum laa ya-shu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ مَكۡرِهِمۡ أَنَّا دَمَّرۡنَٰهُمۡ وَقَوۡمَهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: فانظر كيف كان عقبة مكرهم انا دمرنهم وقومهم اجمعين
ayahs.translation: Then look how was the outcome of their plan - that We destroyed them and their people, all.
ayahs.transliteration: fan-zur kai-fa kaa-na aa-qi-ba-tu mak-ri-him an-naa dam-mar-naa-hum wa-qaw-ma-hum aj-maeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَتِلۡكَ بُيُوتُهُمۡ خَاوِيَةَۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡلَمُونَ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: فتلك بيوتهم خاوية بما ظلموا ان في ذلك لاية لقوم يعلمون
ayahs.translation: So those are their houses, desolate because of the wrong they had done. Indeed in that is a sign for people who know.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-til-ka buyoo-tu-hum khaa-wiya-tam bi-maa za-la-moo in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaaya-tal li-qaw mi-nyya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنجَيۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَكَانُواْ يَتَّقُونَ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: وانجينا الذين ءامنوا وكانوا يتقون
ayahs.translation: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allāh.
ayahs.transliteration: waan-jai-nal lazee-na aa-ma-noo wa-kaa-noo yat-ta-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلُوطًا إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلۡفَٰحِشَةَ وَأَنتُمۡ تُبۡصِرُونَ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولوطا اذ قال لقومه اتاتون الفحشة وانتم تبصرون
ayahs.translation: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Do you commit immorality while you are seeing?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-loo-tan iz qaa-la li-qaw-miheee a-taa-too-nal faa-hi-sha-ta waan-tum tub-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ شَهۡوَةٗ مِّن دُونِ ٱلنِّسَآءِۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٞ تَجۡهَلُونَ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: ائنكم لتاتون الرجال شهوة من دون النساء بل انتم قوم تجهلون
ayahs.translation: Do you indeed approach men with desire instead of women? Rather, you are a people behaving ignorantly."
ayahs.transliteration: ain-na-kum la-taa-too-nar ri-jaa-la shah-wa-tam min doo-nin ni-saaa bal an-tum qaw-mun ta-jha-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓاْ أَخۡرِجُوٓاْ ءَالَ لُوطٖ مِّن قَرۡيَتِكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُمۡ أُنَاسٞ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: فما كان جواب قومه الا ان قالوا اخرجوا ءال لوط من قريتكم انهم اناس يتطهرون
ayahs.translation: But the answer of his people was not except that they said, "Expel the family of Lot from your city. Indeed, they are people who keep themselves pure."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-maa kaa-na ja-waa-ba qaw-miheee il-laaa an qaa-looo ak-hri-jooo aa-laa loo-tim min qa-rya-ti-kum in-na-hum u-naa-su-ny ya-ta-ta-hha-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرۡنَٰهَا مِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: فانجينه واهله الا امراته قدرنها من الغبرين
ayahs.translation: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; We destined her to be of those who remained behind.
ayahs.transliteration: faan-jai-naa-hu waah-la-hooo il-lam raa-ta-hoo qad-dar-naa-haa mi-nal ghaa-bireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم مَّطَرٗاۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: وامطرنا عليهم مطرا فساء مطر المنذرين
ayahs.translation: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
ayahs.transliteration: waam-tar-naa a-lai-himm ma-ta-ran fa-saaaa ma-ta-rul mun-zareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصۡطَفَىٰٓۗ ءَآللَّهُ خَيۡرٌ أَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: قل الحمد لله وسلم علي عباده الذين اصطفي ءالله خير اما يشركون
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Praise be to Allāh, and peace upon His servants whom He has chosen. Is Allāh better or what they associate with Him?"
ayahs.transliteration: qu-lil ham-du lil-laa-hi wa-sa-laa-mun a-laa i-baa-di-hil lazee-nas ta-faa aaal-laa-hu khai-run am-mmaa yus-hri-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا بِهِۦ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهۡجَةٖ مَّا كَانَ لَكُمۡ أَن تُنۢبِتُواْ شَجَرَهَآۗ أَءِلَٰهٞ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ يَعۡدِلُونَ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: امن خلق السموت والارض وانزل لكم من السماء ماء فانبتنا به حدائق ذات بهجة ما كان لكم ان تنبتوا شجرها اءله مع الله بل هم قوم يعدلون
ayahs.translation: [More precisely], is He [not best] who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you rain from the sky, causing to grow thereby gardens of joyful beauty which you could not [otherwise] have grown the trees thereof? Is there a deity with Allāh? [No], but they are a people who ascribe equals [to Him].
ayahs.transliteration: am-man kha-la-qas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da waan-za-la la-kum mi-nas sa-maaai maaaan faan-bat-naa bihee ha-daaai-qa zaa-ta bah-jah maa kaa-na la-kum an tun-bi-too sha-ja-ra-haa ai-laa-hun maal laah bal hum qaw-mu-ny ya-di-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمَّن جَعَلَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ قَرَارٗا وَجَعَلَ خِلَٰلَهَآ أَنۡهَٰرٗا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ حَاجِزًاۗ أَءِلَٰهٞ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: امن جعل الارض قرارا وجعل خللها انهرا وجعل لها روسي وجعل بين البحرين حاجزا اءله مع الله بل اكثرهم لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: Is He [not best] who made the earth a stable ground and placed within it rivers and made for it firmly set mountains and placed between the two seas a barrier? Is there a deity with Allāh? [No], but most of them do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: am-mann jaa-lal ar-da qa-raa-ranw wa-jaa-la khi-laa-la-haaa a-nhaa-ranw wa-jaa-la la-haa ra-waa-siya wa-jaa-la bai-nal bah-rai-ni haa-ji-zaa ai-laa-hun ma al-lah bal ak-sa-ru-hum laa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلۡمُضۡطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكۡشِفُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَيَجۡعَلُكُمۡ خُلَفَآءَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَءِلَٰهٞ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: امن يجيب المضطر اذا دعاه ويكشف السوء ويجعلكم خلفاء الارض اءله مع الله قليلا ما تذكرون
ayahs.translation: Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth? Is there a deity with Allāh? Little do you remember.
ayahs.transliteration: am-ma-ny yu-jee-bul mud-tar-ra i-zaa daaa-hu wayak-shi-fus sooo-a waya-ja-lu-kum khu-la-faaaal ar-di ai-laa-hun ma al-lah qalee-lan maa ta-zak-ka-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمَّن يَهۡدِيكُمۡ فِي ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ وَمَن يُرۡسِلُ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشۡرَۢا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ رَحۡمَتِهِۦٓۗ أَءِلَٰهٞ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِۚ تَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ ٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: امن يهديكم في ظلمت البر والبحر ومن يرسل الريح بشرا بين يدي رحمته اءله مع الله تعلي الله عما يشركون
ayahs.translation: Is He [not best] who guides you through the darknesses of the land and sea and who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy? Is there a deity with Allāh? High is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
ayahs.transliteration: am-ma-ny yah-dee-kum fee zu-lu-maa-til bar-ri wal-bah-ri wa-ma-ny yur-si-lu riyaa-ha bus-hran bai-na ya-dai rah-ma-tih ai-laa-hun ma al-lah taaa-lal laa-hu am-maa yus-hri-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمَّن يَبۡدَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَمَن يَرۡزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَءِلَٰهٞ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِۚ قُلۡ هَاتُواْ بُرۡهَٰنَكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ ٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: امن يبدؤا الخلق ثم يعيده ومن يرزقكم من السماء والارض اءله مع الله قل هاتوا برهنكم ان كنتم صدقين
ayahs.translation: Is He [not best] who begins creation and then repeats it and who provides for you from the heaven and earth? Is there a deity with Allāh? Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: am-ma-ny yab-daul khal-qa thum-ma yuee-du-hoo wa-ma-ny yar-zu-qu-kum mi-nas sam-maaai wa-lard ai-laa-hun ma al-lah qul haa-too bu-rhaa-na-kum in kun-tum saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُل لَّا يَعۡلَمُ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُۚ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبۡعَثُونَ ٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: قل لا يعلم من في السموت والارض الغيب الا الله وما يشعرون ايان يبعثون
ayahs.translation: Say, "None in the heavens and earth knows the unseen except Allāh, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected."
ayahs.transliteration: qul laa ya-la-mu man fis sam-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-dil ghai-ba il-lal laah wa-maa ya-shu-roo-na aiyaa-na yu-ba-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱدَّٰرَكَ عِلۡمُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ مِّنۡهَاۖ بَلۡ هُم مِّنۡهَا عَمُونَ ٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: بل ادرك علمهم في الاخرة بل هم في شك منها بل هم منها عمون
ayahs.translation: Rather, their knowledge is arrested concerning the Hereafter. Rather, they are in doubt about it. Rather, they are, concerning it, blind.
ayahs.transliteration: ba-lid daa-ra-ka il-mu-hum fil aa-khi-rah bal hum fee shak-kin mi-nhaa bal hum mi-nhaa a-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبٗا وَءَابَآؤُنَآ أَئِنَّا لَمُخۡرَجُونَ ٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: وقال الذين كفروا اءذا كنا تربا وءاباؤنا ائنا لمخرجون
ayahs.translation: And those who disbelieve say, "When we have become dust as well as our forefathers, will we indeed be brought out [of the graves]?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-lal lazee-na ka-fa-rooo ai-zaa kun-naa tu-raa-banw waaa-baaau-naaa ain-naa la-muk-hra-joon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَقَدۡ وُعِدۡنَا هَٰذَا نَحۡنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا مِن قَبۡلُ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: لقد وعدنا هذا نحن وءاباؤنا من قبل ان هذا الا اسطير الاولين
ayahs.translation: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before. This is not but legends of the former peoples."
ayahs.transliteration: la-qad wu-i-dnaa haa-zaa nah-nu waaa-baaau-naa min qab-lu in haa-zaaa il-laaa a-saa-tee-rul aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ سِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ ٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: قل سيروا في الارض فانظروا كيف كان عقبة المجرمين
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Proceed [i.e., travel] through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals."
ayahs.transliteration: qul see-roo fil ar-di fan-zu-roo kai-fa kaa-na aa-qi-ba-tul muj-rimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا تَكُن فِي ضَيۡقٖ مِّمَّا يَمۡكُرُونَ ٧٠
ayahs.text_simple: ولا تحزن عليهم ولا تكن في ضيق مما يمكرون
ayahs.translation: And grieve not over them or be in distress from what they conspire.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa tah-zan a-lai-him wa-laa ta-kun fee dai-qin mim-maa yam-ku-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ ٧١
ayahs.text_simple: ويقولون متي هذا الوعد ان كنتم صدقين
ayahs.translation: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"
ayahs.transliteration: waya-qoo-loo-na ma-taa haa-zal wa-du in kun-tum saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُم بَعۡضُ ٱلَّذِي تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ ٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: قل عسي ان يكون ردف لكم بعض الذي تستعجلون
ayahs.translation: Say, "Perhaps it is close behind you [i.e., very near] - some of that for which you are impatient.
ayahs.transliteration: qul a-saaa a-ny ya-koo-na ra-di-fa la-kum ba-dul lazee tas-ta-ji-loon
