ayahs.text_simple: وقال انما اتخذتم من دون الله اوثنا مودة بينكم في الحيوة الدنيا ثم يوم القيمة يكفر بعضكم ببعض ويلعن بعضكم بعضا وماويكم النار وما لكم من نصرين
ayahs.translation: And [Abraham] said, "You have only taken, other than Allāh, idols as [a bond of] affection among you in worldly life. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-la in-na-mat ta-khaz-tum min doo-nil laa-hi aw-saa-nam ma-wad-da-ta bai-ni-kum fil hayaa-tid du-nyaa sum-ma yaw-mal qiyaa-ma-ti yak-fu-ru ba-du-kum bi-ba-dinw waya-la-nu ba-du-kum ba-danw wa-ma-waa-ku-mun naa-ru wa-maa la-kum min naa-sireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ فَـَٔامَنَ لَهُۥ لُوطٞۘ وَقَالَ إِنِّي مُهَاجِرٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّيٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: فامن له لوط وقال اني مهاجر الي ربي انه هو العزيز الحكيم
ayahs.translation: And Lot believed him. [Abraham] said, "Indeed, I will emigrate to [the service of] my Lord. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
ayahs.transliteration: faaa-ma-na la-hoo loot wa-qaa-la in-nee mu-ha-ji-run i-laa rab-bee in-na-hoo hu-wal azee-zul hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِ ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ أَجۡرَهُۥ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: ووهبنا له اسحق ويعقوب وجعلنا في ذريته النبوة والكتب وءاتينه اجره في الدنيا وانه في الاخرة لمن الصلحين
ayahs.translation: And We gave to him Isaac and Jacob and placed in his descendants prophethood and scripture. And We gave him his reward in this world, and indeed, he is in the Hereafter among the righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-wa-hab-naa la-hoo i-shaa-qa waya-qoo-ba wa-jaal-naa fee zur-riyya-ti-hin nu-buw-wa-ta wal-ki-taa-ba waaa-tai-naa-hu aj-ra-hoo fid du-nyaa wain-na-hoo fil aa-khi-ra-ti la-mi-nas saa-liheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلُوطًا إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّكُمۡ لَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلۡفَٰحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنۡ أَحَدٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: ولوطا اذ قال لقومه انكم لتاتون الفحشة ما سبقكم بها من احد من العلمين
ayahs.translation: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-loo-tan iz qaa-la li-qaw-miheee in-na-kum la-ta-too-nal faa-hi-sha-ta maa sa-ba-qa-kum bi-haa min a-ha-din mi-nal aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ وَتَقۡطَعُونَ ٱلسَّبِيلَ وَتَأۡتُونَ فِي نَادِيكُمُ ٱلۡمُنكَرَۖ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ ٱئۡتِنَا بِعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: ائنكم لتاتون الرجال وتقطعون السبيل وتاتون في ناديكم المنكر فما كان جواب قومه الا ان قالوا ائتنا بعذاب الله ان كنت من الصدقين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road and commit in your meetings [every] evil." And the answer of his people was not but that they said, "Bring us the punishment of Allāh, if you should be of the truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: ain-na-kum la-ta-too-nar ri-jaa-la wa-taq-taoo-nas sabee-la wa-ta-too-na fee naadee-ku-mul mun-ka-ra fa-maa kaa-na ja-waa-ba qaw-miheee il-laaa an qaa-lu ti-naaa bi-a-zaa-bil laa-hi in kun-ta mi-nas saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: قال رب انصرني علي القوم المفسدين
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord, support me against the corrupting people."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-bin sur-nee a-lal qaw-mil muf-sideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا مُهۡلِكُوٓاْ أَهۡلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِۖ إِنَّ أَهۡلَهَا كَانُواْ ظَٰلِمِينَ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: ولما جاءت رسلنا ابرهيم بالبشري قالوا انا مهلكوا اهل هذه القرية ان اهلها كانوا ظلمين
ayahs.translation: And when Our messengers [i.e., angels] came to Abraham with the good tidings, they said, "Indeed, we will destroy the people of that [i.e., Lot's] city. Indeed, its people have been wrongdoers."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lam-maa jaaaat ru-su-lu-naaa ib-raa-hee-ma bil-bus-hraa qaa-looo in-naa muh-li-koo ah-li haa-zi-hil qa-rya-ti in-na ah-la-haa kaa-noo zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّ فِيهَا لُوطٗاۚ قَالُواْ نَحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن فِيهَاۖ لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُۥ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَهُۥ كَانَتۡ مِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: قال ان فيها لوطا قالوا نحن اعلم بمن فيها لننجينه واهله الا امراته كانت من الغبرين
ayahs.translation: [Abraham] said, "Indeed, within it is Lot." They said, "We are more knowing of who is within it. We will surely save him and his family, except his wife. She is to be of those who remain behind."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la in-na fee-ha loo-taa qaa-loo nah-nu a-la-mu bi-man fee-haa la-nu-naj-jjiyan-na-hoo waah-la-hooo il-lam raa-ta-hoo kaa-nat mi-nal ghaa-bireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَا لُوطٗا سِيٓءَ بِهِمۡ وَضَاقَ بِهِمۡ ذَرۡعٗاۖ وَقَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهۡلَكَ إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَكَ كَانَتۡ مِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولما ان جاءت رسلنا لوطا سيء بهم وضاق بهم ذرعا وقالوا لا تخف ولا تحزن انا منجوك واهلك الا امراتك كانت من الغبرين
ayahs.translation: And when Our messengers [i.e., angels] came to Lot, he was distressed for them and felt for them great discomfort. They said, "Fear not, nor grieve. Indeed, we will save you and your family, except your wife; she is to be of those who remain behind.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lam-maaa an jaaaat ru-su-lu-naa loo-tan seeea bi-him wa-daa-qa bi-him za-ranw wa-qaa-loo laa ta-khaf wa-laa tah-zan in-naa mu-naj-joo-ka waah-la-ka il-lam raa-ta-ka kaa-nat mi-nal ghaa-bireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ رِجۡزٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡسُقُونَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: انا منزلون علي اهل هذه القرية رجزا من السماء بما كانوا يفسقون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient."
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa mun-zi-loo-na a-laaa ah-li haa-zi-hil qa-rya-ti rij-zan mi-nas sa-maaai bi-maa kaa-noo yaf-su-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَا مِنۡهَآ ءَايَةَۢ بَيِّنَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد تركنا منها ءاية بينة لقوم يعقلون
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad ta-rak-naa mi-nhaaa aaya-tan baiyi-na-tan li-qaw-mi-ny ya-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِلَىٰ مَدۡيَنَ أَخَاهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٗا فَقَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرۡجُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: والي مدين اخاهم شعيبا فقال يقوم اعبدوا الله وارجوا اليوم الاخر ولا تعثوا في الارض مفسدين
ayahs.translation: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."
ayahs.transliteration: wai-laa ma-dya-na a-khaa-hum shu-a-y-ban fa-qaa-la yaa-qaw-mi bu-dul laa-ha war-jul yaw-mal aa-khi-ra wa-laa ta-saw fil ar-di muf-sideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلرَّجۡفَةُ فَأَصۡبَحُواْ فِي دَارِهِمۡ جَٰثِمِينَ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: فكذبوه فاخذتهم الرجفة فاصبحوا في دارهم جثمين
ayahs.translation: But they denied him, so the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kaz-za-boo-hu faa-kha-za-thu-mur raj-fa-tu faas-ba-hoo fee daa-ri-him jaa-simeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَعَادٗا وَثَمُودَاْ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمۡۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَصَدَّهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُواْ مُسۡتَبۡصِرِينَ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: وعادا وثمودا وقد تبين لكم من مسكنهم وزين لهم الشيطن اعملهم فصدهم عن السبيل وكانوا مستبصرين
ayahs.translation: And [We destroyed] ʿAad and Thamūd, and it has become clear to you from their [ruined] dwellings. And Satan had made pleasing to them their deeds and averted them from the path, and they were endowed with perception.
ayahs.transliteration: waaa-danw wa-sa-moo-da wa-qad ta-baiya-na la-kum min ma-saa-ki-ni-him wa-zaiya-na la-hu-mush shai-taa-nu a-maa-la-hum fa-sad-da-hum a-nis sabee-li wa-kaa-noo mus-tab-sireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَٰرُونَ وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا كَانُواْ سَٰبِقِينَ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: وقرون وفرعون وهمن ولقد جاءهم موسي بالبينت فاستكبروا في الارض وما كانوا سبقين
ayahs.translation: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-roo-na wa-fi-raw-na wa-haa-maa-na wa-la-qad jaaaa-hum moo-sa bil-baiyi-naa-ti fas-tak-ba-roo fil ar-di wa-maa kaa-noo saa-biqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكُلًّا أَخَذۡنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦۖ فَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ حَاصِبٗا وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ أَخَذَتۡهُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ خَسَفۡنَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ أَغۡرَقۡنَاۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظۡلِمَهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: فكلا اخذنا بذنبه فمنهم من ارسلنا عليه حاصبا ومنهم من اخذته الصيحة ومنهم من خسفنا به الارض ومنهم من اغرقنا وما كان الله ليظلمهم ولكن كانوا انفسهم يظلمون
ayahs.translation: So each We seized for his sin; and among them were those upon whom We sent a storm of stones, and among them were those who were seized by the blast [from the sky], and among them were those whom We caused the earth to swallow, and among them were those whom We drowned. And Allāh would not have wronged them, but it was they who were wronging themselves.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kul-lan a-khaz-naa bi-zan-bihee fa-mi-nhum man ar-sal-naa a-lai-hi haa-si-baa wa-mi-nhum man a-kha-za-thus sai-ha-tu wa-mi-nhum man kha-saf-naa bi-hil ar-da wa-mi-nhum man ag-hraq-naa wa-maa kaa-nal laa-hu liyaz-li-ma-hum wa-laa-kin kaa-noo an-fu-sa-hum yaz-li-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡلِيَآءَ كَمَثَلِ ٱلۡعَنكَبُوتِ ٱتَّخَذَتۡ بَيۡتٗاۖ وَإِنَّ أَوۡهَنَ ٱلۡبُيُوتِ لَبَيۡتُ ٱلۡعَنكَبُوتِۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: مثل الذين اتخذوا من دون الله اولياء كمثل العنكبوت اتخذت بيتا وان اوهن البيوت لبيت العنكبوت لو كانوا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: The example of those who take allies other than Allāh is like that of the spider who takes [i.e., constructs] a home. And indeed, the weakest of homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew.
ayahs.transliteration: ma-sa-lul lazee-nat ta-kha-zoo min doo-nil laa-hi aw-liyaaaa ka-ma-sa-lil an-ka-boot it-ta-kha-zat bai-taa wain-na a-wha-nal buyoo-ti la-bai-tul an-ka-boot law kaa-noo ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَيۡءٖۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: ان الله يعلم ما يدعون من دونه من شيء وهو العزيز الحكيم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Allāh knows whatever thing they call upon other than Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal laa-ha ya-la-mu maa ya-doo-na min doo-nihee min shai wa-hu-wal azee-zul hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلُ نَضۡرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِۖ وَمَا يَعۡقِلُهَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡعَٰلِمُونَ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: وتلك الامثل نضربها للناس وما يعقلها الا العلمون
ayahs.translation: And these examples We present to the people, but none will understand them except those of knowledge.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-til-kal am-saa-lu nad-ri-bu-haa lin-naa-si wa-maa ya-qi-lu-haaa il-lal aa-li-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: خلق الله السموت والارض بالحق ان في ذلك لاية للمؤمنين
ayahs.translation: Allāh created the heavens and the earth in truth. Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
ayahs.transliteration: kha-la-qal laa-hus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da bi-lhaqq in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaaya-tan lil-mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱتۡلُ مَآ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ مِنَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنۡهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَٱلۡمُنكَرِۗ وَلَذِكۡرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكۡبَرُۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَصۡنَعُونَ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: اتل ما اوحي اليك من الكتب واقم الصلوة ان الصلوة تنهي عن الفحشاء والمنكر ولذكر الله اكبر والله يعلم ما تصنعون
ayahs.translation: Recite, [O Muḥammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allāh is greater. And Allāh knows that which you do.
ayahs.transliteration: ut-lu maaa oo-hiya i-lai-ka mi-nal ki-taa-bi waa-qi-mis sa-laa-ta in-nas sa-laa-ta ta-nhaa a-nil fah-shaaai wal-mun-kar wa-la-zik-rul laa-hi ak-bar wal-laa-hu ya-la-mu maa tas-naoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَا تُجَٰدِلُوٓاْ أَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَقُولُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ وَإِلَٰهُنَا وَإِلَٰهُكُمۡ وَٰحِدٞ وَنَحۡنُ لَهُۥ مُسۡلِمُونَ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولا تجدلوا اهل الكتب الا بالتي هي احسن الا الذين ظلموا منهم وقولوا ءامنا بالذي انزل الينا وانزل اليكم والهنا والهكم وحد ونحن له مسلمون
ayahs.translation: And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in a way that is best, except for those who commit injustice among them, and say, "We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. And our God and your God is one; and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa tu-jaa-di-looo ah-lal ki-taa-bi il-laa bil-latee hiya ah-sa-nu il-lal lazee-na za-la-moo mi-nhum wa-qoo-looo aa-man-naa bil-lazeee un-zi-la i-lai-naa waun-zi-la i-lai-kum wail-laa-hun-na wai-la-hu-kum waa-hi-dun-wwa nah-nu la-hoo mus-li-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦۖ وَمِنۡ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَن يُؤۡمِنُ بِهِۦۚ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: وكذلك انزلنا اليك الكتب فالذين ءاتينهم الكتب يؤمنون به ومن هؤلاء من يؤمن به وما يجحد بايتنا الا الكفرون
ayahs.translation: And thus We have sent down to you the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān]. And those to whom We [previously] gave the Scripture believe in it. And among these [people of Makkah] are those who believe in it. And none reject Our verses except the disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ka-zaa-li-ka an-zal-naaa i-lai-kal ki-taab fal-la-zee-na aa-tai-naa-hu-mul ki-taa-ba yu-mi-noo-na bihee wa-min haaau-laaai ma-ny yu-mi-nu bih wa-maa ya-jha-du bi-a-ayaa-ti-naa il-lal kaa-fi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتۡلُواْ مِن قَبۡلِهِۦ مِن كِتَٰبٖ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَۖ إِذٗا لَّٱرۡتَابَ ٱلۡمُبۡطِلُونَ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: وما كنت تتلوا من قبله من كتب ولا تخطه بيمينك اذا لارتاب المبطلون
ayahs.translation: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa kun-ta tat-loo min qab-lihee min ki-taa-binw wa-laa ta-khut-tu-bhoo biyamee-ni-ka i-zal lar-taa-bal mub-ti-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ هُوَ ءَايَٰتُۢ بَيِّنَٰتٞ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَۚ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: بل هو ءايت بينت في صدور الذين اوتوا العلم وما يجحد بايتنا الا الظلمون
ayahs.translation: Rather, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is distinct verses [preserved] within the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. And none reject Our verses except the wrongdoers.
ayahs.transliteration: bal hu-wa aayaa-tum baiyi-naa-tun fee su-doo-ril lazee-na oo-tul ilm wa-maa ya-jha-du bi-a-ayaa-ti-naa il-laz zaa-li-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ قُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡأٓيَٰتُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا لولا انزل عليه ءايت من ربه قل انما الايت عند الله وانما انا نذير مبين
ayahs.translation: But they say, "Why are not signs sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "The signs are only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-loo law-laaa un-zi-la a-lai-hi aayaa-tum mir rab-bihee qul in-na-mal aayaa-tu in-dal laa-hi wain-na-maaa a-na nazee-rum mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفِهِمۡ أَنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَرَحۡمَةٗ وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: اولم يكفهم انا انزلنا عليك الكتب يتلي عليهم ان في ذلك لرحمة وذكري لقوم يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: And is it not sufficient for them that We revealed to you the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] which is recited to them? Indeed in that is a mercy and reminder for a people who believe.
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-lam yak-fi-him an-naaa an-zal-naa a-lai-kal ki-taa-ba yut-laa a-lai-him in-na fee zaa-li-ka la-rah-ma-tanw wa-zik-raa li-qaw-mi-ny yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكُمۡ شَهِيدٗاۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ وَكَفَرُواْ بِٱللَّهِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: قل كفي بالله بيني وبينكم شهيدا يعلم ما في السموت والارض والذين ءامنوا بالبطل وكفروا بالله اولئك هم الخسرون
ayahs.translation: Say, "Sufficient is Allāh between me and you as Witness. He knows what is in the heavens and earth. And they who have believed in falsehood and disbelieved in Allāh - it is those who are the losers."
ayahs.transliteration: qul ka-faa bil-laa-hi bainee wa-bai-na-kum shahee-daa ya-la-mu maa fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lard wal-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo bil-baa-ti-li wa-ka-fa-roo bil-laa-hi u-laaai-ka hu-mul khaa-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَكَ بِٱلۡعَذَابِ وَلَوۡلَآ أَجَلٞ مُّسَمّٗى لَّجَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُۚ وَلَيَأۡتِيَنَّهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: ويستعجلونك بالعذاب ولولا اجل مسمي لجاءهم العذاب ولياتينهم بغتة وهم لا يشعرون
ayahs.translation: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. And if not for [the decree of] a specified term, punishment would have reached them. But it will surely come to them suddenly while they perceive not.
ayahs.transliteration: wayas-ta-ji-loo-na-ka bi-la-zaab wa-law-laaa a-ja-lum mu-sam-mal la-jaaaa-hu-mul a-zaab wa-laya-ti-a-nna-hum bag-hta-tanw wa-hum laa ya-shu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَكَ بِٱلۡعَذَابِ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةُۢ بِٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: يستعجلونك بالعذاب وان جهنم لمحيطة بالكفرين
ayahs.translation: They urge you to hasten the punishment. And indeed, Hell will be encompassing of the disbelievers
ayahs.transliteration: yas-ta-ji-loo-na-ka bi-la-zaab wain-na ja-han-na-ma la-mu-hee-ta-tum bil-kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يَغۡشَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِن فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَمِن تَحۡتِ أَرۡجُلِهِمۡ وَيَقُولُ ذُوقُواْ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: يوم يغشيهم العذاب من فوقهم ومن تحت ارجلهم ويقول ذوقوا ما كنتم تعملون
ayahs.translation: On the Day the punishment will cover them from above them and from below their feet and it is said, "Taste [the result of] what you used to do."
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma yag-hshaa-hu-mul a-zaa-bu min faw-qi-him wa-min tah-ti ar-ju-li-him waya-qoo-lu zoo-qoo maa kun-tum ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ أَرۡضِي وَٰسِعَةٞ فَإِيَّٰيَ فَٱعۡبُدُونِ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: يعبادي الذين ءامنوا ان ارضي وسعة فايي فاعبدون
ayahs.translation: O My servants who have believed, indeed My earth is spacious, so worship only Me.
ayahs.transliteration: yaai-baa-diyal lazee-na aa-ma-nooo in-na ar-dee waa-si-a-tun faiyyaaya fa-bu-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡنَا تُرۡجَعُونَ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: كل نفس ذائقة الموت ثم الينا ترجعون
ayahs.translation: Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned.
ayahs.transliteration: kul-lu naf-sin zaaai-qa-tul maw-ti sum-ma i-lai-naa tur-jaoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ غُرَفٗا تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ نِعۡمَ أَجۡرُ ٱلۡعَٰمِلِينَ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: والذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لنبوئنهم من الجنة غرفا تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها نعم اجر العملين
ayahs.translation: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - We will surely assign to them of Paradise [elevated] chambers beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti la-nu-baw-wi-a-nna-hum mi-nal jan-na-ti ghu-ra-fan taj-ree min tah-ti-hal a-nhaa-ru khaa-li-dee-na fee-haa ni-ma aj-rul aa-mileen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: الذين صبروا وعلي ربهم يتوكلون
ayahs.translation: Who have been patient and upon their Lord rely.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na sa-ba-roo waa-laa rab-bi-him ya-ta-wak-ka-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَآبَّةٖ لَّا تَحۡمِلُ رِزۡقَهَا ٱللَّهُ يَرۡزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمۡۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: وكاين من دابة لا تحمل رزقها الله يرزقها واياكم وهو السميع العليم
ayahs.translation: And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. Allāh provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kaayyim min daaab-ba-til laa tah-mi-lu riz-qa-haa al-laa-hu yar-zu-qu-haa waiyyaa-kum wa-hu-was samee-ul aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: ولئن سالتهم من خلق السموت والارض وسخر الشمس والقمر ليقولن الله فاني يؤفكون
ayahs.translation: If you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth and subjected the sun and the moon?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Then how are they deluded?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lain saal-ta-hum man kha-la-qas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da wa-sak-hkha-rash sham-sa wal-qa-ma-ra laya-qoo-lun-nal laa-hu faan-na yu-fa-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقۡدِرُ لَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء من عباده ويقدر له ان الله بكل شيء عليم
ayahs.translation: Allāh extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts for him. Indeed Allāh is, of all things, Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: al-laa-hu yab-su-tur riz-qa li-ma-ny ya-shaaau min i-baa-dihee wayaq-di-ru lah in-nal laa-ha bi-kul-li shaiin aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّن نَّزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَوۡتِهَا لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ ٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولئن سالتهم من نزل من السماء ماء فاحيا به الارض من بعد موتها ليقولن الله قل الحمد لله بل اكثرهم لا يعقلون
ayahs.translation: And if you asked them, "Who sends down rain from the sky and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "Praise to Allāh"; but most of them do not reason.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lain saal-ta-hum man naz-za-la mi-nas sa-maaai maaaan faa-hyaa bi-hil ar-da min ba-di maw-ti-haa laya-qoo-lun-nal laah qu-lil ham-du lil-lah bal ak-sa-ru-hum laa ya-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَآ إِلَّا لَهۡوٞ وَلَعِبٞۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ لَهِيَ ٱلۡحَيَوَانُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ ٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: وما هذه الحيوة الدنيا الا لهو ولعب وان الدار الاخرة لهي الحيوان لو كانوا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: And this worldly life is not but diversion and amusement. And indeed, the home of the Hereafter - that is the [eternal] life, if only they knew.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa haa-zi-hil hayaa-tud du-nyaaa il-laa lah-wunw wa-laib wain-nad daa-ral aa-khi-ra-ta la-hiyal haya-waan law kaa-no ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا رَكِبُواْ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ دَعَوُاْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡبَرِّ إِذَا هُمۡ يُشۡرِكُونَ ٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: فاذا ركبوا في الفلك دعوا الله مخلصين له الدين فلما نجيهم الي البر اذا هم يشركون
ayahs.translation: And when they board a ship, they supplicate Allāh, sincere to Him in religion [i.e., faith and hope]. But when He delivers them to the land, at once they associate others with Him
ayahs.transliteration: fai-zaa ra-ki-boo fil ful-ki daa-wul laa-ha muk-hli-see-na la-hud dee-na fa-lam-maa naj-jaa-hum i-lal bar-ri i-zaa hum yus-hri-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِيَكۡفُرُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُواْۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ ٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: ليكفروا بما ءاتينهم وليتمتعوا فسوف يعلمون
ayahs.translation: So that they will deny what We have granted them, and they will enjoy themselves. But they are going to know.
ayahs.transliteration: liyak-fu-roo bi-maaa aa-tai-naa-hum wa-liya-ta-mat-taoo fa-saw faya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا جَعَلۡنَا حَرَمًا ءَامِنٗا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ ٱلنَّاسُ مِنۡ حَوۡلِهِمۡۚ أَفَبِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ يُؤۡمِنُونَ وَبِنِعۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَكۡفُرُونَ ٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: اولم يروا انا جعلنا حرما ءامنا ويتخطف الناس من حولهم افبالبطل يؤمنون وبنعمة الله يكفرون
ayahs.translation: Have they not seen that We made [Makkah] a safe sanctuary, while people are being taken away all around them? Then in falsehood do they believe, and in the favor of Allāh they disbelieve?
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-lam ya-raw an-naa jaal-naa ha-ra-man aa-mi-nanw wayu-ta-khat-ta-fun naa-su min haw-li-him a-fa-bil-baa-ti-li yu-mi-noo-na wa-bi-ni-ma-til laa-hi yak-fu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوۡ كَذَّبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُۥٓۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوٗى لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: ومن اظلم ممن افتري علي الله كذبا او كذب بالحق لما جاءه اليس في جهنم مثوي للكفرين
ayahs.translation: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allāh or denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a [sufficient] residence for the disbelievers?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-man az-la-mu mim-ma-ni if-ta-raa a-lal laa-hi ka-zi-ban aw kaz-za-ba bi-lhaq-qi lam-maa jaaaah a-lai-sa fee ja-han-na-ma mas-wal lil-kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُواْ فِينَا لَنَهۡدِيَنَّهُمۡ سُبُلَنَاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: والذين جهدوا فينا لنهدينهم سبلنا وان الله لمع المحسنين
ayahs.translation: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allāh is with the doers of good.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na jaa-ha-doo fee-naa la-nah-diyan-na-hum su-bu-la-na wain-nal laa-ha la-maal muh-sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: الٓمٓ ١
ayahs.text_simple: الم
ayahs.translation: Alif, Lām, Meem.
ayahs.transliteration: a-lif-laaam-meeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: غُلِبَتِ ٱلرُّومُ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: غلبت الروم
ayahs.translation: The Byzantines have been defeated
ayahs.transliteration: ghu-li-ba-tir room

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِيٓ أَدۡنَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَهُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ غَلَبِهِمۡ سَيَغۡلِبُونَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: في ادني الارض وهم من بعد غلبهم سيغلبون
ayahs.translation: In the nearest land. But they, after their defeat, will overcome
ayahs.transliteration: feee ad-nal ar-di wa-hum mim ba-di gha-la-bi-him sayag-hli-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي بِضۡعِ سِنِينَۗ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ مِن قَبۡلُ وَمِنۢ بَعۡدُۚ وَيَوۡمَئِذٖ يَفۡرَحُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: في بضع سنين لله الامر من قبل ومن بعد ويومئذ يفرح المؤمنون
ayahs.translation: Within three to nine years. To Allāh belongs the command [i.e., decree] before and after. And that day the believers will rejoice
ayahs.transliteration: fee bi-di sineen lil-laa-hil am-ru min qab-lu wa-mim bad wayaw-mai-zi-ny yaf-ra-hul mu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: بِنَصۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ يَنصُرُ مَن يَشَآءُۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: بنصر الله ينصر من يشاء وهو العزيز الرحيم
ayahs.translation: In the victory of Allāh. He gives victory to whom He wills, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: bi-nas-ril laa yan-su-ru mai ya-shaaau wa-hu-wal azee-zur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِۖ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱللَّهُ وَعۡدَهُۥ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: وعد الله لا يخلف الله وعده ولكن اكثر الناس لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: [It is] the promise of Allāh. Allāh does not fail in His promise, but most of the people do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-dal laa-hi laa yuk-hli-ful laa-hu wa-da-hoo wa-laa-kin-na ak-sa-ran naa-si laa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَعۡلَمُونَ ظَٰهِرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ غَٰفِلُونَ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: يعلمون ظهرا من الحيوة الدنيا وهم عن الاخرة هم غفلون
ayahs.translation: They know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the Hereafter, are unaware.
ayahs.transliteration: ya-la-moo-na zaa-hi-ram mi-nal hayaa-tid du-nya wa-hum a-nil aa-khi-ra-ti hum ghaa-fi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُواْ فِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۗ مَّا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۗ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِلِقَآيِٕ رَبِّهِمۡ لَكَٰفِرُونَ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: اولم يتفكروا في انفسهم ما خلق الله السموت والارض وما بينهما الا بالحق واجل مسمي وان كثيرا من الناس بلقاي ربهم لكفرون
ayahs.translation: Do they not contemplate within themselves? Allāh has not created the heavens and the earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term. And indeed, many of the people, in the meeting with their Lord, are disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-lam ya-ta-fak-ka-roo feee an-fu-si-him maa kha-la-qal laa-hus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da wa-maa bai-na-hu-maaa il-laa bi-lhaq-qi waa-ja-lim mu-sam-maa wain-na kasee-ram mi-nan naa-si bi-li-qaaai rab-bi-him la-kaa-fi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَانُوٓاْ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةٗ وَأَثَارُواْ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَعَمَرُوهَآ أَكۡثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوهَا وَجَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِۖ فَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظۡلِمَهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: اولم يسيروا في الارض فينظروا كيف كان عقبة الذين من قبلهم كانوا اشد منهم قوة واثاروا الارض وعمروها اكثر مما عمروها وجاءتهم رسلهم بالبينت فما كان الله ليظلمهم ولكن كانوا انفسهم يظلمون
ayahs.translation: Have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? They were greater than them in power, and they plowed [or excavated] the earth and built it up more than they [i.e., the Makkans] have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences. And Allāh would not ever have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves.
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-lam ya-see-roo fil ar-di fayan-zu-roo kai-fa kaa-na aa-qi-ba-tul lazee-na min qab-li-him kaa-nooo a-shad-da min-hhum quw-wa-tanw waa-saa-rul ar-da waa-ma-roo-haaa ak-sa-ra mim-maa a-ma-roo-haa wa-jaaaa-thum ru-su-lu-hum bil-baiyi-naa-ti fa-maa kaa-nal laa-hu liyaz-li-ma-hum wa-laa-kin kaa-nooo an-fu-sa-hum yaz-li-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔواْ ٱلسُّوٓأَىٰٓ أَن كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَانُواْ بِهَا يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: ثم كان عقبة الذين اسوا السواي ان كذبوا بايت الله وكانوا بها يستهزءون
ayahs.translation: Then the end of those who did evil was the worst [consequence] because they denied the signs of Allāh and used to ridicule them.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma kaa-na aa-qi-ba-tal lazee-na a-saaaus sooo-a-aa an kaz-za-boo bi-a-ayaa-til laa-hi wa-kaa-noo bi-haa yas-tah-zioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ يَبۡدَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: الله يبدؤا الخلق ثم يعيده ثم اليه ترجعون
ayahs.translation: Allāh begins creation; then He will repeat it; then to Him you will be returned.
ayahs.transliteration: al-laa-hu yab-daul khal-qa sum-ma yuee-du-hoo sum-ma i-lai-hi tur-jaoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُبۡلِسُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: ويوم تقوم الساعة يبلس المجرمون
ayahs.translation: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will be in despair.
ayahs.transliteration: wayaw-ma ta-qoo-mus saaa-tu yub-li-sul muj-ri-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُم مِّن شُرَكَآئِهِمۡ شُفَعَٰٓؤُاْ وَكَانُواْ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمۡ كَٰفِرِينَ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولم يكن لهم من شركائهم شفعؤا وكانوا بشركائهم كفرين
ayahs.translation: And there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lam ya-kul la-hum min shu-ra-kaaai-him shu-faaaau wa-kaa-noo bi-shu-ra-kaaai-him kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَفَرَّقُونَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: ويوم تقوم الساعة يومئذ يتفرقون
ayahs.translation: And the Day the Hour appears - that Day they will become separated.
ayahs.transliteration: wayaw-ma ta-qoo-mus saaa-tu yaw-mai-zi-ny ya-ta-far-ra-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَهُمۡ فِي رَوۡضَةٖ يُحۡبَرُونَ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: فاما الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت فهم في روضة يحبرون
ayahs.translation: And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted.
ayahs.transliteration: faam-mal lazee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti fa-hum fee raw-da-ti-ny yuh-ba-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَلِقَآيِٕ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُحۡضَرُونَ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: واما الذين كفروا وكذبوا بايتنا ولقاي الاخرة فاولئك في العذاب محضرون
ayahs.translation: But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our verses and the meeting of the Hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
ayahs.transliteration: waam-mal lazee-na ka-fa-roo wa-kaz-za-boo bi-a-ayaa-ti-naa wa-li-qaaail aa-khi-ra-ti fau-laaai-ka fil a-zaa-bi muh-da-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمۡسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصۡبِحُونَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: فسبحن الله حين تمسون وحين تصبحون
ayahs.translation: So exalted is Allāh when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-su-bhaa-nal laa-hi hee-na tum-soo-na wahee-na tus-bi-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَهُ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَعَشِيّٗا وَحِينَ تُظۡهِرُونَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: وله الحمد في السموت والارض وعشيا وحين تظهرون
ayahs.translation: And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-hul ham-du fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di waa-shiyyanw wahee-na tu-zhi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡحَيَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَيِّتِ وَيُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلۡحَيِّ وَيُحۡيِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَاۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُونَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: يخرج الحي من الميت ويخرج الميت من الحي ويحي الارض بعد موتها وكذلك تخرجون
ayahs.translation: He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. And thus will you be brought out.
ayahs.transliteration: yuk-hri-jul haiya mi-nal maiyi-ti wayuk-hri-jul maiyi-ta mi-nal haiyi wayu-hyil ar-da ba-da maw-ti-haa wa-ka-zaa-li-ka tuk-hra-joon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنۡ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٖ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَنتُم بَشَرٞ تَنتَشِرُونَ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: ومن ءايته ان خلقكم من تراب ثم اذا انتم بشر تنتشرون
ayahs.translation: And of His signs is that He created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing [throughout the earth].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-min aayaa-tiheee an kha-la-qa-kum min tu-raa-bin sum-ma i-zaaa an-tum ba-sha-run tan-ta-shi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنۡ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا لِّتَسۡكُنُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَكُم مَّوَدَّةٗ وَرَحۡمَةًۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: ومن ءايته ان خلق لكم من انفسكم ازوجا لتسكنوا اليها وجعل بينكم مودة ورحمة ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يتفكرون
ayahs.translation: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-min aayaa-tiheee an kha-la-qa la-kum min an-fu-si-kum az-waa-jal li-tas-ku-nooo i-lai-haa wa-jaa-la bai-na-kum ma-wad-da-tanw wa-rah-mah in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayaa-til li-qaw-mi-ny ya-ta-fak-ka-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلۡقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱخۡتِلَٰفُ أَلۡسِنَتِكُمۡ وَأَلۡوَٰنِكُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّلۡعَٰلِمِينَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: ومن ءايته خلق السموت والارض واختلف السنتكم والونكم ان في ذلك لايت للعلمين
ayahs.translation: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-min aayaa-tihee khal-qus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-laar-di wak-hti-laa-fu al-si-na-ti-kum waal-waa-ni-kum in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayaa-til li-laa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ مَنَامُكُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱبۡتِغَآؤُكُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَسۡمَعُونَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: ومن ءايته منامكم باليل والنهار وابتغاؤكم من فضله ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يسمعون
ayahs.translation: And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-min aayaa-tihee ma-naa-mu-kum bil-lai-li wan-na-haa-ri wab-ti-ghaaau-kum min fad-lih in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayaa-til li-qaw-mi-ny yas-maoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُرِيكُمُ ٱلۡبَرۡقَ خَوۡفٗا وَطَمَعٗا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَيُحۡيِۦ بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَآۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: ومن ءايته يريكم البرق خوفا وطمعا وينزل من السماء ماء فيحي به الارض بعد موتها ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يعقلون
ayahs.translation: And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-min aayaa-tihee yu-ree-ku-mul bar-qa khaw-fanw wa-ta-maanw wayu-naz-zi-lu mi-nas sa-maaai maaaan fayu-hyee bi-hil ar-da ba-da maw-ti-haaa in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayaa-til li-qaw-mi-ny ya-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَن تَقُومَ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ بِأَمۡرِهِۦۚ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمۡ دَعۡوَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِذَآ أَنتُمۡ تَخۡرُجُونَ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: ومن ءايته ان تقوم السماء والارض بامره ثم اذا دعاكم دعوة من الارض اذا انتم تخرجون
ayahs.translation: And of His signs is that the heaven and earth stand [i.e., remain] by His command. Then when He calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-min aayaa-tihee an ta-qoo-mas sa-maaau wa-lar-du bi-a-mrih sum-ma i-zaa daaa-kum da-wa-tam mi-nal ar-di i-zaaa an-tum tak-hru-joon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ كُلّٞ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: وله من في السموت والارض كل له قنتون
ayahs.translation: And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. All are to Him devoutly obedient.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-hoo man fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di kul-lul la-hoo qaa-ni-toon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يَبۡدَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَهُوَ أَهۡوَنُ عَلَيۡهِۚ وَلَهُ ٱلۡمَثَلُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: وهو الذي يبدؤا الخلق ثم يعيده وهو اهون عليه وله المثل الاعلي في السموت والارض وهو العزيز الحكيم
ayahs.translation: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest description [i.e., attribute] in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wal lazee yab-daul khal-qa sum-ma yuee-du-hoo wa-hu-wa ah-wa-nu a-laih wa-la-hul ma-sa-lul la-laa fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lard wa-hu-wal azee-zul hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ضَرَبَ لَكُم مَّثَلٗا مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡۖ هَل لَّكُم مِّن مَّا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُكُم مِّن شُرَكَآءَ فِي مَا رَزَقۡنَٰكُمۡ فَأَنتُمۡ فِيهِ سَوَآءٞ تَخَافُونَهُمۡ كَخِيفَتِكُمۡ أَنفُسَكُمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لِقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: ضرب لكم مثلا من انفسكم هل لكم من ما ملكت ايمنكم من شركاء في ما رزقنكم فانتم فيه سواء تخافونهم كخيفتكم انفسكم كذلك نفصل الايت لقوم يعقلون
ayahs.translation: He presents to you an example from yourselves. Do you have among those whom your right hands possess [i.e., slaves] any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]? Thus do We detail the verses for a people who use reason.
ayahs.transliteration: da-ra-ba la-kum ma-sa-lam min an-fu-si-kum hal la-kum mim maa ma-la-kat ay-maa-nu-kum min shu-ra-kaaaa fee maa ra-zaq-naa-kum faan-tum fee-hi sa-waaaun ta-khaa-foo-na-hum ka-khee-fa-ti-kum an-fu-sa-kum ka-zaa-li-ka nu-fas-si-lul aayaa-ti li-qaw-mi-ny ya-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُم بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖۖ فَمَن يَهۡدِي مَنۡ أَضَلَّ ٱللَّهُۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: بل اتبع الذين ظلموا اهواءهم بغير علم فمن يهدي من اضل الله وما لهم من نصرين
ayahs.translation: But those who wrong follow their [own] desires without knowledge. Then who can guide one whom Allāh has sent astray? And for them there are no helpers.
ayahs.transliteration: ba-lit ta-baal lazee-na za-la-mooo ah-waaaa-hum bi-ghai-ri il-min fa-mai yah-dee man a-dal-lal laa-hu wa-maa la-hum min naa-sireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَقِمۡ وَجۡهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفٗاۚ فِطۡرَتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِي فَطَرَ ٱلنَّاسَ عَلَيۡهَاۚ لَا تَبۡدِيلَ لِخَلۡقِ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: فاقم وجهك للدين حنيفا فطرت الله التي فطر الناس عليها لا تبديل لخلق الله ذلك الدين القيم ولكن اكثر الناس لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the religion, inclining to truth. [Adhere to] the fiṭrah of Allāh upon which He has created [all] people. No change should there be in the creation of Allāh. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-qim wa-jha-ka lid-dee-ni hanee-faa fit-ra-tal laa-hil latee fa-ta-ran naa-sa a-lai-haa laa taab-dee-la li-khal-qil laah zaa-li-kad dee-nul qaiyi-mu wa-laa-kin-na ak-sa-ran naa-si laa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيۡهِ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَلَا تَكُونُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: منيبين اليه واتقوه واقيموا الصلوة ولا تكونوا من المشركين
ayahs.translation: [Adhere to it], turning in repentance to Him, and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allāh
ayahs.transliteration: munee-bee-na i-lai-hi wat-ta-qoo-hu waaqee-mus sa-laa-ta wa-laa ta-koo-noo mi-nal mus-hri-keen

ayahs.text_uthmani: مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ فَرَّقُواْ دِينَهُمۡ وَكَانُواْ شِيَعٗاۖ كُلُّ حِزۡبِۭ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ فَرِحُونَ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: من الذين فرقوا دينهم وكانوا شيعا كل حزب بما لديهم فرحون
ayahs.translation: [Or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has.
ayahs.transliteration: mi-nal lazee-na far-ra-qoo dee-na-hum wa-kaa-noo shiyaan kul-lu hiz-bim bi-maa la-dai-him fa-ri-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلنَّاسَ ضُرّٞ دَعَوۡاْ رَبَّهُم مُّنِيبِينَ إِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَذَاقَهُم مِّنۡهُ رَحۡمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُم بِرَبِّهِمۡ يُشۡرِكُونَ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: واذا مس الناس ضر دعوا ربهم منيبين اليه ثم اذا اذاقهم منه رحمة اذا فريق منهم بربهم يشركون
ayahs.translation: And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord,
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa mas-san naa-sa dur-run daaw rab-ba-hum munee-bee-na i-lai-hi sum-ma i-zaaa a-za-qa-hum mi-nhu rah-ma-tan i-zaa faree-qum mi-nhum be-rab-bi-him yus-hri-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِيَكۡفُرُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡۚ فَتَمَتَّعُواْ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: ليكفروا بما ءاتينهم فتمتعوا فسوف تعلمون
ayahs.translation: So that they will deny what We have granted them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.
ayahs.transliteration: liyak-fu-roo bi-maaa aa-tai-naa-hum fa-ta-mat-taoo fa-saw-fa ta-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٗا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يُشۡرِكُونَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: ام انزلنا عليهم سلطنا فهو يتكلم بما كانوا به يشركون
ayahs.translation: Or have We sent down to them an authority [i.e., a proof or scripture], and it speaks of what they have been associating with Him?
ayahs.transliteration: am an-zal-naa a-lai-him sul-taa-nan fa-hu-wa ya-ta-kal-la-mu bi-maa kaa-noo bihee yus-hri-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَآ أَذَقۡنَا ٱلنَّاسَ رَحۡمَةٗ فَرِحُواْ بِهَاۖ وَإِن تُصِبۡهُمۡ سَيِّئَةُۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ إِذَا هُمۡ يَقۡنَطُونَ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: واذا اذقنا الناس رحمة فرحوا بها وان تصبهم سيئة بما قدمت ايديهم اذا هم يقنطون
ayahs.translation: And when We let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaaa a-zaq-nan naa-sa rah-ma-tan fa-ri-hoo bi-haa wain tu-si-bhum sayyi-a-tum bi-maa qad-da-mat ay-dee-him i-zaa hum yaq-na-toon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: اولم يروا ان الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: Do they not see that Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-lam ya-raw an-nal laa-ha yab-su-tur riz-qa li-mai ya-shaaau wayaq-dir in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayaa-til li-qaw-mi-ny yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَـَٔاتِ ذَا ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلۡمِسۡكِينَ وَٱبۡنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ لِّلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجۡهَ ٱللَّهِۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: فات ذا القربي حقه والمسكين وابن السبيل ذلك خير للذين يريدون وجه الله واولئك هم المفلحون
ayahs.translation: So give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. That is best for those who desire the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh, and it is they who will be the successful.
ayahs.transliteration: faaa-ti zal qur-baa haq-qa-hoo wal-mis-kee-na wab-nas sabeel zaa-li-ka khai-rul lil-la-zee-na yu-ree-doo-na wa-jhal laa-hi wau-laaai-ka hu-mul muf-li-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ ءَاتَيۡتُم مِّن رِّبٗا لِّيَرۡبُوَاْ فِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَلَا يَرۡبُواْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِۖ وَمَآ ءَاتَيۡتُم مِّن زَكَوٰةٖ تُرِيدُونَ وَجۡهَ ٱللَّهِ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُضۡعِفُونَ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: وما ءاتيتم من ربا ليربوا في امول الناس فلا يربوا عند الله وما ءاتيتم من زكوة تريدون وجه الله فاولئك هم المضعفون
ayahs.translation: And whatever you give for interest [i.e., advantage] to increase within the wealth of people will not increase with Allāh. But what you give in zakāh, desiring the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh - those are the multipliers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa aa-tai-tum mir ri-bal liyar-bu-wa feee am-waa-lin naa-si fa-laa yar-boo in-dal laa-hi wa-maaa aa-tai-tum min zaa-kaa-tin turee-doo-na wa-jhal laa-hi fau-laaai-ka hu-mul mu-di-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُحۡيِيكُمۡۖ هَلۡ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَفۡعَلُ مِن ذَٰلِكُم مِّن شَيۡءٖۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: الله الذي خلقكم ثم رزقكم ثم يميتكم ثم يحييكم هل من شركائكم من يفعل من ذلكم من شيء سبحنه وتعلي عما يشركون
ayahs.translation: Allāh is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. Are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
ayahs.transliteration: al-laa-hul lazee kha-la-qa-kum sum-ma ra-za-qa-kum sum-ma yu-mee-tu-kum sum-ma yu-hyee-kum hal min shu-ra-kaaai-kum mai yaf a-lu min zaa-li-kum min shai su-bhaa-na-hoo wa-taaa-laa am-maa yus-hri-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ظَهَرَ ٱلۡفَسَادُ فِي ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ أَيۡدِي ٱلنَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُم بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي عَمِلُواْ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: ظهر الفساد في البر والبحر بما كسبت ايدي الناس ليذيقهم بعض الذي عملوا لعلهم يرجعون
ayahs.translation: Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned so He [i.e., Allāh] may let them taste part of [the consequence of] what they have done that perhaps they will return [to righteousness].
ayahs.transliteration: za-ha-ral fa-saa-du fil bar-ri wal-bah-ri bi-maa ka-sa-bat ay-din naa-si liyuzee-qa-hum ba-dal lazee a-mi-loo laal-la-hum yar-jioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ سِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلُۚ كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّشۡرِكِينَ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: قل سيروا في الارض فانظروا كيف كان عقبة الذين من قبل كان اكثرهم مشركين
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators [of others with Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: qul see-roo fil ar-di fan-zu-roo kai-fa kaa-na aa-qi-ba-tul lazee-na min qabl kaa-na ak-sa-ru-hum mus-hri-keen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَقِمۡ وَجۡهَكَ لِلدِّينِ ٱلۡقَيِّمِ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ يَوۡمٞ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِۖ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصَّدَّعُونَ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: فاقم وجهك للدين القيم من قبل ان ياتي يوم لا مرد له من الله يومئذ يصدعون
ayahs.translation: So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the correct religion before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. That Day, they will be divided.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-qim wa-jha-ka lid-dee-nil qaiyi-mi min qab-li a-ny yaa-tiya yaw-mul laa ma-rad-da la-hoo mi-nal laa-hi yaw-mai-zi-ny yas-sad-daoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيۡهِ كُفۡرُهُۥۖ وَمَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلِأَنفُسِهِمۡ يَمۡهَدُونَ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: من كفر فعليه كفره ومن عمل صلحا فلانفسهم يمهدون
ayahs.translation: Whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing,
ayahs.transliteration: man ka-fa-ra faa-lai-hi kuf-ru-hoo wa-man a-mi-la saa-li-han fa-li-a-nfu-si-him ya-mha-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: ليجزي الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت من فضله انه لا يحب الكفرين
ayahs.translation: That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not like the disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: liyaj-ziyal lazee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti min fad-lih in-na-hoo laa yu-hib-bul kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَن يُرۡسِلَ ٱلرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَٰتٖ وَلِيُذِيقَكُم مِّن رَّحۡمَتِهِۦ وَلِتَجۡرِيَ ٱلۡفُلۡكُ بِأَمۡرِهِۦ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: ومن ءايته ان يرسل الرياح مبشرت وليذيقكم من رحمته ولتجري الفلك بامره ولتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون
ayahs.translation: And of His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of good tidings and to let you taste His mercy [i.e., rain] and so the ships may sail at His command and so you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-min aayaa-tiheee a-ny yur-si-lar riyaa-ha mu-bas-hshi-raa-tinw wa-liyu-zee-qa-kum mir rah-ma-tihee wa-li-taj-riyal ful-ku bi-a-mri-hee wa-li-tab-ta-ghoo min fad-lihee wa-laal-la-kum tas-hku-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِمۡ فَجَآءُوهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْۖ وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيۡنَا نَصۡرُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ارسلنا من قبلك رسلا الي قومهم فجاءوهم بالبينت فانتقمنا من الذين اجرموا وكان حقا علينا نصر المؤمنين
ayahs.translation: And We have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then We took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon Us was support of the believers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad ar-sal-naa min qab-li-ka ru-su-lan i-laa qaw-mi-him fa-jaaaoo-hum bil-baiyi-naa-ti fan-ta-qam-naa mi-nal lazee-na aj-ra-moo wa-kaa-na haq-qan a-lai-naa nas-rul mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي يُرۡسِلُ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابٗا فَيَبۡسُطُهُۥ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيۡفَ يَشَآءُ وَيَجۡعَلُهُۥ كِسَفٗا فَتَرَى ٱلۡوَدۡقَ يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ خِلَٰلِهِۦۖ فَإِذَآ أَصَابَ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمۡ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُونَ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: الله الذي يرسل الريح فتثير سحابا فيبسطه في السماء كيف يشاء ويجعله كسفا فتري الودق يخرج من خلله فاذا اصاب به من يشاء من عباده اذا هم يستبشرون
ayahs.translation: It is Allāh who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. And when He causes it to fall upon whom He wills of His servants, immediately they rejoice
ayahs.transliteration: al-laa-hul lazee yur-si-lur riyaa-ha fa-tu-see-ru sa-haa-ban fayab-su-tu-hoo fis sa-maaai kai-fa ya-shaaau waya-ja-lu-hoo ki-sa-fan fa-ta-ral wad-qa yak-hru-ju min khi-laa-lihee fai-zaaa a-saa-ba bihee mai ya-shaaau min i-baa-diheee i-zaa hum yas-tab-shi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِن كَانُواْ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيۡهِم مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ لَمُبۡلِسِينَ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: وان كانوا من قبل ان ينزل عليهم من قبله لمبلسين
ayahs.translation: Although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair.
ayahs.transliteration: wain kaa-noo min qab-li a-ny yu-naz-za-la a-lai-him min qab-lihee la-mub-liseen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱنظُرۡ إِلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِ رَحۡمَتِ ٱللَّهِ كَيۡفَ يُحۡيِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَآۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: فانظر الي ءاثر رحمت الله كيف يحي الارض بعد موتها ان ذلك لمحي الموتي وهو علي كل شيء قدير
ayahs.translation: So observe the effects of the mercy of Allāh - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.
ayahs.transliteration: fan-zur i-laaa aa-saa-ri rah-ma-til laa-hi kai-fa yu-hyil ar-da ba-da maw-ti-haa in-na zaa-li-ka la-mu-hyil maw-taa wa-hu-wa a-laa kul-li shaiin qadeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَئِنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رِيحٗا فَرَأَوۡهُ مُصۡفَرّٗا لَّظَلُّواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ يَكۡفُرُونَ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: ولئن ارسلنا ريحا فراوه مصفرا لظلوا من بعده يكفرون
ayahs.translation: But if We should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lain ar-sal-naa ree-han fa-raa-whu mus-far-ral la-zal-loo mim ba-dihee yak-fu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّكَ لَا تُسۡمِعُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَلَا تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوۡاْ مُدۡبِرِينَ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: فانك لا تسمع الموتي ولا تسمع الصم الدعاء اذا ولوا مدبرين
ayahs.translation: So indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating.
ayahs.transliteration: fain-na-ka laa tus-miul maw-taa wa-laa tus-mius sum-mad du-a-aaa i-zaa wal-law mud-bireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَٰدِ ٱلۡعُمۡيِ عَن ضَلَٰلَتِهِمۡۖ إِن تُسۡمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤۡمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسۡلِمُونَ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: وما انت بهد العمي عن ضللتهم ان تسمع الا من يؤمن بايتنا فهم مسلمون
ayahs.translation: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [in submission to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa an-ta bi-haa-dil u-myi an da-laa-la-ti-him in tus-miu il-laa mai yu-mi-nu bi-a-ayaa-ti-naa fa-hum mus-li-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن ضَعۡفٖ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ضَعۡفٖ قُوَّةٗ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ قُوَّةٖ ضَعۡفٗا وَشَيۡبَةٗۚ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡقَدِيرُ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: الله الذي خلقكم من ضعف ثم جعل من بعد ضعف قوة ثم جعل من بعد قوة ضعفا وشيبة يخلق ما يشاء وهو العليم القدير
ayahs.translation: Allāh is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-hul lazee kha-la-qa-kum min du-fin sum-ma jaa-la mim ba-di du-fin quw-wa-tan sum-ma jaa-la mim ba-di quw-wa-tin du-fanw wa-shai-bah yak-hlu-qu maa ya-shaaau wa-hu-wal alee-mul qadeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُقۡسِمُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُواْ غَيۡرَ سَاعَةٖۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَانُواْ يُؤۡفَكُونَ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: ويوم تقوم الساعة يقسم المجرمون ما لبثوا غير ساعة كذلك كانوا يؤفكون
ayahs.translation: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. Thus they were deluded.
ayahs.transliteration: wayaw-ma ta-qoo-mus saaa-tu yuq-si-mul muj-ri-moo-na maa la-bi-soo ghai-ra saaah ka-zaa-li-ka kaa-noo yu-fa-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ وَٱلۡإِيمَٰنَ لَقَدۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡ فِي كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡبَعۡثِۖ فَهَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡبَعۡثِ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: وقال الذين اوتوا العلم والايمن لقد لبثتم في كتب الله الي يوم البعث فهذا يوم البعث ولكنكم كنتم لا تعلمون
ayahs.translation: But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "You remained the extent of Allāh's decree until the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not used to know."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-lal lazee-na oo-tul il-ma walee-maa-na la-qad la-bis-tum fee ki-taa-bil laa-hi i-laa yaw-mil ba-si fa-haa-zaa yaw-mul ba-si wa-laa-kin-na-kum kun-tum laa ta-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مَعۡذِرَتُهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُونَ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: فيومئذ لا ينفع الذين ظلموا معذرتهم ولا هم يستعتبون
ayahs.translation: So that Day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: fayaw-mai-zil laa yan-faul lazee-na za-la-moo ma-zi-ra-tu-hum wa-laa hum yus-ta-ta-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ ضَرَبۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٖۚ وَلَئِن جِئۡتَهُم بِـَٔايَةٖ لَّيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا مُبۡطِلُونَ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ضربنا للناس في هذا القرءان من كل مثل ولئن جئتهم باية ليقولن الذين كفروا ان انتم الا مبطلون
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly presented to the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example. But, [O Muḥammad], if you should bring them a sign, the disbelievers will surely say, "You [believers] are but falsifiers."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad da-rab-naa lin-naa-si fee haa-zal qu-raa-ni min kul-li ma-sal wa-lain ji-ta-hum bi-a-aya-til laya-qoo-lan-nal lazee-na ka-fa-roo in an-tum il-laa mub-ti-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ يَطۡبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: كذلك يطبع الله علي قلوب الذين لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: Thus does Allāh seal the hearts of those who do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: ka-zaa-li-ka yat-baul laa-hu a-laa qu-loo-bil lazee-na laa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱصۡبِرۡ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞۖ وَلَا يَسۡتَخِفَّنَّكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: فاصبر ان وعد الله حق ولا يستخفنك الذين لا يوقنون
ayahs.translation: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].
ayahs.transliteration: fas-bir in-na wa-dal laa-hi haq-qunw wa-laa yas-ta-khif-fan-na-kal lazee-na laa yoo-qi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: الٓمٓ ١
ayahs.text_simple: الم
ayahs.translation: Alif, Lām, Meem.
ayahs.transliteration: a-lif-laaam-meeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: تلك ءايت الكتب الحكيم
ayahs.translation: These are verses of the wise Book,
ayahs.transliteration: til-ka aayaa-tul ki-taa-bil hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: هُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٗ لِّلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: هدي ورحمة للمحسنين
ayahs.translation: As guidance and mercy for the doers of good
ayahs.transliteration: hu-danw wa-rah-ma-tal lil-muh-sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوقِنُونَ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: الذين يقيمون الصلوة ويؤتون الزكوة وهم بالاخرة هم يوقنون
ayahs.translation: Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and they, of the Hereafter, are certain [in faith].
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na yu-qee-moo-nas sa-laa-ta wayu-too-naz za-kaa-ta wa-hum bi-laa-khi-ra-ti hum yoo-qi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدٗى مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك علي هدي من ربهم واولئك هم المفلحون
ayahs.translation: Those are on [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-ka a-laa hu-dam mir rab-bi-him wau-laaai-ka hu-mul muf-li-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَشۡتَرِي لَهۡوَ ٱلۡحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًاۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: ومن الناس من يشتري لهو الحديث ليضل عن سبيل الله بغير علم ويتخذها هزوا اولئك لهم عذاب مهين
ayahs.translation: And of the people is he who buys the amusement of speech to mislead [others] from the way of Allāh without knowledge and who takes it [i.e., His way] in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mi-nan naa-si mai yas-hta-ree lah-wal had-de-si liyu-dil-la an sabee-lil laa-hi bi-ghai-ri il-minw wayat-ta-khi-za-haa hu-zu-waa u-laaai-ka la-hum a-zaa-bum muheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا وَلَّىٰ مُسۡتَكۡبِرٗا كَأَن لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَا كَأَنَّ فِيٓ أُذُنَيۡهِ وَقۡرٗاۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: واذا تتلي عليه ءايتنا ولي مستكبرا كان لم يسمعها كان في اذنيه وقرا فبشره بعذاب اليم
ayahs.translation: And when Our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa tut-laa a-lay-hi aayaa-tu-naa wal-laa mus-tak-bi-ran kaal lam yas-ma-haa kaan-na feee u-zu-nai-hi waq-ran fa-bas-hshi-ru bi-a-zaa-bin aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلنَّعِيمِ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم جنت النعيم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the Gardens of Pleasure,
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti la-hum ja-naa-tun naeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٗاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: خلدين فيها وعد الله حقا وهو العزيز الحكيم
ayahs.translation: Wherein they abide eternally; [it is] the promise of Allāh [which is] truth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: khaa-li-dee-na fee-ha wa-dal laa-hi haq-qaa wa-hu-wal azee-zul hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ بِغَيۡرِ عَمَدٖ تَرَوۡنَهَاۖ وَأَلۡقَىٰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمۡ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَآبَّةٖۚ وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجٖ كَرِيمٍ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: خلق السموت بغير عمد ترونها والقي في الارض روسي ان تميد بكم وبث فيها من كل دابة وانزلنا من السماء ماء فانبتنا فيها من كل زوج كريم
ayahs.translation: He created the heavens without pillars that you see and has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with you, and dispersed therein from every creature. And We sent down rain from the sky and made grow therein [plants] of every noble kind.
ayahs.transliteration: kha-la-qas sa-maa-waa-ti bi-ghai-ri a-ma-din ta-raw-na-haa waal-qaa fil ar-di ra-waa-siya an tamee-da bi-kum wa-bas-sa fee-haa min kul-li daaab-bah waan-zal-naa mi-nas sa-maaai maaaan faam-bat-naa fee-ha min kul-li zaw-jin kareem

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا خَلۡقُ ٱللَّهِ فَأَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦۚ بَلِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: هذا خلق الله فاروني ماذا خلق الذين من دونه بل الظلمون في ضلل مبين
ayahs.translation: This is the creation of Allāh. So show Me what those other than Him have created. Rather, the wrongdoers are in clear error.
ayahs.transliteration: haa-zaa khal-qul laa-hi faa-roonee maa-zaa kha-la-qal lazee-na min doo-nih ba-liz zaa-li-moo-na fee da-la-lim mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا لُقۡمَٰنَ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ أَنِ ٱشۡكُرۡ لِلَّهِۚ وَمَن يَشۡكُرۡ فَإِنَّمَا يَشۡكُرُ لِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٞ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ءاتينا لقمن الحكمة ان اشكر لله ومن يشكر فانما يشكر لنفسه ومن كفر فان الله غني حميد
ayahs.translation: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad aa-tai-naa luq-maa-nal hik-ma-ta a-ni shkur lil-laah wa-ma-ny yas-hkur fain-na-maa yas-hku-ru li-naf-sihee wa-man ka-fa-ra fain-nal laa-ha gha-niyyun hameed

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ قَالَ لُقۡمَٰنُ لِٱبۡنِهِۦ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُۥ يَٰبُنَيَّ لَا تُشۡرِكۡ بِٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّ ٱلشِّرۡكَ لَظُلۡمٌ عَظِيمٞ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: واذ قال لقمن لابنه وهو يعظه يبني لا تشرك بالله ان الشرك لظلم عظيم
ayahs.translation: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Luqmān said to his son while he was instructing him, "O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allāh. Indeed, association [with Him] is great injustice."
ayahs.transliteration: waiz qaa-la luq-maa-nu lib-nihee wa-hu-wa yai-zu-hoo ya-bu-naiya laa tus-hrik bil-laah in-nash shir-ka la-zul-mun azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَوَصَّيۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ حَمَلَتۡهُ أُمُّهُۥ وَهۡنًا عَلَىٰ وَهۡنٖ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ فِي عَامَيۡنِ أَنِ ٱشۡكُرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيۡكَ إِلَيَّ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: ووصينا الانسن بولديه حملته امه وهنا علي وهن وفصله في عامين ان اشكر لي ولولديك الي المصير
ayahs.translation: And We have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. His mother carried him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. Be grateful to Me and to your parents; to Me is the [final] destination.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-was-sai-nal in-saa-na bi-waa-li-dai-hi ha-ma-la-thu um-mu-hoo wah-nan a-laa wah-ninw wa-fi-saa-lu-hoo fee aa-mai-ni a-ni is-hkur lee wa-li-waa-li-dai-ka i-laiyal maseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِن جَٰهَدَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تُشۡرِكَ بِي مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞ فَلَا تُطِعۡهُمَاۖ وَصَاحِبۡهُمَا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا مَعۡرُوفٗاۖ وَٱتَّبِعۡ سَبِيلَ مَنۡ أَنَابَ إِلَيَّۚ ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: وان جهداك علي ان تشرك بي ما ليس لك به علم فلا تطعهما وصاحبهما في الدنيا معروفا واتبع سبيل من اناب الي ثم الي مرجعكم فانبئكم بما كنتم تعملون
ayahs.translation: But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them but accompany them in [this] world with appropriate kindness and follow the way of those who turn back to Me [in repentance]. Then to Me will be your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.
ayahs.transliteration: wain jaa-ha-daa-ka a-laaa an tus-hri-ka bee maa lai-sa la-ka bihee il-mun fa-laa tu-ti-hu-maa wa-saa-hi-bhu-maa fid du-nyaa ma-roo-fanw wat-ta-bi sabee-la man a-naa-ba i-layy sum-ma i-laiya mar-jiu-kum fau-nab-biu-kum bi-maa kun-tum ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنَّهَآ إِن تَكُ مِثۡقَالَ حَبَّةٖ مِّنۡ خَرۡدَلٖ فَتَكُن فِي صَخۡرَةٍ أَوۡ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ أَوۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَأۡتِ بِهَا ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٞ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: يبني انها ان تك مثقال حبة من خردل فتكن في صخرة او في السموت او في الارض يات بها الله ان الله لطيف خبير
ayahs.translation: [And Luqmān said], "O my son, indeed if it [i.e., a wrong] should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or in the earth, Allāh will bring it forth. Indeed, Allāh is Subtle and Aware.
ayahs.transliteration: ya-bu-naiya in-na-haaa in ta-ku mis-qaa-la hab-ba-tim min khar-da-lin fa-ta-kun fee sak-hra-tin aw fis sa-maa-waa-ti aw fil ar-di yaa-ti bi-al lah in-nal laa-ha latee-fun khabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰبُنَيَّ أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأۡمُرۡ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَٱنۡهَ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِ وَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَكَۖ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عَزۡمِ ٱلۡأُمُورِ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: يبني اقم الصلوة وامر بالمعروف وانه عن المنكر واصبر علي ما اصابك ان ذلك من عزم الامور
ayahs.translation: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] resolve.
ayahs.transliteration: yaa-bu-naiya a-qi-mis sa-laa-ta waa-mur bil-ma-roo-fi wa-nha a-nil mun-ka-ri was-bir a-laa maaa a-saa-ba-ka in-na zaa-li-ka min az-mil u-moor

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا تُصَعِّرۡ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمۡشِ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَرَحًاۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخۡتَالٖ فَخُورٖ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: ولا تصعر خدك للناس ولا تمش في الارض مرحا ان الله لا يحب كل مختال فخور
ayahs.translation: And do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people and do not walk through the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allāh does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa tu-sair khad-da-ka lin-naa-si wa-laa tam-shi fil ar-di maa-ra-han in-nal laa-ha laa yu-hib-bu kul-la muk-htaa-lin fa-khoor

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱقۡصِدۡ فِي مَشۡيِكَ وَٱغۡضُضۡ مِن صَوۡتِكَۚ إِنَّ أَنكَرَ ٱلۡأَصۡوَٰتِ لَصَوۡتُ ٱلۡحَمِيرِ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: واقصد في مشيك واغضض من صوتك ان انكر الاصوت لصوت الحمير
ayahs.translation: And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys."
ayahs.transliteration: waq-sid fee ma-shyi-ka wag-hdud min saw-tik in-na an-ka-ral as-waa-ti la-saw-tul hameer

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَأَسۡبَغَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ نِعَمَهُۥ ظَٰهِرَةٗ وَبَاطِنَةٗۗ وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِي ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖ وَلَا هُدٗى وَلَا كِتَٰبٖ مُّنِيرٖ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: الم تروا ان الله سخر لكم ما في السموت وما في الارض واسبغ عليكم نعمه ظهرة وباطنة ومن الناس من يجدل في الله بغير علم ولا هدي ولا كتب منير
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that Allāh has made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you His favors, [both] apparent and unapparent? But of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening Book [from Him].
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam ta-raw an-nal laa-ha sak-hkha-ra la-kum maa fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-maa fil ar-di waas-ba-gha a-lai-kum ni-a-ma-hoo zaa-hi-ra-tanw wa-baa-ti-nah wa-mi-nan naa-si ma-ny yu-jaa-di-lu fil laa-hi bi-ghay-ri il-minw wa-laa hu-danw wa-laa ki-taa-bim muneer

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّبِعُواْ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُواْ بَلۡ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ ءَابَآءَنَآۚ أَوَلَوۡ كَانَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ يَدۡعُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: واذا قيل لهم اتبعوا ما انزل الله قالوا بل نتبع ما وجدنا عليه ءاباءنا اولو كان الشيطن يدعوهم الي عذاب السعير
ayahs.translation: And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allāh has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers." Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze?
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa qee-la la-hu-mut ta-bioo maaa an-za-lal laa-hu qaa-loo bal nat-ta-biu maa wa-jad-naa a-lai-hi aa-baaaa-naa a-wa-law kaa-nash shai-taa-nu ya-doo-hum i-laa a-zaa-bis saeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَمَن يُسۡلِمۡ وَجۡهَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحۡسِنٞ فَقَدِ ٱسۡتَمۡسَكَ بِٱلۡعُرۡوَةِ ٱلۡوُثۡقَىٰۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡأُمُورِ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: ومن يسلم وجهه الي الله وهو محسن فقد استمسك بالعروة الوثقي والي الله عقبة الامور
ayahs.translation: And whoever submits his face [i.e., self] to Allāh while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allāh will be the outcome of [all] matters.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ma-ny yus-lim wa-jha-hooo i-lal laa-hi wa-hu-wa muh-si-nun fa-qa-di is-tam-sa-ka bi-lur-wa-til wus-qaa wai-lal laa-hi aa-qi-ba-tul u-moor

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَن كَفَرَ فَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ كُفۡرُهُۥٓۚ إِلَيۡنَا مَرۡجِعُهُمۡ فَنُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: ومن كفر فلا يحزنك كفره الينا مرجعهم فننبئهم بما عملوا ان الله عليم بذات الصدور
ayahs.translation: And whoever has disbelieved - let not his disbelief grieve you. To Us is their return, and We will inform them of what they did. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-man ka-fa-ra fa-laa yah-zun-ka kuf-ruh i-lai-naa mar-jiu-hum fa-nu-nab-biu-hum bi-maa a-mi-loo in-nal laa-ha alee-mum bi-zaa-tis su-door

ayahs.text_uthmani: نُمَتِّعُهُمۡ قَلِيلٗا ثُمَّ نَضۡطَرُّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٖ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: نمتعهم قليلا ثم نضطرهم الي عذاب غليظ
ayahs.translation: We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: nu-mat-tiu-hum qalee-lan sum-ma nad-tar-ru-hum i-laa a-zaa-bin ghaleez

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولئن سالتهم من خلق السموت والارض ليقولن الله قل الحمد لله بل اكثرهم لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allāh"; but most of them do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lain saal-ta-hum man kha-la-qas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da laya-qoo-lun-nal laah qu-lil ham-du lil-laah bal ak-sa-ru-hum laa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: لله ما في السموت والارض ان الله هو الغني الحميد
ayahs.translation: To Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
ayahs.transliteration: lil-la-hi ma fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lard in-nal laa-ha hu-wal gha-niyyul hameed

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡ أَنَّمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِن شَجَرَةٍ أَقۡلَٰمٞ وَٱلۡبَحۡرُ يَمُدُّهُۥ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ سَبۡعَةُ أَبۡحُرٖ مَّا نَفِدَتۡ كَلِمَٰتُ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٞ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولو انما في الارض من شجرة اقلم والبحر يمده من بعده سبعة ابحر ما نفدت كلمت الله ان الله عزيز حكيم
ayahs.translation: And if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea [was ink], replenished thereafter by seven [more] seas, the words of Allāh would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law an-na-maa fil ar-di min sha-ja-ra-tin aq-laa-munw wal-bah-ru ya-mud-du-hoo mim ba-dihee sa-ba-tu a-bhu-rim maa na-fi-dat ka-li-maa-tul laah in-nal laa-ha azee-zun hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَّا خَلۡقُكُمۡ وَلَا بَعۡثُكُمۡ إِلَّا كَنَفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٍۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٌ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: ما خلقكم ولا بعثكم الا كنفس وحدة ان الله سميع بصير
ayahs.translation: Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
ayahs.transliteration: maa khal-qu-kum wa-laa ba-su-kum il-laa ka-naf-sin-wwaa hi-dah in-nal laa-ha samee-um baseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيۡلَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ يَجۡرِيٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗى وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: الم تر ان الله يولج اليل في النهار ويولج النهار في اليل وسخر الشمس والقمر كل يجري الي اجل مسمي وان الله بما تعملون خبير
ayahs.translation: Do you not see [i.e., know] that Allāh causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term, and that Allāh, of whatever you do, is Aware?
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam ta-ra an-nal laa-ha yoo-li-jul lai-la fin na-haa-ri wayoo-li-jun na-haa-ra fil lai-li wa-sak-hkha-rash sham-sa wal-qa-ma-ra kul-lu-ny yaj-reee i-laaa a-ja-lim mu-sam-manw waan-nal laa-ha bi-maa ta-ma-loo-na khabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: ذلك بان الله هو الحق وان ما يدعون من دونه البطل وان الله هو العلي الكبير
ayahs.translation: That is because Allāh is the True Reality, and that what they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allāh is the Most High, the Grand.
ayahs.transliteration: zaa-li-ka bi-a-nnal laa-ha hu-wal haq-qu waan-na maa ya-doo-na min doo-ni-hil baa-ti-lu waan-nal laa-ha hu-wal a-liyyul kabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ تَجۡرِي فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ بِنِعۡمَتِ ٱللَّهِ لِيُرِيَكُم مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٖ شَكُورٖ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: الم تر ان الفلك تجري في البحر بنعمت الله ليريكم من ءايته ان في ذلك لايت لكل صبار شكور
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that ships sail through the sea by the favor of Allāh that He may show you of His signs? Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam ta-ra an-nal ful-ka taj-ree fil bah-ri bi-ni-ma-til laa-hi liyu-riya-kum min aayaa-tih in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayaa-til li-kul-li sab-baa-rin sha-koor

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا غَشِيَهُم مَّوۡجٞ كَٱلظُّلَلِ دَعَوُاْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡبَرِّ فَمِنۡهُم مُّقۡتَصِدٞۚ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا كُلُّ خَتَّارٖ كَفُورٖ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: واذا غشيهم موج كالظلل دعوا الله مخلصين له الدين فلما نجيهم الي البر فمنهم مقتصد وما يجحد بايتنا الا كل ختار كفور
ayahs.translation: And when waves come over them like canopies, they supplicate Allāh, sincere to Him in religion [i.e., faith]. But when He delivers them to the land, there are [some] of them who are moderate [in faith]. And none rejects Our signs except everyone treacherous and ungrateful.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa gha-shiya-hum maw-jun kaz-zu-la-li daa-wul laa-ha muk-hli-see-na la-hud dee-na fa-lam-maa naj-jaa-hum i-lal bar-ri fa-mi-nhum muq-ta-sid wa-maa ya-jha-du bi-a-ayaa-ti-naa il-laa kul-lu khat-taa-rin ka-foor

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ وَٱخۡشَوۡاْ يَوۡمٗا لَّا يَجۡزِي وَالِدٌ عَن وَلَدِهِۦ وَلَا مَوۡلُودٌ هُوَ جَازٍ عَن وَالِدِهِۦ شَيۡـًٔاۚ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡغَرُورُ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: يايها الناس اتقوا ربكم واخشوا يوما لا يجزي والد عن ولده ولا مولود هو جاز عن والده شيا ان وعد الله حق فلا تغرنكم الحيوة الدنيا ولا يغرنكم بالله الغرور
ayahs.translation: O mankind, fear your Lord and fear a Day when no father will avail his son, nor will a son avail his father at all. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allāh by the Deceiver [i.e., Satan].
