ayahs.text_simple: لينذر من كان حيا ويحق القول علي الكفرين
ayahs.translation: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word [i.e., decree] against the disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: liyun-zi-ra man kaa-na haiyanw waya-hiq-qal qaw-lu a-lal kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ أَيۡدِينَآ أَنۡعَٰمٗا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ ٧١
ayahs.text_simple: اولم يروا انا خلقنا لهم مما عملت ايدينا انعما فهم لها ملكون
ayahs.translation: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-lam ya-raw an-naa kha-laq-naa la-hum mim-maa a-mi-lat ai-dee-naaa a-naa-man fa-hum la-haa maa-li-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَذَلَّلۡنَٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَأۡكُلُونَ ٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: وذللنها لهم فمنها ركوبهم ومنها ياكلون
ayahs.translation: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-zal-lal-naa-haa la-hum fa-mi-nhaa ra-koo-bu-hum wa-mi-nhaa ya-ku-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ ٧٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولهم فيها منفع ومشارب افلا يشكرون
ayahs.translation: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-hum fee-haa ma-naa-fiu wa-ma-shaa-rib a-fa-laa yas-hku-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةٗ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ ٧٤
ayahs.text_simple: واتخذوا من دون الله ءالهة لعلهم ينصرون
ayahs.translation: But they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
ayahs.transliteration: wat-ta-kha-zoo min doo-nil laa-hi aa-li-ha-tal laal-la-hum yun-sa-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُندٞ مُّحۡضَرُونَ ٧٥
ayahs.text_simple: لا يستطيعون نصرهم وهم لهم جند محضرون
ayahs.translation: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.
ayahs.transliteration: laa yas-ta-tee-o-o-na nas-ra-hum wa-hum la-hum jun-dum muh-da-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡۘ إِنَّا نَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ ٧٦
ayahs.text_simple: فلا يحزنك قولهم انا نعلم ما يسرون وما يعلنون
ayahs.translation: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-laa yah-zun-ka qaw-lu-hum in-naa na-la-mu maa yu-sir-roo-na wa-maa yu-li-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٞ مُّبِينٞ ٧٧
ayahs.text_simple: اولم ير الانسن انا خلقنه من نطفة فاذا هو خصيم مبين
ayahs.translation: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-lam ya-ral in-saa-nu an-naa kha-laq-naa-hu min nut-fa-tin fai-zaa hu-wa khasee-mum mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلٗا وَنَسِيَ خَلۡقَهُۥۖ قَالَ مَن يُحۡيِ ٱلۡعِظَٰمَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٞ ٧٨
ayahs.text_simple: وضرب لنا مثلا ونسي خلقه قال من يحي العظم وهي رميم
ayahs.translation: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
ayahs.transliteration: wa-da-ra-ba la-naa mas-lan-wwa na-siya khal-qa-hoo qaa-la mai yu-hyil i-zaa-ma wa-hiya rameem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيهَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيمٌ ٧٩
ayahs.text_simple: قل يحييها الذي انشاها اول مرة وهو بكل خلق عليم
ayahs.translation: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
ayahs.transliteration: qul yu-hyee-hal lazeee an-shaa-haaa aw-wa-la mar-rah wa-hu-wa bi-kul-li khal-qin aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلۡأَخۡضَرِ نَارٗا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنۡهُ تُوقِدُونَ ٨٠
ayahs.text_simple: الذي جعل لكم من الشجر الاخضر نارا فاذا انتم منه توقدون
ayahs.translation: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee jaa-la la-kum mi-nash sha-ja-ril ak-hda-ri naa-ran fai-zaaa an-tum mi-nhu too-qi-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٨١
ayahs.text_simple: اوليس الذي خلق السموت والارض بقدر علي ان يخلق مثلهم بلي وهو الخلق العليم
ayahs.translation: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-lai-sal lazee kha-la-qas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da bi-qaa-di-rin a-laaa ai yak-hlu-qa mis-la-hum ba-laa wa-hu-wal khal-laa-qul aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَمۡرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيۡـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ ٨٢
ayahs.text_simple: انما امره اذا اراد شيا ان يقول له كن فيكون
ayahs.translation: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-maa am-ru-hooo i-zaaa a-raa-da shai-an ai ya-qoo-la la-hoo kun faya-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ ٨٣
ayahs.text_simple: فسبحن الذي بيده ملكوت كل شيء واليه ترجعون
ayahs.translation: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-su-bhaa-nal lazee biya-dihee ma-la-koo-tu kul-li shaiin-wwa i-lai-hi tur-jaoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفّٗا ١
ayahs.text_simple: والصفت صفا
ayahs.translation: By those [angels] lined up in rows
ayahs.transliteration: was-saaaf-faa-ti saf-faa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجۡرٗا ٢
ayahs.text_simple: فالزجرت زجرا
ayahs.translation: And those who drive [the clouds]
ayahs.transliteration: faz-zaa-ji-raa-ti zaj-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱلتَّٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكۡرًا ٣
ayahs.text_simple: فالتليت ذكرا
ayahs.translation: And those who recite the message,
ayahs.transliteration: fat-taa-liyaa-ti zik-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمۡ لَوَٰحِدٞ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان الهكم لوحد
ayahs.translation: Indeed, your God is One,
ayahs.transliteration: in-na il-laa-ha-kum la-waa-hid

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: رب السموت والارض وما بينهما ورب المشرق
ayahs.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
ayahs.transliteration: rab-bus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di wa-maa bai-na-hu-maa wa-rab-bul ma-shaa-riq

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلۡكَوَاكِبِ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: انا زينا السماء الدنيا بزينة الكواكب
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa zaiyan-nas sa-maaa ad-du-nyaa bizee-na-ti-nil ka-waa-kib

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَحِفۡظٗا مِّن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنٖ مَّارِدٖ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: وحفظا من كل شيطن مارد
ayahs.translation: And as protection against every rebellious devil
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hif-zam min kul-li shai-taa-nim maa-rid

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٖ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: لا يسمعون الي الملا الاعلي ويقذفون من كل جانب
ayahs.translation: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
ayahs.transliteration: laa yas-sam-maoo-na i-lal ma-lail aa-laa wayuq-za-foo-na min kul-li jaa-nib

ayahs.text_uthmani: دُحُورٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ وَاصِبٌ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: دحورا ولهم عذاب واصب
ayahs.translation: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
ayahs.transliteration: du-hoo-ranw wa-la-hum a-zaa-bunw waa-sib

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ ٱلۡخَطۡفَةَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٞ ثَاقِبٞ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: الا من خطف الخطفة فاتبعه شهاب ثاقب
ayahs.translation: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa man kha-ti-fal khat-fa-ta faat-baa-hoo shi-haa-bun saa-qib

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَهُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَم مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآۚ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٖ لَّازِبِۭ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: فاستفتهم اهم اشد خلقا ام من خلقنا انا خلقنهم من طين لازب
ayahs.translation: Then inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created them [i.e., men] from sticky clay.
ayahs.transliteration: fas-taf-ti-him a-hum a-shad-du khal-qan am man kha-laq-naa in-naa kha-laq-naa-hum min tee-nil laa-zib

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ عَجِبۡتَ وَيَسۡخَرُونَ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: بل عجبت ويسخرون
ayahs.translation: But you wonder, while they mock,
ayahs.transliteration: bal a-jib-ta wayas-kha-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ لَا يَذۡكُرُونَ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: واذا ذكروا لا يذكرون
ayahs.translation: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa zuk-ki-roo laa yaz-ku-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡاْ ءَايَةٗ يَسۡتَسۡخِرُونَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: واذا راوا ءاية يستسخرون
ayahs.translation: And when they see a sign, they ridicule.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa raaw aaya-ta-ny yas-tas-khi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٌ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا ان هذا الا سحر مبين
ayahs.translation: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-looo in haa-zaa il-laa sih-rum mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: اءذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظما اءنا لمبعوثون
ayahs.translation: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
ayahs.transliteration: ai-zaa mit-naa wa-kun-naa tu-raa-banw wai-zaa-man ain-naa la-ma-boo-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: اوءاباؤنا الاولون
ayahs.translation: And our forefathers [as well]?"
ayahs.transliteration: a-waaa-baau-nal aw-wa-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ نَعَمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ دَٰخِرُونَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: قل نعم وانتم دخرون
ayahs.translation: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."
ayahs.transliteration: qul naam waan-tum daa-khi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ فَإِذَا هُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: فانما هي زجرة وحدة فاذا هم ينظرون
ayahs.translation: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
ayahs.transliteration: fain-na-maa hiya zaj-ra-tunw waa-hi-da-tun fai-zaa hum yan-zu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا يويلنا هذا يوم الدين
ayahs.translation: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-loo yaa-wai-la-naa haa-zaa yaw-mud deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: هذا يوم الفصل الذي كنتم به تكذبون
ayahs.translation: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
ayahs.transliteration: haa-zaa yaw-mul fas-lil lazee kun-tum bihee tu-ka-zi-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ ٱحۡشُرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَأَزۡوَٰجَهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡبُدُونَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: احشروا الذين ظلموا وازوجهم وما كانوا يعبدون
ayahs.translation: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
ayahs.transliteration: uh-shu-rul lazee-na za-la-moo waaz-waa-ja-hum wa-maa kaa-noo ya-bu-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهۡدُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: من دون الله فاهدوهم الي صرط الجحيم
ayahs.translation: Other than Allāh, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
ayahs.transliteration: min doo-nil laa-hi fah-doo-hum i-laa si-raa-til jaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقِفُوهُمۡۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسۡـُٔولُونَ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: وقفوهم انهم مسولون
ayahs.translation: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qi-foo-hum in-na-hum ma-soo-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: ما لكم لا تناصرون
ayahs.translation: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
ayahs.transliteration: maa la-kum laa ta-naa-sa-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ هُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مُسۡتَسۡلِمُونَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: بل هم اليوم مستسلمون
ayahs.translation: But they, that Day, are in surrender.
ayahs.transliteration: bal hu-mul yaw-ma mus-tas-li-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: واقبل بعضهم علي بعض يتساءلون
ayahs.translation: And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.
ayahs.transliteration: waaq-ba-la ba-du-hum a-laa ba-di-ny ya-ta-saaaa-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَأۡتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا انكم كنتم تاتوننا عن اليمين
ayahs.translation: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-looo in-na-kum kun-tum taa-too-na-naa a-nil ya-meen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ بَل لَّمۡ تَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا بل لم تكونوا مؤمنين
ayahs.translation: They [i.e., the oppressors] will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo bal lam ta-koo-noo mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنِۭۖ بَلۡ كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا طَٰغِينَ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: وما كان لنا عليكم من سلطن بل كنتم قوما طغين
ayahs.translation: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa kaa-na la-naa a-lai-kum min sul-taa-nim bal kun-tum qaw-man taa-gheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡنَا قَوۡلُ رَبِّنَآۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: فحق علينا قول ربنا انا لذائقون
ayahs.translation: So the word [i.e., decree] of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
ayahs.transliteration: fa-haq-qa a-lai-naa qaw-lu rab-bi-naaa in-naa la-zaaai-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَغۡوَيۡنَٰكُمۡ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَٰوِينَ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: فاغوينكم انا كنا غوين
ayahs.translation: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
ayahs.transliteration: faag-hwai-naa-kum in-naa kun-naa ghaaween

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: فانهم يومئذ في العذاب مشتركون
ayahs.translation: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: fain-na-hum yaw-mai-zin fil a-zaa-bi mus-hta-ri-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفۡعَلُ بِٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: انا كذلك نفعل بالمجرمين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa ka-zaa-li-ka naf a-lu bil-muj-rimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: انهم كانوا اذا قيل لهم لا اله الا الله يستكبرون
ayahs.translation: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allāh," were arrogant
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hum kaa-nooo i-zaa qee-la la-hum laaa i-laa-ha il-lal laa-hu yas-tak-bi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٖ مَّجۡنُونِۭ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: ويقولون ائنا لتاركوا ءالهتنا لشاعر مجنون
ayahs.translation: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
ayahs.transliteration: waya-qoo-loo-na ain-naa la-taa-ri-kooo aa-li-ha-ti-naa li-shaai-rim maj-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ جَآءَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: بل جاء بالحق وصدق المرسلين
ayahs.translation: Rather, he [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
ayahs.transliteration: bal jaaaa bi-lhaq-qi wa-sad-da-qal mur-saleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمۡ لَذَآئِقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡأَلِيمِ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: انكم لذائقوا العذاب الاليم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-kum la-zaaai-qul a-zaa-bil aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: وما تجزون الا ما كنتم تعملون
ayahs.translation: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa tuj-zaw-na il-laa maa kun-tum ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: الا عباد الله المخلصين
ayahs.translation: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa i-baa-dal laa-hil muk-hla-seen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ رِزۡقٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك لهم رزق معلوم
ayahs.translation: Those will have a provision determined -
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-ka la-hum riz-qum ma-loom

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَوَٰكِهُ وَهُم مُّكۡرَمُونَ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: فوكه وهم مكرمون
ayahs.translation: Fruits; and they will be honored
ayahs.transliteration: fa-waa-ki-hu wa-hum muk-ra-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: في جنت النعيم
ayahs.translation: In gardens of pleasure
ayahs.transliteration: fee jan-naa-tin naeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: علي سرر متقبلين
ayahs.translation: On thrones facing one another.
ayahs.transliteration: a-laa su-ru-rim mu-ta-qaa-bileen

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِكَأۡسٖ مِّن مَّعِينِۭ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: يطاف عليهم بكاس من معين
ayahs.translation: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
ayahs.transliteration: yu-taa-fu a-lai-him bi-kaa-sim mim maeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَيۡضَآءَ لَذَّةٖ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: بيضاء لذة للشربين
ayahs.translation: White and delicious to the drinkers;
ayahs.transliteration: bai-daaaa laz-za-til lis-hshaa-ribeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَا فِيهَا غَوۡلٞ وَلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنزَفُونَ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: لا فيها غول ولا هم عنها ينزفون
ayahs.translation: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
ayahs.transliteration: laa fee-haa ghaw-lunw wa-laa hum a-nhaa yun-za-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَعِندَهُمۡ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ عِينٞ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: وعندهم قصرت الطرف عين
ayahs.translation: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
ayahs.transliteration: wain-da-hum qaa-si-raa-tut tar-fi een

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيۡضٞ مَّكۡنُونٞ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: كانهن بيض مكنون
ayahs.translation: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
ayahs.transliteration: kaan-na-hun-na bai-dum mak-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: فاقبل بعضهم علي بعض يتساءلون
ayahs.translation: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
ayahs.transliteration: faaq-ba-la ba-du-hum a-laa ba-di-ny ya-ta-saaaa-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ قَآئِلٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينٞ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: قال قائل منهم اني كان لي قرين
ayahs.translation: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la qaaai-lum mi-nhum in-nee kaa-na lee qareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصَدِّقِينَ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: يقول اءنك لمن المصدقين
ayahs.translation: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
ayahs.transliteration: ya-qoo-lu ain-na-ka la-mi-nal mu-sad-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: اءذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظما اءنا لمدينون
ayahs.translation: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
ayahs.transliteration: ai-zaa mit-naa wa-kun-naa tu-raa-banw wai-zaa-man ain-naa la-ma-dee-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلۡ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: قال هل انتم مطلعون
ayahs.translation: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la hal an-tum mut-ta-lioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِي سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: فاطلع فرءاه في سواء الجحيم
ayahs.translation: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
ayahs.transliteration: fat-ta-laa fa-raaa-hu fee sa-waaail jaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرۡدِينِ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: قال تالله ان كدت لتردين
ayahs.translation: He will say, "By Allāh, you almost ruined me.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la tal-laa-hi in kit-ta la-tur-deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡلَا نِعۡمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡضَرِينَ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولولا نعمة ربي لكنت من المحضرين
ayahs.translation: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law-laa ni-ma-tu rab-bee la-kun-tu mi-nal muh-dareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: افما نحن بميتين
ayahs.translation: Then, are we not to die
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-maa nah-nu bi-maiyiteen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَوۡتَتَنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: الا موتتنا الاولي وما نحن بمعذبين
ayahs.translation: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
ayahs.transliteration: il-la maw-ta-ta-nal oo-la wa-maa nah-nu bi-mu-a-zza-been

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: ان هذا لهو الفوز العظيم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na haa-zaa la-hu-wal faw-zul azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِمِثۡلِ هَٰذَا فَلۡيَعۡمَلِ ٱلۡعَٰمِلُونَ ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: لمثل هذا فليعمل العملون
ayahs.translation: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
ayahs.transliteration: li-mis-li haa-za fa-lya-ma li-laa-mi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ نُّزُلًا أَمۡ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: اذلك خير نزلا ام شجرة الزقوم
ayahs.translation: Is that [i.e., Paradise] a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?
ayahs.transliteration: a-zaa-li-ka khai-run nu-zu-lan am sha-ja-ra-tuz zaq-qoom

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰهَا فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلظَّٰلِمِينَ ٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: انا جعلنها فتنة للظلمين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa jaal-naa-haa fit-na-tal liz-zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٞ تَخۡرُجُ فِيٓ أَصۡلِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ ٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: انها شجرة تخرج في اصل الجحيم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-haa sha-ja-ra-tun tak-hru-ju feee as-lil jaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: طَلۡعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ ٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: طلعها كانه رءوس الشيطين
ayahs.translation: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
ayahs.transliteration: ta-lu-haa kaan-na-hoo ruoo-sush shayaateen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَأٓكِلُونَ مِنۡهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ ٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: فانهم لاكلون منها فمالون منها البطون
ayahs.translation: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
ayahs.transliteration: fain-na-hum laaa-ki-loo-na mi-nhaa fa-maa-lioo-na mi-nhal bu-toon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا لَشَوۡبٗا مِّنۡ حَمِيمٖ ٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: ثم ان لهم عليها لشوبا من حميم
ayahs.translation: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma in-na la-hum a-lai-haa la-shaw-bam min hameem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرۡجِعَهُمۡ لَإِلَى ٱلۡجَحِيمِ ٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: ثم ان مرجعهم لالي الجحيم
ayahs.translation: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma in-na mar-ji-a-hum lai-lal jaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمۡ أَلۡفَوۡاْ ءَابَآءَهُمۡ ضَآلِّينَ ٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: انهم الفوا ءاباءهم ضالين
ayahs.translation: Indeed they found their fathers astray.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hum al-faw aa-baaaa-hum daaal-leen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَهُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمۡ يُهۡرَعُونَ ٧٠
ayahs.text_simple: فهم علي ءاثرهم يهرعون
ayahs.translation: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-hum a-laa aa-saa-ri-him yuh-raoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ ضَلَّ قَبۡلَهُمۡ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ٧١
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ضل قبلهم اكثر الاولين
ayahs.translation: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad dal-la qab-la-hum ak-sa-rul aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ ٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ارسلنا فيهم منذرين
ayahs.translation: And We had already sent among them warners.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad ar-sal-naa fee-him mun-zireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ ٧٣
ayahs.text_simple: فانظر كيف كان عقبة المنذرين
ayahs.translation: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
ayahs.transliteration: fan-zur kai-fa kaa-na aa-qi-ba-tul mun-zareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ ٧٤
ayahs.text_simple: الا عباد الله المخلصين
ayahs.translation: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa i-baa-dal laa-hil muk-hla-seen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٞ فَلَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمُجِيبُونَ ٧٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد نادينا نوح فلنعم المجيبون
ayahs.translation: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad naa-daa-naa noo-hun fa-la-ni-mal mujee-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ ٧٦
ayahs.text_simple: ونجينه واهله من الكرب العظيم
ayahs.translation: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-naj-jai-naa-hu waah-la-hoo mi-nal kar-bil azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلۡبَاقِينَ ٧٧
ayahs.text_simple: وجعلنا ذريته هم الباقين
ayahs.translation: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaal-naa zur-riyya-ta-hoo hum-mul baaqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ ٧٨
ayahs.text_simple: وتركنا عليه في الاخرين
ayahs.translation: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-rak-naa a-lai-hi fil aa-khireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٖ فِي ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٧٩
ayahs.text_simple: سلم علي نوح في العلمين
ayahs.translation: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
ayahs.transliteration: sa-laa-mun a-laa noo-hin fil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ٨٠
ayahs.text_simple: انا كذلك نجزي المحسنين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa ka-zaa-li-ka naj-zil muh-sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٨١
ayahs.text_simple: انه من عبادنا المؤمنين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hoo min i-baa-di-nal mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ ٨٢
ayahs.text_simple: ثم اغرقنا الاخرين
ayahs.translation: Then We drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma ag-hraq-nal aa-khareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٨٣
ayahs.text_simple: وان من شيعته لابرهيم
ayahs.translation: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na min sheea-tihee laib-raaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلۡبٖ سَلِيمٍ ٨٤
ayahs.text_simple: اذ جاء ربه بقلب سليم
ayahs.translation: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
ayahs.transliteration: iz jaaaa rab-ba-hoo bi-qal-bin saleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعۡبُدُونَ ٨٥
ayahs.text_simple: اذ قال لابيه وقومه ماذا تعبدون
ayahs.translation: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
ayahs.transliteration: iz qaa-la li-a-bee-hi wa-qaw-mihee maa-zaa ta-bu-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَئِفۡكًا ءَالِهَةٗ دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ ٨٦
ayahs.text_simple: ائفكا ءالهة دون الله تريدون
ayahs.translation: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allāh you desire?
ayahs.transliteration: aif-kan aa-li-ha-tan doo-nal laa-hi turee-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٨٧
ayahs.text_simple: فما ظنكم برب العلمين
ayahs.translation: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
ayahs.transliteration: fa-maa zan-nu-kum bi-rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَنَظَرَ نَظۡرَةٗ فِي ٱلنُّجُومِ ٨٨
ayahs.text_simple: فنظر نظرة في النجوم
ayahs.translation: And he cast a look at the stars
ayahs.transliteration: fa-na-za-ra naz-ra-tan fin nu-joom

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقِيمٞ ٨٩
ayahs.text_simple: فقال اني سقيم
ayahs.translation: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qaa-la in-nee saqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ مُدۡبِرِينَ ٩٠
ayahs.text_simple: فتولوا عنه مدبرين
ayahs.translation: So they turned away from him, departing.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ta-wal-law a-nhu mud-bireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمۡ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ ٩١
ayahs.text_simple: فراغ الي ءالهتهم فقال الا تاكلون
ayahs.translation: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-raa-gha i-laaa aa-li-ha-ti-him fa-qaa-la a-laa taa-ku-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَنطِقُونَ ٩٢
ayahs.text_simple: ما لكم لا تنطقون
ayahs.translation: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"
ayahs.transliteration: maa la-kum laa tan-ti-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضَرۡبَۢا بِٱلۡيَمِينِ ٩٣
ayahs.text_simple: فراغ عليهم ضربا باليمين
ayahs.translation: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-raa-gha a-lai-him dar-bam bi-lyameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَقۡبَلُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ يَزِفُّونَ ٩٤
ayahs.text_simple: فاقبلوا اليه يزفون
ayahs.translation: Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.
ayahs.transliteration: faaq-ba-looo i-lai-hi ya-zif-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَتَعۡبُدُونَ مَا تَنۡحِتُونَ ٩٥
ayahs.text_simple: قال اتعبدون ما تنحتون
ayahs.translation: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la a-ta-bu-doo-na maa ta-nhi-toon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ ٩٦
ayahs.text_simple: والله خلقكم وما تعملون
ayahs.translation: While Allāh created you and that which you do?"
ayahs.transliteration: wal-laa-hu kha-la-qa-kum wa-maa ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ ٱبۡنُواْ لَهُۥ بُنۡيَٰنٗا فَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي ٱلۡجَحِيمِ ٩٧
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا ابنوا له بنينا فالقوه في الجحيم
ayahs.translation: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-lu bnoo la-hoo bu-nyaa-nan faal-qoo-hu fil jaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدٗا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِينَ ٩٨
ayahs.text_simple: فارادوا به كيدا فجعلنهم الاسفلين
ayahs.translation: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-raa-doo bihee kai-dan fa-jaal-naa-hu-mul as-faleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ ٩٩
ayahs.text_simple: وقال اني ذاهب الي ربي سيهدين
ayahs.translation: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-la in-nee zaa-hi-bun i-laa rab-bee sayah-deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ ١٠٠
ayahs.text_simple: رب هب لي من الصلحين
ayahs.translation: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
ayahs.transliteration: rab-bi hab lee mi-nas saa-liheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ حَلِيمٖ ١٠١
ayahs.text_simple: فبشرنه بغلم حليم
ayahs.translation: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bas-hshar-naa-hu bi-ghu-laa-min haleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعۡيَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡمَنَامِ أَنِّيٓ أَذۡبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا تَرَىٰۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفۡعَلۡ مَا تُؤۡمَرُۖ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ ١٠٢
ayahs.text_simple: فلما بلغ معه السعي قال يبني اني اري في المنام اني اذبحك فانظر ماذا تري قال يابت افعل ما تؤمر ستجدني ان شاء الله من الصبرين
ayahs.translation: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-ma ba-la-gha maa-hus saya qaa-la yaa-bu-niya in-neee a-raa fil ma-naa-mi an-neee az-ba-hu-ka fan-zur maa-zaa ta-raa qaa-la yaaaa-ba-tif al maa tu-ma-ru sa-ta-ji-dunee in shaaa al-laa-hu mi-nas saa-bireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَسۡلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلۡجَبِينِ ١٠٣
ayahs.text_simple: فلما اسلما وتله للجبين
ayahs.translation: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maaa as-la-maa wa-tal-la-hoo lil-jabeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَٰدَيۡنَٰهُ أَن يَٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُ ١٠٤
ayahs.text_simple: وندينه ان يابرهيم
ayahs.translation: We called to him, "O Abraham,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-naa-dai-naa-hu ai yaaaaib-raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَدۡ صَدَّقۡتَ ٱلرُّءۡيَآۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ١٠٥
ayahs.text_simple: قد صدقت الرءيا انا كذلك نجزي المحسنين
ayahs.translation: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.transliteration: qad sad-daq-tar ruyaa in-naa ka-zaa-li-ka naj-zil muh-sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡبَلَٰٓؤُاْ ٱلۡمُبِينُ ١٠٦
ayahs.text_simple: ان هذا لهو البلؤا المبين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, this was the clear trial.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na haa-zaa la-hu-wal ba-laaaul mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفَدَيۡنَٰهُ بِذِبۡحٍ عَظِيمٖ ١٠٧
ayahs.text_simple: وفدينه بذبح عظيم
ayahs.translation: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-fa-dai-naa-hu bi-zi-bhin azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ ١٠٨
ayahs.text_simple: وتركنا عليه في الاخرين
ayahs.translation: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-rak-naa a-lai-hi fil aa-khireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ١٠٩
ayahs.text_simple: سلم علي ابرهيم
ayahs.translation: "Peace upon Abraham."
ayahs.transliteration: sa-laa-mun a-laaa ib-raaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ١١٠
ayahs.text_simple: كذلك نجزي المحسنين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.transliteration: ka-zaa-li-ka naj-zil muh-sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ١١١
ayahs.text_simple: انه من عبادنا المؤمنين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hoo min i-baa-di-nal mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِإِسۡحَٰقَ نَبِيّٗا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ ١١٢
ayahs.text_simple: وبشرنه باسحق نبيا من الصلحين
ayahs.translation: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-bas-hshar-naa-hu bii-shaa-qa na-biyam mi-nas saa-liheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَبَٰرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسۡحَٰقَۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحۡسِنٞ وَظَالِمٞ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ مُبِينٞ ١١٣
ayahs.text_simple: وبركنا عليه وعلي اسحق ومن ذريتهما محسن وظالم لنفسه مبين
ayahs.translation: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself [i.e., sinner].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-baa-rak-naa a-lai-hi waa-laaa i-shaaq wa-min zur-riyya-ti-hi-maa muh-si-nunw wa-zaa-li-mul li-naf-sihee mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ ١١٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد مننا علي موسي وهرون
ayahs.translation: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad ma-nan-na a-laa moo-saa wa-haa-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُمَا وَقَوۡمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ ١١٥
ayahs.text_simple: ونجينهما وقومهما من الكرب العظيم
ayahs.translation: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-naj-jai-naa-hu-maa wa-qaw-ma-hu-maa mi-nal kar-bil azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَصَرۡنَٰهُمۡ فَكَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ ١١٦
ayahs.text_simple: ونصرنهم فكانوا هم الغلبين
ayahs.translation: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-na-sar-naa-hum fa-kaa-noo hu-mul ghaa-libeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَبِينَ ١١٧
ayahs.text_simple: وءاتينهما الكتب المستبين
ayahs.translation: And We gave them the explicit Scripture [i.e., the Torah],
ayahs.transliteration: waaa-tai-naa-hu-mal ki-taa-bal mus-tabeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمَ ١١٨
ayahs.text_simple: وهدينهما الصرط المستقيم
ayahs.translation: And We guided them on the straight path.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ha-dai-naa-hu-mus si-raa-tal mus-taqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ ١١٩
ayahs.text_simple: وتركنا عليهما في الاخرين
ayahs.translation: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-rak-naa a-lai-hi-maa fil aa-khireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ ١٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: سلم علي موسي وهرون
ayahs.translation: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."
ayahs.transliteration: sa-laa-mun a-laa moo-saa wa-haa-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ١٢١
ayahs.text_simple: انا كذلك نجزي المحسنين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa ka-zaa-li-ka naj-zil muh-sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمَا مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ١٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: انهما من عبادنا المؤمنين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hu-maa min i-baa-di-nal mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ إِلۡيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ ١٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: وان الياس لمن المرسلين
ayahs.translation: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na i-lyaa-sa la-mi-nal mur-saleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ ١٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: اذ قال لقومه الا تتقون
ayahs.translation: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allāh?
ayahs.transliteration: iz qaa-la li-qaw-miheee a-laa tat-ta-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَتَدۡعُونَ بَعۡلٗا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡخَٰلِقِينَ ١٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: اتدعون بعلا وتذرون احسن الخلقين
ayahs.translation: Do you call upon Baʿl and leave the best of creators -
ayahs.transliteration: a-ta-doo-na ba-lanw wa-ta-za-roo-na ah-sa-nal khaa-liqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمۡ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ١٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: الله ربكم ورب ءابائكم الاولين
ayahs.translation: Allāh, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
ayahs.transliteration: al-laa-ha rab-ba-kum wa-rab-ba aa-baaai-ku-mul aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ ١٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: فكذبوه فانهم لمحضرون
ayahs.translation: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kaz-za-boo-hu fain-na-hum la-muh-da-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ ١٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: الا عباد الله المخلصين
ayahs.translation: Except the chosen servants of Allāh.
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa i-baa-dal laa-hil muk-hla-seen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ ١٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: وتركنا عليه في الاخرين
ayahs.translation: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-rak-naa a-lai-hi fil aa-khireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلۡ يَاسِينَ ١٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: سلم علي ال ياسين
ayahs.translation: "Peace upon Elias."
ayahs.transliteration: sa-laa-mun a-laaa i-lyaaseen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ١٣١
ayahs.text_simple: انا كذلك نجزي المحسنين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa ka-zaa-li-ka naj-zil muh-sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ١٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: انه من عبادنا المؤمنين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hoo min i-baa-di-nal mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لُوطٗا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ ١٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: وان لوطا لمن المرسلين
ayahs.translation: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na loo-tal la-mi-nal mur-saleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ نَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ ١٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: اذ نجينه واهله اجمعين
ayahs.translation: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
ayahs.transliteration: iz naj-jai-naa-hu waah-la-hooo aj-maeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَجُوزٗا فِي ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ ١٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: الا عجوزا في الغبرين
ayahs.translation: Except an old woman [i.e., his wife] among those who remained [with the evildoers].
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa a-joo-zan fil ghaa-bireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَمَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ ١٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: ثم دمرنا الاخرين
ayahs.translation: Then We destroyed the others.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma dam-mar-nal aa-khareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكُمۡ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيۡهِم مُّصۡبِحِينَ ١٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: وانكم لتمرون عليهم مصبحين
ayahs.translation: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na-kum la-ta-mur-roo-na a-lai-him mus-biheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَبِٱلَّيۡلِۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ ١٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: وباليل افلا تعقلون
ayahs.translation: And at night. Then will you not use reason?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-bil-lail a-fa-laa ta-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ ١٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: وان يونس لمن المرسلين
ayahs.translation: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na yoo-nu-sa la-mi-nal mur-saleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ ١٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: اذ ابق الي الفلك المشحون
ayahs.translation: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
ayahs.transliteration: iz a-ba-qa i-lal ful-kil mas-hhoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُدۡحَضِينَ ١٤١
ayahs.text_simple: فساهم فكان من المدحضين
ayahs.translation: And he drew lots and was among the losers.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-saa-ha-ma fa-kaa-na mi-nal mu-dhadeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱلۡتَقَمَهُ ٱلۡحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٞ ١٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: فالتقمه الحوت وهو مليم
ayahs.translation: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
ayahs.transliteration: fal-ta-qa-ma-hul hoo-tu wa-hu-wa muleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَوۡلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسَبِّحِينَ ١٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: فلولا انه كان من المسبحين
ayahs.translation: And had he not been of those who exalt Allāh,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-law-laaa an-na-hoo kaa-na mi-nal mu-sab-biheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطۡنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ ١٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: للبث في بطنه الي يوم يبعثون
ayahs.translation: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
ayahs.transliteration: la-la-bi-sa fee bat-niheee i-laa yaw-mi yu-ba-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٞ ١٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: فنبذنه بالعراء وهو سقيم
ayahs.translation: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-na-baz-naa-hu bi-la-raaai wa-hu-wa saqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ شَجَرَةٗ مِّن يَقۡطِينٖ ١٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: وانبتنا عليه شجرة من يقطين
ayahs.translation: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.
ayahs.transliteration: waam-bat-naa a-lai-hi sha-ja-ra-tam mai yaq-teen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِاْئَةِ أَلۡفٍ أَوۡ يَزِيدُونَ ١٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: وارسلنه الي مائة الف او يزيدون
ayahs.translation: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
ayahs.transliteration: waar-sal-naa-hu i-laa mi-a-ti al-fin aw ya-zee-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَـَٔامَنُواْ فَمَتَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ ١٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: فامنوا فمتعنهم الي حين
ayahs.translation: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
ayahs.transliteration: faaa-ma-noo fa-mat-ta-naa-hum i-laa heen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ ١٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: فاستفتهم الربك البنات ولهم البنون
ayahs.translation: So inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?
ayahs.transliteration: fas-taf-ti-him a-li-rab-bi-kal ba-naa-tu wa-la-hu-mul ba-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثٗا وَهُمۡ شَٰهِدُونَ ١٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: ام خلقنا الملئكة انثا وهم شهدون
ayahs.translation: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
ayahs.transliteration: am kha-laq-nal ma-laaai-ka-ta i-naa-sanw wa-hum shaa-hi-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنۡ إِفۡكِهِمۡ لَيَقُولُونَ ١٥١
ayahs.text_simple: الا انهم من افكهم ليقولون
ayahs.translation: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
ayahs.transliteration: a-laaa in-na-hum min if-ki-him laya-qoo-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ ١٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: ولد الله وانهم لكذبون
ayahs.translation: "Allāh has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-dal laa-hu wain-na-hum la-kaa-zi-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَصۡطَفَى ٱلۡبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلۡبَنِينَ ١٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: اصطفي البنات علي البنين
ayahs.translation: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
ayahs.transliteration: as-ta-fal ba-naa-ti a-lal baneen

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ تَحۡكُمُونَ ١٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: ما لكم كيف تحكمون
ayahs.translation: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
ayahs.transliteration: maa la-kum kai-fa tah-ku-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ ١٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: افلا تذكرون
ayahs.translation: Then will you not be reminded?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-laa ta-zak-ka-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٞ مُّبِينٞ ١٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: ام لكم سلطن مبين
ayahs.translation: Or do you have a clear authority?
ayahs.transliteration: am la-kum sul-taa-num mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأۡتُواْ بِكِتَٰبِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ ١٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: فاتوا بكتبكم ان كنتم صدقين
ayahs.translation: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-too bi-ki-taa-bi-kum in kun-tum saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُواْ بَيۡنَهُۥ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ نَسَبٗاۚ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمَتِ ٱلۡجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ ١٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: وجعلوا بينه وبين الجنة نسبا ولقد علمت الجنة انهم لمحضرون
ayahs.translation: And they have made [i.e., claimed] between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought [to punishment].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaa-loo bai-na-hoo wa-bai-nal jin-na-ti na-sa-baa wa-la-qad a-li-ma-til jin-na-tu in-na-hum la-muh-da-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ ١٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: سبحن الله عما يصفون
ayahs.translation: Exalted is Allāh above what they describe,
ayahs.transliteration: su-bhaa-nal laa-hi am-maa ya-si-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ ١٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: الا عباد الله المخلصين
ayahs.translation: Except the chosen servants of Allāh [who do not share in that sin].
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa i-baa-dal laa-hil muk-hla-seen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ ١٦١
ayahs.text_simple: فانكم وما تعبدون
ayahs.translation: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
ayahs.transliteration: fain-na-kum wa-maa ta-bu-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ بِفَٰتِنِينَ ١٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: ما انتم عليه بفتنين
ayahs.translation: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
ayahs.transliteration: maaa an-tum a-lai-hi bi-faaa-tineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنۡ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ ١٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: الا من هو صال الجحيم
ayahs.translation: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa man hu-wa saa-lil jaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ ١٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: وما منا الا له مقام معلوم
ayahs.translation: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa min-naaa il-laa la-hoo ma-qaa-mun ma-loom

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ ١٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: وانا لنحن الصافون
ayahs.translation: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
ayahs.transliteration: wain-naa la-nah-nus saaf-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُسَبِّحُونَ ١٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: وانا لنحن المسبحون
ayahs.translation: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allāh."
ayahs.transliteration: wain-naa la-nah-nul mu-sab-bi-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِن كَانُواْ لَيَقُولُونَ ١٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: وان كانوا ليقولون
ayahs.translation: And indeed, they [i.e., the disbelievers] used to say,
ayahs.transliteration: wain kaa-noo laya-qoo-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَوۡ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكۡرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ١٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: لو ان عندنا ذكرا من الاولين
ayahs.translation: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
ayahs.transliteration: law an-na in-da-naa zik-ram mi-nal aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ ١٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: لكنا عباد الله المخلصين
ayahs.translation: We would have been the chosen servants of Allāh."
ayahs.transliteration: la-kun-na i-baa-dal laa-hil muk-hla-seen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكَفَرُواْ بِهِۦۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ ١٧٠
ayahs.text_simple: فكفروا به فسوف يعلمون
ayahs.translation: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ka-fa-roo bihee fa-saw-fa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ سَبَقَتۡ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ ١٧١
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد سبقت كلمتنا لعبادنا المرسلين
ayahs.translation: And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad sa-ba-qat ka-li-ma-tu-naa lii-baa-di-nal mur-saleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمۡ لَهُمُ ٱلۡمَنصُورُونَ ١٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: انهم لهم المنصورون
ayahs.translation: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa-hum la-hu-mul man-soo-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ ١٧٣
ayahs.text_simple: وان جندنا لهم الغلبون
ayahs.translation: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers [i.e., the believers] will be those who overcome.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na jun-da-na la-hu-mul ghaa-li-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ ١٧٤
ayahs.text_simple: فتول عنهم حتي حين
ayahs.translation: So, [O Muḥammad], leave them for a time.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ta-wal-la a-nhum hat-ta heen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَبۡصِرۡهُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يُبۡصِرُونَ ١٧٥
ayahs.text_simple: وابصرهم فسوف يبصرون
ayahs.translation: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
ayahs.transliteration: waab-si-rhum fa-saw-fa yub-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ ١٧٦
ayahs.text_simple: افبعذابنا يستعجلون
ayahs.translation: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-bi-a-zaa-bi-naa yas-ta-ji-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمۡ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ ١٧٧
ayahs.text_simple: فاذا نزل بساحتهم فساء صباح المنذرين
ayahs.translation: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
ayahs.transliteration: fai-zaa na-za-la bi-saa-ha-ti-him fa-saaaa sa-baa-hul mun-zareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ ١٧٨
ayahs.text_simple: وتول عنهم حتي حين
ayahs.translation: And leave them for a time.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-wal-la a-nhum hat-taa heen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَبۡصِرۡ فَسَوۡفَ يُبۡصِرُونَ ١٧٩
ayahs.text_simple: وابصر فسوف يبصرون
ayahs.translation: And see, for they are going to see.
ayahs.transliteration: waab-sir fa-saw-fa yub-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلۡعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ ١٨٠
ayahs.text_simple: سبحن ربك رب العزة عما يصفون
ayahs.translation: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
ayahs.transliteration: su-bhaa-na rab-bi-ka rab-bil iz-za-ti am-ma ya-si-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ ١٨١
ayahs.text_simple: وسلم علي المرسلين
ayahs.translation: And peace upon the messengers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-sa-laa-mun a-lal mur-saleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ١٨٢
ayahs.text_simple: والحمد لله رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lham-du lil-laa-hi rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: صٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ذِي ٱلذِّكۡرِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: ص والقرءان ذي الذكر
ayahs.translation: Ṣād. By the Qur’ān containing reminder...
ayahs.transliteration: saaad wal-qu-raa-ni ziz zikr

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي عِزَّةٖ وَشِقَاقٖ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: بل الذين كفروا في عزة وشقاق
ayahs.translation: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
ayahs.transliteration: ba-lil lazee-na ka-fa-roo fee iz-za-tinw wa-shi-qaaq

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن قَرۡنٖ فَنَادَواْ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٖ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: كم اهلكنا من قبلهم من قرن فنادوا ولات حين مناص
ayahs.translation: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
ayahs.transliteration: kam ah-lak-naa min qab-li-him min qar-nin fa-naa-daw wa-laa-ta hee-na ma-naas

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَعَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡۖ وَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٞ كَذَّابٌ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: وعجبوا ان جاءهم منذر منهم وقال الكفرون هذا سحر كذاب
ayahs.translation: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
ayahs.transliteration: waa-ji-booo an jaaaa-hum mun-zi-rum mi-nhum wa-qaa-lal kaa-fi-roo-na haa-zaa saa-hi-run kaz-zaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَجَعَلَ ٱلۡأٓلِهَةَ إِلَٰهٗا وَٰحِدًاۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عُجَابٞ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: اجعل الالهة الها وحدا ان هذا لشيء عجاب
ayahs.translation: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
ayahs.transliteration: a-jaa-lal aa-li-ha-ta i-laa-hanw waa-hi-dan in-na haa-zaa la-shaiun u-jaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱمۡشُواْ وَٱصۡبِرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمۡۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٞ يُرَادُ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: وانطلق الملا منهم ان امشوا واصبروا علي ءالهتكم ان هذا لشيء يراد
ayahs.translation: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.
ayahs.transliteration: wan-ta-la-qal ma-lau mi-nhum a-nim shoo was-bi-roo a-laaa aa-li-ha-ti-kum in-nna haa-zaa la-shaiu-ny yu-raad

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي ٱلۡمِلَّةِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخۡتِلَٰقٌ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ما سمعنا بهذا في الملة الاخرة ان هذا الا اختلق
ayahs.translation: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
ayahs.transliteration: maa sa-mi-naa bi-haa-zaa fil mil-la-til aa-khi-ra-ti in haa-zaaa il-lakh ti-laaq

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ مِّن ذِكۡرِيۚ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: اءنزل عليه الذكر من بيننا بل هم في شك من ذكري بل لما يذوقوا عذاب
ayahs.translation: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: aun-zi-la a-lai-hiz zik-ru min bai-ni-naa bal hum fee shak-kin min zik-ree bal lam-maa ya-zoo-qoo a-zaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡوَهَّابِ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: ام عندهم خزائن رحمة ربك العزيز الوهاب
ayahs.translation: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
ayahs.transliteration: am in-da-hum kha-zaaai-nu rah-ma-ti rab-bi-kal azee-zil wa-hhab

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ لَهُم مُّلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَلۡيَرۡتَقُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبِ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: ام لهم ملك السموت والارض وما بينهما فليرتقوا في الاسبب
ayahs.translation: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
ayahs.transliteration: am la-hum mul-kus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di wa-maa bai-na-hu-maa fa-lyar-ta-qoo fil as-baab

ayahs.text_uthmani: جُندٞ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُومٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: جند ما هنالك مهزوم من الاحزاب
ayahs.translation: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
ayahs.transliteration: jun-dum maa hu-naa-li-ka mah-zoo-mum mi-nal ah-zaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَعَادٞ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ ذُو ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وعاد وفرعون ذو الاوتاد
ayahs.translation: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] ʿAad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
ayahs.transliteration: kaz-za-bat qab-la-hum qaw-mu noo-hinw waaa-dunw wa-fi-raw-nu zul aw-taad

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوۡمُ لُوطٖ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: وثمود وقوم لوط واصحب ليكة اولئك الاحزاب
ayahs.translation: And [the tribe of] Thamūd and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket [i.e., people of Madyan]. Those are the companies.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-sa-moo-du wa-qaw-mu loo-tinw waa-shaa-bul ay-kah u-laaai-kal ah-zaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان كل الا كذب الرسل فحق عقاب
ayahs.translation: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
ayahs.transliteration: in kul-lun il-laa kaz-za-bar ru-su-la fa-haq-qa i-qaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٖ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: وما ينظر هؤلاء الا صيحة وحدة ما لها من فواق
ayahs.translation: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa yan-zu-ru haaau-laaai il-laa sai-ha-tanw waa-hi-da-tam maa la-haa min fa-waaq

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا ربنا عجل لنا قطنا قبل يوم الحساب
ayahs.translation: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-loo rab-ba-naa aj-jil la-naa qit-ta-naa qab-la yaw-mil hi-saab

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلۡأَيۡدِۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: اصبر علي ما يقولون واذكر عبدنا داود ذا الايد انه اواب
ayahs.translation: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: is-bir a-laa maa ya-qoo-loo-na waz-kur ab-da-naa daa-woo-da zal ai-di in-na-hooo aw-waab

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا ٱلۡجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِشۡرَاقِ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: انا سخرنا الجبال معه يسبحن بالعشي والاشراق
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa sak-hkhar-nal ji-baa-la maa-hoo yu-sab-bih-na bi-la-shiyyi wa-lis-hraaq

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلطَّيۡرَ مَحۡشُورَةٗۖ كُلّٞ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٞ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: والطير محشورة كل له اواب
ayahs.translation: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
ayahs.transliteration: wat-tay-ra mah-shoo-rah kul-lul la-hooo aw-waab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَشَدَدۡنَا مُلۡكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَفَصۡلَ ٱلۡخِطَابِ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: وشددنا ملكه وءاتينه الحكمة وفصل الخطاب
ayahs.translation: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-sha-dad-naa mul-ka-hoo waaa-tai-naa-hul hik-ma-ta wa-fas-lal khi-taab

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَصۡمِ إِذۡ تَسَوَّرُواْ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابَ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: وهل اتيك نبؤا الخصم اذ تسوروا المحراب
ayahs.translation: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hal a-taa-ka na-baul khasm iz ta-saw-wa-rul mih-raab

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنۡهُمۡۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ خَصۡمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعۡضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تُشۡطِطۡ وَٱهۡدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: اذ دخلوا علي داود ففزع منهم قالوا لا تخف خصمان بغي بعضنا علي بعض فاحكم بيننا بالحق ولا تشطط واهدنا الي سواء الصرط
ayahs.translation: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
ayahs.transliteration: iz da-kha-loo a-laa daa-woo-da fa-fa-zi-a mi-nhum qaa-loo laa ta-khaf khas-maa-ni ba-ghaa ba-du-naa a-laa ba-din fah-kum bai-na-naaa bi-lhaq-qi wa-laa tus-htit wah-di-naaa i-laa sa-waaais si-raat

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِي لَهُۥ تِسۡعٞ وَتِسۡعُونَ نَعۡجَةٗ وَلِيَ نَعۡجَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ فَقَالَ أَكۡفِلۡنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي ٱلۡخِطَابِ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: ان هذا اخي له تسع وتسعون نعجة ولي نعجة وحدة فقال اكفلنيها وعزني في الخطاب
ayahs.translation: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
ayahs.transliteration: in-na haa-zaaa a-khee la-hoo ti-sunw wa-ti-soo-na na-ja-tanw wa-liya na-ja-tunw waa-hi-dah fa-qaa-la ak-fil-nee-ha waaz-zanee fil khi-taab

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَقَدۡ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعۡجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبۡغِي بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٞ مَّا هُمۡۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسۡتَغۡفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّۤ رَاكِعٗاۤ وَأَنَابَ۩ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: قال لقد ظلمك بسؤال نعجتك الي نعاجه وان كثيرا من الخلطاء ليبغي بعضهم علي بعض الا الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت وقليل ما هم وظن داود انما فتنه فاستغفر ربه وخر راكعا واناب
ayahs.translation: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la la-qad za-la-ma-ka bi-su-a-a-li na-ja-ti-ka i-laa ni-a-a-jih wain-na kasee-ran mi-nal khu-la-taaai layab-ghee ba-du-hum a-laa ba-din il-lal lazee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti wa-qa-lee-lun maa hum wa-zan-na daa-woo-du an-na-maa fa-tan-naa-hu fas-tag-hfa-ra rab-ba-hoo wa-khar-ra raa-ki-anw waa-naab

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَغَفَرۡنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: فغفرنا له ذلك وان له عندنا لزلفي وحسن ماب
ayahs.translation: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-gha-far-naa la-hoo zaa-lik wain-na la-hoo in-da-naa la-zul-faa wa-hus-na maaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةٗ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدُۢ بِمَا نَسُواْ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحِسَابِ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: يداود انا جعلنك خليفة في الارض فاحكم بين الناس بالحق ولا تتبع الهوي فيضلك عن سبيل الله ان الذين يضلون عن سبيل الله لهم عذاب شديد بما نسوا يوم الحساب
ayahs.translation: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allāh." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allāh will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
ayahs.transliteration: yaa-daa-woo-du in-naa jaal-naa-ka khalee-fa-tan fil ar-di fah-kum bai-nan naa-si bi-lhaq-qi wa-laa tat-ta-biil ha-waa fayu-dil-la-ka an sabee-lil laah in-nal lazee-na ya-dil-loo-na an sabee-lil laah la-hum a-zaa-bun shadee-dum bi-maa na-soo yaw-mal hi-saab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا بَٰطِلٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: وما خلقنا السماء والارض وما بينهما بطلا ذلك ظن الذين كفروا فويل للذين كفروا من النار
ayahs.translation: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa kha-laq-nas sa-maaaa wa-lar-da wa-maa bai-na-hu-maa baa-ti-laa zaa-li-ka zan-nul lazee-na ka-fa-roo fa-way-lul lil-la-zee-na ka-fa-roo mi-nan naar

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلۡفُجَّارِ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: ام نجعل الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت كالمفسدين في الارض ام نجعل المتقين كالفجار
ayahs.translation: Or should We treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allāh like the wicked?
ayahs.transliteration: am na-ja-lul lazee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti kal-mu-fis-dee-na fil ar-di am na-ja-lul mut-ta-qee-na kal-fuj-jaar

ayahs.text_uthmani: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡكَ مُبَٰرَكٞ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: كتب انزلنه اليك مبرك ليدبروا ءايته وليتذكر اولوا الالبب
ayahs.translation: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
ayahs.transliteration: ki-taa-bun an-zal-naa-hu i-lai-ka mu-baa-ra-kul liyad-dab-ba-rooo aayaa-tihee wa-liya-ta-zak-ka-ra u-lul al-baab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَوَهَبۡنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَۚ نِعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: ووهبنا لداود سليمن نعم العبد انه اواب
ayahs.translation: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-wa-hab-naa li-daa-woo-da su-lai-maan ni-mal abd in-na-hoo aw-waab

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ عُرِضَ عَلَيۡهِ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلۡجِيَادُ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: اذ عرض عليه بالعشي الصفنت الجياد
ayahs.translation: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
ayahs.transliteration: iz u-ri-da a-lai-hi bi-la-shiyyis saa-fi-naa-tul jiyaad

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَحۡبَبۡتُ حُبَّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتۡ بِٱلۡحِجَابِ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: فقال اني احببت حب الخير عن ذكر ربي حتي توارت بالحجاب
ayahs.translation: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qaa-la in-neee ah-bab-tu hub-bal khai-ri an zik-ri rab-bee hat-taa ta-waa-rat bi-lhi-jaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسۡحَۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَاقِ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: ردوها علي فطفق مسحا بالسوق والاعناق
ayahs.translation: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
ayahs.transliteration: rud-doo-haa a-laiya fa-ta-fi-qa ma-sham bis-soo-qi wa-la-naaq

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا عَلَىٰ كُرۡسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدٗا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد فتنا سليمن والقينا علي كرسيه جسدا ثم اناب
ayahs.translation: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad fa-tan-naa su-lai-maa-na waal-qai-naa a-laa kur-siyyihee ja-sa-dan sum-ma a-naab

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَهَبۡ لِي مُلۡكٗا لَّا يَنۢبَغِي لِأَحَدٖ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِيٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: قال رب اغفر لي وهب لي ملكا لا ينبغي لاحد من بعدي انك انت الوهاب
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-bigh fir lee wa-hab lee mul-kal laa yam-ba-ghee li-a-ha-din min badee in-na-ka an-tal wa-hhaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَسَخَّرۡنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجۡرِي بِأَمۡرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيۡثُ أَصَابَ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: فسخرنا له الريح تجري بامره رخاء حيث اصاب
ayahs.translation: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-sa-khar-naa la-hur ree-ha taj-ree bi-a-mri-hee ru-khaaaan hai-su a-saab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٖ وَغَوَّاصٖ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: والشيطين كل بناء وغواص
ayahs.translation: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver
ayahs.transliteration: was-hshayaa-tee-na kul-la ban-naaainw wa-ghaw-waas

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَصۡفَادِ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: وءاخرين مقرنين في الاصفاد
ayahs.translation: And others bound together in irons.
ayahs.transliteration: waaa-kha-ree-na mu-qar-ra-nee-na fil as-faad

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمۡنُنۡ أَوۡ أَمۡسِكۡ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: هذا عطاؤنا فامنن او امسك بغير حساب
ayahs.translation: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
ayahs.transliteration: haa-zaa a-taaau-naa fam-nun aw am-sik bi-ghai-ri hi-saab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: وان له عندنا لزلفي وحسن ماب
ayahs.translation: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na la-hoo in-da-naa la-zul-faa wa-hus-na maaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ بِنُصۡبٖ وَعَذَابٍ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: واذكر عبدنا ايوب اذ نادي ربه اني مسني الشيطن بنصب وعذاب
ayahs.translation: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
ayahs.transliteration: waz-kur ab-da-naaa ayyoob iz naa-da rab-ba-hooo an-nee mas-sa-niyash shai-taa-nu bi-nus-binw waa-zaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱرۡكُضۡ بِرِجۡلِكَۖ هَٰذَا مُغۡتَسَلُۢ بَارِدٞ وَشَرَابٞ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: اركض برجلك هذا مغتسل بارد وشراب
ayahs.translation: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink."
ayahs.transliteration: ur-kud bi-rij-li-ka haa-za mug-hta-sa-lun baa-ri-dunw wa-sha-raab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهۡلَهُۥ وَمِثۡلَهُم مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: ووهبنا له اهله ومثلهم معهم رحمة منا وذكري لاولي الالبب
ayahs.translation: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-wa-hab-naa la-hoo ah-la-hoo wa-mis-la-hum maa-hum rah-ma-tan min-na wa-zik-raa liu-lil al-baab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَخُذۡ بِيَدِكَ ضِغۡثٗا فَٱضۡرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحۡنَثۡۗ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَٰهُ صَابِرٗاۚ نِّعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٞ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: وخذ بيدك ضغثا فاضرب به ولا تحنث انا وجدنه صابرا نعم العبد انه اواب
ayahs.translation: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-khuz biya-di-ka dig-hsan fad-rib bihee wa-laa tah-nas in-naa wa-jad-naa-hu saa-bi-raa ni-mal abd in-na-hooo aw-waab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ أُوْلِي ٱلۡأَيۡدِي وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: واذكر عبدنا ابرهيم واسحق ويعقوب اولي الايدي والابصر
ayahs.translation: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
ayahs.transliteration: waz-kur i-baa-da-naaa ib-raa-hee-ma wai-shaa-qa waya-qoo-ba u-lil ay-dee wa-lab-saar

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَخۡلَصۡنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٖ ذِكۡرَى ٱلدَّارِ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: انا اخلصنهم بخالصة ذكري الدار
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
ayahs.transliteration: in-naaa ak-hlas-naa-hum bi-khaa-li-sa-tin zik-rad daar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمۡ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصۡطَفَيۡنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: وانهم عندنا لمن المصطفين الاخيار
ayahs.translation: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na-hum in-da-naa la-mi-nal mus-ta-fai-nal a-khyaar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ وَكُلّٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: واذكر اسمعيل واليسع وذا الكفل وكل من الاخيار
ayahs.translation: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
ayahs.transliteration: waz-kur is-maaee-la wa-lya-saa wa-zal kif-li wa-kul-lun mi-nal a-khyaar

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا ذِكۡرٞۚ وَإِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: هذا ذكر وان للمتقين لحسن ماب
ayahs.translation: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return -
ayahs.transliteration: haa-zaa zik-run wain-na lil-mut-ta-qee-na la-hus-na maaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٖ مُّفَتَّحَةٗ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡوَٰبُ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: جنت عدن مفتحة لهم الابوب
ayahs.translation: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
ayahs.transliteration: jan-naa-ti ad-nin mu-fat-ta-ha-tan la-hu-mul ab-waab

ayahs.text_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٖ كَثِيرَةٖ وَشَرَابٖ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: متكين فيها يدعون فيها بفكهة كثيرة وشراب
ayahs.translation: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
ayahs.transliteration: mut-ta-kiee-na fee-haa ya-doo-na fee-haa bi-faa-ki-ha-tin kasee-ra-tinw wa-sha-raab

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَعِندَهُمۡ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ أَتۡرَابٌ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: وعندهم قصرت الطرف اتراب
ayahs.translation: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-da-hum qaa-si-raa-tut tar-fi at-raab

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: هذا ما توعدون ليوم الحساب
ayahs.translation: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
ayahs.transliteration: haa-zaa maa too-a-doo-na liyaw-mil hi-saab

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزۡقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان هذا لرزقنا ما له من نفاد
ayahs.translation: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na haa-zaa la-riz-qu-naa maa la-hoo min na-faad

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذَاۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٖ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: هذا وان للطغين لشر ماب
ayahs.translation: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
ayahs.transliteration: haa-zaa wain-na lit-taa-ghee-na la-shar-ra maaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: جَهَنَّمَ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمِهَادُ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: جهنم يصلونها فبئس المهاد
ayahs.translation: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
ayahs.transliteration: ja-han-na-ma yas-law-na-haa fa-bi-sal mi-haad

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا فَلۡيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٞ وَغَسَّاقٞ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: هذا فليذوقوه حميم وغساق
ayahs.translation: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
ayahs.transliteration: haa-zaa fa-lya-zoo-qoo-hu hamee-munw wa-ghas-saaq

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكۡلِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٌ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: وءاخر من شكله ازوج
ayahs.translation: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
ayahs.transliteration: waaa-kha-ru min shak-liheee az-waaj

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا فَوۡجٞ مُّقۡتَحِمٞ مَّعَكُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِهِمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ صَالُواْ ٱلنَّارِ ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: هذا فوج مقتحم معكم لا مرحبا بهم انهم صالوا النار
ayahs.translation: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
ayahs.transliteration: haa-zaa faw-jun muq-ta-hi-mun maa-kum laa ma-rha-ban bi-him in-na-hum saa-lun naar

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِكُمۡۖ أَنتُمۡ قَدَّمۡتُمُوهُ لَنَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا بل انتم لا مرحبا بكم انتم قدمتموه لنا فبئس القرار
ayahs.translation: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo bal an-tum laa ma-rha-ban bi-kum an-tum qad-dam-tu-moo-hu la-naa fa-bi-sal qa-raar

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدۡهُ عَذَابٗا ضِعۡفٗا فِي ٱلنَّارِ ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا ربنا من قدم لنا هذا فزده عذابا ضعفا في النار
ayahs.translation: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo rab-ba-naa man qad-da-ma la-naa haa-zaa fa-zi-dhu a-zaa-ban di-fan fin naar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالٗا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَشۡرَارِ ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا ما لنا لا نري رجالا كنا نعدهم من الاشرار
ayahs.translation: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-loo maa la-naa laa na-raa ri-jaa-lan kun-naa naud-du-hum mi-nal as-hraar

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَتَّخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا أَمۡ زَاغَتۡ عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ ٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: اتخذنهم سخريا ام زاغت عنهم الابصر
ayahs.translation: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
ayahs.transliteration: at-ta-khaz-naa-hum sik-hriyyan am zaa-ghat a-nhu-mul ab-saar

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقّٞ تَخَاصُمُ أَهۡلِ ٱلنَّارِ ٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان ذلك لحق تخاصم اهل النار
ayahs.translation: Indeed, that is truth [i.e., reality] - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na zaa-li-ka la-haq-qun ta-khaa-su-mu ah-lin naar

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٞۖ وَمَا مِنۡ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ ٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: قل انما انا منذر وما من اله الا الله الوحد القهار
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allāh, the One, the Prevailing,
ayahs.transliteration: qul in-na-maaa a-na mun-zi-runw wa-maa min laa-hin il-lal laa-hul waa-hi-dul qa-hhaar

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرُ ٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: رب السموت والارض وما بينهما العزيز الغفر
ayahs.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."
ayahs.transliteration: rab-bus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di wa-maa bai-na-hu-mal azee-zul ghaf-faar

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ هُوَ نَبَؤٌاْ عَظِيمٌ ٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: قل هو نبؤا عظيم
ayahs.translation: Say, "It is great news
ayahs.transliteration: qul hu-wa na-baun azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَنتُمۡ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضُونَ ٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: انتم عنه معرضون
ayahs.translation: From which you turn away.
ayahs.transliteration: an-tum a-nhu mu-ri-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنۡ عِلۡمِۭ بِٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰٓ إِذۡ يَخۡتَصِمُونَ ٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: ما كان لي من علم بالملا الاعلي اذ يختصمون
ayahs.translation: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
