ayahs.transliteration: maa kaa-na liya min il-min bil-ma-lail a-laaa iz yak-hta-si-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ ٧٠
ayahs.text_simple: ان يوحي الي الا انما انا نذير مبين
ayahs.translation: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
ayahs.transliteration: i-nyyoo-haaa i-laiya il-laaa an-na maaa a-na nazee-run mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرٗا مِّن طِينٖ ٧١
ayahs.text_simple: اذ قال ربك للملئكة اني خلق بشرا من طين
ayahs.translation: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
ayahs.transliteration: iz qaa-la rab-bu-ka lil-ma-laaai-ka-ti in-nee khaa-li-qun ba-sha-ran min teen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ ٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: فاذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحي فقعوا له سجدين
ayahs.translation: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
ayahs.transliteration: fai-za saw-wai-tu-hoo wa-na-fak-htu fee-hi mir roohee fa-qaoo la-hoo saa-jideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ ٧٣
ayahs.text_simple: فسجد الملئكة كلهم اجمعون
ayahs.translation: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-sa-ja-dal ma-laaai-ka-tu kul-lu-hum aj-maoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٧٤
ayahs.text_simple: الا ابليس استكبر وكان من الكفرين
ayahs.translation: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: il-laaa ib-lees stak-ba-ra wa-kaa-na mi-nal kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسۡجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقۡتُ بِيَدَيَّۖ أَسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ أَمۡ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَالِينَ ٧٥
ayahs.text_simple: قال يابليس ما منعك ان تسجد لما خلقت بيدي استكبرت ام كنت من العالين
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la yaaaib-lee-su maa ma-naa-ka an tas-ju-da li-maa kha-laq-tu biya-daiya as-tak-bar-ta am kun-ta min a-laaleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡهُ خَلَقۡتَنِي مِن نَّارٖ وَخَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن طِينٖ ٧٦
ayahs.text_simple: قال انا خير منه خلقتني من نار وخلقته من طين
ayahs.translation: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la a-na khai-rum mi-nhu kha-laq-tanee min naa-rinw wa-kha-laq-ta-hoo min teen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٞ ٧٧
ayahs.text_simple: قال فاخرج منها فانك رجيم
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "Then get out of it [i.e., Paradise], for indeed, you are expelled.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la fak-hruj mi-nhaa fain-na-ka rajeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ لَعۡنَتِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ ٧٨
ayahs.text_simple: وان عليك لعنتي الي يوم الدين
ayahs.translation: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na a-lai-ka la-nateee i-laa yaw-mid deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ ٧٩
ayahs.text_simple: قال رب فانظرني الي يوم يبعثون
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-bi faan-zir-neee i-laa yaw-mi yu-ba-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنظَرِينَ ٨٠
ayahs.text_simple: قال فانك من المنظرين
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la fain-na-ka mi-nal mun-zareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡوَقۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡلُومِ ٨١
ayahs.text_simple: الي يوم الوقت المعلوم
ayahs.translation: Until the Day of the time well-known."
ayahs.transliteration: i-laa yaw-mil waq-til ma-loom

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ ٨٢
ayahs.text_simple: قال فبعزتك لاغوينهم اجمعين
ayahs.translation: [Iblees] said, "By Your might, I will surely mislead them all
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la fa-biiz-za-ti-ka laug-hwiyan-na-hum aj-maeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ ٨٣
ayahs.text_simple: الا عبادك منهم المخلصين
ayahs.translation: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa i-baa-da-ka mi-nhu-mul muk-hla-seen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَٱلۡحَقُّ وَٱلۡحَقَّ أَقُولُ ٨٤
ayahs.text_simple: قال فالحق والحق اقول
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la fa-lhaqq wa-lhaq-qa a-qool

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ ٨٥
ayahs.text_simple: لاملان جهنم منك وممن تبعك منهم اجمعين
ayahs.translation: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
ayahs.transliteration: laam-laan-na ja-han-na-ma min-ka wa-mim-man ta-bi-a-ka mi-nhum aj-maeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَكَلِّفِينَ ٨٦
ayahs.text_simple: قل ما اسلكم عليه من اجر وما انا من المتكلفين
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., the Qur’ān] any payment, and I am not of the pretentious.
ayahs.transliteration: qul maaa a-sa-lu-kum a-lai-hi min aj-rinw wa-maaa a-na mi-nal mu-ta-kal-lifeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٨٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان هو الا ذكر للعلمين
ayahs.translation: It is but a reminder to the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: in hu-wa il-laa zik-rul li-laa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعۡدَ حِينِۭ ٨٨
ayahs.text_simple: ولتعلمن نباه بعد حين
ayahs.translation: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-ta-la-mun-na na-baa-hoo ba-da heen

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: تنزيل الكتب من الله العزيز الحكيم
ayahs.translation: The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: tan-zee-lul ki-taa-bi mi-nal laa-hil azee-zil hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَٱعۡبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: انا انزلنا اليك الكتب بالحق فاعبد الله مخلصا له الدين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muḥammad], in truth. So worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naaa an-zal-naaa i-lai-kal ki-taa-ba bi-lhaq-qi fa-bu-dil laa-ha muk-hli-sal la-hud deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡخَالِصُۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ مَا نَعۡبُدُهُمۡ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلۡفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ فِي مَا هُمۡ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَنۡ هُوَ كَٰذِبٞ كَفَّارٞ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: الا لله الدين الخالص والذين اتخذوا من دونه اولياء ما نعبدهم الا ليقربونا الي الله زلفي ان الله يحكم بينهم في ما هم فيه يختلفون ان الله لا يهدي من هو كذب كفار
ayahs.translation: Unquestionably, for Allāh is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allāh in position." Indeed, Allāh will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allāh does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.
ayahs.transliteration: a-laa lil-laa-hid dee-nul khaa-lis wal-la-zee-nat ta-kha-zoo min doo-niheee aw-liyaaaa maa na-bu-du-hum il-laa liyu-qar-ri-boo-naaa i-lal laa-hi zul-faa in-nal laa-ha yah-ku-mu bai-na-hum fee maa hum fee-hi yak-hta-li-foon in-nal laa-ha laa yah-dee man hu-wa kaa-zi-bun kaf-faar

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّوۡ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدٗا لَّٱصۡطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: لو اراد الله ان يتخذ ولدا لاصطفي مما يخلق ما يشاء سبحنه هو الله الوحد القهار
ayahs.translation: If Allāh had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allāh, the One, the Prevailing.
ayahs.transliteration: law a-raa-dal laa-hu ai yat-ta-khi-za wa-la-dal las-ta-faa mim-maa yak-hlu-qu maa ya-shaaa su-bhaa-na-hoo hu-wal laa-hul waa-hi-dul qa-hhaar

ayahs.text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيۡلِۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ يَجۡرِي لِأَجَلٖ مُّسَمًّىۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرُ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: خلق السموت والارض بالحق يكور اليل علي النهار ويكور النهار علي اليل وسخر الشمس والقمر كل يجري لاجل مسمي الا هو العزيز الغفر
ayahs.translation: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
ayahs.transliteration: kha-la-qas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da bi-lhaqq yu-kaw-wi-rul lai-la a-lan na-haa-ri wayu-kaw-wi-run na-haa-ra a-laal lai-li wa-sak-hkha-rash sham-sa wal-qa-ma-ra kul-lu-ny yaj-ree li-a-ja-lim mu-sam-maa a-laa hu-wal azee-zul ghaf-faar

ayahs.text_uthmani: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٖ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۡهَا زَوۡجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزۡوَٰجٖۚ يَخۡلُقُكُمۡ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ خَلۡقٗا مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ خَلۡقٖ فِي ظُلُمَٰتٖ ثَلَٰثٖۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصۡرَفُونَ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: خلقكم من نفس وحدة ثم جعل منها زوجها وانزل لكم من الانعم ثمنية ازوج يخلقكم في بطون امهتكم خلقا من بعد خلق في ظلمت ثلث ذلكم الله ربكم له الملك لا اله الا هو فاني تصرفون
ayahs.translation: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is Allāh, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?
ayahs.transliteration: kha-la-qa-kum min naf-sinw waa-hi-da-tin sum-ma jaa-la mi-nhaa zaw-ja-haa waan-za-la la-kum mi-nal a-naa-mi sa-maa-niya-ta az-waaj yak-hlu-qu-kum fee bu-too-ni um-ma-haa-ti-kum khal-qam mim ba-di khal-qin fee zu-lu-maa-tin sa-laas zaa-li-ku-mul laa-hu rab-bu-kum la-hul mulk laaa i-laa-ha il-laa hu-wa faan-naa tus-ra-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِن تَكۡفُرُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنكُمۡۖ وَلَا يَرۡضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلۡكُفۡرَۖ وَإِن تَشۡكُرُواْ يَرۡضَهُ لَكُمۡۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان تكفروا فان الله غني عنكم ولا يرضي لعباده الكفر وان تشكروا يرضه لكم ولا تزر وازرة وزر اخري ثم الي ربكم مرجعكم فينبئكم بما كنتم تعملون انه عليم بذات الصدور
ayahs.translation: If you disbelieve - indeed, Allāh is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves [i.e., likes] it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
ayahs.transliteration: in tak-fu-roo fain-nal laa-ha gha-niyyun an-kum wa-laa yar-daa lii-baa-di-hil kuf-ra wain tas-hku-roo yar-da-hu la-kum wa-laa ta-zi-ru waa-zi-ra-tunw wiz-ra uk-hraa sum-ma i-laa ra-bi-kum mar-jiu-kum fayu-nab-biu-kum bi-maa kun-tum ta-ma-loon in-na-hoo alee-mum bi-zaa-tis su-door

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ ضُرّٞ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعۡمَةٗ مِّنۡهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ مِن قَبۡلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادٗا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۚ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعۡ بِكُفۡرِكَ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: واذا مس الانسن ضر دعا ربه منيبا اليه ثم اذا خوله نعمة منه نسي ما كان يدعوا اليه من قبل وجعل لله اندادا ليضل عن سبيله قل تمتع بكفرك قليلا انك من اصحب النار
ayahs.translation: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allāh equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire."
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa mas-sal in-saa-na dur-run daaa rab-ba-hoo munee-ban i-lai-hi sum-ma i-zaa khaw-wa-la-hoo ni-ma-tam mi-nhu na-siya maa kaa-na ya-dooo i-lai-hi min qab-lu wa-jaa-la lil-laa-hi an-daa-dal liyu-dil-la an sabee-lih qul ta-mat-ta bi-kuf-ri-ka qalee-lan in-na-ka min a-shaa-bin naar

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمَّنۡ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيۡلِ سَاجِدٗا وَقَآئِمٗا يَحۡذَرُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَيَرۡجُواْ رَحۡمَةَ رَبِّهِۦۗ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: امن هو قنت ءاناء اليل ساجدا وقائما يحذر الاخرة ويرجوا رحمة ربه قل هل يستوي الذين يعلمون والذين لا يعلمون انما يتذكر اولوا الالبب
ayahs.translation: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.
ayahs.transliteration: am-man hu-wa qaa-ni-tun aa-naaaal lai-li saa-ji-danw wa-qaaai-mai yah-za-rul aa-khi-ra-ta wayar-joo rah-ma-ta rab-bih qul hal yas-ta-wil lazee-na ya-la-moo-na wal-la-zee-na laa ya-la-moon in-na-maa ya-ta-zak-ka-ru u-lul al-baab

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمۡۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٞۗ وَأَرۡضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجۡرَهُم بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: قل يعباد الذين ءامنوا اتقوا ربكم للذين احسنوا في هذه الدنيا حسنة وارض الله وسعة انما يوفي الصبرون اجرهم بغير حساب
ayahs.translation: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allāh is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account [i.e., limit]."
ayahs.transliteration: qul yaai-baa-dil lazee-na aa-ma-nut ta-qoo rab-ba-kum lil-la-zee-na ah-sa-noo fee haa-zi-hid du-nyaa ha-sa-nah waar-dul laa-hi waa-si-ah in-na-maa yu-waf-fas saa-bi-roo-na aj-ra-hum bi-ghay-ri hi-sab

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: قل اني امرت ان اعبد الله مخلصا له الدين
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
ayahs.transliteration: qul in-neee u-mir-tu an a-bu-dal laa-ha muk-hli-sal la-hud deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأُمِرۡتُ لِأَنۡ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: وامرت لان اكون اول المسلمين
ayahs.translation: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."
ayahs.transliteration: wau-mir-tu li-an a-koo-na aw-wa-lal mus-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ إِنۡ عَصَيۡتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: قل اني اخاف ان عصيت ربي عذاب يوم عظيم
ayahs.translation: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."
ayahs.transliteration: qul in-neee a-khaa-fu in a-sai-tu rab-bee a-zaa-ba yaw-min azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعۡبُدُ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُۥ دِينِي ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: قل الله اعبد مخلصا له ديني
ayahs.translation: Say, "Allāh [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,
ayahs.transliteration: qu-lil laa-ha a-bu-du muk-hli-sal la-hoo deenee

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱعۡبُدُواْ مَا شِئۡتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦۗ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخُسۡرَانُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: فاعبدوا ما شئتم من دونه قل ان الخسرين الذين خسروا انفسهم واهليهم يوم القيمة الا ذلك هو الخسران المبين
ayahs.translation: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bu-doo maa shi-tum min doo-nih qul in-nal khaa-si-ree-nal lazee-na kha-si-rooo an-fu-sa-hum waah-lee-him yaw-mal qiyaa-mah a-laa zaa-li-ka hu-wal khus-raa-nul mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَهُم مِّن فَوۡقِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحۡتِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥۚ يَٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: لهم من فوقهم ظلل من النار ومن تحتهم ظلل ذلك يخوف الله به عباده يعباد فاتقون
ayahs.translation: They will have canopies [i.e., layers] of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allāh threatens [i.e., warns] His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.
ayahs.transliteration: la-hum min faw-qi-him zu-la-lum mi-nan naa-ri wa-min tah-ti-him zu-lal zaa-li-ka yu-khaw-wi-ful laa-hu bihee i-baa-dah yaai-baa-di fat-ta-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَنَبُواْ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ أَن يَعۡبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰۚ فَبَشِّرۡ عِبَادِ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: والذين اجتنبوا الطغوت ان يعبدوها وانابوا الي الله لهم البشري فبشر عباد
ayahs.translation: But those who have avoided ṭāghūt, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allāh - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-naj ta-na-but taa-ghoo-ta ai ya-bu-doo-haa waa-naa-booo i-lal laa-hi la-hu-mul bus-hraa fa-bas-hshir i-baad

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحۡسَنَهُۥٓۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: الذين يستمعون القول فيتبعون احسنه اولئك الذين هديهم الله واولئك هم اولوا الالبب
ayahs.translation: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allāh has guided, and those are people of understanding.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na yas-ta-mioo-nal qaw-la fayat-ta-bioo-na ah-sa-nah u-laaai-kal lazee-na ha-daa-hu-mul laa-hu wau-laaai-ka hum u-lul al-baab

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَمَنۡ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: افمن حق عليه كلمة العذاب افانت تنقذ من في النار
ayahs.translation: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-man haq-qa a-lai-hi ka-li-ma-tul a-zaab a-faan-ta tun-qi-zu man fin naar

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ رَبَّهُمۡ لَهُمۡ غُرَفٞ مِّن فَوۡقِهَا غُرَفٞ مَّبۡنِيَّةٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: لكن الذين اتقوا ربهم لهم غرف من فوقها غرف مبنية تجري من تحتها الانهر وعد الله لا يخلف الله الميعاد
ayahs.translation: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allāh. Allāh does not fail in [His] promise.
ayahs.transliteration: laa-ki-nil lazee-nat ta-qaw rab-ba-hum la-hum ghu-ra-fum min faw-qi-haa ghu-ra-fum mab-niyya-tun taj-ree min tah-ti-hal a-nhaar wa-dal laah laa yuk-hli-ful laa-hul meeaad

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَٰبِيعَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرۡعٗا مُّخۡتَلِفًا أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصۡفَرّٗا ثُمَّ يَجۡعَلُهُۥ حُطَٰمًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: الم تر ان الله انزل من السماء ماء فسلكه ينبيع في الارض ثم يخرج به زرعا مختلفا الونه ثم يهيج فتريه مصفرا ثم يجعله حطما ان في ذلك لذكري لاولي الالبب
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that Allāh sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam ta-ra an-nal laa-ha an-za-la mi-nas sa-maaai maaaan fa-sa-la-ka-hoo ya-naabeea fil ar-di sum-ma yuk-hri-ju bihee za-ram muk-hta-li-fan al-waa-nu-hoo sum-ma ya-hee-ju fa-ta-ra-hu mus-far-ran sum-ma ya-ja-lu-hoo hu-taa-maa in-na fee zaa-li-ka la-zik-raa liu-lil al-baab

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدۡرَهُۥ لِلۡإِسۡلَٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡقَٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: افمن شرح الله صدره للاسلم فهو علي نور من ربه فويل للقسية قلوبهم من ذكر الله اولئك في ضلل مبين
ayahs.translation: So is one whose breast Allāh has expanded to [accept] Islām and he is upon [i.e., guided by] a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allāh. Those are in manifest error.
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-man sha-ra-hal laa-hu sad-ra-hoo li-lis-laa-mi fa-hu-wa a-laa noo-rim mir rab-bih fa-wai-lul lil-qaa-siya-ti qu-loo-bu-hum min zik-ril laah u-laaai-ka fee da-laa-lim mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡحَدِيثِ كِتَٰبٗا مُّتَشَٰبِهٗا مَّثَانِيَ تَقۡشَعِرُّ مِنۡهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمۡ وَقُلُوبُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٍ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: الله نزل احسن الحديث كتبا متشبها مثاني تقشعر منه جلود الذين يخشون ربهم ثم تلين جلودهم وقلوبهم الي ذكر الله ذلك هدي الله يهدي به من يشاء ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد
ayahs.translation: Allāh has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance [i.e., mention] of Allāh. That is the guidance of Allāh by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no guide.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-hu naz-za-la ah-sa-nal hadee-si ki-taa-bam mu-ta-shaa-bi-ham ma-saa-niy taq-shair-ru mi-nhu ju-loo-dul lazee-na yak-hshaw-na rab-ba-hum sum-ma talee-nu ju-loo-du-hum wa-qu-loo-bu-hum i-laa zik-ril laah zaa-li-ka hu-dal laa-hi yah-dee bihee mai ya-shaaa wa-mai yud-li-lil laa-hu fa-maa la-hoo min haad

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِي بِوَجۡهِهِۦ سُوٓءَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُواْ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡسِبُونَ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: افمن يتقي بوجهه سوء العذاب يوم القيمة وقيل للظلمين ذوقوا ما كنتم تكسبون
ayahs.translation: Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn."
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-mai yat-taqee bi-wa-jhihee sooo-al a-zaa-bi yaw-mal qiyaa-mah waqee-la liz-zaa-li-mee-na zoo-qoo maa kun-tum tak-si-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: كذب الذين من قبلهم فاتيهم العذاب من حيث لا يشعرون
ayahs.translation: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.
ayahs.transliteration: kaz-za-bal lazee-na min qab-li-him faa-taa-hu-mul a-zaa-bu min hai-su laa ya-shu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخِزۡيَ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: فاذاقهم الله الخزي في الحيوة الدنيا ولعذاب الاخرة اكبر لو كانوا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: So Allāh made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-zaa-qa-hu-mul laa-hul khi-zya fil hayaa-tid du-nyaa wa-laa-zaa-bul aa-khi-ra-ti ak-bar law kaa-noo ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ ضَرَبۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٖ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ضربنا للناس في هذا القرءان من كل مثل لعلهم يتذكرون
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad da-rab-naa lin-naa-si fee haa-zal qu-raa-ni min kul-li ma-sa-lil laal-la-hum ya-ta-zak-ka-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيۡرَ ذِي عِوَجٖ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: قرءانا عربيا غير ذي عوج لعلهم يتقون
ayahs.translation: [It is] an Arabic Qur’ān, without any deviance that they might become righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: qu-raa-nan a-ra-biyyan ghai-ra zee i-wa-jil laal-la-hum yat-ta-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا رَّجُلٗا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلٗا سَلَمٗا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًاۚ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: ضرب الله مثلا رجلا فيه شركاء متشكسون ورجلا سلما لرجل هل يستويان مثلا الحمد لله بل اكثرهم لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: Allāh presents an example: a man [i.e., slave] owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allāh! But most of them do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: da-ra-bal laa-hu ma-sa-lar ra-ju-lan fee-hi shu-ra-kaaau mu-ta-shaa-ki-soo-na wa-ra-ju-lan sa-la-mal li-ra-ju-lin hal yas-ta-wiyaa-ni ma-sa-laa a-lham-du lil-laah bal ak-sa-ru-hum laa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٞ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: انك ميت وانهم ميتون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-ka maiyi-tunw wain-na-hum maiyi-toon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمۡ تَخۡتَصِمُونَ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: ثم انكم يوم القيمة عند ربكم تختصمون
ayahs.translation: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma in-na-kum yaw-mal qiyaa-ma-ti in-da rab-bi-kum tak-hta-si-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ فَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلصِّدۡقِ إِذۡ جَآءَهُۥٓۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوٗى لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: فمن اظلم ممن كذب علي الله وكذب بالصدق اذ جاءه اليس في جهنم مثوي للكفرين
ayahs.translation: So who is more unjust than one who lies about Allāh and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-man az-la-mu mim-man ka-za-ba a-lal laa-hi wa-kaz-za-ba bis-sid-qi iz jaaaah a-lai-sa fee ja-han-na-ma mas-wal lil-kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِي جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدۡقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: والذي جاء بالصدق وصدق به اولئك هم المتقون
ayahs.translation: And the one who has brought the truth [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-lazee jaaaa bis-sid-qi wa-sad-da-qa biheee u-laaai-ka hu-mul mut-ta-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: لهم ما يشاءون عند ربهم ذلك جزاء المحسنين
ayahs.translation: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good -
ayahs.transliteration: la-hum maa ya-shaaaoo-na in-da rab-bi-him zaa-li-ka ja-zaaaul muh-sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِيُكَفِّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ أَسۡوَأَ ٱلَّذِي عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَهُمۡ أَجۡرَهُم بِأَحۡسَنِ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: ليكفر الله عنهم اسوا الذي عملوا ويجزيهم اجرهم باحسن الذي كانوا يعملون
ayahs.translation: That Allāh may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do.
ayahs.transliteration: liyu-kaf-fi-ral laa-hu a-nhum as-wa al-lazee a-mi-loo wayaj-ziya-hum aj-ra-hum bi-a-hsa-nil lazee kaa-no ya-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبۡدَهُۥۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٖ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: اليس الله بكاف عبده ويخوفونك بالذين من دونه ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد
ayahs.translation: Is not Allāh sufficient for His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allāh leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
ayahs.transliteration: a-lai-sal laa-hu bi-kaa-fin ab-da-hoo wayu-khaw-wi-foo-na-ka bil-la-zee-na min doo-nih wa-mai yud-li-lil laa-hu fa-maa la-hoo min haad

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَن يَهۡدِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّۗ أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٖ ذِي ٱنتِقَامٖ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: ومن يهد الله فما له من مضل اليس الله بعزيز ذي انتقام
ayahs.translation: And whoever Allāh guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not Allāh Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mai yah-dil laa-hu fa-maa la-hoo min mu-dil a-lai-sal laa-hu bi-a-zee-zin zin ti-qaam

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلۡ أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنۡ أَرَادَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلۡ هُنَّ كَٰشِفَٰتُ ضُرِّهِۦٓ أَوۡ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحۡمَةٍ هَلۡ هُنَّ مُمۡسِكَٰتُ رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ قُلۡ حَسۡبِيَ ٱللَّهُۖ عَلَيۡهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ ٱلۡمُتَوَكِّلُونَ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: ولئن سالتهم من خلق السموت والارض ليقولن الله قل افرءيتم ما تدعون من دون الله ان ارادني الله بضر هل هن كشفت ضره او ارادني برحمة هل هن ممسكت رحمته قل حسبي الله عليه يتوكل المتوكلون
ayahs.translation: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "Then have you considered what you invoke besides Allāh? If Allāh intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allāh; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lain saal-ta-hum man kha-la-qas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da laya-qoo-lu-nal laah qul a-fa-raai-tum maa ta-doo-na min doo-nil laa-hi in a-raa-da-niyal laa-hu bi-dur-rin hal hun-na kaa-shi-faa-tu dur-riheee aw a-raa-danee bi-rah-ma-tin hal hun-na mum-si-kaa-tu rah-ma-tih qul has-biyal laa-hu a-lai-hi ya-ta-wak-ka-lul mu-ta-wak-ki-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡمَلُواْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمۡ إِنِّي عَٰمِلٞۖ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: قل يقوم اعملوا علي مكانتكم اني عمل فسوف تعلمون
ayahs.translation: Say, "O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know
ayahs.transliteration: qul yaa-qaw-mi ma-loo a-laa ma-kaa-na-ti-kum in-nee aa-mi-lun fa-saw-fa ta-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَن يَأۡتِيهِ عَذَابٞ يُخۡزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيۡهِ عَذَابٞ مُّقِيمٌ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: من ياتيه عذاب يخزيه ويحل عليه عذاب مقيم
ayahs.translation: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment."
ayahs.transliteration: mai yaa-tee-hi a-zaa-bu-ny yuk-hzee-hi waya-hil-lu a-lai-hi a-zaa-bum muqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيۡهَاۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِوَكِيلٍ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: انا انزلنا عليك الكتب للناس بالحق فمن اهتدي فلنفسه ومن ضل فانما يضل عليها وما انت عليهم بوكيل
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a manager [i.e., authority] over them.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa an-zal-naa a-lai-kal ki-taa-ba lin-naa-si bi-lhaqq fa-ma-nih ta-daa fa-li-naf-sihee wa-man dal-la fain-na-maa ya-dil-lu a-lai-haa wa-maaa an-ta a-lai-him bi-wakeel

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلۡأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوۡتِهَا وَٱلَّتِي لَمۡ تَمُتۡ فِي مَنَامِهَاۖ فَيُمۡسِكُ ٱلَّتِي قَضَىٰ عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَيُرۡسِلُ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: الله يتوفي الانفس حين موتها والتي لم تمت في منامها فيمسك التي قضي عليها الموت ويرسل الاخري الي اجل مسمي ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يتفكرون
ayahs.translation: Allāh takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
ayahs.transliteration: al-laa-hu ya-ta-waf-fal an-fu-sa hee-na maw-ti-haa wal-latee lam ta-mut fee ma-naa-mi-haa fayum-si-kul latee qa-daa a-lai-hal maw-ta wayur-si-lul uk-hraaa i-laaa a-ja-lim mu-sam-maa in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayaa-til li-qaw-mai ya-ta-fak-kar-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُفَعَآءَۚ قُلۡ أَوَلَوۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: ام اتخذوا من دون الله شفعاء قل اولو كانوا لا يملكون شيا ولا يعقلون
ayahs.translation: Or have they taken other than Allāh as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?"
ayahs.transliteration: a-mit ta-kha-zoo min doo-nil laa-hi shu-faaaa qul a-wa-law kaa-noo laa yam-li-koo-na shai-aw wa-laa ya-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُل لِّلَّهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ جَمِيعٗاۖ لَّهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: قل لله الشفعة جميعا له ملك السموت والارض ثم اليه ترجعون
ayahs.translation: Say, "To Allāh belongs [the right to allow] intercession entirely. To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned."
ayahs.transliteration: qul lil-laa-hish sha-faaa-tu jameeaa la-hoo mul-kus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di sum-ma i-lai-hi tur-jaoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَحۡدَهُ ٱشۡمَأَزَّتۡ قُلُوبُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمۡ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُونَ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: واذا ذكر الله وحده اشمازت قلوب الذين لا يؤمنون بالاخرة واذا ذكر الذين من دونه اذا هم يستبشرون
ayahs.translation: And when Allāh is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa zu-ki-ral laa-hu wah-da-hush maaz-zat qu-loo-bul lazee-na laa yu-mi-noo-na bi-laa-khi-ra-ti wai-zaa zu-ki-ral lazee-na min doo-niheee i-zaa hum yas-tab-shi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ عَٰلِمَ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ أَنتَ تَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَ عِبَادِكَ فِي مَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: قل اللهم فاطر السموت والارض علم الغيب والشهدة انت تحكم بين عبادك في ما كانوا فيه يختلفون
ayahs.translation: Say, "O Allāh, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ."
ayahs.transliteration: qu-lil laa-hum-ma faa-ti-ras sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di aa-li-mal ghai-bi was-hsha-haa-da-ti an-ta tah-ku-mu bai-na i-baa-di-ka fee maa kaa-noo feehee yak-hta-li-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا وَمِثۡلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفۡتَدَوۡاْ بِهِۦ مِن سُوٓءِ ٱلۡعَذَابِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمۡ يَكُونُواْ يَحۡتَسِبُونَ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولو ان للذين ظلموا ما في الارض جميعا ومثله معه لافتدوا به من سوء العذاب يوم القيمة وبدا لهم من الله ما لم يكونوا يحتسبون
ayahs.translation: And if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from Allāh that which they had not taken into account.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law an-na lil-la-zee-na za-la-moo maa fil ar-di jameeanw wa-mis-la-hoo maa-hoo laf-ta-daw bihee min soooil a-zaa-bi yaw-mal qiyaa-mah wa-ba-daa la-hum mi-nal laa-hi maa lam ya-koo-noo yah-ta-si-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: وبدا لهم سيات ما كسبوا وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزءون
ayahs.translation: And there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ba-daa la-hum saiyi-a-a-tu maa ka-sa-boo wa-haa-qa bi-him maa kaa-noo bihee yas-tah-zioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ ضُرّٞ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلۡنَٰهُ نِعۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمِۭۚ بَلۡ هِيَ فِتۡنَةٞ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: فاذا مس الانسن ضر دعانا ثم اذا خولنه نعمة منا قال انما اوتيته علي علم بل هي فتنة ولكن اكثرهم لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon Us; then when We bestow on him a favor from Us, he says, "I have only been given it because of [my] knowledge." Rather, it is a trial, but most of them do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: fai-zaa mas-sal in-saa-na dur-run daaa-naa sum-ma i-zaa khaw-wal-naa-hu ni-ma-tam min-na qaa-la in-na-maaa oo-tee-tu-hoo a-laa ilm bal hiya fit-na-tunw wa-laa-kin-na ak-sa-ra-hum laa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَدۡ قَالَهَا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: قد قالها الذين من قبلهم فما اغني عنهم ما كانوا يكسبون
ayahs.translation: Those before them had already said it, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.
ayahs.transliteration: qad qaa-la-hal lazee-na min qab-li-him fa-maaa ag-hnaa a-nhum maa kaa-noo yak-si-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَصَابَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْ وَمَا هُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: فاصابهم سيات ما كسبوا والذين ظلموا من هؤلاء سيصيبهم سيات ما كسبوا وما هم بمعجزين
ayahs.translation: And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these [people] will be struck [i.e., afflicted] by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-saa-ba-hum saiyi-a-a-tu maa ka-sa-boo wal-la-zee-na za-la-moo min haaau-laaai sayusee-bu-hum saiyi-a-a-tu maa ka-sa-boo wa-maa hum bi-mu-jizeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: اولم يعلموا ان الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: Do they not know that Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-lam ya-la-mooo an-nal laa-ha yab-su-tur riz-qa li-mai ya-shaaau wayaq-dir in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayaa-til li-qaw-mi-ny yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسۡرَفُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ لَا تَقۡنَطُواْ مِن رَّحۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغۡفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًاۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: قل يعبادي الذين اسرفوا علي انفسهم لا تقنطوا من رحمة الله ان الله يغفر الذنوب جميعا انه هو الغفور الرحيم
ayahs.translation: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
ayahs.transliteration: qul yaai-baa-diyal lazee-na as-ra-foo a-laaa an-fu-si-him laa taq-na-too mir rah-ma-til laah in-nal laa-ha yag-hfi-ruz zu-noo-ba jameeaa in-na-hoo hu-wal gha-foo-rur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنِيبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ وَأَسۡلِمُواْ لَهُۥ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَكُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: وانيبوا الي ربكم واسلموا له من قبل ان ياتيكم العذاب ثم لا تنصرون
ayahs.translation: And return [in repentance] to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped.
ayahs.transliteration: waanee-booo i-laa rab-bi-kum waas-li-moo la-hoo min qab-li a-ny yaa-tiya-ku-mul a-zaa-bu sum-ma laa tun-sa-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱتَّبِعُوٓاْ أَحۡسَنَ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَكُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ بَغۡتَةٗ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَشۡعُرُونَ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: واتبعوا احسن ما انزل اليكم من ربكم من قبل ان ياتيكم العذاب بغتة وانتم لا تشعرون
ayahs.translation: And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord [i.e., the Qur’ān] before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you do not perceive,
ayahs.transliteration: wat-ta-biooo ah-sa-na maaa un-zi-la i-lai-kum mir rab-bi-kum min qab-li ai yaa-tiya-ku-mal a-zaa-bu bag-hta-tanw waan-tum laa ta-shu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَن تَقُولَ نَفۡسٞ يَٰحَسۡرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِي جَنۢبِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ ٱلسَّٰخِرِينَ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: ان تقول نفس يحسرتي علي ما فرطت في جنب الله وان كنت لمن السخرين
ayahs.translation: Lest a soul should say, "Oh, [how great is] my regret over what I neglected in regard to Allāh and that I was among the mockers."
ayahs.transliteration: an ta-qoo-la naf-su-ny yaa-has-ra-taa a-laa maa far-rat-tu fee jam-bil laa-hi wain kun-tu la-mi-nas saa-khireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوۡ تَقُولَ لَوۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هَدَىٰنِي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: او تقول لو ان الله هديني لكنت من المتقين
ayahs.translation: Or [lest] it say, "If only Allāh had guided me, I would have been among the righteous."
ayahs.transliteration: aw ta-qoo-la law an-nal laa-ha ha-daanee la-kun-tu mi-nal mut-taqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوۡ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى ٱلۡعَذَابَ لَوۡ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةٗ فَأَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: او تقول حين تري العذاب لو ان لي كرة فاكون من المحسنين
ayahs.translation: Or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, "If only I had another turn so I could be among the doers of good."
ayahs.transliteration: aw ta-qoo-la hee-na ta-ral a-zaa-ba law an-na lee kar-ra-tan faa-koo-na mi-nal muh-sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلَىٰ قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكَ ءَايَٰتِي فَكَذَّبۡتَ بِهَا وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: بلي قد جاءتك ءايتي فكذبت بها واستكبرت وكنت من الكفرين
ayahs.translation: But yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: ba-laa qad jaaaat-ka aayaa-tee fa-kaz-zab-ta bi-haa was-tak-bar-ta wa-kun-ta mi-nal kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ تَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسۡوَدَّةٌۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوٗى لِّلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: ويوم القيمة تري الذين كذبوا علي الله وجوههم مسودة اليس في جهنم مثوي للمتكبرين
ayahs.translation: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allāh [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant?
ayahs.transliteration: wayaw-mal qiyaa-ma-ti ta-ral lazee-na ka-za-boo a-lal laa-hi wu-joo-hu-hum mus-wad-dah a-lai-sa fee ja-han-na-ma mas-wal lil-mu-ta-kab-bireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيُنَجِّي ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ بِمَفَازَتِهِمۡ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلسُّوٓءُ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: وينجي الله الذين اتقوا بمفازتهم لا يمسهم السوء ولا هم يحزنون
ayahs.translation: And Allāh will save those who feared Him by their attainment; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.
ayahs.transliteration: wayu-naj-jil laa-hul lazee-nat ta-qaw bi-ma-faa-za-ti-him laa ya-mas-su-hu-mus sooou wa-laa hum yah-za-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَكِيلٞ ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: الله خلق كل شيء وهو علي كل شيء وكيل
ayahs.translation: Allāh is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.
ayahs.transliteration: al-laa-hu khaa-li-qu kul-li shaiinw wa-hu-wa a-laa kul-li shaiinw wakeel

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ ٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: له مقاليد السموت والارض والذين كفروا بايت الله اولئك هم الخسرون
ayahs.translation: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And they who disbelieve in the verses of Allāh - it is those who are the losers.
ayahs.transliteration: la-hoo ma-qaa-lee-dus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lard wal-la-zee-na ka-fa-roo bi-a-yaa-til laa-hi u-laaai-ka hu-mul khaa-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أَفَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ تَأۡمُرُوٓنِّيٓ أَعۡبُدُ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡجَٰهِلُونَ ٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: قل افغير الله تامروني اعبد ايها الجهلون
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Is it other than Allāh that you order me to worship, O ignorant ones?"
ayahs.transliteration: qul a-fa-ghai-ral laa-hi taa-mu-rooon-neee a-bu-du ayyu-hal jaa-hi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكَ لَئِنۡ أَشۡرَكۡتَ لَيَحۡبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد اوحي اليك والي الذين من قبلك لئن اشركت ليحبطن عملك ولتكونن من الخسرين
ayahs.translation: And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with Allāh, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad oo-hiya i-lai-ka wai-lal lazee-na min qab-li-ka lain as-hrak-ta layah-ba-tan-na a-ma-lu ka-wa-la-ta-koo-nan-na mi-nal khaa-sireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱللَّهَ فَٱعۡبُدۡ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ ٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: بل الله فاعبد وكن من الشكرين
ayahs.translation: Rather, worship [only] Allāh and be among the grateful.
ayahs.transliteration: ba-lil laa-hha fa-bud wa-kum mi-nash shaa-kireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا قَدَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدۡرِهِۦ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ جَمِيعٗا قَبۡضَتُهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ مَطۡوِيَّٰتُۢ بِيَمِينِهِۦۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ ٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: وما قدروا الله حق قدره والارض جميعا قبضته يوم القيمة والسموت مطويت بيمينه سبحنه وتعلي عما يشركون
ayahs.translation: They have not appraised Allāh with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be [within] His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa qa-da-rul laa-ha haq-qa qad-rihee wa-lar-du jameean qab-da-tu-hoo yaw-mal qiyaa-ma-ti was-sa-maa-waa-tu mat-wiyyaa-tum biyamee-nih su-bhaa-na-hoo wa-taaa-laa am-ma yus-hri-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۖ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخۡرَىٰ فَإِذَا هُمۡ قِيَامٞ يَنظُرُونَ ٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: ونفخ في الصور فصعق من في السموت ومن في الارض الا من شاء الله ثم نفخ فيه اخري فاذا هم قيام ينظرون
ayahs.translation: And the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will fall dead except whom Allāh wills. Then it will be blown again, and at once they will be standing, looking on.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-nu-fi-kha fis soo-ri fa-sai-qa man fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-man fil ar-di il-laa man shaaal la-hu sum-ma nu-fi-kha fee-hi uk-hraa fai-zaa hum qiyaa-mu-ny yan-zu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَشۡرَقَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ وَجِاْيٓءَ بِٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءِ وَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ ٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: واشرقت الارض بنور ربها ووضع الكتب وجايء بالنبين والشهداء وقضي بينهم بالحق وهم لا يظلمون
ayahs.translation: And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and the record [of deeds] will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and it will be judged between them in truth, and they will not be wronged.
ayahs.transliteration: waas-hra-qa-til ar-du bi-noo-ri rab-bi-haa wa-wu-di-al ki-taa-bu wajeeea bin-na-biyyee-na was-hshu-ha-daaai wa-qu-diya bai-na-hum bi-lhaq-qi wa-hum laa yuz-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَوُفِّيَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا عَمِلَتۡ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَفۡعَلُونَ ٧٠
ayahs.text_simple: ووفيت كل نفس ما عملت وهو اعلم بما يفعلون
ayahs.translation: And every soul will be fully compensated [for] what it did; and He is most knowing of what they do.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-wuf-fiyat kul-lu naf-sim maa a-mi-lat wa-hu-wa a-la-mu bi-maa yaf a-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًاۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا فُتِحَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ رُسُلٞ مِّنكُمۡ يَتۡلُونَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكُمۡ وَيُنذِرُونَكُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَاۚ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنۡ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَةُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٧١
ayahs.text_simple: وسيق الذين كفروا الي جهنم زمرا حتي اذا جاءوها فتحت ابوبها وقال لهم خزنتها الم ياتكم رسل منكم يتلون عليكم ءايت ربكم وينذرونكم لقاء يومكم هذا قالوا بلي ولكن حقت كلمة العذاب علي الكفرين
ayahs.translation: And those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups until, when they reach it, its gates are opened and its keepers will say, "Did there not come to you messengers from yourselves, reciting to you the verses of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "Yes, but the word [i.e., decree] of punishment has come into effect upon the disbelievers."
ayahs.transliteration: wasee-qal lazee-na ka-fa-roo i-laa ja-han-na-ma zu-ma-raa hat-taaa i-zaa jaaaoo-haa fu-ti-hat ab-waa-bu-haa wa-qaa-la la-hum kha-za-na-tu-haaa a-lam ya-ti-kum ru-su-lun min-kum yat-loo-na a-lai-kum aayaa-ti rab-bi-kum wayun-zi-roo-na-kum li-qaaaa yaw-mi-kum haa-zaa qaa-loo ba-laa wa-laa-kin haq-qat ka-li-ma-tul a-zaa-bi a-lal kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قِيلَ ٱدۡخُلُوٓاْ أَبۡوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ ٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: قيل ادخلوا ابوب جهنم خلدين فيها فبئس مثوي المتكبرين
ayahs.translation: [To them] it will be said, "Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."
ayahs.transliteration: qee-lad khu-loo ab-waa-ba ja-han-na-ma khaa-li-dee-na fee-ha fa-bi-sa mas-wal mu-ta-kab-bireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ رَبَّهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡجَنَّةِ زُمَرًاۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ طِبۡتُمۡ فَٱدۡخُلُوهَا خَٰلِدِينَ ٧٣
ayahs.text_simple: وسيق الذين اتقوا ربهم الي الجنة زمرا حتي اذا جاءوها وفتحت ابوبها وقال لهم خزنتها سلم عليكم طبتم فادخلوها خلدين
ayahs.translation: But those who feared their Lord will be driven to Paradise in groups until, when they reach it while its gates have been opened and its keepers say, "Peace be upon you; you have become pure; so enter it to abide eternally therein," [they will enter].
ayahs.transliteration: wasee-qal lazee-nat ta-qaw rab-ba-hum i-lal jan-na-ti zu-ma-raa hat-taaa i-zaa jaaaoo-haa wa-fu-ti-hat ab-waa-bu-haa wa-qaa-la la-hum kha-za-na-tu-haa sa-laa-mun a-lai-kum tib-tum fad-khu-loo-haa khaa-lideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي صَدَقَنَا وَعۡدَهُۥ وَأَوۡرَثَنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ حَيۡثُ نَشَآءُۖ فَنِعۡمَ أَجۡرُ ٱلۡعَٰمِلِينَ ٧٤
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا الحمد لله الذي صدقنا وعده واورثنا الارض نتبوا من الجنة حيث نشاء فنعم اجر العملين
ayahs.translation: And they will say, "Praise to Allāh, who has fulfilled for us His promise and made us inherit the earth [so] we may settle in Paradise wherever we will. And excellent is the reward of [righteous] workers."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-lull ham-du-lil-laa-hil lazee sa-da-qa-naa wa-da-hoo waaw-ra-sa-nal ar-da na-ta-baw wau mi-nal jan-na-ti hai-su na-shaaau fa-ni-ma aj-rul aa-mileen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَرَى ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ حَآفِّينَ مِنۡ حَوۡلِ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡۚ وَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ وَقِيلَ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٧٥
ayahs.text_simple: وتري الملئكة حافين من حول العرش يسبحون بحمد ربهم وقضي بينهم بالحق وقيل الحمد لله رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne, exalting [Allāh] with praise of their Lord. And it will be judged between them in truth, and it will be said, "[All] praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-ral ma-laaai-ka-ta haaaf-fee-na min haw-lil ar-shi yu-sab-bi-hoo-na bi-ham-di rab-bi-him wa-qu-diya bai-na-hum bi-lhaq-qi waqee-lal ham-du lil-laa-hi rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: حمٓ ١
ayahs.text_simple: حم
ayahs.translation: Ḥā, Meem.
ayahs.transliteration: haameeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: تنزيل الكتب من الله العزيز العليم
ayahs.translation: The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,
ayahs.transliteration: tan-zee-lul ki-taa-bi mi-nal laa-hil azee-zil aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ ٱلتَّوۡبِ شَدِيدِ ٱلۡعِقَابِ ذِي ٱلطَّوۡلِۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ إِلَيۡهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: غافر الذنب وقابل التوب شديد العقاب ذي الطول لا اله الا هو اليه المصير
ayahs.translation: The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance. There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination.
ayahs.transliteration: ghaa-fi-riz zam-bi wa-qaa-bi-lit taw-bi shadee-dil i-qaa-bi zit taw-li laaa i-laa-ha il-laa hu-wa i-lai-hil maseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا يُجَٰدِلُ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَلَا يَغۡرُرۡكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ما يجدل في ءايت الله الا الذين كفروا فلا يغررك تقلبهم في البلد
ayahs.translation: No one disputes concerning the signs of Allāh except those who disbelieve, so be not deceived by their [uninhibited] movement throughout the land.
ayahs.transliteration: maa yu-jaa-di-lu feee aayaa-til laa-hi il-lal lazee-na ka-fa-roo fa-laa yag-hrur-ka ta-qal-lu-bu-hum fil bi-laad

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡۖ وَهَمَّتۡ كُلُّ أُمَّةِۭ بِرَسُولِهِمۡ لِيَأۡخُذُوهُۖ وَجَٰدَلُواْ بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ لِيُدۡحِضُواْ بِهِ ٱلۡحَقَّ فَأَخَذۡتُهُمۡۖ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح والاحزاب من بعدهم وهمت كل امة برسولهم لياخذوه وجدلوا بالبطل ليدحضوا به الحق فاخذتهم فكيف كان عقاب
ayahs.translation: The people of Noah denied before them and the [disbelieving] factions after them, and every nation intended [a plot] for their messenger to seize him, and they disputed by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth. So I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.
ayahs.transliteration: kaz-za-bat qab-la-hum qaw-mu noo-hinw wa-lah-zaa-bu min ba-di-him wa-ham-mat kul-lu um-ma-tin bi-ra-soo-li-him liya-khu-zoo-hu wa-jaa-da-loo bil-baa-ti-li liyu-dhi-doo bi-hil haq-qa faa-khaz-tu-hum fa-kai-fa kaa-na i-qaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: وكذلك حقت كلمت ربك علي الذين كفروا انهم اصحب النار
ayahs.translation: And thus has the word [i.e., decree] of your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ka-zaa-li-ka haq-qat ka-li-ma-tu rab-bi-ka a-lal lazee-na ka-fa-rooo an-na-hum a-shaa-bun naar

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَحۡمِلُونَ ٱلۡعَرۡشَ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهُۥ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۖ رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖ رَّحۡمَةٗ وَعِلۡمٗا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: الذين يحملون العرش ومن حوله يسبحون بحمد ربهم ويؤمنون به ويستغفرون للذين ءامنوا ربنا وسعت كل شيء رحمة وعلما فاغفر للذين تابوا واتبعوا سبيلك وقهم عذاب الجحيم
ayahs.translation: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those around it exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed, [saying], "Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na yah-mi-loo-nal ar-sha wa-man haw-la-hoo yu-sab-bi-hoo-na bi-ham-di rab-bi-him wayu-mi-noo-na bihee wayas-tag-hfi-roo-na lil-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo rab-ba-naa wa-si-ta kul-la shaiir rah-ma-tanw wail-man fag-hfir lil-la-zee-na taa-boo wat-ta-baoo sabee-la-ka wa-qi-him a-zaa-bal jaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَبَّنَا وَأَدۡخِلۡهُمۡ جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمۡ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنۡ ءَابَآئِهِمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمۡۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: ربنا وادخلهم جنت عدن التي وعدتهم ومن صلح من ءابائهم وازوجهم وذريتهم انك انت العزيز الحكيم
ayahs.translation: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: rab-ba-naa waad-khi-lhum jan-naa-ti ad-ni-nil latee waat-ta-hum wa-man sa-la-ha min aa-baaai-him waaz-waa-ji-him wa-zur-riyyaa-ti-him in-na-ka an-tal azee-zul hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقِهِمُ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِۚ وَمَن تَقِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ يَوۡمَئِذٖ فَقَدۡ رَحِمۡتَهُۥۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: وقهم السيات ومن تق السيات يومئذ فقد رحمته وذلك هو الفوز العظيم
ayahs.translation: And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qi-hi-mus saiyi-a-at wa-man ta-qis saiyi-a-a-ti yaw-mai-zin fa-qad ra-him-tah wa-zaa-li-ka hu-wal faw-zul azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُنَادَوۡنَ لَمَقۡتُ ٱللَّهِ أَكۡبَرُ مِن مَّقۡتِكُمۡ أَنفُسَكُمۡ إِذۡ تُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِيمَٰنِ فَتَكۡفُرُونَ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين كفروا ينادون لمقت الله اكبر من مقتكم انفسكم اذ تدعون الي الايمن فتكفرون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who disbelieve will be addressed, "The hatred of Allāh for you was [even] greater than your hatred of yourselves [this Day in Hell] when you were invited to faith, but you disbelieved [i.e., refused]."
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na ka-fa-roo yu-naa-daw-na la-maq-tul laa-hi ak-ba-ru mim maq-ti-kum an-fu-sa-kum iz tu-daw-na i-lal ee-maa-ni fa-tak-fu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَآ أَمَتَّنَا ٱثۡنَتَيۡنِ وَأَحۡيَيۡتَنَا ٱثۡنَتَيۡنِ فَٱعۡتَرَفۡنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلۡ إِلَىٰ خُرُوجٖ مِّن سَبِيلٖ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا ربنا امتنا اثنتين واحييتنا اثنتين فاعترفنا بذنوبنا فهل الي خروج من سبيل
ayahs.translation: They will say, "Our Lord, You made us lifeless twice and gave us life twice, and we have confessed our sins. So is there to an exit any way?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo rab-ba-naaa a-mat-ta-nas na-tai-ni waa-hyai-ta-nas na-tai-ni fa-ta-raf-naa bi-zu-noo-bi-naa fa-hal i-laa khu-roo-jim min sabeel

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَحۡدَهُۥ كَفَرۡتُمۡ وَإِن يُشۡرَكۡ بِهِۦ تُؤۡمِنُواْۚ فَٱلۡحُكۡمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡعَلِيِّ ٱلۡكَبِيرِ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: ذلكم بانه اذا دعي الله وحده كفرتم وان يشرك به تؤمنوا فالحكم لله العلي الكبير
ayahs.translation: [They will be told], "That is because, when Allāh was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed. So the judgement is with Allāh, the Most High, the Grand."
ayahs.transliteration: zaa-li-kum bi-a-nna-hooo i-zaa du-i-yal laa-hu wah-da-hoo ka-far-tum wai-ny yus-hrak bihee tu-mi-noo fa-lhuk-mu lil-laa-hil a-liyyil kabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقٗاۚ وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَن يُنِيبُ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: هو الذي يريكم ءايته وينزل لكم من السماء رزقا وما يتذكر الا من ينيب
ayahs.translation: It is He who shows you His signs and sends down to you from the sky, provision. But none will remember except he who turns back [in repentance].
ayahs.transliteration: hu-wal lazee yu-ree-kum aayaa-tihee wayu-naz-zi-lu la-kum mi-nas sa-maaai riz-qaa wa-maa ya-ta-zak-ka-ru il-laa mai yu-neeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱدۡعُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: فادعوا الله مخلصين له الدين ولو كره الكفرون
ayahs.translation: So invoke Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion, although the disbelievers dislike it.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-dul laa-ha muk-hli-see-na la-hud dee-na wa-law ka-ri-hal kaa-fi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَفِيعُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ ذُو ٱلۡعَرۡشِ يُلۡقِي ٱلرُّوحَ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ يَوۡمَ ٱلتَّلَاقِ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: رفيع الدرجت ذو العرش يلقي الروح من امره علي من يشاء من عباده لينذر يوم التلاق
ayahs.translation: [He is] the Exalted above [all] degrees, Owner of the Throne; He places the inspiration of His command [i.e., revelation] upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting.
ayahs.transliteration: rafee-ud da-ra-jaa-ti zul ar-shi yul-qir roo-ha min am-rihee a-laa mai ya-shaaau min i-baa-dihee liyun-zi-ra yaw-mat ta-laaq

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ هُم بَٰرِزُونَۖ لَا يَخۡفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِنۡهُمۡ شَيۡءٞۚ لِّمَنِ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡوَٰحِدِ ٱلۡقَهَّارِ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: يوم هم برزون لا يخفي علي الله منهم شيء لمن الملك اليوم لله الوحد القهار
ayahs.translation: The Day they come forth nothing concerning them will be concealed from Allāh. To whom belongs [all] sovereignty this Day? To Allāh, the One, the Prevailing.
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma hum baa-ri-zoo-na laa yak-hfaa a-lal laa-hi mi-nhum shai li-ma-nil mul-kul yaw-ma lil-laa-hil waa-hi-dil qa-haar

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡۚ لَا ظُلۡمَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: اليوم تجزي كل نفس بما كسبت لا ظلم اليوم ان الله سريع الحساب
ayahs.translation: This Day every soul will be recompensed for what it earned. No injustice today! Indeed, Allāh is swift in account.
ayahs.transliteration: a-lyaw-ma tuj-zaa kul-lu naf-sim bi-maa ka-sa-bat laa zul-mal yawm in-nal laa-ha saree-ul hi-saab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡأٓزِفَةِ إِذِ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ لَدَى ٱلۡحَنَاجِرِ كَٰظِمِينَۚ مَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنۡ حَمِيمٖ وَلَا شَفِيعٖ يُطَاعُ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: وانذرهم يوم الازفة اذ القلوب لدي الحناجر كظمين ما للظلمين من حميم ولا شفيع يطاع
ayahs.translation: And warn them, [O Muḥammad], of the Approaching Day, when hearts are at the throats, filled [with distress]. For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor [who is] obeyed.
ayahs.transliteration: waan-zi-rhum yaw-mal aa-zi-fa-ti i-zil qu-loo-bu la-dal ha-naa-ji-ri kaa-zimeen maa liz-zaa-li-mee-na min hamee-minw wa-laa shafeei-ny yu-taa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَعۡلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنِ وَمَا تُخۡفِي ٱلصُّدُورُ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: يعلم خائنة الاعين وما تخفي الصدور
ayahs.translation: He knows that which deceives the eyes and what the breasts conceal.
ayahs.transliteration: ya-la-mu khaaai-na-tal ayu-ni wa-maa tuk-hfis su-door

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ يَقۡضِي بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَقۡضُونَ بِشَيۡءٍۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: والله يقضي بالحق والذين يدعون من دونه لا يقضون بشيء ان الله هو السميع البصير
ayahs.translation: And Allāh judges with truth, while those they invoke besides Him judge not with anything. Indeed, Allāh - He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-laa-hu yaq-dee bi-lhaqq wal-la-zee-na ya-doo-na min doo-nihee laa yaq-doo-na bi-shai in-nal laa-ha hu-was samee-ul baseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ أَوَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُواْ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةٗ وَءَاثَارٗا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمۡ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٖ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: اولم يسيروا في الارض فينظروا كيف كان عقبة الذين كانوا من قبلهم كانوا هم اشد منهم قوة وءاثارا في الارض فاخذهم الله بذنوبهم وما كان لهم من الله من واق
ayahs.translation: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those who were before them? They were greater than them in strength and in impression on the land, but Allāh seized them for their sins. And they had not from Allāh any protector.
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-lam ya-see-roo fil ar-di fayan-zu-roo kai-fa kaa-na aa-qi-ba-tul lazee-na kaa-noo min qab-li-him kaa-noo hum a-shad-da mi-nhum quw-wa-tanw waaa-saa-ran fil ar-di faa-kha-za-hu-mul laa-hu bi-zu-noo-bi-him wa-maa kaa-na la-hum mi-nal laa-hi minw waaq

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ كَانَت تَّأۡتِيهِمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَكَفَرُواْ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ قَوِيّٞ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: ذلك بانهم كانت تاتيهم رسلهم بالبينت فكفروا فاخذهم الله انه قوي شديد العقاب
ayahs.translation: That was because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so Allāh seized them. Indeed, He is Powerful and severe in punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: zaa-li-ka bi-a-nna-hum kaa-nat taatee-him ru-su-lu-hum bil-baiyi-naa-ti fa-ka-fa-roo faa-kha-za-hu-mul laah in-na-hoo qa-wiyyun shadee-dul i-qaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٍ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ارسلنا موسي بايتنا وسلطن مبين
ayahs.translation: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad ar-sal-naa moo-saa bi-a-ayaa-ti-naa wa-sul-taa-nim mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَقَٰرُونَ فَقَالُواْ سَٰحِرٞ كَذَّابٞ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: الي فرعون وهمن وقرون فقالوا سحر كذاب
ayahs.translation: To Pharaoh, Hāmān and Qārūn, but they said, "[He is] a magician and a liar."
ayahs.transliteration: i-laa fi-raw-na wa-haa-maa-na wa-qaa-roo-na fa-qaa-loo saa-hi-run kaz-zaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ مِنۡ عِندِنَا قَالُواْ ٱقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَبۡنَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥ وَٱسۡتَحۡيُواْ نِسَآءَهُمۡۚ وَمَا كَيۡدُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: فلما جاءهم بالحق من عندنا قالوا اقتلوا ابناء الذين ءامنوا معه واستحيوا نساءهم وما كيد الكفرين الا في ضلل
ayahs.translation: And when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, "Kill the sons of those who have believed with him and keep their women alive." But the plan of the disbelievers is not except in error.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-ma jaaaa-hum bi-lhaq-qi min in-di-naa qaa-luq tu-looo ab-naaaal lazee-na aa-ma-noo maa-hoo was-ta-hyoo ni-saaaa-hum wa-maa kai-dul kaa-fi-ree-na il-laa fee da-laal

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ذَرُونِيٓ أَقۡتُلۡ مُوسَىٰ وَلۡيَدۡعُ رَبَّهُۥٓۖ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمۡ أَوۡ أَن يُظۡهِرَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلۡفَسَادَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: وقال فرعون ذروني اقتل موسي وليدع ربه اني اخاف ان يبدل دينكم او ان يظهر في الارض الفساد
ayahs.translation: And Pharaoh said, "Let me kill Moses and let him call upon his Lord. Indeed, I fear that he will change your religion or that he will cause corruption in the land."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-la fi-raw-nu za-rooneee aq-tul moo-saa wa-lya-du rab-ba-hoo in-neee a-khaa-fu ai yu-bad-di-la dee-na-kum aw ai yu-zhi-ra fil ar-dil fa-saad

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٖ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: وقال موسي اني عذت بربي وربكم من كل متكبر لا يؤمن بيوم الحساب
ayahs.translation: But Moses said, "Indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-la moo-saaaa in-nee uz-tu bi-rab-bee wa-rab-bi-kum min kul-li mu-ta-kab-bi-ril laa yu-mi-nu biyaw-mil hi-saab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ رَجُلٞ مُّؤۡمِنٞ مِّنۡ ءَالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَكۡتُمُ إِيمَٰنَهُۥٓ أَتَقۡتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَن يَقُولَ رَبِّيَ ٱللَّهُ وَقَدۡ جَآءَكُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ مِن رَّبِّكُمۡۖ وَإِن يَكُ كَٰذِبٗا فَعَلَيۡهِ كَذِبُهُۥۖ وَإِن يَكُ صَادِقٗا يُصِبۡكُم بَعۡضُ ٱلَّذِي يَعِدُكُمۡۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفٞ كَذَّابٞ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: وقال رجل مؤمن من ءال فرعون يكتم ايمنه اتقتلون رجلا ان يقول ربي الله وقد جاءكم بالبينت من ربكم وان يك كذبا فعليه كذبه وان يك صادقا يصبكم بعض الذي يعدكم ان الله لا يهدي من هو مسرف كذاب
ayahs.translation: And a believing man from the family of Pharaoh who concealed his faith said, "Do you kill a man [merely] because he says, 'My Lord is Allāh' while he has brought you clear proofs from your Lord? And if he should be lying, then upon him is [the consequence of] his lie; but if he should be truthful, there will strike you some of what he promises you. Indeed, Allāh does not guide one who is a transgressor and a liar.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-la ra-ju-lum mu-mi-num min aa-li fi-raw-na yak-tu-mu ee-maa-na-hooo a-taq-tu-loo-na ra-ju-lan ai ya-qoo-la rab-bi yal-laa-hu wa-qad jaaaa-kum bil-baiyi-naa-ti mir rab-bi-kum wai-ny ya-ku kaa-zi-ban faa-lai-hi ka-zi-buh wai-ny ya-ku saa-di-qa-ny ya-sib-kum ba-dul lazee yai-du-kum in-nal laa-ha laa yah-dee man hu-wa mus-ri-fun kaz-zaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰقَوۡمِ لَكُمُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ ظَٰهِرِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَمَن يَنصُرُنَا مِنۢ بَأۡسِ ٱللَّهِ إِن جَآءَنَاۚ قَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ مَآ أُرِيكُمۡ إِلَّا مَآ أَرَىٰ وَمَآ أَهۡدِيكُمۡ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: يقوم لكم الملك اليوم ظهرين في الارض فمن ينصرنا من باس الله ان جاءنا قال فرعون ما اريكم الا ما اري وما اهديكم الا سبيل الرشاد
ayahs.translation: O my people, sovereignty is yours today, [your being] dominant in the land. But who would protect us from the punishment of Allāh if it came to us?" Pharaoh said, "I do not show you except what I see, and I do not guide you except to the way of right conduct."
ayahs.transliteration: yaa-qaw-mi la-ku-mul mul-kul yaw-ma zaa-hi-ree-na fil ar-di fa-mai yan-su-ru-naa mim baa-sil laa-hi in jaaaa-naa qaa-la fi-raw-nu maaa uree-kum il-laa maaa a-raa wa-maaa ah-dee-kum il-laa sabee-lar ra-shaad

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِيٓ ءَامَنَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُم مِّثۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: وقال الذي ءامن يقوم اني اخاف عليكم مثل يوم الاحزاب
ayahs.translation: And he who believed said, "O my people, indeed I fear for you [a fate] like the day of the companies -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-lal lazee aa-ma-na yaa-qaw-mi in-neee a-khaa-fu a-lai-kum mis-la yaw-mil ah-zaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: مِثۡلَ دَأۡبِ قَوۡمِ نُوحٖ وَعَادٖ وَثَمُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡۚ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلۡمٗا لِّلۡعِبَادِ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: مثل داب قوم نوح وعاد وثمود والذين من بعدهم وما الله يريد ظلما للعباد
ayahs.translation: Like the custom of the people of Noah and of ʿAad and Thamūd and those after them. And Allāh wants no injustice for [His] servants.
ayahs.transliteration: mis-la daa-bi qaw-mi noo-hinw waaa-dinw wa-sa-moo-da wal-la-zee-na mim ba-di-him wa-mal laa-hu yu-ree-du zul-mal li-li-baad

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلتَّنَادِ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: ويقوم اني اخاف عليكم يوم التناد
ayahs.translation: And O my people, indeed I fear for you the Day of Calling -
ayahs.transliteration: wayaa-qaw-mi in-neee a-khaa-fu a-lai-kum yaw-mat ta-naad

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدۡبِرِينَ مَا لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۡ عَاصِمٖۗ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٖ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: يوم تولون مدبرين ما لكم من الله من عاصم ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد
ayahs.translation: The Day you will turn your backs fleeing; there is not for you from Allāh any protector. And whoever Allāh sends astray - there is not for him any guide.
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma tu-wal-loo-na mud-bi-ree-na maa la-kum mi-nal laa-hi min aa-sim wa-mai yud-li-lil laa-hu fa-maa la-hoo min haad

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبۡلُ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا زِلۡتُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلۡتُمۡ لَن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ رَسُولٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفٞ مُّرۡتَابٌ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد جاءكم يوسف من قبل بالبينت فما زلتم في شك مما جاءكم به حتي اذا هلك قلتم لن يبعث الله من بعده رسولا كذلك يضل الله من هو مسرف مرتاب
ayahs.translation: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad jaaaa-kum yoo-su-fu min qab-lu bil-baiyi-naa-ti fa-maa zil-tum fee shak-kim mi-maa jaaaa-kum bihee hat-taaa i-zaa ha-la-ka qul-tum lai ya-ba-sal laa-hu mim ba-dihee ra-soo-laa ka-zaa-li-ka yu-dil-lul laa-hu man hu-wa mus-ri-fum mur-taab

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ سُلۡطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمۡۖ كَبُرَ مَقۡتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعِندَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَطۡبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ قَلۡبِ مُتَكَبِّرٖ جَبَّارٖ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: الذين يجدلون في ءايت الله بغير سلطن اتيهم كبر مقتا عند الله وعند الذين ءامنوا كذلك يطبع الله علي كل قلب متكبر جبار
ayahs.translation: Those who dispute concerning the signs of Allāh without an authority having come to them - great is hatred [of them] in the sight of Allāh and in the sight of those who have believed. Thus does Allāh seal over every heart [belonging to] an arrogant tyrant.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na yu-jaa-di-loo-na feee aaayaa-til laa-hi bi-ghai-ri sul-taa-nin a-taa-hum ka-bu-ra maq-tan in-dal laa-hi wain-dal lazee-na aa-ma-noo ka-zaa-li-ka yat-ba-hul laa-hu a-laa kul-li qal-bi mu-ta-kab-bi-rin jab-baar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ يَٰهَٰمَٰنُ ٱبۡنِ لِي صَرۡحٗا لَّعَلِّيٓ أَبۡلُغُ ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبَ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: وقال فرعون يهمن ابن لي صرحا لعلي ابلغ الاسبب
ayahs.translation: And Pharaoh said, "O Hāmān, construct for me a tower that I might reach the ways -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-la fi-raw-nu yaa-haa-maa-nu ib-ni lee sa-rhal laal-leee ab-lu-ghul as-baab

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَسۡبَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَٰذِبٗاۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِۚ وَمَا كَيۡدُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِلَّا فِي تَبَابٖ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: اسبب السموت فاطلع الي اله موسي واني لاظنه كذبا وكذلك زين لفرعون سوء عمله وصد عن السبيل وما كيد فرعون الا في تباب
ayahs.translation: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin.
ayahs.transliteration: as-baa-bas sa-maa-waa-ti faat-ta-li-a i-laaa i-laa-hi moo-saa wain-nee laa-zun-nu-hoo kaa-zi-baa wa-ka-zaa-li-ka zuyyi-na li-fi-raw-na sooou a-ma-lihee wa-sud-da a-nis sabeel wa-maa kai-du fi-raw-na il-laa fee ta-baab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِيٓ ءَامَنَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱتَّبِعُونِ أَهۡدِكُمۡ سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: وقال الذي ءامن يقوم اتبعون اهدكم سبيل الرشاد
ayahs.translation: And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me; I will guide you to the way of right conduct.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-lal lazeee aa-ma-na yaa-qaw-mit ta-bioo-ni ah-di-kum sabee-lar ra-shaad

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنَّمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا مَتَٰعٞ وَإِنَّ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ هِيَ دَارُ ٱلۡقَرَارِ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: يقوم انما هذه الحيوة الدنيا متع وان الاخرة هي دار القرار
ayahs.translation: O my people, this worldly life is only [temporary] enjoyment, and indeed, the Hereafter - that is the home of [permanent] settlement.
ayahs.transliteration: yaa-qaw-mi in-na-maa haa-zi-hil hayaa-tud du-nyaa ma-taaunw wain-nal aa-khi-ra-ta hiya daa-rul qa-raar

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَنۡ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةٗ فَلَا يُجۡزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثۡلَهَاۖ وَمَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوۡ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُونَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ يُرۡزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: من عمل سيئة فلا يجزي الا مثلها ومن عمل صلحا من ذكر او انثي وهو مؤمن فاولئك يدخلون الجنة يرزقون فيها بغير حساب
ayahs.translation: Whoever does an evil deed will not be recompensed except by the like thereof; but whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - those will enter Paradise, being given provision therein without account.
ayahs.transliteration: man a-mi-la saiyi-a-tan fa-laa yuj-zaaa il-laa mis-la-haa wa-man a-mi-la saa-li-ham min za-ka-rin aw un-saa wa-hu-wa mu-mi-nun fau-laaai-ka yad-khu-loo-nal jan-na-ta yur-za-qoo-na fee-haa bi-ghai-ri hi-saab

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَيَٰقَوۡمِ مَا لِيٓ أَدۡعُوكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلنَّجَوٰةِ وَتَدۡعُونَنِيٓ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: ويقوم ما لي ادعوكم الي النجوة وتدعونني الي النار
ayahs.translation: And O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire?
ayahs.transliteration: wayaa-qaw-mi maa leee a-doo-kum i-lan na-jaa-ti wa-ta-doo-na-neee i-lan naar

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَدۡعُونَنِي لِأَكۡفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَأُشۡرِكَ بِهِۦ مَا لَيۡسَ لِي بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞ وَأَنَا۠ أَدۡعُوكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرِ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: تدعونني لاكفر بالله واشرك به ما ليس لي به علم وانا ادعوكم الي العزيز الغفر
ayahs.translation: You invite me to disbelieve in Allāh and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
ayahs.transliteration: ta-doo-na-nee li-a-kfu-ra bil-laa-hi waus-hri-ka bihee maa lai-sa lee bihee il-munw waa-na a-doo-kum i-lal azee-zil ghaf-faar

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدۡعُونَنِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ لَيۡسَ لَهُۥ دَعۡوَةٞ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَلَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: لا جرم انما تدعونني اليه ليس له دعوة في الدنيا ولا في الاخرة وان مردنا الي الله وان المسرفين هم اصحب النار
ayahs.translation: Assuredly, that to which you invite me has no [response to a] supplication in this world or in the Hereafter; and indeed, our return is to Allāh, and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the Fire.
ayahs.transliteration: laa ja-ra-ma an-na-maa ta-doo-na-nee i-lai-hi lai-sa la-hoo da-wa-tun fid du-nyaa wa-laa fil aa-khi-ra-ti waan-na ma-rad-da-naaa i-lal laa-hi waan-nal mus-ri-fee-na hum a-shaa-bun naar

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَسَتَذۡكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمۡۚ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمۡرِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرُۢ بِٱلۡعِبَادِ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: فستذكرون ما اقول لكم وافوض امري الي الله ان الله بصير بالعباد
ayahs.translation: And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Seeing of [His] servants."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-sa-taz-ku-roo-na maaa a-qoo-lu la-kum wau-faw-wi-du am-reee i-lal laah in-nal laa-ha basee-rum bi-li-baad

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُواْۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: فوقيه الله سيات ما مكروا وحاق بال فرعون سوء العذاب
ayahs.translation: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment -
ayahs.transliteration: fa-wa-qaa-hul laa-hu saiyi-a-a-ti maa ma-ka-roo wa-haa-qa bi-a-a-li fi-raw-na soooul a-zaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلنَّارُ يُعۡرَضُونَ عَلَيۡهَا غُدُوّٗا وَعَشِيّٗاۚ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡخِلُوٓاْ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ أَشَدَّ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: النار يعرضون عليها غدوا وعشيا ويوم تقوم الساعة ادخلوا ءال فرعون اشد العذاب
ayahs.translation: The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening. And the Day the Hour appears [it will be said], "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment."
ayahs.transliteration: an-naa-ru yu-ra-doo-na a-lai-haa ghu-duw-wanw waa-shiyyanw wayaw-ma ta-qoo-mus saaaa-tu ad-khi-looo aa-la fi-raw-na a-shad-dal a-zaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ يَتَحَآجُّونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ فَيَقُولُ ٱلضُّعَفَٰٓؤُاْ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمۡ تَبَعٗا فَهَلۡ أَنتُم مُّغۡنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبٗا مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ ٤٧
