ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-man sa-ba-ra wa-gha-fa-ra in-na zaa-li-ka la-min az-mil u-moor

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن وَلِيّٖ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦۗ وَتَرَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلۡ إِلَىٰ مَرَدّٖ مِّن سَبِيلٖ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: ومن يضلل الله فما له من ولي من بعده وتري الظلمين لما راوا العذاب يقولون هل الي مرد من سبيل
ayahs.translation: And he whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return [to the former world] any way?"
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mai yud-li lil-laa-hu fa-maa la-hoo minw wa-liyyin min ba-dih wa-ta-raz zaa-li-mee-na lam-maa raa-wul a-zaa-ba ya-qoo-loo-na hal i-laa ma-rad-din min sabeel

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَرَىٰهُمۡ يُعۡرَضُونَ عَلَيۡهَا خَٰشِعِينَ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرۡفٍ خَفِيّٖۗ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِي عَذَابٖ مُّقِيمٖ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: وتريهم يعرضون عليها خشعين من الذل ينظرون من طرف خفي وقال الذين ءامنوا ان الخسرين الذين خسروا انفسهم واهليهم يوم القيمة الا ان الظلمين في عذاب مقيم
ayahs.translation: And you will see them being exposed to it [i.e., the Fire], humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-raa-hum yu-ra-doo-na a-lai-haa khaa-shiee-na mi-naz zul-li yan-zu-roo-na min tar-fin khai-fiyy wa-qaa-lal lazee-na aa-ma-nooo in-nal khaa-si-ree-nal lazee-na kha-si-rooo an-fu-sa-hum waah-lee-him yaw-mal qiyaa-mah a-laaa in-naz zaa-li-mee-na fee a-zaa-bin muqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَ يَنصُرُونَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن سَبِيلٍ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: وما كان لهم من اولياء ينصرونهم من دون الله ومن يضلل الله فما له من سبيل
ayahs.translation: And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allāh. And whoever Allāh sends astray - for him there is no way.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa kaa-na la-hum min aw-liyaaaa yan-su-roo-na-hum min doo-nil laah wa-mai yud-li-lil laa-hu fa-maa la-hoo min sabeel

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱسۡتَجِيبُواْ لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ يَوۡمٞ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِۚ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلۡجَإٖ يَوۡمَئِذٖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٖ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: استجيبوا لربكم من قبل ان ياتي يوم لا مرد له من الله ما لكم من ملجا يومئذ وما لكم من نكير
ayahs.translation: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that Day, nor for you will there be any denial.
ayahs.transliteration: is-ta-jee-boo li-rab-bi-kum min qab-li a-ny yaa-tiya yaw-mul laa ma-rad-da la-hoo min al-lah maa la-kum min mal-jai-ny yaw-mai-zinw wa-maa la-kum min nakeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِنۡ أَعۡرَضُواْ فَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَفِيظًاۖ إِنۡ عَلَيۡكَ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُۗ وَإِنَّآ إِذَآ أَذَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِنَّا رَحۡمَةٗ فَرِحَ بِهَاۖ وَإِن تُصِبۡهُمۡ سَيِّئَةُۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ كَفُورٞ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: فان اعرضوا فما ارسلنك عليهم حفيظا ان عليك الا البلغ وانا اذا اذقنا الانسن منا رحمة فرح بها وان تصبهم سيئة بما قدمت ايديهم فان الانسن كفور
ayahs.translation: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful.
ayahs.transliteration: fain a-ra-doo fa-maaa ar-sal-naa-ka a-lai-him hafee-zan in a-lai-ka il-lal ba-laagh wain-naaa i-zaaa a-zaq-nal in-saa-na min-naa rah-ma-tan fa-ri-ha bi-haa wain tu-si-bhum saiyi-a-tun bi-maa qad-da-mat ay-dee-him fain-nal in-saa-na ka-foor

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِّلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ إِنَٰثٗا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ٱلذُّكُورَ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: لله ملك السموت والارض يخلق ما يشاء يهب لمن يشاء انثا ويهب لمن يشاء الذكور
ayahs.translation: To Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what He wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.
ayahs.transliteration: lil-laa-hi mul-kus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lard yak-hlu-qu maa ya-shaaa ya-ha-bu li-mai ya-shaaau i-naa-sanw waya-ha-bu li-mai ya-shaaauz zu-koor

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوۡ يُزَوِّجُهُمۡ ذُكۡرَانٗا وَإِنَٰثٗاۖ وَيَجۡعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيمًاۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٞ قَدِيرٞ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: او يزوجهم ذكرانا وانثا ويجعل من يشاء عقيما انه عليم قدير
ayahs.translation: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.
ayahs.transliteration: aw yu-zaw-wi-ju-hum zuk-raa-nanw wai-naa-sanw waya-ja-lu mai ya-shaaau aqee-maa in-na-hoo alee-mun qadeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحۡيًا أَوۡ مِن وَرَآيِٕ حِجَابٍ أَوۡ يُرۡسِلَ رَسُولٗا فَيُوحِيَ بِإِذۡنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٞ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: وما كان لبشر ان يكلمه الله الا وحيا او من وراي حجاب او يرسل رسولا فيوحي باذنه ما يشاء انه علي حكيم
ayahs.translation: And it is not for any human being that Allāh should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger [i.e., angel] to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa kaa-na li-ba-sha-rin a-ny yu-kal-li-ma-hul laa-hu il-laa wa-hyan aw minw wa-raaai hi-jaa-bin aw yur-si-la ra-soo-lan fayoo-hiya biiz-nihee maa ya-shaaa in-na-hoo a-liyyun hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ رُوحٗا مِّنۡ أَمۡرِنَاۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدۡرِي مَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ وَلَا ٱلۡإِيمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِن جَعَلۡنَٰهُ نُورٗا نَّهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَاۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهۡدِيٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: وكذلك اوحينا اليك روحا من امرنا ما كنت تدري ما الكتب ولا الايمن ولكن جعلنه نورا نهدي به من نشاء من عبادنا وانك لتهدي الي صرط مستقيم
ayahs.translation: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command [i.e., the Qur’ān]. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you guide to a straight path -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ka-zaa-li-ka a-whai-naaa i-lai-ka roo-han min am-ri-naa maa kun-ta tad-ree mal ki-taa-bu wa-lal ee-maa-nu wa-laa-kin jaal-naa-hu noo-ran nah-dee bihee man na-shaaau min i-baa-di-naa wain-na-ka la-tah-deee i-laaa sa-raa-tin mus-taqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: صِرَٰطِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَلَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَصِيرُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: صرط الله الذي له ما في السموت وما في الارض الا الي الله تصير الامور
ayahs.translation: The path of Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allāh do [all] matters evolve [i.e., return].
ayahs.transliteration: si-raa-til laa-hil lazee la-hoo maa fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-maa fil ard a-laaa i-lal laa-hi tasee-rul u-moor

ayahs.text_uthmani: حمٓ ١
ayahs.text_simple: حم
ayahs.translation: Ḥā, Meem.
ayahs.transliteration: haameeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: والكتب المبين
ayahs.translation: By the clear Book,
ayahs.transliteration: wal-ki-taa-bil mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَٰنًا عَرَبِيّٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: انا جعلنه قرءنا عربيا لعلكم تعقلون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa jaal-naa-hu qu-raa-nan a-ra-biyyal laal-la-kum ta-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِيٓ أُمِّ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَدَيۡنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: وانه في ام الكتب لدينا لعلي حكيم
ayahs.translation: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na-hoo feee um-mil ki-taa-bi la-dai-naa laa-liyyun hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَنَضۡرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَ صَفۡحًا أَن كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا مُّسۡرِفِينَ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: افنضرب عنكم الذكر صفحا ان كنتم قوما مسرفين
ayahs.translation: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-nad-ri-bu an-ku-muz zik-ra sa-fhan an kun-tum qaw-man mus-rifeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَمۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن نَّبِيّٖ فِي ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: وكم ارسلنا من نبي في الاولين
ayahs.translation: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kam ar-sal-naa min na-biyyin fil aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: وما ياتيهم من نبي الا كانوا به يستهزءون
ayahs.translation: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa yaa-tee-him min na-biyyin il-laa kaa-noo bihee yas-tah-zioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشٗا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: فاهلكنا اشد منهم بطشا ومضي مثل الاولين
ayahs.translation: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
ayahs.transliteration: faah-lak-naaa a-shad-da mi-nhum bat-shanw wa-ma-daa ma-sa-lul aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: ولئن سالتهم من خلق السموت والارض ليقولن خلقهن العزيز العليم
ayahs.translation: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,"
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lain saal-ta-hum man kha-la-qas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da laya-qoo-lun-na kha-la-qa-hun-nal azee-zul aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَهۡدٗا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا سُبُلٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: الذي جعل لكم الارض مهدا وجعل لكم فيها سبلا لعلكم تهتدون
ayahs.translation: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee jaa-la la-ku-mul ar-da mah-danw wa-jaa-la la-kum fee-haa su-bu-lan laal-la-kum tah-ta-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِي نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءَۢ بِقَدَرٖ فَأَنشَرۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةٗ مَّيۡتٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُونَ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: والذي نزل من السماء ماء بقدر فانشرنا به بلدة ميتا كذلك تخرجون
ayahs.translation: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
ayahs.transliteration: wal-lazee naz-za-la mi-nas sa-maaai maaaam bi-qa-da-rin faan-shar-naa bihee bal-da-tam mai-taa ka-zaa-li-ka tuk-hra-joon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡفُلۡكِ وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ مَا تَرۡكَبُونَ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: والذي خلق الازوج كلها وجعل لكم من الفلك والانعم ما تركبون
ayahs.translation: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount
ayahs.transliteration: wal-lazee kha-la-qal az-waa-ja kul-la-haa wa-jaa-la la-kum mi-nal ful-ki wa-la-naa-mi maa tar-ka-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِتَسۡتَوُۥاْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَةَ رَبِّكُمۡ إِذَا ٱسۡتَوَيۡتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَتَقُولُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقۡرِنِينَ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: لتستوا علي ظهوره ثم تذكروا نعمة ربكم اذا استويتم عليه وتقولوا سبحن الذي سخر لنا هذا وما كنا له مقرنين
ayahs.translation: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.
ayahs.transliteration: li-tas-ta-woo a-laa zu-hoo-rihee sum-ma taz-ku-roo ni-ma-ta rab-bi-kum i-za sta-wai-tum a-lai-hi wa-ta-qoo-loo su-bhaa-nal lazee sak-hkha-ra la-na haa-za wa-maa kun-naa la-hoo muq-rineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: وانا الي ربنا لمنقلبون
ayahs.translation: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."
ayahs.transliteration: wain-naaa i-laa rab-bi-naa la-mun-qa-li-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُواْ لَهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزۡءًاۚ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٞ مُّبِينٌ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: وجعلوا له من عباده جزءا ان الانسن لكفور مبين
ayahs.translation: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaa-loo la-hoo min i-baa-dihee ju-zaa in-nal in-saa-na la-ka-foo-run mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ بَنَاتٖ وَأَصۡفَىٰكُم بِٱلۡبَنِينَ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: ام اتخذ مما يخلق بنات واصفيكم بالبنين
ayahs.translation: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
ayahs.transliteration: a-mit ta-kha-za mim-maa yak-hlu-qu ba-naa-tinw waas-faa-kum bil-baneen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مَثَلٗا ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهُۥ مُسۡوَدّٗا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: واذا بشر احدهم بما ضرب للرحمن مثلا ظل وجهه مسودا وهو كظيم
ayahs.translation: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison [i.e., a daughter], his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa bus-hshi-ra a-ha-du-hum bi-maa da-ra-ba lir-rah-maa-ni ma-sa-lan zal-la wa-jhu-hoo mus-wad-danw wa-hu-wa kazeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُاْ فِي ٱلۡحِلۡيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي ٱلۡخِصَامِ غَيۡرُ مُبِينٖ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: اومن ينشؤا في الحلية وهو في الخصام غير مبين
ayahs.translation: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allāh]?
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-mai yu-nas-hshau fil hi-lya-ti wa-hu-wa fil khi-saa-mi ghai-ru mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُواْ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًاۚ أَشَهِدُواْ خَلۡقَهُمۡۚ سَتُكۡتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمۡ وَيُسۡـَٔلُونَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: وجعلوا الملئكة الذين هم عبد الرحمن انثا اشهدوا خلقهم ستكتب شهدتهم ويسلون
ayahs.translation: And they described the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, as females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaa-lul ma-laaai-ka-tal lazee-na hum i-baa-dur rah-maa-ni i-naa-saa a-sha-hi-doo khal-qa-hum sa-tuk-ta-bu sha-haa-da-tu-hum wayu-sa-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدۡنَٰهُمۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَخۡرُصُونَ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا لو شاء الرحمن ما عبدنهم ما لهم بذلك من علم ان هم الا يخرصون
ayahs.translation: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but misjudging.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-loo law shaaaar rah-maa-nu maa a-bad-naa-hum maa la-hum bi-zaa-li-ka min il-min in hum il-laa yak-hru-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ كِتَٰبٗا مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسۡتَمۡسِكُونَ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: ام ءاتينهم كتبا من قبله فهم به مستمسكون
ayahs.translation: Or have We given them a book before it [i.e., the Qur’ān] to which they are adhering?
ayahs.transliteration: am aa-tai-naa-hum ki-taa-ban min qab-lihee fa-hum bihee mus-tam-si-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّهۡتَدُونَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: بل قالوا انا وجدنا ءاباءنا علي امة وانا علي ءاثرهم مهتدون
ayahs.translation: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."
ayahs.transliteration: bal qaa-looo in-naa wa-jad-naaa aa-baaaa-naa a-laaa um-ma-tinw wain-naa a-laaa aa-saa-ri-him muh-ta-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ فِي قَرۡيَةٖ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتۡرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّقۡتَدُونَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: وكذلك ما ارسلنا من قبلك في قرية من نذير الا قال مترفوها انا وجدنا ءاباءنا علي امة وانا علي ءاثرهم مقتدون
ayahs.translation: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ka-zaa-li-ka maaa ar-sal-naa min qab-li-ka fee qa-rya-tim min nazee-rin il-laa qaa-la mut-ra-foo-haaa in-naa wa-jad-naaa aa-baaaa-naa a-laaa um-ma-tinw wain-naa a-laaa aa-saa-ri-him muq-ta-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ قَٰلَ أَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِأَهۡدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمۡ عَلَيۡهِ ءَابَآءَكُمۡۖ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرۡسِلۡتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: قل اولو جئتكم باهدي مما وجدتم عليه ءاباءكم قالوا انا بما ارسلتم به كفرون
ayahs.translation: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la a-wa-law ji-tu-kum bi-a-hdaa mim-maa wa-jat-dtum a-lai-hi aa-baaaa-kum qaa-looo in-naa bi-maaa ur-sil-tum bihee kaa-fi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡۖ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: فانتقمنا منهم فانظر كيف كان عقبة المكذبين
ayahs.translation: So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
ayahs.transliteration: fan-ta-qam-naa mi-nhum fan-zur kai-fa kaa-na aa-qi-ba-tul mu-kaz-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِي بَرَآءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡبُدُونَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: واذ قال ابرهيم لابيه وقومه انني براء مما تعبدون
ayahs.translation: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
ayahs.transliteration: waiz qaa-la ib-raa-hee-mu li-a-bee-hi wa-qaw-miheee in-na-ne ba-raaaum mim-maa ta-bu-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهۡدِينِ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: الا الذي فطرني فانه سيهدين
ayahs.translation: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."
ayahs.transliteration: il-lal lazee fa-ta-ranee fain-na-hoo sayah-deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةَۢ بَاقِيَةٗ فِي عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: وجعلها كلمة باقية في عقبه لعلهم يرجعون
ayahs.translation: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaa-la-haa ka-li-ma-tan baa-qiya-tan fee a-qi-bihee laal-la-hum yar-jioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَرَسُولٞ مُّبِينٞ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: بل متعت هؤلاء وءاباءهم حتي جاءهم الحق ورسول مبين
ayahs.translation: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.
ayahs.transliteration: bal mat-ta-tu haaau-laaai waaa-baaaa-hum hat-taa jaaaa-hu-mul haq-qu wa-ra-soo-lun mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرٞ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: ولما جاءهم الحق قالوا هذا سحر وانا به كفرون
ayahs.translation: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lam-maa jaaaa-hu-mul haq-qu qaa-loo haa-zaa sih-runw wain-naa bihee kaa-fi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيمٍ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا لولا نزل هذا القرءان علي رجل من القريتين عظيم
ayahs.translation: And they said, "Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-loo law-laa nuz-zi-la haa-zal qu-raa-nu a-laa ra-ju-lin mi-nal qa-rya-tai-ni azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَهُمۡ يَقۡسِمُونَ رَحۡمَتَ رَبِّكَۚ نَحۡنُ قَسَمۡنَا بَيۡنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٖ دَرَجَٰتٖ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُهُم بَعۡضٗا سُخۡرِيّٗاۗ وَرَحۡمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٞ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُونَ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: اهم يقسمون رحمت ربك نحن قسمنا بينهم معيشتهم في الحيوة الدنيا ورفعنا بعضهم فوق بعض درجت ليتخذ بعضهم بعضا سخريا ورحمت ربك خير مما يجمعون
ayahs.translation: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
ayahs.transliteration: a-hum yaq-si-moo-na rah-ma-ta rab-bik nah-nu qa-sam-naa bai-na-hum maee-sha-ta-hum fil hayaa-tid du-nyaa wa-ra-fa-naa ba-da-hum faw-qa ba-din da-ra-jaa-tin liyat-ta-khi-za ba-du-hum ba-dan suk-hriyyaa wa-rah-ma-tu rab-bi-ka khai-run mim-maa yaj-maoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ لَّجَعَلۡنَا لِمَن يَكۡفُرُ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمۡ سُقُفٗا مِّن فِضَّةٖ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيۡهَا يَظۡهَرُونَ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولولا ان يكون الناس امة وحدة لجعلنا لمن يكفر بالرحمن لبيوتهم سقفا من فضة ومعارج عليها يظهرون
ayahs.translation: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law-laaa a-ny ya-koo-nan naa-su um-ma-tanw waa-hi-da-tan la-jaal-naa li-ma-ny yak-fu-ru bir-rah-maa-ni li-buyoo-ti-him su-qu-fan min fid-da-tinw wa-maaa-ri-ja a-lai-haa ya-zha-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمۡ أَبۡوَٰبٗا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيۡهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولبيوتهم ابوبا وسررا عليها يتكون
ayahs.translation: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
ayahs.transliteration: wa-li-buyoo-ti-him ab-waa-banw wa-su-ru-ran a-lai-haa yat-ta-kioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَزُخۡرُفٗاۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: وزخرفا وان كل ذلك لما متع الحيوة الدنيا والاخرة عند ربك للمتقين
ayahs.translation: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-zuk-hru-faa wain kul-lu zaa-li-ka lam-maa ma-taaul hayaa-tid du-nyaa wa-laa-khi-ra-tu in-da rab-bi-ka lil-mut-taqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَن يَعۡشُ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضۡ لَهُۥ شَيۡطَٰنٗا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٞ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: ومن يعش عن ذكر الرحمن نقيض له شيطنا فهو له قرين
ayahs.translation: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mai ya-shu an zik-rir rah-maa-ni nu-qaiyid la-hoo shai-taa-nan fa-hu-wa la-hoo qareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: وانهم ليصدونهم عن السبيل ويحسبون انهم مهتدون
ayahs.translation: And indeed, they [i.e., the devils] avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na-hum laya-sud-doo-na-hum a-nis sabee-li wayah-sa-boo-na an-na-hum muh-ta-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكَ بُعۡدَ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرِينُ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: حتي اذا جاءنا قال يليت بيني وبينك بعد المشرقين فبئس القرين
ayahs.translation: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "How I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west; and what a wretched companion."
ayahs.transliteration: hat-taaa i-zaa jaaaa-naa qaa-la yaa-lai-ta bainee wa-bai-na-ka bu-dal mas-hri-qai-ni fa-bi-sal qareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ إِذ ظَّلَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: ولن ينفعكم اليوم اذ ظلمتم انكم في العذاب مشتركون
ayahs.translation: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lai yan-faa-ku-mul yaw-ma iz za-lam-tum an-na-kum fil a-zaa-bi mus-hta-ri-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَأَنتَ تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوۡ تَهۡدِي ٱلۡعُمۡيَ وَمَن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: افانت تسمع الصم او تهدي العمي ومن كان في ضلل مبين
ayahs.translation: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muḥammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
ayahs.transliteration: a-faan-ta tus-mius sum-ma aw tah-dil u-mya wa-man kaa-na fee da-laa-lin mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِمَّا نَذۡهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنۡهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: فاما نذهبن بك فانا منهم منتقمون
ayahs.translation: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
ayahs.transliteration: faim-maa na-zha-ban-na bi-ka fain-naa mi-nhum mun-ta-qi-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوۡ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِي وَعَدۡنَٰهُمۡ فَإِنَّا عَلَيۡهِم مُّقۡتَدِرُونَ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: او نرينك الذي وعدنهم فانا عليهم مقتدرون
ayahs.translation: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
ayahs.transliteration: aw nu-riyan-na-kal lazee waad-naa-hum fain-naa a-lai-him muq-ta-di-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱسۡتَمۡسِكۡ بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: فاستمسك بالذي اوحي اليك انك علي صرط مستقيم
ayahs.translation: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
ayahs.transliteration: fas-tam-sik bil-lazeee oo-hiya i-lai-ka in-na-ka a-laa si-raa-tin mus-taqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكۡرٞ لَّكَ وَلِقَوۡمِكَۖ وَسَوۡفَ تُسۡـَٔلُونَ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: وانه لذكر لك ولقومك وسوف تسلون
ayahs.translation: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na-hoo la-zik-run la-ka wa-li-qaw-mi-ka wa-saw-fa tu-sa-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَسۡـَٔلۡ مَنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلۡنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةٗ يُعۡبَدُونَ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: وسل من ارسلنا من قبلك من رسلنا اجعلنا من دون الرحمن ءالهة يعبدون
ayahs.translation: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-sal man ar-sal-naa min qab-li-ka mir ru-su-li-naaa a-jaal-naa min doo-nir rah-maa-ni aa-li-ha-ta-ny yu-ba-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ارسلنا موسي بايتنا الي فرعون وملايه فقال اني رسول رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad ar-sal-naa moo-saa bi-a-ayaa-ti-naaa i-laa fi-raw-na wa-ma-laihee fa-qaa-la in-nee ra-soo-lu rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنۡهَا يَضۡحَكُونَ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: فلما جاءهم بايتنا اذا هم منها يضحكون
ayahs.translation: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-ma jaaaa-hum bi-a-ayaa-ti-naaa i-zaa hum mi-nhaa ya-dha-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ أُخۡتِهَاۖ وَأَخَذۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: وما نريهم من ءاية الا هي اكبر من اختها واخذنهم بالعذاب لعلهم يرجعون
ayahs.translation: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa nuree-him min aaya-tin il-laa hiya ak-ba-ru min uk-hti-haa waa-khaz-naa-hum bi-la-zaa-bi laal-la-hum yar-jioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهۡتَدُونَ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا يايه الساحر ادع لنا ربك بما عهد عندك اننا لمهتدون
ayahs.translation: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-loo yaaaayyu-has saa-hir u-du la-naa rab-ba-ka bi-maa a-hi-da in-da-ka in-na-naa la-muh-ta-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمۡ يَنكُثُونَ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: فلما كشفنا عنهم العذاب اذا هم ينكثون
ayahs.translation: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa ka-shaf-naa a-nhu-mul a-zaa-ba i-zaa hum yan-ku-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَادَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِي قَوۡمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَلَيۡسَ لِي مُلۡكُ مِصۡرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِيٓۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: ونادي فرعون في قومه قال يقوم اليس لي ملك مصر وهذه الانهر تجري من تحتي افلا تبصرون
ayahs.translation: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-naa-daa fi-raw-nu fee qaw-mihee qaa-la yaa-qaw-mi a-lai-sa lee mul-ku mis-ra wa-haa-zi-hil a-nhaa-ru taj-ree min tah-tee a-fa-laa tub-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٞ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: ام انا خير من هذا الذي هو مهين ولا يكاد يبين
ayahs.translation: Or am I [not] better than this one [i.e., Moses] who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?
ayahs.transliteration: am a-na khai-run min haa-zal lazee hu-wa mahee-nunw wa-laa ya-kaa-du yu-been

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَوۡلَآ أُلۡقِيَ عَلَيۡهِ أَسۡوِرَةٞ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مُقۡتَرِنِينَ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: فلولا القي عليه اسورة من ذهب او جاء معه الملئكة مقترنين
ayahs.translation: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
ayahs.transliteration: fa-law-laa ul-qiya a-lai-hi as-wi-ra-tun min za-ha-bin aw jaaaa maa-hul ma-laaai-ka-tu muq-ta-rineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱسۡتَخَفَّ قَوۡمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: فاستخف قومه فاطاعوه انهم كانوا قوما فسقين
ayahs.translation: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: fas-ta-khaf-fa qaw-ma-hoo faa-taaooh in-na-hum kaa-noo qaw-man faa-siqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: فلما ءاسفونا انتقمنا منهم فاغرقنهم اجمعين
ayahs.translation: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maaa aa-sa-foo-nan ta-qam-naa mi-nhum faag-hraq-naa-hum aj-maeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ سَلَفٗا وَمَثَلٗا لِّلۡأٓخِرِينَ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: فجعلنهم سلفا ومثلا للاخرين
ayahs.translation: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-jaal-naa-hum sa-la-fanw wa-ma-sa-lan li-laa-khireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡهُ يَصِدُّونَ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولما ضرب ابن مريم مثلا اذا قومك منه يصدون
ayahs.translation: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lam-maa du-ri-bab nu ma-rya-ma ma-sa-lan i-zaa qaw-mu-ka mi-nhu ya-sid-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓاْ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ هُوَۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلَۢاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ خَصِمُونَ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا ءالهتنا خير ام هو ما ضربوه لك الا جدلا بل هم قوم خصمون
ayahs.translation: And they said, "Are our gods better, or is he?" They did not present it [i.e., the comparison] except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-looo aaa-li-ha-tu-naa khai-run am hoo maa da-ra-boo-hu la-ka il-laa ja-da-laa bal hum qaw-mun kha-si-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبۡدٌ أَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ مَثَلٗا لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: ان هو الا عبد انعمنا عليه وجعلنه مثلا لبني اسرءيل
ayahs.translation: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
ayahs.transliteration: in hu-wa il-laa ab-dun a-nam-naa a-lai-hi wa-jaal-naa-hu ma-sa-lan li-baneee is-raaaeel

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةٗ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَخۡلُفُونَ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: ولو نشاء لجعلنا منكم ملئكة في الارض يخلفون
ayahs.translation: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law na-shaaau la-jaal-naa min-kum ma-laaai-ka-tan fil ar-di yak-hlu-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلۡمٞ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمۡتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: وانه لعلم للساعة فلا تمترن بها واتبعون هذا صرط مستقيم
ayahs.translation: And indeed, he [i.e., Jesus] will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na-hoo lail-mun lis-saaa-ti fa-laa tam-ta-run-na bi-haa wat-ta-bioon haa-zaa si-raa-tun mus-taqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: ولا يصدنكم الشيطن انه لكم عدو مبين
ayahs.translation: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa ya-sud-dan-na-ku-mush shai-taa-nu in-na-hoo la-kum a-duw-wun mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِٱلۡحِكۡمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي تَخۡتَلِفُونَ فِيهِۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولما جاء عيسي بالبينت قال قد جئتكم بالحكمة ولابين لكم بعض الذي تختلفون فيه فاتقوا الله واطيعون
ayahs.translation: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom [i.e., prophethood] and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allāh and obey me.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lam-maa jaaaa ee-saa bil-baiyi-naa-ti qaa-la qad ji-tu-kum bi-lhik-ma-ti wa-liu-baiyi-na la-kum ba-dal lazee tak-hta-li-foo-na fee-hi fat-ta-qul laa-ha waatee-o-on

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ ٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان الله هو ربي وربكم فاعبدوه هذا صرط مستقيم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal laa-ha hu-wa rab-bee wa-rab-bu-kum fa-bu-dooh haa-za si-raa-tum mus-taqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱخۡتَلَفَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡۖ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمٍ أَلِيمٍ ٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: فاختلف الاحزاب من بينهم فويل للذين ظلموا من عذاب يوم اليم
ayahs.translation: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
ayahs.transliteration: fak-hta-la-fal ah-zaa-bu min bai-ni-him fa-wai-lun lil-la-zee-na za-la-moo min a-zaa-bi yaw-min aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ ٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: هل ينظرون الا الساعة ان تاتيهم بغتة وهم لا يشعرون
ayahs.translation: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
ayahs.transliteration: hal yan-zu-roo-na il-las saaa-ta an ta-tiya-hum bag-hta-tanw wa-hum laa ya-shu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلۡأَخِلَّآءُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ ٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: الاخلاء يومئذ بعضهم لبعض عدو الا المتقين
ayahs.translation: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
ayahs.transliteration: a-la-khil-laaau yaw-mai-zin ba-du-hum li-ba-din a-duw-wun il-lal mut-taqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُونَ ٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: يعباد لا خوف عليكم اليوم ولا انتم تحزنون
ayahs.translation: [To whom Allāh will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
ayahs.transliteration: yaai-baa-di laa khaw-fun a-lai-ku-mul yaw-ma wa-laaa an-tum tah-za-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُواْ مُسۡلِمِينَ ٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: الذين ءامنوا بايتنا وكانوا مسلمين
ayahs.translation: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo bi-a-ayaa-ti-naa wa-kaa-noo mus-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ أَنتُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُكُمۡ تُحۡبَرُونَ ٧٠
ayahs.text_simple: ادخلوا الجنة انتم وازوجكم تحبرون
ayahs.translation: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."
ayahs.transliteration: ud-khu-lul jan-na-ta an-tum waaz-waa-ju-kum tuh-ba-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِصِحَافٖ مِّن ذَهَبٖ وَأَكۡوَابٖۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيهِ ٱلۡأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنُۖ وَأَنتُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ ٧١
ayahs.text_simple: يطاف عليهم بصحاف من ذهب واكواب وفيها ما تشتهيه الانفس وتلذ الاعين وانتم فيها خلدون
ayahs.translation: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
ayahs.transliteration: yu-taa-fu a-lai-him bi-si-haa-fim min za-ha-binw waak-waab wafee-haa maa tas-hta-hee-hil an-fu-su wa-ta-laz-zul ayu-nu waan-tum fee-haa khaa-li-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُورِثۡتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ ٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: وتلك الجنة التي اورثتموها بما كنتم تعملون
ayahs.translation: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-til-kal jan-na-tul lateee oo-ris-tu-moo-haa bi-maa kun-tum ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَكُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ كَثِيرَةٞ مِّنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ ٧٣
ayahs.text_simple: لكم فيها فكهة كثيرة منها تاكلون
ayahs.translation: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.
ayahs.transliteration: la-kum fee-haa faa-ki-ha-tun kasee-ra-tun mi-nhaa ta-ku-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ ٧٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان المجرمين في عذاب جهنم خلدون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal muj-ri-mee-na fee a-zaa-bi ja-han-na-ma khaa-li-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيهِ مُبۡلِسُونَ ٧٥
ayahs.text_simple: لا يفتر عنهم وهم فيه مبلسون
ayahs.translation: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
ayahs.transliteration: laa yu-fat-ta-ru a-nhum wa-hum fee-hi mub-li-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ٧٦
ayahs.text_simple: وما ظلمنهم ولكن كانوا هم الظلمين
ayahs.translation: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa za-lam-naa-hum wa-laa-kin kaa-noo hu-muz zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَادَوۡاْ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقۡضِ عَلَيۡنَا رَبُّكَۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ ٧٧
ayahs.text_simple: ونادوا يملك ليقض علينا ربك قال انكم مكثون
ayahs.translation: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-naa-daw yaa-maa-li-ku liyaq-di a-lai-naa rab-bu-ka qaa-la in-na-kum maa-ki-thoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَقَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَكُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ ٧٨
ayahs.text_simple: لقد جئنكم بالحق ولكن اكثركم للحق كرهون
ayahs.translation: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
ayahs.transliteration: la-qad ji-naa-kum bi-lhaq-qi wa-laa-kin-na ak-sa-ra-kum li-lhaq-qi kaa-ri-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ أَبۡرَمُوٓاْ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّا مُبۡرِمُونَ ٧٩
ayahs.text_simple: ام ابرموا امرا فانا مبرمون
ayahs.translation: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
ayahs.transliteration: am ab-ra-mooo am-ran fain-naa mub-ri-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ يَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسۡمَعُ سِرَّهُمۡ وَنَجۡوَىٰهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ ٨٠
ayahs.text_simple: ام يحسبون انا لا نسمع سرهم ونجويهم بلي ورسلنا لديهم يكتبون
ayahs.translation: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers [i.e., angels] are with them recording.
ayahs.transliteration: am yah-sa-boo-na an-naa laa nas-mau sir-ra-hum wa-naj-waa-hum ba-laa wa-ru-su-lu-naa la-dai-him yak-tu-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدٞ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلۡعَٰبِدِينَ ٨١
ayahs.text_simple: قل ان كان للرحمن ولد فانا اول العبدين
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."
ayahs.transliteration: qul in kaa-na lir-rah-maa-ni wa-lad faa-na aw-wa-lul aa-bideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ ٨٢
ayahs.text_simple: سبحن رب السموت والارض رب العرش عما يصفون
ayahs.translation: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
ayahs.transliteration: su-bhaa-na rab-bis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di rab-bil ar-shi am-maa ya-si-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ ٨٣
ayahs.text_simple: فذرهم يخوضوا ويلعبوا حتي يلقوا يومهم الذي يوعدون
ayahs.translation: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-za-rhum ya-khoo-doo waya-la-boo hat-taa yu-laa-qoo yaw-ma-hu-mul lazee yoo-a-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهٞ وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَٰهٞۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٨٤
ayahs.text_simple: وهو الذي في السماء اله وفي الارض اله وهو الحكيم العليم
ayahs.translation: And it is He [i.e., Allāh] who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wal lazee fis sa-maaai i-laa-hunw wa-fil ar-di i-laah wa-hu-wal hakee-mul aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ ٨٥
ayahs.text_simple: وتبارك الذي له ملك السموت والارض وما بينهما وعنده علم الساعة واليه ترجعون
ayahs.translation: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-baa-ra-kal lazee la-hoo mul-kus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di wa-maa bai-na-hu-maa wain-da-hoo il-mus saaa-ti wai-lai-hi tur-jaoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ ٨٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولا يملك الذين يدعون من دونه الشفعة الا من شهد بالحق وهم يعلمون
ayahs.translation: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa yam-li-kul lazee-na ya-doo-na min doo-ni-hish sha-faaa-ta il-laa man sha-hi-da bi-lhaq-qi wa-hum ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَهُمۡ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ ٨٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولئن سالتهم من خلقهم ليقولن الله فاني يؤفكون
ayahs.translation: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allāh." So how are they deluded?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lain saal-ta-hum man kha-la-qa-hum laya-qoo-lun nal-laa-hu faan-naa yu-fa-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٞ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٨٨
ayahs.text_simple: وقيله يرب ان هؤلاء قوم لا يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: And [Allāh acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
ayahs.transliteration: waqee-lihee yaa-rab-bi in-na haaau-laaai qaw-mul laa yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱصۡفَحۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقُلۡ سَلَٰمٞۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ ٨٩
ayahs.text_simple: فاصفح عنهم وقل سلم فسوف يعلمون
ayahs.translation: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.
ayahs.transliteration: fas-fah a-nhum wa-qul sa-laam fa-saw-fa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: حمٓ ١
ayahs.text_simple: حم
ayahs.translation: Ḥā, Meem.
ayahs.transliteration: haameeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: والكتب المبين
ayahs.translation: By the clear Book,
ayahs.transliteration: wal-ki-taa-bil mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةٖ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: انا انزلنه في ليلة مبركة انا كنا منذرين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
ayahs.transliteration: in-naaa an-zal-naa-hu fee lai-la-tim mu-baa-ra-kah in-naa kun-naa mun-zireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِيهَا يُفۡرَقُ كُلُّ أَمۡرٍ حَكِيمٍ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: فيها يفرق كل امر حكيم
ayahs.translation: Therein [i.e., on that night] is made distinct every precise matter -
ayahs.transliteration: fee-haa yuf-ra-qu kul-lu am-rin hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡرٗا مِّنۡ عِندِنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: امرا من عندنا انا كنا مرسلين
ayahs.translation: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
ayahs.transliteration: am-ram min in-di-naaa in-naa kun-naa mur-sileen

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَحۡمَةٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: رحمة من ربك انه هو السميع العليم
ayahs.translation: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing,
ayahs.transliteration: rah-ma-tam mir rab-bik in-na-hoo hu-was samee-ul aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: رب السموت والارض وما بينهما ان كنتم موقنين
ayahs.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
ayahs.transliteration: rab-bis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di wa-maa bai-na-hu-maa in kun-tum moo-qineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: لا اله الا هو يحي ويميت ربكم ورب ءابائكم الاولين
ayahs.translation: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
ayahs.transliteration: laaa i-laa-ha il-laa hu-wa yu-hyee wayumee-tu rab-bu-kum wa-rab-bu aa-baaai-ku-mul aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ يَلۡعَبُونَ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: بل هم في شك يلعبون
ayahs.translation: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
ayahs.transliteration: bal hum fee shak-ki-ny ya-la-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٖ مُّبِينٖ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: فارتقب يوم تاتي السماء بدخان مبين
ayahs.translation: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke
ayahs.transliteration: far-ta-qib yaw-ma ta-tis sa-maaau bi-du-khaa-nin mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَغۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: يغشي الناس هذا عذاب اليم
ayahs.translation: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
ayahs.transliteration: yag-hshan naa-sa haa-zaa a-zaa-bun aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَّبَّنَا ٱكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُونَ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: ربنا اكشف عنا العذاب انا مؤمنون
ayahs.translation: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
ayahs.transliteration: rab-ba-nak shif an-nal a-zaa-ba in-naa mu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ مُّبِينٞ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: اني لهم الذكري وقد جاءهم رسول مبين
ayahs.translation: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
ayahs.transliteration: an-naa la-hu-muz zik-raa wa-qad jaaaa-hum ra-soo-lum mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمٞ مَّجۡنُونٌ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: ثم تولوا عنه وقالوا معلم مجنون
ayahs.translation: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
ayahs.transliteration: sum-maa ta-wal-law a-nhu wa-qaa-loo mu-a-lla-mum maj-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ قَلِيلًاۚ إِنَّكُمۡ عَآئِدُونَ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: انا كاشفوا العذاب قليلا انكم عائدون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa kaa-shi-ful a-zaa-bi qalee-laa in-na-kum aaai-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ ٱلۡبَطۡشَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: يوم نبطش البطشة الكبري انا منتقمون
ayahs.translation: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma nab-ti-shul bat-sha-tal kub-raa in-naa mun-ta-qi-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ كَرِيمٌ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد فتنا قبلهم قوم فرعون وجاءهم رسول كريم
ayahs.translation: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad fa-tan-naa qab-la-hum qaw-ma fi-raw-na wa-jaaaa-hum ra-soo-lun kareem

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَنۡ أَدُّوٓاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: ان ادوا الي عباد الله اني لكم رسول امين
ayahs.translation: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allāh. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
ayahs.transliteration: an ad-dooo i-laiya i-baa-dal laa-hi in-nee la-kum ra-soo-lun ameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: وان لا تعلوا علي الله اني ءاتيكم بسلطن مبين
ayahs.translation: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allāh. Indeed, I have come to you with clear evidence.
ayahs.transliteration: waal laa ta-loo a-lal laa-hi in-nee aa-tee-kum bi-sul-taa-nim mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۡ أَن تَرۡجُمُونِ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: واني عذت بربي وربكم ان ترجمون
ayahs.translation: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-nee uz-tu bi-rab-bee wa-rab-bi-kum an tar-ju-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِن لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ لِي فَٱعۡتَزِلُونِ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: وان لم تؤمنوا لي فاعتزلون
ayahs.translation: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
ayahs.transliteration: wail lam tu-mi-noo lee fa-ta-zi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٞ مُّجۡرِمُونَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: فدعا ربه ان هؤلاء قوم مجرمون
ayahs.translation: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-daaa rab-ba-hooo an-na haaau-laaai qaw-mum muj-ri-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيۡلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: فاسر بعبادي ليلا انكم متبعون
ayahs.translation: [Allāh said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
ayahs.transliteration: faas-ri bii-baadee lai-lan in-na-kum mut-ta-baoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱتۡرُكِ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًاۖ إِنَّهُمۡ جُندٞ مُّغۡرَقُونَ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: واترك البحر رهوا انهم جند مغرقون
ayahs.translation: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
ayahs.transliteration: wat-ru-kil bah-ra rah-wan in-na-hum jun-dum mug-hra-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَمۡ تَرَكُواْ مِن جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: كم تركوا من جنت وعيون
ayahs.translation: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
ayahs.transliteration: kam ta-ra-koo min jan-naa-tinw wauyoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٖ وَمَقَامٖ كَرِيمٖ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: وزروع ومقام كريم
ayahs.translation: And crops and noble sites
ayahs.transliteration: wa-zu-rooinw wa-ma-qaa-min kareem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَعۡمَةٖ كَانُواْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: ونعمة كانوا فيها فكهين
ayahs.translation: And comfort wherein they were amused.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-na-ma-tin kaa-noo fee-haa faa-kiheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: كذلك واورثنها قوما ءاخرين
ayahs.translation: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.
ayahs.transliteration: ka-zaa-li-ka waaw-ras-naa-haa qaw-man aa-khareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: فما بكت عليهم السماء والارض وما كانوا منظرين
ayahs.translation: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-maa ba-kat a-lai-hi-mus sa-maaau wa-lar-du wa-maa kaa-noo mun-zareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡمُهِينِ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد نجينا بني اسرءيل من العذاب المهين
ayahs.translation: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad naj-jai-naa baneee is-raaaee-la mi-nal a-zaa-bil muheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: من فرعون انه كان عاليا من المسرفين
ayahs.translation: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
ayahs.transliteration: min fi-rawn in-na-hoo kaa-na aa-liyam mi-nal mus-rifeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱخۡتَرۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد اخترنهم علي علم علي العلمين
ayahs.translation: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qa-dikh tar-naa-hum a-laa il-min a-lal aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٞاْ مُّبِينٌ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: وءاتينهم من الايت ما فيه بلؤا مبين
ayahs.translation: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
ayahs.transliteration: waaa-tai-naa-hum mi-nal aayaa-ti maa fee-hi ba-laaaum mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان هؤلاء ليقولون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
ayahs.transliteration: in-na haaau-laaai laya-qoo-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: ان هي الا موتتنا الاولي وما نحن بمنشرين
ayahs.translation: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
ayahs.transliteration: in hiya il-laa maw-ta-tu-nal oo-laa wa-maa nah-nu bi-mun-shareen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: فاتوا بابائنا ان كنتم صدقين
ayahs.translation: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-too bi-a-a-baaa i-naaa in-kun-tum saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعٖ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: اهم خير ام قوم تبع والذين من قبلهم اهلكنهم انهم كانوا مجرمين
ayahs.translation: Are they better or the people of Tubbaʿ and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
ayahs.transliteration: a-hum khay-run am qaw-mu tub-bainw wal-la-zee-na min qab-li-him ah-lak-naa-hum in-na-hum kaa-noo muj-rimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: وما خلقنا السموت والارض وما بينهما لعبين
ayahs.translation: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa kha-laq-nas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da wa-maa bai-na-hu-maa laaibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا خَلَقۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: ما خلقنهما الا بالحق ولكن اكثرهم لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: maa kha-laq-naa-hu-maaa il-laa bi-lhaq-qi wa-laa-kin-na ak-sa-ra-hum laa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: ان يوم الفصل ميقتهم اجمعين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
ayahs.transliteration: in-na yaw-mal fas-li mee-qaa-tu-hum aj-maeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي مَوۡلًى عَن مَّوۡلٗى شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: يوم لا يغني مولي عن مولي شيا ولا هم ينصرون
ayahs.translation: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma laa yug-hnee maw-lan am maw-lan shai-anw wa-laa hum yun-sa-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: الا من رحم الله انه هو العزيز الرحيم
ayahs.translation: Except those [believers] on whom Allāh has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa mar ra-hi-mal laah in-na-hoo hu-wal azee-zur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: ان شجرت الزقوم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the tree of zaqqūm
ayahs.transliteration: in-na sha-ja-ra-taz zaq-qoom

ayahs.text_uthmani: طَعَامُ ٱلۡأَثِيمِ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: طعام الاثيم
ayahs.translation: Is food for the sinful.
ayahs.transliteration: taaa-mul aseem

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ يَغۡلِي فِي ٱلۡبُطُونِ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: كالمهل يغلي في البطون
ayahs.translation: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
ayahs.transliteration: kal-muh-li yag-hlee fil bu-toon

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَغَلۡيِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: كغلي الحميم
ayahs.translation: Like the boiling of scalding water.
ayahs.transliteration: ka-gha-lyil hameem

ayahs.text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَٱعۡتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: خذوه فاعتلوه الي سواء الجحيم
ayahs.translation: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
ayahs.transliteration: khu-zoo-hu fa-ti-loo-hu i-laa sa-waaail jaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ صُبُّواْ فَوۡقَ رَأۡسِهِۦ مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: ثم صبوا فوق راسه من عذاب الحميم
ayahs.translation: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma sub-boo faw-qa ra-sihee min a-zaa-bil hameem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذُقۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡكَرِيمُ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: ذق انك انت العزيز الكريم
ayahs.translation: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!
ayahs.transliteration: zuq in-na-ka an-tal azee-zul kareem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمۡتَرُونَ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: ان هذا ما كنتم به تمترون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
ayahs.transliteration: in-na haa-zaa maa kun-tum bihee tam-ta-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٖ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: ان المتقين في مقام امين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place:
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal mut-ta-qee-na fee ma-qaa-min ameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: في جنت وعيون
ayahs.translation: Within gardens and springs,
ayahs.transliteration: fee jan-naa-tinw wauyoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَلۡبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٖ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: يلبسون من سندس واستبرق متقبلين
ayahs.translation: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
ayahs.transliteration: yal-ba-soo-na min sun-du-sinw wais-tab-ra-qim mu-ta-qaa-bileen

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٖ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: كذلك وزوجنهم بحور عين
ayahs.translation: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
ayahs.transliteration: ka-zaa-li-ka wa-zaw-waj-naa-hum bi-hoo-rin een

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: يدعون فيها بكل فكهة ءامنين
ayahs.translation: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
ayahs.transliteration: ya-doo-na fee-haa bi-kul-li faa-ki-ha-tin aa-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوۡتَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: لا يذوقون فيها الموت الا الموتة الاولي ووقيهم عذاب الجحيم
ayahs.translation: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
ayahs.transliteration: laa ya-zoo-qoo-na fee-hal maw-taa il-lal maw-ta-tal oo-laa wa-wa-qaa-hum a-zaa-bal jaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَضۡلٗا مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: فضلا من ربك ذلك هو الفوز العظيم
ayahs.translation: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
ayahs.transliteration: fad-lam mir rab-bik zaa-li-ka hu-wal faw-zul azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: فانما يسرنه بلسانك لعلهم يتذكرون
ayahs.translation: And indeed, We have eased it [i.e., the Qur’ān] in your tongue that they might be reminded.
ayahs.transliteration: fain-na-maa yas-sar-naa-hu bi-li-saa-ni-ka laal-la-hum ya-ta-zak-ka-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ إِنَّهُم مُّرۡتَقِبُونَ ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: فارتقب انهم مرتقبون
ayahs.translation: So watch, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
ayahs.transliteration: far-ta-qib in-na-hum mur-ta-qi-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: حمٓ ١
ayahs.text_simple: حم
ayahs.translation: Ḥā, Meem.
ayahs.transliteration: haameeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: تنزيل الكتب من الله العزيز الحكيم
ayahs.translation: The revelation of the Book is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: tan-zee-lul ki-taa-bi mi-nal laa-hil azee-zil hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: ان في السموت والارض لايت للمؤمنين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di laaayaa-til lil-mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفِي خَلۡقِكُمۡ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: وفي خلقكم وما يبث من دابة ءايت لقوم يوقنون
ayahs.translation: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].
ayahs.transliteration: wafee kha-la-qi-kum wa-maa ya-bus-su min daaab-ba-tin aayaa-tul li-qaw-mi-ny yoo-qi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱخۡتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزۡقٖ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا وَتَصۡرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: واختلف اليل والنهار وما انزل الله من السماء من رزق فاحيا به الارض بعد موتها وتصريف الريح ءايت لقوم يعقلون
ayahs.translation: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allāh sends down from the sky of provision [i.e., rain] and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.
ayahs.transliteration: wak-hti-laa-fil lai-li wan-na-haa-ri wa-maaa an-za-lal laa-hu mi-nas sa-maaai mir riz-qin faa-hyaa bi-hil ar-da ba-da maw-ti-haa wa-tas-ree-fir riyaa-hi aayaa-tul li-qaw-mi-ny ya-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتۡلُوهَا عَلَيۡكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: تلك ءايت الله نتلوها عليك بالحق فباي حديث بعد الله وءايته يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: These are the verses of Allāh which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allāh and His verses will they believe?
ayahs.transliteration: til-ka aaya-tul laa-hi nat-loo-haa a-lai-ka bi-lhaqq fa-bi-a-yyi hadee-sim ba-dal laa-hi waaayaa-tihee yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيۡلٞ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٖ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ويل لكل افاك اثيم
ayahs.translation: Woe to every sinful liar
ayahs.transliteration: wai-lul li-kul-li af-faa-kin aseem

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَسۡمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسۡتَكۡبِرٗا كَأَن لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَاۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: يسمع ءايت الله تتلي عليه ثم يصر مستكبرا كان لم يسمعها فبشره بعذاب اليم
ayahs.translation: Who hears the verses of Allāh recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: yas-mau aayaa-til laa-hi tut-laa a-lai-hi sum-ma yu-sir-ru mus-tak-bi-ran kaal lam yas-ma-haa fa-bas-hshi-rhu bi-a-zaa-bin aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيۡـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًاۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: واذا علم من ءايتنا شيا اتخذها هزوا اولئك لهم عذاب مهين
ayahs.translation: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa a-li-ma min aayaa-ti-naa shai-a-nit ta-kha-za-haa hu-zu-waa u-laaai-ka la-hum a-zaa-bum muheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمۡ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُم مَّا كَسَبُواْ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡلِيَآءَۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: من ورائهم جهنم ولا يغني عنهم ما كسبوا شيا ولا ما اتخذوا من دون الله اولياء ولهم عذاب عظيم
ayahs.translation: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allāh as allies. And they will have a great punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: minw wa-raaai-him ja-han-na-mu wa-laa yug-hnee a-nhum maa ka-sa-boo shai-anw wa-laa mat ta-kha-zoo min doo-nil laa-hi aw-liyaaa wa-la-hum a-zaa-bun azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا هُدٗىۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مِّن رِّجۡزٍ أَلِيمٌ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: هذا هدي والذين كفروا بايت ربهم لهم عذاب من رجز اليم
ayahs.translation: This [Qur’ān] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
ayahs.transliteration: haa-zaa hu-daa wal-la-zee-na ka-fa-roo bi-a-ayaa-ti rab-bi-him la-hum a-zaa-bum mir rij-zin aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ لِتَجۡرِيَ ٱلۡفُلۡكُ فِيهِ بِأَمۡرِهِۦ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: الله الذي سخر لكم البحر لتجري الفلك فيه بامره ولتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون
ayahs.translation: It is Allāh who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
ayahs.transliteration: al-laa-hul lazee sah-kha-ra la-ku-mul bah-ra li-taj-riyal ful-ku fee-hi bi-a-mri-hee wa-li-tab-ta-ghoo min fad-lihee wa-laal-la-kum tas-hku-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا مِّنۡهُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: وسخر لكم ما في السموت وما في الارض جميعا منه ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يتفكرون
ayahs.translation: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-sak-hkha-ra la-kum maa fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-maa fil ar-di jameeam mi-nhu in-na fee zaa-li-ka laaayaa-til li-qaw-mi-ny ya-ta-fak-ka-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَغۡفِرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجۡزِيَ قَوۡمَۢا بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: قل للذين ءامنوا يغفروا للذين لا يرجون ايام الله ليجزي قوما بما كانوا يكسبون
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allāh [i.e., of His retribution] so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
ayahs.transliteration: qul lil-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo yag-hfi-roo lil-la-zee-na laa yar-joo-na ayyaa-mal laa-hi liyaj-ziya qaw-mam bi-maa kaa-noo yak-si-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَاۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ تُرۡجَعُونَ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: من عمل صلحا فلنفسه ومن اساء فعليها ثم الي ربكم ترجعون
ayahs.translation: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against it [i.e., the self or soul]. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
ayahs.transliteration: man a-mi-la saa-li-han fa-li-naf-sihee wa-man a-saaaa faa-lai-haa sum-ma i-laa rab-bi-kum tur-jaoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحُكۡمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ءاتينا بني اسرءيل الكتب والحكم والنبوة ورزقنهم من الطيبت وفضلنهم علي العلمين
ayahs.translation: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad aa-tai-naa baneee is-raaaee-lal ki-taa-ba wa-lhuk-ma wan-nu-buw-wa-ta wa-ra-zaq-naa-hum mi-nat taiyi-baa-ti wa-fad-dal-naa-hum a-lal aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم بَيِّنَٰتٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِۖ فَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفُوٓاْ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيَۢا بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِي بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: وءاتينهم بينت من الامر فما اختلفوا الا من بعد ما جاءهم العلم بغيا بينهم ان ربك يقضي بينهم يوم القيمة فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون
ayahs.translation: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
ayahs.transliteration: waaa-tai-naa-hum baiyi-naa-tim mi-nal am-ri fa-makh ta-la-fooo il-laa mim ba-di maa jaaaa-hu-mul il-mu ba-ghyam bai-na-hum in-na rab-ba-ka yaq-dee bai-na-hum yaw-mal qiyaa-ma-ti fee-maa kaa-noo fee-hi yak-hta-li-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ فَٱتَّبِعۡهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ أَهۡوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: ثم جعلنك علي شريعة من الامر فاتبعها ولا تتبع اهواء الذين لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: Then We put you, [O Muḥammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma jaal-naa-ka a-laa shareea-tim mi-nal am-ri fat-ta-bi-haa wa-laa tat-ta-bi ah-waaa al-la-zee-na laa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمۡ لَن يُغۡنُواْ عَنكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـٔٗاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءُ بَعۡضٖۖ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِيُّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: انهم لن يغنوا عنك من الله شيا وان الظلمين بعضهم اولياء بعض والله ولي المتقين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allāh at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allāh is the protector of the righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hum la-ny yug-hnoo an-ka mi-nal laa-hi shai-a-a wain-naz zaa-li-mee-na ba-du-hum aw-liyaaau ba-dinw wal-laa-hu wa-liyyul mut-taqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا بَصَٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: هذا بصئر للناس وهدي ورحمة لقوم يوقنون
ayahs.translation: This [Qur’ān] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
ayahs.transliteration: haa-zaa ba-saaai-ru lin-naa-si wa-hu-danw wa-rah-ma-tul li-qaw-mi-ny yoo-qi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَرَحُواْ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجۡعَلَهُمۡ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَوَآءٗ مَّحۡيَاهُمۡ وَمَمَاتُهُمۡۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُونَ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: ام حسب الذين اجترحوا السيات ان نجعلهم كالذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت سواء محياهم ومماتهم ساء ما يحكمون
ayahs.translation: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge [i.e., assume].
ayahs.transliteration: am ha-si-bal lazee-naj ta-ra-hus saiyi-a-a-ti an na-ja-la-hum kal-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lu saa-li-haa-ti sa-waaaam ma-hyaa-hum wa-ma-maa-tu-hum saaaa maa yah-ku-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: وخلق الله السموت والارض بالحق ولتجزي كل نفس بما كسبت وهم لا يظلمون
ayahs.translation: And Allāh created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kha-la-qal laa-hus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da bi-lhaq-qi wa-li-tuj-zaa kul-lu naf-sim bi-maa ka-sa-bat wa-hum laa yuz-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٖ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمۡعِهِۦ وَقَلۡبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَٰوَةٗ فَمَن يَهۡدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ٱللَّهِۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: افرءيت من اتخذ الهه هويه واضله الله علي علم وختم علي سمعه وقلبه وجعل علي بصره غشوة فمن يهديه من بعد الله افلا تذكرون
ayahs.translation: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allāh has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allāh? Then will you not be reminded?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-raay-ta ma-nit ta-kha-za i-laa-ha-hoo ha-waa-hu waa-dal-la-hul laa-hu a-laa il-minw wa-kha-ta-ma a-laa sa-mihee wa-qal-bihee wa-jaa-la a-laa ba-sa-rihee ghi-shaa-wa-tan fa-ma-ny yah-dee-hi mim ba-dil laah a-fa-laa ta-zak-ka-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ مَا هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنۡيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا يُهۡلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهۡرُۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا ما هي الا حياتنا الدنيا نموت ونحيا وما يهلكنا الا الدهر وما لهم بذلك من علم ان هم الا يظنون
ayahs.translation: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-loo maa hiya il-laa hayaa-tu-nad du-nyaa na-moo-tu wa-na-hyaa wa-maa yuh-li-ku-naaa il-lad dahr wa-maa la-hum bi-zaa-li-ka min il-min in hum il-laa ya-zun-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ ٱئۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: واذا تتلي عليهم ءايتنا بينت ما كان حجتهم الا ان قالوا ائتوا بابائنا ان كنتم صدقين
ayahs.translation: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa tut-laa a-lai-him aayaa-tu-na baiyi-naa-tim maa kaa-na huj-ja-ta-hum il-laaa an qaa-lu too bi-a-a-baaai-naaa in kun-tum saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحۡيِيكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: قل الله يحييكم ثم يميتكم ثم يجمعكم الي يوم القيمة لا ريب فيه ولكن اكثر الناس لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: Say, "Allāh causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."
ayahs.transliteration: qu-lil laa-hu yu-hyee-kum sum-ma yu-mee-tu-kum sum-ma yaj-mau-kum i-laa yaw-mil qiyaa-ma-ti laa rai-ba fee-hi wa-laa-kin-na ak-sa-ran naa-si laa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَخۡسَرُ ٱلۡمُبۡطِلُونَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولله ملك السموت والارض ويوم تقوم الساعة يومئذ يخسر المبطلون
ayahs.translation: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lil-laa-hi mul-kus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lard wayaw-ma ta-qoo-mus saaa-tu yaw-mai-zi-ny yak-hsa-rul mub-ti-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٖ جَاثِيَةٗۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةٖ تُدۡعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: وتري كل امة جاثية كل امة تدعي الي كتبها اليوم تجزون ما كنتم تعملون
ayahs.translation: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-raa kul-la um-ma-tin jaa-siyah kul-lu um-ma-tin tu-daaa i-laa ki-taa-bi-haa a-lyaw-ma tuj-zaw-na maa kun-tum ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا كِتَٰبُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسۡتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: هذا كتبنا ينطق عليكم بالحق انا كنا نستنسخ ما كنتم تعملون
ayahs.translation: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do."
ayahs.transliteration: haa-zaa ki-taa-bu-naa yan-ti-qu a-lai-kum bi-lhaqq in-naa kun-naa nas-tan-si-khu maa kun-tum ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُدۡخِلُهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: فاما الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت فيدخلهم ربهم في رحمته ذلك هو الفوز المبين
ayahs.translation: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.
ayahs.transliteration: faam-mal lazee-na aa-maa-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti fayud-khi-lu-hum rab-bu-hum fee rah-ma-tih zaa-li-ka hu-wal faw-zul mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَفَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ ءَايَٰتِي تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتُمۡ وَكُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا مُّجۡرِمِينَ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: واما الذين كفروا افلم تكن ءايتي تتلي عليكم فاستكبرتم وكنتم قوما مجرمين
ayahs.translation: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a criminal people?
ayahs.transliteration: waam-mal lazee-na ka-fa-rooo a-fa-lam ta-kun aayaa-tee tut-laa a-lai-kum fas-tak-bar-tum wa-kun-tum qaw-mam muj-rimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهَا قُلۡتُم مَّا نَدۡرِي مَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ إِن نَّظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنّٗا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُسۡتَيۡقِنِينَ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: واذا قيل ان وعد الله حق والساعة لا ريب فيها قلتم ما ندري ما الساعة ان نظن الا ظنا وما نحن بمستيقنين
ayahs.translation: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.'"
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa qee-la in-na wa-dal laa-hi haq-qunw was-saaa-tu laa rai-ba fee-haa qul-tum maa nad-ree mas saaa-tu in na-zun-nu il-laa zan-nanw wa-maa nah-nu bi-mus-tai-qineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: وبدا لهم سيات ما عملوا وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزءون
ayahs.translation: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ba-daa la-hum saiyi-a-a-tu maa a-mi-loo wa-haa-qa bi-him maa kaa-noo bihee yas-tah-zioon
