ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَنسَىٰكُمۡ كَمَا نَسِيتُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَا وَمَأۡوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: وقيل اليوم ننسيكم كما نسيتم لقاء يومكم هذا وماويكم النار وما لكم من نصرين
ayahs.translation: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.
ayahs.transliteration: waqee-lal yaw-ma nan-saa-kum ka-maa nasee-tum li-qaaaa yaw-mi-kum haa-zaa wa-maa-waa-ku-mun naa-ru wa-maa la-kum min naa-sireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذۡتُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوٗا وَغَرَّتۡكُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡرَجُونَ مِنۡهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُونَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: ذلكم بانكم اتخذتم ءايت الله هزوا وغرتكم الحيوة الدنيا فاليوم لا يخرجون منها ولا هم يستعتبون
ayahs.translation: That is because you took the verses of Allāh in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: zaa-li-kum bi-a-nna-ku-mut ta-khaz-tum aayaa-til laa-hi hu-zu-wanw wa-ghar-rat-ku-mul hayaa-tud du-nyaa fa-lyaw-ma laa yuk-hra-joo-na mi-nhaa wa-laa hum yus-ta-ta-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: فلله الحمد رب السموت ورب الارض رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: Then, to Allāh belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lil-laa-hil ham-du rab-bis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-rab-bil ar-di rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَهُ ٱلۡكِبۡرِيَآءُ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: وله الكبرياء في السموت والارض وهو العزيز الحكيم
ayahs.translation: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-hul kib-riyaaau fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di wa-hu-wal azee-zul hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: حمٓ ١
ayahs.text_simple: حم
ayahs.translation: Ḥā, Meem.
ayahs.transliteration: haameeeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: تنزيل الكتب من الله العزيز الحكيم
ayahs.translation: The revelation of the Book is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: tan-zee-lul ki-taa-bi mi-nal laa-hil azee-zil hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَمَّآ أُنذِرُواْ مُعۡرِضُونَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: ما خلقنا السموت والارض وما بينهما الا بالحق واجل مسمي والذين كفروا عما انذروا معرضون
ayahs.translation: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.
ayahs.transliteration: maa kha-laq-nas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da wa-maa bai-na-hu-maaa il-laa bi-lhaq-qi waa-ja-lim mu-sam-maa wal-la-zee-na ka-fa-roo am-maaa un-zi-roo mu-ri-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شِرۡكٞ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِۖ ٱئۡتُونِي بِكِتَٰبٖ مِّن قَبۡلِ هَٰذَآ أَوۡ أَثَٰرَةٖ مِّنۡ عِلۡمٍ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: قل ارءيتم ما تدعون من دون الله اروني ماذا خلقوا من الارض ام لهم شرك في السموت ائتوني بكتب من قبل هذا او اثرة من علم ان كنتم صدقين
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allāh? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: qul a-raay-tum maa ta-doo-na min doo-nil laa-hi a-roonee maa-zaa kha-la-qoo mi-nal ar-di am la-hum shir-kun fis sa-maa-waa-ti ee-toonee bi-ki-taa-bim min qab-li haa-zaaa aw a-saa-ra-tim min il-min in kun-tum saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَنۡ أَضَلُّ مِمَّن يَدۡعُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَن لَّا يَسۡتَجِيبُ لَهُۥٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَهُمۡ عَن دُعَآئِهِمۡ غَٰفِلُونَ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: ومن اضل ممن يدعوا من دون الله من لا يستجيب له الي يوم القيمة وهم عن دعائهم غفلون
ayahs.translation: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allāh those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection [i.e., never], and they, of their invocation, are unaware.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-man a-dal-lu mim-ma-ny ya-doo min doo-nil laa-hi mal laa yas-ta-jee-bu la-hooo i-laa yaw-mil qiyaa-ma-ti wa-hum an du-a-aai-him ghaa-fi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا حُشِرَ ٱلنَّاسُ كَانُواْ لَهُمۡ أَعۡدَآءٗ وَكَانُواْ بِعِبَادَتِهِمۡ كَٰفِرِينَ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: واذا حشر الناس كانوا لهم اعداء وكانوا بعبادتهم كفرين
ayahs.translation: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa hu-shi-ran naa-su kaa-noo la-hum a-daaaanw wa-kaa-noo bii-baa-da-ti-him kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ هَٰذَا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٌ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: واذا تتلي عليهم ءايتنا بينت قال الذين كفروا للحق لما جاءهم هذا سحر مبين
ayahs.translation: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is obvious magic."
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa tut-laa a-lai-him aayaa-tu-naa baiyi-naa-tin qaa-lal lazee-na ka-fa-roo li-lhaq-qi lam-maa jaaaa-hum haa-zaa sih-rum mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُۖ قُلۡ إِنِ ٱفۡتَرَيۡتُهُۥ فَلَا تَمۡلِكُونَ لِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـًٔاۖ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِۚ كَفَىٰ بِهِۦ شَهِيدَۢا بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: ام يقولون افتريه قل ان افتريته فلا تملكون لي من الله شيا هو اعلم بما تفيضون فيه كفي به شهيدا بيني وبينكم وهو الغفور الرحيم
ayahs.translation: Or do they say, "He has invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, you will not possess for me [the power of protection] from Allāh at all. He is most knowing of that in which you are involved. Sufficient is He as Witness between me and you, and He is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
ayahs.transliteration: am ya-qoo-loo-naf ta-raa-hu qul i-nif ta-rai-tu-hoo fa-laa tam-li-koo-na lee mi-nal laa-hi shai-an hu-wa a-la-mu bi-maa tufee-doo-na fee-hi ka-faa bihee shahee-dam bainee wa-bai-na-kum wa-hu-wal gha-foo-rur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ مَا كُنتُ بِدۡعٗا مِّنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَمَآ أَدۡرِي مَا يُفۡعَلُ بِي وَلَا بِكُمۡۖ إِنۡ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: قل ما كنت بدعا من الرسل وما ادري ما يفعل بي ولا بكم ان اتبع الا ما يوحي الي وما انا الا نذير مبين
ayahs.translation: Say, "I am not something new among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner."
ayahs.transliteration: qul maa kun-tu bi-dam mi-nal ru-su-li wa-maaa ad-reee ma yu-fa-lu bee wa-laa bi-kum in at-ta-biu il-laa maa yoo-haaa i-laiya wa-maaa a-na il-laa nazee-rum mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِن كَانَ مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَفَرۡتُم بِهِۦ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٞ مِّنۢ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ مِثۡلِهِۦ فَـَٔامَنَ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: قل ارءيتم ان كان من عند الله وكفرتم به وشهد شاهد من بني اسرءيل علي مثله فامن واستكبرتم ان الله لا يهدي القوم الظلمين
ayahs.translation: Say, "Have you considered: if it [i.e., the Qur’ān] was from Allāh, and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant...?" Indeed, Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.
ayahs.transliteration: qul a-raay-tum in kaa-na min in-dil laa-hi wa-ka-far-tum bihee wa-sha-hi-da shaa-hi-dum mim banee is-raaaee-la a-laa mis-lihee faaa-ma-na was-tak-bar-tum in-nal laa-ha laa yah-dil qaw-maz zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَوۡ كَانَ خَيۡرٗا مَّا سَبَقُونَآ إِلَيۡهِۚ وَإِذۡ لَمۡ يَهۡتَدُواْ بِهِۦ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَٰذَآ إِفۡكٞ قَدِيمٞ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: وقال الذين كفروا للذين ءامنوا لو كان خيرا ما سبقونا اليه واذ لم يهتدوا به فسيقولون هذا افك قديم
ayahs.translation: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "If it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it." And when they are not guided by it, they will say, "This is an ancient falsehood."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-lal lazee-na ka-fa-roo lil-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo law kaa-na khai-ram maa sa-ba-qoo-naaa i-lyh waiz lam yah-ta-doo bihee fa-saya-qoo-loo-na haa-zaaa if-kun qadeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِن قَبۡلِهِۦ كِتَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامٗا وَرَحۡمَةٗۚ وَهَٰذَا كِتَٰبٞ مُّصَدِّقٞ لِّسَانًا عَرَبِيّٗا لِّيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَبُشۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: ومن قبله كتب موسي اماما ورحمة وهذا كتب مصدق لسانا عربيا لينذر الذين ظلموا وبشري للمحسنين
ayahs.translation: And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-min qab-lihee ki-taa-bu moo-saaa i-maa-manw wa-rah-mah wa-haa-zaa ki-taa-bum mu-sad-di-qul li-saa-nan a-ra-biyyal liyun-zi-ral lazee-na za-la-moo wa-bus-hraa lil-muh-sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ فَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين قالوا ربنا الله ثم استقموا فلا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na qaa-loo rab-bu-nal laa-hu sum-mas ta-qaa-moo fa-laa khaw-fun a-lai-him wa-laa hum yah-za-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك اصحب الجنة خلدين فيها جزاء بما كانوا يعملون
ayahs.translation: Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-ka a-sha-bul jan-na-ti khaa-li-dee-na fee-haa ja-zaaaam bi-maa kaa-no ya-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَوَصَّيۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ إِحۡسَٰنًاۖ حَمَلَتۡهُ أُمُّهُۥ كُرۡهٗا وَوَضَعَتۡهُ كُرۡهٗاۖ وَحَمۡلُهُۥ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ ثَلَٰثُونَ شَهۡرًاۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَبَلَغَ أَرۡبَعِينَ سَنَةٗ قَالَ رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحٗا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَصۡلِحۡ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِيٓۖ إِنِّي تُبۡتُ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: ووصينا الانسن بولديه احسنا حملته امه كرها ووضعته كرها وحمله وفصله ثلثون شهرا حتي اذا بلغ اشده وبلغ اربعين سنة قال رب اوزعني ان اشكر نعمتك التي انعمت علي وعلي ولدي وان اعمل صلحا ترضيه واصلح لي في ذريتي اني تبت اليك واني من المسلمين
ayahs.translation: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-was-sai-nal in-saa-na bi-waa-li-dai-hi ih-saa-na ha-ma-la-thu um-mu-hoo ku-rhan-wwa wa-daa-thu ku-rhanw wa-ham-lu-hoo wa-fi-saa-lu-hoo sa-laa-soo-na shah-raa hat-taaa i-zaa ba-la-gha a-shud-da-hoo wa-ba-la-gha ar-baee-na sa-na-tan qaa-la rab-bi aw-zineee an as-hku-ra ni-ma-ta-kal lateee a-nam-ta a-laiya waa-laa waa-li-daiya waan a-ma-la saa-li-han tar-daa-hu waas-lih lee fee zur-riyyatee in-nee tub-tu i-lai-ka wain-nee mi-nal mus-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنۡهُمۡ أَحۡسَنَ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَنَتَجَاوَزُ عَن سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ فِيٓ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡجَنَّةِۖ وَعۡدَ ٱلصِّدۡقِ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك الذين نتقبل عنهم احسن ما عملوا ونتجاوز عن سياتهم في اصحب الجنة وعد الصدق الذي كانوا يوعدون
ayahs.translation: Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, [their being] among the companions of Paradise. [That is] the promise of truth which they had been promised.
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-kal lazee-na na-ta-qab-ba-lu a-nhum ah-sa-na maa a-mi-loo wa-na-ta-jaa-wa-zu an saiyi-a-a-ti-him feee a-shaa-bil jan-na-ti wa-das sid-qil lazee kaa-noo yoo-a-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِي قَالَ لِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ أُفّٖ لَّكُمَآ أَتَعِدَانِنِيٓ أَنۡ أُخۡرَجَ وَقَدۡ خَلَتِ ٱلۡقُرُونُ مِن قَبۡلِي وَهُمَا يَسۡتَغِيثَانِ ٱللَّهَ وَيۡلَكَ ءَامِنۡ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: والذي قال لولديه اف لكما اتعدانني ان اخرج وقد خلت القرون من قبلي وهما يستغيثان الله ويلك ءامن ان وعد الله حق فيقول ما هذا الا اسطير الاولين
ayahs.translation: But one who says to his parents, "Uff to you; do you promise me that I will be brought forth [from the earth] when generations before me have already passed on [into oblivion]?" while they call to Allāh for help [and to their son], "Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth." But he says, "This is not but legends of the former peoples" -
ayahs.transliteration: wal-lazee qaa-la li-waa-li-dai-hi uf-fil la-ku-maaa a-tai-da-ni-neee an uk-hra-ja wa-qad kha-la-til qu-roo-nu min qab-lee wa-hu-maa yas-ta-ghee-saa-nil laa-ha wai-la-ka aa-min in-na wa-dal laa-hi haqq faya-qoo-lu maa haa-zaaa il-laaa a-saa-tee-rul aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ فِيٓ أُمَمٖ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ خَٰسِرِينَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك الذين حق عليهم القول في امم قد خلت من قبلهم من الجن والانس انهم كانوا خسرين
ayahs.translation: Those are the ones upon whom the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect, [who will be] among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-kal lazee-na haq-qa a-lai-hi-mul qaw-lu feee u-ma-min qad kha-lat min qab-li-him mi-nal jin-ni wa-lin-si in-na-hum kaa-noo khaa-sireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلِكُلّٖ دَرَجَٰتٞ مِّمَّا عَمِلُواْۖ وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: ولكل درجت مما عملوا وليوفيهم اعملهم وهم لا يظلمون
ayahs.translation: And for all there are degrees [of reward and punishment] for what they have done, and [it is] so that He may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-li-kul-lin da-ra-jaa-tum mim-maa a-mi-loo wa-liyu-waf-fiya-hum a-maa-la-hum wa-hum laa yuz-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَوۡمَ يُعۡرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَذۡهَبۡتُمۡ طَيِّبَٰتِكُمۡ فِي حَيَاتِكُمُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱسۡتَمۡتَعۡتُم بِهَا فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ عَذَابَ ٱلۡهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَفۡسُقُونَ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: ويوم يعرض الذين كفروا علي النار اذهبتم طيبتكم في حياتكم الدنيا واستمتعتم بها فاليوم تجزون عذاب الهون بما كنتم تستكبرون في الارض بغير الحق وبما كنتم تفسقون
ayahs.translation: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."
ayahs.transliteration: wayaw-ma yu-ra-dul lazee-na ka-fa-roo a-lan naa-ri a-zhab-tum taiyi-baa-ti-kum fee hayaa-ti-ku-mud du-nyaa was-tam-ta-tum bi-haa fa-lyaw-ma tuj-zaw-na a-zaa-bal hoo-ni bi-maa kun-tum tas-tak-bi-roo-na fil ar-di bi-ghai-ril haq-qi wa-bi-maa kun-tum taf-su-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَٱذۡكُرۡ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذۡ أَنذَرَ قَوۡمَهُۥ بِٱلۡأَحۡقَافِ وَقَدۡ خَلَتِ ٱلنُّذُرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦٓ أَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوٓاْ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: واذكر اخا عاد اذ انذر قومه بالاحقاف وقد خلت النذر من بين يديه ومن خلفه الا تعبدوا الا الله اني اخاف عليكم عذاب يوم عظيم
ayahs.translation: And mention, [O Muḥammad], the brother of ʿAad, when he warned his people in [the region of] al-Aḥqāf - and warners had already passed on before him and after him - [saying], "Do not worship except Allāh. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
ayahs.transliteration: waz-kur a-khaa aad iz an-za-ra qaw-ma-hoo bi-lah-qaa-fi wa-qad kha-la-tin nu-zu-ru mim bai-ni ya-dai-hi wa-min khal-fiheee al-laa ta-bu-dooo il-lal laa-ha in-neee a-khaa-fu a-lai-kum a-zaa-ba yaw-min azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓاْ أَجِئۡتَنَا لِتَأۡفِكَنَا عَنۡ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأۡتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا اجئتنا لتافكنا عن ءالهتنا فاتنا بما تعدنا ان كنت من الصدقين
ayahs.translation: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo a-ji-ta-naa li-taa-fi-ka-naa an aa-li-ha-ti-naa fa-ti-naa bi-maa tai-du-naaa in kun-ta mi-nas saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡعِلۡمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأُبَلِّغُكُم مَّآ أُرۡسِلۡتُ بِهِۦ وَلَٰكِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰكُمۡ قَوۡمٗا تَجۡهَلُونَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: قال انما العلم عند الله وابلغكم ما ارسلت به ولكني اريكم قوما تجهلون
ayahs.translation: He said, "Knowledge [of its time] is only with Allāh, and I convey to you that with which I was sent; but I see you [to be] a people behaving ignorantly."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la in-na-mal il-mu in-dal laa-hi wau-bal-li-ghu-kum maaa ur-sil-tu bihee wa-laa-kin-neee a-raa-kum qaw-man ta-jha-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهُ عَارِضٗا مُّسۡتَقۡبِلَ أَوۡدِيَتِهِمۡ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا عَارِضٞ مُّمۡطِرُنَاۚ بَلۡ هُوَ مَا ٱسۡتَعۡجَلۡتُم بِهِۦۖ رِيحٞ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: فلما راوه عارضا مستقبل اوديتهم قالوا هذا عارض ممطرنا بل هو ما استعجلتم به ريح فيها عذاب اليم
ayahs.translation: And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, "This is a cloud bringing us rain!" Rather, it is that for which you were impatient: a wind, within it a painful punishment,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa raa-whu aa-ri-dam mus-taq-bi-la aw-diya-ti-him qaa-loo haa-zaa aa-ri-dum mum-ti-ru-naa bal hu-wa mas ta-jal-tum bihee ree-hun fee-haa a-zaa-bun aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَيۡءِۭ بِأَمۡرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصۡبَحُواْ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَٰكِنُهُمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: تدمر كل شيء بامر ربها فاصبحوا لا يري الا مسكنهم كذلك نجزي القوم المجرمين
ayahs.translation: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people.
ayahs.transliteration: tu-dam-mi-ru kul-la shaiim bi-a-mri rab-bi-haa faas-ba-hoo laa yu-raaa il-laa ma-saa-ki-nu-hum ka-zaa-li-ka naj-zil qaw-mal muj-rimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ مَكَّنَّٰهُمۡ فِيمَآ إِن مَّكَّنَّٰكُمۡ فِيهِ وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ سَمۡعٗا وَأَبۡصَٰرٗا وَأَفۡـِٔدَةٗ فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُمۡ سَمۡعُهُمۡ وَلَآ أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ وَلَآ أَفۡـِٔدَتُهُم مِّن شَيۡءٍ إِذۡ كَانُواْ يَجۡحَدُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد مكنهم فيما ان مكنكم فيه وجعلنا لهم سمعا وابصرا وافدة فما اغني عنهم سمعهم ولا ابصرهم ولا افدتهم من شيء اذ كانوا يجحدون بايت الله وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزءون
ayahs.translation: And We had certainly established them in such as We have not established you, and We made for them hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]. But their hearing and vision and hearts availed them not from anything [of the punishment] when they were [continually] rejecting the signs of Allāh; and they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad mak-kan-naa-hum fee-maaa im mak-kan-naa-kum fee-hi wa-jal-naa la-hum sa-manw waab-saa-ranw waa-fi-da-tan fa-maaa ag-hnaa a-nhum sa-mu-hum wa-laaa ab-saa-ru-hum wa-laaa a-fi-da-tu-hum min shaiin iz kaa-noo ya-jha-doo-na bi-a-ayaa-til laa-hi wa-haa-qa bi-him maa kaa-noo bihee yas-tah-zioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مَا حَوۡلَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ وَصَرَّفۡنَا ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد اهلكنا ما حولكم من القري وصرفنا الايت لعلهم يرجعون
ayahs.translation: And We have already destroyed what surrounds you of [those] cities, and We have diversified the signs [or verses] that perhaps they might return [from disbelief].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad ah-lak-naa ma haw-la-kum mi-nal qu-raa wa-sar-raf-nal aayaa-ti laal-la-hum yar-jioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَوۡلَا نَصَرَهُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ قُرۡبَانًا ءَالِهَةَۢۖ بَلۡ ضَلُّواْ عَنۡهُمۡۚ وَذَٰلِكَ إِفۡكُهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: فلولا نصرهم الذين اتخذوا من دون الله قربانا ءالهة بل ضلوا عنهم وذلك افكهم وما كانوا يفترون
ayahs.translation: Then why did those they took besides Allāh as deities by which to approach [Him] not aid them? But they had strayed [i.e., departed] from them. And that was their falsehood and what they were inventing.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-law-laa na-sa-ra-hu-mul lazee-nat ta-kha-zoo min doo-nil laa-hi qur-baa-nan aa-li-ha-tam bal dal-loo a-nhum wa-zaa-li-ka if-ku-hum wa-maa kaa-noo yaf-ta-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ صَرَفۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ نَفَرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوٓاْ أَنصِتُواْۖ فَلَمَّا قُضِيَ وَلَّوۡاْ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِم مُّنذِرِينَ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: واذ صرفنا اليك نفرا من الجن يستمعون القرءان فلما حضروه قالوا انصتوا فلما قضي ولوا الي قومهم منذرين
ayahs.translation: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We directed to you a few of the jinn, listening to the Qur’ān. And when they attended it, they said, "Listen attentively." And when it was concluded, they went back to their people as warners.
ayahs.transliteration: waiz sa-ra-fi-naaa i-lai-ka na-fa-ram mi-nal jin-ni yas-ta-mioo-nal qu-raa-na fa-lam-maa ha-da-roo-hu qaa-looo an-si-too fa-lam-maa qu-diya wal-law i-laa qaw-mi-him mun-zireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ يَٰقَوۡمَنَآ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا كِتَٰبًا أُنزِلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلۡحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا يقومنا انا سمعنا كتبا انزل من بعد موسي مصدقا لما بين يديه يهدي الي الحق والي طريق مستقيم
ayahs.translation: They said, "O our people, indeed we have heard a [recited] Book revealed after Moses confirming what was before it which guides to the truth and to a straight path.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo yaa-qaw-ma-naaa in-naa sa-mi-naa ki-taa-ban un-zi-la mim ba-di moo-sa mu-sad-di-qal li-maa bai-na ya-di-hi yah-deee i-lal haq-qi wai-laa taree-qim mus-taqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰقَوۡمَنَآ أَجِيبُواْ دَاعِيَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَامِنُواْ بِهِۦ يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُجِرۡكُم مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: يقومنا اجيبوا داعي الله وءامنوا به يغفر لكم من ذنوبكم ويجركم من عذاب اليم
ayahs.translation: O our people, respond to the Caller [i.e., Messenger] of Allāh and believe in him; He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive for you your sins and protect you from a painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: yaa-qaw-ma-naaa ajee-boo daaiyal laa-hi waaa-mi-noo bihee yag-hfir la-kum min zu-noo-bi-kum wayu-jir-kum min a-zaa-bin aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَن لَّا يُجِبۡ دَاعِيَ ٱللَّهِ فَلَيۡسَ بِمُعۡجِزٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَيۡسَ لَهُۥ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءُۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: ومن لا يجب داعي الله فليس بمعجز في الارض وليس له من دونه اولياء اولئك في ضلل مبين
ayahs.translation: But he who does not respond to the Caller of Allāh will not cause failure [to Him] upon earth, and he will not have besides Him any protectors. Those are in manifest error."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mal laa yu-jib daaiyal laa-hi fa-lai-sa bi-mu-ji-zin fil ar-di wa-lai-sa la-hoo min doo-niheee aw-liyaaa u-laaai-ka fee da-laa-lim mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَلَمۡ يَعۡيَ بِخَلۡقِهِنَّ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحۡـِۧيَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰۚ بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: اولم يروا ان الله الذي خلق السموت والارض ولم يعي بخلقهن بقدر علي ان يحي الموتي بلي انه علي كل شيء قدير
ayahs.translation: Do they not see that Allāh, who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes. Indeed, He is over all things competent.
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-lam ya-raw an-nal laa-hal lazee kha-la-qas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da wa-lam yaya bi-khal qi-hin-na bi-qaa-di-rin a-laaa aiyu-hyiyal maw-taa ba-laaa in-na-hoo a-laa kul-li shaiin qadeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَوۡمَ يُعۡرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَلَيۡسَ هَٰذَا بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَاۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: ويوم يعرض الذين كفروا علي النار اليس هذا بالحق قالوا بلي وربنا قال فذوقوا العذاب بما كنتم تكفرون
ayahs.translation: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will say, "Then taste the punishment for what you used to deny."
ayahs.transliteration: wayaw-ma yu-ra-dul lazee-na ka-fa-roo a-lan naa-ri a-lai-sa haa-za bi-lhaqq qaa-loo ba-laa wa-rab-bi-naa qaa-la fa-zoo-qul a-zaa-ba bi-maa kun-tum tak-fu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱصۡبِرۡ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡعَزۡمِ مِنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِل لَّهُمۡۚ كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا سَاعَةٗ مِّن نَّهَارِۭۚ بَلَٰغٞۚ فَهَلۡ يُهۡلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلۡقَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: فاصبر كما صبر اولوا العزم من الرسل ولا تستعجل لهم كانهم يوم يرون ما يوعدون لم يلبثوا الا ساعة من نهار بلغ فهل يهلك الا القوم الفسقون
ayahs.translation: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them. It will be - on the Day they see that which they are promised - as though they had not remained [in the world] except an hour of a day. [This is] notification. And will [any] be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people?
ayahs.transliteration: fas-bir ka-maa sa-ba-ra u-lul az-mi mi-nar ru-su-li wa-laa tas-ta-jil la-hum kaan-na-hum yaw-ma ya-raw-na maa yoo-a-doo-na lam yal-ba-sooo il-laa saaa-tam min na-haar ba-laagh fa-hal yuh-la-ku il-lal qaw-mul faa-si-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ ١
ayahs.text_simple: الذين كفروا وصدوا عن سبيل الله اضل اعملهم
ayahs.translation: Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allāh - He will waste their deeds.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na ka-fa-roo wa-sad-doo an sabee-lil laa-hi a-dal-la a-maa-la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَءَامَنُواْ بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡ كَفَّرَ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ وَأَصۡلَحَ بَالَهُمۡ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: والذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت وءامنوا بما نزل علي محمد وهو الحق من ربهم كفر عنهم سياتهم واصلح بالهم
ayahs.translation: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muḥammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti waaa-ma-noo bi-maa nuz-zi-la a-laa mu-ham-ma-din-wwa hu-wal haq-qu mir rab-bi-him kaf-fa-ra a-nhum saiyi-a-a-ti-him waas-la-ha baa-la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلۡبَٰطِلَ وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلۡحَقَّ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمۡثَٰلَهُمۡ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: ذلك بان الذين كفروا اتبعوا البطل وان الذين ءامنوا اتبعوا الحق من ربهم كذلك يضرب الله للناس امثلهم
ayahs.translation: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allāh present to the people their comparisons.
ayahs.transliteration: zaa-li-ka bi-a-nnal lazee-na ka-fa-rut ta-baul baa-ti-la waan-nal lazee-na aa-ma-nut ta-baul haq-qa mir rab-bi-him ka-zaa-li-ka yad-ri-bul laa-hu lin-naa-si am-saa-la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَضَرۡبَ ٱلرِّقَابِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَثۡخَنتُمُوهُمۡ فَشُدُّواْ ٱلۡوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنَّۢا بَعۡدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتَّىٰ تَضَعَ ٱلۡحَرۡبُ أَوۡزَارَهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَلَوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَٱنتَصَرَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَبۡلُوَاْ بَعۡضَكُم بِبَعۡضٖۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ قُتِلُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: فاذا لقيتم الذين كفروا فضرب الرقاب حتي اذا اثخنتموهم فشدوا الوثاق فاما منا بعد واما فداء حتي تضع الحرب اوزارها ذلك ولو يشاء الله لانتصر منهم ولكن ليبلوا بعضكم ببعض والذين قتلوا في سبيل الله فلن يضل اعملهم
ayahs.translation: So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure [their] bonds, and either [confer] favor afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens. That [is the command]. And if Allāh had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allāh - never will He waste their deeds.
ayahs.transliteration: fai-zaa laqee-tu-mul lazee-na ka-fa-roo fa-dar-bar ri-qaa-bi hat-taaa i-zaa as-khan-tu-moo-hum fa-shud-dul wa-saa-qa faim-maa man-nnam ba-du waim-maa fi-daaaan hat-taa ta-daal har-bu aw-zaa-ra-haa zaa-li-ka wa-law ya-shaaaul laa-hu lan-ta-sa-ra mi-nhum wa-laa-kin liyab-lu-wa ba-da-kum bi-bad wal-la-zee-na qu-ti-loo fee sabee-lil laa-hi fa-la-ny yu-dil-la a-maa-la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَيَهۡدِيهِمۡ وَيُصۡلِحُ بَالَهُمۡ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: سيهديهم ويصلح بالهم
ayahs.translation: He will guide them and amend their condition
ayahs.transliteration: sayah-dee-him wayus-li-hu baa-la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيُدۡخِلُهُمُ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمۡ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: ويدخلهم الجنة عرفها لهم
ayahs.translation: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them.
ayahs.transliteration: wayud-khi-lu-hu-mul jan-na-ta ar-ra-fa-haa la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن تَنصُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ يَنصُرۡكُمۡ وَيُثَبِّتۡ أَقۡدَامَكُمۡ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: يايها الذين ءامنوا ان تنصروا الله ينصركم ويثبت اقدامكم
ayahs.translation: O you who have believed, if you support Allāh, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayyu-hal lazee-na aa-ma-nooo in tan-su-rul laa-ha yan-sur-kum wayu-sab-bit aq-daa-ma-kum

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَتَعۡسٗا لَّهُمۡ وَأَضَلَّ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: والذين كفروا فتعسا لهم واضل اعملهم
ayahs.translation: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na ka-fa-roo fa-ta-sal la-hum waa-dal-la a-maa-la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ كَرِهُواْ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأَحۡبَطَ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: ذلك بانهم كرهوا ما انزل الله فاحبط اعملهم
ayahs.translation: That is because they disliked what Allāh revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds.
ayahs.transliteration: zaa-li-ka bi-a-nna-hum ka-ri-hoo maaa an-zal al-laa-hu faah-ba-ta a-maa-la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ أَفَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۖ دَمَّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡۖ وَلِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ أَمۡثَٰلُهَا ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: افلم يسيروا في الارض فينظروا كيف كان عقبة الذين من قبلهم دمر الله عليهم وللكفرين امثلها
ayahs.translation: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allāh destroyed [everything] over them, and for the disbelievers is something comparable.
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-lam ya-see-roo fil ar-di fayan-zu-roo kai-fa kaa-na aa-qi-ba-tul lazee-na min qab-li-him dam-ma-ral laa-hu a-lai-him wa-lil-kaa-fi-ree-na am-saa-lu-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوۡلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَأَنَّ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ لَا مَوۡلَىٰ لَهُمۡ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: ذلك بان الله مولي الذين ءامنوا وان الكفرين لا مولي لهم
ayahs.translation: That is because Allāh is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector.
ayahs.transliteration: zaa-li-ka bi-a-nnal laa-ha maw-lal lazee-na aa-ma-noo waan-nal kaa-fi-ree-na laa maw-laa la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدۡخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأۡكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأۡكُلُ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمُ وَٱلنَّارُ مَثۡوٗى لَّهُمۡ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: ان الله يدخل الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر والذين كفروا يتمتعون وياكلون كما تاكل الانعم والنار مثوي لهم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Allāh will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal laa-ha yud-khi-lul lazee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti jan-naa-tin taj-ree min tah-ti-hal a-nhaa-ru wal-la-zee-na ka-fa-roo ya-ta-mat-taoo-na waya-ku-loo-na ka-maa ta-ku-lul a-naa-mu wan-naa-ru mas-wan la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ هِيَ أَشَدُّ قُوَّةٗ مِّن قَرۡيَتِكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَخۡرَجَتۡكَ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمۡ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: وكاين من قرية هي اشد قوة من قريتك التي اخرجتك اهلكنهم فلا ناصر لهم
ayahs.translation: And how many a city was stronger than your city [i.e., Makkah] which drove you out? We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kaayyim min qa-rya-tin hiya a-shad-du quw-wa-tam min qa-rya-ti-kal lateee ak-hra-jat-ka ah-lak-naa-hum fa-laa naa-si-ra la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ كَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُم ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: افمن كان علي بينة من ربه كمن زين له سوء عمله واتبعوا اهواءهم
ayahs.translation: So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-man kaa-na a-laa baiyi-na-tim mir rab-bihee ka-man zuyyi-na la-hoo sooou a-ma-lihee wat-ta-baooo ah-waaaa-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَّثَلُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِي وُعِدَ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَۖ فِيهَآ أَنۡهَٰرٞ مِّن مَّآءٍ غَيۡرِ ءَاسِنٖ وَأَنۡهَٰرٞ مِّن لَّبَنٖ لَّمۡ يَتَغَيَّرۡ طَعۡمُهُۥ وَأَنۡهَٰرٞ مِّنۡ خَمۡرٖ لَّذَّةٖ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ وَأَنۡهَٰرٞ مِّنۡ عَسَلٖ مُّصَفّٗىۖ وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَمَغۡفِرَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ كَمَنۡ هُوَ خَٰلِدٞ فِي ٱلنَّارِ وَسُقُواْ مَآءً حَمِيمٗا فَقَطَّعَ أَمۡعَآءَهُمۡ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: مثل الجنة التي وعد المتقون فيها انهر من ماء غير ءاسن وانهر من لبن لم يتغير طعمه وانهر من خمر لذة للشربين وانهر من عسل مصفي ولهم فيها من كل الثمرت ومغفرة من ربهم كمن هو خلد في النار وسقوا ماء حميما فقطع امعاءهم
ayahs.translation: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord... [Are its inhabitants] like those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines?
ayahs.transliteration: ma-sa-lul jan-na-til latee wu-i-dal mut-ta-qoo-na fee-haaa a-nhaa-rum min maaain ghay-ri aa-si-ninw waa-nhaa-rum mil la-ba-nil lam ya-ta-ghaiyar ta-mu-hoo waa-nhaa-rum min kham-ril laz-za-tin li-shaa-ri-bee-na waa-nhaa-rum min a-sa-lim mu-saf-fanw wa-la-hum fee-ha min kul-lis sa-ma-raa-ti wa-mag-hfi-ra-tum mir rab-bi-him ka-man hu-wa khaa-li-dun fin naa-ri wa-su-qoo maaaan hamee-man fa-qat-taa a-maaaa-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَسۡتَمِعُ إِلَيۡكَ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا خَرَجُواْ مِنۡ عِندِكَ قَالُواْ لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًاۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: ومنهم من يستمع اليك حتي اذا خرجوا من عندك قالوا للذين اوتوا العلم ماذا قال ءانفا اولئك الذين طبع الله علي قلوبهم واتبعوا اهواءهم
ayahs.translation: And among them, [O Muḥammad], are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge, "What has he said just now?" Those are the ones of whom Allāh has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mi-nhum mai yas-ta-miu i-lai-ka hat-taaa i-zaa kha-ra-joo min in-di-ka qaa-loo lil-la-zee-na oo-tul il-ma maa-zaa qaa-la aa-ni-faa u-laaai-kal lazee-na ta-baal laa-hu a-laa qu-loo-bi-him wat-ta-baooo ah-waaaa-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱهۡتَدَوۡاْ زَادَهُمۡ هُدٗى وَءَاتَىٰهُمۡ تَقۡوَىٰهُمۡ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: والذين اهتدوا زادهم هدي وءاتيهم تقويهم
ayahs.translation: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-nah ta-daw zaa-da-hum hu-danw waaa-taa-hum taq-waa-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَهَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةٗۖ فَقَدۡ جَآءَ أَشۡرَاطُهَاۚ فَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمۡ إِذَا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ذِكۡرَىٰهُمۡ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: فهل ينظرون الا الساعة ان تاتيهم بغتة فقد جاء اشراطها فاني لهم اذا جاءتهم ذكريهم
ayahs.translation: Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly? But already there have come [some of] its indications. Then how [i.e., what good] to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-hal yan-zu-roo-na il-las saaa-ta an ta-tiya-hum bag-hta-tan fa-qad jaaaa as-hraa-tu-haa faan-naa la-hum i-zaa jaaaa-thum zik-raa-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱعۡلَمۡ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمۡ وَمَثۡوَىٰكُمۡ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: فاعلم انه لا اله الا الله واستغفر لذنبك وللمؤمنين والمؤمنت والله يعلم متقلبكم ومثويكم
ayahs.translation: So know, [O Muḥammad], that there is no deity except Allāh and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women. And Allāh knows of your movement and your resting place.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam an-na-hoo laaa i-laa-ha il-lal laa-hu was-tag-hfir li-zam-bi-ka wa-lil-mu-mi-nee-na wal-mu-mi-naat wal-laa-hu ya-la-mu mu-ta-qal-la-ba-kum wa-mas-waa-kum

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَتۡ سُورَةٞۖ فَإِذَآ أُنزِلَتۡ سُورَةٞ مُّحۡكَمَةٞ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا ٱلۡقِتَالُ رَأَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيۡكَ نَظَرَ ٱلۡمَغۡشِيِّ عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۖ فَأَوۡلَىٰ لَهُمۡ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: ويقول الذين ءامنوا لولا نزلت سورة فاذا انزلت سورة محكمة وذكر فيها القتال رايت الذين في قلوبهم مرض ينظرون اليك نظر المغشي عليه من الموت فاولي لهم
ayahs.translation: Those who believe say, "Why has a sūrah not been sent down?" But when a precise sūrah is revealed and battle is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] looking at you with a look of one overcome by death. And more appropriate for them [would have been]
ayahs.transliteration: waya-qoo-lul lazee-na aa-ma-noo law-laa nuz-zi-lat soo-ra-tun fai-zaaa un-zi-lat soo-ra-tum muh-ka-ma-tunw wa-zu-ki-ra fee-hal qi-taa-lu raay-tal lazee-na fee qu-loo-bi-him ma-ra-du-ny yan-zu-roo-na i-lai-ka na-za-ral mag-hshiyyi a-lai-hi mi-nal maw-ti faaw-laa la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: طَاعَةٞ وَقَوۡلٞ مَّعۡرُوفٞۚ فَإِذَا عَزَمَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ فَلَوۡ صَدَقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيۡرٗا لَّهُمۡ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: طاعة وقول معروف فاذا عزم الامر فلو صدقوا الله لكان خيرا لهم
ayahs.translation: Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allāh, it would have been better for them.
ayahs.transliteration: taaa-tunw wa-qaw-lum ma-roof fai-zaa a-za-mal am-ru fa-law sa-da-qul laa-ha la-kaa-na khai-ral la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَهَلۡ عَسَيۡتُمۡ إِن تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ أَن تُفۡسِدُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوٓاْ أَرۡحَامَكُمۡ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: فهل عسيتم ان توليتم ان تفسدوا في الارض وتقطعوا ارحامكم
ayahs.translation: So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-hal a-sai-tum in ta-wal-lai-tum an tuf-si-doo fil ar-di wa-tu-qat-tiooo a-rhaa-ma-kum

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمۡ وَأَعۡمَىٰٓ أَبۡصَٰرَهُمۡ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك الذين لعنهم الله فاصمهم واعمي ابصرهم
ayahs.translation: Those [who do so] are the ones that Allāh has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision.
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-kal lazee-na laa-na-hu-mul laa-hu faa-sam-ma-hum waa-maaa ab-saa-ra-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ أَمۡ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقۡفَالُهَآ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: افلا يتدبرون القرءان ام علي قلوب اقفالها
ayahs.translation: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur’ān, or are there locks upon [their] hearts?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-laa ya-ta-dab-ba-roo-nal qu-raa-na am a-laa qu-loo-bin aq-faa-lu-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱرۡتَدُّواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَدۡبَٰرِهِم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡهُدَى ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمۡ وَأَمۡلَىٰ لَهُمۡ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين ارتدوا علي ادبرهم من بعد ما تبين لهم الهدي الشيطن سول لهم واملي لهم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who reverted back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-nar tad-doo a-laaa ad-baa-ri-him min ba-di maa ta-baiya-na la-hu-mul hu-dash shai-taa-nu saw-wa-la la-hum waam-laa la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ قَالُواْ لِلَّذِينَ كَرِهُواْ مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ سَنُطِيعُكُمۡ فِي بَعۡضِ ٱلۡأَمۡرِۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ إِسۡرَارَهُمۡ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: ذلك بانهم قالوا للذين كرهوا ما نزل الله سنطيعكم في بعض الامر والله يعلم اسرارهم
ayahs.translation: That is because they said to those who disliked what Allāh sent down, "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allāh knows what they conceal.
ayahs.transliteration: zaa-li-ka bi-a-nna-hum qaa-loo lil-la-zee-na ka-ri-hoo maa naz-za-lal laa-hu sa-nu-tee-u-kum fee ba-dil am-ri wal-laa-hu ya-la-mu is-raa-ra-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكَيۡفَ إِذَا تَوَفَّتۡهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَضۡرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمۡ وَأَدۡبَٰرَهُمۡ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: فكيف اذا توفتهم الملئكة يضربون وجوههم وادبرهم
ayahs.translation: Then how [will it be] when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kai-fa i-zaa ta-waf-fa-thu-mul ma-laaai-ka-tu yad-ri-boo-na wu-joo-ha-hum waad-baa-ra-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ ٱتَّبَعُواْ مَآ أَسۡخَطَ ٱللَّهَ وَكَرِهُواْ رِضۡوَٰنَهُۥ فَأَحۡبَطَ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: ذلك بانهم اتبعوا ما اسخط الله وكرهوا رضونه فاحبط اعملهم
ayahs.translation: That is because they followed what angered Allāh and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds.
ayahs.transliteration: zaa-li-ka bi-a-nna-hu-mut ta-baoo maaa as-kha-tal laa-ha wa-ka-ri-hoo rid-waa-na-hoo faah-ba-ta a-maa-la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَن لَّن يُخۡرِجَ ٱللَّهُ أَضۡغَٰنَهُمۡ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: ام حسب الذين في قلوبهم مرض ان لن يخرج الله اضغنهم
ayahs.translation: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allāh would never expose their [feelings of] hatred?
ayahs.transliteration: am ha-si-bal lazee-na fee qu-loo-bi-him ma-ra-dun al la-ny yuk-hri-jal laa-hu ad-ghaa-na-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَأَرَيۡنَٰكَهُمۡ فَلَعَرَفۡتَهُم بِسِيمَٰهُمۡۚ وَلَتَعۡرِفَنَّهُمۡ فِي لَحۡنِ ٱلۡقَوۡلِۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ أَعۡمَٰلَكُمۡ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: ولو نشاء لارينكهم فلعرفتهم بسيمهم ولتعرفنهم في لحن القول والله يعلم اعملكم
ayahs.translation: And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of [their] speech. And Allāh knows your deeds.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law na-shaaau laa-rai-naa-ka-hum fa-laa-raf-ta-hum bisee-maa-hum wa-la-ta-ri-fan-na-hum fee lah-nil qawl wal-laa-hu ya-la-mu a-maa-la-kum

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَنَبۡلُوَنَّكُمۡ حَتَّىٰ نَعۡلَمَ ٱلۡمُجَٰهِدِينَ مِنكُمۡ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ وَنَبۡلُوَاْ أَخۡبَارَكُمۡ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: ولنبلونكم حتي نعلم المجهدين منكم والصبرين ونبلوا اخباركم
ayahs.translation: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of Allāh] and the patient, and We will test your affairs.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-nab-lu-wan-na-kum hat-taa na-la-mal mu-jaa-hi-dee-na min-kum was-saa-bi-ree-na wa-nab-lu-wa ak-hbaa-ra-kum

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَشَآقُّواْ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰ لَن يَضُرُّواْ ٱللَّهَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَسَيُحۡبِطُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين كفروا وصدوا عن سبيل الله وشاقوا الرسول من بعد ما تبين لهم الهدي لن يضروا الله شيا وسيحبط اعملهم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allāh and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them - never will they harm Allāh at all, and He will render worthless their deeds.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na ka-fa-roo wa-sad-doo an sabee-lil laa-hi wa-shaaaq-qur ra-soo-la min ba-di maa ta-baiya-na la-hu-mul hu-daa la-ny ya-dur-rul laa-ha shai-anw wa-sayuh-bi-tu a-maa-la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَلَا تُبۡطِلُوٓاْ أَعۡمَٰلَكُمۡ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: يايها الذين ءامنوا اطيعوا الله واطيعوا الرسول ولا تبطلوا اعملكم
ayahs.translation: O you who have believed, obey Allāh and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayyu-hal lazee-na aa-ma-noo atee-ul laa-ha waatee-ur ra-soo-la wa-laa tub-ti-looo a-maa-la-kum

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُواْ وَهُمۡ كُفَّارٞ فَلَن يَغۡفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمۡ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين كفروا وصدوا عن سبيل الله ثم ماتوا وهم كفار فلن يغفر الله لهم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allāh and then died while they were disbelievers - never will Allāh forgive them.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na ka-fa-roo wa-sad-doo an sabee-lil laa-hi sum-ma maa-too wa-hum kuf-faa-run fa-la-ny yag-hfi-ral laa-hu la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَا تَهِنُواْ وَتَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلسَّلۡمِ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَوۡنَ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَكُمۡ وَلَن يَتِرَكُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلَكُمۡ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: فلا تهنوا وتدعوا الي السلم وانتم الاعلون والله معكم ولن يتركم اعملكم
ayahs.translation: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allāh is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-laa ta-hi-noo wa-ta-dooo i-las sal-mi waan-tu-mul a-law-na wal-laa-hu maa-kum wa-la-ny ya-ti-ra-kum a-maa-la-kum

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا لَعِبٞ وَلَهۡوٞۚ وَإِن تُؤۡمِنُواْ وَتَتَّقُواْ يُؤۡتِكُمۡ أُجُورَكُمۡ وَلَا يَسۡـَٔلۡكُمۡ أَمۡوَٰلَكُمۡ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: انما الحيوة الدنيا لعب ولهو وان تؤمنوا وتتقوا يؤتكم اجوركم ولا يسلكم امولكم
ayahs.translation: [This] worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and fear Allāh, He will give you your rewards and not ask you for your properties.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-mal hayaa-tud du-nyaa lai-bunw wa-lahw wain tu-mi-noo wa-tat-ta-qoo yu-ti-kum u-joo-ra-kum wa-laa ya-sal-kum am-waa-la-kum

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِن يَسۡـَٔلۡكُمُوهَا فَيُحۡفِكُمۡ تَبۡخَلُواْ وَيُخۡرِجۡ أَضۡغَٰنَكُمۡ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان يسلكموها فيحفكم تبخلوا ويخرج اضغنكم
ayahs.translation: If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your hatred [i.e., unwillingness].
ayahs.transliteration: i-ny ya-sal-ku-moo-haa fayuh-fi-kum tab-kha-loo wayuk-hrij ad-ghaa-na-kum

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰٓأَنتُمۡ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ تُدۡعَوۡنَ لِتُنفِقُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَمِنكُم مَّن يَبۡخَلُۖ وَمَن يَبۡخَلۡ فَإِنَّمَا يَبۡخَلُ عَن نَّفۡسِهِۦۚ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلۡفُقَرَآءُۚ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوۡاْ يَسۡتَبۡدِلۡ قَوۡمًا غَيۡرَكُمۡ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوٓاْ أَمۡثَٰلَكُم ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: هانتم هؤلاء تدعون لتنفقوا في سبيل الله فمنكم من يبخل ومن يبخل فانما يبخل عن نفسه والله الغني وانتم الفقراء وان تتولوا يستبدل قوما غيركم ثم لا يكونوا امثلكم
ayahs.translation: Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of Allāh - but among you are those who withhold [out of greed]. And whoever withholds only withholds [benefit] from himself; and Allāh is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away [i.e., refuse], He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you.
ayahs.transliteration: haaaan-tum haaau-laaai tu-daw-na li-tun-fi-qoo fee sabee-lil laa-hi fa-min-kum ma-ny yab-kha-lu wa-ma-ny yab-khal fain-na-maa yab-kha-lu an naf-sih wal-laa-hu gha-niyyu waan-tu-mul fu-qa-raaa wain ta-ta-wal-law yas-tab-dil qaw-man ghai-ra-kum sum-ma laa ya-koo-nooo am-saa-la-kum

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا فَتَحۡنَا لَكَ فَتۡحٗا مُّبِينٗا ١
ayahs.text_simple: انا فتحنا لك فتحا مبينا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have given you, [O Muḥammad], a clear conquest
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa fa-tah-naa la-ka fa-tham mubee-naa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِّيَغۡفِرَ لَكَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنۢبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعۡمَتَهُۥ عَلَيۡكَ وَيَهۡدِيَكَ صِرَٰطٗا مُّسۡتَقِيمٗا ٢
ayahs.text_simple: ليغفر لك الله ما تقدم من ذنبك وما تاخر ويتم نعمته عليك ويهديك صرطا مستقيما
ayahs.translation: That Allāh may forgive for you what preceded of your sin [i.e., errors] and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path
ayahs.transliteration: liyag-hfi-ra la-kal laa-hu maa ta-qad-da-ma min zan-bi-ka wa-maa taak-hkha-ra wayu-tim-ma ni-ma-ta-hoo a-lai-ka wayah-diya-ka si-raa-tan mus-ta-qee-ma

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَنصُرَكَ ٱللَّهُ نَصۡرًا عَزِيزًا ٣
ayahs.text_simple: وينصرك الله نصرا عزيزا
ayahs.translation: And [that] Allāh may aid you with a mighty victory.
ayahs.transliteration: wayan-su-ra-kal laa-hu nas-ran azee-zaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ لِيَزۡدَادُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنٗا مَّعَ إِيمَٰنِهِمۡۗ وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمٗا ٤
ayahs.text_simple: هو الذي انزل السكينة في قلوب المؤمنين ليزدادوا ايمنا مع ايمنهم ولله جنود السموت والارض وكان الله عليما حكيما
ayahs.translation: It is He who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their [present] faith. And to Allāh belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, and ever is Allāh Knowing and Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: hu-wal lazeee an-za-las sakee-na-ta fee qu-loo-bil mu-mi-nee-na liyaz-daa-dooo ee-maa-nam maa ee-maa-ni-him wa-lil-laa-hi ju-noo-dus sa-ma-waa-ti wa-lard wa-kaa-nal laa-hu alee-man hakee-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِّيُدۡخِلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ فَوۡزًا عَظِيمٗا ٥
ayahs.text_simple: ليدخل المؤمنين والمؤمنت جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها ويكفر عنهم سياتهم وكان ذلك عند الله فوزا عظيما
ayahs.translation: [And] that He may admit the believing men and the believing women to gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein eternally and remove from them their misdeeds - and ever is that, in the sight of Allāh, a great attainment –
ayahs.transliteration: liyud-khi-lal mu-mi-nee-na wal-mu-mi-naa-ti jan-naa-tin taj-ree min tah-ti-hal a-nhaa-ru khaa-li-dee-na fee-haa wayu-kaf-fi-ra a-nhum saiyi-a-a-ti-him wa-kaa-na zaa-li-ka in-dal laa-hi faw-zan azee-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقَٰتِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكَٰتِ ٱلظَّآنِّينَ بِٱللَّهِ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوۡءِۚ عَلَيۡهِمۡ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوۡءِۖ وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَعَنَهُمۡ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَسَآءَتۡ مَصِيرٗا ٦
ayahs.text_simple: ويعذب المنفقين والمنفقت والمشركين والمشركت الظانين بالله ظن السوء عليهم دائرة السوء وغضب الله عليهم ولعنهم واعد لهم جهنم وساءت مصيرا
ayahs.translation: And [that] He may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women, and the polytheist men and polytheist women - those who assume about Allāh an assumption of evil nature. Upon them is a misfortune of evil nature; and Allāh has become angry with them and has cursed them and prepared for them Hell, and evil it is as a destination.
ayahs.transliteration: wayu-a-zzi-bal mu-naa-fi-qee-na wal-mu-naa-fi-qaa-ti wal-mus-hri-kee-na wal-mus-hri-kaa-tiz zaaan-nee-na bil-laa-hi zan-nas saw a-lai-him daaai-ra-tus sa-wi wa-gha-di-bal laa-hu a-lai-him wa-laa-na-hum waaad-da la-hum ja-han-na-ma wa-saaaat masee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولله جنود السموت والارض وكان الله عزيزا حكيما
ayahs.translation: And to Allāh belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lil-laa-hi ju-noo-dus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lard wa-kaa-nal laa-hu azee-zan hakee-ma

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ شَٰهِدٗا وَمُبَشِّرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا ٨
ayahs.text_simple: انا ارسلنك شهدا ومبشرا ونذيرا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner
ayahs.transliteration: in-naaa ar-sal-naa-ka shaa-hi-danw wa-mu-bas-hshi-ranw wa-na-zee-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِّتُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُۚ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكۡرَةٗ وَأَصِيلًا ٩
ayahs.text_simple: لتؤمنوا بالله ورسوله وتعزروه وتوقروه وتسبحوه بكرة واصيلا
ayahs.translation: That you [people] may believe in Allāh and His Messenger and honor him and respect him [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] and exalt Him [i.e., Allāh] morning and afternoon.
ayahs.transliteration: li-tu-mi-noo bil-laa-hi wa-ra-soo-lihee wa-tu-a-zzi-roo-hu wa-tu-waq-qi-roo-hu wa-tu-sab-bi-hoo-hu buk-ra-tanw waasee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوۡقَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَوۡفَىٰ بِمَا عَٰهَدَ عَلَيۡهُ ٱللَّهَ فَسَيُؤۡتِيهِ أَجۡرًا عَظِيمٗا ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين يبايعونك انما يبايعون الله يد الله فوق ايديهم فمن نكث فانما ينكث علي نفسه ومن اوفي بما عهد عليه الله فسيؤتيه اجرا عظيما
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you, [O Muḥammad] - they are actually pledging allegiance to Allāh. The hand of Allāh is over their hands. So he who breaks his word only breaks it to the detriment of himself. And he who fulfills that which he has promised Allāh - He will give him a great reward.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na yu-baayioo-na-ka in-na-maa yu-baayioo-nal laa-ha ya-dul laa-hi faw-qa ay-dee-him fa-man na-ka-sa fain-na-maa yan-ku-su a-laa naf-sihee wa-man aw-faa bi-maa aa-ha-da a-lai-hul-laa-ha fa-sa yu-tee-hi aj-ran azee-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَيَقُولُ لَكَ ٱلۡمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابِ شَغَلَتۡنَآ أَمۡوَٰلُنَا وَأَهۡلُونَا فَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَنَاۚ يَقُولُونَ بِأَلۡسِنَتِهِم مَّا لَيۡسَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمۡۚ قُلۡ فَمَن يَمۡلِكُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـًٔا إِنۡ أَرَادَ بِكُمۡ ضَرًّا أَوۡ أَرَادَ بِكُمۡ نَفۡعَۢاۚ بَلۡ كَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرَۢا ١١
ayahs.text_simple: سيقول لك المخلفون من الاعراب شغلتنا امولنا واهلونا فاستغفر لنا يقولون بالسنتهم ما ليس في قلوبهم قل فمن يملك لكم من الله شيا ان اراد بكم ضرا او اراد بكم نفعا بل كان الله بما تعملون خبيرا
ayahs.translation: Those who remained behind of the bedouins will say to you, "Our properties and our families occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us." They say with their tongues what is not within their hearts. Say, "Then who could prevent Allāh at all if He intended for you harm or intended for you benefit? Rather, ever is Allāh, of what you do, Aware.
ayahs.transliteration: saya-qoo-lu la-kal mu-khal-la-foo-na mi-nal a-raa-bi shai-gha-lat-naaa am-waa-lu-naa waah-loo-naa fas-tag-hfir la-naa ya-qoo-loo-na bi-a-lsi-na-ti-him maa lai-sa fee qu-loo-bi-him qul fa-ma-ny yam-li-ku la-kum mi-nal laa-hi shai-an in a-raa-da bi-kum dar-ran aw a-raa-da bi-kum naf aa bal kaa-nal laa-hu bi-maa ta-ma-loo-na khabee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَنقَلِبَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِيهِمۡ أَبَدٗا وَزُيِّنَ ذَٰلِكَ فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡ وَظَنَنتُمۡ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوۡءِ وَكُنتُمۡ قَوۡمَۢا بُورٗا ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: بل ظننتم ان لن ينقلب الرسول والمؤمنون الي اهليهم ابدا وزين ذلك في قلوبكم وظننتم ظن السوء وكنتم قوما بورا
ayahs.translation: But you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families, ever, and that was made pleasing in your hearts. And you assumed an assumption of evil and became a people ruined."
ayahs.transliteration: bal za-nan-tum al la-ny yan-qa-li-bar ra-soo-lu wal-mu-mi-noo-na i-laaa ah-lee-him a-ba-danw wa-zuyyi-na zaa-li-ka fee qu-loo-bi-kum wa-za-nan-tum zan-nnas sa-wi wa-kun-tum qaw-mam boo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَن لَّمۡ يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ فَإِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ سَعِيرٗا ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: ومن لم يؤمن بالله ورسوله فانا اعتدنا للكفرين سعيرا
ayahs.translation: And whoever has not believed in Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers a Blaze.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mal lam yu-mim bil-laa-hi wa-ra-soo-lihee fain-naaa a-tad-naa lil-kaa-fi-ree-na saee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ يَغۡفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولله ملك السموت والارض يغفر لمن يشاء ويعذب من يشاء وكان الله غفورا رحيما
ayahs.translation: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lil-laa-hii mul-kus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lard yag-hfi-ru li-ma-ny ya-shaaau wayu-a-zzi-bu ma-ny ya-shaaa wa-kaa-nal laa-hu gha-foo-rar rahee-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَيَقُولُ ٱلۡمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا ٱنطَلَقۡتُمۡ إِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَأۡخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعۡكُمۡۖ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُبَدِّلُواْ كَلَٰمَ ٱللَّهِۚ قُل لَّن تَتَّبِعُونَا كَذَٰلِكُمۡ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ مِن قَبۡلُۖ فَسَيَقُولُونَ بَلۡ تَحۡسُدُونَنَاۚ بَلۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَفۡقَهُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: سيقول المخلفون اذا انطلقتم الي مغانم لتاخذوها ذرونا نتبعكم يريدون ان يبدلوا كلم الله قل لن تتبعونا كذلكم قال الله من قبل فسيقولون بل تحسدوننا بل كانوا لا يفقهون الا قليلا
ayahs.translation: Those who remained behind will say when you set out toward the war booty to take it, "Let us follow you." They wish to change the words of Allāh. Say, "Never will you follow us. Thus did Allāh say before." So they will say, "Rather, you envy us." But [in fact] they were not understanding except a little.
ayahs.transliteration: saya-qoo-lul mu-khal-la-foo-na i-zan ta-laq-tum i-laa ma-ghaa-ni-ma li-taa-khu-zoo-haa za-roo-naa nat-ta-bi-kum yu-ree-doo-na a-ny yu-bad-di-loo ka-laa-mal laah qul lan tat-ta-bioo-naa ka-zaa-li-kum qaa-lal laa-hu min qab-lu fa-saya-qoo-loo-na bal tah-su-doo-nan-na bal kaa-noo laa yaf-qa-hoo-na il-laa qalee-la

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُل لِّلۡمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابِ سَتُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٍ أُوْلِي بَأۡسٖ شَدِيدٖ تُقَٰتِلُونَهُمۡ أَوۡ يُسۡلِمُونَۖ فَإِن تُطِيعُواْ يُؤۡتِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَجۡرًا حَسَنٗاۖ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوۡاْ كَمَا تَوَلَّيۡتُم مِّن قَبۡلُ يُعَذِّبۡكُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: قل للمخلفين من الاعراب ستدعون الي قوم اولي باس شديد تقتلونهم او يسلمون فان تطيعوا يؤتكم الله اجرا حسنا وان تتولوا كما توليتم من قبل يعذبكم عذابا اليما
ayahs.translation: Say to those who remained behind of the bedouins, "You will be called to [face] a people of great military might; you may fight them, or they will submit. So if you obey, Allāh will give you a good reward; but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment."
ayahs.transliteration: qul lil-mu-khal-la-fee-na mi-nal a-raa-bi sa-tu-daw-na i-laa qaw-min ulee baa-sin shadee-din tu-qaa-ti-loo-na-hum aw yus-li-moo-na fain tu-tee-o-o yu-ti-ku-mul laa-hu aj-ran ha-sa-nanw wain ta-ta-wal-law ka-maa ta-wal-lai-tum min qab-lu yu-a-zzib-kum a-zaa-ban alee-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّيۡسَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ حَرَجٞ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡرَجِ حَرَجٞ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡمَرِيضِ حَرَجٞۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ يُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبۡهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: ليس علي الاعمي حرج ولا علي الاعرج حرج ولا علي المريض حرج ومن يطع الله ورسوله يدخله جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر ومن يتول يعذبه عذابا اليما
ayahs.translation: There is not upon the blind any guilt or upon the lame any guilt or upon the ill any guilt [for remaining behind]. And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger - He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away - He will punish him with a painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: lai-sa a-lal a-maa ha-ra-junw wa-laa a-lal a-ra-ji ha-ra-junw wa-laa a-lal maree-di ha-raj wa-ma-ny yu-ti-lil laa-ha wa-ra-soo-la-hoo yud-khi-lhu jan-naa-tin taj-ree min tah-ti-hal a-nhaa-ru wa-ma-ny ya-ta-wal-la yu-a-zzi-bhu a-zaa-ban alee-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ لَّقَدۡ رَضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ إِذۡ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحۡتَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِي قُلُوبِهِمۡ فَأَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَأَثَٰبَهُمۡ فَتۡحٗا قَرِيبٗا ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: لقد رضي الله عن المؤمنين اذ يبايعونك تحت الشجرة فعلم ما في قلوبهم فانزل السكينة عليهم واثبهم فتحا قريبا
ayahs.translation: Certainly was Allāh pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you, [O Muḥammad], under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquility upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest
ayahs.transliteration: la-qad ra-diyal laa-hu a-nil mu-mi-nee-na iz yu-baayioo-na-ka tah-tash sha-ja-ra-ti faa-li-ma maa fee qu-loo-bi-him faan-za-las sakee-na-ta a-lai-him waa-saa-ba-hum fa-than qaree-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةٗ يَأۡخُذُونَهَاۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمٗا ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: ومغانم كثيرة ياخذونها وكان الله عزيزا حكيما
ayahs.translation: And much war booty which they will take. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ma-ghaa-ni-ma kasee-ra-ta-ny yaa-khu-zoo-na-haa wa-kaa-nal laa-hu azee-zan hakee-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَعَدَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةٗ تَأۡخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمۡ هَٰذِهِۦ وَكَفَّ أَيۡدِيَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنكُمۡ وَلِتَكُونَ ءَايَةٗ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَيَهۡدِيَكُمۡ صِرَٰطٗا مُّسۡتَقِيمٗا ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: وعدكم الله مغانم كثيرة تاخذونها فعجل لكم هذه وكف ايدي الناس عنكم ولتكون ءاية للمؤمنين ويهديكم صرطا مستقيما
ayahs.translation: Allāh has promised you much booty that you will take [in the future] and has hastened for you this [victory] and withheld the hands of people from you - that it may be a sign for the believers and [that] He may guide you to a straight path.
ayahs.transliteration: waa-da-ku-mul laa-hu ma-ghaa-ni-ma kasee-ra-tan taa-khu-zoo-na-haa faaj-ja-la la-kum haa-zihee wa-kaf-fa ay-diyan naa-si an-kum wa-li-ta-koo-na aaya-tal lil-mu-mi-nee-na wayah-diya-kum si-raa-tam mus-ta-qee-ma

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأُخۡرَىٰ لَمۡ تَقۡدِرُواْ عَلَيۡهَا قَدۡ أَحَاطَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَاۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٗا ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: واخري لم تقدروا عليها قد احاط الله بها وكان الله علي كل شيء قديرا
ayahs.translation: And [He promises] other [victories] that you were [so far] unable to [realize] which Allāh has already encompassed. And ever is Allāh, over all things, competent.
ayahs.transliteration: wauk-hraa lam taq-di-roo a-lai-haa qad a-haa-tal laa-hu bi-haa wa-kaa-nal laa-hu a-laa kul-li shaiin qadee-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡ قَٰتَلَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوَلَّوُاْ ٱلۡأَدۡبَٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيّٗا وَلَا نَصِيرٗا ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: ولو قتلكم الذين كفروا لولوا الادبر ثم لا يجدون وليا ولا نصيرا
ayahs.translation: And if those [Makkans] who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned their backs [in flight]. Then they would not find a protector or a helper.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law qaa-ta-la-ku-mul lazee-na ka-fa-roo la-wal-la-wul ad-baa-ra sum-ma laa ya-ji-doo-na wa-liyan-wwa laa nasee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِي قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبۡدِيلٗا ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: سنة الله التي قد خلت من قبل ولن تجد لسنة الله تبديلا
ayahs.translation: [This is] the established way of Allāh which has occurred before. And never will you find in the way of Allāh any change.
ayahs.transliteration: sun-na-tal laa-hil latee qad kha-lat min qab-lu wa-lan ta-ji-da li-sun-na-til laa-hi tab-dee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي كَفَّ أَيۡدِيَهُمۡ عَنكُمۡ وَأَيۡدِيَكُمۡ عَنۡهُم بِبَطۡنِ مَكَّةَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَنۡ أَظۡفَرَكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: وهو الذي كف ايديهم عنكم وايديكم عنهم ببطن مكة من بعد ان اظفركم عليهم وكان الله بما تعملون بصيرا
ayahs.translation: And it is He who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within [the area of] Makkah after He caused you to overcome them. And ever is Allāh, of what you do, Seeing.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wal lazee kaf-fa ay-diya-hum an-kum waay-diya-kum a-nhum bi-bat-ni mak-ka-ta mim ba-di an az-fa-ra-kum a-lai-him wa-kaa-nal laa-hu bi-maa ta-ma-loo-na basee-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّوكُمۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ وَٱلۡهَدۡيَ مَعۡكُوفًا أَن يَبۡلُغَ مَحِلَّهُۥۚ وَلَوۡلَا رِجَالٞ مُّؤۡمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءٞ مُّؤۡمِنَٰتٞ لَّمۡ تَعۡلَمُوهُمۡ أَن تَطَـُٔوهُمۡ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنۡهُم مَّعَرَّةُۢ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖۖ لِّيُدۡخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ لَوۡ تَزَيَّلُواْ لَعَذَّبۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: هم الذين كفروا وصدوكم عن المسجد الحرام والهدي معكوفا ان يبلغ محله ولولا رجال مؤمنون ونساء مؤمنت لم تعلموهم ان تطوهم فتصيبكم منهم معرة بغير علم ليدخل الله في رحمته من يشاء لو تزيلوا لعذبنا الذين كفروا منهم عذابا اليما
ayahs.translation: They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām while the offering was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice. And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample [i.e., kill] them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without [your] knowledge - [you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]. [This was so] that Allāh might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart [from them], We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment
ayahs.transliteration: hu-mul lazee-na ka-fa-roo wa-sad-doo-kum a-nil mas-ji-dil ha-raa-mi wa-lha-dya ma-koo-fan a-ny yab-lu-gha ma-hil-lah wa-law-laa ri-jaa-lum mu-mi-noo-na wa-ni-saaaum mu-mi-naa-tul lam ta-la-moo-hum an ta-taoo-hum fa-tu-see-ba-kum mi-nhum maar-ra-tum bi-ghai-ri il-min liyud-khi-lal laa-hu fee rah-ma-tihee ma-ny ya-shaaa law ta-zayya-loo laaz-zab-nal lazee-na ka-fa-roo mi-nhum a-zaa-ban alee-ma

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلۡحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَأَلۡزَمَهُمۡ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓاْ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهۡلَهَاۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٗا ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: اذ جعل الذين كفروا في قلوبهم الحمية حمية الجهلية فانزل الله سكينته علي رسوله وعلي المؤمنين والزمهم كلمة التقوي وكانوا احق بها واهلها وكان الله بكل شيء عليما
ayahs.translation: When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts chauvinism - the chauvinism of the time of ignorance. But Allāh sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness, and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it. And ever is Allāh, of all things, Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: iz jaa-lal lazee-na ka-fa-roo fee qu-loo-bi-hi-mul ha-miyya-ta ha-miyya-tal jaa-hi-liyya-ti faan-za-lal laa-hu sakee-na-ta-hoo a-laa ra-soo-lihee waa-lal mu-mi-nee-na waal-za-ma-hum ka-li-ma-tat taq-waa wa-kaa-nooo a-haq-qa bi-haa waah-la-haa wa-kaa-nal laa-hu bi-kul-li shaiin alee-ma

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّقَدۡ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءۡيَا بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ لَتَدۡخُلُنَّ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدَ ٱلۡحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمۡ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمۡ تَعۡلَمُواْ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتۡحٗا قَرِيبًا ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: لقد صدق الله رسوله الرءيا بالحق لتدخلن المسجد الحرام ان شاء الله ءامنين محلقين رءوسكم ومقصرين لا تخافون فعلم ما لم تعلموا فجعل من دون ذلك فتحا قريبا
ayahs.translation: Certainly has Allāh showed to His Messenger the vision [i.e., dream] in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, if Allāh wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and [hair] shortened, not fearing [anyone]. He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near [at hand].
ayahs.transliteration: la-qad sa-da-qal laa-hu ra-soo-la-hur ruyaa bi-lhaqq la-tad-khu-lun-nal mas-ji-dal ha-raa-ma in shaaaal laa-hu aa-mi-nee-na mu-hal-li-qee-na ruoo-sa-kum wa-mu-qas-si-ree-na laa ta-khaa-foo-na faa-li-ma maa lam ta-la-moo fa-jaa-la min doo-ni zaa-li-ka fa-than qaree-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَرۡسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلۡحَقِّ لِيُظۡهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدٗا ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: هو الذي ارسل رسوله بالهدي ودين الحق ليظهره علي الدين كله وكفي بالله شهيدا
ayahs.translation: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allāh as Witness.
ayahs.transliteration: hu-wal lazeee ar-sa-la ra-soo-la-hoo bi-lhu-daa wadee-nil haq-qi liyu-zhi-ra-hoo a-lad dee-ni kul-lih wa-ka-faa bil-laa-hi shahee-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: مُّحَمَّدٞ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلۡكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ تَرَىٰهُمۡ رُكَّعٗا سُجَّدٗا يَبۡتَغُونَ فَضۡلٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضۡوَٰنٗاۖ سِيمَاهُمۡ فِي وُجُوهِهِم مِّنۡ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمۡ فِي ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِۚ وَمَثَلُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡإِنجِيلِ كَزَرۡعٍ أَخۡرَجَ شَطۡـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسۡتَغۡلَظَ فَٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعۡجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلۡكُفَّارَۗ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنۡهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٗ وَأَجۡرًا عَظِيمَۢا ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: محمد رسول الله والذين معه اشداء علي الكفار رحماء بينهم تريهم ركعا سجدا يبتغون فضلا من الله ورضونا سيماهم في وجوههم من اثر السجود ذلك مثلهم في التورية ومثلهم في الانجيل كزرع اخرج شطه فازره فاستغلظ فاستوي علي سوقه يعجب الزراع ليغيظ بهم الكفار وعد الله الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت منهم مغفرة واجرا عظيما
ayahs.translation: Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allāh; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking bounty from Allāh and [His] pleasure. Their sign is in their faces from the effect of prostration [i.e., prayer]. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that He [i.e., Allāh] may enrage by them the disbelievers. Allāh has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.
ayahs.transliteration: mu-ham-ma-dur ra-soo-lul laah wal-la-zee-na maa-hooo a-shid-daaau a-lal kuf-faaa-ri ru-ha-maaau bai-na-hum ta-raa-hum ruk-kaan suj-ja-da-ny yab-ta-ghoo-na fad-lam mi-nal laa-hi wa-rid-waa-na see-maa-hum fee wu-joo-hi-him min a-sa-ris su-jood zaa-li-ka ma-sa-lu-hum fit taw-raah wa-ma-sa-lu-hum fil in-jee-li ka-za-rin ak-hra-ja sha-ta-hoo faaa-za-ra-hoo fas-tag-hla-za fas-ta-waa a-laa soo-qihee yu-ji-buz zur-raaa liya-ghee-za bi-hi-mul kuf-faar waa-dal laa-hul lazee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti mi-nhum mag-hfi-ra-tanw waaj-ran azee-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُقَدِّمُواْ بَيۡنَ يَدَيِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٞ ١
ayahs.text_simple: يايها الذين ءامنوا لا تقدموا بين يدي الله ورسوله واتقوا الله ان الله سميع عليم
ayahs.translation: O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before Allāh and His Messenger but fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaayyu-hal lazee-na aa-ma-noo la tu-qad-di-moo bai-na ya-dayil laa-hi wa-ra-soo-lihee wat-ta-qul laah in-nal laa-ha samee-un aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَرۡفَعُوٓاْ أَصۡوَٰتَكُمۡ فَوۡقَ صَوۡتِ ٱلنَّبِيِّ وَلَا تَجۡهَرُواْ لَهُۥ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ كَجَهۡرِ بَعۡضِكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ أَن تَحۡبَطَ أَعۡمَٰلُكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَشۡعُرُونَ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: يايها الذين ءامنوا لا ترفعوا اصوتكم فوق صوت النبي ولا تجهروا له بالقول كجهر بعضكم لبعض ان تحبط اعملكم وانتم لا تشعرون
ayahs.translation: O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaayyu-hal lazee-na aa-ma-noo laa tar-faooo as-waa-ta-kum faw-qa saw-tin na-biyi wa-laa ta-jha-roo la-hoo bil-qaw-li ka-jah-ri ba-di-kum li-ba-din an tah-ba-ta a-maa-lu-kum waan-tum laa ta-shu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصۡوَٰتَهُمۡ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمۡتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمۡ لِلتَّقۡوَىٰۚ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَأَجۡرٌ عَظِيمٌ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين يغضون اصوتهم عند رسول الله اولئك الذين امتحن الله قلوبهم للتقوي لهم مغفرة واجر عظيم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allāh - they are the ones whose hearts Allāh has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na ya-ghud-doo-na as-waa-ta-hum in-da ra-soo-lil laa-hi u-laaai-kal lazee-nam ta-ha-nal laa-hu qu-loo-ba-hum lit-taq-waa la-hum mag-hfi-ra-tunw waaj-run azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلۡحُجُرَٰتِ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين ينادونك من وراء الحجرت اكثرهم لا يعقلون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who call you, [O Muḥammad], from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na yu-naa-doo-na-ka minw wa-raaail hu-ju-raa-ti ak-sa-ru-hum laa ya-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡ أَنَّهُمۡ صَبَرُواْ حَتَّىٰ تَخۡرُجَ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَكَانَ خَيۡرٗا لَّهُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولو انهم صبروا حتي تخرج اليهم لكان خيرا لهم والله غفور رحيم
ayahs.translation: And if they had been patient until you [could] come out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law an-na-hum sa-ba-roo hat-ta tak-hru-ja i-lai-him la-kaa-na khai-ral la-hum wal-laa-hu gha-foo-rur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن جَآءَكُمۡ فَاسِقُۢ بِنَبَإٖ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓاْ أَن تُصِيبُواْ قَوۡمَۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٖ فَتُصۡبِحُواْ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلۡتُمۡ نَٰدِمِينَ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: يايها الذين ءامنوا ان جاءكم فاسق بنبا فتبينوا ان تصيبوا قوما بجهلة فتصبحوا علي ما فعلتم ندمين
ayahs.translation: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayyu-hal lazee-na aa-ma-noo in jaaaa-kum faa-si-qum bi-na-bain fa-ta-baiya-nooo an tusee-boo qaw-mam bi-ja-ha-la-tin fa-tus-bi-hoo a-laa maa faal-tum naa-dimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ فِيكُمۡ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِۚ لَوۡ يُطِيعُكُمۡ فِي كَثِيرٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ لَعَنِتُّمۡ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُۥ فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡكُفۡرَ وَٱلۡفُسُوقَ وَٱلۡعِصۡيَانَۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلرَّٰشِدُونَ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: واعلموا ان فيكم رسول الله لو يطيعكم في كثير من الامر لعنتم ولكن الله حبب اليكم الايمن وزينه في قلوبكم وكره اليكم الكفر والفسوق والعصيان اولئك هم الرشدون
ayahs.translation: And know that among you is the Messenger of Allāh. If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but Allāh has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the [rightly] guided.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-mooo an-na fee-kum ra-soo-lal laah law yu-tee-u-kum fee kasee-rim mi-nal am-ri laa-nit-tum wa-laa-kin-nal laa-ha hab-ba-ba i-lai-ku-mul ee-maa-na wa-zaiya-na-hoo fee qu-loo-bi-kum wa-kar-ra-ha i-lai-ku-mul kuf-ra wal-fu-soo-qa wa-li-syaan u-laaai-ka hu-mur raa-shi-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَضۡلٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعۡمَةٗۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: فضلا من الله ونعمة والله عليم حكيم
ayahs.translation: [It is] as bounty from Allāh and favor. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: fad-lam mi-nal laa-hi wa-ni-mah wal-laa-hu alee-mun hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٱقۡتَتَلُواْ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَإِنۢ بَغَتۡ إِحۡدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰ فَقَٰتِلُواْ ٱلَّتِي تَبۡغِي حَتَّىٰ تَفِيٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ فَإِن فَآءَتۡ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَهُمَا بِٱلۡعَدۡلِ وَأَقۡسِطُوٓاْۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُقۡسِطِينَ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: وان طائفتان من المؤمنين اقتتلوا فاصلحوا بينهما فان بغت احديهما علي الاخري فقتلوا التي تبغي حتي تفيء الي امر الله فان فاءت فاصلحوا بينهما بالعدل واقسطوا ان الله يحب المقسطين
ayahs.translation: And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allāh. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allāh loves those who act justly.
ayahs.transliteration: wain taaai-fa-taa-ni mi-nal mu-mi-nee-na naq-ta-ta-loo faas-li-hoo bai-na-hu-maa faim ba-ghat ih-daa-hu-maa a-lal uk-hraa fa-qaa-ti-lul latee tab-ghee hat-taa tafeeea i-laaa am-ril laah fain faaaat faas-li-hoo bai-na-hu-maa bi-lad-li waaq-si-too in-nal laa-ha yu-hib-bul muq-siteen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ إِخۡوَةٞ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَ أَخَوَيۡكُمۡۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: انما المؤمنون اخوة فاصلحوا بين اخويكم واتقوا الله لعلكم ترحمون
ayahs.translation: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allāh that you may receive mercy.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-mal mu-mi-noo-na ik-hwa-tun faas-li-hoo bai-na a-kha-way-kum wat-ta-qul laa-ha laal-la-kum tu-rha-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا يَسۡخَرۡ قَوۡمٞ مِّن قَوۡمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُواْ خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا نِسَآءٞ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهُنَّۖ وَلَا تَلۡمِزُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَلَا تَنَابَزُواْ بِٱلۡأَلۡقَٰبِۖ بِئۡسَ ٱلِٱسۡمُ ٱلۡفُسُوقُ بَعۡدَ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنِۚ وَمَن لَّمۡ يَتُبۡ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ١١
