ayahs.text_simple: يايها الذين ءامنوا لا يسخر قوم من قوم عسي ان يكونوا خيرا منهم ولا نساء من نساء عسي ان يكن خيرا منهن ولا تلمزوا انفسكم ولا تنابزوا بالالقب بئس الاسم الفسوق بعد الايمن ومن لم يتب فاولئك هم الظلمون
ayahs.translation: O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name [i.e., mention] of disobedience after [one's] faith. And whoever does not repent - then it is those who are the wrongdoers.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayyu-hal lazee-na aa-ma-noo laa yas-khar qaw-mum min qaw-min a-saaa a-ny ya-koo-noo khai-ram mi-nhum wa-laa ni-saaaum min ni-saaain a-saaa ay ya-kun-na khai-ram mi-nhun-na wa-laa tal-mi-zooo an-fu-sa-kum wa-laa ta-naa-ba-zoo bi-lal-qaab bi-sal is-mul fu-soo-qu ba-dal ee-maan wa-mal lam ya-tub fau-laaai-ka hu-muz zaa-li-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱجۡتَنِبُواْ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعۡضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثۡمٞۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُواْ وَلَا يَغۡتَب بَّعۡضُكُم بَعۡضًاۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمۡ أَن يَأۡكُلَ لَحۡمَ أَخِيهِ مَيۡتٗا فَكَرِهۡتُمُوهُۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٞ رَّحِيمٞ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: يايها الذين ءامنوا اجتنبوا كثيرا من الظن ان بعض الظن اثم ولا تجسسوا ولا يغتب بعضكم بعضا ايحب احدكم ان ياكل لحم اخيه ميتا فكرهتموه واتقوا الله ان الله تواب رحيم
ayahs.translation: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayyu-hal lazee-na aa-ma-nuj ta-ni-boo kasee-ram mi-naz zan-ni in-na ba-daz zan-ni is-munw wa-laa ta-jas-sa-soo wa-la yag-htab ba-du-kum ba-daa ayu-hib-bu a-ha-du-kum a-ny yaa-ku-la lah-ma a-khee-hi mai-tan fa-ka-rih-tu-mooh wat-ta-qul laa in-nal laa-ha taw-waa-bur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٖ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلۡنَٰكُمۡ شُعُوبٗا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ أَكۡرَمَكُمۡ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتۡقَىٰكُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٞ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: يايها الناس انا خلقنكم من ذكر وانثي وجعلنكم شعوبا وقبائل لتعارفوا ان اكرمكم عند الله اتقيكم ان الله عليم خبير
ayahs.translation: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allāh is the most righteous of you. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Aware.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayyu-han naa-su in-naa kha-laq-naa-kum min za-ka-rinw waun-saa wa-jaal-naa-kum shuoo-banw wa-qa-baaai-la li-taaa-ra-foo in-na ak-ra-ma-kum in-dal laa-hi at-qaa-kum in-nal laa-ha alee-mun khabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَتِ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابُ ءَامَنَّاۖ قُل لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ وَلَٰكِن قُولُوٓاْ أَسۡلَمۡنَا وَلَمَّا يَدۡخُلِ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَا يَلِتۡكُم مِّنۡ أَعۡمَٰلِكُمۡ شَيۡـًٔاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: قالت الاعراب ءامنا قل لم تؤمنوا ولكن قولوا اسلمنا ولما يدخل الايمن في قلوبكم وان تطيعوا الله ورسوله لا يلتكم من اعملكم شيا ان الله غفور رحيم
ayahs.translation: The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not [yet] believed; but say [instead], 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey Allāh and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds of anything. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la-ti-la raa-bu aa-man-naa qul lam tu-mi-noo wa-laa-kin qoo-looo as-lam-naa wa-lam-ma yad-khu-lil ee-maa-nu fee qu-loo-bi-kum wain tu-tee-ul laa-ha wa-ra-soo-la-hoo laa ya-lit-kum min a-maa-li-kum shai-a-a in-nal laa-ha gha-foo-rur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَرۡتَابُواْ وَجَٰهَدُواْ بِأَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ وَأَنفُسِهِمۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: انما المؤمنون الذين ءامنوا بالله ورسوله ثم لم يرتابوا وجهدوا بامولهم وانفسهم في سبيل الله اولئك هم الصدقون
ayahs.translation: The believers are only the ones who have believed in Allāh and His Messenger and then doubt not but strive with their properties and their lives in the cause of Allāh. It is those who are the truthful.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-mal muu-mi-noo-nal lazee-na aa-ma-noo bil-laa-hi wa-ra-soo-lihee sum-ma lam yar-taa-boo wa-jaa-ha-doo bi-a-mwaa-li-him waan-fu-si-him fee sabee-lil laah u-laaai-ka hu-mus saa-di-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمۡ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: قل اتعلمون الله بدينكم والله يعلم ما في السموت وما في الارض والله بكل شيء عليم
ayahs.translation: Say, "Would you acquaint Allāh with your religion while Allāh knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allāh is Knowing of all things?"
ayahs.transliteration: qul a-tu-a-lli-moo-nal laa-ha bidee-ni-kum wal-laa-hu ya-la-mu maa fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-maa fil ard wal-laa-hu bi-kul-li shaiin aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيۡكَ أَنۡ أَسۡلَمُواْۖ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّواْ عَلَيَّ إِسۡلَٰمَكُمۖ بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ أَنۡ هَدَىٰكُمۡ لِلۡإِيمَٰنِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: يمنون عليك ان اسلموا قل لا تمنوا علي اسلمكم بل الله يمن عليكم ان هديكم للايمن ان كنتم صدقين
ayahs.translation: They consider it a favor to you that they have accepted Islām. Say, "Do not consider your Islām a favor to me. Rather, Allāh has conferred favor upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if you should be truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: ya-mun-noo-na a-lai-ka an as-la-moo qul laa ta-mun-noo a-laiya is-laa-ma-kum ba-lil laa-hu ya-mun-nu a-lai-kum an ha-daa-kum li-lee-maa-ni in kun-tum saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ غَيۡبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: ان الله يعلم غيب السموت والارض والله بصير بما تعملون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Allāh knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh is Seeing of what you do.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal laa-ha ya-la-mu ghai-bas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lard wal-laa-hu basee-rum bi-maa ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ٱلۡمَجِيدِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: ق والقرءان المجيد
ayahs.translation: Qāf. By the honored Qur’ān...
ayahs.transliteration: qaaaf wal-qu-raa-nil majeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ عَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَيۡءٌ عَجِيبٌ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: بل عجبوا ان جاءهم منذر منهم فقال الكفرون هذا شيء عجيب
ayahs.translation: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
ayahs.transliteration: bal a-ji-booo an jaaa-hum mun-zi-rum mi-nhum fa-qaa-lal kaa-fi-roo-na haa-zaa shaiun ajeeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗاۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجۡعُۢ بَعِيدٞ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: اءذا متنا وكنا ترابا ذلك رجع بعيد
ayahs.translation: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant [i.e., unlikely] return."
ayahs.transliteration: ai-zaa mit-naa wa-kun-naa tu-raa-ban zaa-li-ka ra-jum baeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظُۢ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: قد علمنا ما تنقص الارض منهم وعندنا كتب حفيظ
ayahs.translation: We know what the earth diminishes [i.e., consumes] of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
ayahs.transliteration: qad a-lim-naa maa tan-qu-sul ar-du mi-nhum wain-da-naa ki-taa-bun hafeez

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ فِيٓ أَمۡرٖ مَّرِيجٍ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: بل كذبوا بالحق لما جاءهم فهم في امر مريج
ayahs.translation: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
ayahs.transliteration: bal kaz-za-boo bi-lhaq-qi lam-maa jaaaa-hum fa-hum feee am-rim mareej

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَلَمۡ يَنظُرُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ كَيۡفَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٖ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: افلم ينظروا الي السماء فوقهم كيف بنينها وزينها وما لها من فروج
ayahs.translation: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-lam yan-zu-rooo i-las sa-maaai faw-qa-hum kai-fa ba-nai-naa-haa wa-zaiyan-naa-haa wa-maa la-haa min fu-rooj

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجِۭ بَهِيجٖ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: والارض مددنها والقينا فيها روسي وانبتنا فيها من كل زوج بهيج
ayahs.translation: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lar-da ma-dad-naa-haa waal-qai-naa fee-haa ra-waa-siya waam-bat-naa fee-haa min kul-li zaw-jim baheej

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَبۡصِرَةٗ وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبۡدٖ مُّنِيبٖ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: تبصرة وذكري لكل عبد منيب
ayahs.translation: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: tab-si-ra-tanw wa-zik-raa li-kul-li ab-dim muneeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَزَّلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ مُّبَٰرَكٗا فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٖ وَحَبَّ ٱلۡحَصِيدِ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: ونزلنا من السماء ماء مبركا فانبتنا به جنت وحب الحصيد
ayahs.translation: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
ayahs.transliteration: wa-naz-zal-naa mi-nas sa-maaai maaaam mu-baa-ra-kan faam-bat-naa bihee jan-naa-tinw wa-hab-bal haseed

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّخۡلَ بَاسِقَٰتٖ لَّهَا طَلۡعٞ نَّضِيدٞ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: والنخل باسقت لها طلع نضيد
ayahs.translation: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
ayahs.transliteration: wan-nak-hla baa-si-qaa-til la-ha ta-lun nadeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: رِّزۡقٗا لِّلۡعِبَادِۖ وَأَحۡيَيۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةٗ مَّيۡتٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡخُرُوجُ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: رزقا للعباد واحيينا به بلدة ميتا كذلك الخروج
ayahs.translation: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence [i.e., resurrection].
ayahs.transliteration: riz-qal li-li-baad waa-hyai-naa bihee bal-da-tam mai-taa ka-zaa-li-kal khu-rooj

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح واصحب الرس وثمود
ayahs.translation: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamūd
ayahs.transliteration: kaz-za-bat qab-la-hum qaw-mu noo-hinw waa-shaa-bur ras-si wa-sa-mood

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَعَادٞ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ وَإِخۡوَٰنُ لُوطٖ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: وعاد وفرعون واخون لوط
ayahs.translation: And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers [i.e., people] of Lot
ayahs.transliteration: waaa-dunw wa-fi-raw-nu waik-hwaa-nu loot

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأَيۡكَةِ وَقَوۡمُ تُبَّعٖۚ كُلّٞ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: واصحب الايكة وقوم تبع كل كذب الرسل فحق وعيد
ayahs.translation: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
ayahs.transliteration: waa-shaa-bul ay-ka-ti wa-qaw-mu tub-ba kul-lun kaz-za-bar ru-su-la fa-haq-qa waeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلۡخَلۡقِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي لَبۡسٖ مِّنۡ خَلۡقٖ جَدِيدٖ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: افعيينا بالخلق الاول بل هم في لبس من خلق جديد
ayahs.translation: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
ayahs.transliteration: a-faayee-naa bil-khal-qil aw-wal bal hum fee lab-sim min khal-qin jadeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعۡلَمُ مَا تُوَسۡوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفۡسُهُۥۖ وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ حَبۡلِ ٱلۡوَرِيدِ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد خلقنا الانسن ونعلم ما توسوس به نفسه ونحن اقرب اليه من حبل الوريد
ayahs.translation: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad kha-laq-nal in-saa-na wa-na-la-mu maa tu-was-wi-su bihee naf-su-hoo wa-nah-nu aq-ra-bu i-lai-hi min hab-lil wareed

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلۡمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٞ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: اذ يتلقي المتلقيان عن اليمين وعن الشمال قعيد
ayahs.translation: When the two receivers [i.e., recording angels] receive, seated on the right and on the left.
ayahs.transliteration: iz ya-ta-laq-qal mu-ta-laq-qiyaa-ni a-nil ya-mee-ni waa-nish shi-maa-li qaeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَّا يَلۡفِظُ مِن قَوۡلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيۡهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٞ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: ما يلفظ من قول الا لديه رقيب عتيد
ayahs.translation: He [i.e., man] utters no word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
ayahs.transliteration: maa yal-fi-zu min qaw-lin il-laa la-dai-hi raqee-bun ateed

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَآءَتۡ سَكۡرَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنۡهُ تَحِيدُ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: وجاءت سكرة الموت بالحق ذلك ما كنت منه تحيد
ayahs.translation: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaaaat sak-ra-tul maw-ti bi-lhaqq zaa-li-ka maa kun-ta mi-nhu taheed

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡوَعِيدِ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: ونفخ في الصور ذلك يوم الوعيد
ayahs.translation: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-nu-fi-kha fis soor zaa-li-ka yaw-mul waeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَآءَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٞ وَشَهِيدٞ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: وجاءت كل نفس معها سائق وشهيد
ayahs.translation: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaaaat kul-lu naf-sim maa-haa saaai-qunw wa-shaheed

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّقَدۡ كُنتَ فِي غَفۡلَةٖ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفۡنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ حَدِيدٞ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: لقد كنت في غفلة من هذا فكشفنا عنك غطاءك فبصرك اليوم حديد
ayahs.translation: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
ayahs.transliteration: la-qad kun-ta fee ghaf-la-tim min haa-zaa fa-ka-shaf-naa an-ka ghi-taaaa-ka fa-ba-sa-ru-kal yaw-ma hadeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: وقال قرينه هذا ما لدي عتيد
ayahs.translation: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-la qaree-nu-hoo haa-zaa maa la-daiya ateed

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلۡقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٖ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: القيا في جهنم كل كفار عنيد
ayahs.translation: [Allāh will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
ayahs.transliteration: al-qiyaa fee ja-han-na-ma kul-la kaf-faa-rin aneed

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَّنَّاعٖ لِّلۡخَيۡرِ مُعۡتَدٖ مُّرِيبٍ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: مناع للخير معتد مريب
ayahs.translation: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
ayahs.transliteration: man-naail lil-khay-ri mu-ta-dim mureeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلۡقِيَاهُ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: الذي جعل مع الله الها ءاخر فالقياه في العذاب الشديد
ayahs.translation: Who made [as equal] with Allāh another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee jaa-la maal laa-hi i-laa-han aa-kha-ra faal-qiyaa-hu fil a-zaa-bish shadeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطۡغَيۡتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلِۭ بَعِيدٖ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: قال قرينه ربنا ما اطغيته ولكن كان في ضلل بعيد
ayahs.translation: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la qaree-nu-hoo rab-ba-naa maaa at-ghai-tu-hoo wa-laa-kin kaa-na fee da-laa-lin baeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَا تَخۡتَصِمُواْ لَدَيَّ وَقَدۡ قَدَّمۡتُ إِلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡوَعِيدِ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: قال لا تختصموا لدي وقد قدمت اليكم بالوعيد
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat [i.e., warning].
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la laa tak-hta-si-moo la-daayya wa-qad qad-dam-tu i-lai-kum bil-waeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٖ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: ما يبدل القول لدي وما انا بظلم للعبيد
ayahs.translation: The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
ayahs.transliteration: maa yu-bad-da-lul qaw-lu la-daiya wa-maaa a-na bi-zal-laa-mil li-labeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمۡتَلَأۡتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلۡ مِن مَّزِيدٖ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: يوم نقول لجهنم هل امتلات وتقول هل من مزيد
ayahs.translation: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma na-qoo-lu li-ja-han-na-ma ha-lim ta-laa-ti wa-ta-qoo-lu hal mim mazeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيدٍ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: وازلفت الجنة للمتقين غير بعيد
ayahs.translation: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
ayahs.transliteration: wauz-li-fa-til jan-na-tu lil-mut-ta-qee-na ghai-ra baeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٖ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: هذا ما توعدون لكل اواب حفيظ
ayahs.translation: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allāh] and keeper [of His covenant].
ayahs.transliteration: haa-za maa too-a-doo-na li-kul-li aw-waa-bin hafeez

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَّنۡ خَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلۡبٖ مُّنِيبٍ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: من خشي الرحمن بالغيب وجاء بقلب منيب
ayahs.translation: Who feared the Most Merciful in the unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
ayahs.transliteration: man kha-shiyar rah-maa-na bil-ghai-bi wa-jaaaa bi-qal-bim muneeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱدۡخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٖۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُلُودِ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: ادخلوها بسلم ذلك يوم الخلود
ayahs.translation: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
ayahs.transliteration: ud-khu-loo-haa bi-sa-laa-min zaa-li-ka yaw-mul khu-lood

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيۡنَا مَزِيدٞ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: لهم ما يشاءون فيها ولدينا مزيد
ayahs.translation: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
ayahs.transliteration: la-hum maa ya-shaaaoo-na fee-haa wa-la-dai-naa mazeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشٗا فَنَقَّبُواْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ هَلۡ مِن مَّحِيصٍ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: وكم اهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هم اشد منهم بطشا فنقبوا في البلد هل من محيص
ayahs.translation: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kam ah-lak-naa qab-la-hum min qar-nin hum a-shad-du mi-nhum bat-shan fa-naq-qa-boo fil bi-laad hal mim mahees

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلۡبٌ أَوۡ أَلۡقَى ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٞ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان في ذلك لذكري لمن كان له قلب او القي السمع وهو شهيد
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
ayahs.transliteration: in-na fee zaa-li-ka la-zik-raa li-man kaa-na la-hoo qal-bun aw al-qas sa-ma wa-hu-wa shaheed

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٖ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد خلقنا السموت والارض وما بينهما في ستة ايام وما مسنا من لغوب
ayahs.translation: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad kha-laq-nas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da wa-maa bai-na-hu-maa fee sit-ta-ti ayyaa-min wa-maa mas-sa-naa mil lu-ghoob

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ ٱلۡغُرُوبِ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: فاصبر علي ما يقولون وسبح بحمد ربك قبل طلوع الشمس وقبل الغروب
ayahs.translation: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
ayahs.transliteration: fas-bir a-laa maa ya-qoo-loo-na wa-sab-bih bi-ham-di rab-bi-ka qab-la tu-looish sham-si wa-qab-lal ghu-roob

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَأَدۡبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: ومن اليل فسبحه وادبر السجود
ayahs.translation: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mi-nal lai-li fa-sab-bi-hhu waad-baa-ras su-jood

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱسۡتَمِعۡ يَوۡمَ يُنَادِ ٱلۡمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٖ قَرِيبٖ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: واستمع يوم يناد المناد من مكان قريب
ayahs.translation: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
ayahs.transliteration: was-ta-mi yaw-ma yu-naa-dil mu-naa-di mim ma-kaa-nin qareeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يَسۡمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيۡحَةَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُرُوجِ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: يوم يسمعون الصيحة بالحق ذلك يوم الخروج
ayahs.translation: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma yas-maoo-nas sai-ha-ta bi-lhaqq zaa-li-ka yaw-mul khu-rooj

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيۡنَا ٱلۡمَصِيرُ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: انا نحن نحي ونميت والينا المصير
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa nah-nu nu-hyee wa-nu-mee-tu wai-lai-nal maseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ عَنۡهُمۡ سِرَاعٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشۡرٌ عَلَيۡنَا يَسِيرٞ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: يوم تشقق الارض عنهم سراعا ذلك حشر علينا يسير
ayahs.translation: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma ta-shaq-qa-qul ar-du a-nhum si-raaaa zaa-li-ka has-hrun a-lai-naa ya-seer

ayahs.text_uthmani: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِجَبَّارٖۖ فَذَكِّرۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: نحن اعلم بما يقولون وما انت عليهم بجبار فذكر بالقرءان من يخاف وعيد
ayahs.translation: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.
ayahs.transliteration: nah-nu a-la-mu bi-maa ya-qoo-loo-na wa-maaa an-ta a-lai-him bi-jab-baa-rin fa-zak-kir bil-qu-raa-ni ma-ny ya-khaa-fu waeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرۡوٗا ١
ayahs.text_simple: والذريت ذروا
ayahs.translation: By the [winds] scattering [dust], dispersing [it]
ayahs.transliteration: waz-zaa-riyaa-ti zar-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱلۡحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقۡرٗا ٢
ayahs.text_simple: فالحملت وقرا
ayahs.translation: And the [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lhaa-mi-laa-ti wiq-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱلۡجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسۡرٗا ٣
ayahs.text_simple: فالجريت يسرا
ayahs.translation: And the ships sailing with ease
ayahs.transliteration: fal-jaa-riyaa-ti yus-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱلۡمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمۡرًا ٤
ayahs.text_simple: فالمقسمت امرا
ayahs.translation: And the [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
ayahs.transliteration: fal-mu-qas-si-maa-ti am-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٞ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: انما توعدون لصادق
ayahs.translation: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-maa too-a-doo-na la-saa-diq

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٞ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: وان الدين لوقع
ayahs.translation: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-nad dee-na la-waa-qi

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡحُبُكِ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: والسماء ذات الحبك
ayahs.translation: By the heaven containing pathways,
ayahs.transliteration: was-sa-maaai zaa-til hu-buk

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمۡ لَفِي قَوۡلٖ مُّخۡتَلِفٖ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: انكم لفي قول مختلف
ayahs.translation: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-kum lafee qaw-lim muk-hta-lif

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُؤۡفَكُ عَنۡهُ مَنۡ أُفِكَ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: يؤفك عنه من افك
ayahs.translation: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.
ayahs.transliteration: yu-fa-ku a-nhu man u-fik

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُتِلَ ٱلۡخَرَّٰصُونَ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: قتل الخرصون
ayahs.translation: Destroyed are the misinformers
ayahs.transliteration: qu-ti-lal khar-raa-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَةٖ سَاهُونَ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: الذين هم في غمرة ساهون
ayahs.translation: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na hum fee gham-ra-tin saa-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَسۡـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: يسلون ايان يوم الدين
ayahs.translation: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
ayahs.transliteration: ya-sa-loo-na ayyaa-na yaw-mud deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفۡتَنُونَ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: يوم هم علي النار يفتنون
ayahs.translation: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma hum a-lan naa-ri yuf-ta-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذُوقُواْ فِتۡنَتَكُمۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: ذوقوا فتنتكم هذا الذي كنتم به تستعجلون
ayahs.translation: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
ayahs.transliteration: zoo-qoo fit-na-ta-kum haa-zal lazee kun-tum bihee tas-ta-ji-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: ان المتقين في جنت وعيون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal mut-ta-qee-na fee jan-naa-tinw wauyoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِينَ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: ءاخذين ما ءاتيهم ربهم انهم كانوا قبل ذلك محسنين
ayahs.translation: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
ayahs.transliteration: aa-khi-zee-na maaa aa-taa-hum rab-bu-hum in-na-hum kaa-noo qab-la zaa-li-ka muh-sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَانُواْ قَلِيلٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُونَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: كانوا قليلا من اليل ما يهجعون
ayahs.translation: They used to sleep but little of the night,
ayahs.transliteration: kaa-noo qalee-lam mi-nal lai-li maa yah-jaoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَبِٱلۡأَسۡحَارِ هُمۡ يَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: وبالاسحار هم يستغفرون
ayahs.translation: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-bi-la-shaa-ri hum yas-tag-hfi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ حَقّٞ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: وفي امولهم حق للسائل والمحروم
ayahs.translation: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
ayahs.transliteration: wafeee am-waa-li-him haq-qul lis-saaai-li wal-mah-room

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّلۡمُوقِنِينَ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: وفي الارض ءايت للموقنين
ayahs.translation: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
ayahs.transliteration: wa-fil ar-di aayaa-tul lil-moo-qineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: وفي انفسكم افلا تبصرون
ayahs.translation: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
ayahs.transliteration: wafeee an-fu-si-kum a-fa-laa tub-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقُكُمۡ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: وفي السماء رزقكم وما توعدون
ayahs.translation: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-fis sa-maaai riz-qu-kum wa-maa too-a-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقّٞ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمۡ تَنطِقُونَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: فورب السماء والارض انه لحق مثل ما انكم تنطقون
ayahs.translation: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-wa-rab-bis sa-maaai wa-lar-di in-na-hoo la-haq-qum mis-la maa an-na-kum tan-ti-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: هل اتيك حديث ضيف ابرهيم المكرمين
ayahs.translation: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
ayahs.transliteration: hal a-taa-ka hadee-su dai-fi ib-raa-hee-mal muk-rameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗاۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٞ قَوۡمٞ مُّنكَرُونَ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: اذ دخلوا عليه فقالوا سلما قال سلم قوم منكرون
ayahs.translation: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."
ayahs.transliteration: iz da-kha-loo a-lai-hi fa-qaa-loo sa-laa-man qaa-la sa-laa-mun qaw-mum mun-ka-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلٖ سَمِينٖ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: فراغ الي اهله فجاء بعجل سمين
ayahs.translation: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-raa-gha i-laaa ah-lihee fa-jaaaa biij-lin sameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: فقربه اليهم قال الا تاكلون
ayahs.translation: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qar-ra-ba-hooo i-lai-him qaa-la a-laa taa-ku-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةٗۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٖ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: فاوجس منهم خيفة قالوا لا تخف وبشروه بغلم عليم
ayahs.translation: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
ayahs.transliteration: faaw-ja-sa mi-nhum khee-fa-tan qaa-loo laa ta-khaf wa-bas-hsha-roo-hu bi-ghu-laa-min aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَقۡبَلَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ فِي صَرَّةٖ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٞ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: فاقبلت امراته في صرة فصكت وجهها وقالت عجوز عقيم
ayahs.translation: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
ayahs.transliteration: faaq-ba-la-tim raa-tu-hoo fee sar-ra-tin fa-sak-kat wa-jha-haa wa-qaa-lat a-joo-zun aqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا كذلك قال ربك انه هو الحكيم العليم
ayahs.translation: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo ka-zaa-li-ki qaa-la rab-bu-ki in-na-hoo hu-wal hakee-mul aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: قال فما خطبكم ايها المرسلون
ayahs.translation: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la fa-maa khat-bu-kum ayyu-hal mur-sa-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ مُّجۡرِمِينَ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا انا ارسلنا الي قوم مجرمين
ayahs.translation: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-looo in-naaa ur-sil-naaa i-laa qaw-mim muj-rimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِنُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةٗ مِّن طِينٖ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: لنرسل عليهم حجارة من طين
ayahs.translation: To send down upon them stones of clay,
ayahs.transliteration: li-nur-si-la a-lai-him hi-jaa-ra-tam min teen

ayahs.text_uthmani: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: مسومة عند ربك للمسرفين
ayahs.translation: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
ayahs.transliteration: mu-saw-wa-ma-tan in-da rab-bi-ka lil-mus-rifeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: فاخرجنا من كان فيها من المؤمنين
ayahs.translation: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.
ayahs.transliteration: faak-hraj-naa man kaa-na fee-haa mi-nal mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: فما وجدنا فيها غير بيت من المسلمين
ayahs.translation: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-maa wa-jad-naa fee-haa ghai-ra bai-tim mi-nal mus-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَرَكۡنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: وتركنا فيها ءاية للذين يخافون العذاب الاليم
ayahs.translation: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-rak-naa fee-haaa aaya-tal lil-la-zee-na ya-khaa-foo-nal a-zaa-bal aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفِي مُوسَىٰٓ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: وفي موسي اذ ارسلنه الي فرعون بسلطن مبين
ayahs.translation: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
ayahs.transliteration: wafee moo-saaa iz ar-sal-naa-hu i-laa fi-raw-na bi-sul-taa-nim mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكۡنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٞ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: فتولي بركنه وقال سحر او مجنون
ayahs.translation: But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ta-wal-la bi-ruk-nihee wa-qaa-la saa-hi-run aw maj-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٞ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: فاخذنه وجنوده فنبذنهم في اليم وهو مليم
ayahs.translation: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-khaz-naa-hu wa-ju-noo-da-hoo fa-na-baz-naa-hum fil yam-mi wa-hu-wa muleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلۡعَقِيمَ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: وفي عاد اذ ارسلنا عليهم الريح العقيم
ayahs.translation: And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
ayahs.transliteration: wafee aa-din iz ar-sal-naa a-lai-hi-mur ree-hal aqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيۡءٍ أَتَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتۡهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: ما تذر من شيء اتت عليه الا جعلته كالرميم
ayahs.translation: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
ayahs.transliteration: maa ta-za-ru min shaiin a-tat a-lai-hi il-laa jaa-la-thu kar-rameem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذۡ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: وفي ثمود اذ قيل لهم تمتعوا حتي حين
ayahs.translation: And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
ayahs.transliteration: wafee sa-moo-da iz qee-la la-hum ta-mat-ta-"oo hat-taa heen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَعَتَوۡاْ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: فعتوا عن امر ربهم فاخذتهم الصعقة وهم ينظرون
ayahs.translation: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-taw an am-ri rab-bi-him faa-kha-za-thu-mus saai-qa-tu wa-hum yan-zu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مِن قِيَامٖ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: فما استطعوا من قيام وما كانوا منتصرين
ayahs.translation: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-mas ta-taaoo min qiyaa-minw wa-maa kaa-noo mun-ta-sireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: وقوم نوح من قبل انهم كانوا قوما فسقين
ayahs.translation: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaw-ma noo-him min qab-lu in-na-hum kaa-no qaw-man faa-siqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا بِأَيۡيْدٖ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: والسماء بنينها باييد وانا لموسعون
ayahs.translation: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
ayahs.transliteration: was-sa-maaaa ba-nai-naa-haa bi-a-y-dinw wain-naa la-moo-sioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَرَشۡنَٰهَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَٰهِدُونَ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: والارض فرشنها فنعم المهدون
ayahs.translation: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lar-da fa-ras-hnaa-haa fa-ni-mal maa-hi-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: ومن كل شيء خلقنا زوجين لعلكم تذكرون
ayahs.translation: And of all things We created two mates [i.e., counterparts]; perhaps you will remember.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-min kul-li shaiin kha-laq-naa zaw-jai-ni laal-la-kum ta-zak-ka-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَفِرُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: ففروا الي الله اني لكم منه نذير مبين
ayahs.translation: So flee to Allāh. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-fir-rooo i-lal laa-hi in-nee la-kum mi-nhu nazee-rum mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: ولا تجعلوا مع الله الها ءاخر اني لكم منه نذير مبين
ayahs.translation: And do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa ta-ja-loo maal laa-hi i-laa-han aa-kha-ra in-nee la-kum mi-nhu nazee-rum mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٌ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: كذلك ما اتي الذين من قبلهم من رسول الا قالوا ساحر او مجنون
ayahs.translation: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
ayahs.transliteration: ka-zaa-li-ka maaa a-tal lazee-na min qab-li-him mir ra-soo-lin il-laa qaa-loo saa-hi-run aw maj-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِهِۦۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ طَاغُونَ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: اتواصوا به بل هم قوم طاغون
ayahs.translation: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
ayahs.transliteration: a-ta-waa-saw bih bal hum qaw-mun taa-ghoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٖ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: فتول عنهم فما انت بملوم
ayahs.translation: So leave them, [O Muḥammad], for you are not to be blamed.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ta-wal-la a-nhum fa-maaa an-ta bi-ma-loom

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَذَكِّرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: وذكر فان الذكري تنفع المؤمنين
ayahs.translation: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-zak-kir fain-naz zik-raa tan-faul mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَٱلۡإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُونِ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: وما خلقت الجن والانس الا ليعبدون
ayahs.translation: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa kha-laq-tul jin-na wa-lin-sa il-laa liya-bu-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنۡهُم مِّن رِّزۡقٖ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطۡعِمُونِ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: ما اريد منهم من رزق وما اريد ان يطعمون
ayahs.translation: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
ayahs.transliteration: maaa uree-du mi-nhum mir riz-qinw wa-maaa uree-du a-ny yu-ti-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلۡقُوَّةِ ٱلۡمَتِينُ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: ان الله هو الرزاق ذو القوة المتين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal laa-ha hu-war raz-zaa-qu zul quw-wa-til mateen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوبٗا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصۡحَٰبِهِمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: فان للذين ظلموا ذنوبا مثل ذنوب اصحبهم فلا يستعجلون
ayahs.translation: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not impatiently urge Me.
ayahs.transliteration: fain-na lil-la-zee-na za-la-moo za-noo-bam mis-la za-noo-bi a-shaa-bi-him fa-laa yas-ta-ji-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوۡمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: فويل للذين كفروا من يومهم الذي يوعدون
ayahs.translation: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-wai-lul lil-la-zee-na ka-fa-roo mi-ny yaw-mi-hi-mul lazee yoo-a-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلطُّورِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: والطور
ayahs.translation: By the mount
ayahs.transliteration: wat-toor

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكِتَٰبٖ مَّسۡطُورٖ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: وكتب مسطور
ayahs.translation: And [by] a Book inscribed
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ki-taa-bim mas-toor

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي رَقّٖ مَّنشُورٖ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: في رق منشور
ayahs.translation: In parchment spread open
ayahs.transliteration: fee raq-qim man-shoor

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡمُورِ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: والبيت المعمور
ayahs.translation: And [by] the frequented House
ayahs.transliteration: wal-bai-til ma-moor

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّقۡفِ ٱلۡمَرۡفُوعِ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: والسقف المرفوع
ayahs.translation: And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high
ayahs.transliteration: was-saq-fil mar-foo

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ ٱلۡمَسۡجُورِ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: والبحر المسجور
ayahs.translation: And [by] the sea set on fire,
ayahs.transliteration: wal-bah-ril mas-joor

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٞ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان عذاب ربك لوقع
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na a-zaa-ba rab-bi-ka la-waa-qi

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٖ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: ما له من دافع
ayahs.translation: Of it there is no preventer.
ayahs.transliteration: maa la-hoo min daa-fi

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوۡرٗا ٩
ayahs.text_simple: يوم تمور السماء مورا
ayahs.translation: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma ta-moo-rus sa-maaau maw-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ سَيۡرٗا ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: وتسير الجبال سيرا
ayahs.translation: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-see-rul ji-baa-lu sai-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَوَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: فويل يومئذ للمكذبين
ayahs.translation: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-wai-lu-ny yaw-mai-zil lil-mu-kaaz-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي خَوۡضٖ يَلۡعَبُونَ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: الذين هم في خوض يلعبون
ayahs.translation: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na hum fee khaw-di-ny ya-la-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: يوم يدعون الي نار جهنم دعا
ayahs.translation: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma yu-daoo-na i-laa naa-ri ja-han-na-ma daaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: هذه النار التي كنتم بها تكذبون
ayahs.translation: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
ayahs.transliteration: haa-zi-hin naa-rul latee kun-tum bi-haa tu-kaz-zi-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَسِحۡرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: افسحر هذا ام انتم لا تبصرون
ayahs.translation: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-sih-run haa-zaaaa am an-tum laa tub-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا فَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْ أَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: اصلوها فاصبروا او لا تصبروا سواء عليكم انما تجزون ما كنتم تعملون
ayahs.translation: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
ayahs.transliteration: is-la-whaa fas-bi-rooo aw laa tas-bi-roo sa-waaaun a-lai-kum in-na-maa tuj-zaw-na maa kun-tum ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَنَعِيمٖ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان المتقين في جنت ونعيم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal mut-ta-qee-na fee jan-naa-tinw wa-naeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: فكهين بما ءاتيهم ربهم ووقيهم ربهم عذاب الجحيم
ayahs.translation: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-ki-hee-na bi-maaa aa-taa-hum rab-bu-hum wa-wa-qaa-hum rab-bu-hum a-zaa-bal jaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: كلوا واشربوا هنيا بما كنتم تعملون
ayahs.translation: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
ayahs.transliteration: ku-loo was-hra-boo haneeeam bi-maa kun-tum ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مَّصۡفُوفَةٖۖ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٖ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: متكين علي سرر مصفوفة وزوجنهم بحور عين
ayahs.translation: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
ayahs.transliteration: mut-ta-kiee-na a-laa su-ru-rim mas-foo-fa-tinw wa-zaw-waj-naa-hum bi-hoo-rin een

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَآ أَلَتۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيۡءٖۚ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيِٕۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٞ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: والذين ءامنوا واتبعتهم ذريتهم بايمن الحقنا بهم ذريتهم وما التنهم من عملهم من شيء كل امري بما كسب رهين
ayahs.translation: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo wat-ta-baa-thum zur-riyya-tu-hum biee-maa-nin a-lhaq-naa bi-him zur-riyya-ta-hum wa-maaa a-lat-naa-hum min a-ma-li-him min shai kul-lum riim bi-maa ka-sa-ba raheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمۡدَدۡنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٖ وَلَحۡمٖ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: وامددنهم بفكهة ولحم مما يشتهون
ayahs.translation: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
ayahs.transliteration: waam-dad-naa-hum bi-faa-ki-ha-tinw wa-lah-mim mim-maa yas-hta-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأۡسٗا لَّا لَغۡوٞ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمٞ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: يتنزعون فيها كاسا لا لغو فيها ولا تاثيم
ayahs.translation: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
ayahs.transliteration: ya-ta-naa-zaoo-na fee-haa kaa-sal laa lag-hwun fee-haa wa-laa taaseem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانٞ لَّهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٞ مَّكۡنُونٞ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: ويطوف عليهم غلمان لهم كانهم لؤلؤ مكنون
ayahs.translation: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
ayahs.transliteration: waya-too-fu a-lai-him ghil-maa-nul la-hum kaan-na-hum lu-luum mak-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: واقبل بعضهم علي بعض يتساءلون
ayahs.translation: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
ayahs.transliteration: waaq-ba-la ba-du-hum a-laa ba-di-ny ya-ta-saaaa-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيٓ أَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِينَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا انا كنا قبل في اهلنا مشفقين
ayahs.translation: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-looo in-naa kun-naa qab-lu feee ah-li-naa mus-hfi-qeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: فمن الله علينا ووقينا عذاب السموم
ayahs.translation: So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-man-nnal laa-hu a-lai-naa wa-wa-qaa-naa a-zaa-bas sa-moom

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: انا كنا من قبل ندعوه انه هو البر الرحيم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa kun-naa min qab-lu na-doo-hu in-na-hoo hu-wal bar-rur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٖ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: فذكر فما انت بنعمت ربك بكاهن ولا مجنون
ayahs.translation: So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-zak-kir fa-maaa an-ta bi-ni-ma-ti rab-bi-ka bi-kaa-hi-ninw wa-laa maj-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٞ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيۡبَ ٱلۡمَنُونِ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: ام يقولون شاعر نتربص به ريب المنون
ayahs.translation: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?
ayahs.transliteration: am ya-qoo-loo-na shaai-run na-ta-rab-ba-su bihee rai-bal ma-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُتَرَبِّصِينَ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: قل تربصوا فاني معكم من المتربصين
ayahs.translation: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
ayahs.transliteration: qul ta-rab-ba-soo fain-nee maa-kum mi-nal mu-ta-rab-biseen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ تَأۡمُرُهُمۡ أَحۡلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآۚ أَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ طَاغُونَ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: ام تامرهم احلمهم بهذا ام هم قوم طاغون
ayahs.translation: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
ayahs.transliteration: am taa-mu-ru-hum ah-laa-mu-hum bi-haa-zaaa am hum qaw-mun taa-ghoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥۚ بَل لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: ام يقولون تقوله بل لا يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
ayahs.transliteration: am ya-qoo-loo-na ta-qaw-wa-lah bal laa yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِحَدِيثٖ مِّثۡلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: فلياتوا بحديث مثله ان كانوا صدقين
ayahs.translation: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lyaa-too bi-ha-dee-sim mis-liheee in kaa-noo saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: ام خلقوا من غير شيء ام هم الخلقون
ayahs.translation: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
ayahs.transliteration: am khu-li-qoo min ghai-ri shaiin am hu-mul khaa-li-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: ام خلقوا السموت والارض بل لا يوقنون
ayahs.translation: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
ayahs.transliteration: am kha-la-qus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lard bal laa yoo-qi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُونَ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: ام عندهم خزائن ربك ام هم المصيطرون
ayahs.translation: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
ayahs.transliteration: am in-da-hum kha-zaaai-nu rab-bi-ka am hu-mul mu-sai-ti-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمٞ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ فِيهِۖ فَلۡيَأۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٍ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: ام لهم سلم يستمعون فيه فليات مستمعهم بسلطن مبين
ayahs.translation: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].
ayahs.transliteration: am la-hum sul-la-mu-ny yas-ta-mioo-na fee-hi fa-lyaa-ti mus-ta-miu-hum bi-sul-taa-nim mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: ام له البنت ولكم البنون
ayahs.translation: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
ayahs.transliteration: am la-hul ba-naa-tu wa-la-ku-mul ba-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمٖ مُّثۡقَلُونَ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: ام تسلهم اجرا فهم من مغرم مثقلون
ayahs.translation: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
ayahs.transliteration: am ta-sa-lu-hum aj-ran fa-hum mim mag-hra-mim mus-qa-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: ام عندهم الغيب فهم يكتبون
ayahs.translation: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
ayahs.transliteration: am in-da-hu-mul ghai-bu fa-hum yak-tu-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ يُرِيدُونَ كَيۡدٗاۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡمَكِيدُونَ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: ام يريدون كيدا فالذين كفروا هم المكيدون
ayahs.translation: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
ayahs.transliteration: am yu-ree-doo-na kai-dan fal-la-zee-na ka-fa-roo hu-mul makee-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: ام لهم اله غير الله سبحن الله عما يشركون
ayahs.translation: Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
ayahs.transliteration: am la-hum i-laa-hun ghai-rul laa su-bhaa-nal laa-hi am-maa yus-hri-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كِسۡفٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطٗا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابٞ مَّرۡكُومٞ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: وان يروا كسفا من السماء ساقطا يقولوا سحاب مركوم
ayahs.translation: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
ayahs.transliteration: wai-ny ya-raw kis-fam mi-nas sa-maaai saa-qi-ta-ny ya-qoo-loo sa-haa-bum mar-koom

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: فذرهم حتي يلقوا يومهم الذي فيه يصعقون
ayahs.translation: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
ayahs.transliteration: fa-za-rhum hat-ta yu-laa-qoo yaw-ma-hu-mul lazee fee-hi yu-sa-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: يوم لا يغني عنهم كيدهم شيا ولا هم ينصرون
ayahs.translation: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma laa yug-hnee a-nhum kai-du-hum shai-anw wa-laa hum yun-sa-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَابٗا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: وان للذين ظلموا عذابا دون ذلك ولكن اكثرهم لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na lil-la-zee-na za-la-moo a-zaa-ban doo-na za-li-ka wa-laa-kin-na ak-sa-ra-hum laa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: واصبر لحكم ربك فانك باعيننا وسبح بحمد ربك حين تقوم
ayahs.translation: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise
ayahs.transliteration: was-bir li-huk-mi rab-bi-ka fain-na-ka bi-a-yu-ni-naa wa-sab-bih bi-ham-di rab-bi-ka hee-na ta-qoom

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَإِدۡبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: ومن اليل فسبحه وادبر النجوم
ayahs.translation: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mi-nal lai-li fa-sab-bi-hhu waid-baa-ran nu-joom

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجۡمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ ١
ayahs.text_simple: والنجم اذا هوي
ayahs.translation: By the star when it descends,
ayahs.transliteration: wan-naj-mi i-zaa ha-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمۡ وَمَا غَوَىٰ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: ما ضل صاحبكم وما غوي
ayahs.translation: Your companion [i.e., Muḥammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
ayahs.transliteration: maa dal-la saa-hi-bu-kum wa-maa gha-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰٓ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: وما ينطق عن الهوي
ayahs.translation: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa yyan-ti-qu a-nil ha-waaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحۡيٞ يُوحَىٰ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان هو الا وحي يوحي
ayahs.translation: It is not but a revelation revealed,
ayahs.transliteration: in hu-wa il-laa wa-hyu-ny yoo-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡقُوَىٰ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: علمه شديد القوي
ayahs.translation: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-ma-hoo shadee-dul qu-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذُو مِرَّةٖ فَٱسۡتَوَىٰ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: ذو مرة فاستوي
ayahs.translation: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
ayahs.transliteration: zoo mir-ra-tin fas-ta-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ بِٱلۡأُفُقِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: وهو بالافق الاعلي
ayahs.translation: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wa bi-lu-fu-qil a-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: ثم دنا فتدلي
ayahs.translation: Then he approached and descended
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma da-naa fa-ta-dal-la

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوۡسَيۡنِ أَوۡ أَدۡنَىٰ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: فكان قاب قوسين او ادني
ayahs.translation: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kaa-na qaa-ba qaw-sai-ni aw ad-naa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِۦ مَآ أَوۡحَىٰ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: فاوحي الي عبده ما اوحي
ayahs.translation: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed [i.e., conveyed].
ayahs.transliteration: faa-whaaa i-laa ab-dihee maaa a-whaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلۡفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: ما كذب الفؤاد ما راي
ayahs.translation: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.
ayahs.transliteration: maa ka-za-bal fu-a-a-du maa raaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: افتمرونه علي ما يري
ayahs.translation: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-tu-maa-roo-na-hoo a-laa maa ya-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ رَءَاهُ نَزۡلَةً أُخۡرَىٰ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد رءاه نزلة اخري
ayahs.translation: And he certainly saw him in another descent
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad raaa-hu naz-la-tan uk-hraa

ayahs.text_uthmani: عِندَ سِدۡرَةِ ٱلۡمُنتَهَىٰ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: عند سدرة المنتهي
ayahs.translation: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
ayahs.transliteration: in-da sid-ra-til mun-ta-ha

ayahs.text_uthmani: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰٓ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: عندها جنة الماوي
ayahs.translation: Near it is the Garden of Refuge [i.e., Paradise] -
ayahs.transliteration: in-da-haa jan-na-tul maa-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ يَغۡشَى ٱلسِّدۡرَةَ مَا يَغۡشَىٰ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: اذ يغشي السدرة ما يغشي
ayahs.translation: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].
ayahs.transliteration: iz yag-hshas sid-ra-ta maa yag-hshaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا زَاغَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: ما زاغ البصر وما طغي
ayahs.translation: The sight [of the Prophet (ﷺ)] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].
ayahs.transliteration: maa zaa-ghal ba-sa-ru wa-maa ta-ghaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَقَدۡ رَأَىٰ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: لقد راي من ءايت ربه الكبري
ayahs.translation: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
ayahs.transliteration: la-qad raaa min aayaa-ti rab-bi-hil kub-raaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلۡعُزَّىٰ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: افرءيتم اللت والعزي
ayahs.translation: So have you considered al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-raay-tu-mul laa-ta wa-luz-zaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰٓ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: ومنوة الثالثة الاخري
ayahs.translation: And Manāt, the third - the other one?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ma-naa-tas saa-li-sa-tal uk-hraa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: الكم الذكر وله الانثي
ayahs.translation: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
ayahs.transliteration: a-la-ku-muz za-ka-ru wa-la-hul un-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: تِلۡكَ إِذٗا قِسۡمَةٞ ضِيزَىٰٓ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: تلك اذا قسمة ضيزي
ayahs.translation: That, then, is an unjust division.
ayahs.transliteration: til-ka i-zan qis-ma-tun dee-zaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءٞ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهۡوَى ٱلۡأَنفُسُۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: ان هي الا اسماء سميتموها انتم وءاباؤكم ما انزل الله بها من سلطن ان يتبعون الا الظن وما تهوي الانفس ولقد جاءهم من ربهم الهدي
ayahs.translation: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allāh has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
ayahs.transliteration: in hiya il-laaa as-maaaun sam-mai-tu-moo-haaa an-tum waaa-baaau-kum maaa an-za-lal laa-hu bi-haa min sul-taan i-ny yat-ta-bioo-na il-laz zan-na wa-maa tah-wal an-fu-su wa-la-qad jaaaa-hum mir rab-bi-hi-mul hu-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: ام للانسن ما تمني
ayahs.translation: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
ayahs.transliteration: am li-lin-saa-ni maa ta-man-naa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: فلله الاخرة والاولي
ayahs.translation: Rather, to Allāh belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lil-laa-hil aa-khi-ra-tu wa-loo-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغۡنِي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن يَأۡذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡضَىٰٓ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: وكم من ملك في السموت لا تغني شفعتهم شيا الا من بعد ان ياذن الله لمن يشاء ويرضي
ayahs.translation: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allāh has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kam mim ma-la-kin fis sa-maa-waa-ti laa tug-hnee sha-faaa-tu-hum shai-an il-laa mim ba-di a-ny yaa-za-nal laa-hu li-ma-ny ya-shaaau wayar-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسۡمِيَةَ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين لا يؤمنون بالاخرة ليسمون الملئكة تسمية الانثي
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na laa yu-mi-noo-na bi-laa-khi-ra-ti layu-sam-moo-nal ma-laaai-ka-ta tas-miya-tal un-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ شَيۡـٔٗا ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: وما لهم به من علم ان يتبعون الا الظن وان الظن لا يغني من الحق شيا
ayahs.translation: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa la-hum bihee min il-min i-ny yat-ta-bioo-na il-laz zan-na wain-naz zan-na laa yug-hnee mi-nal haq-qi shai-a-a

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَلَمۡ يُرِدۡ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: فاعرض عن من تولي عن ذكرنا ولم يرد الا الحيوة الدنيا
ayahs.translation: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-rid am man ta-wal-laa an zik-ri-naa wa-lam yu-rid il-lal hayaa-tad du-nyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مَبۡلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: ذلك مبلغهم من العلم ان ربك هو اعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله وهو اعلم بمن اهتدي
ayahs.translation: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
ayahs.transliteration: za-li-ka mab-la-ghu-hum mi-nal ilm in-na rab-ba-ka hu-wa a-la-mu bi-man dal-la an sabee-lihee wa-hu-wa a-la-mu bi-ma-nih ta-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَى ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: ولله ما في السموت وما في الارض ليجزي الذين اسوا بما عملوا ويجزي الذين احسنوا بالحسني
ayahs.translation: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lil-laa-hi maa fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-maa fil ar-di liyaj-ziyal lazee-na a-saaaoo bi-maa a-mi-loo wayaj-ziyal lazee-na ah-sa-noo bi-lhus-naa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِۚ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡ إِذۡ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِذۡ أَنتُمۡ أَجِنَّةٞ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡۖ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: الذين يجتنبون كبئر الاثم والفوحش الا اللمم ان ربك وسع المغفرة هو اعلم بكم اذ انشاكم من الارض واذ انتم اجنة في بطون امهتكم فلا تزكوا انفسكم هو اعلم بمن اتقي
ayahs.translation: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na yaj-ta-ni-boo-na ka-baaai-ral is-mi wal-fa-waa-hi-sha il-lal la-mam in-na rab-ba-ka waa-siul mag-hfi-rah hu-wa a-la-mu bi-kum iz an-shaa-kum mi-nal ar-di waiz an-tum a-jin-na-tun fee bu-too-ni um-ma-haa-ti-kum fa-laa tu-zak-kooo an-fu-sa-kum hu-wa a-la-mu bi-ma-nit ta-qaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: افرءيت الذي تولي
ayahs.translation: Have you seen the one who turned away
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-raaya-tal lazee ta-wal-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَعۡطَىٰ قَلِيلٗا وَأَكۡدَىٰٓ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: واعطي قليلا واكدي
ayahs.translation: And gave a little and [then] refrained?
ayahs.transliteration: waa-taa qalee-lanw waak-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: اعنده علم الغيب فهو يري
ayahs.translation: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?
ayahs.transliteration: ain-da-hoo il-mul ghai-bi fa-hu-wa ya-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ لَمۡ يُنَبَّأۡ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: ام لم ينبا بما في صحف موسي
ayahs.translation: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
ayahs.transliteration: am lam yu-nab-baa bi-maa fee su-huh-fi moo-sa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِي وَفَّىٰٓ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: وابرهيم الذي وفي
ayahs.translation: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -
ayahs.transliteration: waib-raa-hee-mal lazee waf-faaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: الا تزر وازرة وزر اخري
ayahs.translation: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
ayahs.transliteration: al-laa ta-zi-ru waa-zi-ra-tunw wiz-ra uk-hraa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّيۡسَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: وان ليس للانسن الا ما سعي
ayahs.translation: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
ayahs.transliteration: waal lai-sa li-lin-saa-ni il-laa maa saaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ سَعۡيَهُۥ سَوۡفَ يُرَىٰ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: وان سعيه سوف يري
ayahs.translation: And that his effort is going to be seen -
ayahs.transliteration: waan-na saya-hoo saw-fa yu-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُجۡزَىٰهُ ٱلۡجَزَآءَ ٱلۡأَوۡفَىٰ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: ثم يجزيه الجزاء الاوفي
ayahs.translation: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma yuj-zaa-hul ja-zaaa a-law-faa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡمُنتَهَىٰ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: وان الي ربك المنتهي
ayahs.translation: And that to your Lord is the finality
ayahs.transliteration: waan-na i-laa rab-bi-kal mun-ta-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضۡحَكَ وَأَبۡكَىٰ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: وانه هو اضحك وابكي
ayahs.translation: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
ayahs.transliteration: waan-na-hoo hu-wa a-dha-ka waab-kaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحۡيَا ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: وانه هو امات واحيا
ayahs.translation: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
ayahs.transliteration: waan-na-hoo hu-wa a-maa-ta waa-hyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوۡجَيۡنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: وانه خلق الزوجين الذكر والانثي
ayahs.translation: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
ayahs.transliteration: waan-na-hoo kha-la-qaz zaw-jai-niz za-ka-ra wa-lun-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ إِذَا تُمۡنَىٰ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: من نطفة اذا تمني
ayahs.translation: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
ayahs.transliteration: min nut-fa-tin i-zaa tum-naa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: وان عليه النشاة الاخري
ayahs.translation: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the other [i.e., next] creation.
ayahs.transliteration: waan-na a-lai-hin na-sha-tal uk-hraa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغۡنَىٰ وَأَقۡنَىٰ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: وانه هو اغني واقني
ayahs.translation: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
ayahs.transliteration: waan-na-hoo hu-wa ag-hnaa waaq-naa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعۡرَىٰ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: وانه هو رب الشعري
ayahs.translation: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
ayahs.transliteration: waan-na-hoo hu-wa rab-bush shi-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهۡلَكَ عَادًا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: وانه اهلك عادا الاولي
ayahs.translation: And that He destroyed the first [people of] ʿAad
ayahs.transliteration: waan-na-hooo ah-la-ka aa-da-nil oo-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَثَمُودَاْ فَمَآ أَبۡقَىٰ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: وثمودا فما ابقي
ayahs.translation: And Thamūd - and He did not spare [them] -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-sa-moo-da fa-maaa ab-qaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَظۡلَمَ وَأَطۡغَىٰ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: وقوم نوح من قبل انهم كانوا هم اظلم واطغي
ayahs.translation: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaw-ma noo-him min qab-lu in-na-hum kaa-noo hum az-la-ma waat-ghaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَةَ أَهۡوَىٰ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: والمؤتفكة اهوي
ayahs.translation: And the overturned towns He hurled down
ayahs.transliteration: wal-mu-ta-fi-ka-ta ah-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: فغشيها ما غشي
ayahs.translation: And covered them by that which He covered.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ghas-hshaa-haa maa ghas-hshaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربك تتماري
ayahs.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ka ta-ta-maa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا نَذِيرٞ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰٓ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: هذا نذير من النذر الاولي
ayahs.translation: This [Prophet (ﷺ)] is a warner from [i.e., like] the former warners.
ayahs.transliteration: haa-zaa nazee-rum mi-nan nu-zu-ril oo-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَزِفَتِ ٱلۡأٓزِفَةُ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: ازفت الازفة
ayahs.translation: The Approaching Day has approached.
ayahs.transliteration: a-zi-fa-til aa-zi-fah

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَيۡسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: ليس لها من دون الله كاشفة
ayahs.translation: Of it, [from those] besides Allāh, there is no remover.
ayahs.transliteration: lai-sa la-haa min doo-nil laa-hi kaa-shi-fah

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَمِنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِ تَعۡجَبُونَ ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: افمن هذا الحديث تعجبون
ayahs.translation: Then at this statement do you wonder?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-min ha-zal hadee-si ta-ja-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَضۡحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبۡكُونَ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: وتضحكون ولا تبكون
ayahs.translation: And you laugh and do not weep
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-dha-koo-na wa-laa tab-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنتُمۡ سَٰمِدُونَ ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: وانتم سمدون
ayahs.translation: While you are proudly sporting?
ayahs.transliteration: waan-tum saa-mi-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلَّهِۤ وَٱعۡبُدُواْ۩ ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: فاسجدوا لله واعبدوا
ayahs.translation: So prostrate to Allāh and worship [Him].
ayahs.transliteration: fas-ju-doo lil-laa-hi wa-bu-doo

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱقۡتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلۡقَمَرُ ١
ayahs.text_simple: اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر
ayahs.translation: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
ayahs.transliteration: iq-ta-ra-ba-tis saaa-tu wan-shaq-qal qa-mar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ ءَايَةٗ يُعۡرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحۡرٞ مُّسۡتَمِرّٞ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: وان يروا ءاية يعرضوا ويقولوا سحر مستمر
ayahs.translation: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."
ayahs.transliteration: wai-ny ya-raw aaya-ta-ny yu-ri-doo waya-qoo-loo sih-run mus-ta-mirr

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَكُلُّ أَمۡرٖ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: وكذبوا واتبعوا اهواءهم وكل امر مستقر
ayahs.translation: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kaz-za-boo wat-ta-baooo ah-waaaa-hum wa-kul-lu am-rin mus-ta-qirr

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزۡدَجَرٌ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد جاءهم من الانباء ما فيه مزدجر
ayahs.translation: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad jaaaa-hum mi-nal an-baaai maa fee-hi muz-da-jar

ayahs.text_uthmani: حِكۡمَةُۢ بَٰلِغَةٞۖ فَمَا تُغۡنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: حكمة بلغة فما تغن النذر
ayahs.translation: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
ayahs.transliteration: hik-ma-tun baa-li-gha-tun fa-maa tug-hnin nu-zur

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ نُّكُرٍ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: فتول عنهم يوم يدع الداع الي شيء نكر
ayahs.translation: So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ta-wal-la a-nhum yaw-ma ya-dud daai i-laa shaiin nu-kur

ayahs.text_uthmani: خُشَّعًا أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادٞ مُّنتَشِرٞ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: خشعا ابصرهم يخرجون من الاجداث كانهم جراد منتشر
ayahs.translation: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
ayahs.transliteration: khus-hshaan ab-saa-ru-hum yak-hru-joo-na mi-nal aj-daa-si kaan-na-hum ja-raa-dum mun-ta-shir

ayahs.text_uthmani: مُّهۡطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِۖ يَقُولُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرٞ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: مهطعين الي الداع يقول الكفرون هذا يوم عسر
ayahs.translation: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
ayahs.transliteration: muh-tiee-na i-lad daai ya-qoo-lul kaa-fi-roo-na haa-zaa yaw-mun a-sir

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ فَكَذَّبُواْ عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُواْ مَجۡنُونٞ وَٱزۡدُجِرَ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح فكذبوا عبدنا وقالوا مجنون وازدجر
ayahs.translation: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
ayahs.transliteration: kaz-za-bat qab-la-hum qaw-mu noo-hin fa-kaz-za-boo ab-da-naa wa-qaa-loo maj-noo-nunw waz-du-jir

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَغۡلُوبٞ فَٱنتَصِرۡ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: فدعا ربه اني مغلوب فانتصر
ayahs.translation: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-daaa rab-ba-hooo an-nee mag-hloo-bun fan-ta-sir

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَفَتَحۡنَآ أَبۡوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٖ مُّنۡهَمِرٖ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: ففتحنا ابوب السماء بماء منهمر
ayahs.translation: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
ayahs.transliteration: fa-fa-tah-naaa ab-waa-bas sa-maaai bi-maaain mu-nha-mir

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفَجَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ عُيُونٗا فَٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرٖ قَدۡ قُدِرَ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: وفجرنا الارض عيونا فالتقي الماء علي امر قد قدر
ayahs.translation: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-faj-jar-nal ar-da uyoo-nan fal-ta-qal maaau a-laaa am-rin qad qu-dir

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَحَمَلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلۡوَٰحٖ وَدُسُرٖ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: وحملنه علي ذات الوح ودسر
ayahs.translation: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ha-mal-naa-hu a-laa zaa-ti al-waa-hinw wa-du-sur

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَجۡرِي بِأَعۡيُنِنَا جَزَآءٗ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: تجري باعيننا جزاء لمن كان كفر
ayahs.translation: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
ayahs.transliteration: taj-ree bi-a-yu-ni-naa ja-zaaaan li-man kaa-na ku-fir

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةٗ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد تركنها ءاية فهل من مدكر
ayahs.translation: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qat ta-rak-naa-haa aaya-tan fa-hal min mud-da-kir

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: فكيف كان عذابي ونذر
ayahs.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kai-fa kaa-na a-zaabee wa-nu-zur

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد يسرنا القرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad yas-sar-nal qu-raa-na liz-zik-ri fa-hal min mud-da-kir

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٞ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: كذبت عاد فكيف كان عذابي ونذر
ayahs.translation: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.transliteration: kaz-za-bat aa-dun fa-kai-fa kaa-na a-zaabee wa-nu-zur

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحٗا صَرۡصَرٗا فِي يَوۡمِ نَحۡسٖ مُّسۡتَمِرّٖ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: انا ارسلنا عليهم ريحا صرصرا في يوم نحس مستمر
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa ar-sal-naa a-lai-him ree-han sar-sa-ran fee yaw-mi nah-sin mus-ta-mirr

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٖ مُّنقَعِرٖ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: تنزع الناس كانهم اعجاز نخل منقعر
ayahs.translation: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
ayahs.transliteration: tan-ziun naa-sa kaan-na-hum a-jaa-zu nak-hlin mun-qair

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: فكيف كان عذابي ونذر
ayahs.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kai-fa kaa-na a-zaabee wa-nu-zur

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد يسرنا القرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر
