ayahs.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad yas-sar-nal qu-raa-na liz-zik-ri fa-hal min mud-da-kir

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: كذبت ثمود بالنذر
ayahs.translation: Thamūd denied the warning.
ayahs.transliteration: kaz-za-bat sa-moo-du bin-nu-zur

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرٗا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدٗا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذٗا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٍ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: فقالوا ابشرا منا وحدا نتبعه انا اذا لفي ضلل وسعر
ayahs.translation: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qaa-looo a-ba-sha-ran min-naa waa-hi-dan nat-ta-biu-hooo in-naa i-zal lafee da-laa-linw wa-suur

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَءُلۡقِيَ ٱلذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٞ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: اءلقي الذكر عليه من بيننا بل هو كذاب اشر
ayahs.translation: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
ayahs.transliteration: aul-qiyaz zik-ru a-lai-hi min bai-ni-naa bal hu-wa kaz-zaa-bun a-shir

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَيَعۡلَمُونَ غَدٗا مَّنِ ٱلۡكَذَّابُ ٱلۡأَشِرُ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: سيعلمون غدا من الكذاب الاشر
ayahs.translation: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
ayahs.transliteration: saya-la-moo-na gha-dan ma-nil kaz-zaa-bul a-shir

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا مُرۡسِلُواْ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةٗ لَّهُمۡ فَٱرۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: انا مرسلوا الناقة فتنة لهم فارتقبهم واصطبر
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa mur-si-lun naa-qa-ti fit-na-tan la-hum far-ta-qi-bhum was-ta-bir

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةُۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلُّ شِرۡبٖ مُّحۡتَضَرٞ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: ونبئهم ان الماء قسمة بينهم كل شرب محتضر
ayahs.translation: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-nab-bi-hum an-nal maaaa qis-ma-tun bai-na-hum kul-lu shir-bin muh-ta-dar

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَنَادَوۡاْ صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: فنادوا صاحبهم فتعاطي فعقر
ayahs.translation: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].
ayahs.transliteration: fa-naa-daw saa-hi-ba-hum fa-taaa-taa faa-qar

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: فكيف كان عذابي ونذر
ayahs.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kai-fa kaa-na a-zaabee wa-nu-zur

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلۡمُحۡتَظِرِ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: انا ارسلنا عليهم صيحة وحدة فكانوا كهشيم المحتظر
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naaa ar-sal-naa a-lai-him sai-ha-tanw waa-hi-da-tan fa-kaa-noo ka-ha-shee-mil muh-ta-zir

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد يسرنا القرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad yas-sar-nal qu-raa-na liz-zik-ri fa-hal min mud-da-kir

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطِۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: كذبت قوم لوط بالنذر
ayahs.translation: The people of Lot denied the warning.
ayahs.transliteration: kaz-za-bat qaw-mu loo-tin bin-nu-zur

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٖۖ نَّجَّيۡنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٖ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: انا ارسلنا عليهم حاصبا الا ءال لوط نجينهم بسحر
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa ar-sal-naa a-lai-him haa-si-ban il-laaa aa-la loo-tin naj-jai-naa-hum bi-sa-har

ayahs.text_uthmani: نِّعۡمَةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِنَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَن شَكَرَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: نعمة من عندنا كذلك نجزي من شكر
ayahs.translation: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
ayahs.transliteration: ni-ma-tan min in-di-naa ka-zaa-li-ka naj-zee man sha-kar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَنذَرَهُم بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡاْ بِٱلنُّذُرِ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد انذرهم بطشتنا فتماروا بالنذر
ayahs.translation: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad an-za-ra-hum bat-sha-ta-naa fa-ta-maa-raw bin-nu-zur

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيۡفِهِۦ فَطَمَسۡنَآ أَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد رودوه عن ضيفه فطمسنا اعينهم فذوقوا عذابي ونذر
ayahs.translation: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad raa-wa-doo-hu an daifeehee fa-ta-mas-naaa ayu-na-hum fa-zoo-qoo a-zaabee wa-nu-zur

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُم بُكۡرَةً عَذَابٞ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد صبحهم بكرة عذاب مستقر
ayahs.translation: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad sab-ba-ha-hum buk-ra-tan a-zaa-bun mus-ta-qirr

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: فذوقوا عذابي ونذر
ayahs.translation: So taste My punishment and warning.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-zoo-qoo a-zaabee wa-nu-zur

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد يسرنا القرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad yas-sar-nal qu-raa-na liz-zik-ri fa-hal min mud-da-kir

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد جاء ءال فرعون النذر
ayahs.translation: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad jaaaa aa-la fi-raw-nan nu-zur

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ أَخۡذَ عَزِيزٖ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: كذبوا بايتنا كلها فاخذنهم اخذ عزيز مقتدر
ayahs.translation: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
ayahs.transliteration: kaz-za-boo bi-a-ayaa-ti-naa kul-li-haa faa-khaz-naa-hum ak-hza azee-zim muq-ta-dir

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أُوْلَٰٓئِكُمۡ أَمۡ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٞ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: اكفاركم خير من اولئكم ام لكم براءة في الزبر
ayahs.translation: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?
ayahs.transliteration: a-kuf-faa-ru-kum khai-run min u-laaai-kum am la-kum ba-raaaa-tun fiz zu-bur

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيعٞ مُّنتَصِرٞ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: ام يقولون نحن جميع منتصر
ayahs.translation: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
ayahs.transliteration: am ya-qoo-loo-na nah-nu jamee-un mun-ta-sir

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَيُهۡزَمُ ٱلۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: سيهزم الجمع ويولون الدبر
ayahs.translation: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
ayahs.transliteration: sayuh-za-mul ja-mu wayu-wal-loo-nad du-bur

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: بل الساعة موعدهم والساعة ادهي وامر
ayahs.translation: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
ayahs.transliteration: ba-lis saaa-tu ma-wi-du-hum was-saaa-tu a-dhaa waa-marr

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٖ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان المجرمين في ضلل وسعر
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness..
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal muj-ri-mee-na fee da-laa-linw wa-suur

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: يوم يسحبون في النار علي وجوههم ذوقوا مس سقر
ayahs.translation: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma yu-sha-boo-na fin naa-ri a-laa wu-joo-hi-him zoo-qoo mas-sa sa-qar

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٖ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: انا كل شيء خلقنه بقدر
ayahs.translation: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa kul-la shaiin kha-laq-naa-hu bi-qa-dar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَمۡرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٞ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: وما امرنا الا وحدة كلمح بالبصر
ayahs.translation: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa am-ru-naaa il-laa waa-hi-da-tun ka-la-mhin bil-ba-sar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد اهلكنا اشياعكم فهل من مدكر
ayahs.translation: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad ah-lak-naaa a-shyaaa-kum fa-hal min mud-da-kir

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ شَيۡءٖ فَعَلُوهُ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: وكل شيء فعلوه في الزبر
ayahs.translation: And everything they did is in written records.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kul-lu shaiin faa-loo-hu fiz zu-bur

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٖ وَكَبِيرٖ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: وكل صغير وكبير مستطر
ayahs.translation: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kul-lu sa-ghee-rinw wa-ka-bee-rin mus-ta-tar

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَنَهَرٖ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان المتقين في جنت ونهر
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal mut-ta-qee-na fee jan-naa-tinw wa-na-har

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٖ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: في مقعد صدق عند مليك مقتدر
ayahs.translation: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
ayahs.transliteration: fee ma-qa-di sid-qin in-da malee-kin muq-ta-dir

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ١
ayahs.text_simple: الرحمن
ayahs.translation: The Most Merciful
ayahs.transliteration: ar-rah-maan

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَلَّمَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: علم القرءان
ayahs.translation: Taught the Qur’ān,
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-mal qu-ran

ayahs.text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: خلق الانسن
ayahs.translation: Created man,
ayahs.transliteration: kha-la-qal in-saan

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلۡبَيَانَ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: علمه البيان
ayahs.translation: [And] taught him eloquence.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-ma-hul bayaan

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُ بِحُسۡبَانٖ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: الشمس والقمر بحسبان
ayahs.translation: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
ayahs.transliteration: as-hsham-su wal-qa-ma-ru bi-hus-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجۡمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسۡجُدَانِ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: والنجم والشجر يسجدان
ayahs.translation: And the stars and trees prostrate.
ayahs.transliteration: wan-naj-mu was-hsha-ja-ru yas-ju-dan

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: والسماء رفعها ووضع الميزان
ayahs.translation: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
ayahs.transliteration: was-sa-maaaa ra-faa-haa wa-wa-daal mee-zan

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَطۡغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡمِيزَانِ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: الا تطغوا في الميزان
ayahs.translation: That you not transgress within the balance.
ayahs.transliteration: al-laa tat-ghaw fil mee-zaan

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلۡوَزۡنَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تُخۡسِرُواْ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: واقيموا الوزن بالقسط ولا تخسروا الميزان
ayahs.translation: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
ayahs.transliteration: waaqee-mul waz-na bil-qis-ti wa-laa tuk-hsi-rul mee-zaan

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلۡأَنَامِ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: والارض وضعها للانام
ayahs.translation: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lar-da wa-daa-haa li-la-naam

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَٱلنَّخۡلُ ذَاتُ ٱلۡأَكۡمَامِ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: فيها فكهة والنخل ذات الاكمام
ayahs.translation: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
ayahs.transliteration: fee-haa faa-ki-ha-tunw wan-nak-hlu zaa-tul ak-maam

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡحَبُّ ذُو ٱلۡعَصۡفِ وَٱلرَّيۡحَانُ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: والحب ذو العصف والريحان
ayahs.translation: And grain having husks and scented plants.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lhab-bu zul as-fi war-rai-haan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ كَٱلۡفَخَّارِ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: خلق الانسن من صلصل كالفخار
ayahs.translation: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.
ayahs.transliteration: kha-la-qal in-saa-na min sal-saa-lin kal-fak-hkhaar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَخَلَقَ ٱلۡجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٖ مِّن نَّارٖ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: وخلق الجان من مارج من نار
ayahs.translation: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kha-la-qal jaaan mim maa-ri-jim min naar

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَغۡرِبَيۡنِ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: رب المشرقين ورب المغربين
ayahs.translation: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
ayahs.transliteration: rab-bul mas-hri-qay-ni wa-rab-bul mag-hri-bayn

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَرَجَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ يَلۡتَقِيَانِ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: مرج البحرين يلتقيان
ayahs.translation: He released the two seas, meeting [one another];
ayahs.transliteration: ma-ra-jal bah-ray-ni yal-ta-qiyaan

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخٞ لَّا يَبۡغِيَانِ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: بينهما برزخ لا يبغيان
ayahs.translation: Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses.
ayahs.transliteration: bai-na-hu-maa bar-za-khul laa yab-ghiyaan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهُمَا ٱللُّؤۡلُؤُ وَٱلۡمَرۡجَانُ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: يخرج منهما اللؤلؤ والمرجان
ayahs.translation: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
ayahs.transliteration: yak-hru-ju mi-nhu-mal lu-luu wal-mar-jaan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَهُ ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ كَٱلۡأَعۡلَٰمِ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: وله الجوار المنشات في البحر كالاعلم
ayahs.translation: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-hul ja-waa-ril mun-shaaa-tu fil bah-ri ka-la-laam

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: كُلُّ مَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا فَانٖ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: كل من عليها فان
ayahs.translation: Everyone upon it [i.e., the earth] will perish,
ayahs.transliteration: kul-lu man a-lai-haa faan

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَبۡقَىٰ وَجۡهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: ويبقي وجه ربك ذو الجلل والاكرام
ayahs.translation: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
ayahs.transliteration: wayab-qaa wa-jhu rab-bi-ka zul ja-laa-li wa-lik-raam

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَسۡـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأۡنٖ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: يسله من في السموت والارض كل يوم هو في شان
ayahs.translation: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is in [i.e., bringing about] a matter.
ayahs.transliteration: ya-sa-lu-hoo man fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lard kul-la yaw-min hu-wa fee shaan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَنَفۡرُغُ لَكُمۡ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: سنفرغ لكم ايه الثقلان
ayahs.translation: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
ayahs.transliteration: sa-naf-ru-ghu la-kum ayyu-has sa-qa-laan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ أَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنۡ أَقۡطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنفُذُواْۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: يمعشر الجن والانس ان استطعتم ان تنفذوا من اقطار السموت والارض فانفذوا لا تنفذون الا بسلطن
ayahs.translation: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: yaa-ma-sha-ral jin-ni wa-lin-si i-nis ta-ta-tum an tan-fu-zoo min aq-taa-ris sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di fan-fu-zoo laa tan-fu-zoo-na il-laa bi-sul-taan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُرۡسَلُ عَلَيۡكُمَا شُوَاظٞ مِّن نَّارٖ وَنُحَاسٞ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: يرسل عليكما شواظ من نار ونحاس فلا تنتصران
ayahs.translation: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
ayahs.transliteration: yur-sa-lu a-lai-ku-maa shu-waa-zum min naa-rin-wwa nu-haa-sun fa-laa tan-ta-si-raan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ وَرۡدَةٗ كَٱلدِّهَانِ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: فاذا انشقت السماء فكانت وردة كالدهان
ayahs.translation: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -
ayahs.transliteration: fai-zan shaq-qa-tis sa-maaau fa-kaa-nat war-da-tan kad-di-haan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٞ وَلَا جَآنّٞ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: فيومئذ لا يسل عن ذنبه انس ولا جان
ayahs.translation: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.
ayahs.transliteration: fayaw-mai-zil laa yu-sa-lu an zam-biheee in-sunw wa-laa jaann

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُعۡرَفُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمۡ فَيُؤۡخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِي وَٱلۡأَقۡدَامِ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: يعرف المجرمون بسيمهم فيؤخذ بالنوصي والاقدام
ayahs.translation: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
ayahs.transliteration: yu-ra-ful muj-ri-moo-na bisee-maa-hum fayu-kha-zu bin-na-waa-si wa-laq-daam

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: هذه جهنم التي يكذب بها المجرمون
ayahs.translation: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.
ayahs.transliteration: haa-zihee ja-han-na-mul latee yu-kaz-zi-bu bi-hal muj-ri-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَطُوفُونَ بَيۡنَهَا وَبَيۡنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٖ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: يطوفون بينها وبين حميم ءان
ayahs.translation: They will circulate between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
ayahs.transliteration: ya-too-foo-na bai-na-haa wa-bai-na hamee-mim aan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلِمَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولمن خاف مقام ربه جنتان
ayahs.translation: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-li-man khaa-fa ma-qaa-ma rab-bihee jan-na-taan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَوَاتَآ أَفۡنَانٖ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: ذواتا افنان
ayahs.translation: Having [spreading] branches.
ayahs.transliteration: za-waa-taaa af-naan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِيهِمَا عَيۡنَانِ تَجۡرِيَانِ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: فيهما عينان تجريان
ayahs.translation: In both of them are two springs, flowing.
ayahs.transliteration: fee-hi-maa ay-naa-ni taj-riyaan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٖ زَوۡجَانِ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: فيهما من كل فكهة زوجان
ayahs.translation: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.
ayahs.transliteration: fee-hi-maa min kul-li faa-ki-ha-tin zaw-jaan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشِۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنۡ إِسۡتَبۡرَقٖۚ وَجَنَى ٱلۡجَنَّتَيۡنِ دَانٖ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: متكين علي فرش بطائنها من استبرق وجني الجنتين دان
ayahs.translation: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
ayahs.transliteration: mut-ta-kiee-na a-laa fu-ru-shim ba-taaai-nu-haa min is-tab-raq wa-ja-nal jan-na-tai-ni daan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ إِنسٞ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنّٞ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: فيهن قصرت الطرف لم يطمثهن انس قبلهم ولا جان
ayahs.translation: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinnī -
ayahs.transliteration: fee-hin-na qaa-si-ra-tut tar-fi lam yat-mi-shun-na in-sun qab-la-hum wa-laa jaaann

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلۡيَاقُوتُ وَٱلۡمَرۡجَانُ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: كانهن الياقوت والمرجان
ayahs.translation: As if they were rubies and coral.
ayahs.transliteration: kaan-na-hun-nal yaa-qoo-tu wal-mar-jaan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَلۡ جَزَآءُ ٱلۡإِحۡسَٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلۡإِحۡسَٰنُ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: هل جزاء الاحسن الا الاحسن
ayahs.translation: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?
ayahs.transliteration: hal ja-zaaaul ih-saa-ni il-lal ih-saan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: ومن دونهما جنتان
ayahs.translation: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-min doo-ni-hi-maa jan-na-taan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: مُدۡهَآمَّتَانِ ٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: مدهامتان
ayahs.translation: Dark green [in color].
ayahs.transliteration: mu-dhaaam-ma-taan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِيهِمَا عَيۡنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ ٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: فيهما عينان نضاختان
ayahs.translation: In both of them are two springs, spouting.
ayahs.transliteration: fee-hi-maa ay-naa-ni nad-daa-kha-taan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِيهِمَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَنَخۡلٞ وَرُمَّانٞ ٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: فيهما فكهة ونخل ورمان
ayahs.translation: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.
ayahs.transliteration: fee-hi-maa faa-ki-ha-tunw wa-nak-hlunw wa-rum-maan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِيهِنَّ خَيۡرَٰتٌ حِسَانٞ ٧٠
ayahs.text_simple: فيهن خيرت حسان
ayahs.translation: In them are good and beautiful women -
ayahs.transliteration: fee-hin-na khai-raa-tun hi-saan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٧١
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: حُورٞ مَّقۡصُورَٰتٞ فِي ٱلۡخِيَامِ ٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: حور مقصورت في الخيام
ayahs.translation: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -
ayahs.transliteration: hoo-rum maq-soo-raa-tun fil khiyaam

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٧٣
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ إِنسٞ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنّٞ ٧٤
ayahs.text_simple: لم يطمثهن انس قبلهم ولا جان
ayahs.translation: Untouched before them by man or jinnī -
ayahs.transliteration: lam yat-mi-shun-na in-sun qab-la-hum wa-laa jaaann

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٧٥
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفۡرَفٍ خُضۡرٖ وَعَبۡقَرِيٍّ حِسَانٖ ٧٦
ayahs.text_simple: متكين علي رفرف خضر وعبقري حسان
ayahs.translation: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.
ayahs.transliteration: mut-ta-kiee-na a-laa raf-ra-fin khud-rinw waab-qa-riyyin hi-saan

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ٧٧
ayahs.text_simple: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi aa-laaai rab-bi-ku-maa tu-kaz-zi-baan

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسۡمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ ٧٨
ayahs.text_simple: تبرك اسم ربك ذي الجلل والاكرام
ayahs.translation: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
ayahs.transliteration: ta-baa-rak as-mu rab-bi-ka zil ja-laa-li wa-lik-raam

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلۡوَاقِعَةُ ١
ayahs.text_simple: اذا وقعت الواقعة
ayahs.translation: When the Occurrence occurs,
ayahs.transliteration: i-zaa wa-qaa-til waa-qi-ah

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَيۡسَ لِوَقۡعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: ليس لوقعتها كاذبة
ayahs.translation: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.
ayahs.transliteration: lai-sa li-wa-qa-ti-haa kaa-zi-bah

ayahs.text_uthmani: خَافِضَةٞ رَّافِعَةٌ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: خافضة رافعة
ayahs.translation: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].
ayahs.transliteration: kha-fi-da-tur raa-fi-ah

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ رَجّٗا ٤
ayahs.text_simple: اذا رجت الارض رجا
ayahs.translation: When the earth is shaken with convulsion
ayahs.transliteration: i-zaa ruj-ja-til ar-du raj-jaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ بَسّٗا ٥
ayahs.text_simple: وبست الجبال بسا
ayahs.translation: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
ayahs.transliteration: wa-bus-sa-til ji-baa-lu bas-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكَانَتۡ هَبَآءٗ مُّنۢبَثّٗا ٦
ayahs.text_simple: فكانت هباء منبثا
ayahs.translation: And become dust dispersing,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kaa-nat ha-baaaam mum-bas-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكُنتُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا ثَلَٰثَةٗ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: وكنتم ازوجا ثلثة
ayahs.translation: And you become [of] three kinds:
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kun-tum az-waa-jan sa-laa-sah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: فاصحب الميمنة ما اصحب الميمنة
ayahs.translation: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
ayahs.transliteration: faa-shaa-bul mai-ma-na-ti maaa a-shaa-bul mai-ma-nah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: واصحب المشمة ما اصحب المشمة
ayahs.translation: And the companions of the left - what are companions of the left?
ayahs.transliteration: waa-shaa-bul ma-sha-ma-ti maaa a-shaa-bul ma-sha-mah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: والسبقون السبقون
ayahs.translation: And the forerunners, the forerunners -
ayahs.transliteration: was-saa-bi-qoo-nas saa-bi-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك المقربون
ayahs.translation: Those are the ones brought near [to Allāh]
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-kal mu-qar-ra-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: في جنت النعيم
ayahs.translation: In the Gardens of Pleasure,
ayahs.transliteration: fee jan-naa-tin naeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُلَّةٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: ثلة من الاولين
ayahs.translation: A [large] company of the former peoples
ayahs.transliteration: sul-la-tum mi-nal aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَلِيلٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: وقليل من الاخرين
ayahs.translation: And a few of the later peoples,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qa-lee-lum mi-nal aa-khireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مَّوۡضُونَةٖ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: علي سرر موضونة
ayahs.translation: On thrones woven [with ornament],
ayahs.transliteration: a-laa su-ru-rim maw-doo-nah

ayahs.text_uthmani: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيۡهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: متكين عليها متقبلين
ayahs.translation: Reclining on them, facing each other.
ayahs.transliteration: mut-ta-kiee-na a-lai-haa mu-ta-qa-bileen

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَٰنٞ مُّخَلَّدُونَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: يطوف عليهم ولدن مخلدون
ayahs.translation: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal
ayahs.transliteration: ya-too-fu a-lai-him wil-daa-num mu-khal-la-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: بِأَكۡوَابٖ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأۡسٖ مِّن مَّعِينٖ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: باكواب واباريق وكاس من معين
ayahs.translation: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -
ayahs.transliteration: bi-a-kwaa-binw waa-baareeq wa-kaa-sim mim maeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنۡهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: لا يصدعون عنها ولا ينزفون
ayahs.translation: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -
ayahs.transliteration: laa yu-sad-daoo-na a-nhaa wa-laa yun-zi-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفَٰكِهَةٖ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: وفكهة مما يتخيرون
ayahs.translation: And fruit of what they select
ayahs.transliteration: wa-faa-ki-ha-tim mim-maa ya-ta-khaiya-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَحۡمِ طَيۡرٖ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: ولحم طير مما يشتهون
ayahs.translation: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lah-mi tai-rim mim-maa yas-hta-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَحُورٌ عِينٞ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: وحور عين
ayahs.translation: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hoo-run een

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَأَمۡثَٰلِ ٱللُّؤۡلُوِٕ ٱلۡمَكۡنُونِ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: كامثل اللؤلو المكنون
ayahs.translation: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,
ayahs.transliteration: kaam-saa-lil lu-lu-il mak-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: جزاء بما كانوا يعملون
ayahs.translation: As reward for what they used to do.
ayahs.transliteration: ja-zaaaam bi-maa kaa-noo ya-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمًا ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا ولا تاثيما
ayahs.translation: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
ayahs.transliteration: laa yas-maoo-na fee-haa lag-hwanw wa-laa taasee-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا قِيلٗا سَلَٰمٗا سَلَٰمٗا ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: الا قيلا سلما سلما
ayahs.translation: Only a saying [of] peace, peace.
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa qee-lan sa-laa-man sa-laa-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡيَمِينِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡيَمِينِ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: واصحب اليمين ما اصحب اليمين
ayahs.translation: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
ayahs.transliteration: waa-shaa-bul ya-mee-ni maaa a-shaa-bul ya-meen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي سِدۡرٖ مَّخۡضُودٖ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: في سدر مخضود
ayahs.translation: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed
ayahs.transliteration: fee sid-rim mak-hdood

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَطَلۡحٖ مَّنضُودٖ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: وطلح منضود
ayahs.translation: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-lhim man-dood

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَظِلّٖ مَّمۡدُودٖ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: وظل ممدود
ayahs.translation: And shade extended
ayahs.transliteration: wa-zil-lim mam-dood

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآءٖ مَّسۡكُوبٖ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: وماء مسكوب
ayahs.translation: And water poured out
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaaim mas-koob

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفَٰكِهَةٖ كَثِيرَةٖ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: وفكهة كثيرة
ayahs.translation: And fruit, abundant [and varied],
ayahs.transliteration: wa-faa-ki-ha-tin kasee-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا مَقۡطُوعَةٖ وَلَا مَمۡنُوعَةٖ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: لا مقطوعة ولا ممنوعة
ayahs.translation: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,
ayahs.transliteration: laa maq-too-a-tinw wa-laa mam-noo-ah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفُرُشٖ مَّرۡفُوعَةٍ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: وفرش مرفوعة
ayahs.translation: And [upon] beds raised high.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-fu-ru-shim mar-foo-ah

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنشَأۡنَٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءٗ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: انا انشانهن انشاء
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have produced them [i.e., the women of Paradise] in a [new] creation
ayahs.transliteration: in-naaa an-shaa-naa-hun-na in-shaaaaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُنَّ أَبۡكَارًا ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: فجعلنهن ابكارا
ayahs.translation: And made them virgins,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-jaal-naa-hun-na ab-kaa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: عُرُبًا أَتۡرَابٗا ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: عربا اترابا
ayahs.translation: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,
ayahs.transliteration: u-ru-ban at-raa-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِّأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: لاصحب اليمين
ayahs.translation: For the companions of the right [who are]
ayahs.transliteration: li-a-shaa-bil ya-meen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُلَّةٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: ثلة من الاولين
ayahs.translation: A company of the former peoples
ayahs.transliteration: sul-la-tum mi-nal aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَثُلَّةٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: وثلة من الاخرين
ayahs.translation: And a company of the later peoples.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-sul-la-tum mi-nal aa-khireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: واصحب الشمال ما اصحب الشمال
ayahs.translation: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
ayahs.transliteration: waa-shaa-bush shi-maa-li maaa a-shaa-bush shi-maal

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي سَمُومٖ وَحَمِيمٖ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: في سموم وحميم
ayahs.translation: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
ayahs.transliteration: fee sa-moo-minw wa-hameem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَظِلّٖ مِّن يَحۡمُومٖ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: وظل من يحموم
ayahs.translation: And a shade of black smoke,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-zil-lim mi-ny yah-moom

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا بَارِدٖ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: لا بارد ولا كريم
ayahs.translation: Neither cool nor beneficial.
ayahs.transliteration: laa baa-ri-dinw wa-laa kareem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتۡرَفِينَ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: انهم كانوا قبل ذلك مترفين
ayahs.translation: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hum kaa-noo qab-la zaa-li-ka mut-rafeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَانُواْ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلۡحِنثِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: وكانوا يصرون علي الحنث العظيم
ayahs.translation: And they used to persist in the great violation,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kaa-noo yu-sir-roo-na a-lal hin-sil azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَانُواْ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: وكانوا يقولون ائذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظما اءنا لمبعوثون
ayahs.translation: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kaa-noo ya-qoo-loo-na ai-zaa mit-naa wa-kun-naa tu-raa-banw wai-zaa-man ain-naa la-ma-boo-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: اوءاباؤنا الاولون
ayahs.translation: And our forefathers [as well]?"
ayahs.transliteration: a-waaa-baaau-nal aw-wa-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: قل ان الاولين والاخرين
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, the former and later peoples
ayahs.transliteration: qul in-nal aw-wa-lee-na wa-laa-khireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَمَجۡمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَٰتِ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: لمجموعون الي ميقت يوم معلوم
ayahs.translation: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
ayahs.transliteration: la-maj-moooo-na i-laa mee-qaa-ti yaw-mim ma-loom

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبُونَ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: ثم انكم ايها الضالون المكذبون
ayahs.translation: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma in-na-kum ayyu-had daaal-loo-nal mu-kaz-zi-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَأٓكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٖ مِّن زَقُّومٖ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: لاكلون من شجر من زقوم
ayahs.translation: Will be eating from trees of zaqqūm
ayahs.transliteration: laaa-ki-loo-na min sha-ja-rim min zaq-qoom

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: فمالون منها البطون
ayahs.translation: And filling with it your bellies
ayahs.transliteration: fa-maa-lioo-na mi-nhal bu-toon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَشَٰرِبُونَ عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: فشربون عليه من الحميم
ayahs.translation: And drinking on top of it from scalding water
ayahs.transliteration: fa-shaa-ri-boo-na a-lai-hi mi-nal hameem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَشَٰرِبُونَ شُرۡبَ ٱلۡهِيمِ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: فشربون شرب الهيم
ayahs.translation: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-shaa-ri-boo-na shur-bal heem

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: هذا نزلهم يوم الدين
ayahs.translation: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.
ayahs.transliteration: haa-zaa nu-zu-lu-hum yaw-mad deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: نَحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ فَلَوۡلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ ٥٧
ayahs.text_simple: نحن خلقنكم فلولا تصدقون
ayahs.translation: We have created you, so why do you not believe?
ayahs.transliteration: nah-nu kha-laq-naa-kum fa-law-laa tu-sad-di-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تُمۡنُونَ ٥٨
ayahs.text_simple: افرءيتم ما تمنون
ayahs.translation: Have you seen that which you emit?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-raay-tum maa tum-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمۡ تَخۡلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ ٥٩
ayahs.text_simple: ءانتم تخلقونه ام نحن الخلقون
ayahs.translation: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?
ayahs.transliteration: aan-tum tak-hlu-qoo-na-hooo am nah-nul khaa-li-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: نَحۡنُ قَدَّرۡنَا بَيۡنَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ ٦٠
ayahs.text_simple: نحن قدرنا بينكم الموت وما نحن بمسبوقين
ayahs.translation: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
ayahs.transliteration: nah-nu qad-dar-naa bai-na-ku-mul maw-ta wa-maa nah-nu bi-mas-booqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمۡثَٰلَكُمۡ وَنُنشِئَكُمۡ فِي مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ ٦١
ayahs.text_simple: علي ان نبدل امثلكم وننشئكم في ما لا تعلمون
ayahs.translation: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: a-laaa an nu-bad-di-la am-saa-la-kum wa-nun-shi-a-kum fee maa laa ta-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتُمُ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ فَلَوۡلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ ٦٢
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد علمتم النشاة الاولي فلولا تذكرون
ayahs.translation: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad a-lim-tu-mun na-sha-tal oo-laa fa-law-laa ta-zak-ka-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَحۡرُثُونَ ٦٣
ayahs.text_simple: افرءيتم ما تحرثون
ayahs.translation: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-raay-tum maa tah-ru-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمۡ تَزۡرَعُونَهُۥٓ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلزَّٰرِعُونَ ٦٤
ayahs.text_simple: ءانتم تزرعونه ام نحن الزرعون
ayahs.translation: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?
ayahs.transliteration: aan-tum taz-raoo-na-hooo am nah-nuz zaa-riooon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ حُطَٰمٗا فَظَلۡتُمۡ تَفَكَّهُونَ ٦٥
ayahs.text_simple: لو نشاء لجعلنه حطما فظلتم تفكهون
ayahs.translation: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,
ayahs.transliteration: law na-shaaau la-jaal-naa-hu hu-taa-man fa-zal-tum ta-fak-ka-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا لَمُغۡرَمُونَ ٦٦
ayahs.text_simple: انا لمغرمون
ayahs.translation: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa la-mug-hra-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ نَحۡنُ مَحۡرُومُونَ ٦٧
ayahs.text_simple: بل نحن محرومون
ayahs.translation: Rather, we have been deprived."
ayahs.transliteration: bal nah-nu mah-roo-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱلۡمَآءَ ٱلَّذِي تَشۡرَبُونَ ٦٨
ayahs.text_simple: افرءيتم الماء الذي تشربون
ayahs.translation: And have you seen the water that you drink?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-raay-tu-mul maaa al-lazee tas-hra-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَنزَلۡتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُزۡنِ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُنزِلُونَ ٦٩
ayahs.text_simple: ءانتم انزلتموه من المزن ام نحن المنزلون
ayahs.translation: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?
ayahs.transliteration: aan-tum an-zal-tu-moo-hu mi-nal muz-ni am nah-nul mun-zi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَوۡ نَشَآءُ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ أُجَاجٗا فَلَوۡلَا تَشۡكُرُونَ ٧٠
ayahs.text_simple: لو نشاء جعلنه اجاجا فلولا تشكرون
ayahs.translation: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?
ayahs.transliteration: law na-shaaau jaal-naa-hu u-jaa-jan fa-law-laa tas-hku-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِي تُورُونَ ٧١
ayahs.text_simple: افرءيتم النار التي تورون
ayahs.translation: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-raay-tu-mun naa-ral latee too-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَنشَأۡتُمۡ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُنشِـُٔونَ ٧٢
ayahs.text_simple: ءانتم انشاتم شجرتها ام نحن المنشون
ayahs.translation: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?
ayahs.transliteration: aan-tum an-shaa-tum sha-ja-ra-ta-haaa am nah-nul mun-shioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: نَحۡنُ جَعَلۡنَٰهَا تَذۡكِرَةٗ وَمَتَٰعٗا لِّلۡمُقۡوِينَ ٧٣
ayahs.text_simple: نحن جعلنها تذكرة ومتعا للمقوين
ayahs.translation: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,
ayahs.transliteration: nah-nu jaal-naa-haa taz-ki-ra-tanw wa-ma-taaal lil-muq-ween

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ ٧٤
ayahs.text_simple: فسبح باسم ربك العظيم
ayahs.translation: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-sab-bih bis-mi rab-bi-kal azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِمَوَٰقِعِ ٱلنُّجُومِ ٧٥
ayahs.text_simple: فلا اقسم بموقع النجوم
ayahs.translation: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-laa uq-si-mu bi-maa-waa qiin-nu-joom

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَقَسَمٞ لَّوۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ ٧٦
ayahs.text_simple: وانه لقسم لو تعلمون عظيم
ayahs.translation: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na-hoo la-qa-sa-mul law ta-la-moo-na azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقُرۡءَانٞ كَرِيمٞ ٧٧
ayahs.text_simple: انه لقرءان كريم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is a noble Qur’ān.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hoo la-qu-raa-nun kareem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي كِتَٰبٖ مَّكۡنُونٖ ٧٨
ayahs.text_simple: في كتب مكنون
ayahs.translation: In a Register well-protected;.
ayahs.transliteration: fee ki-taa-bim mak-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا يَمَسُّهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُطَهَّرُونَ ٧٩
ayahs.text_simple: لا يمسه الا المطهرون
ayahs.translation: None touch it except the purified [i.e., the angels].
ayahs.transliteration: laa ya-mas-su-hooo il-lal mu-ta-hha-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَنزِيلٞ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٨٠
ayahs.text_simple: تنزيل من رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: tan-zee-lum mir rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَبِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدۡهِنُونَ ٨١
ayahs.text_simple: افبهذا الحديث انتم مدهنون
ayahs.translation: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-bi-haa-zal hadee-si an-tum mu-dhi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَجۡعَلُونَ رِزۡقَكُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ تُكَذِّبُونَ ٨٢
ayahs.text_simple: وتجعلون رزقكم انكم تكذبون
ayahs.translation: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-ja-loo-na riz-qa-kum an-na-kum tu-kaz-zi-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَوۡلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلۡحُلۡقُومَ ٨٣
ayahs.text_simple: فلولا اذا بلغت الحلقوم
ayahs.translation: Then why, when it [i.e., the soul at death] reaches the throat
ayahs.transliteration: fa-law-laaa i-zaa ba-la-gha-til hul-qoom

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنتُمۡ حِينَئِذٖ تَنظُرُونَ ٨٤
ayahs.text_simple: وانتم حينئذ تنظرون
ayahs.translation: And you are at that time looking on -
ayahs.transliteration: waan-tum hee-nai-zin tan-zu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنكُمۡ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبۡصِرُونَ ٨٥
ayahs.text_simple: ونحن اقرب اليه منكم ولكن لا تبصرون
ayahs.translation: And We [i.e., Our angels] are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-nah-nu aq-ra-bu i-lai-hi min-kum wa-laa-kil laa tub-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَوۡلَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ غَيۡرَ مَدِينِينَ ٨٦
ayahs.text_simple: فلولا ان كنتم غير مدينين
ayahs.translation: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-law-laaa in kun-tum ghai-ra madeeneen

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَرۡجِعُونَهَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ ٨٧
ayahs.text_simple: ترجعونها ان كنتم صدقين
ayahs.translation: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?
ayahs.transliteration: tar-jioo-na-haaa in kun-tum saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ ٨٨
ayahs.text_simple: فاما ان كان من المقربين
ayahs.translation: And if he [i.e., the deceased] was of those brought near [to Allāh],
ayahs.transliteration: faam-maaa in kaa-na mi-nal mu-qar-rabeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَرَوۡحٞ وَرَيۡحَانٞ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٖ ٨٩
ayahs.text_simple: فروح وريحان وجنت نعيم
ayahs.translation: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ra-whunw wa-rai-haa-nunw wa-jan-na-tu naeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ ٩٠
ayahs.text_simple: واما ان كان من اصحب اليمين
ayahs.translation: And if he was of the companions of the right,
ayahs.transliteration: waam-maaa in kaa-na min a-shaa-bil ya-meen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَسَلَٰمٞ لَّكَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ ٩١
ayahs.text_simple: فسلم لك من اصحب اليمين
ayahs.translation: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-sa-laa-mul la-ka min a-shaa-bil ya-meen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ ٩٢
ayahs.text_simple: واما ان كان من المكذبين الضالين
ayahs.translation: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,
ayahs.transliteration: waam-maaa in kaa-na mi-nal mu-kaz-zi-bee-nad daaal-leen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَنُزُلٞ مِّنۡ حَمِيمٖ ٩٣
ayahs.text_simple: فنزل من حميم
ayahs.translation: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water
ayahs.transliteration: fa-nu-zu-lum min hameem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَصۡلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ ٩٤
ayahs.text_simple: وتصلية جحيم
ayahs.translation: And burning in Hellfire.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-tas-liya-tu jaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ ٱلۡيَقِينِ ٩٥
ayahs.text_simple: ان هذا لهو حق اليقين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, this is the true certainty,
ayahs.transliteration: in-na haa-za la-hu-wa haq-qul ya-qeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ ٩٦
ayahs.text_simple: فسبح باسم ربك العظيم
ayahs.translation: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-sab-bih bis-mi rab-bi-kal azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ١
ayahs.text_simple: سبح لله ما في السموت والارض وهو العزيز الحكيم
ayahs.translation: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allāh, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: sab-ba-ha lil-laa-hi maa fis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di wa-hu-wal azee-zul hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: له ملك السموت والارض يحي ويميت وهو علي كل شيء قدير
ayahs.translation: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.
ayahs.transliteration: la-hoo mul-kus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di yu-hyee wayumee-tu wa-hu-wa a-laa kul-li shaiin qadeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُ وَٱلۡأٓخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلۡبَاطِنُۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: هو الاول والاخر والظهر والباطن وهو بكل شيء عليم
ayahs.translation: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: hu-wal aw-wa-lu wa-laa-khi-ru waz-zaa-hi-ru wal-baa-ti-nu wa-hu-wa bi-kul-li shaiin aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعۡرُجُ فِيهَاۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٞ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: هو الذي خلق السموت والارض في ستة ايام ثم استوي علي العرش يعلم ما يلج في الارض وما يخرج منها وما ينزل من السماء وما يعرج فيها وهو معكم اين ما كنتم والله بما تعملون بصير
ayahs.translation: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.
ayahs.transliteration: hu-wal lazee kha-la-qas sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-da fee sit-ta-ti ayyaa-min sum-mas ta-waa a-lal arsh ya-la-mu maa ya-li-ju fil ar-di wa-maa yak-hru-ju mi-nhaa wa-maa yan-zi-lu mi-nas sa-maaai wa-maa ya-ru-ju fee-ha wa-hu-wa maa-kum ay-na maa kun-tum wal-laa-hu bi-maa ta-ma-loo-na baseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرۡجَعُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: له ملك السموت والارض والي الله ترجع الامور
ayahs.translation: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allāh are returned [all] matters.
ayahs.transliteration: la-hoo mul-kus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lard wai-lal laa-hi tur-jaul u-moor

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيۡلَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: يولج اليل في النهار ويولج النهار في اليل وهو عليم بذات الصدور
ayahs.translation: He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
ayahs.transliteration: yoo-li-jul lai-la fin na-haa-ri wayoo-li-jun na-haa-ra fil lail wa-hu-wa alee-mum bi-zaa-tis su-door

ayahs.text_uthmani: ءَامِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسۡتَخۡلَفِينَ فِيهِۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنكُمۡ وَأَنفَقُواْ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٞ كَبِيرٞ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ءامنوا بالله ورسوله وانفقوا مما جعلكم مستخلفين فيه فالذين ءامنوا منكم وانفقوا لهم اجر كبير
ayahs.translation: Believe in Allāh and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successive inheritors. For those who have believed among you and spent, there will be a great reward.
ayahs.transliteration: aaa-mi-noo bil-laa-hi wa-ra-soo-lihee waan-fi-qoo mim-maa jaa-la-kum mus-tak-hla-fee-na fee-hi fal-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo min-kum waan-fa-qoo la-hum aj-run kabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا لَكُمۡ لَا تُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدۡعُوكُمۡ لِتُؤۡمِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمۡ وَقَدۡ أَخَذَ مِيثَٰقَكُمۡ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: وما لكم لا تؤمنون بالله والرسول يدعوكم لتؤمنوا بربكم وقد اخذ ميثقكم ان كنتم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation: And why do you not believe in Allāh while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant, if you should [truly] be believers?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa la-kum laa tu-mi-noo-na bil-laa-hi war-ra-soo-lu ya-doo-kum li-tu-mi-noo bi-rab-bi-kum wa-qad a-kha-za mee-saa-qa-kum in kun-tum mu-mineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِۦٓ ءَايَٰتِۭ بَيِّنَٰتٖ لِّيُخۡرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُمۡ لَرَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: هو الذي ينزل علي عبده ءايت بينت ليخرجكم من الظلمت الي النور وان الله بكم لرءوف رحيم
ayahs.translation: It is He who sends down upon His Servant [Muḥammad (ﷺ)] verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And indeed, Allāh is to you Kind and Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: hu-wal lazee yu-naz-zi-lu a-laa ab-diheee aayaa-tim baiyi-naa-til liyuk-hri-ja-kum mi-naz zu-lu-maa-ti i-lan noor wain-nal laa-ha bi-kum la-raoo-fur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا لَكُمۡ أَلَّا تُنفِقُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ لَا يَسۡتَوِي مِنكُم مَّنۡ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبۡلِ ٱلۡفَتۡحِ وَقَٰتَلَۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَعۡظَمُ دَرَجَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدُ وَقَٰتَلُواْۚ وَكُلّٗا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: وما لكم الا تنفقوا في سبيل الله ولله ميرث السموت والارض لا يستوي منكم من انفق من قبل الفتح وقتل اولئك اعظم درجة من الذين انفقوا من بعد وقتلوا وكلا وعد الله الحسني والله بما تعملون خبير
ayahs.translation: And why do you not spend in the cause of Allāh while to Allāh belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest [of Makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it]. Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought. But to all Allāh has promised the best [reward]. And Allāh, of what you do, is Aware.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa la-kum al-laa tun-fi-qoo fee sabee-lil laa-hi wa-lil-laa-hi mee-raa-sus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lard laa yas-tawee min-kum man an-fa-qa min qab-lil fa-thi wa-qaa-tal u-laaai-ka a-za-mu da-ra-ja-tam mi-nal lazee-na an-fa-qoo min ba-du wa-qaa-ta-loo wa-kul-lanw waad al-laa-hul hus-naa wal-laa-hu bi-maa ta-ma-loo-na khabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يُقۡرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗا فَيُضَٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥٓ أَجۡرٞ كَرِيمٞ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: من ذا الذي يقرض الله قرضا حسنا فيضعفه له وله اجر كريم
ayahs.translation: Who is it that would loan Allāh a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?
ayahs.transliteration: man zal lazee yuq-ri-dul laa-ha qar-dan ha-sa-nan fayu-daai-fa-hoo la-hoo wa-la-hooo aj-run kareem

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ تَرَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ يَسۡعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَبِأَيۡمَٰنِهِمۖ بُشۡرَىٰكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ جَنَّٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: يوم تري المؤمنين والمؤمنت يسعي نورهم بين ايديهم وبايمنهم بشريكم اليوم جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها ذلك هو الفوز العظيم
ayahs.translation: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment.
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma ta-ral mu-mi-nee-na wal-mu-mi-naa-ti ya-saa noo-ru-hum bai-na ay-dee-him wa-bi-a-y-maa-ni-him bus-hraa-ku-mul yaw-ma jan-naa-tun taj-ree min tah-ti-hal a-nhaa-ru khaa-li-dee-na fee-ha zaa-li-ka hu-wal faw-zul azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يَقُولُ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقَٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقۡتَبِسۡ مِن نُّورِكُمۡ قِيلَ ٱرۡجِعُواْ وَرَآءَكُمۡ فَٱلۡتَمِسُواْ نُورٗاۖ فَضُرِبَ بَيۡنَهُم بِسُورٖ لَّهُۥ بَابُۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَةُ وَظَٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلۡعَذَابُ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: يوم يقول المنفقون والمنفقت للذين ءامنوا انظرونا نقتبس من نوركم قيل ارجعوا وراءكم فالتمسوا نورا فضرب بينهم بسور له باب باطنه فيه الرحمة وظهره من قبله العذاب
ayahs.translation: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment.
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma ya-qoo-lul mu-naa-fi-qoo-na wal-mu-naa-fi-qaa-tu lil-la-zee-na aa-ma-nu un-zu-roo-naa naq-ta-bis min noo-ri-kum qee-la rjioo wa-raaaa-kum fal-ta-mi-soo noo-ran fa-du-ri-ba bai-na-hum bi-soo-ril la-hoo baa-bun baa-ti-nu-hoo fee-hir rah-ma-tu wa-zaa-hi-ru-hoo min qi-ba-li-hi a-zaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُنَادُونَهُمۡ أَلَمۡ نَكُن مَّعَكُمۡۖ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمۡ فَتَنتُمۡ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَتَرَبَّصۡتُمۡ وَٱرۡتَبۡتُمۡ وَغَرَّتۡكُمُ ٱلۡأَمَانِيُّ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡغَرُورُ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: ينادونهم الم نكن معكم قالوا بلي ولكنكم فتنتم انفسكم وتربصتم وارتبتم وغرتكم الاماني حتي جاء امر الله وغركم بالله الغرور
ayahs.translation: They [i.e., the hypocrites] will call to them [i.e., the believers], "Were we not with you?" They will say, "Yes, but you afflicted yourselves and awaited [misfortune for us] and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allāh. And the Deceiver [i.e., Satan] deceived you concerning Allāh.
ayahs.transliteration: yu-naa-doo-na-hum a-lam na-kum maa-kum qaa-loo ba-laa wa-laa-kin-na-kum fa-tan-tum an-fu-sa-kum wa-ta-rab-bas-tum war-tab-tum wa-ghar-rat-ku-mul a-maa-niyyu hat-ta jaaaa am-rul laa-hi wa-ghar-ra-kum bil-laa-hil gha-roor

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا يُؤۡخَذُ مِنكُمۡ فِدۡيَةٞ وَلَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ مَأۡوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُۖ هِيَ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: فاليوم لا يؤخذ منكم فدية ولا من الذين كفروا ماويكم النار هي موليكم وبئس المصير
ayahs.translation: So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lyaw-ma laa yu-kha-zu min-kum fi-dya-tunw wa-laa mi-nal lazee-na ka-fa-roo ma-waa-ku-mun naa-ru hiya maw-laa-kum wa-bi-sal maseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ أَلَمۡ يَأۡنِ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَن تَخۡشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمۡ لِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُواْ كَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبۡلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡأَمَدُ فَقَسَتۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡۖ وَكَثِيرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَٰسِقُونَ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: الم يان للذين ءامنوا ان تخشع قلوبهم لذكر الله وما نزل من الحق ولا يكونوا كالذين اوتوا الكتب من قبل فطال عليهم الامد فقست قلوبهم وكثير منهم فسقون
ayahs.translation: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allāh and what has come down of the truth? And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient.
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam ya-ni lil-la-zee-na aa-ma-nooo an tak-hshaa qu-loo-bu-hum li-zik-ril laa-hi wa-maa na-za-la mi-nal haq-qi wa-laa ya-koo-noo kal-la-zee-na oo-tul ki-taa-ba min qab-lu fa-taa-la a-lai-hi-mul a-ma-du fa-qa-sat qu-loo-bu-hum wa-ka-see-rum mi-nhum faa-si-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحۡيِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَاۚ قَدۡ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: اعلموا ان الله يحي الارض بعد موتها قد بينا لكم الايت لعلكم تعقلون
ayahs.translation: Know that Allāh gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. We have made clear to you the signs; perhaps you will understand.
ayahs.transliteration: i-la-mooo an-nal laa-ha yu-hyil ar-da ba-da maw-ti-haa qad baiyan-naa la-ku-mul aayaa-ti laal-la-kum ta-qi-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَٱلۡمُصَّدِّقَٰتِ وَأَقۡرَضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗا يُضَٰعَفُ لَهُمۡ وَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٞ كَرِيمٞ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: ان المصدقين والمصدقت واقرضوا الله قرضا حسنا يضعف لهم ولهم اجر كريم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allāh a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal mus-sad-di-qee-na wal-mus-sad-di-qaa-ti waaq-ra-dul laa-ha qar-dan has-sa-na-ny yu-daaa-fu la-hum wa-la-hum aj-run kareem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَۖ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرُهُمۡ وَنُورُهُمۡۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: والذين ءامنوا بالله ورسله اولئك هم الصديقون والشهداء عند ربهم لهم اجرهم ونورهم والذين كفروا وكذبوا بايتنا اولئك اصحب الجحيم
ayahs.translation: And those who have believed in Allāh and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light. But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo bil-laa-hi wa-ru-su-liheee u-laaai-ka hu-mus sid-dee-qoon was-hshu-ha-daaau in-da rab-bi-him la-hum aj-ru-hum wa-noo-ru-hum wal-la-zee-na ka-fa-roo wa-kaz-za-boo bi-a-ayaa-ti-naaa u-laaai-ka a-shaa-bul jaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّمَا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا لَعِبٞ وَلَهۡوٞ وَزِينَةٞ وَتَفَاخُرُۢ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَتَكَاثُرٞ فِي ٱلۡأَمۡوَٰلِ وَٱلۡأَوۡلَٰدِۖ كَمَثَلِ غَيۡثٍ أَعۡجَبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصۡفَرّٗا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَٰمٗاۖ وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدٞ وَمَغۡفِرَةٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضۡوَٰنٞۚ وَمَا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَآ إِلَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلۡغُرُورِ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: اعلموا انما الحيوة الدنيا لعب ولهو وزينة وتفاخر بينكم وتكاثر في الامول والاولد كمثل غيث اعجب الكفار نباته ثم يهيج فتريه مصفرا ثم يكون حطما وفي الاخرة عذاب شديد ومغفرة من الله ورضون وما الحيوة الدنيا الا متع الغرور
ayahs.translation: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose [resulting] plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes [scattered] debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allāh and approval. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.
ayahs.transliteration: i-la-mooo an-na-mal hayaa-tud du-nyaa lai-bunw wa-lah-wunw wazee-na-tunw wa-ta-faa-khu-rum bai-na-kum wa-ta-kaa-su-run fil am-waa-li wa-law-laad ka-ma-sa-li ghai-sin a-ja-bal kuf-faa-ra na-baa-tu-hoo sum-ma ya-hee-ju fa-ta-raa-hu mus-faa-ran sum-ma ya-koo-nu hu-taa-maa wa-fil aa-khi-ra-ti a-zaa-bun shadee-dunw wa-mag-hfi-ra-tum mi-nal laa-hi wa-rid-waan wa-mal haiyaa tud-du-nyaaa il-laa ma-taaul ghu-roor

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَابِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَغۡفِرَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرۡضُهَا كَعَرۡضِ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أُعِدَّتۡ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤۡتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلۡفَضۡلِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: سابقوا الي مغفرة من ربكم وجنة عرضها كعرض السماء والارض اعدت للذين ءامنوا بالله ورسله ذلك فضل الله يؤتيه من يشاء والله ذو الفضل العظيم
ayahs.translation: Race [i.e., compete] toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allāh and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allāh which He gives to whom He wills, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.
ayahs.transliteration: saa-bi-qooo i-laa mag-hfi-ra-tim mir rab-bi-kum wa-jan-na-tin ar-du-haa kaar-dis sa-maaai wa-lar-di u-i-ddat lil-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo bil-laa-hi wa-ru-su-lih zaa-li-ka fad-lul laa-hi yu-tee-hi ma-ny ya-shaaa wal-laa-hu zul fad-lil azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ إِلَّا فِي كِتَٰبٖ مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن نَّبۡرَأَهَآۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٞ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: ما اصاب من مصيبة في الارض ولا في انفسكم الا في كتب من قبل ان نبراها ان ذلك علي الله يسير
ayahs.translation: No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allāh, is easy -
ayahs.transliteration: maaa a-saa-ba min musee-ba-tin fil ar-di wa-laa feee an-fu-si-kum il-laa fee ki-taa-bim min qab-li an nab-raa-haa in-naa zaa-li-ka a-lal laa-hi ya-seer

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِّكَيۡلَا تَأۡسَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَفۡرَحُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخۡتَالٖ فَخُورٍ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: لكيلا تاسوا علي ما فاتكم ولا تفرحوا بما ءاتيكم والله لا يحب كل مختال فخور
ayahs.translation: In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult [in pride] over what He has given you. And Allāh does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful -
ayahs.transliteration: li-kai-laa ta-saw a-laa maa faa-ta-kum wa-laa taf-ra-hoo bi-maaa aa-taa-kum wal-laa-hu laa yu-hib-bu kul-la muk-htaa-lin fa-khoor

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَبۡخَلُونَ وَيَأۡمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلۡبُخۡلِۗ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: الذين يبخلون ويامرون الناس بالبخل ومن يتول فان الله هو الغني الحميد
ayahs.translation: [Those] who are stingy and enjoin upon people stinginess. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zeee-na yab-kha-loo-na wayaa-mu-roo-nan naa-sa bil-bukhl wa-ma-ny ya-ta-wal-la fain-nal laa-ha hu-wal gha-niyyul hameed

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلَنَا بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَأَنزَلۡنَا مَعَهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ ٱلنَّاسُ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِۖ وَأَنزَلۡنَا ٱلۡحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأۡسٞ شَدِيدٞ وَمَنَٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعۡلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥ وَرُسُلَهُۥ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٞ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: لقد ارسلنا رسلنا بالبينت وانزلنا معهم الكتب والميزان ليقوم الناس بالقسط وانزلنا الحديد فيه باس شديد ومنفع للناس وليعلم الله من ينصره ورسله بالغيب ان الله قوي عزيز
ayahs.translation: We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance that the people may maintain [their affairs] in justice. And We sent down iron, wherein is great military might and benefits for the people, and so that Allāh may make evident those who support Him and His messengers unseen. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
ayahs.transliteration: la-qad ar-sal-naa ru-su-la-naa bil-baiyi-naa-ti waan-zal-naa maa-hu-mul ki-taa-ba wal-mee-zaa-na liya-qoo-man naa-su bil-qist waan-zal-nal hadee-da fee-hi baa-sun shadee-dunw wa-ma-naa-fiu lin-naa-si wa-liya-la-mal laa-hu ma-ny yan-su-ru-hoo wa-ru-su-la-hoo bil-ghaib in-nal laa-ha qa-wiyyun azeez

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحٗا وَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلۡكِتَٰبَۖ فَمِنۡهُم مُّهۡتَدٖۖ وَكَثِيرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَٰسِقُونَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد ارسلنا نوحا وابرهيم وجعلنا في ذريتهما النبوة والكتب فمنهم مهتد وكثير منهم فسقون
ayahs.translation: And We have already sent Noah and Abraham and placed in their descendants prophethood and scripture; and among them is he who is guided, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad ar-sal-naa noo-hanw waib-raa-hee-ma wa-jaal-naa fee zur-riyya-ti-hi-man nu-buw-wa-ta wal-ki-taa-ba fa-mi-nhum muh-tad wa-ka-see-rum mi-nhum faa-si-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ قَفَّيۡنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيۡنَا بِعِيسَى ٱبۡنِ مَرۡيَمَ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡإِنجِيلَۖ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ رَأۡفَةٗ وَرَحۡمَةٗۚ وَرَهۡبَانِيَّةً ٱبۡتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبۡنَٰهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ إِلَّا ٱبۡتِغَآءَ رِضۡوَٰنِ ٱللَّهِ فَمَا رَعَوۡهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَاۖ فَـَٔاتَيۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ أَجۡرَهُمۡۖ وَكَثِيرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَٰسِقُونَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: ثم قفينا علي ءاثرهم برسلنا وقفينا بعيسي ابن مريم وءاتينه الانجيل وجعلنا في قلوب الذين اتبعوه رافة ورحمة ورهبانية ابتدعوها ما كتبنها عليهم الا ابتغاء رضون الله فما رعوها حق رعايتها فاتينا الذين ءامنوا منهم اجرهم وكثير منهم فسقون
ayahs.translation: Then We sent following their footsteps [i.e., traditions] Our messengers and followed [them] with Jesus, the son of Mary, and gave him the Gospel. And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except [that they did so] seeking the approval of Allāh. But they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave the ones who believed among them their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma qaf-fai-naa a-laa aa-saa-ri-him bi-ru-su-li-naa wa-qaf-fai-naa biee-sab ni ma-rya-ma waaa-tai-naa-hul in-jee-la wa-jaal-naa fee qu-loo-bil lazee-nat ta-baoo-hu ra-fa-tanw wa-rah-ma-tanw rah-baa-niyya-tan ib-ta-daoo-ha maa ka-tab-naa-haa a-lai-him il-lab ti-ghaaaa rid-waa-nil laa-hi fa-maa raa-whaa haq-qa ri-a-aya-ti-haa faaa-tai-nal lazee-na aa-ma-noo mi-nhum aj-ra-hum wa-ka-see-rum mi-nhum faa-si-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَءَامِنُواْ بِرَسُولِهِۦ يُؤۡتِكُمۡ كِفۡلَيۡنِ مِن رَّحۡمَتِهِۦ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ نُورٗا تَمۡشُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: يايها الذين ءامنوا اتقوا الله وءامنوا برسوله يؤتكم كفلين من رحمته ويجعل لكم نورا تمشون به ويغفر لكم والله غفور رحيم
ayahs.translation: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and believe in His Messenger; He will [then] give you a double portion of His mercy and make for you a light by which you will walk and forgive you; and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayyu-hal lazee-na aa-maa-nut ta-qul laa-ha waaa-mi-noo bi-ra-soo-lihee yu-ti-kum kif-lai-ni mir rah-ma-tihee waya-jal la-kum noo-ran tam-shoo-na bihee wayag-hfir la-kum wal-laa-hu gha-foo-rur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِّئَلَّا يَعۡلَمَ أَهۡلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ أَلَّا يَقۡدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ مِّن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلۡفَضۡلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤۡتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلۡفَضۡلِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: لئلا يعلم اهل الكتب الا يقدرون علي شيء من فضل الله وان الفضل بيد الله يؤتيه من يشاء والله ذو الفضل العظيم
ayahs.translation: [This is] so that the People of the Scripture may know that they are not able [to obtain] anything from the bounty of Allāh and that [all] bounty is in the hand of Allāh; He gives it to whom He wills. And Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.
ayahs.transliteration: li-a-lla ya-la-ma ah-lul ki-taa-bi al-laa yaq-di-roo-na a-laa shaiin min fad-lil laa-hi waan-nal fad-la biya-dil laa-hi yu-tee-hi ma-ny ya-shaaa wal-laa-hu zul fa-di-lil azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَدۡ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوۡلَ ٱلَّتِي تُجَٰدِلُكَ فِي زَوۡجِهَا وَتَشۡتَكِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسۡمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٌ ١
ayahs.text_simple: قد سمع الله قول التي تجدلك في زوجها وتشتكي الي الله والله يسمع تحاوركما ان الله سميع بصير
ayahs.translation: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
ayahs.transliteration: qad sa-mi-al laa-hu qaw-lal latee tu-jaa-di-lu-ka fee zaw-ji-haa wa-tas-hta-keee i-lal laa-hi wal-laa-hu yas-mau ta-haa-wu-ra-ku-maa in-nal laa-ha samee-um baseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَٰتِهِمۡۖ إِنۡ أُمَّهَٰتُهُمۡ إِلَّا ٱلَّٰٓـِٔي وَلَدۡنَهُمۡۚ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَزُورٗاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٞ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: الذين يظهرون منكم من نسائهم ما هن امهتهم ان امهتهم الا الي ولدنهم وانهم ليقولون منكرا من القول وزورا وان الله لعفو غفور
ayahs.translation: Those who pronounce ẓihār among you [to separate] from their wives - they are not [consequently] their mothers. Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood. But indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na yu-zaa-hi-roo-na min-kum min ni-saaai-him maa hun-naa um-ma-haa-ti-him in um-ma-haa-tu-hum il-lal laaaee wa-lad-na-hum wain-naa-hum laya-qoo-loo-na mun-ka-ram mi-nal qaw-li wa-zoo-raa wain-nal laa-ha laa-fuw-wun gha-foor

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمۡ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُواْ فَتَحۡرِيرُ رَقَبَةٖ مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّاۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِۦۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: والذين يظهرون من نسائهم ثم يعودون لما قالوا فتحرير رقبة من قبل ان يتماسا ذلكم توعظون به والله بما تعملون خبير
ayahs.translation: And those who pronounce ẓihār from their wives and then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. That is what you are admonished thereby; and Allāh is Aware of what you do.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na yu-zaa-hi-roo-na min ni-saaai-him sum-ma yaoo-doo-na li-maa qaa-loo fa-tah-ree-ru ra-qa-ba-tim min qab-li a-ny ya-ta-maaas-saa zaa-li-kum too-a-zoo-na bih wal-laa-hu bi-maa ta-ma-loo-na khabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَن لَّمۡ يَجِدۡ فَصِيَامُ شَهۡرَيۡنِ مُتَتَابِعَيۡنِ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّاۖ فَمَن لَّمۡ يَسۡتَطِعۡ فَإِطۡعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسۡكِينٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦۚ وَتِلۡكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِۗ وَلِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: فمن لم يجد فصيام شهرين متتابعين من قبل ان يتماسا فمن لم يستطع فاطعام ستين مسكينا ذلك لتؤمنوا بالله ورسوله وتلك حدود الله وللكفرين عذاب اليم
ayahs.translation: And he who does not find [a slave] - then a fast for two months consecutively before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons. That is for you to believe [completely] in Allāh and His Messenger; and those are the limits [set by] Allāh. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-mal lam ya-jid fa-siyaa-mu shah-rai-ni mu-ta-taa-bi-a-y-ni min qab-li a-ny ya-ta-maaas-saa fa-mal lam yas-ta-ti fai-taa-mu sit-tee-na mis-kee-na zaa-li-ka li-tu-mi-noo bil-laa-hi wa-ra-soo-lih-wa til-ka hu-doo-dul laah wa-lil-kaa-fi-ree-na a-zaa-bun aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ كُبِتُواْ كَمَا كُبِتَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ وَقَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَآ ءَايَٰتِۭ بَيِّنَٰتٖۚ وَلِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين يحادون الله ورسوله كبتوا كما كبت الذين من قبلهم وقد انزلنا ءايت بينت وللكفرين عذاب مهين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who oppose Allāh and His Messenger are abased as those before them were abased. And We have certainly sent down verses of clear evidence. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment
