ayahs.translation: O Prophet, when you [Muslims] divorce women, divorce them for [the commencement of] their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period, and fear Allāh, your Lord. Do not turn them out of their [husbands'] houses, nor should they [themselves] leave [during that period] unless they are committing a clear immorality. And those are the limits [set by] Allāh. And whoever transgresses the limits of Allāh has certainly wronged himself. You know not; perhaps Allāh will bring about after that a [different] matter.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayyu-han na-biyyu i-zaa tal-laq-tum-mun ni-saaaa fa-tal-li-qoo-hun-na liid-da-ti-hin-na waah-sul id-da-ta wat-ta-qul laa-ha rab-ba-kum laa tuk-hri-joo-hun-na min buyoo-ti-hin-na wa-laa yak-hruj-na il-laaa a-ny ya-tee-na bi-faa-hi-sha-tim mu-baiyi-nah wa-til-ka hu-doo-dul laah wa-ma-ny ya-taad-da hu-doo-dal laa-hi fa-qad za-la-ma naf-sah laa tad-ree laal-lal laa-ha yuh-di-su ba-da zaa-li-ka am-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا بَلَغۡنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمۡسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعۡرُوفٍ أَوۡ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعۡرُوفٖ وَأَشۡهِدُواْ ذَوَيۡ عَدۡلٖ مِّنكُمۡ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَ لِلَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مَخۡرَجٗا ٢
ayahs.text_simple: فاذا بلغن اجلهن فامسكوهن بمعروف او فارقوهن بمعروف واشهدوا ذوي عدل منكم واقيموا الشهدة لله ذلكم يوعظ به من كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الاخر ومن يتق الله يجعل له مخرجا
ayahs.translation: And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allāh. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allāh and the Last Day. And whoever fears Allāh - He will make for him a way out
ayahs.transliteration: fai-zaa ba-lag-hna a-ja-la-hun-na faam-si-koo-hun-na bi-ma-roo-fin aw faa-ri-qoo-hun-na bi-ma-roo-finw waas-hhi-doo za-wai ad-lim min-kum waaqee-mush sha-haa-da-ta lil-laah zaa-li-kum yoo-a-zu bihee man kaa-na yu-mi-nu bil-laa-hi wa-lyaw-mil aa-khir wa-ma-ny yat-ta-qil laa-ha ya-jal la-hoo mak-hra-jaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَرۡزُقۡهُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَحۡتَسِبُۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسۡبُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمۡرِهِۦۚ قَدۡ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدۡرٗا ٣
ayahs.text_simple: ويرزقه من حيث لا يحتسب ومن يتوكل علي الله فهو حسبه ان الله بلغ امره قد جعل الله لكل شيء قدرا
ayahs.translation: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allāh - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allāh will accomplish His purpose. Allāh has already set for everything a [decreed] extent.
ayahs.transliteration: wayar-zu-qhu min hai-su laa yah-ta-sib wa-ma-ny ya-ta-wak-kal a-lal laa-hi fa-hu-wa has-buh in-nal laa-ha baa-li-ghu am-rih qad jaa-lal laa-hu li-kul-li shaiin qad-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔي يَئِسۡنَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمۡ إِنِ ٱرۡتَبۡتُمۡ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَٰثَةُ أَشۡهُرٖ وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔي لَمۡ يَحِضۡنَۚ وَأُوْلَٰتُ ٱلۡأَحۡمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعۡنَ حَمۡلَهُنَّۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ يُسۡرٗا ٤
ayahs.text_simple: والي يئسن من المحيض من نسائكم ان ارتبتم فعدتهن ثلثة اشهر والي لم يحضن واولت الاحمال اجلهن ان يضعن حملهن ومن يتق الله يجعل له من امره يسرا
ayahs.translation: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth. And whoever fears Allāh - He will make for him of his matter ease.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-laaaee yais-na mi-nal mahee-di min ni-saaai-kum i-nir tab-tum faid-da-tu-hun-na sa-laa-sa-tu as-hhu-rinw wal-laaaee lam ya-hidn wau-laa-tul ah-maa-li a-ja-lu-hun-na a-ny ya-da-na ham-la-hun wa-ma-ny yat-ta-qil laa-ha ya-jal la-hoo min am-rihee yus-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡكُمۡۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرۡ عَنۡهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعۡظِمۡ لَهُۥٓ أَجۡرًا ٥
ayahs.text_simple: ذلك امر الله انزله اليكم ومن يتق الله يكفر عنه سياته ويعظم له اجرا
ayahs.translation: That is the command of Allāh, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allāh - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.
ayahs.transliteration: zaa-li-ka am-rul laa-hi an-za-la-hoo i-lai-kum wa-ma-ny yat-ta-qil laa-ha yu-kaf-fir a-nhu saiyi-a-a-tihee wayu-zim la-hoo aj-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَسۡكِنُوهُنَّ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجۡدِكُمۡ وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُواْ عَلَيۡهِنَّۚ وَإِن كُنَّ أُوْلَٰتِ حَمۡلٖ فَأَنفِقُواْ عَلَيۡهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعۡنَ حَمۡلَهُنَّۚ فَإِنۡ أَرۡضَعۡنَ لَكُمۡ فَـَٔاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَأۡتَمِرُواْ بَيۡنَكُم بِمَعۡرُوفٖۖ وَإِن تَعَاسَرۡتُمۡ فَسَتُرۡضِعُ لَهُۥٓ أُخۡرَىٰ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: اسكنوهن من حيث سكنتم من وجدكم ولا تضاروهن لتضيقوا عليهن وان كن اولت حمل فانفقوا عليهن حتي يضعن حملهن فان ارضعن لكم فاتوهن اجورهن واتمروا بينكم بمعروف وان تعاسرتم فسترضع له اخري
ayahs.translation: Lodge them [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them. And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for him [i.e., the father] another woman.
ayahs.transliteration: as-ki-noo-hun-na min hai-su sa-kan-tum minw wuj-di-kum wa-laa tu-daaar-roo-hun-na li-tu-daiyi-qoo a-lai-hinn wain kun-na u-laa-ti ham-lin faan-fi-qoo a-lai-hin-na hat-taa ya-da-na ham-la-hunn fain ar-da-na la-kum faaa-too-hun-na u-joo-ra-hunn wa-ta-mi-roo bai-na-kum bi-ma-roo-finw wain taaa-sar-tum fa-sa-tur-diu la-hooo uk-hraa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِيُنفِقۡ ذُو سَعَةٖ مِّن سَعَتِهِۦۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقُهُۥ فَلۡيُنفِقۡ مِمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُۚ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا مَآ ءَاتَىٰهَاۚ سَيَجۡعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بَعۡدَ عُسۡرٖ يُسۡرٗا ٧
ayahs.text_simple: لينفق ذو سعة من سعته ومن قدر عليه رزقه فلينفق مما ءاتيه الله لا يكلف الله نفسا الا ما ءاتيها سيجعل الله بعد عسر يسرا
ayahs.translation: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allāh has given him. Allāh does not charge a soul except [according to] what He has given it. Allāh will bring about, after hardship, ease [i.e., relief].
ayahs.transliteration: liyun-fiq zoo saa-tim min saa-tih wa-man qu-di-ra a-lai-hi riz-qu-hoo fa-lyun-fiq mim-maaa aa-taa-hul laah laa yu-kal-li-ful laa-hu naf-san il-laa maaa aa-taa-haa saya-ja-lul laa-hu ba-da us-ri-ny yus-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ عَتَتۡ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِۦ فَحَاسَبۡنَٰهَا حِسَابٗا شَدِيدٗا وَعَذَّبۡنَٰهَا عَذَابٗا نُّكۡرٗا ٨
ayahs.text_simple: وكاين من قرية عتت عن امر ربها ورسله فحاسبنها حسابا شديدا وعذبنها عذابا نكرا
ayahs.translation: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kaayyim min qa-rya-tin a-tat an am-ri rab-bi-haa wa-ru-su-lihee fa-haa-sab-naa-haa hi-saa-ban shadee-danw waaz-zab-naa-haa a-zaa-ban nuk-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَذَاقَتۡ وَبَالَ أَمۡرِهَا وَكَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ أَمۡرِهَا خُسۡرًا ٩
ayahs.text_simple: فذاقت وبال امرها وكان عقبة امرها خسرا
ayahs.translation: And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair [i.e., rebellion], and the outcome of its affair was loss.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-zaa-qat wab-ba-la am-ri-haa wa-kaa-na aa-qi-ba-tu am-ri-haa khus-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٗا شَدِيدٗاۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ يَٰٓأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۚ قَدۡ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيۡكُمۡ ذِكۡرٗا ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: اعد الله لهم عذابا شديدا فاتقوا الله ياولي الالبب الذين ءامنوا قد انزل الله اليكم ذكرا
ayahs.translation: Allāh has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allāh, O you of understanding who have believed. Allāh has sent down to you a message [i.e., the Qur’ān].
ayahs.transliteration: aad-dal laa-hu la-hum a-zaa-ban shadee-dan fat-ta-qul laa-ha yaaau-lil al-baab al-la-zee-na aam-ma-noo qad an-za-lal laa-hu i-lai-kum zik-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَّسُولٗا يَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَٰتٖ لِّيُخۡرِجَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِۚ وَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحٗا يُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ قَدۡ أَحۡسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ رِزۡقًا ١١
ayahs.text_simple: رسولا يتلوا عليكم ءايت الله مبينت ليخرج الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت من الظلمت الي النور ومن يؤمن بالله ويعمل صلحا يدخله جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها ابدا قد احسن الله له رزقا
ayahs.translation: [He sent] a Messenger [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] reciting to you the distinct verses of Allāh that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light. And whoever believes in Allāh and does righteousness - He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever. Allāh will have perfected for him a provision.
ayahs.transliteration: ra-soo-la-ny yat-loo a-lai-kum aayaa-til laa-hi mu-baiyi-naa-til liyuk-hri-jal lazee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti mi-naz zu-lu-maa-ti i-lan noor wa-ma-ny yu-min bil-laa-hi waya-mal saa-li-ha-ny yud-khi-lhu jan-naa-tin taj-ree min tah-ti-hal a-nhaa-ru khaa-li-dee-na fee-haa a-ba-daa qad ah-sa-nal laa-hu la-hoo riz-qaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِثۡلَهُنَّۖ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ بَيۡنَهُنَّ لِتَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدۡ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمَۢا ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: الله الذي خلق سبع سموت ومن الارض مثلهن يتنزل الامر بينهن لتعلموا ان الله علي كل شيء قدير وان الله قد احاط بكل شيء علما
ayahs.translation: It is Allāh who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them. [His] command descends among them so you may know that Allāh is over all things competent and that Allāh has encompassed all things in knowledge.
ayahs.transliteration: al-laa-hul lazee kha-la-qa sa-ba sa-maa-waa-tinw wa-mi-nal ar-di mis-la-hun-na ya-ta-naz-za-lul am-ru bai-na-hun-na li-ta-la-mooo an-nal laa-ha a-laa kul-li shaiin qadee-runw waan-nal laa-ha qad a-haa-ta bi-kul-li shaiin il-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكَۖ تَبۡتَغِي مَرۡضَاتَ أَزۡوَٰجِكَۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ ١
ayahs.text_simple: يايها النبي لم تحرم ما احل الله لك تبتغي مرضات ازوجك والله غفور رحيم
ayahs.translation: O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what Allāh has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayyu-han na-biyyu li-ma tu-har-ri-mu maaa a-hal-lal laa-hu la-ka tab-ta-ghee mar-daa-ta az-waa-jik wal-laa-hu gha-foo-rur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَدۡ فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ تَحِلَّةَ أَيۡمَٰنِكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: قد فرض الله لكم تحلة ايمنكم والله موليكم وهو العليم الحكيم
ayahs.translation: Allāh has already ordained for you [Muslims] the dissolution of your oaths. And Allāh is your protector, and He is the Knowing, the Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: qad fa-ra-dal laa-hu la-kum ta-hil-la-ta ay-maa-ni-kum wal-laa-hu maw-laa-kum wa-hu-wal alee-mul hakeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذۡ أَسَرَّ ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضِ أَزۡوَٰجِهِۦ حَدِيثٗا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتۡ بِهِۦ وَأَظۡهَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِ عَرَّفَ بَعۡضَهُۥ وَأَعۡرَضَ عَنۢ بَعۡضٖۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِۦ قَالَتۡ مَنۡ أَنۢبَأَكَ هَٰذَاۖ قَالَ نَبَّأَنِيَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: واذ اسر النبي الي بعض ازوجه حديثا فلما نبات به واظهره الله عليه عرف بعضه واعرض عن بعض فلما نباها به قالت من انباك هذا قال نباني العليم الخبير
ayahs.translation: And [remember] when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement; and when she informed [another] of it and Allāh showed it to him, he made known part of it and ignored a part. And when he informed her about it, she said, "Who told you this?" He said, "I was informed by the Knowing, the Aware."
ayahs.transliteration: waiz a-sar-ran na-biyyu i-laa ba-di az-waa-jihee hadee-san fa-lam-maa nab-baat bihee waa-zha-ra-hul laa-hu a-lai-hi ar-ra-fa ba-da-hoo waa-ra-da am ba-din fa-lam-maa nab-baa-haa bihee qaa-lat man am-baa-ka haa-za qaa-la nab-baa-niyal alee-mul khabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِن تَتُوبَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ فَقَدۡ صَغَتۡ قُلُوبُكُمَاۖ وَإِن تَظَٰهَرَا عَلَيۡهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ مَوۡلَىٰهُ وَجِبۡرِيلُ وَصَٰلِحُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَۖ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان تتوبا الي الله فقد صغت قلوبكما وان تظهرا عليه فان الله هو موليه وجبريل وصلح المؤمنين والملئكة بعد ذلك ظهير
ayahs.translation: If you two [wives] repent to Allāh, [it is best], for your hearts have deviated. But if you cooperate against him - then indeed Allāh is his protector, and Gabriel and the righteous of the believers and the angels, moreover, are [his] assistants.
ayahs.transliteration: in ta-too-baaa i-lal laa-hi fa-qad sa-ghat qu-loo-bu-ku-maa wain ta-zaa-ha-raa a-lai-hi fain-nal laa-ha hu-wa maw-laa-hu wa-jib-ree-lu wa-saa-li-hul mu-mineen wal-ma-laaai-ka-tu ba-da zaa-li-ka zaheer

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُۥٓ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبۡدِلَهُۥٓ أَزۡوَٰجًا خَيۡرٗا مِّنكُنَّ مُسۡلِمَٰتٖ مُّؤۡمِنَٰتٖ قَٰنِتَٰتٖ تَٰٓئِبَٰتٍ عَٰبِدَٰتٖ سَٰٓئِحَٰتٖ ثَيِّبَٰتٖ وَأَبۡكَارٗا ٥
ayahs.text_simple: عسي ربه ان طلقكن ان يبدله ازوجا خيرا منكن مسلمت مؤمنت قنتت تئبت عبدت سئحت ثيبت وابكارا
ayahs.translation: Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to Allāh], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling - [ones] previously married and virgins.
ayahs.transliteration: a-saa rab-bu-hooo in tal-la-qa-kun-na a-ny yub-di-la-hooo az-waa-jan khai-ram min-kun-na mus-li-maa-tim mu-mi-naa-tin qaa-ni-taa-tin taaai-baa-tin aa-bi-daa-tin saaai-haa-tin saiyi-baa-tinw waab-kaa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ قُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيكُمۡ نَارٗا وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلۡحِجَارَةُ عَلَيۡهَا مَلَٰٓئِكَةٌ غِلَاظٞ شِدَادٞ لَّا يَعۡصُونَ ٱللَّهَ مَآ أَمَرَهُمۡ وَيَفۡعَلُونَ مَا يُؤۡمَرُونَ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: يايها الذين ءامنوا قوا انفسكم واهليكم نارا وقودها الناس والحجارة عليها ملئكة غلاظ شداد لا يعصون الله ما امرهم ويفعلون ما يؤمرون
ayahs.translation: O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are [appointed] angels, harsh and severe; they do not disobey Allāh in what He commands them but do what they are commanded.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayyu-hal lazee-na aa-ma-noo qooo an-fu-sa-kum waah-lee-kum naa-ranw wa-qoo-du-han naa-su wa-lhi-jaa-ra-tu a-lai-haa ma-laaai-ka-tun ghi-laa-zun shi-daa-dul laa ya-soo-nal laa-ha maa a-ma-ra-hum wayaf a-loo-na maa yu-ma-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَا تَعۡتَذِرُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: يايها الذين كفروا لا تعتذروا اليوم انما تجزون ما كنتم تعملون
ayahs.translation: O you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that Day. You will only be recompensed for what you used to do.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayyu-hal lazee-na ka-fa-roo la ta-ta-zi-rul yaw-ma in-na-maa tuj-zaw-na maa kun-tum ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوۡبَةٗ نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمۡ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمۡ وَيُدۡخِلَكُمۡ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ يَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡزِي ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِيَّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥۖ نُورُهُمۡ يَسۡعَىٰ بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَبِأَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَتۡمِمۡ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: يايها الذين ءامنوا توبوا الي الله توبة نصوحا عسي ربكم ان يكفر عنكم سياتكم ويدخلكم جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر يوم لا يخزي الله النبي والذين ءامنوا معه نورهم يسعي بين ايديهم وبايمنهم يقولون ربنا اتمم لنا نورنا واغفر لنا انك علي كل شيء قدير
ayahs.translation: O you who have believed, repent to Allāh with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow [on] the Day when Allāh will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent."
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayyu-hal lazee-na aa-ma-noo too-booo i-lal laa-hi taw-ba-tan na-soo-han a-saa rab-bu-kum a-ny yu-kaf-fi-ra an-kum sayyi-a-a-ti-kum wayud-khi-la-kum jan-naa-tin taj-ree min tah-ti-hal a-nhaa-ru yaw-ma laa yuk-hzil laa-hun na-biyya wal-la-zee-na aa-ma-noo maa-hoo noo-ru-hum ya-saa bai-na ay-dee-him wa-bi-a-y-maa-ni-him ya-qoo-loo-na rab-ba-naaa at-mim la-naa noo-ra-naa wag-hfir la-na in-na-ka a-laa kul-li shaiin qadeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ جَٰهِدِ ٱلۡكُفَّارَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱغۡلُظۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ وَمَأۡوَىٰهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: يايها النبي جهد الكفار والمنفقين واغلظ عليهم وماويهم جهنم وبئس المصير
ayahs.translation: O Prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayyu-han na-biyyu jaa-hi-dil kuf-faa-ra wal-mu-naa-fi-qee-na wag-hluz a-lai-him wa-ma-waa-hum ja-han-na-mu wa-bi-sal maseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱمۡرَأَتَ نُوحٖ وَٱمۡرَأَتَ لُوطٖۖ كَانَتَا تَحۡتَ عَبۡدَيۡنِ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا صَٰلِحَيۡنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمۡ يُغۡنِيَا عَنۡهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـٔٗا وَقِيلَ ٱدۡخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: ضرب الله مثلا للذين كفروا امرات نوح وامرات لوط كانتا تحت عبدين من عبادنا صلحين فخانتاهما فلم يغنيا عنهما من الله شيا وقيل ادخلا النار مع الدخلين
ayahs.translation: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter."
ayahs.transliteration: da-ra-bal laa-hu ma-sa-lal lil-la-zee-na ka-fa-ru im-raa-ta noo-hinw wam-raa-ta loot kaa-na-taa tah-ta ab-dai-ni min i-baa-di-naa saa-li-hai-ni fa-khaa-na-taa-hu-maa fa-lam yug-hniyaa a-nhu-maa mi-nal laa-hi shai-anw waqee-lad khu-lan naa-ra maad daa-khileen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱمۡرَأَتَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِذۡ قَالَتۡ رَبِّ ٱبۡنِ لِي عِندَكَ بَيۡتٗا فِي ٱلۡجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: وضرب الله مثلا للذين ءامنوا امرات فرعون اذ قالت رب ابن لي عندك بيتا في الجنة ونجني من فرعون وعمله ونجني من القوم الظلمين
ayahs.translation: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-da-ra-bal laa-hu ma-sa-lal lil-le-zee-na aa-ma-num-ra a-ta fi-rawn iz qaa-lat rab bib-ni lee in-da-ka bai-tan fil jan-na-ti wa-naj-jinee min fi-raw-na waa-ma-lihee wa-naj-jinee mi-nal qaw-miz zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَرۡيَمَ ٱبۡنَتَ عِمۡرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَحۡصَنَتۡ فَرۡجَهَا فَنَفَخۡنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتۡ بِكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتۡ مِنَ ٱلۡقَٰنِتِينَ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: ومريم ابنت عمرن التي احصنت فرجها فنفخنا فيه من روحنا وصدقت بكلمت ربها وكتبه وكانت من القنتين
ayahs.translation: And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of ʿImrān, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ma-rya-mab na-ta im-raa-nal lateee ah-sa-nat far-ja-haa fa-na-fak-hnaa feehee mir roo-hi-naa wa-sad-da-qat bi-ka-li-maa-ti ra-bhi-haa wa-ku-tu-bihee wa-kaa-nat mi-nal qaa-niteen

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ ١
ayahs.text_simple: تبرك الذي بيده الملك وهو علي كل شيء قدير
ayahs.translation: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -
ayahs.transliteration: ta-baa-ra-kal lazee biya-di-hil mul-ku wa-hu-wa a-laa kul-li shaiin qadeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ أَيُّكُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: الذي خلق الموت والحيوة ليبلوكم ايكم احسن عملا وهو العزيز الغفور
ayahs.translation: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee kha-la-qal maw-ta wa-lhayaa-ta liyab-lu-wa-kum ayyu-kum ah-sa-nu a-ma-laa wa-hu-wal azee-zul gha-foor

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ طِبَاقٗاۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٖۖ فَٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ هَلۡ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٖ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: الذي خلق سبع سموت طباقا ما تري في خلق الرحمن من تفوت فارجع البصر هل تري من فطور
ayahs.translation: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee kha-la-qa sa-ba sa-maa-waa-tin ti-baa-qam maa ta-raa fee khal-qir rah-maa-ni min ta-faa-wut far-jiil ba-sa-ra hal ta-raa min fu-toor

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيۡنِ يَنقَلِبۡ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ خَاسِئٗا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٞ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ثم ارجع البصر كرتين ينقلب اليك البصر خاسئا وهو حسير
ayahs.translation: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-mar jiil ba-sa-ra kar-ra-tai-ni yan-qa-lib i-lai-kal ba-sa-ru khaa-si-anw wa-hu-wa haseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا رُجُومٗا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد زينا السماء الدنيا بمصبيح وجعلنها رجوما للشيطين واعتدنا لهم عذاب السعير
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars] and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad zaiyan-nas sa-maaaad du-nyaa bi-ma-saa-bee-ha wa-jaal-naa-haa ru-joo-mal lis-hshayaa-tee-ni waa-tad-naa la-hum a-zaa-bas saeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: وللذين كفروا بربهم عذاب جهنم وبئس المصير
ayahs.translation: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lil-la-zee-na ka-fa-roo bi-rab-bi-him a-zaa-bu ja-han-na-ma wa-bi-sal maseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذَآ أُلۡقُواْ فِيهَا سَمِعُواْ لَهَا شَهِيقٗا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: اذا القوا فيها سمعوا لها شهيقا وهي تفور
ayahs.translation: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.
ayahs.transliteration: i-zaaa ul-qoo fee-haa sa-mioo la-haa shahee-qanw wa-hiya ta-foor

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَيۡظِۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلۡقِيَ فِيهَا فَوۡجٞ سَأَلَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: تكاد تميز من الغيظ كلما القي فيها فوج سالهم خزنتها الم ياتكم نذير
ayahs.translation: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"
ayahs.transliteration: ta-kaa-du ta-mayya-zu mi-nal ghaizz kul-la-maaa ul-qiya fee-haa faw-jun saa-la-hum kha-za-na-tu-haaa a-lam ya-ti-kum nazeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ قَدۡ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٞ فَكَذَّبۡنَا وَقُلۡنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ كَبِيرٖ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا بلي قد جاءنا نذير فكذبنا وقلنا ما نزل الله من شيء ان انتم الا في ضلل كبير
ayahs.translation: They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allāh has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo ba-laa qad jaaaa-naa nazee-run fa-kaz-zab-naa wa-qul-naa maa naz-za-lal laa-hu min shaiin in an-tum il-laa fee da-laa-lin kabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ كُنَّا نَسۡمَعُ أَوۡ نَعۡقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِيٓ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا لو كنا نسمع او نعقل ما كنا في اصحب السعير
ayahs.translation: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-loo law kun-naa nas-mau aw-na qi-lu maa kun-naa feee a-shaa-bis saeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱعۡتَرَفُواْ بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسُحۡقٗا لِّأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: فاعترفوا بذنبهم فسحقا لاصحب السعير
ayahs.translation: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ta-ra-foo bi-zam-bi-him fa-suh-qal li-a-shaa-bis saeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَأَجۡرٞ كَبِيرٞ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين يخشون ربهم بالغيب لهم مغفرة واجر كبير
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na yak-hshaw-na rab-ba-hum bil-ghai-bi la-hum mag-hfi-ra-tunw waaj-run kabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَسِرُّواْ قَوۡلَكُمۡ أَوِ ٱجۡهَرُواْ بِهِۦٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: واسروا قولكم او اجهروا به انه عليم بذات الصدور
ayahs.translation: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
ayahs.transliteration: waa-sir-roo qaw-la-kum a-wi jha-roo bih in-na-hoo alee-mum bi-zaa-tis su-door

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: الا يعلم من خلق وهو اللطيف الخبير
ayahs.translation: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Aware?
ayahs.transliteration: a-laa ya-la-mu man kha-la-qa wa-hu-wal latee-ful khabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ ذَلُولٗا فَٱمۡشُواْ فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُواْ مِن رِّزۡقِهِۦۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: هو الذي جعل لكم الارض ذلولا فامشوا في مناكبها وكلوا من رزقه واليه النشور
ayahs.translation: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.
ayahs.transliteration: hu-wal lazee jaa-la la-ku-mul ar-da za-loo-lan fam-shoo fee ma-naa-ki-bi-haa wa-ku-loo mir riz-qih wai-lai-hin nu-shoor

ayahs.text_uthmani: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخۡسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: ءامنتم من في السماء ان يخسف بكم الارض فاذا هي تمور
ayahs.translation: Do you feel secure that He who is above would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?
ayahs.transliteration: aa-min-tum man fis sa-maaai ai yak-hsi-fa bi-ku-mul ar-da fai-zaa hiya ta-moor

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَاصِبٗاۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ كَيۡفَ نَذِيرِ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: ام امنتم من في السماء ان يرسل عليكم حاصبا فستعلمون كيف نذير
ayahs.translation: Or do you feel secure that He who is above would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.
ayahs.transliteration: am a-min-tum man fis sa-maaai ai yur-si-la a-lai-kum haa-si-ban fa-sa-ta-la-moo-na kai-fa nazeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد كذب الذين من قبلهم فكيف كان نكير
ayahs.translation: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad kaz-za-bal lazee-na min qab-li-him fa-kai-fa kaa-na nakeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلطَّيۡرِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ صَٰٓفَّٰتٖ وَيَقۡبِضۡنَۚ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءِۭ بَصِيرٌ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: اولم يروا الي الطير فوقهم صفت ويقبضن ما يمسكهن الا الرحمن انه بكل شيء بصير
ayahs.translation: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.
ayahs.transliteration: a-wa-lam ya-raw i-lat tai-ri faw-qa-hum saaaf-faa-tinw wayaq-bidn maa yum-si-ku-hun-na il-lar rah-maan in-na-hoo bi-kul-li shaiin baseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمَّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ جُندٞ لَّكُمۡ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ إِنِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: امن هذا الذي هو جند لكم ينصركم من دون الرحمن ان الكفرون الا في غرور
ayahs.translation: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.
ayahs.transliteration: am-man haa-zal lazee hu-wa jun-dul la-kum yan-su-ru-kum min doo-nir rah-maan i-nil kaa-fi-roo-na il-laa fee ghu-roor

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمَّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي يَرۡزُقُكُمۡ إِنۡ أَمۡسَكَ رِزۡقَهُۥۚ بَل لَّجُّواْ فِي عُتُوّٖ وَنُفُورٍ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: امن هذا الذي يرزقكم ان امسك رزقه بل لجوا في عتو ونفور
ayahs.translation: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.
ayahs.transliteration: am-man haa-zal lazee yar-zu-qu-kum in am-sa-ka riz-qah bal laj-joo fee u-tuw-winw wa-nu-foor

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَمَن يَمۡشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِهِۦٓ أَهۡدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمۡشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: افمن يمشي مكبا علي وجهه اهدي امن يمشي سويا علي صرط مستقيم
ayahs.translation: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-mai yam-shee mu-kib-ban a-laa wa-jhihee ah-daaa am-ma-ny yam-shee sa-wiyyan a-laa si-ra-tim mus-taqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَكُمۡ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: قل هو الذي انشاكم وجعل لكم السمع والابصر والافدة قليلا ما تشكرون
ayahs.translation: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful."
ayahs.transliteration: qul hu-wal lazee an-shaa-kum wa-jaa-la la-ku-mus sa-ma wa-lab-saa-ra wa-la-fi-da-ta qalee-lam maa tas-hku-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: قل هو الذي ذراكم في الارض واليه تحشرون
ayahs.translation: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."
ayahs.transliteration: qul hu-wal lazee za-raa-kum fil ar-di wai-lai-hi tuh-sha-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: ويقولون متي هذا الوعد ان كنتم صدقين
ayahs.translation: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
ayahs.transliteration: waya-qoo-loo-na ma-taa haa-zal wa-du in kun-tum saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡعِلۡمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: قل انما العلم عند الله وانما انا نذير مبين
ayahs.translation: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."
ayahs.transliteration: qul in-na-mal il-mu in-dal laa-hi wain-na-maaa a-na nazee-rum mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهُ زُلۡفَةٗ سِيٓـَٔتۡ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: فلما راوه زلفة سيت وجوه الذين كفروا وقيل هذا الذي كنتم به تدعون
ayahs.translation: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-laam-maa raa-whu zul-fa-tan seeeat wu-joo-hul lazee-na ka-fa-roo waqee-la haa-zal lazee kun-tum bihee tad-daoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَهۡلَكَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِيَ أَوۡ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: قل ارءيتم ان اهلكني الله ومن معي او رحمنا فمن يجير الكفرين من عذاب اليم
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered: whether Allāh should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"
ayahs.transliteration: qul a-raay-tum in ah-la-ka niyal laa-hu wa-mam maiya aw ra-hi-ma-naa fa-maiyu-jee-rul kaa-fi-ree-na min a-zaa-bin aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡنَاۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: قل هو الرحمن ءامنا به وعليه توكلنا فستعلمون من هو في ضلل مبين
ayahs.translation: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."
ayahs.transliteration: qul hu-war rah-maa-nu aa-man-naa bihee waa-lai-hi ta-wak-kal-naa fa-sa-ta-la-moo-na man hu-wa fee da-laa-lim mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَصۡبَحَ مَآؤُكُمۡ غَوۡرٗا فَمَن يَأۡتِيكُم بِمَآءٖ مَّعِينِۭ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: قل ارءيتم ان اصبح ماؤكم غورا فمن ياتيكم بماء معين
ayahs.translation: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
ayahs.transliteration: qul a-raay-tum in as-ba-ha maaau-kum ghaw-ran fa-mai ya-tee-kum bi-maaaim maeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: نٓۚ وَٱلۡقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسۡطُرُونَ ١
ayahs.text_simple: ن والقلم وما يسطرون
ayahs.translation: Nūn. By the pen and what they inscribe,
ayahs.transliteration: noon wal-qa-la-mi wa-maa yas-tu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجۡنُونٖ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: ما انت بنعمة ربك بمجنون
ayahs.translation: You are not, [O Muḥammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.
ayahs.transliteration: maa an-ta bi-ni-ma-ti rab-bi-ka bi-maj-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجۡرًا غَيۡرَ مَمۡنُونٖ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: وان لك لاجرا غير ممنون
ayahs.translation: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na la-ka laaj-ran ghai-ra mam-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٖ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: وانك لعلي خلق عظيم
ayahs.translation: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na-ka laa-laa khu-lu-qin azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَسَتُبۡصِرُ وَيُبۡصِرُونَ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: فستبصر ويبصرون
ayahs.translation: So you will see and they will see
ayahs.transliteration: fa-sa-tub-si-ru wayub-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلۡمَفۡتُونُ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: باييكم المفتون
ayahs.translation: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].
ayahs.transliteration: bi-a-yyi-ku-mul maf-toon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان ربك هو اعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله وهو اعلم بالمهتدين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa rab-ba-ka hu-wa a-la-mu bi-man dal-la an sabee-lihee wa-hu-wa a-la-mu bil-muh-tadeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: فلا تطع المكذبين
ayahs.translation: Then do not obey the deniers.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-laa tu-tiil mu-kaz-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَدُّواْ لَوۡ تُدۡهِنُ فَيُدۡهِنُونَ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: ودوا لو تدهن فيدهنون
ayahs.translation: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].
ayahs.transliteration: wad-doo law tu-dhi-nu fayu-dhi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِعۡ كُلَّ حَلَّافٖ مَّهِينٍ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: ولا تطع كل حلاف مهين
ayahs.translation: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa tu-ti kul-la hal-laa-fim maheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَمَّازٖ مَّشَّآءِۭ بِنَمِيمٖ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: هماز مشاء بنميم
ayahs.translation: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -
ayahs.transliteration: ham-maa-zim mas-hshaaaim bi-nameem

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَّنَّاعٖ لِّلۡخَيۡرِ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: مناع للخير معتد اثيم
ayahs.translation: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,
ayahs.transliteration: man-naail lil-khai-ri mu-ta-din aseem

ayahs.text_uthmani: عُتُلِّۭ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: عتل بعد ذلك زنيم
ayahs.translation: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.
ayahs.transliteration: u-tul-lim ba-da zaa-li-ka zaneem

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٖ وَبَنِينَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان كان ذا مال وبنين
ayahs.translation: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,
ayahs.transliteration: an kaa-na zaa maa-lin-wwa baneen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: اذا تتلي عليه ءايتنا قال اسطير الاولين
ayahs.translation: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
ayahs.transliteration: i-zaa tut-laa a-lai-hi aayaa-tu-naa qaa-la a-saa-tee-rul aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلۡخُرۡطُومِ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: سنسمه علي الخرطوم
ayahs.translation: We will brand him upon the snout.
ayahs.transliteration: sa-na-si-mu-hoo a-lal khur-toom

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا بَلَوۡنَٰهُمۡ كَمَا بَلَوۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ إِذۡ أَقۡسَمُواْ لَيَصۡرِمُنَّهَا مُصۡبِحِينَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: انا بلونهم كما بلونا اصحب الجنة اذ اقسموا ليصرمنها مصبحين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa ba-law-naa-hum ka-maa ba-law-naaa a-shaa-bal jan-na-ti iz aq-sa-moo layas-ri-mun-na-haa mus-biheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا يَسۡتَثۡنُونَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: ولا يستثنون
ayahs.translation: Without making exception.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa yas-tas-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَطَافَ عَلَيۡهَا طَآئِفٞ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمۡ نَآئِمُونَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: فطاف عليها طائف من ربك وهم نائمون
ayahs.translation: So there came upon it [i.e., the garden] an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-taa-fa a-lai-haa taaai-fum mir rab-bi-ka wa-hum naaai-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَصۡبَحَتۡ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: فاصبحت كالصريم
ayahs.translation: And it became as though reaped.
ayahs.transliteration: faas-ba-hat kas-sareem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَتَنَادَوۡاْ مُصۡبِحِينَ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: فتنادوا مصبحين
ayahs.translation: And they called one another at morning,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ta-naa-daw mus-biheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱغۡدُواْ عَلَىٰ حَرۡثِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰرِمِينَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: ان اغدوا علي حرثكم ان كنتم صرمين
ayahs.translation: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
ayahs.transliteration: a-ni ghdoo a-laa har-si-kum in kun-tum saa-rimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱنطَلَقُواْ وَهُمۡ يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: فانطلقوا وهم يتخفتون
ayahs.translation: So they set out, while lowering their voices,
ayahs.transliteration: fan-ta-la-qoo wa-hum ya-ta-khaa-fa-toon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَن لَّا يَدۡخُلَنَّهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّسۡكِينٞ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان لا يدخلنها اليوم عليكم مسكين
ayahs.translation: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
ayahs.transliteration: al laa yad-khu-lan-na-hal yaw-ma a-lai-kum mis-keen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَغَدَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ حَرۡدٖ قَٰدِرِينَ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: وغدوا علي حرد قدرين
ayahs.translation: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-gha-daw a-laa har-din qaa-direen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهَا قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: فلما راوها قالوا انا لضالون
ayahs.translation: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam-maa raa-whaa qaa-looo in-naa la-daaal-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ نَحۡنُ مَحۡرُومُونَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: بل نحن محرومون
ayahs.translation: Rather, we have been deprived."
ayahs.transliteration: bal nah-nu mah-roo-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَوۡسَطُهُمۡ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ لَوۡلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: قال اوسطهم الم اقل لكم لولا تسبحون
ayahs.translation: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allāh]?'"
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la aw-sa-tu-hum a-lam a-qul la-kum law-laa tu-sab-bi-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا سبحن ربنا انا كنا ظلمين
ayahs.translation: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo su-bhaa-na rab-bi-naaa in-naa kun-naa zaa-limeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَلَٰوَمُونَ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: فاقبل بعضهم علي بعض يتلومون
ayahs.translation: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.
ayahs.transliteration: faaq-ba-la ba-du-hum a-laa ba-di-ny ya-ta-laa-wa-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَٰغِينَ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا يويلنا انا كنا طغين
ayahs.translation: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo yaa-wai-la-naaa in-naa kun-naa taa-gheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبۡدِلَنَا خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: عسي ربنا ان يبدلنا خيرا منها انا الي ربنا رغبون
ayahs.translation: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."
ayahs.transliteration: a-saa rab-bu-naaa a-ny yub-di-la-naa khai-ram mi-nhaaa in-naaa i-laa rab-bi-naa raa-ghi-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡعَذَابُۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: كذلك العذاب ولعذاب الاخرة اكبر لو كانوا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
ayahs.transliteration: ka-zaa-li-kal a-zaab wa-laa-zaa-bul aa-khi-ra-ti ak-bar law kaa-noo ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان للمتقين عند ربهم جنت النعيم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na lil-mut-ta-qee-na in-da rab-bi-him jan-naa-tin naeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَنَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ كَٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: افنجعل المسلمين كالمجرمين
ayahs.translation: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-na-ja-lul mus-li-mee-na kal-muj-rimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ تَحۡكُمُونَ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: ما لكم كيف تحكمون
ayahs.translation: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?
ayahs.transliteration: maa la-kum kai-fa tah-ku-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ كِتَٰبٞ فِيهِ تَدۡرُسُونَ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: ام لكم كتب فيه تدرسون
ayahs.translation: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn
ayahs.transliteration: am la-kum ki-taa-bun fee-hi tad-ru-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَكُمۡ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: ان لكم فيه لما تخيرون
ayahs.translation: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?
ayahs.transliteration: in-na la-kum fee-hi la-maa ta-khaiya-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ أَيۡمَٰنٌ عَلَيۡنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمۡ لَمَا تَحۡكُمُونَ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: ام لكم ايمن علينا بلغة الي يوم القيمة ان لكم لما تحكمون
ayahs.translation: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
ayahs.transliteration: am la-kum ay-maa-nun a-lai-naa baa-li-gha-tun i-laa yaw-mil qiyaa-ma-ti in-na la-kum la-maa tah-ku-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَلۡهُمۡ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: سلهم ايهم بذلك زعيم
ayahs.translation: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.
ayahs.transliteration: sa-lhum ayyu-hum bi-zaa-li-ka zaeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شُرَكَآءُ فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمۡ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: ام لهم شركاء فلياتوا بشركائهم ان كانوا صدقين
ayahs.translation: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.
ayahs.transliteration: am la-hum shu-ra-kaaau fa-lya-too bi-shu-ra-kaaai-him in kaa-noo saa-diqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يُكۡشَفُ عَن سَاقٖ وَيُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: يوم يكشف عن ساق ويدعون الي السجود فلا يستطيعون
ayahs.translation: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but they [i.e., the disbelievers] will not be able,
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma yuk-sha-fu an saa-qinw wayu-daw-na i-las su-joo-di fa-laa yas-ta-tee-o-on

ayahs.text_uthmani: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةٞۖ وَقَدۡ كَانُواْ يُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمۡ سَٰلِمُونَ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: خشعة ابصرهم ترهقهم ذلة وقد كانوا يدعون الي السجود وهم سلمون
ayahs.translation: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.
ayahs.transliteration: khaa-shi-a-tan ab-saa-ru-hum ta-rha-qu-hum zil-la-tunw wa-qad kaa-noo yu-daw-na i-las su-joo-di wa-hum saa-li-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَذَرۡنِي وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِۖ سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُهُم مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: فذرني ومن يكذب بهذا الحديث سنستدرجهم من حيث لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation: So leave Me, [O Muḥammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies this statement [i.e., the Qur’ān]. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-zar-nee wa-ma-ny yu-kaz-zi-bu bi-haa-zal hadee-si sa-nas-tad-ri-ju-hum min hai-su laa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأُمۡلِي لَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ كَيۡدِي مَتِينٌ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: واملي لهم ان كيدي متين
ayahs.translation: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
ayahs.transliteration: waum-lee la-hum in-na kaidee mateen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمٖ مُّثۡقَلُونَ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: ام تسلهم اجرا فهم من مغرم مثقلون
ayahs.translation: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
ayahs.transliteration: am ta-sa-lu-hum aj-ran fa-hum min mag-hra-min mus-qa-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: ام عندهم الغيب فهم يكتبون
ayahs.translation: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
ayahs.transliteration: am in-da-hu-mul ghai-bu fa-hum yak-tu-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلۡحُوتِ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكۡظُومٞ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: فاصبر لحكم ربك ولا تكن كصاحب الحوت اذ نادي وهو مكظوم
ayahs.translation: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muḥammad], and be not like the companion of the fish [i.e., Jonah] when he called out while he was distressed.
ayahs.transliteration: fas-bir li-huk-mi rab-bi-ka wa-laa ta-kun ka-saa-hi-bil hoot iz naa-daa wa-hu-wa mak-zoom

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّوۡلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعۡمَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذۡمُومٞ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: لولا ان تدركه نعمة من ربه لنبذ بالعراء وهو مذموم
ayahs.translation: If not that a favor [i.e., mercy] from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
ayahs.transliteration: law-laaa an ta-daa-ra-ka-hoo ni-ma-tum mir rab-bihee la-nu-bi-za bi-la-raaai wa-hu-wa maz-moom

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱجۡتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: فاجتبه ربه فجعله من الصلحين
ayahs.translation: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: faj-ta-baa-hu rab-bu-hoo fa-jaa-la-hoo mi-nas saa-liheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزۡلِقُونَكَ بِأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجۡنُونٞ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: وان يكاد الذين كفروا ليزلقونك بابصرهم لما سمعوا الذكر ويقولون انه لمجنون
ayahs.translation: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes [i.e., looks] when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."
ayahs.transliteration: wai-ny ya-kaa-dul lazee-na ka-fa-roo layuz-li-qoo-na-ka bi-a-bsaa-ri-him lam-maa sa-miuz zik-ra waya-qoo-loo-na in-na-hoo la-maj-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: وما هو الا ذكر للعلمين
ayahs.translation: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa hu-wa il-laa zik-rul li-laa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلۡحَآقَّةُ ١
ayahs.text_simple: الحاقة
ayahs.translation: The Inevitable Reality -
ayahs.transliteration: a-lhaaaq-qah

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا ٱلۡحَآقَّةُ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: ما الحاقة
ayahs.translation: What is the Inevitable Reality?
ayahs.transliteration: mal haaaq-qah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡحَآقَّةُ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: وما ادريك ما الحاقة
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa ad-raa-ka mal haaaq-qah

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ وَعَادُۢ بِٱلۡقَارِعَةِ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: كذبت ثمود وعاد بالقارعة
ayahs.translation: Thamūd and ʿAad denied the Striking Calamity [i.e., the Resurrection].
ayahs.transliteration: kaz-za-bat sa-moo-du waaa-dum bil-qaa-ri-ah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهۡلِكُواْ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: فاما ثمود فاهلكوا بالطاغية
ayahs.translation: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].
ayahs.transliteration: faam-maa sa-moo-du fauh-li-koo bit-taa-ghiyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا عَادٞ فَأُهۡلِكُواْ بِرِيحٖ صَرۡصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٖ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: واما عاد فاهلكوا بريح صرصر عاتية
ayahs.translation: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
ayahs.transliteration: waam-maa aa-dun fauh-li-koo biree-hin sar-sa-rin aa-tiyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبۡعَ لَيَالٖ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومٗاۖ فَتَرَى ٱلۡقَوۡمَ فِيهَا صَرۡعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ خَاوِيَةٖ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: سخرها عليهم سبع ليال وثمنية ايام حسوما فتري القوم فيها صرعي كانهم اعجاز نخل خاوية
ayahs.translation: Which He [i.e., Allāh] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
ayahs.transliteration: sak-kha-ra-haa a-lai-him sa-ba layaa-linw wa-sa-maa-niya-ta ayyaa-min hu-soo-man fa-ta-ral qaw-ma fee-haa sa-raa kaan-na-hum a-jaa-zu nak-hlin khaa-wiyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَهَلۡ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٖ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: فهل تري لهم من باقية
ayahs.translation: Then do you see of them any remains?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-hal ta-raa la-hum min baa-qiyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَن قَبۡلَهُۥ وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلۡخَاطِئَةِ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: وجاء فرعون ومن قبله والمؤتفكت بالخاطئة
ayahs.translation: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaaaa fi-raw-nu wa-man qab-la-hoo wal-mu-ta-fi-kaa-tu bil-khaa-ti-ah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَعَصَوۡاْ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ أَخۡذَةٗ رَّابِيَةً ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: فعصوا رسول ربهم فاخذهم اخذة رابية
ayahs.translation: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
ayahs.transliteration: faa-saw ra-soo-la rab-bi-him faa-kha-za-hum ak-hza-tar raa-biyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلۡمَآءُ حَمَلۡنَٰكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡجَارِيَةِ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: انا لما طغا الماء حملنكم في الجارية
ayahs.translation: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you [i.e., your ancestors] in the sailing ship
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa lam-maa ta-ghal maaau ha-mal-naa-kum fil jaa-riyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِنَجۡعَلَهَا لَكُمۡ تَذۡكِرَةٗ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٞ وَٰعِيَةٞ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: لنجعلها لكم تذكرة وتعيها اذن وعية
ayahs.translation: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
ayahs.transliteration: li-na-ja-la-haa la-kum taz-ki-ra-tanw wa-taiya-haa u-zu-nunw waaiyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ نَفۡخَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: فاذا نفخ في الصور نفخة وحدة
ayahs.translation: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
ayahs.transliteration: fai-zaa nu-fi-kha fis soo-ri naf-kha-tunw waa-hi-dah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: وحملت الارض والجبال فدكتا دكة وحدة
ayahs.translation: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-mi-la-til ar-du wal-ji-baa-lu fa-duk-ka-taa dak-ka-tanw waa-hi-dah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ وَقَعَتِ ٱلۡوَاقِعَةُ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: فيومئذ وقعت الواقعة
ayahs.translation: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,
ayahs.transliteration: fayaw-mai-zinw wa-qaa-til waa-qi-ah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِيَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ وَاهِيَةٞ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: وانشقت السماء فهي يومئذ واهية
ayahs.translation: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
ayahs.transliteration: wan-shaq-qa-tis sa-maaau fa-hiya yaw-mai-zinw waa-hiyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرۡجَآئِهَاۚ وَيَحۡمِلُ عَرۡشَ رَبِّكَ فَوۡقَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ ثَمَٰنِيَةٞ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: والملك علي ارجائها ويحمل عرش ربك فوقهم يومئذ ثمنية
ayahs.translation: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
ayahs.transliteration: wal-ma-la-ku a-laaa ar-jaaai-haa wayah-mi-lu ar-sha rab-bi-ka faw-qa-hum yaw-mai-zin sa-maa-niyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَئِذٖ تُعۡرَضُونَ لَا تَخۡفَىٰ مِنكُمۡ خَافِيَةٞ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: يومئذ تعرضون لا تخفي منكم خافية
ayahs.translation: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-mai-zin tu-ra-doo-na laa tak-hfaa min-kum khaa-fiyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقۡرَءُواْ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: فاما من اوتي كتبه بيمينه فيقول هاؤم اقرءوا كتبيه
ayahs.translation: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
ayahs.transliteration: faam-maa man oo-tiya ki-taa-ba-hoo biyamee-nihee faya-qoo-lu haaau-muq raoo ki-taa-biyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنِّي ظَنَنتُ أَنِّي مُلَٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهۡ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: اني ظننت اني ملق حسابيه
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
ayahs.transliteration: in-nee zan-nan-tu an-nee mu-laa-qin hi-saa-biyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٖ رَّاضِيَةٖ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: فهو في عيشة راضية
ayahs.translation: So he will be in a pleasant life -
ayahs.transliteration: fa-hu-wa fee ee-sha-tir raa-diyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٖ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: في جنة عالية
ayahs.translation: In an elevated garden,
ayahs.transliteration: fee jan-nna-tin aa-liyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٞ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: قطوفها دانية
ayahs.translation: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
ayahs.transliteration: qu-too-fu-haa daa-niyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَآ أَسۡلَفۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَيَّامِ ٱلۡخَالِيَةِ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: كلوا واشربوا هنيا بما اسلفتم في الايام الخالية
ayahs.translation: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
ayahs.transliteration: ku-loo was-hra-boo haneeeam bi-maaa as-laf-tum fil ayyaa-mil kha-liyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: واما من اوتي كتبه بشماله فيقول يليتني لم اوت كتبيه
ayahs.translation: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
ayahs.transliteration: waam-maa man oo-tiya ki-taa-ba-hoo bi-shi-maa-lihee faya-qoo-lu yaa-lai-tanee lam oo-ta ki-taaa-biyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَمۡ أَدۡرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهۡ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولم ادر ما حسابيه
ayahs.translation: And had not known what is my account.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lam ad-ri maa hi-saa-biyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰلَيۡتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلۡقَاضِيَةَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: يليتها كانت القاضية
ayahs.translation: I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.
ayahs.transliteration: yaa-lai-ta-haa kaa-na-til qaa-diyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنِّي مَالِيَهۡۜ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: ما اغني عني ماليه
ayahs.translation: My wealth has not availed me.
ayahs.transliteration: maaa ag-hnaa an-nee maa-liyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَلَكَ عَنِّي سُلۡطَٰنِيَهۡ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: هلك عني سلطنيه
ayahs.translation: Gone from me is my authority."
ayahs.transliteration: ha-la-ka an-nee sul-taa-niyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: خذوه فغلوه
ayahs.translation: [Allāh will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
ayahs.transliteration: khu-zoo-hu fa-ghul-looh

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: ثم الجحيم صلوه
ayahs.translation: Then into Hellfire drive him.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-mal jahee-ma sal-looh

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ فِي سِلۡسِلَةٖ ذَرۡعُهَا سَبۡعُونَ ذِرَاعٗا فَٱسۡلُكُوهُ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: ثم في سلسلة ذرعها سبعون ذراعا فاسلكوه
ayahs.translation: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma fee sil-si-la-tin za-ru-haa sa-boo-na zi-raaan fas-lu-kooh

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: انه كان لا يؤمن بالله العظيم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allāh, the Most Great,
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hoo kaa-na laa yu-mi-nu bil-laa-hil azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولا يحض علي طعام المسكين
ayahs.translation: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa ya-hud-du a-laa taaa-mil mis-keen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَيۡسَ لَهُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ هَٰهُنَا حَمِيمٞ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: فليس له اليوم ههنا حميم
ayahs.translation: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lay-sa la-hul yaw-ma haa-hu-naa hameem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنۡ غِسۡلِينٖ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولا طعام الا من غسلين
ayahs.translation: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa taaa-mun il-laa min ghis-leen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا يَأۡكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡخَٰطِـُٔونَ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: لا ياكله الا الخطون
ayahs.translation: None will eat it except the sinners.
ayahs.transliteration: laa ya-ku-lu-hooo il-lal khaa-tioon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِمَا تُبۡصِرُونَ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: فلا اقسم بما تبصرون
ayahs.translation: So I swear by what you see
ayahs.transliteration: fa-laaa uq-si-mu bi-maa tub-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: وما لا تبصرون
ayahs.translation: And what you do not see
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa laa tub-si-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلُ رَسُولٖ كَرِيمٖ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: انه لقول رسول كريم
ayahs.translation: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the word of a noble Messenger.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hoo la-qaw-lu ra-soo-lin kareem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَاعِرٖۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تُؤۡمِنُونَ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: وما هو بقول شاعر قليلا ما تؤمنون
ayahs.translation: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa hu-wa bi-qaw-li shaair qalee-lan maa tu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا بِقَوۡلِ كَاهِنٖۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: ولا بقول كاهن قليلا ما تذكرون
ayahs.translation: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa bi-qaw-li kaa-hin qalee-lan maa ta-zak-ka-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَنزِيلٞ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: تنزيل من رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: tan-zee-lum mir rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيۡنَا بَعۡضَ ٱلۡأَقَاوِيلِ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولو تقول علينا بعض الاقاويل
ayahs.translation: And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law ta-qaw-wa-la a-lai-naa ba-dal a-qaaweel

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَأَخَذۡنَا مِنۡهُ بِٱلۡيَمِينِ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: لاخذنا منه باليمين
ayahs.translation: We would have seized him by the right hand;
ayahs.transliteration: laa-khaz-naa mi-nhu bi-lyameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعۡنَا مِنۡهُ ٱلۡوَتِينَ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: ثم لقطعنا منه الوتين
ayahs.translation: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma la-qa-ta-naa mi-nhul wateen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ عَنۡهُ حَٰجِزِينَ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: فما منكم من احد عنه حجزين
ayahs.translation: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-maa min-kum min a-ha-din a-nhu haa-jizeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذۡكِرَةٞ لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: وانه لتذكرة للمتقين
ayahs.translation: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na-hoo la-taz-ki-ra-tul lil-mut-taqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَعۡلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: وانا لنعلم ان منكم مكذبين
ayahs.translation: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na la-na-la-mu an-na min-kum mu-kaz-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسۡرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: وانه لحسرة علي الكفرين
ayahs.translation: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na-hu la-has-ra-tun a-lal kaa-fireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلۡيَقِينِ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: وانه لحق اليقين
ayahs.translation: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na-hoo la-haq-qul ya-qeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: فسبح باسم ربك العظيم
ayahs.translation: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
ayahs.transliteration: fas-sab-bih bis-mi rab-bi-kal azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَأَلَ سَآئِلُۢ بِعَذَابٖ وَاقِعٖ ١
ayahs.text_simple: سال سائل بعذاب واقع
ayahs.translation: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
ayahs.transliteration: saa-la saaai-lun bi-a-zaa-binw waa-qi

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ لَيۡسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٞ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: للكفرين ليس له دافع
ayahs.translation: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.
ayahs.transliteration: lil-kaa-fi-ree-na lai-sa la-hoo daa-fi

ayahs.text_uthmani: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِي ٱلۡمَعَارِجِ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: من الله ذي المعارج
ayahs.translation: [It is] from Allāh, owner of the ways of ascent.
ayahs.transliteration: mi-nal laa-hi zil maaa-rij

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَعۡرُجُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيۡهِ فِي يَوۡمٖ كَانَ مِقۡدَارُهُۥ خَمۡسِينَ أَلۡفَ سَنَةٖ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: تعرج الملئكة والروح اليه في يوم كان مقداره خمسين الف سنة
ayahs.translation: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
ayahs.transliteration: ta-ru-jul ma-laaai-ka-tu war-roo-hu i-lai-hi fee yaw-min kaa-na miq-daa-ru-hoo kham-see-na al-fa sa-nah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱصۡبِرۡ صَبۡرٗا جَمِيلًا ٥
ayahs.text_simple: فاصبر صبرا جميلا
ayahs.translation: So be patient with gracious patience.
ayahs.transliteration: fas-bir sab-ran jamee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمۡ يَرَوۡنَهُۥ بَعِيدٗا ٦
ayahs.text_simple: انهم يرونه بعيدا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,
ayahs.transliteration: i-naa-hum ya-raw-na-hoo baee-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبٗا ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ونريه قريبا
ayahs.translation: But We see it [as] near.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-na-raa-hu qaree-baa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: يوم تكون السماء كالمهل
ayahs.translation: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma ta-koo-nus sa-maaau kal-muhl

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَكُونُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَٱلۡعِهۡنِ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: وتكون الجبال كالعهن
ayahs.translation: And the mountains will be like wool,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-koo-nul ji-baa-lu ka-lihn

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا يَسۡـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمٗا ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: ولا يسل حميم حميما
ayahs.translation: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa ya-sa-lu hamee-mun hamee-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمۡۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُ لَوۡ يَفۡتَدِي مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمِئِذِۭ بِبَنِيهِ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: يبصرونهم يود المجرم لو يفتدي من عذاب يومئذ ببنيه
ayahs.translation: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children
ayahs.transliteration: yu-bas-sa-roo-na-hum ya-wad-dul muj-ri-mu law yaf-tadee min a-zaa-bi yaw-mai-zim bi-baneeh

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: وصحبته واخيه
ayahs.translation: And his wife and his brother
ayahs.transliteration: wa-saa-hi-ba-tihee waa-kheeh

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِي تُـٔۡوِيهِ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: وفصيلته التي تويه
ayahs.translation: And his nearest kindred who shelter him
ayahs.transliteration: wa-fa-see-la-thil latee tuweeh

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: ومن في الارض جميعا ثم ينجيه
ayahs.translation: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-man fil ar-di jameean sum-ma yun-jeeh

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّآۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: كلا انها لظي
ayahs.translation: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laa in-na-haa la-zaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: نَزَّاعَةٗ لِّلشَّوَىٰ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: نزاعة للشوي
ayahs.translation: A remover of exteriors.
ayahs.transliteration: naz-zaaa-tal lis-hsha-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَدۡعُواْ مَنۡ أَدۡبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: تدعوا من ادبر وتولي
ayahs.translation: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
ayahs.transliteration: ta-doo man ad-ba-ra wa-ta-wal-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوۡعَىٰٓ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: وجمع فاوعي
ayahs.translation: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ja-maa faa-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: ان الانسن خلق هلوعا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal in-saa-na khu-li-qa ha-loo-a-a

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعٗا ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: اذا مسه الشر جزوعا
ayahs.translation: When evil touches him, impatient,
ayahs.transliteration: i-zaa mas-sa-hush shar-ru ja-zoo-a-a

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلۡخَيۡرُ مَنُوعًا ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: واذا مسه الخير منوعا
ayahs.translation: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa mas-sa-hul khai-ru ma-noo-a-a

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلۡمُصَلِّينَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: الا المصلين
ayahs.translation: Except the observers of prayer -
ayahs.transliteration: il-lal mu-sal-leen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمۡ دَآئِمُونَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: الذين هم علي صلاتهم دائمون
ayahs.translation: Those who are constant in their prayer
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na hum a-laa sa-laa-ti-him daaai-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ حَقّٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: والذين في امولهم حق معلوم
ayahs.translation: And those within whose wealth is a known right
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na feee am-waa-li-him haq-qun ma-loom

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: للسائل والمحروم
ayahs.translation: For the petitioner and the deprived -
ayahs.transliteration: lis-saaai-li wal-mah-room

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: والذين يصدقون بيوم الدين
ayahs.translation: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na yu-sad-di-qoo-na biyaw-mid deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: والذين هم من عذاب ربهم مشفقون
ayahs.translation: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na hum min a-zaa-bi rab-bi-him mus-hfi-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمۡ غَيۡرُ مَأۡمُونٖ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: ان عذاب ربهم غير مامون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
ayahs.transliteration: in-na a-zaa-ba rab-bi-him ghai-ru ma-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِفُرُوجِهِمۡ حَٰفِظُونَ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: والذين هم لفروجهم حفظون
ayahs.translation: And those who guard their private parts
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na hum li-fu-roo-ji-him haa-fi-zoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُومِينَ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: الا علي ازوجهم او ما ملكت ايمنهم فانهم غير ملومين
ayahs.translation: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa a-laaa az-waa-ji-him aw maa ma-la-kat ay-maa-nu-hum fain-na-hum ghai-ru ma-loomeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡعَادُونَ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: فمن ابتغي وراء ذلك فاولئك هم العادون
ayahs.translation: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ma-nib ta-ghaa wa-raaaa zaa-li-ka fau-laaai-ka hu-mul aa-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمۡ وَعَهۡدِهِمۡ رَٰعُونَ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: والذين هم لامنتهم وعهدهم رعون
ayahs.translation: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na hum li-a-maa-naa-ti-him waah-di-him raaoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَٰدَٰتِهِمۡ قَآئِمُونَ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: والذين هم بشهدتهم قائمون
ayahs.translation: And those who are in their testimonies upright
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na hum bi-sha-haa-daa-ti-him qaaai-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمۡ يُحَافِظُونَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: والذين هم علي صلاتهم يحافظون
ayahs.translation: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na hum a-laa sa-laa-ti-him yu-haa-fi-zoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ مُّكۡرَمُونَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك في جنت مكرمون
ayahs.translation: They will be in gardens, honored.
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-ka fee jan-naa-tim muk-ra-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ قِبَلَكَ مُهۡطِعِينَ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: فمال الذين كفروا قبلك مهطعين
ayahs.translation: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muḥammad],
ayahs.transliteration: fa-maa lil-la-zee-na ka-fa-roo qi-ba-la-ka muh-tieen

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: عن اليمين وعن الشمال عزين
ayahs.translation: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?
ayahs.transliteration: a-nil ya-mee-ni waa-nish shi-maa-li izeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَيَطۡمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُدۡخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٖ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: ايطمع كل امري منهم ان يدخل جنة نعيم
ayahs.translation: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
ayahs.transliteration: ayat-mau kul-lum riim mi-nhum a-ny yud-kha-la jan-na-ta naeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّآۖ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: كلا انا خلقنهم مما يعلمون
ayahs.translation: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laaa in-naa kha-laq-na-hum mim-maa ya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: فلا اقسم برب المشرق والمغرب انا لقدرون
ayahs.translation: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
ayahs.transliteration: fa-laaa uq-si-mu bi-rab-bil ma-shaa-ri-qi wal-ma-ghaa-ri-bi in-naa la-qaa-di-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: علي ان نبدل خيرا منهم وما نحن بمسبوقين
ayahs.translation: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
ayahs.transliteration: a-laaa an nu-bad-di-la khai-ran mi-nhum wa-maa nah-nu bi-mas-booqeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: فذرهم يخوضوا ويلعبوا حتي يلقوا يومهم الذي يوعدون
ayahs.translation: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -
ayahs.transliteration: fa-za-rhum ya-khoo-doo waya-la-boo hat-taa yu-laa-qoo yaw-ma-hu-mul lazee yoo-a-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ سِرَاعٗا كَأَنَّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٖ يُوفِضُونَ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: يوم يخرجون من الاجداث سراعا كانهم الي نصب يوفضون
ayahs.translation: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma yak-hru-joo-na mi-nal aj-daa-si si-raaan kaan-na-hum i-laa nu-su-bi-ny yoo-fi-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةٞۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: خشعة ابصرهم ترهقهم ذلة ذلك اليوم الذي كانوا يوعدون
ayahs.translation: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
ayahs.transliteration: khaa-shi-a-tan ab-saa-ru-hum ta-rha-qu-hum zil-lah zaa-li-kal yaw-mul lazee kaa-noo yoo-a-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَنۡ أَنذِرۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ ١
ayahs.text_simple: انا ارسلنا نوحا الي قومه ان انذر قومك من قبل ان ياتيهم عذاب اليم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
ayahs.transliteration: in-naaa ar-sal-naa noo-han i-laa qaw-mihee an an-zir qaw-ma-ka min qab-li a-ny yaa-tiya-hum a-zaa-bun aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: قال يقوم اني لكم نذير مبين
ayahs.translation: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner -
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la yaa-qaw-mi in-nee la-kum nazee-rum mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: ان اعبدوا الله واتقوه واطيعون
ayahs.translation: To worship Allāh, fear Him and obey me.
ayahs.transliteration: a-ni bu-dul laa-ha wat-ta-qoo-hu waatee-o-on

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرۡكُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُۚ لَوۡ كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: يغفر لكم من ذنوبكم ويؤخركم الي اجل مسمي ان اجل الله اذا جاء لا يؤخر لو كنتم تعلمون
ayahs.translation: He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allāh, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew."
ayahs.transliteration: yag-hfir la-kum min zu-noo-bi-kum wayu-a-khkhir-kum i-laaa a-ja-lim mu-sam-maa in-naa a-ja-lal laa-hi i-zaa jaaaa laa yu-a-khkhar law kun-tum ta-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُ قَوۡمِي لَيۡلٗا وَنَهَارٗا ٥
ayahs.text_simple: قال رب اني دعوت قومي ليلا ونهارا
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la rab-bi in-nee daaw-tu qaw-mee lai-lanw wa-na-ha-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَمۡ يَزِدۡهُمۡ دُعَآءِيٓ إِلَّا فِرَارٗا ٦
ayahs.text_simple: فلم يزدهم دعاءي الا فرارا
ayahs.translation: But my invitation increased them not except in flight [i.e., aversion].
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lam ya-zi-dhum du-a-aaeee il-laa fi-raa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ لِتَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ جَعَلُوٓاْ أَصَٰبِعَهُمۡ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَٱسۡتَغۡشَوۡاْ ثِيَابَهُمۡ وَأَصَرُّواْ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ ٱسۡتِكۡبَارٗا ٧
ayahs.text_simple: واني كلما دعوتهم لتغفر لهم جعلوا اصبعهم في ءاذانهم واستغشوا ثيابهم واصروا واستكبروا استكبارا
ayahs.translation: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
ayahs.transliteration: wainee kul-la-maa daaw-tu-hum li-tag-hfi-ra la-hum jaa-looo a-saa-bi-a-hum fee aa-zaa-ni-him was-tag-hshaw siyaa-ba-hum waa-saar-roo was-tak-ba-rus tik-baa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ جِهَارٗا ٨
ayahs.text_simple: ثم اني دعوتهم جهارا
ayahs.translation: Then I invited them publicly.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma in-nee daaw-tu-hum ji-haa-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَنتُ لَهُمۡ وَأَسۡرَرۡتُ لَهُمۡ إِسۡرَارٗا ٩
ayahs.text_simple: ثم اني اعلنت لهم واسررت لهم اسرارا
ayahs.translation: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
ayahs.transliteration: sum-maa in-neee a-lan-tu la-hum waas-rar-tu la-hum is-raa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارٗا ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: فقلت استغفروا ربكم انه كان غفارا
ayahs.translation: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qul-tus tag-hfi-roo ra-ba-kum in-na-hoo kaa-na ghaf-faa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُرۡسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّدۡرَارٗا ١١
ayahs.text_simple: يرسل السماء عليكم مدرارا
ayahs.translation: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
ayahs.transliteration: yur-si-lis sa-maaaa a-lai-kum mid-raa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيُمۡدِدۡكُم بِأَمۡوَٰلٖ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ جَنَّٰتٖ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ أَنۡهَٰرٗا ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: ويمددكم بامول وبنين ويجعل لكم جنت ويجعل لكم انهرا
ayahs.translation: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
ayahs.transliteration: wayum-did-kum bi-a-mwaa-linw wa-ba-nee-na waya-jal la-kum jan-naa-tinw waya-jal la-kum a-nhaa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَّا لَكُمۡ لَا تَرۡجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارٗا ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: ما لكم لا ترجون لله وقارا
ayahs.translation: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allāh [due] grandeur
ayahs.transliteration: maa la-kum laa tar-joo-na lil-laa-hi wa-qaa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَدۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ أَطۡوَارًا ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: وقد خلقكم اطوارا
ayahs.translation: While He has created you in stages?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qad kha-la-qa-kum at-waa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ طِبَاقٗا ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: الم تروا كيف خلق الله سبع سموت طباقا
ayahs.translation: Do you not consider how Allāh has created seven heavens in layers
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam ta-raw kai-fa kha-la-qal laa-hu sa-ba sa-maa-waa-tin ti-baa-qaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورٗا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ سِرَاجٗا ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: وجعل القمر فيهن نورا وجعل الشمس سراجا
ayahs.translation: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaa-lal qa-ma-ra fee-hin-na noo-ranw wa-jaa-lash sham-sa si-raa-jaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ نَبَاتٗا ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: والله انبتكم من الارض نباتا
