ayahs.translation: And Allāh has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-laa-hu am-ba-ta-kum mi-nal ar-di na-baa-taa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمۡ فِيهَا وَيُخۡرِجُكُمۡ إِخۡرَاجٗا ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: ثم يعيدكم فيها ويخرجكم اخراجا
ayahs.translation: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma yuee-du-kum fee-haa wayuk-hri-ju-kum ik-hraa-jaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِسَاطٗا ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: والله جعل لكم الارض بساطا
ayahs.translation: And Allāh has made for you the earth an expanse
ayahs.transliteration: wal-laa-hu jaa-la la-ku-mul ar-da bi-saa-taa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِّتَسۡلُكُواْ مِنۡهَا سُبُلٗا فِجَاجٗا ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: لتسلكوا منها سبلا فجاجا
ayahs.translation: That you may follow therein roads of passage.'"
ayahs.transliteration: li-tas-lu-koo mi-nhaa su-bu-lan fi-jaa-jaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالَ نُوحٞ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمۡ عَصَوۡنِي وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَن لَّمۡ يَزِدۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارٗا ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: قال نوح رب انهم عصوني واتبعوا من لم يزده ماله وولده الا خسارا
ayahs.translation: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-la noo-hur rab-bi in-na-hum a-saw-nee wat-ta-baoo mal lam ya-zi-dhu maa-lu-hoo wa-wa-la-du-hooo il-laa kha-saa-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرٗا كُبَّارٗا ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: ومكروا مكرا كبارا
ayahs.translation: And they conspired an immense conspiracy
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ma-ka-roo mak-ran kub-baa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدّٗا وَلَا سُوَاعٗا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسۡرٗا ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: وقالوا لا تذرن ءالهتكم ولا تذرن ودا ولا سواعا ولا يغوث ويعوق ونسرا
ayahs.translation: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwāʿ or Yaghūth and Yaʿūq and Nasr.'
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-loo laa ta-za-run-na aa-li-ha-ta-kum wa-laa ta-za-run-na wad-danw wa-laa su-waaanw wa-laa ya-ghoo-sa wayaoo-qa wa-nas-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَدۡ أَضَلُّواْ كَثِيرٗاۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلٗا ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: وقد اضلوا كثيرا ولا تزد الظلمين الا ضللا
ayahs.translation: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qad a-dal-loo kasee-ranw wa-laa ta-zi-diz zaa-li-mee-na il-laa da-laa-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمۡ أُغۡرِقُواْ فَأُدۡخِلُواْ نَارٗا فَلَمۡ يَجِدُواْ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارٗا ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: مما خطيتهم اغرقوا فادخلوا نارا فلم يجدوا لهم من دون الله انصارا
ayahs.translation: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers.
ayahs.transliteration: mim-maa khateeeaa-ti-him ug-hri-qoo faud-khi-loo naa-ran fa-lam ya-ji-doo la-hum min doo-nil laa-hi an-saa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ نُوحٞ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: وقال نوح رب لا تذر علي الارض من الكفرين ديارا
ayahs.translation: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-la noo-hur rab-bi laa ta-zar a-lal ar-di mi-nal kaa-fi-ree-na daiyaa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرۡهُمۡ يُضِلُّواْ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓاْ إِلَّا فَاجِرٗا كَفَّارٗا ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: انك ان تذرهم يضلوا عبادك ولا يلدوا الا فاجرا كفارا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-ka in ta-za-rhum yu-dil-loo i-baa-da-ka wa-laa ya-li-dooo il-laa faa-ji-ran kaf-faa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنٗا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارَۢا ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: رب اغفر لي ولولدي ولمن دخل بيتي مؤمنا وللمؤمنين والمؤمنت ولا تزد الظلمين الا تبارا
ayahs.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
ayahs.transliteration: rab-bi ig-hfir lee wa-li-waa-li-daiya wa-li-man da-kha-la bai-tiya mu-mi-nanw wa-lil-mu-mi-nee-na wal-mu-mi-naa-ti wa-laa ta-zi-diz zaa-li-mee-na il-laa ta-baa-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡءَانًا عَجَبٗا ١
ayahs.text_simple: قل اوحي الي انه استمع نفر من الجن فقالوا انا سمعنا قرءانا عجبا
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
ayahs.transliteration: qul oo-hiya i-laiya an-nna hus-ta-maa na-fa-rum mi-nal jin-ni fa-qaa-looo in-naa sa-mi-naa qu-raa-nan a-ja-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدٗا ٢
ayahs.text_simple: يهدي الي الرشد فامنا به ولن نشرك بربنا احدا
ayahs.translation: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
ayahs.transliteration: yah-deee i-lar rus-hdi faaa-man-naa bihee wa-lan nus-hri-ka bi-rab-bi-naaa a-ha-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةٗ وَلَا وَلَدٗا ٣
ayahs.text_simple: وانه تعلي جد ربنا ما اتخذ صحبة ولا ولدا
ayahs.translation: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
ayahs.transliteration: waan-na-hoo taaa-laa jad-du rab-bi-naa mat ta-kha-za saa-hi-ba-tanw wa-laa wa-la-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطٗا ٤
ayahs.text_simple: وانه كان يقول سفيهنا علي الله شططا
ayahs.translation: And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees] has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.
ayahs.transliteration: waan-na-hoo kaa-na ya-qoo-lu safee-hu-naa al al-la-hi sha-ta-ta

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلۡإِنسُ وَٱلۡجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا ٥
ayahs.text_simple: وانا ظننا ان لن تقول الانس والجن علي الله كذبا
ayahs.translation: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allāh a lie.
ayahs.transliteration: waan-naa za-nan-naaa al lan ta-qoo-lal in-su wal-jin-nu al al-la-hi ka-zi-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمۡ رَهَقٗا ٦
ayahs.text_simple: وانه كان رجال من الانس يعوذون برجال من الجن فزادوهم رهقا
ayahs.translation: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden [i.e., sin].
ayahs.transliteration: waan-na-hoo kaa-na ri-jaa-lun mi-nal in-si yaoo-zoo-na bi-ri-jaa-lin mi-nal jin-ni fa-zaa-doo-hum ra-ha-qa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُمۡ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٗا ٧
ayahs.text_simple: وانهم ظنوا كما ظننتم ان لن يبعث الله احدا
ayahs.translation: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allāh would never send anyone [as a messenger].
ayahs.transliteration: waan-na-hum zan-noo ka-maa za-nan-tum al la-ny ya-ba-sal laa-hu a-ha-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنَٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسٗا شَدِيدٗا وَشُهُبٗا ٨
ayahs.text_simple: وانا لمسنا السماء فوجدنها ملئت حرسا شديدا وشهبا
ayahs.translation: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
ayahs.transliteration: waan-naa la-mas-nas sa-maaaa fa-wa-jad-naa-haa mu-li-at ha-ra-san shadee-danw wa-shu-hu-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِۖ فَمَن يَسۡتَمِعِ ٱلۡأٓنَ يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ شِهَابٗا رَّصَدٗا ٩
ayahs.text_simple: وانا كنا نقعد منها مقعد للسمع فمن يستمع الان يجد له شهابا رصدا
ayahs.translation: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
ayahs.transliteration: waan-naa kun-naa na-qu-du mi-nhaa ma-qaai-da lis-sa-mi fa-ma-ny yas-ta-miil aa-na ya-jid la-hoo shi-haa-bar ra-sa-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدۡرِيٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ أَرَادَ بِهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ رَشَدٗا ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: وانا لا ندري اشر اريد بمن في الارض ام اراد بهم ربهم رشدا
ayahs.translation: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
ayahs.transliteration: waan-naa laa nad-reee a-shar-run uree-da bi-man fil ar-di am a-raa-da bi-him rab-bu-hum ra-sha-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدٗا ١١
ayahs.text_simple: وانا منا الصلحون ومنا دون ذلك كنا طرائق قددا
ayahs.translation: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.
ayahs.transliteration: waan-naa min-nas saa-li-hoo-na wa-min-naa doo-na zaa-li-ka kun-naa ta-raaai-qa qi-da-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبٗا ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: وانا ظننا ان لن نعجز الله في الارض ولن نعجزه هربا
ayahs.translation: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
ayahs.transliteration: waan-naa za-nan-naaa al lan nu-ji-zal laa-ha fil ar-di wa-lan nu-ji-za-hoo ha-ra-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ فَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسٗا وَلَا رَهَقٗا ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: وانا لما سمعنا الهدي ءامنا به فمن يؤمن بربه فلا يخاف بخسا ولا رهقا
ayahs.translation: And when we heard the guidance [i.e., the Qur’ān], we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
ayahs.transliteration: waan-naa lam-maa sa-mi-nal hu-daaa aa-man-naa bihee fa-ma-ny yu-min bi-rab-bihee fa-laa ya-khaa-fu bak-hsanw wa-laa ra-ha-qa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلۡمُسۡلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَۖ فَمَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوۡاْ رَشَدٗا ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: وانا منا المسلمون ومنا القسطون فمن اسلم فاولئك تحروا رشدا
ayahs.translation: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
ayahs.transliteration: waan-naa min-nal mus-li-moo-na wa-min-nal qaa-si-too-na fa-man as-la-ma fau-laaai-ka ta-har-raw ra-sha-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبٗا ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: واما القسطون فكانوا لجهنم حطبا
ayahs.translation: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
ayahs.transliteration: waam-mal qaa-si-too-na fa-kaa-noo li-ja-han-na-ma ha-ta-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقٗا ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: والو استقموا علي الطريقة لاسقينهم ماء غدقا
ayahs.translation: And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision]
ayahs.transliteration: waal-la-wis ta-qaa-moo a-lat taree-qa-ti laas-qay-naa-hum maaan gha-da-qa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَمَن يُعۡرِضۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابٗا صَعَدٗا ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: لنفتنهم فيه ومن يعرض عن ذكر ربه يسلكه عذابا صعدا
ayahs.translation: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: li-naf-ti-na-hum feeh wa-ma-ny yu-rid an zik-ri rab-bihee yas-lu-khu a-zaa-ban saa-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٗا ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: وان المسجد لله فلا تدعوا مع الله احدا
ayahs.translation: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allāh, so do not invoke with Allāh anyone.
ayahs.transliteration: waan-nal ma-saa-ji-da lil-laa-hi fa-laa ta-doo maal laa-hi a-ha-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدۡعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِ لِبَدٗا ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: وانه لما قام عبد الله يدعوه كادوا يكونون عليه لبدا
ayahs.translation: And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of Allāh stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
ayahs.transliteration: waan-na-hoo lam-maa qaa-ma ab-dul laa-hi ya-doo-hu kaa-doo ya-koo-noo-na a-lai-hi li-ba-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي وَلَآ أُشۡرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدٗا ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: قل انما ادعوا ربي ولا اشرك به احدا
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
ayahs.transliteration: qul in-na-maaa a-doo rab-bee wa-laaa us-hri-ku biheee a-ha-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرّٗا وَلَا رَشَدٗا ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: قل اني لا املك لكم ضرا ولا رشدا
ayahs.translation: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
ayahs.transliteration: qul in-nee laaa am-li-ku la-kum dar-ranw wa-laa ra-sha-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٞ وَلَنۡ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلۡتَحَدًا ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: قل اني لن يجيرني من الله احد ولن اجد من دونه ملتحدا
ayahs.translation: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allāh anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
ayahs.transliteration: qul in-nee la-ny yu-jee-ranee mi-nal laa-hi a-ha-dunw wa-lan a-ji-da min doo-nihee mul-ta-ha-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا بَلَٰغٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦۚ وَمَن يَعۡصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: الا بلغا من الله ورسلته ومن يعص الله ورسوله فان له نار جهنم خلدين فيها ابدا
ayahs.translation: But [I have for you] only notification from Allāh, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa ba-laa-gham mi-nal laa-hi wa-ri-saa-laa-tih wa-ma-ny ya-sil laa-ha wa-ra-soo-la-hoo fain-na la-hoo naa-ra ja-han-na-ma khaa-li-dee-na fee-haaa a-ba-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرٗا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدٗا ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: حتي اذا راوا ما يوعدون فسيعلمون من اضعف ناصرا واقل عددا
ayahs.translation: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
ayahs.transliteration: hat-taaa i-zaa raaw maa yoo-a-doo-na fa-saya-la-moo-na man a-da-fu naa-si-ranw waa-qal-lu a-da-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبٞ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمۡ يَجۡعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّيٓ أَمَدًا ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: قل ان ادري اقريب ما توعدون ام يجعل له ربي امدا
ayahs.translation: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
ayahs.transliteration: qul in ad-reee a-qa-ree-bum maa too-a-doo-na am ya-ja-lu la-hoo rab-beee a-ma-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيۡبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: علم الغيب فلا يظهر علي غيبه احدا
ayahs.translation: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
ayahs.transliteration: aa-li-mul ghai-bi fa-laa yu-zhi-ru a-laa ghai-biheee a-ha-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٖ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسۡلُكُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ رَصَدٗا ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: الا من ارتضي من رسول فانه يسلك من بين يديه ومن خلفه رصدا
ayahs.translation: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa ma-nir ta-daa mir ra-soo-lin fain-na-hoo yas-lu-ku min bai-ni ya-dai-hi wa-min khal-fihee ra-sa-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِّيَعۡلَمَ أَن قَدۡ أَبۡلَغُواْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَأَحۡصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدَۢا ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: ليعلم ان قد ابلغوا رسلت ربهم واحاط بما لديهم واحصي كل شيء عددا
ayahs.translation: That he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
ayahs.transliteration: liya-la-ma an qad ab-la-ghoo ri-saa-laa-ti rab-bi-him waa-haa-ta bi-maa la-dai-him waah-saa kul-la shaiin a-da-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُزَّمِّلُ ١
ayahs.text_simple: يايها المزمل
ayahs.translation: O you who wraps himself [in clothing],
ayahs.transliteration: yaaiyu-hal muz-zam-mil

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُمِ ٱلَّيۡلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا ٢
ayahs.text_simple: قم اليل الا قليلا
ayahs.translation: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
ayahs.transliteration: qu-mil lai-la il-laa qalee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: نِّصۡفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصۡ مِنۡهُ قَلِيلًا ٣
ayahs.text_simple: نصفه او انقص منه قليلا
ayahs.translation: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
ayahs.transliteration: nis-fa-hooo a-wi nqus mi-nhu qalee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوۡ زِدۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَرۡتِيلًا ٤
ayahs.text_simple: او زد عليه ورتل القرءان ترتيلا
ayahs.translation: Or add to it, and recite the Qur’ān with measured recitation.
ayahs.transliteration: aw zid a-lai-hi wa-rat-ti-lil qu-raa-na tar-tee-la

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا سَنُلۡقِي عَلَيۡكَ قَوۡلٗا ثَقِيلًا ٥
ayahs.text_simple: انا سنلقي عليك قولا ثقيلا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa sa-nul-qee a-lai-ka qaw-lan saqee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطۡـٔٗا وَأَقۡوَمُ قِيلًا ٦
ayahs.text_simple: ان ناشئة اليل هي اشد وطا واقوم قيلا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
ayahs.transliteration: inn naa-shi-a-tal lai-li hiya a-shad-ddu wa-tanw waaq-wa-mu qee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبۡحٗا طَوِيلٗا ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان لك في النهار سبحا طويلا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na la-ka fin na-haa-ri sa-bhan tawee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ إِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيلٗا ٨
ayahs.text_simple: واذكر اسم ربك وتبتل اليه تبتيلا
ayahs.translation: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
ayahs.transliteration: waz-ku-ris ma rab-bi-ka wa-ta-bat-tal i-lai-hi tab-tee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذۡهُ وَكِيلٗا ٩
ayahs.text_simple: رب المشرق والمغرب لا اله الا هو فاتخذه وكيلا
ayahs.translation: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
ayahs.transliteration: rab-bul mas-hri-qi wal-mag-hrii-bi laaa i-laa-ha il-laa hu-wa fat-ta-khi-zhu wakee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهۡجُرۡهُمۡ هَجۡرٗا جَمِيلٗا ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: واصبر علي ما يقولون واهجرهم هجرا جميلا
ayahs.translation: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
ayahs.transliteration: was-bir a-laa maa ya-qoo-loo-na wah-ju-rhum haj-ran jamee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَذَرۡنِي وَٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ أُوْلِي ٱلنَّعۡمَةِ وَمَهِّلۡهُمۡ قَلِيلًا ١١
ayahs.text_simple: وذرني والمكذبين اولي النعمة ومهلهم قليلا
ayahs.translation: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-zar-nee wal-mu-kaz-zi-bee-na u-lin na-ma-ti wa-ma-hhi-lhum qalee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَدَيۡنَآ أَنكَالٗا وَجَحِيمٗا ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: ان لدينا انكالا وجحيما
ayahs.translation: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
ayahs.transliteration: in-na la-dai-naaa an-kaa-lanw wa-ja-hee-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَطَعَامٗا ذَا غُصَّةٖ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: وطعاما ذا غصة وعذابا اليما
ayahs.translation: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-taaa-man zaa ghus-sa-tinw waa-zaa-ban alee-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَثِيبٗا مَّهِيلًا ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: يوم ترجف الارض والجبال وكانت الجبال كثيبا مهيلا
ayahs.translation: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma tar-ju-ful ar-du wal-ji-baa-lu wa-kaa-na-til ji-baa-lu kasee-bam mahee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ رَسُولٗا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيۡكُمۡ كَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ رَسُولٗا ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: انا ارسلنا اليكم رسولا شهدا عليكم كما ارسلنا الي فرعون رسولا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa ar-sal-naaa i-lai-kum ra-soo-lan shaa-hi-dan aley-kum ka-maaa ar-sal-naaa i-laa fi-raw-na ra-soo-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَعَصَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ أَخۡذٗا وَبِيلٗا ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: فعصي فرعون الرسول فاخذنه اخذا وبيلا
ayahs.translation: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
ayahs.transliteration: faa-saa fi-raw-nur ra-soo-la faa-khaz-naa-hu ak-hzanw wabee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكَيۡفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرۡتُمۡ يَوۡمٗا يَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡوِلۡدَٰنَ شِيبًا ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: فكيف تتقون ان كفرتم يوما يجعل الولدن شيبا
ayahs.translation: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white-haired?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kai-fa tat-ta-qoo-na in ka-far-tum yaw-ma-ny ya-ja-lul wil-daa-na shee-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرُۢ بِهِۦۚ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَفۡعُولًا ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: السماء منفطر به كان وعده مفعولا
ayahs.translation: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
ayahs.transliteration: as-sa-maaau mun-fa-ti-rum bih kaa-na wa-du-hoo ma-foo-la

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةٞۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: ان هذه تذكرة فمن شاء اتخذ الي ربه سبيلا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na haa-zihee taz-ki-ra-tun fa-man shaaaat ta-kha-za i-laa rab-bihee sabee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدۡنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَنِصۡفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٞ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحۡصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرۡضَىٰ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضۡرِبُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَبۡتَغُونَ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنۡهُۚ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقۡرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗاۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرٖ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيۡرٗا وَأَعۡظَمَ أَجۡرٗاۚ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ ٱللَّهَۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمُۢ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: ان ربك يعلم انك تقوم ادني من ثلثي اليل ونصفه وثلثه وطائفة من الذين معك والله يقدر اليل والنهار علم ان لن تحصوه فتاب عليكم فاقرءوا ما تيسر من القرءان علم ان سيكون منكم مرضي وءاخرون يضربون في الارض يبتغون من فضل الله وءاخرون يقتلون في سبيل الله فاقرءوا ما تيسر منه واقيموا الصلوة وءاتوا الزكوة واقرضوا الله قرضا حسنا وما تقدموا لانفسكم من خير تجدوه عند الله هو خيرا واعظم اجرا واستغفروا الله ان الله غفور رحيم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muḥammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allāh determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allāh and others fighting for the cause of Allāh. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allāh a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na rab-ba-ka ya-la-mu an-na-ka ta-qoo-mu ad-naa min su-lu-sayil lai-li wa-nis-fa-hoo wa-su-lu-sa-hoo wa-taaai-fa-tum mi-nal lazee-na maak wal-laa-hu yu-qad-di-rul lai-la wan-na-haar a-li-ma al lan tuh-soo-hu fa-taa-ba a-lai-kum faq-raoo maa tayas-sa-ra mi-nal qu-raan a-li-ma an saya-koo-nu min-kum mar-daa waaa-kha-roo-na yad-ri-boo-na fil ar-di yab-ta-ghoo-na min fad-lil laa-hi waaa-kha-roo-na yu-qaa-ti-loo-na fee sabee-lil laa-hi faq-raoo ma tayas-sa-ra mi-nhu waaqee-mus sa-laa-ta waaa-tuz za-kaa-ta waaq-ri-dul laa-ha qar-dan ha-sa-naa wa-maa tu-qa-di-moo li-a-nfu-si-kum min khai-rin ta-ji-doo-hu in-dal laa-hi hu-wa khay-ranw waa-za-ma aj-raa was-tag-hfi-rul laa-haa in-nal laa-ha gha-foo-rur raheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُدَّثِّرُ ١
ayahs.text_simple: يايها المدثر
ayahs.translation: O you who covers himself [with a garment],
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayyu-hal mud-das-sir

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُمۡ فَأَنذِرۡ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: قم فانذر
ayahs.translation: Arise and warn
ayahs.transliteration: qum faan-zir

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرۡ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: وربك فكبر
ayahs.translation: And your Lord glorify
ayahs.transliteration: wa-rab-ba-ka fa-kab-bir

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرۡ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: وثيابك فطهر
ayahs.translation: And your clothing purify
ayahs.transliteration: wa-siyaa-ba-ka fa-ta-hhir

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلرُّجۡزَ فَٱهۡجُرۡ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: والرجز فاهجر
ayahs.translation: And uncleanliness avoid
ayahs.transliteration: war-ruj-za fah-jur

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَمۡنُن تَسۡتَكۡثِرُ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولا تمنن تستكثر
ayahs.translation: And do not confer favor to acquire more
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa tam-nun tas-tak-sir

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصۡبِرۡ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ولربك فاصبر
ayahs.translation: But for your Lord be patient.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-li-rab-bi-ka fas-bir

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِي ٱلنَّاقُورِ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: فاذا نقر في الناقور
ayahs.translation: And when the trumpet is blown,
ayahs.transliteration: fai-zaa nu-qi-ra fin naa-qoor

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَوۡمٌ عَسِيرٌ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: فذلك يومئذ يوم عسير
ayahs.translation: That Day will be a difficult day
ayahs.transliteration: fa-zaa-li-ka yaw-mai-zi-ny yaw-mun aseer

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ غَيۡرُ يَسِيرٖ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: علي الكفرين غير يسير
ayahs.translation: For the disbelievers - not easy.
ayahs.transliteration: a-lal kaa-fi-ree-na ghai-ru ya-seer

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَرۡنِي وَمَنۡ خَلَقۡتُ وَحِيدٗا ١١
ayahs.text_simple: ذرني ومن خلقت وحيدا
ayahs.translation: Leave Me with the one I created alone
ayahs.transliteration: zar-nee wa-man kha-laq-tu wahee-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلۡتُ لَهُۥ مَالٗا مَّمۡدُودٗا ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: وجعلت له مالا ممدودا
ayahs.translation: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaal-tu la-hoo maa-lam mam-doo-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودٗا ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: وبنين شهودا
ayahs.translation: And children present [with him]
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ba-nee-na shu-hoo-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمۡهِيدٗا ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: ومهدت له تمهيدا
ayahs.translation: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ma-hhat-tu la-hoo ta-mhee-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يَطۡمَعُ أَنۡ أَزِيدَ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: ثم يطمع ان ازيد
ayahs.translation: Then he desires that I should add more.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma yat-mau an azeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّآۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِأٓيَٰتِنَا عَنِيدٗا ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: كلا انه كان لايتنا عنيدا
ayahs.translation: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laaa in-na-hoo kaa-na li-a-ayaa-ti-naa anee-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَأُرۡهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: سارهقه صعودا
ayahs.translation: I will cover him with arduous torment.
ayahs.transliteration: sau-rhi-qu-hoo saoo-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: انه فكر وقدر
ayahs.translation: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hoo fak-ka-ra wa-qad-dar

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقُتِلَ كَيۡفَ قَدَّرَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: فقتل كيف قدر
ayahs.translation: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qu-ti-la kay-fa qad-dar

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيۡفَ قَدَّرَ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: ثم قتل كيف قدر
ayahs.translation: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma qu-ti-la kai-fa qad-dar

ayahs.text_simple: ثم نظر
ayahs.translation: Then he considered [again];
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma na-zar

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: ثم عبس وبسر
ayahs.translation: Then he frowned and scowled;
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma a-ba-sa wa-ba-sar

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدۡبَرَ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: ثم ادبر واستكبر
ayahs.translation: Then he turned back and was arrogant
ayahs.transliteration: sum-maa ad-ba-ra was-tak-bar

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ يُؤۡثَرُ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: فقال ان هذا الا سحر يؤثر
ayahs.translation: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qaa-la in haa-zaaa il-laa sih-ru-ny yu-sar

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوۡلُ ٱلۡبَشَرِ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: ان هذا الا قول البشر
ayahs.translation: This is not but the word of a human being."
ayahs.transliteration: in haa-zaaa il-laa qaw-lul ba-shar

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَأُصۡلِيهِ سَقَرَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: ساصليه سقر
ayahs.translation: I will drive him into Saqar.
ayahs.transliteration: saus-lee-hi sa-qar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: وما ادريك ما سقر
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa ad-raa-ka maa sa-qar

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَا تُبۡقِي وَلَا تَذَرُ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: لا تبقي ولا تذر
ayahs.translation: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
ayahs.transliteration: laa tub-qee wa-laa ta-zar

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَوَّاحَةٞ لِّلۡبَشَرِ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: لواحة للبشر
ayahs.translation: Altering [i.e., blackening] the skins.
ayahs.transliteration: law-waa-ha-tul lil-ba-shar

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَلَيۡهَا تِسۡعَةَ عَشَرَ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: عليها تسعة عشر
ayahs.translation: Over it are nineteen [angels].
ayahs.transliteration: a-lai-haa ti-sa-ta a-shar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةٗۖ وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا عِدَّتَهُمۡ إِلَّا فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِيَسۡتَيۡقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَيَزۡدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنٗا وَلَا يَرۡتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ وَٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَا يَعۡلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡبَشَرِ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: وما جعلنا اصحب النار الا ملئكة وما جعلنا عدتهم الا فتنة للذين كفروا ليستيقن الذين اوتوا الكتب ويزداد الذين ءامنوا ايمنا ولا يرتاب الذين اوتوا الكتب والمؤمنون وليقول الذين في قلوبهم مرض والكفرون ماذا اراد الله بهذا مثلا كذلك يضل الله من يشاء ويهدي من يشاء وما يعلم جنود ربك الا هو وما هي الا ذكري للبشر
ayahs.translation: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allāh intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allāh send astray whom He wills and guide whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it [i.e., mention of the Fire] is not but a reminder to humanity.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa jaal-naaa a-shaa-ban naa-ri il-laa ma-laaai-ka-tanw wa-maa jaal-naa id-da-ta-hum il-laa fit-na-tal lil-la-zee-na ka-fa-roo liyas-tai-qi-nal lazee-na oo-tul ki-taa-ba wayaz-daa-dal lazee-na aa-ma-nooo ee-maa-nanw wa-laa yar-taa-bal lazee-na oo-tul ki-taa-ba wal-mu-mi-noo-na wa-liya-qoo-lal lazee-na fee qu-loo-bi-him ma-ra-dunw wal-kaa-fi-roo-na maa-zaaa a-raa-dal laa-hu bi-haa-zaa ma-sa-laa ka-zaa-li-ka yu-dil-lul laa-hu mai ya-shaaau wayah-dee mai ya-shaaa wa-maa ya-la-mu ju-noo-da rab-bi-ka il-laa hoo wa-maa hiya il-laa zik-raa lil-ba-shar

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّا وَٱلۡقَمَرِ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: كلا والقمر
ayahs.translation: No! By the moon
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laa wal-qa-mar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذۡ أَدۡبَرَ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: واليل اذ ادبر
ayahs.translation: And [by] the night when it departs
ayahs.transliteration: wal-lai-li id ad-bar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلصُّبۡحِ إِذَآ أَسۡفَرَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: والصبح اذا اسفر
ayahs.translation: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
ayahs.transliteration: was-sub hi i-zaaa as-far

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهَا لَإِحۡدَى ٱلۡكُبَرِ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: انها لاحدي الكبر
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions]
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-haa laih-dal ku-bar

ayahs.text_uthmani: نَذِيرٗا لِّلۡبَشَرِ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: نذيرا للبشر
ayahs.translation: As a warning to humanity -
ayahs.transliteration: nazee-ral lil-ba-shar

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوۡ يَتَأَخَّرَ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: لمن شاء منكم ان يتقدم او يتاخر
ayahs.translation: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
ayahs.transliteration: li-man shaaaa min-kum a-ny ya-ta-qad-da-ma aw ya-taak-hkhar

ayahs.text_uthmani: كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ رَهِينَةٌ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: كل نفس بما كسبت رهينة
ayahs.translation: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained
ayahs.transliteration: kul-lu naf-sim bi-ma ka-sa-bat rahee-nah

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡيَمِينِ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: الا اصحب اليمين
ayahs.translation: Except the companions of the right,.
ayahs.transliteration: il-laaa a-shaa-bal ya-meen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي جَنَّٰتٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: في جنت يتساءلون
ayahs.translation: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
ayahs.transliteration: fee jan-naa-ti-ny ya-ta-saaaa-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَنِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: عن المجرمين
ayahs.translation: About the criminals,
ayahs.transliteration: a-nil muj-rimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا سَلَكَكُمۡ فِي سَقَرَ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: ما سلككم في سقر
ayahs.translation: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
ayahs.transliteration: maa sa-la-ka-kum fee sa-qar

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ لَمۡ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُصَلِّينَ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا لم نك من المصلين
ayahs.translation: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-loo lam na-ku mi-nal mu-sal-leen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَمۡ نَكُ نُطۡعِمُ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينَ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولم نك نطعم المسكين
ayahs.translation: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lam na-ku nu-ti-mul mis-keen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلۡخَآئِضِينَ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: وكنا نخوض مع الخائضين
ayahs.translation: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kun-naa na-khoo-du maal khaaaideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: وكنا نكذب بيوم الدين
ayahs.translation: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kun-naa nu-kaz-zi-bu biyaw-mid deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلۡيَقِينُ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: حتي اتينا اليقين
ayahs.translation: Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death]."
ayahs.transliteration: hat-taaa a-taa-nal ya-qeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمۡ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: فما تنفعهم شفعة الشفعين
ayahs.translation: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-maa tan-fau-hum sha-faaa-tush shaa-fieen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلتَّذۡكِرَةِ مُعۡرِضِينَ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: فما لهم عن التذكرة معرضين
ayahs.translation: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
ayahs.transliteration: fa-maa la-hum a-nit taz-ki-ra-ti mu-rideen

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمۡ حُمُرٞ مُّسۡتَنفِرَةٞ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: كانهم حمر مستنفرة
ayahs.translation: As if they were alarmed donkeys
ayahs.transliteration: kaan-na-hum hu-mu-rum mus-tan-fi-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَرَّتۡ مِن قَسۡوَرَةِۭ ٥١
ayahs.text_simple: فرت من قسورة
ayahs.translation: Fleeing from a lion?
ayahs.transliteration: far-rat min qas-wa-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُؤۡتَىٰ صُحُفٗا مُّنَشَّرَةٗ ٥٢
ayahs.text_simple: بل يريد كل امري منهم ان يؤتي صحفا منشرة
ayahs.translation: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
ayahs.transliteration: bal yu-ree-du kul-lum riim mi-nhum a-ny yu-taa su-hu-fam mu-nas-hsha-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّاۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ ٥٣
ayahs.text_simple: كلا بل لا يخافون الاخرة
ayahs.translation: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laa bal laa ya-khaa-foo-nal aa-khi-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذۡكِرَةٞ ٥٤
ayahs.text_simple: كلا انه تذكرة
ayahs.translation: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laaa in-na-hoo taz-ki-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ ٥٥
ayahs.text_simple: فمن شاء ذكره
ayahs.translation: Then whoever wills will remember it.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-man shaaaa za-ka-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَذۡكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ هُوَ أَهۡلُ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ وَأَهۡلُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِ ٥٦
ayahs.text_simple: وما يذكرون الا ان يشاء الله هو اهل التقوي واهل المغفرة
ayahs.translation: And they will not remember except that Allāh wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa yaz-ku-roo-na il-laaa a-ny ya-shaaaal laah hu-wa ah-lut taq-waa waah-lul mag-hfi-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: لا اقسم بيوم القيمة
ayahs.translation: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
ayahs.transliteration: laaa uq-si-mu biyaw-mil qiyaa-mah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلنَّفۡسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: ولا اقسم بالنفس اللوامة
ayahs.translation: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laaa uq-si-mu bin-naf-sil law-waa-mah

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَيَحۡسَبُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجۡمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: ايحسب الانسن الن نجمع عظامه
ayahs.translation: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?
ayahs.transliteration: ayah-sa-bul in-saa-nu al-lan naj-ma i-zaa-mah

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُۥ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: بلي قدرين علي ان نسوي بنانه
ayahs.translation: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
ayahs.transliteration: ba-laa qaa-di-ree-na a-laaa an nu-saw-wiya ba-naa-nah

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ يُرِيدُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفۡجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: بل يريد الانسن ليفجر امامه
ayahs.translation: But man desires to continue in sin.
ayahs.transliteration: bal yu-ree-dul in-saa-nu liyaf-ju-ra a-maa-mah

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَسۡـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: يسل ايان يوم القيمة
ayahs.translation: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
ayahs.transliteration: ya-sa-lu ayyyaa-na yaw-mul qiyaa-mah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: فاذا برق البصر
ayahs.translation: So when vision is dazzled
ayahs.transliteration: fai-zaa ba-ri-qal ba-sar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَخَسَفَ ٱلۡقَمَرُ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: وخسف القمر
ayahs.translation: And the moon darkens
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kha-sa-fal qa-mar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: وجمع الشمس والقمر
ayahs.translation: And the sun and the moon are joined,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ju-mi-ash sham-su wal-qa-mar

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَقُولُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ يَوۡمَئِذٍ أَيۡنَ ٱلۡمَفَرُّ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: يقول الانسن يومئذ اين المفر
ayahs.translation: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"
ayahs.transliteration: ya-qoo-lul in-saa-nu yaw-mai-zin ay-nal ma-farr

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: كلا لا وزر
ayahs.translation: No! There is no refuge.
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laa laa wa-zar

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقَرُّ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: الي ربك يومئذ المستقر
ayahs.translation: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.
ayahs.transliteration: i-laa rab-bi-ka yaw-mai-zi-nil mus-ta-qarr

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُنَبَّؤُاْ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: ينبؤا الانسن يومئذ بما قدم واخر
ayahs.translation: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.
ayahs.transliteration: yu-nab-baul in-saa-nu yaw-mai-zim bi-maa qad-da-ma waak-hkhar

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٞ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: بل الانسن علي نفسه بصيرة
ayahs.translation: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,
ayahs.transliteration: ba-lil in-saa-nu a-laa naf-sihee basee-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَوۡ أَلۡقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولو القي معاذيره
ayahs.translation: Even if he presents his excuses.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-law al-qaa maaazee-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَا تُحَرِّكۡ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعۡجَلَ بِهِۦٓ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: لا تحرك به لسانك لتعجل به
ayahs.translation: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muḥammad], to hasten with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān].
ayahs.transliteration: laa tu-har-rik bihee li-saa-na-ka li-ta-ja-la bih

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا جَمۡعَهُۥ وَقُرۡءَانَهُۥ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان علينا جمعه وقرءانه
ayahs.translation: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na a-lai-naa ja-ma-hoo wa-qu-raa-nah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا قَرَأۡنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعۡ قُرۡءَانَهُۥ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: فاذا قرانه فاتبع قرءانه
ayahs.translation: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
ayahs.transliteration: fai-zaa qa-raa-naa-hu fat-ta-bi qu-raa-nah

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا بَيَانَهُۥ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: ثم ان علينا بيانه
ayahs.translation: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma in-na a-lai-naa bayaa-nah

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّا بَلۡ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: كلا بل تحبون العاجلة
ayahs.translation: No! But you [i.e., mankind] love the immediate
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laa bal tu-hib-boo-nal aa-ji-lah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: وتذرون الاخرة
ayahs.translation: And leave [i.e., neglect] the Hereafter.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-za-roo-nal aa-khi-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ نَّاضِرَةٌ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: وجوه يومئذ ناضرة
ayahs.translation: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
ayahs.transliteration: wu-joo-hu-ny yaw-mai-zin naa-di-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٞ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: الي ربها ناظرة
ayahs.translation: Looking at their Lord.
ayahs.transliteration: i-laa rab-bi-haa naa-zi-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَوُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بَاسِرَةٞ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: ووجوه يومئذ باسرة
ayahs.translation: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-wu-joo-hu-ny yaw-mai-zim baa-si-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفۡعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٞ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: تظن ان يفعل بها فاقرة
ayahs.translation: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.
ayahs.transliteration: ta-zun-nu a-ny yu-fa-la bi-haa faa-qi-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِيَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: كلا اذا بلغت التراقي
ayahs.translation: No! When it [i.e., the soul] has reached the collar bones
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laaa i-zaa ba-la-gha-tit ta-raaqee

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ مَنۡۜ رَاقٖ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: وقيل من راق
ayahs.translation: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"
ayahs.transliteration: waqee-la man raaq

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡفِرَاقُ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: وظن انه الفراق
ayahs.translation: And he [i.e., the dying one] is certain that it is the [time of] separation
ayahs.transliteration: wa-zan-na an-na-hul fi-raaq

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: والتفت الساق بالساق
ayahs.translation: And the leg is wound about the leg,
ayahs.transliteration: wal-taf-fa-tis saa-qu bis-saaq

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ٱلۡمَسَاقُ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: الي ربك يومئذ المساق
ayahs.translation: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.
ayahs.transliteration: i-laa rab-bi-ka yaw-mai-zi-nil ma-saaq

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: فلا صدق ولا صلي
ayahs.translation: And he [i.e., the disbeliever] had not believed, nor had he prayed.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-laa sad-da-qa wa-laa sal-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: ولكن كذب وتولي
ayahs.translation: But [instead], he denied and turned away.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa-kin kaz-za-ba wa-ta-wal-la

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: ثم ذهب الي اهله يتمطي
ayahs.translation: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma za-ha-ba i-laaa ah-lihee ya-ta-mat-ta

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوۡلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوۡلَىٰ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: اولي لك فاولي
ayahs.translation: Woe to you, and woe!
ayahs.transliteration: aw-laa la-ka faaw-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَوۡلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوۡلَىٰٓ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: ثم اولي لك فاولي
ayahs.translation: Then woe to you, and woe!
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma aw-laa la-ka faaw-la

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَيَحۡسَبُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتۡرَكَ سُدًى ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: ايحسب الانسن ان يترك سدي
ayahs.translation: Does man think that he will be left neglected?
ayahs.transliteration: ayah-sa-bul in-saa-nu ai yut-ra-ka su-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ يَكُ نُطۡفَةٗ مِّن مَّنِيّٖ يُمۡنَىٰ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: الم يك نطفة من مني يمني
ayahs.translation: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam ya-ku nut-fa-tam mim ma-niyyi-ny yum-naa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةٗ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: ثم كان علقة فخلق فسوي
ayahs.translation: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allāh] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma kaa-na a-la-qa-tan fa-kha-la-qa fa-saw-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَ مِنۡهُ ٱلزَّوۡجَيۡنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰٓ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: فجعل منه الزوجين الذكر والانثي
ayahs.translation: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-jaa-la mi-nhuz zaw-jay-niz za-ka-ra wa-lun-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَيۡسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحۡـِۧيَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: اليس ذلك بقدر علي ان يحي الموتي
ayahs.translation: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
ayahs.transliteration: a-lai-sa zaa-li-ka bi-qaa-di-rin a-laaa a-ny yu-hyiyal maw-taa

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَلۡ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡإِنسَٰنِ حِينٞ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهۡرِ لَمۡ يَكُن شَيۡـٔٗا مَّذۡكُورًا ١
ayahs.text_simple: هل اتي علي الانسن حين من الدهر لم يكن شيا مذكورا
ayahs.translation: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
ayahs.transliteration: hal a-taa a-lal in-saa-ni hee-num mi-nad dah-ri lam ya-kun shai-am maz-koo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ أَمۡشَاجٖ نَّبۡتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ سَمِيعَۢا بَصِيرًا ٢
ayahs.text_simple: انا خلقنا الانسن من نطفة امشاج نبتليه فجعلنه سميعا بصيرا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa kha-laq-nal in-saa-na min nut-fa-tin am-shaa-jin nab-ta-lee-hi fa-jaal-naa-hu sameeam basee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا هَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرٗا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا ٣
ayahs.text_simple: انا هدينه السبيل اما شاكرا واما كفورا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa ha-dai-naa-hus sabee-la im-maa shaa-ki-ranw waim-maa ka-foo-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَاْ وَأَغۡلَٰلٗا وَسَعِيرًا ٤
ayahs.text_simple: انا اعتدنا للكفرين سلسلا واغللا وسعيرا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naaa a-tad-naa lil-kaa-fi-ree-na sa-laa-si-la waag-hlaa-lanw wa-saee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ يَشۡرَبُونَ مِن كَأۡسٖ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا ٥
ayahs.text_simple: ان الابرار يشربون من كاس كان مزاجها كافورا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kāfūr,
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal ab-raa-ra yas-hra-boo-na min kaa-sin kaa-na mi-zaa-ju-haa kaa-foo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَيۡنٗا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفۡجِيرٗا ٦
ayahs.text_simple: عينا يشرب بها عباد الله يفجرونها تفجيرا
ayahs.translation: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allāh will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
ayahs.transliteration: ay-na-ny yas-hra-bu bi-haa i-baa-dul laa-hi yu-faj-ji-roo-na-haa taf-jee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذۡرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوۡمٗا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسۡتَطِيرٗا ٧
ayahs.text_simple: يوفون بالنذر ويخافون يوما كان شره مستطيرا
ayahs.translation: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
ayahs.transliteration: yoo-foo-na bin-naz-ri waya-khaa-foo-na yaw-man kaa-na shar-ru-hoo mus-ta-tee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيُطۡعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسۡكِينٗا وَيَتِيمٗا وَأَسِيرًا ٨
ayahs.text_simple: ويطعمون الطعام علي حبه مسكينا ويتيما واسيرا
ayahs.translation: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
ayahs.transliteration: wayut-"i-moo-nat taaa-ma a-laa hub-bihee mis-kee-nanw wayatee-manw waasee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا نُطۡعِمُكُمۡ لِوَجۡهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمۡ جَزَآءٗ وَلَا شُكُورًا ٩
ayahs.text_simple: انما نطعمكم لوجه الله لا نريد منكم جزاء ولا شكورا
ayahs.translation: [Saying], "We feed you only for the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa-maa nu-ti-mu-kum li-wa-jhil laa-hi laa nuree-du min-kum ja-zaaaanw wa-laa shu-koo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوۡمًا عَبُوسٗا قَمۡطَرِيرٗا ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: انا نخاف من ربنا يوما عبوسا قمطريرا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa na-khaa-fu mir rab-bin-na yaw-man a-boo-san qam-ta-ree-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمۡ نَضۡرَةٗ وَسُرُورٗا ١١
ayahs.text_simple: فوقيهم الله شر ذلك اليوم ولقيهم نضرة وسرورا
ayahs.translation: So Allāh will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
ayahs.transliteration: fa-wa-qaa-hu-mul laa-hu shar-ra zaa-li-kal yaw-mi wa-laq-qaa-hum nad-ra-tanw wa-su-roo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُواْ جَنَّةٗ وَحَرِيرٗا ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: وجزيهم بما صبروا جنة وحريرا
ayahs.translation: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ja-zaa-hum bi-maa sa-ba-roo ja-na-tanw wa-ha-ree-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِۖ لَا يَرَوۡنَ فِيهَا شَمۡسٗا وَلَا زَمۡهَرِيرٗا ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: متكين فيها علي الارائك لا يرون فيها شمسا ولا زمهريرا
ayahs.translation: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
ayahs.transliteration: mut-ta-kiee-na fee-ha a-lal a-raaai-ki laa ya-raw-na fee-haa sham-sanw wa-laa za-mha-ree-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيۡهِمۡ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتۡ قُطُوفُهَا تَذۡلِيلٗا ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: ودانية عليهم ظللها وذللت قطوفها تذليلا
ayahs.translation: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-daa-niya-tan a-lai-him zi-laa-lu-haa wa-zul-li-lat qu-too-fu-haa taz-lee-la

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٖ مِّن فِضَّةٖ وَأَكۡوَابٖ كَانَتۡ قَوَارِيرَا۠ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: ويطاف عليهم بانية من فضة واكواب كانت قواريرا
ayahs.translation: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
ayahs.transliteration: wayu-taa-fu a-lai-him bi-a-a-niya-tim min fid-da-tinw waak-waa-bin kaa-nat qa-waa-ree-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَوَارِيرَاْ مِن فِضَّةٖ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقۡدِيرٗا ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: قواريرا من فضة قدروها تقديرا
ayahs.translation: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
ayahs.transliteration: qa-waa-ree-ra min fid-da-tin qad-da-roo-haa taq-dee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيُسۡقَوۡنَ فِيهَا كَأۡسٗا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: ويسقون فيها كاسا كان مزاجها زنجبيلا
ayahs.translation: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
ayahs.transliteration: wayus-kaw-na fee-haa kaa-san kaa-na mi-zaa-ju-haa zan-ja-bee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَيۡنٗا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلۡسَبِيلٗا ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: عينا فيها تسمي سلسبيلا
ayahs.translation: [From] a fountain within it [i.e., Paradise] named Salsabeel.
ayahs.transliteration: ay-nan fee-ha tu-sam-maa sal-sa-bee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَٰنٞ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ حَسِبۡتَهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٗا مَّنثُورٗا ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: ويطوف عليهم ولدن مخلدون اذا رايتهم حسبتهم لؤلؤا منثورا
ayahs.translation: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
ayahs.transliteration: waya-too-fu a-lai-him wil-daa-num mu-khal-la-doo-na i-zaa raay-ta-hum ha-sib-ta-hum lu-lu-am man-soo-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيۡتَ نَعِيمٗا وَمُلۡكٗا كَبِيرًا ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: واذا رايت ثم رايت نعيما وملكا كبيرا
ayahs.translation: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa raay-ta sam-ma raay-ta naee-manw wa-mul-kan kabee-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَٰلِيَهُمۡ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضۡرٞ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقٞۖ وَحُلُّوٓاْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٖ وَسَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ شَرَابٗا طَهُورًا ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: عليهم ثياب سندس خضر واستبرق وحلوا اساور من فضة وسقيهم ربهم شرابا طهورا
ayahs.translation: Upon them [i.e., the inhabitants] will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
ayahs.transliteration: aa-liya-hum siyaa-bu sun-du-sin khud-runw wais-tab-raq wa-hul-looo a-saa-wi-ra min fid-da-tinw wa-sa-qaa-hum rab-bu-hum sha-raa-ban ta-hoo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمۡ جَزَآءٗ وَكَانَ سَعۡيُكُم مَّشۡكُورًا ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: ان هذا كان لكم جزاء وكان سعيكم مشكورا
ayahs.translation: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa haa-zaa kaa-na la-kum jaz-zanw wa-kaa-na sayu-kum mas-hkoo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَنزِيلٗا ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: انا نحن نزلنا عليك القرءان تنزيلا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Qur’ān progressively.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa nah-nu naz-zal-naa a-lai-kal qu-raa-na tan-zee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مِنۡهُمۡ ءَاثِمًا أَوۡ كَفُورٗا ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: فاصبر لحكم ربك ولا تطع منهم ءاثما او كفورا
ayahs.translation: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
ayahs.transliteration: fas-bir li-huk-mi rab-bi-ka wa-laa tu-ti mi-nhum aa-si-man aw ka-foo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ بُكۡرَةٗ وَأَصِيلٗا ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: واذكر اسم ربك بكرة واصيلا
ayahs.translation: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
ayahs.transliteration: waz-ku-ri is-ma rab-bi-ka buk-ra-tanw waasee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَٱسۡجُدۡ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحۡهُ لَيۡلٗا طَوِيلًا ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: ومن اليل فاسجد له وسبحه ليلا طويلا
ayahs.translation: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt [i.e., praise] Him a long [part of the] night.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mi-nal lai-li fas-jud la-hoo wa-sab-bi-hhu lai-lan tawee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ يَوۡمٗا ثَقِيلٗا ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان هؤلاء يحبون العاجلة ويذرون وراءهم يوما ثقيلا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na haaau-laai yu-hib-boo-na aa-ji-la-ta waya-za-roo-na wa-raaaa-hum yaw-man saqee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: نَّحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰهُمۡ وَشَدَدۡنَآ أَسۡرَهُمۡۖ وَإِذَا شِئۡنَا بَدَّلۡنَآ أَمۡثَٰلَهُمۡ تَبۡدِيلًا ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: نحن خلقنهم وشددنا اسرهم واذا شئنا بدلنا امثلهم تبديلا
ayahs.translation: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
ayahs.transliteration: nah-nu kha-laq-naa-hum wa-sha-dad-naaa as-ra-hum wai-zaa shi-naa bad-dal-naaa am-saa-la-hum tab-dee-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةٞۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلٗا ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: ان هذه تذكرة فمن شاء اتخذ الي ربه سبيلا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na haa-zihee taz-ki-ra-tun fa-man shaaaat ta-kha-za i-laa rab-bihee sabee-la

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمٗا ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: وما تشاءون الا ان يشاء الله ان الله كان عليما حكيما
ayahs.translation: And you do not will except that Allāh wills. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa ta-shaaaoo-na il-laa a-ny ya-shaaaal laah in-nal laa-haa kaa-na alee-man hakee-ma

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُدۡخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمَۢا ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: يدخل من يشاء في رحمته والظلمين اعد لهم عذابا اليما
ayahs.translation: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: yud-khi-lu mai ya-shaaau fee rah-ma-tih waz-zaa-li-mee-na aad-da la-hum a-zaa-ban alee-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡمُرۡسَلَٰتِ عُرۡفٗا ١
ayahs.text_simple: والمرسلت عرفا
ayahs.translation: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
ayahs.transliteration: wal-mur-sa-laa-ti ur-faa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱلۡعَٰصِفَٰتِ عَصۡفٗا ٢
ayahs.text_simple: فالعصفت عصفا
ayahs.translation: And the winds that blow violently
ayahs.transliteration: fa-laa-si-faa-ti as-faa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّٰشِرَٰتِ نَشۡرٗا ٣
ayahs.text_simple: والنشرت نشرا
ayahs.translation: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
ayahs.transliteration: wan-naa-shi-raa-ti nas-hraa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱلۡفَٰرِقَٰتِ فَرۡقٗا ٤
ayahs.text_simple: فالفرقت فرقا
ayahs.translation: And those [angels] who bring criterion
ayahs.transliteration: fal-faa-ri-qaa-ti far-qaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱلۡمُلۡقِيَٰتِ ذِكۡرًا ٥
ayahs.text_simple: فالملقيت ذكرا
ayahs.translation: And those [angels] who deliver a message
ayahs.transliteration: fal-mul-qiyaa-ti zik-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: عُذۡرًا أَوۡ نُذۡرًا ٦
ayahs.text_simple: عذرا او نذرا
ayahs.translation: As justification or warning,
ayahs.transliteration: uz-ran aw nuz-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٞ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: انما توعدون لوقع
ayahs.translation: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-maa too-a-doo-na la-waa-qi

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتۡ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: فاذا النجوم طمست
ayahs.translation: So when the stars are obliterated
ayahs.transliteration: fai-zam nu-joo-mu tu-mi-sat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتۡ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: واذا السماء فرجت
ayahs.translation: And when the heaven is opened
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zas sa-maaau fu-ri-jat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجِبَالُ نُسِفَتۡ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: واذا الجبال نسفت
ayahs.translation: And when the mountains are blown away
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zal ji-baa-lu nu-si-fat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتۡ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: واذا الرسل اقتت
ayahs.translation: And when the messengers' time has come...
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zar ru-su-lu uq-qi-tat

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِأَيِّ يَوۡمٍ أُجِّلَتۡ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: لاي يوم اجلت
ayahs.translation: For what Day was it postponed?
ayahs.transliteration: li-a-yyi yaw-min uj-ji-lat

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: ليوم الفصل
ayahs.translation: For the Day of Judgement.
ayahs.transliteration: liyaw-mil fasl

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: وما ادريك ما يوم الفصل
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa ad-raa-ka maa yaw-mul fasl

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
ayahs.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-lu-ny yaw-ma i-zil-lil-mu-kaz-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ نُهۡلِكِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: الم نهلك الاولين
ayahs.translation: Did We not destroy the former peoples?
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam nuh-li-kil aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نُتۡبِعُهُمُ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: ثم نتبعهم الاخرين
ayahs.translation: Then We will follow them with the later ones.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma nut-biu-hu-mul aa-khireen

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفۡعَلُ بِٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: كذلك نفعل بالمجرمين
ayahs.translation: Thus do We deal with the criminals.
ayahs.transliteration: kaz-za-li-ka naf a-lu bil-muj-rimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
ayahs.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-lunw yaw-mai-zil lil-mu-kaz-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ نَخۡلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٖ مَّهِينٖ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: الم نخلقكم من ماء مهين
ayahs.translation: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam nak-hluk-kum mim maaaim maheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ فِي قَرَارٖ مَّكِينٍ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: فجعلنه في قرار مكين
ayahs.translation: And We placed it in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb]
ayahs.transliteration: fa-jaal-naa-hu fee qa-raa-rim makeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: الي قدر معلوم
ayahs.translation: For a known extent.
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa qad-rim ma-loom

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقَدَرۡنَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡقَٰدِرُونَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: فقدرنا فنعم القدرون
ayahs.translation: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qa-dar-naa fa-ni-mal qaa-di-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
ayahs.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-lu-ny yaw-mai-zil lil-mu-kaz-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ كِفَاتًا ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: الم نجعل الارض كفاتا
ayahs.translation: Have We not made the earth a container
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam na-ja-lil ar-da ki-faa-taa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَحۡيَآءٗ وَأَمۡوَٰتٗا ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: احياء واموتا
ayahs.translation: Of the living and the dead?
ayahs.transliteration: a-hyaaaanw waam-waa-taa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ شَٰمِخَٰتٖ وَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُم مَّآءٗ فُرَاتٗا ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: وجعلنا فيها روسي شمخت واسقينكم ماء فراتا
ayahs.translation: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaal-naa fee-haa ra-waa-siya shaa-mi-khaa-tinw waas-qai-naa-kum maaaan fu-raa-taa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
ayahs.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-lu-ny yaw-mai-zil lil-mu-kaz-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: انطلقوا الي ما كنتم به تكذبون
ayahs.translation: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.
ayahs.transliteration: in-ta-li-qooo i-laa maa kun-tum bihee tu-kaz-zi-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ ظِلّٖ ذِي ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٖ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: انطلقوا الي ظل ذي ثلث شعب
ayahs.translation: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns
ayahs.transliteration: in-ta-li-qooo i-laa zil-lin zee sa-laa-si shu-ab

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا ظَلِيلٖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: لا ظليل ولا يغني من اللهب
ayahs.translation: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
ayahs.transliteration: laa zalee-linw wa-laa yug-hnee mi-nal la-hab

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهَا تَرۡمِي بِشَرَرٖ كَٱلۡقَصۡرِ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: انها ترمي بشرر كالقصر
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-haa tar-mee bi-sha-ra-rin kal-qasr

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَٰلَتٞ صُفۡرٞ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: كانه جملت صفر
ayahs.translation: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
ayahs.transliteration: kaan-na-hoo ji-maa-la-tun sufr

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
ayahs.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-lu-ny yaw-mai-zil lil-mu-ka-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: هذا يوم لا ينطقون
ayahs.translation: This is a Day they will not speak,
ayahs.transliteration: haa-zaa yaw-mu laa yan-ti-qoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا يُؤۡذَنُ لَهُمۡ فَيَعۡتَذِرُونَ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولا يؤذن لهم فيعتذرون
ayahs.translation: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa yu-za-nu la-hum faya-ta-zi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
ayahs.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-lunw yaw-mai-zil lil-mu-kaz-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِۖ جَمَعۡنَٰكُمۡ وَٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: هذا يوم الفصل جمعنكم والاولين
ayahs.translation: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
ayahs.transliteration: haa-za yaw-mul fas-li ja-ma-naa-kum wa-law-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمۡ كَيۡدٞ فَكِيدُونِ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: فان كان لكم كيد فكيدون
ayahs.translation: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
ayahs.transliteration: fain kaa-na la-kum kai-dun fakee-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
ayahs.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-lu-ny yaw-mai-zil lil-mu-kaz-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَٰلٖ وَعُيُونٖ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: ان المتقين في ظلل وعيون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal mut-ta-qee-na fee zi-laa-linw wauyoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: وفوكه مما يشتهون
ayahs.translation: And fruits from whatever they desire,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-fa-waa-ki-ha mim-maa yas-hta-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: كلوا واشربوا هنيا بما كنتم تعملون
ayahs.translation: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
ayahs.transliteration: ku-loo was-hra-boo haneeeam bi-maa kun-tum ta-ma-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: انا كذلك نجزي المحسنين
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa ka-zaa-li-ka naj-zil muh-sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
ayahs.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-lu-ny yaw-mai-zil lil-muz-kaz-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: كُلُواْ وَتَمَتَّعُواْ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجۡرِمُونَ ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: كلوا وتمتعوا قليلا انكم مجرمون
ayahs.translation: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
ayahs.transliteration: ku-loo wa-ta-mat-taoo qalee-lan in-na-kum muj-ri-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ٤٧
ayahs.text_simple: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
ayahs.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-lun-ny yaw-mai-zil lil-mu-kaz-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرۡكَعُواْ لَا يَرۡكَعُونَ ٤٨
ayahs.text_simple: واذا قيل لهم اركعوا لا يركعون
ayahs.translation: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa qee-la la-hu-mur kaoo laa yar-kaoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ٤٩
ayahs.text_simple: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
ayahs.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-lun-ny yaw-mai-zil lil-mu-kaz-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَهُۥ يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٥٠
ayahs.text_simple: فباي حديث بعده يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: Then in what statement after it [i.e., the Qur’ān] will they believe?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bi-a-yyi hadee-sim ba-da-hoo yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ ١
ayahs.text_simple: عم يتساءلون
ayahs.translation: About what are they asking one another?
ayahs.transliteration: am-ma ya-ta-saaa-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: عن النبا العظيم
ayahs.translation: About the great news -
ayahs.transliteration: a-nin na-baail azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي هُمۡ فِيهِ مُخۡتَلِفُونَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: الذي هم فيه مختلفون
ayahs.translation: That over which they are in disagreement.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zi hum fee-hi muk-hta-li-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّا سَيَعۡلَمُونَ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: كلا سيعلمون
ayahs.translation: No! They are going to know.
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laa saya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كـَلَّا سَيَعۡلَمُونَ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: ثم كلا سيعلمون
ayahs.translation: Then, no! They are going to know.
ayahs.transliteration: thum-ma kal-laa saya-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مِهَٰدٗا ٦
ayahs.text_simple: الم نجعل الارض مهدا
ayahs.translation: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam na-ja-lil ar-da mi-haa-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡجِبَالَ أَوۡتَادٗا ٧
ayahs.text_simple: والجبال اوتادا
ayahs.translation: And the mountains as stakes?
ayahs.transliteration: wal-ji-baa-la au-taa-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَخَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا ٨
ayahs.text_simple: وخلقنكم ازوجا
ayahs.translation: And We created you in pairs
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kha-laq-naa-kum az-waa-ja

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلۡنَا نَوۡمَكُمۡ سُبَاتٗا ٩
ayahs.text_simple: وجعلنا نومكم سباتا
ayahs.translation: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaal-na nau-ma-kum su-ba-ta

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلَّيۡلَ لِبَاسٗا ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: وجعلنا اليل لباسا
ayahs.translation: And made the night as clothing
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaal-nal lai-la li-ba-sa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشٗا ١١
ayahs.text_simple: وجعلنا النهار معاشا
ayahs.translation: And made the day for livelihood
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaal-nan na-ha-ra maaa-sha

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَبَنَيۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعٗا شِدَادٗا ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: وبنينا فوقكم سبعا شدادا
ayahs.translation: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ba-nai-na fau-qa-kum sa-ban shi-daa-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلۡنَا سِرَاجٗا وَهَّاجٗا ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: وجعلنا سراجا وهاجا
ayahs.translation: And made [therein] a burning lamp
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaal-na si-raa-jaw wa-hhaa-ja

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُعۡصِرَٰتِ مَآءٗ ثَجَّاجٗا ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: وانزلنا من المعصرت ماء ثجاجا
ayahs.translation: And sent down from the rain clouds pouring water
ayahs.transliteration: waan-zal-na mi-nal mu-si-raa-ti maaan thaj-jaa-ja

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِّنُخۡرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبّٗا وَنَبَاتٗا ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: لنخرج به حبا ونباتا
ayahs.translation: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
ayahs.transliteration: li-nuk-hri-ja bihee hab-baw wa-na-baa-ta

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلۡفَافًا ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: وجنت الفافا
ayahs.translation: And gardens of entwined growth.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jan-naa-tin al-fa-fa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتٗا ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان يوم الفصل كان ميقتا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
ayahs.transliteration: in-na yau-mal fas-li ka-na mee-qaa-ta

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأۡتُونَ أَفۡوَاجٗا ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: يوم ينفخ في الصور فتاتون افواجا
ayahs.translation: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
ayahs.transliteration: yau-ma yun-fa-khu fis soo-ri fa-taa-too-na af-waa-ja

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبٗا ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: وفتحت السماء فكانت ابوبا
ayahs.translation: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
ayahs.transliteration: wa-fu-ti-ha-tis sa-maau fa-kaa-nat ab-waa-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ فَكَانَتۡ سَرَابًا ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: وسيرت الجبال فكانت سرابا
ayahs.translation: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-suyyi-raa-til ji-baa-lu fa-kaa-nat sa-raa-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتۡ مِرۡصَادٗا ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: ان جهنم كانت مرصادا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
ayahs.transliteration: in-na ja-han-na-ma kaa-nat mir-saa-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابٗا ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: للطغين مابا
ayahs.translation: For the transgressors, a place of return,
ayahs.transliteration: lit-taa-ghee-na maaa-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحۡقَابٗا ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: لبثين فيها احقابا
ayahs.translation: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
ayahs.transliteration: laa-bi-thee-na fee-haa ah-qaa-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرۡدٗا وَلَا شَرَابًا ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: لا يذوقون فيها بردا ولا شرابا
ayahs.translation: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink.
ayahs.transliteration: laa ya-zoo-qoo-na fee-ha bar-daw wa-laa sha-raa-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا حَمِيمٗا وَغَسَّاقٗا ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: الا حميما وغساقا
ayahs.translation: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
ayahs.transliteration: il-la hamee-maw wa-ghas-saa-qa

ayahs.text_uthmani: جَزَآءٗ وِفَاقًا ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: جزاء وفاقا
ayahs.translation: An appropriate recompense.
ayahs.transliteration: ja-zaaaw wi-faa-qa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ حِسَابٗا ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: انهم كانوا لا يرجون حسابا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hum kaa-nu laa yar-joo-na hi-saa-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابٗا ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: وكذبوا بايتنا كذابا
ayahs.translation: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kaz-za-bu bi-a-ayaa-ti-na kiz-za-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ كِتَٰبٗا ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: وكل شيء احصينه كتبا
ayahs.translation: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kul-la shaiin ah-sai-naa-hu ki-taa-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَذُوقُواْ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمۡ إِلَّا عَذَابًا ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: فذوقوا فلن نزيدكم الا عذابا
ayahs.translation: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-zoo-qoo fa-lan nazee-da-kum il-llaa a-zaa-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: ان للمتقين مفازا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
ayahs.transliteration: in-na lil-mut-ta-qee-na ma-faa-za

ayahs.text_uthmani: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعۡنَٰبٗا ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: حدائق واعنبا
ayahs.translation: Gardens and grapevines
ayahs.transliteration: ha-daai-qa waaa-naa-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتۡرَابٗا ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: وكواعب اترابا
ayahs.translation: And young women [companions] of equal age.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kaa-wai-ba at-raa-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَأۡسٗا دِهَاقٗا ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: وكاسا دهاقا
ayahs.translation: And a full cup.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ka-san di-haa-qa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا كِذَّٰبٗا ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا ولا كذبا
ayahs.translation: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
ayahs.transliteration: laa yas-maoo-na fi-ha lag-hwaw wa-laa kiz-za-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: جَزَآءٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابٗا ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: جزاء من ربك عطاء حسابا
ayahs.translation: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,
ayahs.transliteration: ja-zaaam mir rab-bi-ka a-taaan hi-saa-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابٗا ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: رب السموت والارض وما بينهما الرحمن لا يملكون منه خطابا
ayahs.translation: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
ayahs.transliteration: rab-bis sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lar-di wa-maa bai-na-hu-mar rah-maa-ni laa yam-li-koo-na mi-nhu khi-taa-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗاۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابٗا ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: يوم يقوم الروح والملئكة صفا لا يتكلمون الا من اذن له الرحمن وقال صوابا
ayahs.translation: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
ayahs.transliteration: yau-ma ya-qoo-mur roo-hu wal-ma-laai-ka-tu saf-fal laa ya-ta-kal-la-moo-na il-llaa man a-zi-na la-hur rah-maa-nu wa-qaa-la sa-waa-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: ذلك اليوم الحق فمن شاء اتخذ الي ربه مابا
ayahs.translation: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
ayahs.transliteration: zaa-li-kal yau-mul haq-qu fa-man shaaat ta-khaa-za il-llaa rab-bi-hi maaa-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابٗا قَرِيبٗا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: انا انذرنكم عذابا قريبا يوم ينظر المرء ما قدمت يداه ويقول الكافر يليتني كنت تربا
