ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa an-zar-naa-kum a-zaa-ban qaree-baiy yau-ma yan-zu-rul mar-ru maa qad-da-mat ya-daa-hu waya qoo-lul-kaa-fi-ru yaa-lai-tanee kun-tu tu-raa-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرۡقٗا ١
ayahs.text_simple: والنزعت غرقا
ayahs.translation: By those [angels] who extract with violence
ayahs.transliteration: wan-naa-zi-a-a-ti ghar-qa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشۡطٗا ٢
ayahs.text_simple: والنشطت نشطا
ayahs.translation: And [by] those who remove with ease
ayahs.transliteration: wan-naa-shi-taa-ti nas-hta

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبۡحٗا ٣
ayahs.text_simple: والسبحت سبحا
ayahs.translation: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
ayahs.transliteration: was-ssaa-bi-haa-ti sa-bha

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبۡقٗا ٤
ayahs.text_simple: فالسبقت سبقا
ayahs.translation: And those who race each other in a race
ayahs.transliteration: fas-ssaa-bi-qaa-ti sab-qa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱلۡمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمۡرٗا ٥
ayahs.text_simple: فالمدبرت امرا
ayahs.translation: And those who arrange [each] matter,
ayahs.transliteration: fal-mu-dab-bi-raa-ti am-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: يوم ترجف الراجفة
ayahs.translation: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma tar-ju-fur raa-ji-fa

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَتۡبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: تتبعها الرادفة
ayahs.translation: There will follow it the subsequent [one].
ayahs.transliteration: tat-bau-har raa-di-fa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلُوبٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ وَاجِفَةٌ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: قلوب يومئذ واجفة
ayahs.translation: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,
ayahs.transliteration: qu-loo-bu-ny yau-maai-ziw waa-ji-fa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَبۡصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٞ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: ابصرها خشعة
ayahs.translation: Their eyes humbled.
ayahs.transliteration: ab-saa-ru-haa kha-shi-ah

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرۡدُودُونَ فِي ٱلۡحَافِرَةِ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: يقولون اءنا لمردودون في الحافرة
ayahs.translation: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
ayahs.transliteration: ya-qoo-loo-na ain-na la-mar-doo-doo-na fil haa-fi-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمٗا نَّخِرَةٗ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: اءذا كنا عظما نخرة
ayahs.translation: Even if we should be decayed bones?"
ayahs.transliteration: ai-zaa kun-na i-zaa man-na-khi-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَالُواْ تِلۡكَ إِذٗا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٞ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: قالوا تلك اذا كرة خاسرة
ayahs.translation: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
ayahs.transliteration: qaa-lu til-ka i-zan kar-ra-tun khaa-si-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: فانما هي زجرة وحدة
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
ayahs.transliteration: fain-na-ma hiya zaj-ra-tuw waa-hi-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: فاذا هم بالساهرة
ayahs.translation: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
ayahs.transliteration: fai-zaa hum bis-ssaa-hi-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: هل اتيك حديث موسي
ayahs.translation: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -
ayahs.transliteration: hal a-taa-ka hadee-thu mu-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: اذ ناديه ربه بالواد المقدس طوي
ayahs.translation: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwā,
ayahs.transliteration: iz na-daa-hu rab-bu-hu bil-waa-dil mu-qad-da-si tu-wa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: اذهب الي فرعون انه طغي
ayahs.translation: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
ayahs.transliteration: i-zhab i-laa fi-rau-na in-na-hu ta-ghaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقُلۡ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: فقل هل لك الي ان تزكي
ayahs.translation: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qul hal la-ka i-laa an ta-zak-ka

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَهۡدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخۡشَىٰ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: واهديك الي ربك فتخشي
ayahs.translation: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"
ayahs.transliteration: waah-diya-ka i-la rab-bi-ka fa-tak-hsha

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلۡأٓيَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: فاريه الاية الكبري
ayahs.translation: And he showed him the greatest sign,
ayahs.transliteration: faa-raa-hul aaya-tal kub-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: فكذب وعصي
ayahs.translation: But he [i.e., Pharaoh] denied and disobeyed.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kaz-za-ba waa-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدۡبَرَ يَسۡعَىٰ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: ثم ادبر يسعي
ayahs.translation: Then he turned his back, striving [i.e., plotting].
ayahs.transliteration: thum-ma ad-ba-ra ya-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: فحشر فنادي
ayahs.translation: And he gathered [his people] and called out
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ha-sha-ra fa-na-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: فقال انا ربكم الاعلي
ayahs.translation: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qa-la a-na rab-bu-ku-mul a-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰٓ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: فاخذه الله نكال الاخرة والاولي
ayahs.translation: So Allāh seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression]..
ayahs.transliteration: faa-kha-za-hul laa-hu na-ka-lal aa-khi-ra-ti wa-loo-la

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةٗ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰٓ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: ان في ذلك لعبرة لمن يخشي
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a lesson [i.e., warning] for whoever would fear [Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: in-na fee zaa-li-ka laib-ra-tal li-maiy yak-sha

ayahs.text_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُۚ بَنَىٰهَا ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: ءانتم اشد خلقا ام السماء بنيها
ayahs.translation: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? He [i.e., Allāh] constructed it.
ayahs.transliteration: aan-tum a-shad-du khal-qan a-mis sa-maau ba-naa-ha

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَفَعَ سَمۡكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: رفع سمكها فسويها
ayahs.translation: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
ayahs.transliteration: ra-fa sam-ka-ha fa-saw-waa-ha

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَغۡطَشَ لَيۡلَهَا وَأَخۡرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: واغطش ليلها واخرج ضحيها
ayahs.translation: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
ayahs.transliteration: waag-hta-sha lai-la-ha waak-hra-ja du-haa-ha

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: والارض بعد ذلك دحيها
ayahs.translation: And after that He spread the earth.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lar-da ba-da zaa-li-ka da-haa-ha

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَخۡرَجَ مِنۡهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرۡعَىٰهَا ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: اخرج منها ماءها ومرعيها
ayahs.translation: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
ayahs.transliteration: ak-hra-ja mi-nha maaa-ha wa-ma-raa-ha

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡجِبَالَ أَرۡسَىٰهَا ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: والجبال ارسيها
ayahs.translation: And the mountains He set firmly
ayahs.transliteration: wal-ji-ba-la ar-saa-ha

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَتَٰعٗا لَّكُمۡ وَلِأَنۡعَٰمِكُمۡ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: متعا لكم ولانعمكم
ayahs.translation: As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.
ayahs.transliteration: ma-taaal la-kum wa-li-a-naa-mi-kum

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: فاذا جاءت الطامة الكبري
ayahs.translation: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -
ayahs.transliteration: fai-zaa jaaaa-tit taaam-ma-tul kub-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: يوم يتذكر الانسن ما سعي
ayahs.translation: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
ayahs.transliteration: yau-ma ya-ta-zak-ka-rul in-saa-nu ma saaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلۡجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: وبرزت الجحيم لمن يري
ayahs.translation: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-bur-ri-za-til jahee-mu li-ma-ny ya-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: فاما من طغي
ayahs.translation: So as for he who transgressed
ayahs.transliteration: faam-maa man ta-ghaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: وءاثر الحيوة الدنيا
ayahs.translation: And preferred the life of the world,
ayahs.transliteration: waaa-sa-ral hayaa-tad du-nyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ هِيَ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: فان الجحيم هي الماوي
ayahs.translation: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
ayahs.transliteration: fain-nal jahee-ma hiyal maa-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفۡسَ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: واما من خاف مقام ربه ونهي النفس عن الهوي
ayahs.translation: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
ayahs.transliteration: waam-maa man khaa-fa ma-qaa-ma rab-bihee wa-na-han naf-sa a-nil ha-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ هِيَ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: فان الجنة هي الماوي
ayahs.translation: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.
ayahs.transliteration: fain-nal jan-na-ta hiyal ma-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرۡسَىٰهَا ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: يسلونك عن الساعة ايان مرسيها
ayahs.translation: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
ayahs.transliteration: ya-sa-loo-na-ka a-nis saaa-ti ayyaa-na mur-saa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكۡرَىٰهَآ ٤٣
ayahs.text_simple: فيم انت من ذكريها
ayahs.translation: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
ayahs.transliteration: fee-ma an-ta min zik-raa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ ٤٤
ayahs.text_simple: الي ربك منتهيها
ayahs.translation: To your Lord is its finality.
ayahs.transliteration: i-laa rab-bi-ka mun-ta-haa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخۡشَىٰهَا ٤٥
ayahs.text_simple: انما انت منذر من يخشيها
ayahs.translation: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-maaa an-ta mun-zi-ru maiy yak-shaa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَهَا لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوۡ ضُحَىٰهَا ٤٦
ayahs.text_simple: كانهم يوم يرونها لم يلبثوا الا عشية او ضحيها
ayahs.translation: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
ayahs.transliteration: kaan-na-hum yaw-ma ya-raw-na-haa lam yal-ba-sooo il-laa a-shiyya-tan aw du-haa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ ١
ayahs.text_simple: عبس وتولي
ayahs.translation: He [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ) ] frowned and turned away
ayahs.transliteration: a-ba-sa wa-ta-wal-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: ان جاءه الاعمي
ayahs.translation: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
ayahs.transliteration: an jaaa-hul a-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا يُدۡرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: وما يدريك لعله يزكي
ayahs.translation: But what would make you perceive, [O Muḥammad], that perhaps he might be purified
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa yud-ree-ka laal-la-hu yaz-zak-kaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوۡ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰٓ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: او يذكر فتنفعه الذكري
ayahs.translation: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
ayahs.transliteration: aw yaz-zak-ka-ru fa-tan-faa-huz zik-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: اما من استغني
ayahs.translation: As for he who thinks himself without need,
ayahs.transliteration: am-ma ma-nis tag-hnaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: فانت له تصدي
ayahs.translation: To him you give attention.
ayahs.transliteration: faan-ta la-hu ta-sad-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَيۡكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: وما عليك الا يزكي
ayahs.translation: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ma a-lai-ka al-laa yaz-zak-ka

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسۡعَىٰ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: واما من جاءك يسعي
ayahs.translation: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
ayahs.transliteration: waam-ma man jaaa-ka ya-sa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ يَخۡشَىٰ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: وهو يخشي
ayahs.translation: While he fears [Allāh],
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wa yak-hshaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ عَنۡهُ تَلَهَّىٰ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: فانت عنه تلهي
ayahs.translation: From him you are distracted.
ayahs.transliteration: faan-ta a-nhu ta-la-hhaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذۡكِرَةٞ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: كلا انها تذكرة
ayahs.translation: No! Indeed, they [i.e., these verses] are a reminder;
ayahs.transliteration: kal-la in-na-ha taz-ki-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: فمن شاء ذكره
ayahs.translation: So whoever wills may remember it.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-man shaaa za-ka-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي صُحُفٖ مُّكَرَّمَةٖ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: في صحف مكرمة
ayahs.translation: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,
ayahs.transliteration: fi su-hu-fim mu-kar-ra-ma

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَّرۡفُوعَةٖ مُّطَهَّرَةِۭ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: مرفوعة مطهرة
ayahs.translation: Exalted and purified,
ayahs.transliteration: mar-foo-a-tim mu-ta-hha-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: بِأَيۡدِي سَفَرَةٖ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: بايدي سفرة
ayahs.translation: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,
ayahs.transliteration: bi-a-i-dee sa-fa-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: كِرَامِۭ بَرَرَةٖ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: كرام بررة
ayahs.translation: Noble and dutiful.
ayahs.transliteration: ki-raa-mim ba-ra-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُتِلَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكۡفَرَهُۥ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: قتل الانسن ما اكفره
ayahs.translation: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] is man; how disbelieving is he.
ayahs.transliteration: qu-ti-lal in-sa-nu maa ak-fa-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: مِنۡ أَيِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: من اي شيء خلقه
ayahs.translation: From what thing [i.e., substance] did He create him?
ayahs.transliteration: min aiyyi shaiin kha-laq

ayahs.text_uthmani: مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: من نطفة خلقه فقدره
ayahs.translation: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
ayahs.transliteration: min nut-fa-tin kha-la-qa-hoo fa-qad-da-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: ثم السبيل يسره
ayahs.translation: Then He eased the way for him;
ayahs.transliteration: thum-mas sabee-la yas-sa-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقۡبَرَهُۥ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: ثم اماته فاقبره
ayahs.translation: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
ayahs.transliteration: thum-ma a-ma-ta-hu faaq-ba-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: ثم اذا شاء انشره
ayahs.translation: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
ayahs.transliteration: thum-ma i-za shaaa an-sha-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّا لَمَّا يَقۡضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: كلا لما يقض ما امره
ayahs.translation: No! He [i.e., man] has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
ayahs.transliteration: kal-la lam-ma yaq-di maa a-ma-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلۡيَنظُرِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: فلينظر الانسن الي طعامه
ayahs.translation: Then let mankind look at his food -
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lyan-zu-ril in-sa-nu i-laa taa-mih

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَنَّا صَبَبۡنَا ٱلۡمَآءَ صَبّٗا ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: انا صببنا الماء صبا
ayahs.translation: How We poured down water in torrents,
ayahs.transliteration: an-na sa-bab nal-maaa sab-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ شَقَقۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ شَقّٗا ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: ثم شققنا الارض شقا
ayahs.translation: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],
ayahs.transliteration: thum-ma sha qaq-na-lar-da shaq-qa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا حَبّٗا ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: فانبتنا فيها حبا
ayahs.translation: And caused to grow within it grain
ayahs.transliteration: faam-bat-na fee-ha hab-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَعِنَبٗا وَقَضۡبٗا ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: وعنبا وقضبا
ayahs.translation: And grapes and herbage
ayahs.transliteration: wai-na-baw-wa qad-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَزَيۡتُونٗا وَنَخۡلٗا ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: وزيتونا ونخلا
ayahs.translation: And olive and palm trees
ayahs.transliteration: wa-zai-too-naw wa-nak-hla

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلۡبٗا ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: وحدائق غلبا
ayahs.translation: And gardens of dense shrubbery
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ha-daai-qa ghul-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفَٰكِهَةٗ وَأَبّٗا ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: وفكهة وابا
ayahs.translation: And fruit and grass -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-fa-ki-ha-taw waab-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَّتَٰعٗا لَّكُمۡ وَلِأَنۡعَٰمِكُمۡ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: متعا لكم ولانعمكم
ayahs.translation: [As] enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.
ayahs.transliteration: ma-taal la-kum wa-li-a-na-mi-kum

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: فاذا جاءت الصاخة
ayahs.translation: But when there comes the Deafening Blast
ayahs.transliteration: fai-za jaaa-tis saa-khah

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مِنۡ أَخِيهِ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: يوم يفر المرء من اخيه
ayahs.translation: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
ayahs.transliteration: yau-ma ya-fir-rul ma-ru min a-kheeh

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: وامه وابيه
ayahs.translation: And his mother and his father
ayahs.transliteration: waum-mihee waabeeh

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: وصحبته وبنيه
ayahs.translation: And his wife and his children,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-sa-hi-ba-tihee wa-baneeh

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِكُلِّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ شَأۡنٞ يُغۡنِيهِ ٣٧
ayahs.text_simple: لكل امري منهم يومئذ شان يغنيه
ayahs.translation: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
ayahs.transliteration: li-kul lim-riim mi-nhum yaw-maai-zin shaa nuyyug-hneeh

ayahs.text_uthmani: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ مُّسۡفِرَةٞ ٣٨
ayahs.text_simple: وجوه يومئذ مسفرة
ayahs.translation: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -
ayahs.transliteration: wu-joo-hu-ny yau-mai-zim mus-fi-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: ضَاحِكَةٞ مُّسۡتَبۡشِرَةٞ ٣٩
ayahs.text_simple: ضاحكة مستبشرة
ayahs.translation: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.
ayahs.transliteration: da-hi-ka-tum mus-tab-shi-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَوُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٍ عَلَيۡهَا غَبَرَةٞ ٤٠
ayahs.text_simple: ووجوه يومئذ عليها غبرة
ayahs.translation: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-wu-joo-huy yau-mai-zin a-lai-ha gha-ba-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَرۡهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ ٤١
ayahs.text_simple: ترهقها قترة
ayahs.translation: Blackness will cover them.
ayahs.transliteration: ta-rha-qu-ha qa-ta-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡكَفَرَةُ ٱلۡفَجَرَةُ ٤٢
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك هم الكفرة الفجرة
ayahs.translation: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
ayahs.transliteration: u-laai-ka hu-mul ka-fa-ra-tul fa-ja-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ كُوِّرَتۡ ١
ayahs.text_simple: اذا الشمس كورت
ayahs.translation: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
ayahs.transliteration: i-zash sham-su kuw-wi-rat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتۡ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: واذا النجوم انكدرت
ayahs.translation: And when the stars fall, dispersing,
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zan nu-joo-mun ka-da-rat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتۡ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: واذا الجبال سيرت
ayahs.translation: And when the mountains are removed
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zal ji-baa-lu suyyi-rat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلۡعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتۡ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: واذا العشار عطلت
ayahs.translation: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zal i-shaa-ru ut-ti-lat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلۡوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتۡ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: واذا الوحوش حشرت
ayahs.translation: And when the wild beasts are gathered
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zal wu-hoo-shu hu-shi-rat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلۡبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتۡ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: واذا البحار سجرت
ayahs.translation: And when the seas are filled with flame
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zal bi-haa-ru suj-ji-rat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتۡ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: واذا النفوس زوجت
ayahs.translation: And when the souls are paired
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zan nu-foo-su zuw-wi-jat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلۡمَوۡءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتۡ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: واذا الموءدة سئلت
ayahs.translation: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zal ma-woo-da-tu su-i-lat

ayahs.text_uthmani: بِأَيِّ ذَنۢبٖ قُتِلَتۡ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: باي ذنب قتلت
ayahs.translation: For what sin she was killed
ayahs.transliteration: bi-a-yyi zam-bin qu-ti-lat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتۡ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: واذا الصحف نشرت
ayahs.translation: And when the pages are spread [i.e., made public]
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zas su-hu-fu nu-shi-rat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتۡ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: واذا السماء كشطت
ayahs.translation: And when the sky is stripped away
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zas sa-maaau ku-shi-tat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتۡ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: واذا الجحيم سعرت
ayahs.translation: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zal jahee-mu su-i-rat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَنَّةُ أُزۡلِفَتۡ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: واذا الجنة ازلفت
ayahs.translation: And when Paradise is brought near,
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zal jan-na-tu uz-li-fat

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٞ مَّآ أَحۡضَرَتۡ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: علمت نفس ما احضرت
ayahs.translation: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
ayahs.transliteration: a-li-mat naf-sum maaa ah-da-rat

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلۡخُنَّسِ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: فلا اقسم بالخنس
ayahs.translation: So I swear by the retreating stars -
ayahs.transliteration: fa-laaa uq-si-mu bil-khun-nas

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡكُنَّسِ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: الجوار الكنس
ayahs.translation: Those that run [their courses] and disappear [i.e., set]
ayahs.transliteration: al-ja-waa-ril kun-nas

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا عَسۡعَسَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: واليل اذا عسعس
ayahs.translation: And by the night as it closes in
ayahs.transliteration: wal-lai-li i-zaa a-sas

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلصُّبۡحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: والصبح اذا تنفس
ayahs.translation: And by the dawn when it breathes [i.e., stirs]
ayahs.transliteration: was-su-bhi i-zaa ta-naf-fas

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلُ رَسُولٖ كَرِيمٖ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: انه لقول رسول كريم
ayahs.translation: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel]
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hoo la-qaw-lu ra-soo-lin kareem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلۡعَرۡشِ مَكِينٖ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: ذي قوة عند ذي العرش مكين
ayahs.translation: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
ayahs.transliteration: zee quw-wa-tin in-da zil ar-shi makeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: مُّطَاعٖ ثَمَّ أَمِينٖ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: مطاع ثم امين
ayahs.translation: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
ayahs.transliteration: mu-taain sam-ma ameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجۡنُونٖ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: وما صاحبكم بمجنون
ayahs.translation: And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) ] is not [at all] mad.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa saa-hi-bu-kum bi-maj-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ رَءَاهُ بِٱلۡأُفُقِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولقد رءاه بالافق المبين
ayahs.translation: And he has already seen him [i.e., Gabriel] in the clear horizon.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-qad raaa-hu bi-lu-fu-qil mubeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلۡغَيۡبِ بِضَنِينٖ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: وما هو علي الغيب بضنين
ayahs.translation: And he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa hu-wa a-lal ghai-bi bi-daneen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَيۡطَٰنٖ رَّجِيمٖ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: وما هو بقول شيطن رجيم
ayahs.translation: And it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa hu-wa bi-qaw-li shai-taa-nir rajeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَيۡنَ تَذۡهَبُونَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: فاين تذهبون
ayahs.translation: So where are you going?
ayahs.transliteration: faay-na ta-zha-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان هو الا ذكر للعلمين
ayahs.translation: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
ayahs.transliteration: in hu-wa il-laa zik-rul li-laa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَسۡتَقِيمَ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: لمن شاء منكم ان يستقيم
ayahs.translation: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
ayahs.transliteration: li-man shaaaa min-kum ai yas-taqeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: وما تشاءون الا ان يشاء الله رب العلمين
ayahs.translation: And you do not will except that Allāh wills - Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa ta-shaaaoo-na il-laaa ai ya-shaaa al-laa-hu rab-bul aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتۡ ١
ayahs.text_simple: اذا السماء انفطرت
ayahs.translation: When the sky breaks apart
ayahs.transliteration: i-zas sa-maaaun fa-ta-rat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلۡكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتۡ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: واذا الكواكب انتثرت
ayahs.translation: And when the stars fall, scattering,
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zal ka-waa-ki-bun ta-sa-rat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلۡبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتۡ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: واذا البحار فجرت
ayahs.translation: And when the seas are erupted
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zal bi-haa-ru fuj-ji-rat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلۡقُبُورُ بُعۡثِرَتۡ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: واذا القبور بعثرت
ayahs.translation: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered [i.e., exposed],
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zal qu-boo-ru bu-si-rat

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٞ مَّا قَدَّمَتۡ وَأَخَّرَتۡ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: علمت نفس ما قدمت واخرت
ayahs.translation: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
ayahs.transliteration: a-li-mat naf-sum maa qad-da-mat waak-hkha-rat

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: يايها الانسن ما غرك بربك الكريم
ayahs.translation: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayyu-hal in-saaa-nu maa ghar-ra-ka bi-rab-bi-kal kareem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: الذي خلقك فسويك فعدلك
ayahs.translation: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee kha-la-qa-ka fa-saw-waa-ka faa-da-lak

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِيٓ أَيِّ صُورَةٖ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: في اي صورة ما شاء ركبك
ayahs.translation: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
ayahs.transliteration: feee ayye soo-ra-tim maa shaaaa rak-ka-bak

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّا بَلۡ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: كلا بل تكذبون بالدين
ayahs.translation: No! But you deny the Recompense.
ayahs.transliteration: kal-la bal tu-kaz-zi-boo-na bid-deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَحَٰفِظِينَ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: وان عليكم لحفظين
ayahs.translation: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na a-lai-kum la-haa-fizeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: كِرَامٗا كَٰتِبِينَ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: كراما كتبين
ayahs.translation: Noble and recording;
ayahs.transliteration: ki-raa-man kaa-tibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَعۡلَمُونَ مَا تَفۡعَلُونَ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: يعلمون ما تفعلون
ayahs.translation: They know whatever you do.
ayahs.transliteration: ya-la-moo-na ma taf a-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٖ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: ان الابرار لفي نعيم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal ab-raa-ra lafee naeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلۡفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمٖ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: وان الفجار لفي جحيم
ayahs.translation: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-nal fuj-jaa-ra lafee jaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: يصلونها يوم الدين
ayahs.translation: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
ayahs.transliteration: yas-law-na-haa yaw-mad deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: وما هم عنها بغائبين
ayahs.translation: And never therefrom will they be absent.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa hum a-nhaa bi-ghaaaibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: وما ادريك ما يوم الدين
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa ad-raa-ka maa yaw-mud deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: ثم ما ادريك ما يوم الدين
ayahs.translation: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma maaa ad-raa-ka maa yaw-mud deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسٞ لِّنَفۡسٖ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلَّهِ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: يوم لا تملك نفس لنفس شيا والامر يومئذ لله
ayahs.translation: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allāh.
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma laa tam-li-ku naf-sul li-naf-sin shai-anw wa-lam-ru yaw-mai-zil lil-laah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيۡلٞ لِّلۡمُطَفِّفِينَ ١
ayahs.text_simple: ويل للمطففين
ayahs.translation: Woe to those who give less [than due],
ayahs.transliteration: wai-lul lil-mu-taf-fi-feen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكۡتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُونَ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: الذين اذا اكتالوا علي الناس يستوفون
ayahs.translation: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na i-zak taa-loo a-lan naa-si yas-taw-foon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمۡ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمۡ يُخۡسِرُونَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: واذا كالوهم او وزنوهم يخسرون
ayahs.translation: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa kaa-loo-hum aw wa-za-noo-hum yuk-hsi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبۡعُوثُونَ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: الا يظن اولئك انهم مبعوثون
ayahs.translation: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
ayahs.transliteration: a-laa ya-zun-nu u-laaai-ka an-na-hum ma-boo-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِيَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: ليوم عظيم
ayahs.translation: For a tremendous Day -
ayahs.transliteration: liyaw-min azeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: يوم يقوم الناس لرب العلمين
ayahs.translation: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma ya-qoo-mun naa-su li-rab-bil aa-lameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٖ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: كلا ان كتب الفجار لفي سجين
ayahs.translation: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laaa in-na ki-taa-bal fuj-jaa-ri lafee sij-jeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٞ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: وما ادريك ما سجين
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa ad-raa-ka maa sij-jeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: كِتَٰبٞ مَّرۡقُومٞ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: كتب مرقوم
ayahs.translation: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
ayahs.transliteration: ki-taa-bum mar-qoom

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
ayahs.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
ayahs.transliteration: wai-lu-ny yaw-mai-zil lil-mu-kaz-zibeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: الذين يكذبون بيوم الدين
ayahs.translation: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na yu-kaz-zi-boo-na biyaw-mid deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: وما يكذب به الا كل معتد اثيم
ayahs.translation: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa yu-kaz-zi-bu biheee il-laa kul-lu mu-ta-din aseem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: اذا تتلي عليه ءايتنا قال اسطير الاولين
ayahs.translation: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
ayahs.transliteration: i-zaa tut-laa a-lai-hi aayaa-tu-naa qaa-la a-saa-tee-rul aw-waleen

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: كلا بل ران علي قلوبهم ما كانوا يكسبون
ayahs.translation: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laa bal raa-na a-laa qu-loo-bi-him maa kaa-noo yak-si-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ عَن رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّمَحۡجُوبُونَ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: كلا انهم عن ربهم يومئذ لمحجوبون
ayahs.translation: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laaa in-na-hum ar rab-bi-him yaw-mai-zil la-mah-joo-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمۡ لَصَالُواْ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: ثم انهم لصالوا الجحيم
ayahs.translation: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma in-na-hum la-saa-lul jaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: ثم يقال هذا الذي كنتم به تكذبون
ayahs.translation: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma yu-qaa-lu haa-zal lazee kun-tum bihee tu-kaz-zi-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: كلا ان كتب الابرار لفي عليين
ayahs.translation: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laaa in-na ki-taa-bal ab-raa-ri lafee il-liyyeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: وما ادريك ما عليون
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa ad-raa-ka maa il-liyyoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: كِتَٰبٞ مَّرۡقُومٞ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: كتب مرقوم
ayahs.translation: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
ayahs.transliteration: ki-taa-bum mar-qoom

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَشۡهَدُهُ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: يشهده المقربون
ayahs.translation: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: yas-hha-du-hul mu-qar-ra-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: ان الابرار لفي نعيم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal ab-raa-ra lafee naeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: علي الارائك ينظرون
ayahs.translation: On adorned couches, observing.
ayahs.transliteration: a-lal a-raaai-ki yan-zu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَعۡرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمۡ نَضۡرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: تعرف في وجوههم نضرة النعيم
ayahs.translation: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
ayahs.transliteration: ta-ri-fu fee wu-joo-hi-him nad-ra-tan naeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُسۡقَوۡنَ مِن رَّحِيقٖ مَّخۡتُومٍ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: يسقون من رحيق مختوم
ayahs.translation: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
ayahs.transliteration: yus-qaw-na mir rahee-qim mak-htoom

ayahs.text_uthmani: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسۡكٞۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلۡمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: ختمه مسك وفي ذلك فليتنافس المتنفسون
ayahs.translation: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
ayahs.transliteration: khi-taa-mu-hoo misk wafee zaa-li-ka fa-lya-ta-naa-fa-sil mu-ta-naa-fi-soon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسۡنِيمٍ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: ومزاجه من تسنيم
ayahs.translation: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-mi-zaa-ju-hoo min tas-neem

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَيۡنٗا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: عينا يشرب بها المقربون
ayahs.translation: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.
ayahs.transliteration: ai-naiy yas-hra-bu bi-hal mu-qar-ra-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضۡحَكُونَ ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين اجرموا كانوا من الذين ءامنوا يضحكون
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na aj-ra-moo kaa-noo mi-nal lazee-na aa-ma-noo ya-dha-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِهِمۡ يَتَغَامَزُونَ ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: واذا مروا بهم يتغامزون
ayahs.translation: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa mar-roo bi-him ya-ta-ghaa-ma-zoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ ٣١
ayahs.text_simple: واذا انقلبوا الي اهلهم انقلبوا فكهين
ayahs.translation: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zan qa-la-booo i-laaa ah-li-hi-mun qa-la-boo fa-kiheen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ ٣٢
ayahs.text_simple: واذا راوهم قالوا ان هؤلاء لضالون
ayahs.translation: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa raa-whum qaa-looo in-na haaau-laaai la-daaal-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُرۡسِلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَٰفِظِينَ ٣٣
ayahs.text_simple: وما ارسلوا عليهم حفظين
ayahs.translation: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa ur-si-loo a-lai-him haa-fizeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ ٣٤
ayahs.text_simple: فاليوم الذين ءامنوا من الكفار يضحكون
ayahs.translation: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lyaw-mal lazee-na aa-ma-noo mi-nal kuf-faa-ri ya-dha-koon

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ ٣٥
ayahs.text_simple: علي الارائك ينظرون
ayahs.translation: On adorned couches, observing.
ayahs.transliteration: a-lal a-raaai-ki yan-zu-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ ٣٦
ayahs.text_simple: هل ثوب الكفار ما كانوا يفعلون
ayahs.translation: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
ayahs.transliteration: hal suw-wi-bal kuf-faa-ru maa kaa-noo yaf a-loon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتۡ ١
ayahs.text_simple: اذا السماء انشقت
ayahs.translation: When the sky has split [open]
ayahs.transliteration: i-zas sa-maaaun shaq-qat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: واذنت لربها وحقت
ayahs.translation: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
ayahs.transliteration: waa-zi-nat li-rab-bi-haa wa-huq-qat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مُدَّتۡ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: واذا الارض مدت
ayahs.translation: And when the earth has been extended
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zal ar-du mud-dat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَلۡقَتۡ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتۡ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: والقت ما فيها وتخلت
ayahs.translation: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
ayahs.transliteration: waal-qat maa fee-haa wa-ta-khal-lat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: واذنت لربها وحقت
ayahs.translation: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] –
ayahs.transliteration: waa-zi-nat li-rab-bi-haa wa-huq-qat

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحٗا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: يايها الانسن انك كادح الي ربك كدحا فملقيه
ayahs.translation: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayyu-hal in-saa-nu in-na-ka kaa-di-hun i-laa rab-bi-ka ka-dhan fa-mu-laaqeeh

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: فاما من اوتي كتبه بيمينه
ayahs.translation: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
ayahs.transliteration: faam-maa man oo-tiya ki-taa-ba-hoo biyamee-nih

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَسَوۡفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابٗا يَسِيرٗا ٨
ayahs.text_simple: فسوف يحاسب حسابا يسيرا
ayahs.translation: He will be judged with an easy account
ayahs.transliteration: fa-saw-fa yu-haa-sa-bu hi-saa-bai ya-see-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورٗا ٩
ayahs.text_simple: وينقلب الي اهله مسرورا
ayahs.translation: And return to his people in happiness.
ayahs.transliteration: wayan-qa-li-bu i-laaa ah-lihee mas-roo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهِۦ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: واما من اوتي كتبه وراء ظهره
ayahs.translation: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
ayahs.transliteration: waam-maa man oo-tiya ki-taa-ba-hoo wa-raaaa zah-rih

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَسَوۡفَ يَدۡعُواْ ثُبُورٗا ١١
ayahs.text_simple: فسوف يدعوا ثبورا
ayahs.translation: He will cry out for destruction
ayahs.transliteration: fa-saw-fa ya-doo su-boo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَصۡلَىٰ سَعِيرًا ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: ويصلي سعيرا
ayahs.translation: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
ayahs.transliteration: wayas-laa saee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورًا ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: انه كان في اهله مسرورا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hoo kaa-na feee ah-lihee mas-roo-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: انه ظن ان لن يحور
ayahs.translation: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hoo zan-na al lai ya-hoor

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرٗا ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: بلي ان ربه كان به بصيرا
ayahs.translation: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.
ayahs.transliteration: ba-laaa in-na rab-ba-hoo kaa-na bihee basee-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: فلا اقسم بالشفق
ayahs.translation: So I swear by the twilight glow
ayahs.transliteration: fa-laaa uq-si-mu bis-hsha-faq

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيۡلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: واليل وما وسق
ayahs.translation: And [by] the night and what it envelops
ayahs.transliteration: wal-lai-li wa-maa wa-saq

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: والقمر اذا اتسق
ayahs.translation: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
ayahs.transliteration: wal-qa-ma-ri i-zat ta-saq

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَتَرۡكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٖ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: لتركبن طبقا عن طبق
ayahs.translation: [That] you will surely embark upon [i.e., experience] state after state.
ayahs.transliteration: la-tar-ka-bun-na ta-ba-qan an ta-baq

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: فما لهم لا يؤمنون
ayahs.translation: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-maa la-hum laa yu-mi-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لَا يَسۡجُدُونَۤ۩ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: واذا قرئ عليهم القرءان لا يسجدون
ayahs.translation: And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allāh]?
ayahs.transliteration: wai-zaa qu-ri-a a-lai-hi-mul qu-raa-nu laa yas-ju-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُكَذِّبُونَ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: بل الذين كفروا يكذبون
ayahs.translation: But those who have disbelieved deny,
ayahs.transliteration: ba-lil lazee-na ka-fa-roo yu-kaz-zi-boon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: والله اعلم بما يوعون
ayahs.translation: And Allāh is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-laa-hu a-la-mu bi-maa yoooon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَبَشِّرۡهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: فبشرهم بعذاب اليم
ayahs.translation: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-bas-hshi-rhum bi-a-zaa-bin aleem

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونِۭ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: الا الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم اجر غير ممنون
ayahs.translation: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
ayahs.transliteration: il-lal lazee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti la-hum aj-run ghai-ru mam-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡبُرُوجِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: والسماء ذات البروج
ayahs.translation: By the sky containing great stars
ayahs.transliteration: was-sa-maaai zaa-til bu-rooj

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡمَوۡعُودِ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: واليوم الموعود
ayahs.translation: And [by] the promised Day
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lyaw-mil ma-wood

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَشَاهِدٖ وَمَشۡهُودٖ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: وشاهد ومشهود
ayahs.translation: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-shaa-hi-dinw wa-mas-hhood

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُتِلَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأُخۡدُودِ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: قتل اصحب الاخدود
ayahs.translation: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] were the companions of the trench
ayahs.transliteration: qu-ti-la a-shaa-bul uk-hdood

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡوَقُودِ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: النار ذات الوقود
ayahs.translation: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,
ayahs.transliteration: an-naa-ri zaa-til wa-qood

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذۡ هُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا قُعُودٞ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: اذ هم عليها قعود
ayahs.translation: When they were sitting near it.
ayahs.transliteration: iz hum a-lai-haa quood

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ شُهُودٞ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: وهم علي ما يفعلون بالمؤمنين شهود
ayahs.translation: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hum a-laa maa yaf a-loo-na bil-mu-mi-nee-na shu-hood

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: وما نقموا منهم الا ان يؤمنوا بالله العزيز الحميد
ayahs.translation: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa na-qa-moo mi-nhum il-laaa ai yu-mi-noo bil-laa-hil azee-zil hameed

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: الذي له ملك السموت والارض والله علي كل شيء شهيد
ayahs.translation: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh, over all things, is Witness.
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee la-hoo mul-kus sa-maa-waa-ti wa-lard wal-laa-hu a-laa kul-li shaiin shaheed

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين فتنوا المؤمنين والمؤمنت ثم لم يتوبوا فلهم عذاب جهنم ولهم عذاب الحريق
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na fa-ta-nul mu-mi-nee-na wal-mu-mi-naa-ti sum-ma lam ya-too-boo fa-la-hum a-zaa-bu ja-han-na-ma wa-la-hum a-zaa-bul hareeq

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر ذلك الفوز الكبير
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti la-hum jan-naa-tun taj-ree min tah-ti-hal a-nhaar zaa-li-kal faw-zul kabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ بَطۡشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: ان بطش ربك لشديد
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the assault [i.e., vengeance] of your Lord is severe.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na bat-sha rab-bi-ka la-shadeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبۡدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: انه هو يبدئ ويعيد
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hoo hu-wa yub-diu wayueed

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلۡوَدُودُ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: وهو الغفور الودود
ayahs.translation: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hu-wal gha-foo-rul wa-dood

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذُو ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡمَجِيدُ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: ذو العرش المجيد
ayahs.translation: Honorable Owner of the Throne,
ayahs.transliteration: zul ar-shil majeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَعَّالٞ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: فعال لما يريد
ayahs.translation: Effecter of what He intends.
ayahs.transliteration: faaa-lul li-maa yu-reed

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلۡجُنُودِ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: هل اتيك حديث الجنود
ayahs.translation: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
ayahs.transliteration: hal a-taa-ka hadee-sul ju-nood

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَثَمُودَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: فرعون وثمود
ayahs.translation: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamūd?
ayahs.transliteration: fi-raw-na wa-sa-mood

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي تَكۡذِيبٖ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: بل الذين كفروا في تكذيب
ayahs.translation: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
ayahs.transliteration: ba-lil lazee-na ka-fa-roo fee tak-zeeb

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطُۢ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: والله من ورائهم محيط
ayahs.translation: While Allāh encompasses them from behind.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-laa-hu minw wa-raaai-him muheet

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ هُوَ قُرۡءَانٞ مَّجِيدٞ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: بل هو قرءان مجيد
ayahs.translation: But this is an honored Qur’ān
ayahs.transliteration: bal hu-wa qu-raa-num majeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي لَوۡحٖ مَّحۡفُوظِۭ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: في لوح محفوظ
ayahs.translation: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.
ayahs.transliteration: fee la-whim mah-fooz

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: والسماء والطارق
ayahs.translation: By the sky and the knocker
ayahs.transliteration: was-sa-maaai wat-taa-riq

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: وما ادريك ما الطارق
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is the knocker?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa ad-raa-ka mat taa-riq

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلنَّجۡمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: النجم الثاقب
ayahs.translation: It is the piercing star.
ayahs.transliteration: an-naj-mus saa-qib

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِن كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظٞ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان كل نفس لما عليها حافظ
ayahs.translation: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
ayahs.transliteration: in kul-lu naf-sil lam-maa a-lai-haa haa-fiz

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلۡيَنظُرِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: فلينظر الانسن مم خلق
ayahs.translation: So let man observe from what he was created.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lyan-zu-ril in-saa-nu mim-ma khu-liq

ayahs.text_uthmani: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٖ دَافِقٖ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: خلق من ماء دافق
ayahs.translation: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
ayahs.transliteration: khu-li-qa mim maaain daa-fiq

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَخۡرُجُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ ٱلصُّلۡبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: يخرج من بين الصلب والترائب
ayahs.translation: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
ayahs.transliteration: yak-hru-ju mim bai-nis-sul-bi wat ta-raaaib

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجۡعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٞ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: انه علي رجعه لقادر
ayahs.translation: Indeed, He [i.e., Allāh], to return him [to life], is Able.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hoo a-laa ra-jihee la-qaa-dir

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ تُبۡلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: يوم تبلي السرائر
ayahs.translation: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-ma tub-las sa-raaair

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٖ وَلَا نَاصِرٖ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: فما له من قوة ولا ناصر
ayahs.translation: Then he [i.e., man] will have no power or any helper.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-maa la-hoo min quw-wa-tinw wa-laa naa-sir

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجۡعِ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: والسماء ذات الرجع
ayahs.translation: By the sky which sends back
ayahs.transliteration: was-sa-maaai zaa-tir raj

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدۡعِ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: والارض ذات الصدع
ayahs.translation: And [by] the earth which splits,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lar-di zaa-tis sad

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلٞ فَصۡلٞ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: انه لقول فصل
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a decisive statement,
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hoo la-qaw-lun fasl

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلۡهَزۡلِ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: وما هو بالهزل
ayahs.translation: And it is not amusement.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa hu-wa bi-lhazl

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمۡ يَكِيدُونَ كَيۡدٗا ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: انهم يكيدون كيدا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they are planning a plan,
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-hum ya-kee-doo-na kai-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَكِيدُ كَيۡدٗا ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: واكيد كيدا
ayahs.translation: But I am planning a plan.
ayahs.transliteration: waakee-du kai-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ أَمۡهِلۡهُمۡ رُوَيۡدَۢا ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: فمهل الكفرين امهلهم رويدا
ayahs.translation: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ma-hhi-lil kaa-fi-ree-na a-mhi-lhum ru-wai-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَبِّحِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَى ١
ayahs.text_simple: سبح اسم ربك الاعلي
ayahs.translation: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
ayahs.transliteration: sab-bih is-ma rab-bi-kal a-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: الذي خلق فسوي
ayahs.translation: Who created and proportioned
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee kha-la-qa fa-saw-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: والذي قدر فهدي
ayahs.translation: And who destined and [then] guided
ayahs.transliteration: wal-lazee qad-da-ra fa-ha-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَخۡرَجَ ٱلۡمَرۡعَىٰ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: والذي اخرج المرعي
ayahs.translation: And who brings out the pasture
ayahs.transliteration: wal-lazeee ak-hra-jal ma-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحۡوَىٰ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: فجعله غثاء احوي
ayahs.translation: And [then] makes it black stubble.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-jaa-la-hoo ghu-saaaan ah-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَنُقۡرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: سنقرئك فلا تنسي
ayahs.translation: We will make you recite, [O Muḥammad], and you will not forget,
ayahs.transliteration: sa-nuq-riu-ka fa-laa tan-saaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡجَهۡرَ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: الا ما شاء الله انه يعلم الجهر وما يخفي
ayahs.translation: Except what Allāh should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa maa shaaaal laah in-na-hoo ya-la-mul jah-ra wa-maa yak-hfaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلۡيُسۡرَىٰ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: ونيسرك لليسري
ayahs.translation: And We will ease you toward ease.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-nuyas-si-ru-ka li-lyus-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرۡ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: فذكر ان نفعت الذكري
ayahs.translation: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
ayahs.transliteration: fa-zak-kir in na-faa-tiz zik-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخۡشَىٰ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: سيذكر من يخشي
ayahs.translation: He who fears [Allāh] will be reminded.
ayahs.transliteration: sayaz-zak-ka-ru mai yak-hshaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلۡأَشۡقَى ١١
ayahs.text_simple: ويتجنبها الاشقي
ayahs.translation: But the wretched one will avoid it –
ayahs.transliteration: waya-ta-jan-na-bu-hal as-hqaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي يَصۡلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: الذي يصلي النار الكبري
ayahs.translation: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee yas-lan naa-ral kub-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: ثم لا يموت فيها ولا يحيي
ayahs.translation: Neither dying therein nor living.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma laa ya-moo-tu fee-haa wa-laa ya-hyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: قد افلح من تزكي
ayahs.translation: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
ayahs.transliteration: qad af-la-ha man ta-zak-kaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَذَكَرَ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: وذكر اسم ربه فصلي
ayahs.translation: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-za-ka-ras ma rab-bihee fa-sal-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: بَلۡ تُؤۡثِرُونَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: بل تؤثرون الحيوة الدنيا
ayahs.translation: But you prefer the worldly life,
ayahs.transliteration: bal tu-si-roo-nal hayaa-tad du-nyaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: والاخرة خير وابقي
ayahs.translation: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa-khi-ra-tu khai-runw waab-qaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِي ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: ان هذا لفي الصحف الاولي
ayahs.translation: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
ayahs.transliteration: in-na haa-zaa la-fis su-hu-fil oo-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: صُحُفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: صحف ابرهيم وموسي
ayahs.translation: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
ayahs.transliteration: su-hu-fi ib-raa-hee-ma wa-moo-saa

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلۡغَٰشِيَةِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: هل اتيك حديث الغشية
ayahs.translation: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
ayahs.transliteration: hal a-taa-ka hadee-sul ghaa-shiyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: وجوه يومئذ خشعة
ayahs.translation: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
ayahs.transliteration: wu-joo-hu-ny yaw-mai-zin khaa-shi-ah

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَامِلَةٞ نَّاصِبَةٞ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: عاملة ناصبة
ayahs.translation: Working [hard] and exhausted.
ayahs.transliteration: aa-mi-la-tun naa-si-bah

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَصۡلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةٗ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: تصلي نارا حامية
ayahs.translation: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
ayahs.transliteration: tas-laa naa-ran haa-miyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: تُسۡقَىٰ مِنۡ عَيۡنٍ ءَانِيَةٖ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: تسقي من عين ءانية
ayahs.translation: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.
ayahs.transliteration: tus-qaa min ay-nin aa-niyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٖ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: ليس لهم طعام الا من ضريع
ayahs.translation: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
ayahs.transliteration: lai-sa la-hum taaa-mun il-laa min daree

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا يُسۡمِنُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِن جُوعٖ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: لا يسمن ولا يغني من جوع
ayahs.translation: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
ayahs.transliteration: laa yus-mi-nu wa-laa yug-hnee min joo

ayahs.text_uthmani: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ نَّاعِمَةٞ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: وجوه يومئذ ناعمة
ayahs.translation: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
ayahs.transliteration: wu-joo-hu-ny yaw-mai-zin naai-mah

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِّسَعۡيِهَا رَاضِيَةٞ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: لسعيها راضية
ayahs.translation: With their effort [they are] satisfied
ayahs.transliteration: li-sayi-haa raa-diyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٖ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: في جنة عالية
ayahs.translation: In an elevated garden,
ayahs.transliteration: fee jan-na-tin aa-liyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا تَسۡمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةٗ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: لا تسمع فيها لغية
ayahs.translation: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
ayahs.transliteration: laa tas-mau fee-haa laa-ghiyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِيهَا عَيۡنٞ جَارِيَةٞ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: فيها عين جارية
ayahs.translation: Within it is a flowing spring.
ayahs.transliteration: fee-haa ay-nun jaa-riyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِيهَا سُرُرٞ مَّرۡفُوعَةٞ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: فيها سرر مرفوعة
ayahs.translation: Within it are couches raised high
ayahs.transliteration: fee-haa su-ru-rum mar-foo-ah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَكۡوَابٞ مَّوۡضُوعَةٞ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: واكواب موضوعة
ayahs.translation: And cups put in place
ayahs.transliteration: waak-waa-bum maw-zoo-ah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصۡفُوفَةٞ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: ونمارق مصفوفة
ayahs.translation: And cushions lined up
ayahs.transliteration: wa-na-maa-ri-qu mas-foo-fah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَزَرَابِيُّ مَبۡثُوثَةٌ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: وزرابي مبثوثة
ayahs.translation: And carpets spread around.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-za-raa-biyyu mab-soo-sah

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِبِلِ كَيۡفَ خُلِقَتۡ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: افلا ينظرون الي الابل كيف خلقت
ayahs.translation: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-laa yan-zu-roo-na i-lal i-bi-li kai-fa khu-li-qat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيۡفَ رُفِعَتۡ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: والي السماء كيف رفعت
ayahs.translation: And at the sky - how it is raised?
ayahs.transliteration: wai-las sa-maaai kai-fa ru-fi-at

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلۡجِبَالِ كَيۡفَ نُصِبَتۡ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: والي الجبال كيف نصبت
ayahs.translation: And at the mountains - how they are erected?
ayahs.transliteration: wai-lal ji-baa-li kai-fa nu-si-bat

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَيۡفَ سُطِحَتۡ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: والي الارض كيف سطحت
ayahs.translation: And at the earth - how it is spread out?
ayahs.transliteration: wai-lal ar-di kai-fa su-ti-hat

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٞ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: فذكر انما انت مذكر
ayahs.translation: So remind, [O Muḥammad]; you are only a reminder.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-zak-kir in-na-ma an-ta mu-zak-kir

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّسۡتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِمُصَيۡطِرٍ ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: لست عليهم بمصيطر
ayahs.translation: You are not over them a controller.
ayahs.transliteration: las-ta a-lai-him bi-mu-sai-tir

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: الا من تولي وكفر
ayahs.translation: However, he who turns away and disbelieves –
ayahs.transliteration: il-laa man ta-wal-laa wa-ka-far

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَكۡبَرَ ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: فيعذبه الله العذاب الاكبر
ayahs.translation: Then Allāh will punish him with the greatest punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: fayu-a-zzi-bu-hul laa-hul a-zaa-bal ak-bar

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ إِلَيۡنَآ إِيَابَهُمۡ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: ان الينا ايابهم
ayahs.translation: Indeed, to Us is their return.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa i-lai-naaa iyaa-ba-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا حِسَابَهُم ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: ثم ان علينا حسابهم
ayahs.translation: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma in-na a-lai-naa hi-saa-ba-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡفَجۡرِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: والفجر
ayahs.translation: By the dawn
ayahs.transliteration: wal-fajr

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَيَالٍ عَشۡرٖ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: وليال عشر
ayahs.translation: And [by] ten nights
ayahs.transliteration: wa-layaa-lin ashr

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلشَّفۡعِ وَٱلۡوَتۡرِ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: والشفع والوتر
ayahs.translation: And [by] the even [number] and the odd
ayahs.transliteration: was-hsha-fi wal-watr

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَسۡرِ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: واليل اذا يسر
ayahs.translation: And [by] the night when it passes,
ayahs.transliteration: wal-lai-li i-zaa yasr

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَلۡ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٞ لِّذِي حِجۡرٍ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: هل في ذلك قسم لذي حجر
ayahs.translation: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
ayahs.transliteration: hal fee zaa-li-ka qa-sa-mul lizee hijr

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: الم تر كيف فعل ربك بعاد
ayahs.translation: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ʿAad -
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam ta-ra kai-fa faa-la rab-bu-ka bi-a-ad

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلۡعِمَادِ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ارم ذات العماد
ayahs.translation: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,
ayahs.transliteration: i-ra-maa zaa-til i-maad

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّتِي لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: التي لم يخلق مثلها في البلد
ayahs.translation: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
ayahs.transliteration: al-latee lam yuk-hlaq mis-lu-haa fil bi-laad

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُواْ ٱلصَّخۡرَ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: وثمود الذين جابوا الصخر بالواد
ayahs.translation: And [with] Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-sa-moo-dal lazee-na jaa-bus sak-hra bil-waad

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ ذِي ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: وفرعون ذي الاوتاد
ayahs.translation: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-fi-raw-na zil aw-taad

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: الذين طغوا في البلد
ayahs.translation: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na ta-ghaw fil bi-laad

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَكۡثَرُواْ فِيهَا ٱلۡفَسَادَ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: فاكثروا فيها الفساد
ayahs.translation: And increased therein the corruption.
ayahs.transliteration: faak-sa-roo fee-hal fa-saad

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَصَبَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّكَ سَوۡطَ عَذَابٍ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: فصب عليهم ربك سوط عذاب
ayahs.translation: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-sab-ba a-lai-him rab-bu-ka saw-ta a-zaab

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلۡمِرۡصَادِ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان ربك لبالمرصاد
ayahs.translation: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na rab-ba-ka la-bil-mir-saad

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: فاما الانسن اذا ما ابتليه ربه فاكرمه ونعمه فيقول ربي اكرمن
ayahs.translation: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
ayahs.transliteration: faam-mal in-saa-nu i-zaa mab ta-laa-hu rab-bu-hoo faak-ra-ma-hoo wa-naa-ma-hoo faya-qoo-lu rab-beee ak-ra-man

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: واما اذا ما ابتليه فقدر عليه رزقه فيقول ربي اهنن
ayahs.translation: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
ayahs.transliteration: waam-maaa i-zaa mab ta-laa-hu fa-qa-da-ra a-lai-hi riz-qa-hoo faya-qoo-lu rab-beee a-haa-nan

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّاۖ بَل لَّا تُكۡرِمُونَ ٱلۡيَتِيمَ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: كلا بل لا تكرمون اليتيم
ayahs.translation: No! But you do not honor the orphan
ayahs.transliteration: kal-la bal laa tuk-ri-mooo-nal ya-teem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: ولا تحضون علي طعام المسكين
ayahs.translation: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa ta-haaad-doo-na a-laa taaa-mil mis-keen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكۡلٗا لَّمّٗا ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: وتاكلون التراث اكلا لما
ayahs.translation: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-taa-ku-loo-nat tu-raa-sa ak-lal lam-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡمَالَ حُبّٗا جَمّٗا ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: وتحبون المال حبا جما
ayahs.translation: And you love wealth with immense love.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-tu-hib-boo-nal maa-la hub-ban jam-maa

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّآۖ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ دَكّٗا دَكّٗا ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: كلا اذا دكت الارض دكا دكا
ayahs.translation: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laaa i-zaaa duk-ka-til ar-du dak-kan dak-ka

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلۡمَلَكُ صَفّٗا صَفّٗا ٢٢
ayahs.text_simple: وجاء ربك والملك صفا صفا
ayahs.translation: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-jaaaa rab-bu-ka wal-ma-la-ku saf-fan saf-faa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ ٢٣
ayahs.text_simple: وجايء يومئذ بجهنم يومئذ يتذكر الانسن واني له الذكري
ayahs.translation: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but how [i.e., what good] to him will be the remembrance?
ayahs.transliteration: wajeeea yaw-mai-zim bi-ja-han-nnam yaw-mai-zi-ny ya-ta-zak-ka-rul in-saa-nu waan-naa la-huz zik-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي قَدَّمۡتُ لِحَيَاتِي ٢٤
ayahs.text_simple: يقول يليتني قدمت لحياتي
ayahs.translation: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."
ayahs.transliteration: ya-qoo-lu yaa-lai-tanee qad-dam-tu li-hayaatee

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٞ ٢٥
ayahs.text_simple: فيومئذ لا يعذب عذابه احد
ayahs.translation: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
ayahs.transliteration: fayaw-mai-zil laa yu-a-zzi-bu a-zaa-ba-hooo a-had

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٞ ٢٦
ayahs.text_simple: ولا يوثق وثاقه احد
ayahs.translation: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa yoo-si-qu wa-saa-qa-hooo a-had

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفۡسُ ٱلۡمُطۡمَئِنَّةُ ٢٧
ayahs.text_simple: يايتها النفس المطمئنة
ayahs.translation: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,
ayahs.transliteration: yaaaayya-tu-han naf-sul mut-main-nah

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱرۡجِعِيٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةٗ مَّرۡضِيَّةٗ ٢٨
ayahs.text_simple: ارجعي الي ربك راضية مرضية
ayahs.translation: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
ayahs.transliteration: ir-jieee i-laa rab-bi-ki raa-diya-tam mar-diyyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱدۡخُلِي فِي عِبَٰدِي ٢٩
ayahs.text_simple: فادخلي في عبدي
ayahs.translation: And enter among My [righteous] servants
ayahs.transliteration: fad-khulee fee i-baadee

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱدۡخُلِي جَنَّتِي ٣٠
ayahs.text_simple: وادخلي جنتي
ayahs.translation: And enter My Paradise."
ayahs.transliteration: wad-khulee jan-natee

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: لا اقسم بهذا البلد
ayahs.translation: I swear by this city [i.e., Makkah] –
ayahs.transliteration: laaa uq-si-mu bi-haa-zal ba-lad

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَنتَ حِلُّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: وانت حل بهذا البلد
ayahs.translation: And you, [O Muḥammad], are free of restriction in this city –
ayahs.transliteration: waan-ta hil-lum bi-haa-zal ba-lad

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَوَالِدٖ وَمَا وَلَدَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: ووالد وما ولد
ayahs.translation: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
ayahs.transliteration: wa-waa-li-dinw wa-maa wa-lad

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِي كَبَدٍ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: لقد خلقنا الانسن في كبد
ayahs.translation: We have certainly created man into hardship.
ayahs.transliteration: la-qad kha-laq-nal in-saa-na fee ka-bad

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدٞ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: ايحسب ان لن يقدر عليه احد
ayahs.translation: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
ayahs.transliteration: ayah-sa-bu al lai yaq-di-ra a-lai-hi a-had

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَقُولُ أَهۡلَكۡتُ مَالٗا لُّبَدًا ٦
ayahs.text_simple: يقول اهلكت مالا لبدا
ayahs.translation: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
ayahs.transliteration: ya-qoo-lu ah-lak-tu maa-lal lu-ba-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّمۡ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ايحسب ان لم يره احد
ayahs.translation: Does he think that no one has seen him?
ayahs.transliteration: ayah-sa-bu al lam ya-ra-hooo a-had

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ عَيۡنَيۡنِ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: الم نجعل له عينين
ayahs.translation: Have We not made for him two eyes?
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam na-jal la-hoo ay-nayn

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلِسَانٗا وَشَفَتَيۡنِ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: ولسانا وشفتين
ayahs.translation: And a tongue and two lips?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-li-saa-nanw wa-sha-fa-tayn

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجۡدَيۡنِ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: وهدينه النجدين
ayahs.translation: And have shown him the two ways?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ha-day-naa-hun naj-dayn

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلَا ٱقۡتَحَمَ ٱلۡعَقَبَةَ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: فلا اقتحم العقبة
ayahs.translation: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-laq ta-ha-mal a-qa-bah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡعَقَبَةُ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: وما ادريك ما العقبة
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maaa ad-raa-ka mal a-qa-bah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: فك رقبة
ayahs.translation: It is the freeing of a slave
ayahs.transliteration: fak-ku ra-qa-bah

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوۡ إِطۡعَٰمٞ فِي يَوۡمٖ ذِي مَسۡغَبَةٖ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: او اطعم في يوم ذي مسغبة
ayahs.translation: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
ayahs.transliteration: aw i-taa-mun fee yaw-min zee mas-gha-bah

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَتِيمٗا ذَا مَقۡرَبَةٍ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: يتيما ذا مقربة
ayahs.translation: An orphan of near relationship
ayahs.transliteration: ya-tee-man zaa maq-ra-bah

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوۡ مِسۡكِينٗا ذَا مَتۡرَبَةٖ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: او مسكينا ذا متربة
ayahs.translation: Or a needy person in misery
ayahs.transliteration: aw mis-kee-nan zaa mat-ra-bah

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡمَرۡحَمَةِ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: ثم كان من الذين ءامنوا وتواصوا بالصبر وتواصوا بالمرحمة
ayahs.translation: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
ayahs.transliteration: sum-ma kaa-na mi-nal lazee-na aa-ma-noo wa-ta-waa-saw bis-sab-ri wa-ta-waa-saw bil-ma-rha-mah

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: اولئك اصحب الميمنة
ayahs.translation: Those are the companions of the right.
ayahs.transliteration: u-laaai-ka a-shaa-bul mai-ma-nah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: والذين كفروا بايتنا هم اصحب المشمة
ayahs.translation: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
ayahs.transliteration: wal-la-zee-na ka-fa-roo bi-a-ayaa-ti-naa hum a-shaa-bul ma-sha-mah

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَارٞ مُّؤۡصَدَةُۢ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: عليهم نار مؤصدة
ayahs.translation: Over them will be fire closed in.
ayahs.transliteration: a-lai-him naa-rum mu-sa-dah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلشَّمۡسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا ١
ayahs.text_simple: والشمس وضحيها
ayahs.translation: By the sun and its brightness
ayahs.transliteration: was-hsham-si wa-du-haa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا ٢
ayahs.text_simple: والقمر اذا تليها
ayahs.translation: And [by] the moon when it follows it
ayahs.transliteration: wal-qa-ma-ri i-zaa ta-laa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا ٣
ayahs.text_simple: والنهار اذا جليها
ayahs.translation: And [by] the day when it displays it
ayahs.transliteration: wan-na-haa-ri i-zaa jal-laa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَغۡشَىٰهَا ٤
ayahs.text_simple: واليل اذا يغشيها
ayahs.translation: And [by] the night when it covers [i.e., conceals] it
ayahs.transliteration: wal-lai-li i-zaa yag-hshaa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا ٥
ayahs.text_simple: والسماء وما بنيها
ayahs.translation: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
ayahs.transliteration: was-sa-maaai wa-maa ba-naa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا ٦
ayahs.text_simple: والارض وما طحيها
ayahs.translation: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lar-di wa-maa ta-haa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَنَفۡسٖ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ونفس وما سويها
ayahs.translation: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
ayahs.transliteration: wa-naf-sinw wa-maa saw-waa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَلۡهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقۡوَىٰهَا ٨
ayahs.text_simple: فالهمها فجورها وتقويها
ayahs.translation: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
ayahs.transliteration: faa-lha-ma-haa fu-joo-ra-haa wa-taq-waa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا ٩
ayahs.text_simple: قد افلح من زكيها
ayahs.translation: He has succeeded who purifies it,
ayahs.transliteration: qad af-la-ha man zak-kaa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: وقد خاب من دسيها
ayahs.translation: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qad khaa-ba man das-saa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِطَغۡوَىٰهَآ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: كذبت ثمود بطغويها
ayahs.translation: Thamūd denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
ayahs.transliteration: kaz-za-bat sa-moo-du bi-tag-hwaa-haaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشۡقَىٰهَا ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: اذ انبعث اشقيها
ayahs.translation: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
ayahs.transliteration: i-zim baa-sa as-hqaa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقۡيَٰهَا ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: فقال لهم رسول الله ناقة الله وسقيها
ayahs.translation: And the messenger of Allāh [i.e., Ṣāliḥ] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allāh or [prevent her from] her drink."
ayahs.transliteration: fa-qaa-la la-hum ra-soo-lul laa-hi naa-qa-tal laa-hi wa-su-qiyaa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّىٰهَا ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: فكذبوه فعقروها فدمدم عليهم ربهم بذنبهم فسويها
ayahs.translation: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
ayahs.transliteration: fa-kaz-za-boo-hu faa-qa-roo-haa fa-dam-da-ma a-lai-him rab-bu-hum bi-zam-bi-him fa-saw-waa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقۡبَٰهَا ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولا يخاف عقبها
ayahs.translation: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa ya-khaa-fu uq-baa-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَغۡشَىٰ ١
ayahs.text_simple: واليل اذا يغشي
ayahs.translation: By the night when it covers
ayahs.transliteration: wal-lai-li i-zaa yag-hshaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: والنهار اذا تجلي
ayahs.translation: And [by] the day when it appears
ayahs.transliteration: wan-na-haa-ri i-zaa ta-jal-la

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰٓ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: وما خلق الذكر والانثي
ayahs.translation: And [by] He who created the male and female,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa kha-la-qaz za-ka-ra wa-lun-thaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ سَعۡيَكُمۡ لَشَتَّىٰ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ان سعيكم لشتي
ayahs.translation: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.
