ayahs.transliteration: in-na saya-kum la-shat-taa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أَعۡطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: فاما من اعطي واتقي
ayahs.translation: As for he who gives and fears Allāh
ayahs.transliteration: faam-maa man a-taa wat-ta-qaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: وصدق بالحسني
ayahs.translation: And believes in the best [reward].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-sad-da-qa bi-lhus-naa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلۡيُسۡرَىٰ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: فسنيسره لليسري
ayahs.translation: We will ease him toward ease.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-sa-nuyas-si-ru-hoo li-lyus-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: واما من بخل واستغني
ayahs.translation: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
ayahs.transliteration: waam-maa man ba-khi-la was-tag-hnaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: وكذب بالحسني
ayahs.translation: And denies the best [reward],
ayahs.transliteration: wa-kaz-za-ba bi-lhus-naa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلۡعُسۡرَىٰ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: فسنيسره للعسري
ayahs.translation: We will ease him toward difficulty.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-sa-nuyas-si-ru-hoo li-lus-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: وما يغني عنه ماله اذا تردي
ayahs.translation: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa yug-hnee a-nhu maa-lu-hooo i-zaa ta-rad-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا لَلۡهُدَىٰ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: ان علينا للهدي
ayahs.translation: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na a-lai-naa la-lhu-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: وان لنا للاخرة والاولي
ayahs.translation: And indeed, to us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na la-naa lal aa-khi-ra-ta wa-loo-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَنذَرۡتُكُمۡ نَارٗا تَلَظَّىٰ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: فانذرتكم نارا تلظي
ayahs.translation: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
ayahs.transliteration: faan-zar-tu-kum naa-ran ta-laz-zaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَا يَصۡلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡأَشۡقَى ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: لا يصليها الا الاشقي
ayahs.translation: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one
ayahs.transliteration: laa yas-laa-haaa il-lal as-hqaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: الذي كذب وتولي
ayahs.translation: Who had denied and turned away.
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee kaz-za-ba wa-ta-wal-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلۡأَتۡقَى ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: وسيجنبها الاتقي
ayahs.translation: But the righteous one will avoid it –
ayahs.transliteration: wa-sayu-jan-nna-bu-hal at-qaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي يُؤۡتِي مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: الذي يؤتي ماله يتزكي
ayahs.translation: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee yu-tee maa-la-hoo ya-ta-zak-kaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعۡمَةٖ تُجۡزَىٰٓ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: وما لاحد عنده من نعمة تجزي
ayahs.translation: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded –
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa li-a-ha-din in-da-hoo min ni-ma-tin tuj-zaaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱبۡتِغَآءَ وَجۡهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ ٢٠
ayahs.text_simple: الا ابتغاء وجه ربه الاعلي
ayahs.translation: But only seeking the face [i.e., acceptance] of his Lord, Most High.
ayahs.transliteration: il-lab ti-ghaaaa wa-jhi rab-bi-hil a-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَسَوۡفَ يَرۡضَىٰ ٢١
ayahs.text_simple: ولسوف يرضي
ayahs.translation: And he is going to be satisfied.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-saw-fa yar-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ ١
ayahs.text_simple: والضحي
ayahs.translation: By the morning brightness
ayahs.transliteration: wad-du-haa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: واليل اذا سجي
ayahs.translation: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
ayahs.transliteration: wal-lai-li i-za sa-jaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: ما ودعك ربك وما قلي
ayahs.translation: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muḥammad], nor has He detested [you].
ayahs.transliteration: ma wad-daa-ka rab-bu-ka wa-ma qa-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرٞ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: وللاخرة خير لك من الاولي
ayahs.translation: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-laa-khi-ra-tu khai-rul la-ka mi-nal oo-la

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَسَوۡفَ يُعۡطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرۡضَىٰٓ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولسوف يعطيك ربك فترضي
ayahs.translation: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la-saw-fa yu-tee-ka rab-bu-ka fa-tar-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ يَجِدۡكَ يَتِيمٗا فَـَٔاوَىٰ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: الم يجدك يتيما فاوي
ayahs.translation: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam ya-jid-ka ya-tee-man faaa-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلّٗا فَهَدَىٰ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ووجدك ضالا فهدي
ayahs.translation: And He found you lost and guided [you],
ayahs.transliteration: wa-wa-ja-da-ka daal-lan fa-ha-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلٗا فَأَغۡنَىٰ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: ووجدك عائلا فاغني
ayahs.translation: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-wa-ja-da-ka aai-lan faag-hnaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقۡهَرۡ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: فاما اليتيم فلا تقهر
ayahs.translation: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
ayahs.transliteration: faam-mal ya-tee-ma fa-la ta-qhar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنۡهَرۡ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: واما السائل فلا تنهر
ayahs.translation: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
ayahs.transliteration: waam-mas saai-la fa-la ta-nhar

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا بِنِعۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثۡ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: واما بنعمة ربك فحدث
ayahs.translation: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
ayahs.transliteration: waam-ma bi-ni-ma-ti rab-bi-ka fa-had-dith

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ نَشۡرَحۡ لَكَ صَدۡرَكَ ١
ayahs.text_simple: الم نشرح لك صدرك
ayahs.translation: Did We not expand for you, [O Muḥammad], your breast?
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam nas-hrah la-ka sad-rak

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَوَضَعۡنَا عَنكَ وِزۡرَكَ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: ووضعنا عنك وزرك
ayahs.translation: And We removed from you your burden
ayahs.transliteration: wa-wa-da-na an-ka wiz-rak

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهۡرَكَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: الذي انقض ظهرك
ayahs.translation: Which had weighed upon your back
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee an-qa-da zah-rak

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَرَفَعۡنَا لَكَ ذِكۡرَكَ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ورفعنا لك ذكرك
ayahs.translation: And raised high for you your repute.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ra-fa-na la-ka zik-rak

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرًا ٥
ayahs.text_simple: فان مع العسر يسرا
ayahs.translation: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease [i.e., relief].
ayahs.transliteration: fain-na maal us-ri yus-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرٗا ٦
ayahs.text_simple: ان مع العسر يسرا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na maal us-ri yus-ra

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا فَرَغۡتَ فَٱنصَبۡ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: فاذا فرغت فانصب
ayahs.translation: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
ayahs.transliteration: fai-za fa-rag-hta fan-sab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرۡغَب ٨
ayahs.text_simple: والي ربك فارغب
ayahs.translation: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
ayahs.transliteration: wai-laa rab-bi-ka far-ghab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: والتين والزيتون
ayahs.translation: By the fig and the olive
ayahs.transliteration: wat-tee-ni waz-zai-toon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: وطور سينين
ayahs.translation: And [by] Mount Sinai
ayahs.transliteration: wa-too-ri sineen

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ ٱلۡأَمِينِ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: وهذا البلد الامين
ayahs.translation: And [by] this secure city [i.e., Makkah],
ayahs.transliteration: wa-haa-zal ba-la-dil ameen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: لقد خلقنا الانسن في احسن تقويم
ayahs.translation: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
ayahs.transliteration: la-qad kha-laq-nal in-saa-na fee ah-sa-ni taq-weem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ رَدَدۡنَٰهُ أَسۡفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: ثم رددنه اسفل سفلين
ayahs.translation: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
ayahs.transliteration: thum-ma ra-dad-naa-hu as-fa-la saa-fileen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: الا الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت فلهم اجر غير ممنون
ayahs.translation: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
ayahs.transliteration: il-llal lazee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti fa-la-hum aj-run ghai-ru mam-noon

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعۡدُ بِٱلدِّينِ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: فما يكذبك بعد بالدين
ayahs.translation: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
ayahs.transliteration: fa-ma yu-kaz-zi-bu-ka ba-du bid-deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحۡكَمِ ٱلۡحَٰكِمِينَ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: اليس الله باحكم الحكمين
ayahs.translation: Is not Allāh the most just of judges?
ayahs.transliteration: a-lai-sal laa-hu bi-a-hka-mil haa-kimeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱقۡرَأۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ١
ayahs.text_simple: اقرا باسم ربك الذي خلق
ayahs.translation: Recite in the name of your Lord who created –
ayahs.transliteration: iq-ra bis-mi rab-bi-kal lazee kha-laq

ayahs.text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِنۡ عَلَقٍ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: خلق الانسن من علق
ayahs.translation: Created man from a clinging substance.
ayahs.transliteration: kha-la-qal in-saa-na min a-laq

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱقۡرَأۡ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلۡأَكۡرَمُ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: اقرا وربك الاكرم
ayahs.translation: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
ayahs.transliteration: iq-ra wa-rab-bu-kal ak-ram

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِٱلۡقَلَمِ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: الذي علم بالقلم
ayahs.translation: Who taught by the pen –
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee al-la-ma bil-qa-lam

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَلَّمَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمۡ يَعۡلَمۡ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: علم الانسن ما لم يعلم
ayahs.translation: Taught man that which he knew not.
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-mal in-saa-na ma lam ya-lam

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطۡغَىٰٓ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: كلا ان الانسن ليطغي
ayahs.translation: No! [But] indeed, man transgresses
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laa in-nal in-saa-na layat-ghaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰٓ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان رءاه استغني
ayahs.translation: Because he sees himself self-sufficient.
ayahs.transliteration: ar raaa-hus tag-hnaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجۡعَىٰٓ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: ان الي ربك الرجعي
ayahs.translation: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nna i-laa rab-bi-kar ru-jaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يَنۡهَىٰ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: ارءيت الذي ينهي
ayahs.translation: Have you seen the one who forbids
ayahs.transliteration: a-raai-tal lazee ya-nhaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: عَبۡدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: عبدا اذا صلي
ayahs.translation: A servant when he prays?
ayahs.transliteration: ab-dan i-za sal-laa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: ارءيت ان كان علي الهدي
ayahs.translation: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
ayahs.transliteration: a-raai-ta in ka-na a-lal hu-daa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَوۡ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقۡوَىٰٓ ١٢
ayahs.text_simple: او امر بالتقوي
ayahs.translation: Or enjoins righteousness?
ayahs.transliteration: au a-ma-ra bit-taq-waa

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ ١٣
ayahs.text_simple: ارءيت ان كذب وتولي
ayahs.translation: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
ayahs.transliteration: a-raai-ta in kaz-za-ba wa-ta-wal-la

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ يَعۡلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ ١٤
ayahs.text_simple: الم يعلم بان الله يري
ayahs.translation: Does he not know that Allāh sees?
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam ya-lam bi-a-nnal la-haa ya-raa

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّا لَئِن لَّمۡ يَنتَهِ لَنَسۡفَعَۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ ١٥
ayahs.text_simple: كلا لئن لم ينته لنسفعا بالناصية
ayahs.translation: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock –
ayahs.transliteration: kal-la lail lam yan-ta-hi la-nas-faam bin-na-siyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: نَاصِيَةٖ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٖ ١٦
ayahs.text_simple: ناصية كذبة خاطئة
ayahs.translation: A lying, sinning forelock.
ayahs.transliteration: na-siya-tin ka-zi-ba-tin khaa-ti-ah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلۡيَدۡعُ نَادِيَهُۥ ١٧
ayahs.text_simple: فليدع ناديه
ayahs.translation: Then let him call his associates;
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lya-du naa-diyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَنَدۡعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ ١٨
ayahs.text_simple: سندع الزبانية
ayahs.translation: We will call the angels of Hell.
ayahs.transliteration: sa-na-duz za-baa-niyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّا لَا تُطِعۡهُ وَٱسۡجُدۡۤ وَٱقۡتَرِب۩ ١٩
ayahs.text_simple: كلا لا تطعه واسجد واقترب
ayahs.translation: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: kal-la la tu-ti-hu was-jud waq-ta-rib

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةِ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: انا انزلنه في ليلة القدر
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naa an-zal-naa-hu fee lai-la-til qadr

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: وما ادريك ما ليلة القدر
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa ad-raa-ka ma lai-la-tul qadr

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: ليلة القدر خير من الف شهر
ayahs.translation: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
ayahs.transliteration: lai-la-tul qad-ri khai-rum min al-fee shahr

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: تنزل الملئكة والروح فيها باذن ربهم من كل امر
ayahs.translation: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
ayahs.transliteration: ta-naz-za-lul ma-laai-ka-tu war-roo-hu fee-ha biiz-ni-rab bi-him min kul-li amr

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَلَٰمٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطۡلَعِ ٱلۡفَجۡرِ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: سلم هي حتي مطلع الفجر
ayahs.translation: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
ayahs.transliteration: sa-laa-mun hiya hat-taa mat-lail fajr

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَمۡ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ ١
ayahs.text_simple: لم يكن الذين كفروا من اهل الكتب والمشركين منفكين حتي تاتيهم البينة
ayahs.translation: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence –
ayahs.transliteration: lam ya-ku-nil lazee-na ka-fa-ru min ah-lil ki-taa-bi wal-mus-hri-kee-na mun-fak-kee-na hat-taa ta-tiya-hu-mul bayyi-nah

ayahs.text_uthmani: رَسُولٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتۡلُواْ صُحُفٗا مُّطَهَّرَةٗ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: رسول من الله يتلوا صحفا مطهرة
ayahs.translation: A Messenger from Allāh, reciting purified scriptures
ayahs.transliteration: ra-soo-lum mi-nal laa-hi yat-lu su-hu-fam mu-ta-hha-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِيهَا كُتُبٞ قَيِّمَةٞ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: فيها كتب قيمة
ayahs.translation: Within which are correct writings [i.e., rulings and laws].
ayahs.transliteration: fee-ha ku-tu-bun qaiyi-mah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: وما تفرق الذين اوتوا الكتب الا من بعد ما جاءتهم البينة
ayahs.translation: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa ta-far-ra-qal lazee-na oo-tul ki-taa-ba il-la mim ba-di ma jaaa-thu-mul baiyyi-nah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓاْ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمَةِ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: وما امروا الا ليعبدوا الله مخلصين له الدين حنفاء ويقيموا الصلوة ويؤتوا الزكوة وذلك دين القيمة
ayahs.translation: And they were not commanded except to worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakāh. And that is the correct religion.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa u-mi-roo il-la liya-bu-dul laa-ha muk-hli-see-na la-hud dee-na hu-na-faaa wayuqee-mus sa-laa-ta wayu-tuz za-kaa-ta wa-zaa-li-ka dee-nul qaiyi-mah

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ شَرُّ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين كفروا من اهل الكتب والمشركين في نار جهنم خلدين فيها اولئك هم شر البرية
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na ka-fa-ru min ah-lil ki-taa-bi wal-mus-hri-kee-na fee na-ri ja-han-na-ma khaa-li-dee-na fee-ha u-laai-ka hum shar-rul bareeyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت اولئك هم خير البرية
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal lazee-na aa-ma-nu waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti u-lai-ka hum khai-rul bareeyyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: جَزَآؤُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ رَّضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُۥ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: جزاؤهم عند ربهم جنت عدن تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها ابدا رضي الله عنهم ورضوا عنه ذلك لمن خشي ربه
ayahs.translation: Their reward with their Lord will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allāh being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
ayahs.transliteration: ja-zaau-hum in-da rab-bi-him jan-naa-tu ad-nin taj-ree min tah-ti-hal a-nhaa-ru kha-li-dee-na fee-ha a-ba-da ra-diy yal-laa-hu a-nhum wa-ra-du an zaa-li-ka li-man kha-shiya rab-bah

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذَا زُلۡزِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ زِلۡزَالَهَا ١
ayahs.text_simple: اذا زلزلت الارض زلزالها
ayahs.translation: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
ayahs.transliteration: i-zaa zul-zi-la-til ar-du zil-zaa-la-ha

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَخۡرَجَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ أَثۡقَالَهَا ٢
ayahs.text_simple: واخرجت الارض اثقالها
ayahs.translation: And the earth discharges its burdens
ayahs.transliteration: waak-hra-ja-til ar-du at-hqaa-la-ha

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا ٣
ayahs.text_simple: وقال الانسن ما لها
ayahs.translation: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -
ayahs.transliteration: wa-qaa-lal in-saa-nu ma la-ha

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَئِذٖ تُحَدِّثُ أَخۡبَارَهَا ٤
ayahs.text_simple: يومئذ تحدث اخبارها
ayahs.translation: That Day, it will report its news
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-maai-zin tu-had-di-thu ak-hbaa-ra-ha

ayahs.text_uthmani: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوۡحَىٰ لَهَا ٥
ayahs.text_simple: بان ربك اوحي لها
ayahs.translation: Because your Lord has inspired [i.e., commanded] it.
ayahs.transliteration: bi-a-nna rab-ba-ka a-whaa la-ha

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: يومئذ يصدر الناس اشتاتا ليروا اعملهم
ayahs.translation: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
ayahs.transliteration: yaw-mai-zi-ny yas-du-run naa-su as-hta-tal liyu-raw a-maa-la-hum

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: فمن يعمل مثقال ذرة خيرا يره
ayahs.translation: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-maiy ya-mal mit-hqa-la zar-ra-tin khai raiyya-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: ومن يعمل مثقال ذرة شرا يره
ayahs.translation: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maiy ya-mal mit-hqa-la zar-ra-tin shar-raiy ya-rah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبۡحٗا ١
ayahs.text_simple: والعديت ضبحا
ayahs.translation: By the racers, panting,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laa-diyaa-ti da-bha

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱلۡمُورِيَٰتِ قَدۡحٗا ٢
ayahs.text_simple: فالموريت قدحا
ayahs.translation: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
ayahs.transliteration: fal-moo-riyaa-ti qa-dha

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَٱلۡمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبۡحٗا ٣
ayahs.text_simple: فالمغيرت صبحا
ayahs.translation: And the chargers at dawn,
ayahs.transliteration: fal-mu-ghee-raa-ti su-bha

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَثَرۡنَ بِهِۦ نَقۡعٗا ٤
ayahs.text_simple: فاثرن به نقعا
ayahs.translation: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,
ayahs.transliteration: faa-thar-na bihee na-qa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَوَسَطۡنَ بِهِۦ جَمۡعًا ٥
ayahs.text_simple: فوسطن به جمعا
ayahs.translation: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-wa-sat-na bihee ja-ma

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٞ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: ان الانسن لربه لكنود
ayahs.translation: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal in-sa-na li-rab-bihee la-ka-nood

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٞ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: وانه علي ذلك لشهيد
ayahs.translation: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na-hu a-laa zaa-li-ka la-shaheed

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ لَشَدِيدٌ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: وانه لحب الخير لشديد
ayahs.translation: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
ayahs.transliteration: wain-na-hu li-hub-bil khai-ri la-shadeed

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: افلا يعلم اذا بعثر ما في القبور
ayahs.translation: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
ayahs.transliteration: a-fa-la ya-la-mu i-za bu-thi-ra ma fil qu-boor

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي ٱلصُّدُورِ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: وحصل ما في الصدور
ayahs.translation: And that within the breasts is obtained,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-hus-si-la maa fis su-door

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّخَبِيرُۢ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: ان ربهم بهم يومئذ لخبير
ayahs.translation: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Aware.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na rab-ba-hum bi-him yau-mai-zin la-khabeer

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ ١
ayahs.text_simple: القارعة
ayahs.translation: The Striking Calamity -
ayahs.transliteration: al-qaa-ri-ah

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: ما القارعة
ayahs.translation: What is the Striking Calamity?
ayahs.transliteration: mal qaa-ri-ah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: وما ادريك ما القارعة
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa ad-raa-ka mal qaa-ri-ah

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلۡفَرَاشِ ٱلۡمَبۡثُوثِ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: يوم يكون الناس كالفراش المبثوث
ayahs.translation: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
ayahs.transliteration: yau-ma ya-koo-nun naa-su kal-fa-ra-shil mab-thooth

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَتَكُونُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَٱلۡعِهۡنِ ٱلۡمَنفُوشِ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: وتكون الجبال كالعهن المنفوش
ayahs.translation: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-ta-koo-nul ji-ba-lu ka-lih-nil man-foosh

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: فاما من ثقلت موزينه
ayahs.translation: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
ayahs.transliteration: faam-ma man tha-qu-lat ma-wa-zee-nuh

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٖ رَّاضِيَةٖ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: فهو في عيشة راضية
ayahs.translation: He will be in a pleasant life.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-hu-wa fee i-sha-tir raa-diyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: واما من خفت موزينه
ayahs.translation: But as for one whose scales are light,
ayahs.transliteration: waam-ma man khaf-fat ma-wa-zee-nuh

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٞ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: فامه هاوية
ayahs.translation: His refuge will be an abyss.
ayahs.transliteration: faum-mu-hu haa-wiyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهۡ ١٠
ayahs.text_simple: وما ادريك ما هيه
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what that is?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa ad-raa-ka maa hiyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: نَارٌ حَامِيَةُۢ ١١
ayahs.text_simple: نار حامية
ayahs.translation: It is a Fire, intensely hot.
ayahs.transliteration: naa-run ha-miyah

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلۡهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ ١
ayahs.text_simple: الهيكم التكاثر
ayahs.translation: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you
ayahs.transliteration: a-lhaa-ku-mut ta-ka-thur

ayahs.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰ زُرۡتُمُ ٱلۡمَقَابِرَ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: حتي زرتم المقابر
ayahs.translation: Until you visit the graveyards.
ayahs.transliteration: hat-ta zur-tu-mul ma-qaa-bir

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّا سَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: كلا سوف تعلمون
ayahs.translation: No! You are going to know.
ayahs.transliteration: kal-la saw-fa ta-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كـَلَّا سَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ثم كلا سوف تعلمون
ayahs.translation: Then, no! You are going to know.
ayahs.transliteration: thum-ma kal-la saw-fa ta-la-moon

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّا لَوۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ عِلۡمَ ٱلۡيَقِينِ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: كلا لو تعلمون علم اليقين
ayahs.translation: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
ayahs.transliteration: kal-la law ta-la-moo-na il-mal ya-qeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: لترون الجحيم
ayahs.translation: You will surely see the Hellfire.
ayahs.transliteration: la-ta-ra-wun-nal jaheem

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيۡنَ ٱلۡيَقِينِ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ثم لترونها عين اليقين
ayahs.translation: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
ayahs.transliteration: thum-ma la-ta-ra-wun-na-ha ai-nal ya-qeen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَتُسۡـَٔلُنَّ يَوۡمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: ثم لتسلن يومئذ عن النعيم
ayahs.translation: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
ayahs.transliteration: thum-ma la-tu-sa-lun-na yau-mai-zin a-nin naeem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱلۡعَصۡرِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: والعصر
ayahs.translation: By time,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lasr

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَفِي خُسۡرٍ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: ان الانسن لفي خسر
ayahs.translation: Indeed, mankind is in loss,
ayahs.transliteration: in-nal in-saa-na lafee khusr

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: الا الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت وتواصوا بالحق وتواصوا بالصبر
ayahs.translation: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
ayahs.transliteration: il-lal lazee-na aa-ma-noo waa-mi-lus saa-li-haa-ti wa-ta-waa-saw bi-lhaq-qi wa-ta-waa-saw bis-sabr

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيۡلٞ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٖ لُّمَزَةٍ ١
ayahs.text_simple: ويل لكل همزة لمزة
ayahs.translation: Woe to every scorner and mocker
ayahs.transliteration: wai-lul li-kul-li hu-ma-za-til lu-ma-zah

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي جَمَعَ مَالٗا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: الذي جمع مالا وعدده
ayahs.translation: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee ja-maa maa-lanw waad-da-dah

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَحۡسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخۡلَدَهُۥ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: يحسب ان ماله اخلده
ayahs.translation: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
ayahs.transliteration: yah-sa-bu an-na maa-la-hooo ak-hla-dah

ayahs.text_uthmani: كـَلَّاۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِي ٱلۡحُطَمَةِ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: كلا لينبذن في الحطمة
ayahs.translation: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
ayahs.transliteration: kal-laa layum-ba-zan-na fil hu-ta-mah

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡحُطَمَةُ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: وما ادريك ما الحطمة
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
ayahs.transliteration: wa-maa ad-raa-ka mal hu-ta-mah

ayahs.text_uthmani: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُوقَدَةُ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: نار الله الموقدة
ayahs.translation: It is the fire of Allāh, [eternally] fueled,
ayahs.transliteration: naa-rul laa-hil moo-qa-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّتِي تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةِ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: التي تطلع علي الافدة
ayahs.translation: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
ayahs.transliteration: al-latee tat-ta-liu a-lal a-fi-dah

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّهَا عَلَيۡهِم مُّؤۡصَدَةٞ ٨
ayahs.text_simple: انها عليهم مؤصدة
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it [i.e., Hellfire] will be closed down upon them
ayahs.transliteration: in-na-haa a-lai-him mu-sa-da

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي عَمَدٖ مُّمَدَّدَةِۭ ٩
ayahs.text_simple: في عمد ممددة
ayahs.translation: In extended columns.
ayahs.transliteration: fee a-ma-dim mu-mad-da-dah

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡفِيلِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: الم تر كيف فعل ربك باصحب الفيل
ayahs.translation: Have you not considered, [O Muḥammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam ta-ra kai-fa faa-la rab-bu-ka bi-a-shaa-bil feel

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡ كَيۡدَهُمۡ فِي تَضۡلِيلٖ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: الم يجعل كيدهم في تضليل
ayahs.translation: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
ayahs.transliteration: a-lam ya-jal kai-da-hum fee tad-leel

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَأَرۡسَلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ طَيۡرًا أَبَابِيلَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: وارسل عليهم طيرا ابابيل
ayahs.translation: And He sent against them birds in flocks,
ayahs.transliteration: waar-sa-la a-lai-him tai-ran a-baabeel

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَرۡمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٖ مِّن سِجِّيلٖ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ترميهم بحجارة من سجيل
ayahs.translation: Striking them with stones of hard clay,
ayahs.transliteration: tar-mee-him bi-hi-jaa-ra-tim min sij-jeel

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُمۡ كَعَصۡفٖ مَّأۡكُولِۭ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: فجعلهم كعصف ماكول
ayahs.translation: And He made them like eaten straw.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-jaa-la-hum kaas-fim ma-kool

ayahs.text_uthmani: لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيۡشٍ ١
ayahs.text_simple: لايلف قريش
ayahs.translation: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
ayahs.transliteration: liee-laa-fi qu-raish

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِۦلَٰفِهِمۡ رِحۡلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيۡفِ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: الفهم رحلة الشتاء والصيف
ayahs.translation: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
ayahs.transliteration: ee-laa-fi-him rih-la-tash shi-taaai was-saif

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَلۡيَعۡبُدُواْ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: فليعبدوا رب هذا البيت
ayahs.translation: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
ayahs.transliteration: fa-lya-bu-doo rab-ba haa-zal bait

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٖ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنۡ خَوۡفِۭ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: الذي اطعمهم من جوع وءامنهم من خوف
ayahs.translation: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazeee a-ta-ma-hum min jooinw waaa-ma-na-hum min khawf

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: ارءيت الذي يكذب بالدين
ayahs.translation: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
ayahs.transliteration: a-raay-tal lazee yu-kaz-zi-bu bid-deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِي يَدُعُّ ٱلۡيَتِيمَ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: فذلك الذي يدع اليتيم
ayahs.translation: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
ayahs.transliteration: fa-zaa-li-kal lazee ya-duul ya-teem

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولا يحض علي طعام المسكين
ayahs.translation: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-la ya-hud-du a-laa taaa-mil mis-keen

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡمُصَلِّينَ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: فويل للمصلين
ayahs.translation: So woe to those who pray
ayahs.transliteration: fa-wai-lul-lil mu-sal-leen

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَن صَلَاتِهِمۡ سَاهُونَ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون
ayahs.translation: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na hum an sa-laa-ti-him saa-hoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ يُرَآءُونَ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: الذين هم يراءون
ayahs.translation: Those who make show [of their deeds]
ayahs.transliteration: al-la-zee-na hum yu-raaaoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَيَمۡنَعُونَ ٱلۡمَاعُونَ ٧
ayahs.text_simple: ويمنعون الماعون
ayahs.translation: And withhold [simple] assistance.
ayahs.transliteration: wayam-naoo-nal maaoon

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعۡطَيۡنَٰكَ ٱلۡكَوۡثَرَ ١
ayahs.text_simple: انا اعطينك الكوثر
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muḥammad], al-Kawthar.
ayahs.transliteration: in-naaa a-tai-naa kal-kau-thar

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنۡحَرۡ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: فصل لربك وانحر
ayahs.translation: So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice [to Him alone].
ayahs.transliteration: fa-sal-li li-rab-bi-ka wa-nhar

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلۡأَبۡتَرُ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: ان شانئك هو الابتر
ayahs.translation: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
ayahs.transliteration: in-na shaa-ni-a-ka hu-wal ab-tar

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ ١
ayahs.text_simple: قل يايها الكفرون
ayahs.translation: Say, "O disbelievers,
ayahs.transliteration: qul yaaaayyu-hal kaa-fi-roon

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَآ أَعۡبُدُ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: لا اعبد ما تعبدون
ayahs.translation: I do not worship what you worship.
ayahs.transliteration: laaa a-bu-du maa ta-bu-doon

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعۡبُدُ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: ولا انتم عبدون ما اعبد
ayahs.translation: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laaa an-tum aa-bi-doo-na maaa a-bud

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٞ مَّا عَبَدتُّمۡ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولا انا عابد ما عبدتم
ayahs.translation: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laaa a-na a-bi-dum maa a-bat-tum

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعۡبُدُ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: ولا انتم عبدون ما اعبد
ayahs.translation: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
ayahs.transliteration: wa-laaa an-tum aa-bi-doo-na maaa a-bud

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَكُمۡ دِينُكُمۡ وَلِيَ دِينِ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: لكم دينكم ولي دين
ayahs.translation: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
ayahs.transliteration: la-kum dee-nu-kum wa-liya deen

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصۡرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡفَتۡحُ ١
ayahs.text_simple: اذا جاء نصر الله والفتح
ayahs.translation: When the victory of Allāh has come and the conquest,
ayahs.transliteration: i-za jaaaa nas-rul laa-hi wal-fath

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَرَأَيۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجٗا ٢
ayahs.text_simple: ورايت الناس يدخلون في دين الله افواجا
ayahs.translation: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allāh in multitudes,
ayahs.transliteration: wa-raai-tan naa-sa yad-khu-loo-na fee dee-nil laa-hi af-wa-jaa

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا ٣
ayahs.text_simple: فسبح بحمد ربك واستغفره انه كان توابا
ayahs.translation: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of Repentance.
ayahs.transliteration: fa-sab-bih bi-ham-di rab-bi-ka was-tag-hfirh in-na-hoo kaa-na taw-waa-ba

ayahs.text_uthmani: تَبَّتۡ يَدَآ أَبِي لَهَبٖ وَتَبَّ ١
ayahs.text_simple: تبت يدا ابي لهب وتب
ayahs.translation: May the hands of Abū Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
ayahs.transliteration: tab-bat ya-daa abee la-ha-bin-wwa tabb

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: ما اغني عنه ماله وما كسب
ayahs.translation: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
ayahs.transliteration: maa ag-hnaa a-nhu maa-lu-hoo wa-ma ka-sab

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَيَصۡلَىٰ نَارٗا ذَاتَ لَهَبٖ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: سيصلي نارا ذات لهب
ayahs.translation: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
ayahs.transliteration: sayas-laa naa-ran zaa-ta la-hab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلۡحَطَبِ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: وامراته حمالة الحطب
ayahs.translation: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
ayahs.transliteration: wam-raa-tu-hoo ham-maa la-ta-lha-tab

ayahs.text_uthmani: فِي جِيدِهَا حَبۡلٞ مِّن مَّسَدِۭ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: في جيدها حبل من مسد
ayahs.translation: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
ayahs.transliteration: fee jee-di-haa hab-lum mim ma-sad

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ١
ayahs.text_simple: قل هو الله احد
ayahs.translation: Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One,
ayahs.transliteration: qul hu-wal laa-hu a-had

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: الله الصمد
ayahs.translation: Allāh, the Eternal Refuge.
ayahs.transliteration: al-lah hus-sa-mad

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: لم يلد ولم يولد
ayahs.translation: He neither begets nor is born,
ayahs.transliteration: lam ya-lid wa-lam yoo-lad

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ولم يكن له كفوا احد
ayahs.translation: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-lam ya-kul la-hoo ku-fu-wan a-had

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡفَلَقِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: قل اعوذ برب الفلق
ayahs.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
ayahs.transliteration: qul aoo-zu bi-rab-bil fa-laq

ayahs.text_uthmani: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: من شر ما خلق
ayahs.translation: From the evil of that which He created
ayahs.transliteration: min shar-ri maa kha-laq

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: ومن شر غاسق اذا وقب
ayahs.translation: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
ayahs.transliteration: wa-min shar-ri ghaa-si-qin i-zaa wa-qab

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِي ٱلۡعُقَدِ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: ومن شر النفثت في العقد
ayahs.translation: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
ayahs.transliteration: wa-min shar-rin naf-faa-saa-ti fil u-qad

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: ومن شر حاسد اذا حسد
ayahs.translation: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
ayahs.transliteration: wa-min shar-ri haa-si-din i-zaa ha-sad

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ١
ayahs.text_simple: قل اعوذ برب الناس
ayahs.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
ayahs.transliteration: qul aoo-zu bi-rab-bin naas

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ ٢
ayahs.text_simple: ملك الناس
ayahs.translation: The Sovereign of mankind,
ayahs.transliteration: ma-li-kin naas

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ ٣
ayahs.text_simple: اله الناس
ayahs.translation: The God of mankind,
ayahs.transliteration: i-laa-hin naas

ayahs.text_uthmani: مِن شَرِّ ٱلۡوَسۡوَاسِ ٱلۡخَنَّاسِ ٤
ayahs.text_simple: من شر الوسواس الخناس
ayahs.translation: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -
ayahs.transliteration: min shar-ril was-waa-sil khan-naas

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي يُوَسۡوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ ٥
ayahs.text_simple: الذي يوسوس في صدور الناس
ayahs.translation: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
ayahs.transliteration: al-lazee yu-was-wi-su fee su-doo-rin naas

ayahs.text_uthmani: مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ ٦
ayahs.text_simple: من الجنة والناس
ayahs.translation: From among the jinn and mankind."
ayahs.transliteration: mi-nal jin-na-ti wan-naas
